reorder.why: 總是 = always，放在動詞前；主詞 My mother 是一個人，get 要加 s：gets up。很早只要寫 early。

reorder.a: I am never late in the morning.
reorder.why: 遲到 late 是形容詞，要配 be 動詞：I am late；從不 never 放在 am 後面：I am never late。

reorder.a: She usually washes her face in the morning.
reorder.why: usually 放在動詞前；She 一個人，wash 字尾 sh 加 es：washes her face。

reorder.a: My brother gets dressed very fast.
reorder.why: 穿衣服是 get dressed；My brother 一個人，get 加 s：gets dressed very fast。

reorder.a: What time do you get up?
reorder.why: 幾點 What time + do you + 原形 get up（或 wake up）；do 不能漏。

reorder.a: What time does she get up?
reorder.why: 主詞 she 是一個人，問句用 does，後面的 get up 用原形，不加 s。

reorder.a: They get up late on Sunday.
reorder.why: They 是複數，get 不加 s；晚起是 get up late，late 放後面；星期天 on Sunday。

reading.title: 短文 1
reading.text: My name is Amy. I wake up at 6:30 every morning. First, I turn off the alarm and get up. Then I wash my face and brush my teeth. I always take a shower in the morning. After that, I get dressed and comb my hair. My mother makes breakfast for the family. We have breakfast together at 7:15. My father drinks coffee, but I drink milk. My little brother doesn't like breakfast. He always checks his phone at the table! At 7:45, we leave home and go to school and work.

qs.q: What time does Amy wake up?
qs.why: 原文：I wake up at 6:30 every morning. Amy 每天 6:30 起床。
wn: 原文說 6:30；7:15 是吃早餐的時間。

qs.q: Does Amy take a shower in the morning?
qs.why: 原文：I always take a shower in the morning. 她早上都洗澡，答 Yes。
wn: 原文說 always take a shower，她有洗。
Amy 自己說了 I always take a shower，不是不知道。

qs.q: What does Amy's father drink?
qs.why: 原文：My father drinks coffee, but I drink milk. 爸爸喝咖啡。
wn: 文中沒有提到茶；爸爸喝 coffee。
文中沒有提到水；爸爸喝 coffee。

qs.q: What does Amy's little brother do at the table?
qs.why: 原文：He always checks his phone at the table! 弟弟在餐桌上一直看手機。
wn: 文中沒說他看書，他是 checks his phone。
文中沒說他寫功課，他是 checks his phone。

qs.q: What time does the family leave home?
qs.why: 原文：At 7:45, we leave home. 7:45 出門。
wn: 7:15 是一起吃早餐的時間，不是出門。

reading.title: 短文 2
reading.text: Mei is a teacher. She wakes up at six every morning. She never uses an alarm clock. First, she washes her face and brushes her teeth. Then she gets dressed. She usually has bread and milk for breakfast. She does not drink coffee. Her husband gets up at six thirty. He makes the bed and makes tea. They have breakfast together at seven. Mei leaves home at seven thirty. On Sunday she gets up late. She sometimes stays in bed until nine.

qs.q: What time does Mei wake up?
qs.why: 原文：She wakes up at six every morning. Mei 每天六點起床。
wn: seven 是吃早餐的時間（breakfast at seven）。
六點半起床的是她先生（Her husband）。

qs.q: Does Mei use an alarm clock?
opts: Yes, she uses one every day.
qs.why: 原文：She never uses an alarm clock. never 是從來不，她不用鬧鐘。
wn: 原文說 never uses，從來不用。
never 是任何時候都不用，星期天也不用。

qs.q: What does Mei have for breakfast?
qs.why: 原文：She usually has bread and milk for breakfast. 早餐是麵包和牛奶。
wn: 文中沒有飯和湯；她吃 bread and milk。
原文說 She does not drink coffee，她不喝咖啡。

qs.q: Who makes the tea?
qs.why: 原文：Her husband… makes the bed and makes tea. 泡茶的是她先生。
wn: 文中說泡茶的是 Her husband，不是 Mei。

qs.q: What does Mei do on Sunday?
qs.why: 原文：On Sunday she gets up late. 星期天她晚起。
wn: 文中沒說她星期天上班，她 gets up late。
六點是平常的時間；星期天她 gets up late。

reading.title: 短文 3
reading.text: Jack has two children. He gets up at five thirty every morning. He is always the first person in the house. He washes his face and puts on his clothes. Then he makes breakfast for the family. His children wake up at six thirty. They brush their teeth and get dressed fast. Jack's wife does not eat breakfast. She only drinks a cup of tea. The children eat eggs and bread. They leave the house at seven fifteen. Jack often walks with them to the bus stop.

qs.q: What time does Jack get up?
qs.why: 原文：He gets up at five thirty every morning. Jack 五點半起床。
wn: 7:15 是他們出門的時間（leave the house）。
六點半起床的是小孩（His children）。

qs.q: Who makes breakfast?
qs.why: 原文：Then he makes breakfast for the family. he 是 Jack，早餐是他做的。
wn: 太太 does not eat breakfast，只喝茶，沒說她做早餐。
小孩只是刷牙、換衣服、吃早餐，不是做早餐。

qs.q: Does Jack's wife eat breakfast?
qs.why: 原文：Jack's wife does not eat breakfast. 太太只喝一杯茶。
wn: 吃蛋的是小孩；太太 does not eat breakfast。
吃麵包的是小孩；太太只喝茶。

qs.q: What do the children eat?
qs.why: 原文：The children eat eggs and bread. 小孩吃蛋和麵包。
wn: 文中沒有飯和湯；小孩吃 eggs and bread。
喝茶的是 Jack 的太太；文中沒有麵。

qs.q: Where does Jack often walk with the children?
qs.why: 原文：Jack often walks with them to the bus stop. 他常陪小孩走到公車站。
wn: 文中沒有提到商店；是 to the bus stop。
文中沒有提到公園；是 to the bus stop。

reading.title: 短文 4
reading.text: Ann and Sara live together. Ann gets up at six. She is never late. She takes a shower and washes her hair in the morning. Sara gets up at seven thirty. She does not take a shower in the morning. She takes one at night. Ann usually makes breakfast for both of them. Sara often eats her breakfast very fast. She brushes her teeth and runs to the door. On Saturday, they both get up at ten. They have a big breakfast and drink coffee at home.

qs.q: What time does Ann get up?
qs.why: 原文：Ann gets up at six. Ann 六點起床。
wn: 十點是星期六兩人一起起床的時間（On Saturday）。
七點半起床的是 Sara，不是 Ann。

qs.q: When does Sara take a shower?
qs.why: 原文：She takes one at night. one 指洗澡，Sara 晚上才洗。
wn: 早上洗澡的是 Ann；Sara 早上不洗。
原文說 Sara 早上不洗（does not… in the morning）。

qs.q: Who makes breakfast?
qs.why: 原文：Ann usually makes breakfast for both of them. 做早餐的是 Ann。
wn: Sara 只是吃得很快，早餐是 Ann 做的。
文中沒有提到媽媽；只有 Ann 和 Sara 兩人住。

qs.q: How does Sara eat her breakfast?
qs.why: 原文：Sara often eats her breakfast very fast. Sara 吃得很快。
wn: slowly 是慢；原文說 very fast，很快。
題目 How 問怎麼吃，原文說 very fast；也沒提到學校。

qs.q: What do they do on Saturday?
qs.why: 原文：On Saturday, they both get up at ten. 星期六兩人都十點起床。
wn: 六點是 Ann 平日起床；星期六是 at ten。
文中沒說星期六上班，她們在家吃大份早餐。

reading.title: 短文 1
reading.text: Tom is a student. He goes to school every day. School starts at 8 o'clock. He studies English and math in the morning. At noon, he has lunch with his friends. In the afternoon, he attends class again. Tom's sister, Mary, works in an office. She goes to work by bus. She starts work at 9 and has a meeting every Monday. She answers emails and talks to her colleagues. Mary doesn't have lunch at her desk. She finishes work at six and goes home.

qs.q: What time does school start for Tom?
qs.why: 原文：School starts at 8 o'clock. 學校八點開始上課。
wn: 文中沒有 7 點；學校是 8 o'clock 開始。
九點是 Mary 開始上班的時間，不是 Tom 上學。

qs.q: How does Mary go to work?
qs.why: 原文：She goes to work by bus. Mary 搭公車上班。
wn: 文中沒說開車；原文是 by bus。
文中沒說騎腳踏車；原文是 by bus。

qs.q: When does Mary have a meeting?
qs.why: 原文：has a meeting every Monday. Mary 每週一開會。
wn: 原文說 every Monday，是星期一，不是星期五。
原文說 every Monday，一週一次，不是每天。

qs.q: Does Mary have lunch at her desk?
qs.why: 原文：Mary doesn't have lunch at her desk. 不在桌上吃，答 No。
wn: 原文說 doesn't have lunch at her desk，是不會。
always 是總是；原文是 doesn't，剛好相反。

qs.q: What time does Mary finish work?
qs.why: 原文：She finishes work at six. Mary 六點下班。
wn: 原文說 at six，不是 five。
原文說 at six，不是 seven。

reading.title: 短文 2
reading.text: Peter works in an office. He goes to work by MRT every day. He starts work at nine. First, he reads his email. He has a meeting with his boss at ten every Monday. Peter has lunch at twelve thirty. He usually eats lunch with his friend Lin. They often buy noodles near the office. In the afternoon Peter makes phone calls. He finishes work at six. On Friday he finishes work at five. He does not work on Saturday or Sunday.

qs.q: How does Peter go to work?
qs.why: 原文：He goes to work by MRT every day. Peter 搭捷運上班。
wn: 文中沒說騎車；原文是 by MRT。
文中沒說搭公車；原文是 by MRT（捷運）。

qs.q: What time does Peter start work?
qs.why: 原文：He starts work at nine. Peter 九點開始上班。
wn: 十二點半是吃午餐的時間（lunch at twelve thirty）。
十點是星期一和老闆開會的時間。

qs.q: When does he have a meeting with his boss?
qs.why: 原文：a meeting with his boss at ten every Monday. 週一十點開會。
wn: 九點是每天開始上班，不是開會。
五點是星期五下班時間，不是開會。

reading.title: 短文 1
reading.text: Lisa comes home at six every evening. She cooks dinner for her family. They eat dinner together at seven. After dinner, Lisa's husband washes the dishes. Their children watch TV or play games. Lisa likes to read a book on the sofa. She doesn't watch TV every night. At nine, the children take a shower and brush their teeth. Lisa checks her email one more time. Then she turns off the lights and locks the door. The family goes to bed at ten o'clock.

qs.q: What time does Lisa come home?
qs.why: 原文：Lisa comes home at six every evening. Lisa 六點到家。
wn: 文中沒有五點；Lisa 是 at six 到家。
七點是全家吃晚餐的時間。

qs.q: Who washes the dishes?
qs.why: 原文：After dinner, Lisa's husband washes the dishes. 洗碗的是她先生。
wn: Lisa 是煮晚餐的人，洗碗的是 husband。
小孩是看電視或玩遊戲，不是洗碗。

qs.q: What does Lisa like to do on the sofa?
qs.why: 原文：Lisa likes to read a book on the sofa. 她喜歡在沙發上看書。
wn: Lisa doesn't watch TV every night，她愛看書。
玩遊戲的是小孩，不是 Lisa。

qs.q: What time do the children take a shower?
qs.why: 原文：At nine, the children take a shower. 小孩九點洗澡。
wn: 文中沒有八點；洗澡是 At nine。
十點是全家睡覺的時間（go to bed at ten）。

qs.q: What time does the family go to bed?
qs.why: 原文：The family goes to bed at ten o'clock. 全家十點睡覺。
wn: 九點是小孩洗澡刷牙的時間。
文中沒有十一點；睡覺是 ten o'clock。

reading.title: 短文 2
reading.text: Emma comes home at six thirty. First, she takes off her shoes and washes her hands. Then she cooks dinner for her family. Her son helps her. They have dinner at seven. After dinner, her husband washes the dishes. Emma and her son watch TV for one hour. She never watches TV after ten. She takes a shower at nine thirty. Then she reads a book in bed. Emma goes to bed at eleven. She always sleeps very well.

qs.q: What time does Emma come home?
qs.why: 原文：Emma comes home at six thirty. Emma 六點半到家。
wn: 七點是吃晚餐的時間（dinner at seven）。
九點半是她洗澡的時間。

qs.q: Who helps Emma cook dinner?
qs.why: 原文：she cooks dinner… Her son helps her. 幫忙煮飯的是兒子。
wn: 先生做的是 washes the dishes，洗碗。

qs.q: Who washes the dishes?
qs.why: 原文：After dinner, her husband washes the dishes. 洗碗的是她先生。
wn: Emma 是煮晚餐，飯後是看電視，不是洗碗。
兒子是幫忙煮飯，飯後和 Emma 看電視。

qs.q: Does Emma watch TV after ten?
qs.why: 原文：She never watches TV after ten. never 是從不，十點後不看電視。
wn: sometimes 是有時；原文是 never，一次都不會。
always 是總是，和原文的 never 剛好相反。

qs.q: What does Emma do in bed?
qs.why: 原文：Then she reads a book in bed. 她在床上看書。
wn: 煮飯是在晚餐前，不是在床上。
看電視是和兒子在晚餐後，在床上她是看書。

reading.title: 短文 3
reading.text: David lives alone. He gets home at eight because he works late. He does not cook. He usually buys dinner near his house. He often eats noodles or a lunch box. After dinner he takes a shower. Then he calls his mother. They talk for ten minutes. David watches a movie on his computer. He does not have a TV. On Friday night he meets his friends. They eat dinner together. David goes to bed at midnight.

qs.q: What time does David get home?
qs.why: 原文：He gets home at eight because he works late. David 八點到家。
wn: 原文說 at eight，不是七點。
原文說 at eight，不是六點。

qs.q: Does David cook dinner?
qs.why: 原文：He does not cook. He usually buys dinner. 他不煮，用買的。
wn: 原文說 He does not cook，他不煮飯。
星期五是和朋友一起吃，沒說他煮；原文說 He does not cook。

qs.q: Who does he call after his shower?
qs.why: 原文：he takes a shower. Then he calls his mother. 洗完澡打給媽媽。
wn: 朋友是星期五晚上見面，洗澡後打的是媽媽。

qs.q: Does David have a TV?
qs.why: 原文：He does not have a TV. 他沒有電視，答 No, he doesn't.
wn: 原文說 does not have a TV，他沒有。
他一台都沒有，他是用電腦看電影。

qs.q: What does David do on Friday night?
qs.why: 原文：On Friday night he meets his friends. 星期五晚上他和朋友見面。
wn: works late 是平常晚到家的原因，不是週五晚上的活動。
文中說他 midnight 才睡，沒說早睡。

reading.title: 短文 4
reading.text: The Lin family has a busy evening. Mr. Lin comes home at six. Mrs. Lin comes home at six thirty. Their daughter finishes school at five, so she comes home first. Mr. Lin cooks dinner. He is a good cook. They all have dinner at seven. Their daughter does her homework after dinner. Mr. and Mrs. Lin watch the news on TV. They never watch TV in the morning. Everybody takes a shower before bed. The daughter goes to bed at nine thirty.

qs.q: Who comes home first?
qs.why: 原文：Their daughter… comes home first. 女兒五點放學，最早到家。
wn: 林太太六點半才到家，是最晚的。
林先生六點到家，女兒五點放學，比他早。

qs.q: Who cooks dinner?
qs.why: 原文：Mr. Lin cooks dinner. He is a good cook. 煮晚餐的是林先生。
wn: 文中說 Mr. Lin cooks dinner，不是林太太。
女兒飯後寫功課，沒說她煮飯。

qs.q: What does the daughter do after dinner?
qs.why: 原文：Their daughter does her homework after dinner. 女兒飯後寫功課。
wn: 她九點半才睡，飯後是先寫功課。
看新聞的是林先生和林太太，不是女兒。

qs.q: When do Mr. and Mrs. Lin watch TV?
qs.why: 原文：Mr. and Mrs. Lin watch the news on TV. 這是晚餐後的事，所以是晚上。
wn: 原文說 They never watch TV in the morning。
文中沒有提到中午；他們是晚餐後看電視。

qs.q: What time does the daughter go to bed?
qs.why: 原文：The daughter goes to bed at nine thirty. 女兒九點半睡。
wn: 七點是全家吃晚餐的時間。
六點是林先生到家的時間。

writing.prompt: 請用今天學到的字彙和現在簡單式，寫3到5句英文，描述你的晚間作息。
writing.sample: I come home at six thirty. I cook dinner and eat with my family. After dinner, I watch TV and read a book. I take a shower at nine. I go to bed at eleven.

writing.prompt: 用 3-5 句英文寫出你平常的晚間作息（幾點回家、吃什麼、幾點睡覺）。
writing.sample: I come home at seven every evening. I cook dinner and eat with my family. After dinner, I watch TV for one hour. I take a shower at ten. I go to bed at eleven.

writing.prompt: 用 3-5 句英文介紹家人的晚間作息（請用第三人稱，動詞記得加 -s）。
writing.sample: My father comes home at six thirty. He always cooks dinner for us. My mother washes the dishes after dinner. She often reads a book before bed. They go to bed at ten thirty.

writing.prompt: 用 3-5 句英文，並使用頻率副詞（always / usually / often / sometimes / never）寫出你晚上的習慣。
writing.sample: I always take a shower before bed. I often watch TV after dinner. I sometimes call my mother at nine. I never drink coffee at night. I usually go to bed at eleven.

姊姊＝older sister。例句：That is her older sister.

小孩＝child。例句：She has one child.
girl＝女孩。例句：That girl is my daughter.
爺爺／外公＝grandfather。例句：This is my grandfather.

pretty＝漂亮的。例句：My sister is pretty.

shy＝害羞的。例句：He is a little shy.

起床（下床）＝get up。例句：She gets up early every day.

mc.q: He ___ goes to the gym.
mc.why: 動詞 goes 已經有了，空格只要頻率副詞 often，放在動詞前。

mc.q: She ___ watches TV.
mc.why: 動詞 watches 已經有了，空格要頻率副詞 rarely（很少），放在動詞前。
wn: rare 是形容詞（稀有的），修飾動詞要用 rarely。

mc.q: I ___ drink coffee at night.
mc.why: never 本身就是從不，直接放在 drink 前面：I never drink coffee at night.
wn: 副詞不會加 s，never 永遠長一樣。
never 已經是否定，再加 not 變雙重否定，不對。

mc.q: We ___ the house once a week.
mc.why: once a week 是習慣，用現在簡單式；We 是複數，動詞用原形 clean。
wn: We 是複數，動詞不加 s。
前面沒有 are，不能只用 -ing。

mc.q: He ___ exercise every morning.
mc.why: exercise 這裡是動詞（運動），否定用 doesn't；He 是一個人。
wn: He 是一個人，要用 doesn't。
exercise 是一般動詞，否定不用 is。

mc.q: ___ often do you go swimming?
mc.why: 問多常做一件事，用固定說法 How often（多久一次）。
wn: 沒有 What often 這種說法；問頻率要用 How often。
When 是問什麼時候，不能和 often 連用。

mc.q: She ___ goes shopping on weekends.
mc.why: 動詞 goes 已經有了，空格要副詞 usually（通常），放在動詞前。
wn: usual 是形容詞，修飾動詞要用 usually。
goes 已經是動詞，不能再加 is。

mc.q: They ___ eat out.
mc.why: sometimes 是有時候，是頻率副詞，放在動詞 eat 前面。
wn: sometime 少了 s，意思是某個時候，不是有時候。
times 是次數，不能放在動詞前當有時候。

mc.q: He ___ stays up late.
mc.why: stays 已經是動詞，rarely 直接放在前面：He rarely stays up late. 他很少熬夜。
wn: 已經有 stays，再加 is 就多一個動詞。
副詞不加 s；s 已經加在動詞 stays 上。

mc.q: ___ she get enough sleep?
mc.why: get 是一般動詞，問句用 Does；she 是一個人。
wn: Do 配 I／you／we／they，she 用 Does。
get 是一般動詞，不用 Is 問。

mc.q: Amy ___ gets up at six o'clock.
mc.why: 動詞 gets 已經有了，空格只要頻率副詞 always，放在動詞前。
wn: gets 已經是動詞，不能再加 is。
gets 已經是動詞，不需要 is。

mc.q: My brother ___ eats breakfast at home.
mc.why: 頻率副詞放在一般動詞 eats 前面：usually eats。
wn: 後面已有動詞 eats，不能再加 is。
usual 是形容詞，修飾動詞要用 usually。

mc.q: We ___ go to the park on Sundays.
mc.why: 動詞 go 已經有了，空格只要頻率副詞 often，放在 go 前面。
wn: go 已經是動詞，不能再加 are。
go 已經是動詞，多了 are。

mc.q: Ben ___ watches TV after dinner.
mc.why: 句子已有動詞 watches，空格只要頻率副詞 sometimes，放在動詞前。
wn: Ben 是一個人不用 are，而且 watches 已經是動詞。
watches 已經是動詞，不能再加 is。

mc.q: She is never ___ for class.
mc.why: be late for 是遲到；late 是形容詞，直接放在 is never 後面。
wn: late 是形容詞，前面不加 a。

mc.q: He always ___ his homework after school.
mc.why: 主詞 He 是一個人，always 表示習慣，用現在簡單式，do 加 es 變 does。
wn: He 是一個人（第三人稱單數），動詞要變 does。
前面沒有 is，-ing 不能自己當動詞；習慣要用 does。

mc.q: My parents ___ drink tea at night.
mc.why: 句子已有動詞 drink，空格只要頻率副詞 never，放在動詞前。
wn: drink 已經是動詞，不能再加 are。
drink 已經是動詞，不需要 are。

mc.q: I ___ take the bus to work.
mc.why: 句子已有動詞 take，空格只要頻率副詞 usually，放在 take 前。
wn: take 已經是動詞，不能再加 am。
take 已經是動詞，多了 am。

mc.q: Lisa often ___ her friends on Saturday.
mc.why: often 不影響動詞；Lisa 是一個人，meet 加 s。
wn: 前面沒有 is，不能只用 -ing。
Lisa 是一個人，meet 要加 s。

mc.q: My sister rarely ___ up early.
mc.why: rarely（很少）不影響動詞；My sister 是一個人，get 加 s。
wn: My sister 是一個人，get 要加 s。
前面沒有 is，不能只用 -ing。

mc.q: They ___ study English on Fridays.
mc.why: 句子已有動詞 study，空格只要頻率副詞 always，放在動詞前面。
wn: study 已經是動詞，不需要再加 do。
多了 do，而且 always 要直接放在 study 前。

mc.q: Mr. Lin sometimes ___ to work.
mc.why: Mr. Lin 是一個人，sometimes 表示習慣，walk 要加 s 變 walks。
wn: 主詞是一個人（他），動詞要加 s。
前面沒有 is，-ing 不能自己當動詞。

mc.q: We ___ eat dinner at seven.
mc.why: 句子已經有動詞 eat，頻率副詞 always 直接放在 eat 前面就好。
wn: eat 已經是動詞，不需要再加 are。
多了 is，而且主詞 We 也不配 is。

mc.q: Tom ___ drinks milk. He does not like it.
mc.why: 後句 He does not like it 說他不喜歡，所以是 never（從不）喝。
wn: 不喜歡卻總是喝，和後句矛盾。
不喜歡卻通常喝，和後句矛盾。

mc.q: I ___ go to bed before ten. I like late nights.
mc.why: 後句 I like late nights 說喜歡晚睡，所以很少在十點前睡，用 rarely（很少）。
wn: usually 是通常，和後句喜歡晚睡互相矛盾。
always 是總是早睡，和後句喜歡晚睡不合。

mc.q: She ___ tired on Monday mornings.
mc.why: tired 是形容詞，句子需要 be 動詞 is；頻率副詞放在 be 動詞後面：is often。
wn: 有 be 動詞時，often 放在 is 後面，不放前面。
少了動詞；tired 是形容詞，前面需要 is。

mc.q: My father ___ busy on weekends.
mc.why: busy 是形容詞，要有 be 動詞 is；頻率副詞放在 is 後面。
wn: always 要放在 is 後面。
少了 is，busy 前面要有 be 動詞。

mc.q: He ___ eat breakfast. He has no time.
mc.why: 後句說沒時間，所以是否定；He 是一個人，用 doesn't eat。
wn: eat 是一般動詞，否定不用 is。

mc.q: I ___ watch TV in the morning.
mc.why: 主詞 I，後面有動詞 watch，否定用 don't。
wn: doesn't 配 he／she／it，I 用 don't。
後面有動詞 watch，否定要用 don't。

mc.q: My friends ___ like black coffee.
mc.why: like 是一般動詞，否定用 don't／doesn't；My friends 是複數，用 don't。
wn: like 是一般動詞，否定不用 be 動詞。
doesn't 配一個人，friends 是複數。

mc.q: Amy ___ walk to school. She takes the bus.
mc.why: 後句說她搭公車，所以是不走路；Amy 是一個人，用 doesn't。
wn: 一般動詞否定要用 doesn't，不能只放 not。

mc.q: We ___ study on Sunday mornings.
mc.why: study 是一般動詞，否定用 don't；We 是複數。
wn: doesn't 配一個人，We 用 don't。
study 是一般動詞，否定不用 is。

mc.q: The teacher ___ come on Fridays.
mc.why: 後面 come 是原形，要用否定助動詞；The teacher 是一個人，用 doesn't。
wn: The teacher 是一個人，否定要用 doesn't。
順序錯了，是 does not，not 在 does 後面。

mc.q: You ___ need a car in this city.
mc.why: need 是一般動詞，否定用 don't；主詞 You 用 don't。
wn: need 是一般動詞，否定不用 be 動詞。
doesn't 配 he／she／it，You 用 don't。

mc.q: She ___ often cook at home.
mc.why: She 是一個人，cook 是原形一般動詞，否定用 doesn't。
wn: cook 是一般動詞，否定用 doesn't，不用 isn't。
don't 配 I／you／we／they，She 用 doesn't。

mc.q: ___ you always get up early?
mc.why: 主詞 you，後面有動詞 get up，問句用 Do；always 放在主詞後。
wn: Does 配 he／she／it，you 用 Do。
後面有動詞 get up，問句要用 Do。

mc.q: ___ she usually take the bus?
mc.why: 主詞 she 是一個人，後面 take 是原形一般動詞，問句開頭用 Does。
wn: take 是一般動詞，要用 Does 問；Is 後面不接原形動詞。
Do 配 I／you／we／they；she 一個人要用 Does。

mc.q: ___ they often play basketball?
mc.why: 主詞 they 是複數，後面有動詞 play，問句用 Do。
wn: Does 配一個人，they 是複數。
後面有動詞 play，問句要用 Do。

mc.q: ___ your brother sometimes cook dinner?
mc.why: your brother 是一個人（等於 he），後面 cook 是原形，問句用 Does。
wn: Do 配 I／you／we／they，your brother 是一個人。
cook 是一般動詞，要用 Does 問，不用 Is。

mc.q: ___ we need more milk?
mc.why: need 是一般動詞，問句用 Do／Does；主詞 we 用 Do。
wn: need 是一般動詞，問句不用 Are。
Does 配一個人，we 用 Do。

mc.q: How often ___ Ben go swimming?
mc.why: How often 問多常；go 是一般動詞，Ben 是一個人，用 does。
wn: go 是一般動詞，不用 is 問。

mc.q: How often ___ you read books?
mc.why: 主詞是 you，read 是一般動詞，問句用 do：How often do you read books?
wn: read 是一般動詞，要用 do 問，不用 are。
does 配 he／she／it，you 用 do。

mc.q: Does Lisa always ___ lunch at home?
mc.why: 開頭有 Does，中間的 always 不影響，動詞用原形 eat。
wn: 有 Does 了，動詞不再加 s。

mc.q: Do your parents ___ TV at night?
mc.why: 問句有 Do，後面動詞用原形 watch。
wn: Do 問句的動詞不加 es。

mc.q: 'Never' means about ___ of the time.
mc.why: never 是從不、一次都沒有，所以是 0%。
wn: 一半左右是 sometimes（有時候）。

mc.q: 'Always' means about ___ of the time.
mc.why: always 是總是、每次都這樣，所以大約是 100%。
wn: 一半左右是 sometimes（有時候）。

mc.q: 'Sometimes' means about ___ of the time.
mc.why: sometimes 是有時候，大約一半的時間，所以是 50%。

mc.q: 'Rarely' means 'almost ___'.
mc.why: rarely 是很少，意思是 almost never（幾乎從不）。
wn: always 是總是，和很少相反。
usually 是通常，次數很多，不是很少。

mc.q: I usually ___ my homework at night.
mc.why: do homework 是寫功課；主詞 I 用原形 do。
wn: does 配 he／she／it，I 用 do。
寫功課要用動詞 do，am 不能接 my homework。

mc.q: Kevin often ___ to music on the bus.
mc.why: often 不影響動詞；Kevin 是一個人，listen 加 s。
wn: 前面沒有 is，不能只用 -ing。
Kevin 是一個人，listen 要加 s。

fill.q: I ___ wake up at seven.
fill.why: 空格在 I 和動詞 wake 中間，放頻率副詞 always（總是）。

fill.q: She ___ has breakfast at home.
fill.why: usually 是通常，頻率副詞放在一般動詞 has 前面：She usually has breakfast…

fill.q: He ___ goes to the gym.
fill.why: often 是常常，頻率副詞放在一般動詞 goes 前面：He often goes to the gym。

fill.q: We ___ eat out.
fill.zh: 我們有時候會在外面吃飯。
fill.why: sometimes 是有時候，頻率副詞放在一般動詞 eat 前面：We sometimes eat out。

fill.q: They ___ watch TV.
fill.why: rarely 意思是很少，頻率副詞放在一般動詞 watch 前面：They rarely watch TV。

fill.q: I ___ drink coffee at night.
fill.why: never 是從不，放在一般動詞 drink 前面：I never drink coffee at night。

fill.q: He ___ three times a week.
fill.why: three times a week 是習慣，He 是一個人，exercise 加 s 變 exercises。

fill.q: ___ you go swimming on Saturdays?
fill.why: 主詞是 you，問習慣用 Do 開頭：Do you go swimming…?

fill.q: She ___ stay up late.
fill.why: She 是一個人，否定用 doesn't，後面 stay 用原形；stay up late 是熬夜。

fill.q: How ___ do you clean the house?
fill.why: 問多常、頻率用 How often：How often do you clean the house?

fill.q: Amy always ___ (get) up at six.
fill.why: Amy 是一個人，get 加 s 變 gets；always 不影響動詞。

fill.q: I usually ___ (eat) breakfast at home.
fill.why: 主詞 I 用原形 eat；usually 放在動詞前，不影響動詞。

fill.q: My brother often ___ (play) basketball.
fill.why: My brother 是一個人，play 加 s 變 plays（y 前面是母音 a，直接加 s）。

fill.q: We sometimes ___ (go) to the beach.
fill.why: 主詞 We 用原形 go；sometimes 放在動詞前面，不影響動詞。

fill.q: Tom never ___ (drink) coffee.
fill.why: Tom 是一個人，never 不影響動詞，drink 加 s 變 drinks。

fill.q: My parents usually ___ (watch) TV at night.
fill.why: My parents 是複數，動詞用原形 watch，不加 es。

fill.q: Lisa rarely ___ (take) the bus.
fill.why: Lisa 是一個人，rarely 不影響動詞，take 加 s 變 takes。

fill.q: You often ___ (study) in the library.
fill.why: 主詞 You 用原形 study，不改成 studies；often 不影響動詞。

fill.q: He always ___ (do) his homework before dinner.
fill.why: He 是一個人，do 要加 es 變 does；always 放在動詞前，不影響變化。

fill.q: They ___ (be) never late for class.

reading.title: 短文 1
reading.text: My name is Ken. I always wake up at seven o'clock. I usually have breakfast at home, but I sometimes eat out with friends. I often go to the gym after work. I rarely watch TV because I am busy. I never drink coffee at night. On weekends, I go swimming once a week. My sister is different. She doesn't exercise very much. She usually stays home and reads books. She sometimes goes shopping on Saturdays. We both try to get enough sleep every night.

qs.q: What time does Ken always wake up?
qs.why: 原文：I always wake up at seven o'clock. Ken 都是七點起床。
wn: 原文說 seven o'clock，不是六點。
原文說 seven o'clock，不是八點。

qs.q: How often does Ken go swimming?
qs.why: 原文：I go swimming once a week. once a week 是一週一次。
wn: twice 是兩次；原文是 once，一次。
原文說 once a week，一週一次，不是每天。

qs.q: Does Ken drink coffee at night?
qs.why: 原文：I never drink coffee at night. never 是從不，晚上不喝咖啡。
wn: always 是總是，和原文的 never 相反。
sometimes 是有時；原文是 never，一次都不喝。

qs.q: What does Ken's sister usually do?
qs.why: 原文：She usually stays home and reads books. 姊妹通常在家看書。
wn: 原文說 She doesn't exercise very much。
去游泳的是 Ken，不是他的姊妹。

qs.q: When does Ken's sister go shopping?
qs.why: 原文：She sometimes goes shopping on Saturdays. 她星期六有時會去逛街。
wn: 原文說 on Saturdays，是星期六，不是星期一。
原文說 sometimes… on Saturdays，不是每天。

reading.title: 短文 2
reading.text: My name is Anna. I always get up at six o'clock. I usually drink a glass of water first. Then I take a shower and have breakfast. I often eat bread and eggs. I never drink coffee because I do not like it. I go to work by bus. My office is not far. After work, I sometimes go to the gym with my sister. She rarely comes with me on Friday, because she is very tired. In the evening I read a book. I always go to bed at eleven.

qs.q: What time does Anna get up?
qs.why: 原文：I always get up at six o'clock. Anna 六點起床。
wn: 文中沒有七點；起床是 six o'clock。
十一點是她睡覺的時間（go to bed at eleven）。

qs.q: What does Anna never drink?
qs.why: 原文：I never drink coffee because I do not like it. 她從不喝咖啡。
wn: 她起床先喝 a glass of water，她會喝水。
文中沒有提到茶；never drink 的是 coffee。

qs.q: How does Anna go to work?
qs.why: 原文：I go to work by bus. Anna 搭公車上班。
wn: 文中沒說開車；原文是 by bus。
on foot 是走路；原文是 by bus。

qs.q: Who sometimes goes to the gym with Anna?
qs.why: 原文：I sometimes go to the gym with my sister. 有時和姊妹一起去健身房。
wn: 文中沒有提到朋友；一起去的是 my sister。
文中沒有提到媽媽；一起去的是 my sister。

qs.q: What does Anna do in the evening?
qs.why: 原文：In the evening I read a book. 晚上她看書。
wn: 文中沒說她煮晚餐；晚上是 read a book。
文中沒說她看電視；晚上是 read a book。

reading.title: 短文 3
reading.text: Ben is a student. He usually gets up late. He often has no time for breakfast. He rides his bike to school because the bus is slow. Ben always sits near the window in class. He sometimes talks with his friend Tom, but the teacher does not like that. After school, Ben often plays basketball for one hour. He never plays computer games before dinner. His mother always cooks rice and vegetables. Ben usually does his homework at eight. He is sometimes tired, so he goes to bed early.

qs.q: How does Ben go to school?
qs.why: 原文：He rides his bike to school. ride a bike 是騎腳踏車。
wn: 文中沒說坐車；他是 rides his bike。
原文說 the bus is slow，所以他不搭公車。

qs.q: Why does Ben not take the bus?
qs.why: 原文：because the bus is slow. because 後面就是原因。
wn: 文中沒說公車很擠；原因是 the bus is slow。
文中沒說公車很貴；原因是 the bus is slow。

qs.q: What does Ben often do after school?
qs.why: 原文：After school, Ben often plays basketball. 放學後常打籃球。
wn: 文中沒說 Ben 看書；他放學後打籃球。
晚餐前他 never plays computer games。

qs.q: What does Ben's mother always cook?
qs.why: 原文：His mother always cooks rice and vegetables. 媽媽都煮飯和青菜。
wn: 文中沒有麵包和蛋；媽媽煮 rice and vegetables。
文中沒有麵和魚；媽媽煮 rice and vegetables。

qs.q: When does Ben usually do his homework?
qs.why: 原文：Ben usually does his homework at eight. Ben 通常八點寫功課。
wn: 文中沒有十點；寫功課是 at eight。
文中沒有六點；寫功課是 at eight。

reading.title: 短文 4
reading.text: My grandfather is seventy years old. He always gets up very early. He usually walks in the park before breakfast. He often meets his old friends there. They sometimes drink tea together and talk about their families. My grandfather never uses a phone in the park. He says the park is for quiet time. He rarely takes the bus, because he likes walking. At noon he has a small lunch. In the afternoon he often works in his garden. He always goes to bed at nine o'clock.

qs.q: When does the grandfather walk in the park?
qs.why: 原文：He usually walks in the park before breakfast. 早餐前散步。
wn: 中午他是吃 a small lunch，不是散步。
原文說 before breakfast，是早餐前，不是晚餐後。

qs.q: Who does he often meet in the park?
qs.why: 原文：He often meets his old friends there. there 指公園，他常遇到老朋友。
wn: 文中沒有提到學生；他遇到的是 old friends。
文中沒有提到醫生；他遇到的是 old friends。

qs.q: What does he never do in the park?
qs.why: 原文：My grandfather never uses a phone in the park. 他在公園從不用手機。
wn: 他會和朋友聊家人，不是 never。
他們 sometimes drink tea together，有時會喝。

qs.q: Why does he rarely take the bus?
qs.why: 原文：He rarely takes the bus, because he likes walking. 他喜歡走路。
wn: 文中沒說公車慢；because 後面的原因是 he likes walking。

qs.q: What does he often do in the afternoon?
qs.why: 原文：In the afternoon he often works in his garden. 下午常在花園工作。
wn: 文中沒說他下午睡覺；他 works in his garden。
文中沒說他去買東西；他 works in his garden。

mc.q: I go to work ___ Monday.
mc.why: 星期幾前面用 on：on Monday。
wn: in 用在月份、年份，不配星期。

mc.q: It is seven ___.
mc.why: 整點說法是數字加 o'clock：seven o'clock。
wn: seven hours 是七個小時，不是七點。

mc.q: She has a meeting ___ Tuesday morning.
mc.why: 有星期幾就用 on：on Tuesday morning（星期二早上）。
wn: at 用在幾點，例如 at ten。
單說 in the morning 可以，但前面有 Tuesday 就用 on。

mc.q: What ___ do you get up?
mc.why: 問幾點用固定說法 What time：What time do you get up? 你幾點起床。
wn: times 是次數或倍數，問幾點不用複數。
timing 是時機，不是問幾點的說法。

mc.q: He studies ___ the evening.
mc.why: 早上、下午、傍晚用 in the：in the morning、in the evening。
wn: on 用在星期幾或日期，例如 on Monday。
at 用在幾點或 at night；evening 要用 in the。

mc.q: We rest ___ weekends.
mc.why: 美式英文說 on weekends（在週末），和星期幾一樣用 on。
wn: of 是「…的」，不能用來表示在什麼時間。

mc.q: ___ time is it?
mc.why: 問現在幾點的固定說法是 What time is it?
wn: How 問方法或狀況，不能接 time 問幾點。
When 本身就是什麼時候，不能再接 time。

mc.q: I have English class ___ Mondays.
mc.why: 星期幾前面用 on，每週一說 on Mondays。
wn: at 用在幾點，例如 at nine。
in 用在月份或 in the morning，不配星期。

mc.q: She ___ work on Saturdays.
mc.why: She 是一個人，一般動詞 work 的否定用 doesn't，後面接原形：She doesn't work.
wn: don't 配 I／you／we／they，She 要用 doesn't。
work 是一般動詞，否定用 doesn't，不用 isn't。

mc.q: He plays basketball ___ Thursday.
mc.why: 星期幾前面用 on：on Thursday。
wn: in 用在月份、年份，不配星期。

mc.q: Ben gets up ___ seven o'clock.
mc.why: 幾點鐘前面用 at：at seven o'clock。
wn: in 用在 in the morning 這種一段時間。
on 用在星期幾或日期。

mc.q: My mother works ___ Tuesday and Thursday.
mc.why: 星期幾前面用 on：on Tuesday and Thursday。
wn: in 用在月份、年份，不配星期。
at 用在幾點鐘，不配星期。

mc.q: The store opens ___ nine in the morning.
mc.why: 幾點鐘前面用 at：at nine。
wn: in 用在 in the morning 這種一段時間，不用在幾點。
on 用在星期幾或日期。

mc.q: We visit my grandmother ___ Sunday.
mc.why: 星期幾前面用 on：on Sunday、on Monday。
wn: at 用在幾點，例如 at six，不用在星期。
in 用在月份、年份或 in the morning，不用在星期。

mc.q: Lisa ___ to the gym on Wednesdays.
mc.why: on Wednesdays 是每週三的習慣，Lisa 是一個人，go 變 goes。
wn: Lisa 是一個人，要用 goes。
前面沒有 is，不能只用 -ing。

mc.q: My parents ___ dinner at six thirty.
mc.why: My parents 是兩個人（複數），用 have；have dinner 是吃晚餐。
wn: has 只配一個人（he／she／it），parents 是複數。
前面沒有 are，-ing 不能自己當動詞。

mc.q: What time ___ the class start?
mc.why: start 是一般動詞，問句要 do／does；the class 是單數，用 does。
wn: start 是一般動詞，不用 is 問。
the class 是一個，要用 does。

mc.q: What time ___ you finish work?
mc.why: 主詞是 you，finish 是一般動詞，問句用 do：What time do you finish work?
wn: does 配 he／she／it，you 要用 do。
finish 是一般動詞，要用 do 問，不用 are。

mc.q: ___ your brother study on Fridays?
mc.why: study 是一般動詞，問句用 Does；your brother 是一個人。
wn: your brother 是一個人，用 Does。
study 是一般動詞，不用 Is 問。

mc.q: Today is Monday. Tomorrow is ___.
mc.why: Tomorrow 是明天。星期一的下一天是星期二 Tuesday。
wn: Sunday 是星期日，在星期一的前一天，是昨天。
Friday 是星期五，離星期一還有好幾天。

mc.q: Saturday and Sunday are the ___.
mc.why: 週六和週日合起來叫 the weekend（週末）。
wn: weekday 是平日，指週一到週五。

mc.q: The first day of the school week is ___.
mc.why: 上學的一週從星期一開始，所以是 Monday。
wn: 星期日不用上學，不是上課週的第一天。
Friday 是上課週的最後一天。

mc.why: 7:30 是七點過半小時，英文說 half past seven（past 是過了）。
wn: 英文不說 seven half，要說 half past seven。
o'clock 只用在整點，例如 seven o'clock。

mc.why: 8:15 是八點過 15 分；a quarter 是 15 分鐘，past 是過了。
wn: 少了 a 和 past，要說 a quarter past eight。
英文沒有這種說法，要說 a quarter past eight。

mc.why: 9:45 再 15 分鐘就十點；a quarter 是 15 分鐘，to 是差幾分到：a quarter to ten。
wn: 這是差 15 分到九點，也就是 8:45。

mc.q: 12:00 at night is ___.
mc.why: 晚上 12 點叫 midnight（午夜）。
wn: morning 是早上，不是半夜 12 點。

mc.q: 12:00 in the day is ___.
mc.why: 白天的 12 點是中午，英文是 noon。
wn: midnight 是半夜 12 點，不是白天。
evening 是傍晚到晚上，大約 6 點以後。

mc.q: She ___ have class on Saturdays.
mc.why: 主詞 She 一個人，後面有動詞 have，否定用 doesn't。
wn: don't 配 I／you／we／they，She 用 doesn't。
後面有動詞 have，否定要用 doesn't。

mc.q: We ___ go to school on Sundays.
mc.why: 主詞 We，後面有動詞 go，否定用 don't。
wn: 後面有動詞 go，否定用 don't，不用 aren't。
doesn't 配 he／she／it，We 用 don't。

mc.q: My father ___ work on Friday nights.
mc.why: work 在這裡是動詞（上班），否定要助動詞；My father 是一個人，用 doesn't。
wn: 一般動詞否定不能只放 not，要 doesn't。
My father 是一個人，用 doesn't。

mc.q: My class ___ at eight o'clock.
mc.why: My class 是單數，說固定時間，start 加 s。
wn: 前面沒有 is，不能只用 -ing。
class 是一個，start 要加 s。

mc.q: The shops ___ at ten on Sundays.
mc.why: The shops 有 s 是複數，習慣性的事用原形 open。
wn: 加 s 只給一個人或一件事，shops 是複數。

mc.q: Amy ___ up at six on weekdays.
mc.why: on weekdays 是平日的習慣；Amy 是一個人，get 加 s。
wn: Amy 是一個人，get 要加 s。
前面沒有 is，不能只用 -ing。

mc.q: ___ the bus come at seven?
mc.why: 後面 come 是原形，問句用 Do／Does；the bus 是一件事（單數），用 Does。
wn: the bus 是單數，要用 Does。
come 是一般動詞，問句不用 Is。

mc.q: ___ your classes start at nine?
mc.why: 後面是原形 start，問句用 Do／Does；your classes 是複數，用 Do。
wn: start 是一般動詞，問句不用 Is。

mc.q: He goes to the doctor ___ Tuesday morning.
mc.why: 有星期幾就用 on：on Tuesday morning，後面有 morning 也一樣。
wn: 只說 in the morning 才用 in；有 Tuesday 就用 on。
at 用在幾點，例如 at nine，不用在星期。

mc.q: I read a book ___ night.
mc.why: 晚上的固定說法是 at night。
wn: on 用在星期幾或日期，例如 on Monday。
傍晚是 in the evening，但晚上要說 at night。

mc.q: We have lunch ___ noon.
mc.why: noon（中午 12 點）是一個時間點，用 at：at noon。
wn: on 用在星期幾或日期。
in 用在 in the morning 這種一段時間。

mc.q: She studies English ___ the evening.
mc.why: 早上、下午、傍晚的固定說法用 in：in the evening。
wn: on 用在星期幾或日期。
at 用在幾點或 at night，傍晚是 in the evening。

mc.q: There are ___ days in a week.
mc.why: 一個星期有七天（星期一到星期日），seven 是七。
wn: five 是五，上班日才五天，一星期有七天。
ten 是十，一星期沒有十天。

mc.q: Friday comes after ___.
mc.why: 星期四之後是星期五，所以是 Thursday。
wn: 星期六在星期五之後，不是之前。

mc.q: My day off is ___ Saturday.
mc.why: 星期幾前面用 on：on Saturday。
wn: at 用在幾點鐘，例如 at seven。
in 用在月份、年份或 in the morning。

mc.q: Tom is never late ___ Mondays.
mc.why: 星期幾前面用 on：on Mondays（每週一）。
wn: in 用在月份、年份，不配星期。

mc.q: My sister ___ piano lessons on Thursdays.
mc.why: My sister 是一個人（she），have 要變成 has。
wn: 前面沒有 is，不能只用 -ing。

mc.q: Do you ___ up early on Saturdays?
mc.why: 問句有 Do，後面動詞用原形 get。
wn: Do 問句的動詞不加 s。

mc.q: Does Ken ___ home at six?
mc.why: 問句已經有 Does，後面動詞用原形 come。
wn: 有 Does 了，動詞不再加 s。

mc.q: It is 6:00. It is six ___.
mc.why: 整點的說法是數字加 o'clock：six o'clock。
wn: six hours 是六個小時，不是六點。

mc.q: My mother ___ work at five in the afternoon.
mc.why: My mother 是一個人；finish 結尾是 sh，要加 es。
wn: 前面沒有 is，不能只用 -ing。
My mother 是一個人，要加 es。

mc.q: We ___ have class on Wednesday afternoons.
mc.why: have 是一般動詞，否定用 don't；We 是複數。
wn: have 是一般動詞，不用 be 動詞否定。
doesn't 配一個人，We 用 don't。

fill.why: 星期幾前面用 on：on Monday。

fill.q: She reads the news ___ the morning.

fill.q: Ben always goes to the gym ___ Wednesday.
fill.why: 星期幾前面用 on：on Wednesday。

fill.q: My mother goes to bed ___ midnight.

fill.q: They play tennis ___ the weekend.

fill.q: Lisa ___ (start) work at eight thirty.

fill.q: My classes ___ (finish) at four on Fridays.

fill.q: Tom ___ (have) English class on Tuesdays.
fill.why: Tom 是一個人（第三人稱單數），have 不是直接加 s，要變成 has。

fill.q: We ___ (have) a test every Friday.
fill.why: 主詞 We 是複數，用 have，不用 has。

fill.q: The bus ___ (come) at seven fifteen.
fill.why: The bus 是一件事（單數），come 加 s 變 comes。

fill.q: The shops ___ (open) at ten on Sundays.
fill.why: The shops 有 s，是複數，動詞用原形 open，不加 s。

fill.q: My sister ___ (not work) on Mondays.
fill.why: My sister 是一個人，否定用 doesn't，後面 work 用原形，不加 s。

fill.q: We ___ (not have) class on Saturdays.
fill.why: We 是複數，否定用 don't（do not）加原形 have。

fill.q: He ___ (not get) up early on the weekend.
fill.why: He 是一個人，否定用 doesn't，後面 get 用原形。

fill.q: I ___ (not study) on Sunday mornings.
fill.why: 主詞 I，否定用 don't（do not）加原形 study，不用 doesn't。

fill.q: What time ___ you get up on weekdays?
fill.why: What time 問句，主詞是 you，中間要放 do：What time do you get up?

fill.q: What time ___ your father come home?
fill.why: 主詞 your father 是一個人，What time 問句用 does，後面 come 用原形。

fill.q: ___ your class start at nine?
fill.why: your class 是一件事（單數），問句用 Does，後面 start 用原形。

fill.q: ___ you work on Saturdays?
fill.why: 主要動詞 work 是原形，問句要用助動詞開頭；主詞 you 配 Do：Do you work…?

fill.q: ___ they have music class on Thursdays?
fill.why: 主詞 they 是複數，一般動詞 have 的問句用 Do 開頭。

fill.q: Today is Wednesday. Tomorrow is ___.
fill.why: 星期三的下一天是 Thursday；星期幾第一個字母要大寫。

fill.q: Today is Friday. Tomorrow is ___.
fill.why: 星期五的下一天是 Saturday；星期幾第一個字母要大寫。

fill.q: Saturday and Sunday are the ___.
fill.why: 星期六和星期天合起來是週末，英文是 the weekend。

fill.q: 7:30 is half ___ seven.
fill.why: 7:30 是七點半，說 half past seven（過了七點半小時）。

fill.q: 8:45 is a quarter ___ nine.
fill.why: 8:45 是差 15 分就 9 點，說 a quarter to nine；to 表示差幾分到。

fill.q: 6:15 is a quarter ___ six.
fill.why: 6:15 是六點過十五分，過了幾點用 past：a quarter past six。

fill.q: 12:00 in the day is ___.
fill.why: 白天的 12:00 叫 noon 或 midday（中午十二點）；半夜 12:00 才是 midnight。

fill.q: It is 5:00. It is five ___.
fill.why: 5:00 是整點，說 five o'clock。

fill.q: Amy always ___ (take) the train on Monday.
fill.why: Amy 是一個人，always 不影響動詞，take 加 s 變 takes。

fill.q: My parents usually ___ (watch) a movie on Friday night.
fill.why: My parents 是複數，動詞用原形 watch；usually 不影響動詞。

fill.q: Mr. Wang often ___ (work) late on Thursdays.
fill.why: Mr. Wang 是一個人，often 不影響動詞，work 加 s 變 works。

fill.q: The children ___ (go) to school five days a week.
fill.why: The children 是複數，動詞用原形 go，不加 es。

fill.q: She ___ (be) always free on Sunday afternoons.
fill.why: She 是一個人，be 動詞用 is；always 放在 is 後面。

fill.q: We ___ (be) never at home on Saturday morning.
fill.why: 主詞 We 是複數，be 動詞用 are；never 放在 are 後面。

fill.q: How often ___ your brother play tennis?
fill.why: your brother 是一個人，How often 問句用 does，後面 play 用原形。

fill.q: How often ___ you go to the library?
fill.why: 主詞 you，How often（多常）問句用 do，後面 go 用原形。

fill.q: Does Anna ___ (finish) work at six?
fill.why: Does 問句後面用原形 finish，不加 es。

a: I have English class on Monday.
I have English class on Mondays.
translate.why: 星期幾前面用 on；英文課 English class，English 第一個字母要大寫。有課用 have。

a: He gets up at seven o'clock.
translate.why: He 是一個人，get 加 s：gets up；七點 at seven，後面加 o'clock 也可以。

a: We do not work on Saturday.
translate.why: We 的否定用 don't + 原形 work；星期六 on Saturday，加 s 變 Saturdays 表示每週六。

a: Her class starts at half past eight.
Her class starts at eight thirty.
translate.why: Her class 是一堂課，start 加 s；八點半 half past eight 或 eight thirty，前面用 at。

a: What time do you finish work?
What time do you get off work?
What time do you leave work?
translate.why: 幾點 What time + do you + 原形；下班是 finish work。

a: What time does your class start?
translate.why: 問幾點用 What time；主詞 your class 單數，要用 does，start 用原形。

translate.zh: 我媽媽星期二和星期四工作。
a: My mother works on Tuesday and Thursday.
My mother works on Tuesdays and Thursdays.
My mom works on Tuesday and Thursday.
My mom works on Tuesdays and Thursdays.
translate.why: My mother 是一個人，work 加 s；星期幾前用 on，兩天用 and 連起來：on Tuesday and Thursday。

reading.title: 短文 1
reading.text: Today is Wednesday. Ben has a busy schedule this week. On Mondays, he studies English at seven in the evening. On Tuesdays, he has a meeting at nine o'clock. On Wednesdays, he plays basketball with his friends. He doesn't work on Saturdays or Sundays. Those are his weekends. On Saturday, he usually gets up at half past nine. On Sunday, he rests all day. Ben's sister asks, 'What time do you get up on weekdays?' He says, 'I get up at quarter past six every morning.'

qs.q: What day is it today in the story?
qs.why: 原文：Today is Wednesday. 故事裡今天是星期三。
wn: Monday 是 Ben 讀英文的日子，不是今天。
Sunday 是他休息的日子，不是今天。

qs.q: What time does Ben study English on Mondays?
qs.why: 原文：On Mondays… at seven in the evening. 週一晚上七點讀英文。
wn: 原文說 in the evening，是晚上，不是早上。
九點是星期二開會的時間，不是讀英文。

qs.q: Does Ben work on Saturdays?
qs.why: 原文：He doesn't work on Saturdays or Sundays. 星期六不上班。
wn: 原文說 doesn't work on Saturdays，他不上班。
原文直接說 doesn't work，沒有說有時候。

qs.q: What time does Ben usually get up on Saturday?
qs.why: 原文：On Saturday… at half past nine. half past nine 是九點半。
wn: 六點十五分是平日（weekdays）起床，不是星期六。
九點是星期二開會；星期六是 half past nine。

qs.q: What time does Ben get up on weekdays?
qs.why: 原文：I get up at quarter past six. quarter past six 是 6:15。
wn: half past 是 6:30；原文是 quarter past，6:15。
文中沒有七點起床；七點是週一讀英文。

reading.title: 短文 2
reading.text: Kevin works in a small shop. He works five days a week, from Monday to Friday. He gets up at half past six and takes the train at seven fifteen. The shop opens at nine o'clock and closes at six. Kevin usually has lunch at noon with his friend Sam. On Wednesdays he finishes work early, at four o'clock. He does not work on Saturday or Sunday. On the weekend he often plays football with his brother. He always goes to bed before eleven on weekdays.

qs.q: How many days a week does Kevin work?
qs.why: 原文：He works five days a week, from Monday to Friday. 一週上班五天。
wn: 原文說 five days；週六週日他不上班。
原文說 five days；週末他不上班。

qs.q: What time does the shop open?
qs.why: 原文：The shop opens at nine o'clock and closes at six. 店九點開。
wn: noon 是他吃午餐的時間，不是開店。
六點是 closes，關門的時間，不是開門。

qs.q: When does Kevin finish work early?
qs.why: 原文：On Wednesdays he finishes work early. 週三四點就下班。
wn: 原文說 On Wednesdays，是星期三，不是星期一。
原文說 On Wednesdays，是星期三，不是星期五。

qs.q: What does Kevin often do on the weekend?
qs.why: 原文：On the weekend he often plays football. 週末常踢足球。
wn: 搭火車是平日早上去上班，不是週末。
原文說週末 does not work，不上班。

qs.q: Who has lunch with Kevin?
qs.why: 原文：has lunch at noon with his friend Sam. 一起吃午餐的是 Sam。
wn: his brother 是週末一起踢足球的，不是吃午餐。

reading.title: 短文 3
reading.text: Mia is a nurse. Her schedule is not the same every week. This week she works on Monday, Tuesday and Thursday. She starts at seven in the morning and finishes at three in the afternoon. On Wednesday she stays at home and cleans the house. On Friday evening she meets her friends at a cafe. They usually talk until ten o'clock. Mia never works on Sunday. She always calls her parents on Sunday morning. In the afternoon she often reads a book in the park.

qs.q: What is Mia's job?
qs.why: 原文：Mia is a nurse. nurse 是護理師。
wn: 文中沒說她是服務生；原文說 Mia is a nurse。
文中沒說她是老師；原文說 Mia is a nurse。

qs.q: What time does she start work?
qs.why: 原文：She starts at seven in the morning. 她早上七點開始上班。
wn: 下午三點是她 finishes，下班時間。
十點是週五和朋友聊到幾點，不是上班。

qs.q: What does she do on Wednesday?
opts: She stays at home and cleans.
qs.why: 原文：On Wednesday she stays at home and cleans. 週三在家打掃。
wn: 這週她上班是週一、二、四，週三不上班。
見朋友是 Friday evening，不是週三。

qs.q: When does Mia call her parents?
qs.why: 原文：She always calls her parents on Sunday morning. 週日早上打給爸媽。
wn: 週五晚上是去咖啡店見朋友。
文中沒說週一晚上打電話；是 Sunday morning。

qs.q: Where does she often read a book?
qs.why: 原文：she often reads a book in the park. 她常在公園看書。
wn: 咖啡店是週五和朋友聊天的地方，不是看書。
文中沒說她在醫院看書；原文是 in the park。

reading.title: 短文 4
reading.text: Our English class is on Monday and Wednesday. It starts at half past six in the evening and finishes at eight. Our teacher, Mr. Chen, always comes ten minutes early. We usually study new words first. Then we speak in small groups. Mr. Chen sometimes gives us a short test on Wednesday. He never gives homework on Friday, because we do not have class on Friday. Many students take the bus to school. The bus comes at six o'clock, so we are rarely late.

qs.q: When is the English class?
qs.why: 原文：Our English class is on Monday and Wednesday. 英文課在週一和週三。
wn: 原文說 Monday and Wednesday，不是週二週四。
一週只有兩天，原文也說 Friday 沒課。

qs.q: What time does the class start?
qs.why: 原文：It starts at half past six. half past six 是六點半。
wn: 六點是公車來的時間，不是上課。
八點是 finishes，下課的時間。

qs.q: What does the class do first?
qs.why: 原文：We usually study new words first. first 是先，先學新單字。
wn: 分組說話是 Then，第二步，不是先做。
小考是週三 sometimes 才有，不是一開始做的。

qs.q: When does Mr. Chen sometimes give a test?
qs.why: 原文：sometimes gives us a short test on Wednesday. 週三有時小考。
wn: 原文說 we do not have class on Friday，週五沒課。
原文說小考是 on Wednesday，不是週一。

qs.q: What time does the bus come?
qs.why: 原文：The bus comes at six o'clock. 公車六點來。
wn: 六點半是上課開始的時間，不是公車。
八點是下課的時間，不是公車。

writing.prompt: 請用星期幾和時間表達（例如 on Mondays, at seven o'clock），寫3到5句英文描述你一週的時間表。

She takes a shower and eats breakfast.
She takes a shower and then eats breakfast.

reorder.a: I get up at six every morning.
reorder.why: 起床是 get up；幾點用 at：at six；每天早上 every morning 放句尾。主詞 I，get 不加 s。

reorder.a: She takes a shower and has breakfast.
reorder.why: She 是一個人，兩個動詞都加 s：takes a shower、has breakfast，breakfast 前不加 a。

reorder.a: He always brushes his teeth after breakfast.
reorder.why: He 是一個人，brush 字尾 sh 加 es：brushes his teeth；早餐後 after breakfast。

reorder.a: We leave the house at seven thirty.
reorder.why: 出門是 leave the house；幾點用 at；七點半是 seven thirty。

reorder.a: My father goes to work by car.
reorder.why: 開車上班 drive to work，或 go to work by car（by 後不加 a）；My father 是一個人，動詞加 s。

reorder.a: My mother cooks dinner every day.
reorder.why: My mother 是一個人，cook 或 make 要加 s；煮晚餐 cook dinner，dinner 前不加 a。

reorder.a: The children do their homework before dinner.
reorder.why: children 是複數，用 do 不用 does：do their homework before dinner。

reorder.a: He watches TV for one hour after dinner.
reorder.why: He 一個人，watch 加 es；一小時是 for one hour 或 for an hour，放 after dinner 前。

reorder.a: I go to bed at eleven.
reorder.why: 睡覺時間用 go to bed，不用 sleep；幾點前面用 at：at eleven。

reorder.a: She doesn't walk to school.
reorder.why: She 否定用 doesn't + 原形：doesn't walk，walk 不加 s。

reorder.a: I don't eat breakfast on busy mornings.
reorder.why: I 否定用 don't eat；早上很忙的時候可說 on busy mornings，用 on。

reorder.a: Do you get up early every day?
reorder.why: 問習慣用 Do you + 原形？；早起是 get up early，early 放在 get up 後面，every day 放最後。

reorder.a: Does she cook dinner every night?
reorder.why: 主詞 she 是一個人，問句用 Does + 原形 cook（不加 s）；每天晚上 every night 放句尾。

reorder.a: What time does your day start?
reorder.why: 主詞是 your day（一件事），問句用 does，動詞 start 用原形；What time 放句首。

reorder.a: I usually have lunch near my office.
reorder.why: 通常 usually 放 have 前；公司附近 near my office，near 後面直接接地點，不加 of。

reading.title: 短文 1
reading.text: This is Anna's daily routine. She always wakes up at six thirty. She washes her face, brushes her teeth, and gets dressed. She has breakfast at seven and leaves home at seven thirty. She goes to work by bus. She starts work at nine and has lunch at noon. She usually has a meeting on Mondays. She finishes work at six and gets home at six thirty. In the evening, she cooks dinner and eats with her family. After dinner, she takes a walk and reads a book. She doesn't stay up late. She goes to bed at ten thirty every night.

qs.q: What time does Anna wake up?
qs.why: 原文：She always wakes up at six thirty. Anna 每天六點半起床。
wn: 原文是 six thirty，六點半，不是整點六點。
seven 是她吃早餐的時間（has breakfast at seven），不是起床時間。

qs.q: How does Anna go to work?
qs.why: 原文：She goes to work by bus. 她搭公車上班。
wn: 文中沒有提到開車，原文說 by bus。
文中沒有提到騎腳踏車，原文說 by bus。

qs.q: When does Anna usually have a meeting?
qs.why: 原文：She usually has a meeting on Mondays. 她通常星期一開會。
wn: 文中沒有提到星期五，原文是 on Mondays。
不是每天，原文只說 on Mondays 星期一。

qs.q: What does Anna do after dinner?
qs.why: 原文：After dinner, she takes a walk and reads a book. 晚餐後她散步、看書。
wn: 文中沒有說她看電視，晚餐後是散步和看書。
文中沒有說她去購物，晚餐後是散步和看書。

qs.q: What time does Anna go to bed?
qs.why: 原文：She goes to bed at ten thirty every night. 她每晚十點半睡覺。
wn: 原文是 ten thirty 十點半，不是九點半。
原文是 ten thirty 十點半，不是整點十點。

reading.title: 短文 2
reading.text: This is my day. I get up at six o'clock. First I take a shower and get dressed. Then I have breakfast with my wife. We usually eat bread and drink tea. I leave the house at seven fifteen and take the train to my office. I start work at eight thirty. At noon I have lunch with my friends near the office. I come home at six. My son does his homework, and I cook dinner. After dinner we watch TV. I go to bed at eleven.

qs.q: What does the writer do first in the morning?
qs.why: 原文：First I take a shower and get dressed. first 是首先，起床後第一件事是洗澡。
wn: 煮晚餐是晚上回家後（I cook dinner），不是早上。
看電視是晚餐後（After dinner we watch TV）。

qs.q: Who has breakfast with him?
qs.why: 原文：Then I have breakfast with my wife. 他和太太一起吃早餐。
wn: 兒子出現在晚上寫功課，沒說一起吃早餐。
和朋友一起吃的是午餐（lunch with my friends）。

qs.q: How does he go to the office?
qs.why: 原文：I ... take the train to my office. 他搭火車去辦公室。
wn: 文中沒有提到騎腳踏車，原文說 take the train。
文中沒有提到公車，原文說 take the train 搭火車。

qs.q: What does his son do before dinner?
qs.why: 原文：My son does his homework, and I cook dinner. 爸爸煮晚餐時，兒子在寫功課。
wn: 看電視是晚餐後（After dinner we watch TV），不是晚餐前。
洗澡的是作者本人，而且是早上（First I take a shower）。

qs.q: What time does he go to bed?
qs.why: 原文：I go to bed at eleven. 他十一點睡覺。
wn: six 是起床和回家的時間，不是睡覺時間。
eight thirty 是開始上班的時間（start work）。

reading.title: 短文 3
reading.text: Sara is a teacher. Her day starts early. She always gets up at half past five and drinks a glass of water. She never eats a big breakfast. She walks to school because it is very close. Her first class starts at eight. She has lunch at school at twelve. In the afternoon she talks with parents or reads new books. She comes home at five thirty. She often cooks dinner with her husband. After dinner they go for a short walk. Sara goes to bed at ten.

qs.q: What time does Sara get up?
qs.why: 原文：She always gets up at half past five. half past five 是五點半。
wn: eight 是第一堂課開始的時間（first class starts at eight）。
ten 是她睡覺的時間（goes to bed at ten）。

qs.q: What does Sara never do?
qs.why: 原文：She never eats a big breakfast. never 是從不，她從不吃豐盛的早餐。
wn: 原文說 She often cooks dinner，她常煮晚餐。
原文說 She walks to school，她走路上學。

qs.q: Why does she walk to school?
qs.why: 原文：She walks to school because it is very close. because 後面就是原因：學校很近。
wn: 文中沒有說她沒有車，原因是學校很近。
文中沒有提到公車慢，原因是學校很近。

qs.q: Where does she have lunch?
qs.why: 原文：She has lunch at school at twelve. 她十二點在學校吃午餐。
wn: 她五點半才回家，午餐是在學校吃（at school）。
文中沒有提到餐廳，原文說 at school。

qs.q: What do Sara and her husband do after dinner?
qs.why: 原文：After dinner they go for a short walk. 晚餐後他們去散步一下。
wn: 看新書是她下午在學校做的事，不是晚餐後。
文中沒有提到看電視，晚餐後是去散步。

reading.title: 短文 4
reading.text: Jack and Emma are students. They live with their parents. On weekdays they get up at seven and eat breakfast quickly. Jack rides his bike to school, but Emma takes the bus. Their classes finish at four. Jack usually plays basketball after school. Emma goes to the library and studies. They both come home at six. Their mother cooks dinner, and their father washes the dishes. The family sometimes plays a card game in the evening. Jack and Emma never go to bed after ten thirty on weekdays.

qs.q: How does Jack go to school?
qs.why: 原文：Jack rides his bike to school. Jack 騎腳踏車上學。
wn: 搭公車的是 Emma（Emma takes the bus），不是 Jack。
文中沒有說 Jack 走路，他是騎腳踏車。

qs.q: What does Emma do after school?
qs.why: 原文：Emma goes to the library and studies. Emma 放學後去圖書館讀書。
wn: 打籃球的是 Jack，不是 Emma。
煮晚餐的是媽媽（Their mother cooks dinner）。

qs.q: Who washes the dishes?
qs.why: 原文：their father washes the dishes. 洗碗的是爸爸。
wn: 文中沒有說 Jack 洗碗，洗碗的是爸爸。
媽媽負責煮晚餐（cooks dinner），洗碗的是爸爸。

qs.q: What does the family sometimes do in the evening?
qs.why: 原文：The family sometimes plays a card game in the evening. 全家晚上有時玩紙牌遊戲。
wn: 文中沒有提到看電影，原文說 plays a card game。
文中沒有提到散步，原文說 plays a card game。

qs.q: When do Jack and Emma go to bed on weekdays?
qs.why: 原文：never go to bed after ten thirty on weekdays. 從不超過十點半睡，也就是十點半前睡。
wn: 原文說 never go to bed after ten thirty，十一點以後更不可能。
文中沒有提到九點，只說不會晚於十點半。

reading.title: 短文 1
reading.text: My name is Amy. I wake up at 6:30 every morning. First, I turn off the alarm and get up. Then I wash my face and brush my teeth. I always take a shower in the morning. After that, I get dressed and comb my hair. My mother makes breakfast for the family. We have breakfast together at 7:15. My father drinks coffee, but I drink milk. My little brother doesn't like breakfast. He always checks his phone at the table! At 7:45, we leave home and go to school and work.

qs.q: What time does Amy wake up?
qs.why: 原文：I wake up at 6:30 every morning. Amy 每天 6:30 起床。
wn: 原文說 6:30；7:15 是吃早餐的時間。

qs.q: Does Amy take a shower in the morning?
qs.why: 原文：I always take a shower in the morning. 她早上都洗澡，答 Yes。
wn: 原文說 always take a shower，她有洗。
Amy 自己說了 I always take a shower，不是不知道。

qs.q: What does Amy's father drink?
qs.why: 原文：My father drinks coffee, but I drink milk. 爸爸喝咖啡。
wn: 文中沒有提到茶；爸爸喝 coffee。
文中沒有提到水；爸爸喝 coffee。

qs.q: What does Amy's little brother do at the table?
qs.why: 原文：He always checks his phone at the table! 弟弟在餐桌上一直看手機。
wn: 文中沒說他看書，他是 checks his phone。
文中沒說他寫功課，他是 checks his phone。

qs.q: What time does the family leave home?
qs.why: 原文：At 7:45, we leave home. 7:45 出門。
wn: 7:15 是一起吃早餐的時間，不是出門。

reading.title: 短文 2
reading.text: Tom is a student. He goes to school every day. School starts at 8 o'clock. He studies English and math in the morning. At noon, he has lunch with his friends. In the afternoon, he attends class again. Tom's sister, Mary, works in an office. She goes to work by bus. She starts work at 9 and has a meeting every Monday. She answers emails and talks to her colleagues. Mary doesn't have lunch at her desk. She finishes work at six and goes home.

qs.q: What time does school start for Tom?
qs.why: 原文：School starts at 8 o'clock. 學校八點開始上課。
wn: 文中沒有 7 點；學校是 8 o'clock 開始。
九點是 Mary 開始上班的時間，不是 Tom 上學。

qs.q: How does Mary go to work?
qs.why: 原文：She goes to work by bus. Mary 搭公車上班。
wn: 文中沒說開車；原文是 by bus。
文中沒說騎腳踏車；原文是 by bus。

qs.q: When does Mary have a meeting?
qs.why: 原文：has a meeting every Monday. Mary 每週一開會。
wn: 原文說 every Monday，是星期一，不是星期五。
原文說 every Monday，一週一次，不是每天。

qs.q: Does Mary have lunch at her desk?
qs.why: 原文：Mary doesn't have lunch at her desk. 不在桌上吃，答 No。
wn: 原文說 doesn't have lunch at her desk，是不會。
always 是總是；原文是 doesn't，剛好相反。

qs.q: What time does Mary finish work?
qs.why: 原文：She finishes work at six. Mary 六點下班。
wn: 原文說 at six，不是 five。
原文說 at six，不是 seven。

reading.title: 短文 3
reading.text: Lisa comes home at six every evening. She cooks dinner for her family. They eat dinner together at seven. After dinner, Lisa's husband washes the dishes. Their children watch TV or play games. Lisa likes to read a book on the sofa. She doesn't watch TV every night. At nine, the children take a shower and brush their teeth. Lisa checks her email one more time. Then she turns off the lights and locks the door. The family goes to bed at ten o'clock.

qs.q: What time does Lisa come home?
qs.why: 原文：Lisa comes home at six every evening. Lisa 六點到家。
wn: 文中沒有五點；Lisa 是 at six 到家。
七點是全家吃晚餐的時間。

qs.q: Who washes the dishes?
qs.why: 原文：After dinner, Lisa's husband washes the dishes. 洗碗的是她先生。
wn: Lisa 是煮晚餐的人，洗碗的是 husband。
小孩是看電視或玩遊戲，不是洗碗。

qs.q: What does Lisa like to do on the sofa?
qs.why: 原文：Lisa likes to read a book on the sofa. 她喜歡在沙發上看書。
wn: Lisa doesn't watch TV every night，她愛看書。
玩遊戲的是小孩，不是 Lisa。

qs.q: What time do the children take a shower?
qs.why: 原文：At nine, the children take a shower. 小孩九點洗澡。
wn: 文中沒有八點；洗澡是 At nine。
十點是全家睡覺的時間（go to bed at ten）。

qs.q: What time does the family go to bed?
qs.why: 原文：The family goes to bed at ten o'clock. 全家十點睡覺。
wn: 九點是小孩洗澡刷牙的時間。
文中沒有十一點；睡覺是 ten o'clock。

reading.title: 短文 4
reading.text: My name is Ken. I always wake up at seven o'clock. I usually have breakfast at home, but I sometimes eat out with friends. I often go to the gym after work. I rarely watch TV because I am busy. I never drink coffee at night. On weekends, I go swimming once a week. My sister is different. She doesn't exercise very much. She usually stays home and reads books. She sometimes goes shopping on Saturdays. We both try to get enough sleep every night.

qs.q: What time does Ken always wake up?
qs.why: 原文：I always wake up at seven o'clock. Ken 都是七點起床。
wn: 原文說 seven o'clock，不是六點。
原文說 seven o'clock，不是八點。

qs.q: How often does Ken go swimming?
qs.why: 原文：I go swimming once a week. once a week 是一週一次。
wn: twice 是兩次；原文是 once，一次。
原文說 once a week，一週一次，不是每天。

qs.q: Does Ken drink coffee at night?
qs.why: 原文：I never drink coffee at night. never 是從不，晚上不喝咖啡。
wn: always 是總是，和原文的 never 相反。
sometimes 是有時；原文是 never，一次都不喝。

qs.q: What does Ken's sister usually do?
qs.why: 原文：She usually stays home and reads books. 姊妹通常在家看書。
wn: 原文說 She doesn't exercise very much。
去游泳的是 Ken，不是他的姊妹。

qs.q: When does Ken's sister go shopping?
qs.why: 原文：She sometimes goes shopping on Saturdays. 她星期六有時會去逛街。
wn: 原文說 on Saturdays，是星期六，不是星期一。
原文說 sometimes… on Saturdays，不是每天。

reading.title: 短文 5
reading.text: Today is Wednesday. Ben has a busy schedule this week. On Mondays, he studies English at seven in the evening. On Tuesdays, he has a meeting at nine o'clock. On Wednesdays, he plays basketball with his friends. He doesn't work on Saturdays or Sundays. Those are his weekends. On Saturday, he usually gets up at half past nine. On Sunday, he rests all day. Ben's sister asks, 'What time do you get up on weekdays?' He says, 'I get up at quarter past six every morning.'

qs.q: What day is it today in the story?
qs.why: 原文：Today is Wednesday. 故事裡今天是星期三。
wn: Monday 是 Ben 讀英文的日子，不是今天。
Sunday 是他休息的日子，不是今天。

qs.q: What time does Ben study English on Mondays?
qs.why: 原文：On Mondays… at seven in the evening. 週一晚上七點讀英文。
wn: 原文說 in the evening，是晚上，不是早上。
九點是星期二開會的時間，不是讀英文。

qs.q: Does Ben work on Saturdays?
qs.why: 原文：He doesn't work on Saturdays or Sundays. 星期六不上班。
wn: 原文說 doesn't work on Saturdays，他不上班。
原文直接說 doesn't work，沒有說有時候。

qs.q: What time does Ben usually get up on Saturday?
qs.why: 原文：On Saturday… at half past nine. half past nine 是九點半。
wn: 六點十五分是平日（weekdays）起床，不是星期六。
九點是星期二開會；星期六是 half past nine。

qs.q: What time does Ben get up on weekdays?
qs.why: 原文：I get up at quarter past six. quarter past six 是 6:15。
wn: half past 是 6:30；原文是 quarter past，6:15。
文中沒有七點起床；七點是週一讀英文。

reading.title: 短文 6
reading.text: This is Anna's daily routine. She always wakes up at six thirty. She washes her face, brushes her teeth, and gets dressed. She has breakfast at seven and leaves home at seven thirty. She goes to work by bus. She starts work at nine and has lunch at noon. She usually has a meeting on Mondays. She finishes work at six and gets home at six thirty. In the evening, she cooks dinner and eats with her family. After dinner, she takes a walk and reads a book. She doesn't stay up late. She goes to bed at ten thirty every night.

qs.q: What time does Anna wake up?
qs.why: 原文：She always wakes up at six thirty. Anna 每天六點半起床。
wn: 原文是 six thirty，六點半，不是整點六點。
seven 是她吃早餐的時間（has breakfast at seven），不是起床時間。

qs.q: How does Anna go to work?
qs.why: 原文：She goes to work by bus. 她搭公車上班。
wn: 文中沒有提到開車，原文說 by bus。
文中沒有提到騎腳踏車，原文說 by bus。

qs.q: When does Anna usually have a meeting?
qs.why: 原文：She usually has a meeting on Mondays. 她通常星期一開會。
wn: 文中沒有提到星期五，原文是 on Mondays。
不是每天，原文只說 on Mondays 星期一。

qs.q: What does Anna do after dinner?
qs.why: 原文：After dinner, she takes a walk and reads a book. 晚餐後她散步、看書。
wn: 文中沒有說她看電視，晚餐後是散步和看書。
文中沒有說她去購物，晚餐後是散步和看書。

qs.q: What time does Anna go to bed?
qs.why: 原文：She goes to bed at ten thirty every night. 她每晚十點半睡覺。
wn: 原文是 ten thirty 十點半，不是九點半。
原文是 ten thirty 十點半，不是整點十點。

mc.q: ___ a table in the kitchen.
mc.why: 說某處有某物用 There is；a table 是一張，單數。
wn: There are 配複數，a table 只有一張。
It is 是說這是什麼；說某處有東西要用 There is。

mc.q: ___ two beds in the bedroom.
mc.why: two beds 是兩張床（複數），用 There are。
wn: There is 配單數，two beds 是複數。
isn't 配單數，後面 two beds 是複數，對不上。

mc.q: There ___ a car in the garage.
mc.why: a car 是一台車（單數），用 There is。
wn: are 配複數，a car 只有一台。
am 只配 I，不用在 there 句型。

mc.q: ___ any chairs in the living room?
mc.why: any chairs 是複數，問有沒有用 Are there…?，be 動詞放在 there 前面。
wn: Is there 問單數，chairs 是好幾張。
There 句型問句用 Is／Are，沒有 Do there 的說法。

mc.q: There ___ a garden behind the house.
mc.why: a garden 是一個花園（單數），用 There is。
wn: are 配複數，a garden 只有一個。
be 是原形，句子裡要變成 is 或 are。

mc.q: The lamp is ___ the table.
mc.why: 檯燈放在桌面上，用 on the table。
wn: in 是在裡面，燈不會在桌子裡面。
under 是在桌子底下，檯燈一般放桌上。

mc.q: The shoes are ___ the bed.
mc.zh: 鞋子在床底下。
mc.why: under 是在下面：鞋子放在床底下 under the bed。
wn: on 是在床上面，意思不同。
between 要兩個東西，這裡只有床。

mc.q: The bathroom is ___ the bedroom and the kitchen.
mc.zh: 浴室在臥室和廚房中間。
mc.why: 線索是 the bedroom and the kitchen 兩個房間，夾在中間用 between。
wn: next to 是旁邊；夾在 A and B 中間用 between。
under 是在下面，浴室不在臥室底下。

mc.q: There ___ a window in the study.
mc.why: a window 是一扇窗，單數，否定用 There isn't。
wn: aren't 配複數，a window 只有一扇。
There 句型否定用 isn't，不用 don't。

mc.q: ___ there a park near your house?
mc.why: a park 是一個公園，單數，問句用 Is there…?
wn: Are 配複數，a park 只有一個。
There 問句用 Is／Are，不用 Do。

mc.q: There ___ a kitchen on the first floor.
mc.why: a kitchen 是一間廚房，單數，用 There is。
wn: are 配複數，a kitchen 只有一間。
am 只配 I，There 句型不用。

mc.q: There ___ three bedrooms in my house.
mc.why: three bedrooms 是三間臥室，複數，用 There are。
wn: is 配單數，這裡有 three 三間。
be 是原形，要變成 are 才能用。

mc.q: There ___ not a garage next to the house.
mc.why: 後面有 not 和 a garage（單數），用 There is not a garage。
wn: are 配複數，a garage 只有一間。
There 句型否定是 be 動詞加 not，不用 do not。

mc.q: ___ there a garden behind your house?
mc.why: a garden 是一個花園，單數，問句用 Is there…?
wn: Are 配複數，a garden 只有一個。
There 問句用 be 動詞開頭，不用 Does。

mc.q: ___ there two bathrooms in the flat?
mc.why: two bathrooms 是兩間浴室（複數），問有沒有用 Are there…?
wn: Is there 配單數，two bathrooms 是複數。
there 句型用 be 動詞問，不用 Do。

mc.q: The living room is ___ the kitchen and the bedroom.
mc.why: 句中有 the kitchen and the bedroom 兩個房間，在中間用 between A and B。
wn: under 是在下面，客廳不會在兩個房間底下。
on 是在上面，客廳不會在兩個房間上面。

mc.q: My bedroom is ___ the bathroom.
mc.why: next to 是在旁邊：我的臥室在浴室隔壁。
wn: between 要兩個地點：between A and B。
under 是在下面，房間通常不說在另一間底下。

mc.q: There is a small garden ___ front of the house.
mc.why: 在…前面是固定說法 in front of，空格後已經有 front of，填 in。
wn: 沒有 on front of 的說法，要說 in front of。
沒有 at front of 的說法，要說 in front of。

mc.q: The car is ___ the garage.
mc.why: 在車庫裡面用 in：in the garage。
wn: under 是在下面，車子不會在車庫底下。
between 要兩個東西，這裡只有車庫。

mc.q: There ___ two windows in the living room.
mc.why: two windows 是兩扇窗，複數，用 There are。
wn: is 配單數，這裡有 two 兩扇。
說某處有某物用 There are，不用 has。

mc.why: 桌子放在廚房這個空間裡面，用 in the kitchen。
wn: on 是在表面上，桌子不在廚房上面。
under 是在下面，桌子不在廚房底下。

mc.q: Is there a bathroom downstairs? — Yes, ___ is.
mc.why: 問句是 Is there…?，回答也用 there：Yes, there is。
wn: Is there 問有沒有，回答用 there is，不換成 it is。
回答 Is there 的問題用 there is，不用 that is。

mc.q: Is there a garage here? — No, there ___.
mc.why: 問句 Is there a garage 用 is，否定簡答是 No, there isn't。
wn: 問的是一間 a garage，用 isn't，不用 aren't。
Is there 問句用 be 動詞回答，不用 doesn't。

mc.q: Are there four bedrooms? — No, there ___.
mc.why: 問句 Are there four bedrooms 用 are，否定簡答是 No, there aren't。
wn: 問的是複數 four bedrooms，要用 aren't。
Are there 問句用 be 動詞回答，不用 don't。

mc.q: There ___ any chairs in the garden.
mc.why: any chairs 是複數，否定用 are not，縮寫成 aren't。
wn: isn't 配單數，chairs 是好幾張。
not 要放在 are 後面：are not 或 aren't。

mc.q: There is a lamp ___ the bedroom wall.
mc.why: 燈掛在牆面上，用 on the wall。
wn: in 是在裡面，燈不會在牆裡面。
under 是在下面，燈是掛在牆上。

mc.q: The garden is ___ the house.
mc.why: behind 是在後面：花園在房子後面 behind the house。
wn: between 要兩個東西：between A and B，這裡只有房子。
of 是…的，不能單獨表示位置。

mc.q: There ___ a bathroom and a kitchen upstairs.
mc.why: There 後面第一個名詞是 a bathroom（單數），口語常跟著它用 is。
wn: 說某處有東西用 There is，不說 There have。
be 是原形，句子裡要用 is 或 are。

mc.q: How many rooms ___ there in your house?
mc.why: How many rooms 問數量，rooms 是複數，後面接 are there。
wn: rooms 是複數，不能用 is。
There 問句用 be 動詞，不用 do。

mc.q: There are some boxes ___ the garage.
mc.why: 箱子放在車庫這個空間裡，用 in the garage。
wn: at 指一個地點，說東西放在空間裡面用 in。
of 是…的，不能表示位置。

mc.q: There is a small mat ___ front of the bathroom door.
mc.why: 在…前面的固定說法是 in front of，空格後面已經有 front of。
wn: 沒有 on front of 的說法，要說 in front of。
沒有 at front of 的說法，要說 in front of。

mc.why: no windows 的 windows 有 s，是複數，用 There are no windows（沒有窗戶）。
wn: be 是原形，句子裡要變成 are。

mc.why: only one bathroom 只有一間浴室，單數，用 There is。
wn: are 配複數，這裡 one 只有一間。
說某處有某物用 There is，不說 There have。

mc.q: ___ there a big garden near your school?
mc.why: a big garden 是一個花園，單數，問句用 Is there…?
wn: Are 配複數，a garden 只有一個。
There 問句用 be 動詞，不用 Do。

mc.why: 貓在沙發底下，用 under the sofa。
wn: of 是…的，不能表示位置。
between 要接兩樣東西，這裡只有 the sofa。

wn: at 指一個地點，說房間裡有東西用 in。
of 是…的，不能表示在哪裡。

wn: under 是在下面，花園不會在房子底下。
between 要接兩樣東西，這裡只有 the house。

mc.why: aren't 是否定句，後面 bedrooms 是複數，用 any：一間都沒有。
wn: some 多用在肯定句；否定句用 any。

mc.why: garage 是子音 g 開頭的單數名詞，前面用 a。

mc.why: a clock 是一個時鐘（單數），用 There is。

說某處有某物用 There is，不說 There have。

說某處有某物用 There are，不說 There has。

there 句型用 be 動詞回答，不用 do。

mc.q: Are there any chairs in the garden? — Yes, there ___.
mc.why: 問句 Are there any chairs 用 are，簡答也用 are：Yes, there are。
wn: 問的是複數 chairs，回答要用 are。
Are there 問句用 be 動詞回答，不用 do。

mc.q: There is a bike ___ the garden.
mc.why: 腳踏車在花園這個範圍裡面，用 in the garden。
wn: on 是在表面上，在花園裡要用 in。
of 是…的，不能表示位置。

mc.q: My keys are ___ the table near the door.
mc.why: 鑰匙放在桌面上，用 on the table。
wn: in 是在裡面，鑰匙放在桌上，不是桌子裡。
between 要接兩樣東西，這裡只有 the table。

mc.q: There ___ not any people in the kitchen now.
mc.why: people 本身就是複數（一群人），用 There are not any people。
wn: there 句型的否定用 be 動詞，不用 do。

fill.q: There is ___ garage near the garden.
fill.why: garage 是一間、可數，開頭是子音 g，用 a：a garage。

fill.q: There aren't ___ chairs in the bathroom.
fill.why: 否定句 aren't 後面接複數名詞，用 any：There aren't any chairs。

fill.q: There are ___ boxes in the garage.
fill.why: 肯定句裡表示一些，用 some；any 多用在否定句和問句。

fill.q: The garden is ___ the house.
fill.why: behind 是在後面：花園在房子後面，The garden is behind the house。

fill.q: There ___ a door between the kitchen and the garden.
fill.why: 主角是 a door（一扇），用 is；between… 只是在說位置。

fill.q: There ___ four rooms in my flat.
fill.why: four rooms 是複數，用 There are。

fill.q: Is there a window ___ the bathroom?
fill.why: 浴室是一個房間，在裡面用 in：in the bathroom。

fill.q: There is a picture ___ the living room wall.
fill.why: 畫掛在牆面上，貼著表面用 on：on the wall。

fill.q: ___ there any plants in your garden?
fill.why: plants 有 s 是複數，問句用 Are there any…?

fill.q: There is a cat ___ front of the garage door.
fill.why: 在…前面的固定說法是 in front of，空格後已經有 front of，只缺 in。

fill.q: My shoes are ___ the bedroom door.
fill.why: 這裡填表示位置的介系詞：near 附近、next to 旁邊、behind 後面都可以。

fill.q: There ___ no water in the bathroom now.
fill.why: water 是不可數名詞，當單數看用 is；no 已經是否定，is 不用加 not。

fill.q: There ___ two doors in the kitchen.
fill.why: two doors 是複數，用 There are。

fill.q: The living room is ___ the first floor.
fill.why: 在第幾樓固定用 on：on the first floor。

fill.q: There is a clock ___ the kitchen.
fill.why: 時鐘在廚房裡面，房間用 in：in the kitchen。

fill.q: Are there any bedrooms upstairs? Yes, there ___.
fill.why: 問句是 Are there…?，簡答也用 are：Yes, there are.

fill.q: Is there a garden here? No, there ___.
fill.why: 回答是 No，後面要用否定：No, there isn't.

fill.q: There is a big tree ___ my garden.
fill.why: 樹長在花園裡面，garden 是一塊範圍，用 in：in my garden。

fill.q: There ___ some old chairs in the garage.
fill.why: chairs 有 s 是複數，用 There are；some 表示一些。

fill.q: The bathroom door is ___ the stairs.
fill.why: 這裡填表示位置的介系詞：near 附近、next to 旁邊都可以。

fill.q: There ___ a window between the two doors.
fill.why: 主角是 a window（一扇），用 is；the two doors 只是在說位置。

fill.q: There are two cars ___ front of my house.
fill.why: 在…前面是 in front of，空格後已經有 front of，補上 in。

reading.title: 短文 1
reading.text: My house is small but nice. There is a living room, a kitchen, and a bedroom. There is a sofa in the living room and a TV on the wall. There is a table in the dining room. In the kitchen, there is a fridge next to the window. There is one bathroom near the bedroom. There isn't a garage, but there is a small garden behind the house. There are many flowers in the garden. I like my house very much.

qs.q: Where is the sofa?
qs.why: 原文：There is a sofa in the living room. 沙發在客廳。
wn: 廚房裡的是冰箱（a fridge），不是沙發。
花園裡的是花（many flowers），不是沙發。

qs.q: What is on the wall?
qs.why: 原文：a TV on the wall. on the wall 是在牆上，牆上有一台電視。
wn: 窗戶是在廚房冰箱旁邊提到的，不是在牆上的東西。
文中沒有提到燈，牆上是電視。

qs.q: Is there a garage?
qs.why: 原文：There isn't a garage. 沒有車庫，用 there is 問就用 No, there isn't 回答。
wn: 原文說 There isn't a garage，沒有車庫。
原文說沒有車庫；而且 garage 是一個，也不用 are。

qs.q: Where is the fridge?
qs.why: 原文：there is a fridge next to the window. 冰箱在窗戶旁邊。
wn: 原文是 next to the window 窗戶旁邊，不是門旁邊。
文中沒有說冰箱在桌子下面，原文是 next to the window。

qs.q: What is behind the house?
qs.why: 原文：there is a small garden behind the house. behind 是在後面，房子後面有花園。
wn: 原文說 There isn't a garage，根本沒有車庫。
浴室在臥室附近（near the bedroom），不在房子後面。

reading.title: 短文 2
reading.text: My name is Mei. I live in a small house in Taipei. There are two bedrooms and one bathroom in my house. The kitchen is next to the living room, and there is a big table in the kitchen. There is no garage, but there is a small garden behind the house. In the garden there are some flowers and one tree. My cat often sleeps under the tree. My bedroom is upstairs. There are two windows in my bedroom, and there is a clock on the wall. My house is not big, but it is warm and quiet. I like it very much.

qs.q: How many bedrooms are there in Mei's house?
qs.why: 原文：There are two bedrooms and one bathroom. Mei 家有兩間臥室。
wn: one 是浴室的數量（one bathroom），臥室是 two。
文中沒有三間，臥室是 two bedrooms。

qs.q: Is there a garage in the house?
qs.why: 原文：There is no garage. 沒有車庫，所以回答 No, there isn't.
wn: 原文說 There is no garage，沒有車庫。
原文說 There is no garage，一個車庫都沒有。

qs.q: Where is the garden?
qs.why: 原文：there is a small garden behind the house. behind 是在後面。
wn: in front of 是在前面，原文是 behind 在後面。
在廚房旁邊的是客廳（kitchen is next to the living room）。

qs.q: What is under the tree?
qs.why: 原文：My cat often sleeps under the tree. Mei 的貓常在樹下睡覺。
wn: 大桌子在廚房裡（in the kitchen），不在樹下。
時鐘在臥室牆上（on the wall），不在樹下。

qs.q: Where is the clock?
qs.why: 原文：there is a clock on the wall. 這句在講臥室，時鐘在臥室牆上。
wn: 廚房裡的是大桌子，時鐘在臥室牆上。
原文是 on the wall 在牆上，不是窗戶下面。

reading.title: 短文 3
reading.text: This is my friend Ken's flat. It is on the third floor. There are three rooms in the flat: one bedroom, one living room and one kitchen. There is also a small bathroom next to the bedroom. There isn't a garden, because it is a flat in the city. There are two big windows in the living room. Between the windows there is a picture of the sea. The kitchen is very small. There are no chairs in the kitchen, but there is a little table near the door. Ken says his flat is small but comfortable.

qs.q: Where is Ken's flat?
qs.why: 原文：It is on the third floor. Ken 的公寓在三樓。
wn: 原文是 third floor 三樓，不是 first floor 一樓。
原文說是 flat 公寓，而且 Ken 說它 small 小。

qs.q: How many rooms are there in the flat?
qs.why: 原文：There are three rooms in the flat. 文中直接說三個房間。
wn: 原文列了臥室、客廳、廚房三個，不是兩個。
原文說 three rooms，浴室是另外補充的 also，不算在內。

qs.q: Is there a garden?
opts: Yes, there is a big one.
qs.why: 原文：There isn't a garden, because it is a flat in the city. 沒有花園。
wn: 原文說 There isn't a garden，沒有花園。
原文說 There isn't a garden，連小的都沒有。

qs.q: What is between the two windows?
qs.why: 原文：Between the windows there is a picture of the sea. 兩扇窗中間是一幅海的畫。
wn: 小桌子在廚房門附近，不在兩扇窗中間。
文中沒說門在兩扇窗中間，中間是一幅畫。

qs.q: What is near the kitchen door?
qs.why: 原文：there is a little table near the door. 廚房門附近有一張小桌子。
wn: 原文說 There are no chairs in the kitchen，廚房沒有椅子。
文中沒有提到沙發，門邊是一張小桌子。

reading.title: 短文 4
reading.text: My grandparents live in an old house in the country. The house is big. There are four bedrooms upstairs and two bathrooms. Downstairs there is a living room, a kitchen and a small room for books. There is a garage next to the house, but there isn't a car in it. There are only some old boxes and two bikes. Behind the house there is a big garden with many plants. In front of the house there are three trees. I visit my grandparents every summer. I always sleep in the small bedroom near the stairs.

qs.q: Where do the grandparents live?
qs.why: 原文：live in an old house in the country. in the country 是在鄉下。
wn: 原文是 in the country 鄉下，不是城市。
原文是 an old house，而且 The house is big，不是小公寓。

qs.q: How many bedrooms are there upstairs?
qs.why: 原文：There are four bedrooms upstairs. 樓上有四間臥室。
wn: two 是浴室的數量（two bathrooms），臥室是 four。
three 是房子前面樹的數量，臥室是 four。

qs.q: What is in the garage?
qs.why: 原文：There are only some old boxes and two bikes. 車庫裡只有舊箱子和兩台腳踏車。
wn: 原文說 there isn't a car in it，車庫裡沒有車。
車庫不是空的，裡面有舊箱子和兩台腳踏車。

qs.q: What is in front of the house?
qs.why: 原文：In front of the house there are three trees. 房子前面有三棵樹。
wn: 車庫在房子旁邊（next to the house），不是前面。
大花園在房子後面（Behind the house），不是前面。

qs.q: Where does the writer sleep?
opts: In the small bedroom near the stairs
qs.why: 原文：I always sleep in the small bedroom near the stairs. 作者睡在樓梯旁的小臥室。
wn: 客廳在樓下，文中沒說作者睡客廳。
車庫裡只有箱子和腳踏車，作者睡在小臥室。

mc.q: ___ a sofa in the living room.
mc.zh: 客廳裡有一張沙發。
mc.why: a sofa 是一張沙發（單數），肯定句用 There is。
wn: There are 配複數，a sofa 只有一張。
There isn't 是「沒有」；中文說客廳裡有一張沙發。

mc.q: ___ four chairs in the kitchen.
mc.why: four chairs 是複數，敘述句用 There are 開頭。
wn: There is 配單數，four chairs 是四張。
Is there 是問句的順序，這句是句號結尾的敘述句。

mc.q: There ___ a TV in the bedroom.
mc.why: a TV 是一台電視（單數），用 There is。
wn: are 配複數，a TV 只有一台。
am 只配 I，不用在 there 句型。

mc.q: ___ there a fridge in the kitchen?
mc.why: a fridge 是一台冰箱，單數；問句把 is 搬到 there 前面：Is there…?
wn: Are 配複數，a fridge 只有一台。
There 句型的問句用 be 動詞開頭，不用 Do。

mc.q: The lamp is ___ the desk.
mc.why: 檯燈放在書桌桌面上，用 on the desk。
wn: under 是在桌子底下，檯燈一般放桌上。
between 要接兩樣東西，這裡只有 the desk。

mc.q: The cat is ___ the sofa.
mc.zh: 貓在沙發底下。
mc.why: 貓躲在沙發底下，用 under the sofa。
wn: in 是在裡面，貓不會在沙發裡面。
on 是在沙發上面；中文說的是在沙發底下。

mc.q: The mirror is ___ the wall.
mc.why: 鏡子掛在牆面上，貼著表面用 on：on the wall。
wn: in 是在裡面，鏡子不會在牆壁裡面。
under 是在下面，鏡子是掛在牆上。

mc.q: The bookcase is ___ the desk and the window.
mc.zh: 書櫃在書桌和窗戶中間。
mc.why: 線索是 the desk and the window 兩樣東西，書櫃夾在中間用 between。
wn: next to 是旁邊；夾在 A and B 中間用 between。
under 是在下面，書櫃不會在書桌底下。

mc.q: ___ there a wardrobe in your bedroom?
mc.why: a wardrobe 是一個衣櫃（單數），問有沒有用 Is there…?
wn: Are there 配複數，a wardrobe 是單數。
there 句型用 be 動詞問，不用 Do。

mc.q: There ___ a new sofa in the living room.
mc.why: a new sofa 是一張沙發，單數，用 There is。
wn: are 配複數，a sofa 只有一張。
be 是原形，要用 is 或 are。

mc.q: There ___ four chairs near the table.
mc.why: four chairs 是四張椅子，複數，用 There are。
wn: is 只配單數，four chairs 是四張。
There 後面接 be 動詞，不接 has。

mc.q: There ___ not a TV in my bedroom.
mc.why: 後面有 not 和 a TV（單數），用 There is not a TV。
wn: are 配複數，a TV 只有一台。
There 句型否定是 is not，不用 do not。

mc.q: ___ there two beds in this room?
mc.why: two beds 是兩張床（複數），問有沒有用 Are there…?
wn: Is there 配單數，two beds 是複數。
there 句型用 be 動詞問，不用 Does。

mc.q: The chair is ___ the table and the bed.
mc.why: 句中有 the table and the bed 兩樣東西，在中間用 between A and B。
wn: under 是在下面，椅子不會同時在桌子和床底下。
on 是在上面，椅子不會在桌子和床上面。

mc.q: My bag is ___ the bed.
mc.why: 包包在床底下，用 under the bed。
wn: of 是…的，不能表示位置。
at 指某個地點，放在床底下要用 under。

mc.q: There is a small lamp ___ my bed.
mc.why: 燈就在床的旁邊，用 next to my bed。
wn: between 要接兩樣東西，這裡只有 my bed。
of 是…的，不能表示位置。

mc.q: There ___ some old chairs in the garage.
mc.why: some old chairs 是好幾張椅子（複數），用 There are。
wn: is 配一個東西，chairs 是複數。
說某處有某物用 There are，不說 There has。

mc.q: The TV is ___ front of the sofa.
mc.why: 在…前面的固定說法是 in front of：電視在沙發前面。
wn: 沒有 on front of 這種說法。
沒有 at front of 這種說法。

mc.q: There is a big fridge ___ the kitchen.
mc.why: 冰箱放在廚房這個空間裡面，用 in the kitchen。
wn: on 是在表面上，冰箱不是在廚房上面。
under 是在下面，冰箱不會在廚房底下。

mc.q: Is there a lamp on the table? — Yes, there ___.
mc.why: 問句 Is there a lamp 用 is，簡答也用 is：Yes, there is。
wn: 問的是一盞 a lamp，用 is 回答，不用 are。
Is there 問句用 be 動詞回答，不用 do。

mc.q: Are there two sofas here? — No, there ___.
mc.why: 問句 Are there two sofas 用 are，否定簡答是 No, there aren't。
wn: 問的是複數 two sofas，要用 aren't。
Are there 問句用 be 動詞回答，不用 don't。

mc.q: There ___ no chairs in this room.
mc.why: no chairs 的 chairs 有 s，是複數，用 There are no chairs。
wn: chairs 是複數，is 只配單數。
be 要變成 are 才能放進句子。

mc.q: There is ___ old table in the kitchen.
mc.why: old 開頭是母音的音，前面用 an：an old table。
wn: a 用在子音開頭的字前；old 是母音開頭，要用 an。
some 配複數或不可數，table 是一張（單數）。

mc.q: There is ___ new bed in my bedroom.
mc.why: new 是子音 n 開頭，一個東西前面用 a：a new bed。
wn: an 只用在母音開頭的字前，new 是子音開頭。
any 用在否定句和問句；肯定句說一張床用 a。

mc.q: There aren't ___ lamps in the bathroom.
mc.why: 否定句 There aren't 後面，複數名詞前用 any。
wn: some 用在肯定句；否定句要改成 any。
a 只配一個東西，lamps 是複數。

mc.q: How many chairs ___ there in the kitchen?
mc.why: How many chairs 問數量，chairs 是複數，後面接 are there。
wn: chairs 是複數，不能用 is。
There 句型的問句用 be 動詞，不用 do。

mc.q: There ___ a TV and a lamp in the living room.
mc.why: There is 後面列了 a TV and a lamp，be 動詞常跟著最近的 a TV（單數）用 is。
wn: am 只配 I，There 句型不用 am。
說某處有某物用 There is，不說 There have。

mc.q: There are some books ___ the table.
mc.why: 書放在桌面上，用 on the table。
wn: at 指一個地點，放在桌面上要用 on。
of 是…的，不能表示位置。

mc.q: The bed is ___ the window.
mc.why: near 是在附近：床在窗戶旁邊附近。
wn: of 是…的，不能單獨表示位置。
between 要兩個東西，這裡只有窗戶。

mc.q: There ___ two lamps behind the sofa.
mc.why: two lamps 是兩盞燈（複數），用 There are。
wn: is 配一個東西，two lamps 是複數。
說某處有某物用 There are，不說 There has。

mc.q: Is there a bed in the living room? — No, there ___.
mc.why: 問句 Is there a bed 用 is，否定簡答是 No, there isn't。
wn: 問的是一張 a bed，用 isn't，不用 aren't。
Is there 問句用 be 動詞回答，不用 doesn't。

mc.q: There is a clock ___ the fridge.
mc.why: 時鐘放在冰箱頂上或貼在冰箱表面，用 on the fridge。
wn: in 是在裡面，時鐘不會放進冰箱裡。
between 要接兩樣東西，這裡只有 the fridge。

mc.q: There ___ not any chairs near the door.
mc.why: any chairs 是複數，用 There are not any，也就是 There aren't any。
wn: is 配單數，chairs 是複數。
there 句型的否定用 are not，不用 do not。

mc.q: My phone is ___ the sofa.
mc.why: under 是在下面：手機在沙發底下 under the sofa。
wn: of 是…的，不能單獨表示位置。
at the sofa 不是自然說法，在沙發下面用 under。

mc.q: There is a table ___ the middle of the room.
mc.why: 在…正中間是固定說法 in the middle of。
wn: 沒有 on the middle of 這種說法。
正中間用 in the middle，不用 at。

mc.q: There are three chairs ___ the kitchen.
mc.why: 椅子放在廚房這個空間裡，用 in the kitchen。
wn: on 是在表面上，在房間裡要用 in。
under 是在下面，椅子不在廚房底下。

mc.q: ___ there any lamps in your bedroom?
mc.why: any lamps 是複數，問有沒有用 Are there…?
wn: lamps 有 s 是複數，不用 Is。
there 句型用 be 動詞問，不用 Do。

mc.q: There is a big TV ___ the wall.
mc.why: 電視掛在牆面上，用 on the wall。
wn: in 是在裡面，電視不在牆壁裡。
under 是在下面，電視是掛在牆上。

mc.q: There ___ some water in the fridge.
mc.why: water 是不可數名詞（不能一個一個數），不可數的東西用 There is。
wn: water 不能數，不算複數，不用 are。
說某處有某物用 There is，不說 There have。

mc.q: Are there any tables in the garden? — Yes, there ___.
mc.why: 問句是 Are there any tables，簡答照問句的 be 動詞：Yes, there are。
wn: 問句用 Are 問複數 tables，回答也要用 are。
Are there 的問題用 be 動詞回答，不用 do。

mc.q: The lamp is ___ the bed and the chair.
mc.zh: 檯燈在床和椅子中間。
mc.why: 線索是 the bed and the chair 兩樣東西，燈在中間用 between。
wn: next 單獨不能表示位置，要說 next to。
behind 是在後面；夾在 A and B 中間用 between。

mc.q: There ___ one bed in this small room.
mc.why: one bed 只有一張床，單數，用 There is。
wn: are 配複數，這裡 one 只有一張。
be 是原形，要用 is 或 are。

mc.q: There is a chair ___ front of the TV.
mc.why: 在…前面的固定說法是 in front of：椅子在電視前面。
wn: 沒有 on front of 這種說法。
沒有 at front of 這種說法。

mc.q: There aren't any beds ___ the living room.
mc.why: 床在客廳這個空間裡面，用 in the living room。
wn: on 是在表面上，在房間裡要用 in。
of 是…的，不能表示在哪裡。

mc.q: There ___ four small tables here.
mc.why: four small tables 是四張桌子，複數，用 There are。
wn: is 配一個東西，這裡有 four 四張。
說某處有東西用 There are，不用 has。

mc.q: There is a sofa ___ the two lamps.
mc.why: the two lamps 是兩盞燈，沙發夾在兩盞燈中間，用 between。
wn: under 是在下面，不能表示夾在兩盞燈中間。
on 是在表面上，不能表示在兩者中間。
