reading.title: 短文 1
reading.text: My bedroom is small. There is a bed next to the window. There is a wardrobe between the bed and the door. There is a desk near the window, and there is a lamp on the desk. There are two shelves above the desk, with many books on them. There isn't a TV in my bedroom, but there is a small fan under the desk. I like my quiet room very much.

qs.q: Where is the bed?
qs.why: 原文：There is a bed next to the window. 床在窗戶旁邊。
wn: 門旁邊的是衣櫃（wardrobe between the bed and the door）。
書桌下面的是電扇（a small fan under the desk）。

qs.q: What is between the bed and the door?
qs.why: 原文：There is a wardrobe between the bed and the door. 床和門中間是衣櫃。
wn: 書桌在窗戶附近（near the window），不在床和門中間。
文中沒有提到沙發，中間是衣櫃 wardrobe。

qs.q: Is there a TV in the bedroom?
qs.why: 原文：There isn't a TV in my bedroom. 房間沒有電視，回答 No, there isn't。
wn: 原文說 There isn't a TV，沒有電視。
原文說沒有電視；而且問 Is there 要用 is 回答，不用 are。

qs.q: Where is the lamp?
qs.why: 原文：there is a lamp on the desk. on the desk 是在書桌上。
wn: 原文是 on the desk 書桌上，不是床上。
原文是 on the desk 書桌上，窗戶旁邊的是床和書桌。

qs.q: Where is the fan?
qs.why: 原文：there is a small fan under the desk. under 是在下面，電扇在書桌下面。
wn: 書桌上的是檯燈（a lamp on the desk），電扇在下面。
門旁邊是衣櫃，電扇在書桌下面。

reading.title: 短文 2
reading.text: This is my living room. It is not very big, but I like it. There is a brown sofa near the window. In front of the sofa there is a small table. There are some books and one cup on the table. The TV is on the wall. There is a lamp next to the sofa, and there is a clock above the door. There aren't any beds in this room, of course. My cat likes this room too. She often sleeps under the small table. In the evening my family sits here and we watch TV together.

qs.q: Where is the sofa?
qs.why: 原文：There is a brown sofa near the window. 沙發在窗戶附近。
wn: 桌子下面睡的是貓（sleeps under the small table），不是沙發。
文中沒說沙發在門後，門上方是時鐘。

qs.q: What is on the small table?
qs.why: 原文：There are some books and one cup on the table. 小桌上有一些書和一個杯子。
wn: 檯燈在沙發旁，時鐘在門上方，都不在桌上。
電視在牆上（The TV is on the wall），不在桌上。

qs.q: Where is the TV?
qs.why: 原文：The TV is on the wall. 電視在牆上。
wn: 桌上是書和杯子，電視在牆上。
沙發旁邊的是檯燈（a lamp next to the sofa）。

qs.q: Where does the cat sleep?
qs.why: 原文：She often sleeps under the small table. 這裡的 She 是貓，牠常睡在小桌子下面。
wn: 文中沒說貓睡沙發，原文是 under the small table。
文中沒說貓睡電視後面，原文是 under the small table。

qs.q: Is there a bed in the living room?
qs.why: 原文：There aren't any beds in this room. 客廳裡沒有床，所以回答 No, there isn't.
wn: 原文說 There aren't any beds，一張床都沒有。
原文說 There aren't any beds，一張床都沒有。

reading.title: 短文 3
reading.text: My kitchen is small but useful. There is a big white fridge next to the door. There is some milk and some fruit in the fridge. In the middle of the kitchen there is a wooden table. There are four chairs around it. There is a lamp above the table, so the room is bright. There isn't a TV in my kitchen, and there isn't a sofa. There is a washing machine near the window. On the wall there is a small clock. I cook here every day, and my family eats dinner at this table.

qs.q: Where is the fridge?
qs.why: 原文：There is a big white fridge next to the door. 冰箱在門旁邊。
wn: 冰箱很大，文中說在 next to the door，不在桌下。
窗戶附近的是洗衣機（washing machine near the window）。

qs.q: How many chairs are there?
qs.why: 原文：There are four chairs around it. 桌子旁邊有四張椅子。
wn: 原文是 four chairs 四張，不是兩張。
原文是 four chairs 四張，不是六張。

qs.q: What is above the table?
qs.why: 原文：There is a lamp above the table. above 是在上方，桌子上方有一盞燈。
wn: 時鐘在牆上（On the wall there is a small clock）。
原文說 There isn't a TV，廚房沒有電視。

qs.q: Is there a TV in the kitchen?
opts: Yes, there is a small one.
qs.why: 原文：There isn't a TV in my kitchen. 廚房沒有電視。
wn: 原文說 There isn't a TV，沒有電視。
原文說 There isn't a TV，小的也沒有；small 的是時鐘。

qs.q: What is near the window?
qs.why: 原文：There is a washing machine near the window. 窗戶附近是洗衣機。
wn: 冰箱在門旁邊（next to the door），不在窗邊。
原文說 there isn't a sofa，廚房沒有沙發。

reading.title: 短文 4
reading.text: Anna has a new bedroom. There is a bed near the window and a desk next to the bed. On the desk there is a lamp and a computer. Under the desk there is a box with her shoes. There is a bookshelf behind the door, and there are many books on it. There isn't a TV in Anna's bedroom, because she likes a quiet room. There is a mirror on the wall between the bookshelf and the window. Anna's room is not big, but everything has a good place. She is happy with it.

qs.q: Where is Anna's desk?
qs.why: 原文：a desk next to the bed. 書桌在床旁邊。
wn: 門後面的是書架（a bookshelf behind the door）。
靠窗的是床（a bed near the window），書桌在床旁邊。

qs.q: What is under the desk?
qs.why: 原文：Under the desk there is a box with her shoes. 書桌下有一個裝鞋子的箱子。
wn: 書架在門後面（behind the door），不在書桌下。
檯燈在書桌上（On the desk），不是下面。

qs.q: Where is the bookshelf?
qs.why: 原文：There is a bookshelf behind the door. 書架在門後面。
wn: 靠窗的是床，書架在門後。
書桌上是檯燈和電腦，書架在門後。

qs.q: Is there a TV in her bedroom?
opts: Yes, there is a big one.
qs.why: 原文：There isn't a TV in Anna's bedroom. 她喜歡安靜，房裡沒有電視。
wn: 原文說 There isn't a TV，沒有電視。
原文說 There isn't a TV，大的小的都沒有。

qs.q: Where is the mirror?
opts: Between the bookshelf and the window
qs.why: 原文：a mirror on the wall between the bookshelf and the window. 鏡子在書架和窗戶中間。
wn: 書桌上是檯燈和電腦，鏡子在牆上。
文中沒說床下有東西，鏡子在書架和窗戶中間。

wn: take the bus 是「搭公車」

vocab_review.why: sofa＝沙發。例句：There is a sofa in the living room.

mc.q: ___ a bank near the station.

wn: There are 配複數，a bank 只有一間。
There isn't 是「沒有」；中文說車站附近有一間銀行。

mc.q: ___ many restaurants in this city.
mc.why: many restaurants 是複數，句尾是句號不是問號，用肯定句 There are。
wn: There is 配單數，many restaurants 是很多間。
句尾是句號，這是直述句，不是問句。

mc.q: There ___ a hospital near the park.
mc.why: a hospital 是一間醫院（單數），用 There is。
wn: are 配複數，a hospital 只有一間。
am 只配 I，不用在 there 句型。

mc.q: ___ there a supermarket near your house?
mc.why: a supermarket 是一間超市，單數，問句用 Is there…?
wn: Are 配複數，a supermarket 只有一間。
There 問句用 be 動詞，不用 Do。

mc.q: The library is ___ the school.
mc.why: next to 是在旁邊：圖書館在學校隔壁。
wn: under 是在下面，圖書館不會在學校底下。
on 是在上面，圖書館不會在學校上面。

mc.q: The bus stop is ___ the school.
mc.why: 公車站在學校的前面，用 in front of the school。
wn: under 是在下面，公車站不會在學校底下。
on 是在表面上，公車站不會在學校上面。

mc.q: The café is ___ the bank and the library.
mc.why: 線索是 the bank and the library 兩個地方，夾在中間用 between A and B。
wn: in 是在裡面，不能表示在兩個地方中間。
on 是在表面上，不能表示在兩者中間。

mc.q: There ___ a museum in this small town.
mc.why: a museum 是一間博物館，單數，否定用 There isn't。
wn: aren't 配複數，a museum 只有一間。
There 句型否定用 be 動詞，不用 doesn't。

mc.q: The pharmacy is ___ the hospital.
mc.why: near 是在附近：藥局在醫院附近。
wn: on 是在上面，藥局不會在醫院上面。
under 是在下面，藥局不會在醫院底下。

mc.q: ___ there any hotels near the station?
mc.why: any hotels 是複數，問有沒有用 Are there…?
wn: hotels 有 s 是複數，不用 Is。
there 句型用 be 動詞問，不用 Do。

mc.q: There ___ a bank near my house.
mc.why: a bank 是一間銀行，單數，用 There is。
wn: are 配複數，a bank 只有一間。
be 是原形，要用 is 或 are。

mc.q: There ___ two supermarkets in this town.
mc.why: two supermarkets 是兩間超市，複數，用 There are。
wn: is 配單數，這裡有 two 兩間。
說某地有某物用 There are，不用 has。

mc.q: ___ there a hospital near the station?
mc.why: a hospital 是一間醫院，單數，問句用 Is there…?
wn: Are 配複數，a hospital 只有一間。
There 問句用 be 動詞開頭，不用 Do。

mc.q: ___ there any parks in your city?
mc.why: any parks 是好幾個公園（複數），問句用 Are there…?
wn: Is 配單數，parks 有 s 是複數。
There 問句用 be 動詞開頭，不用 Does。

mc.q: The school is ___ the park and the bank.
mc.why: 句中有 the park and the bank 兩個地點，在中間用 between A and B。
wn: under 是在下面，學校不會在公園和銀行底下。
on 是在上面，學校不會在它們上面。

mc.q: There ___ not a restaurant on this street.
mc.why: a restaurant 是一間餐廳（單數），否定用 There is not。
wn: are 配複數，a restaurant 只有一間。
there 句型的否定用 be 動詞，不用 do。

mc.q: There ___ not any banks near the school.
mc.why: any banks 是複數，用 There are not any，也就是 There aren't any。
wn: is 配單數，banks 是複數。
there 句型的否定用 are not，不用 do not。

mc.q: The supermarket is ___ to the station.
mc.why: 空格後面有 to，固定說法 next to 是在旁邊。
wn: near 後面直接接地點，不加 to。
front 要說 in front of，不能接 to。

mc.q: There is a small park ___ front of the hospital.
mc.why: 在…前面的固定說法是 in front of：公園在醫院前面。
wn: 沒有 on front of 這種說法。
沒有 at front of 這種說法。

mc.q: There ___ three restaurants on this street.
mc.why: three restaurants 是三間（複數），用 There are。
wn: is 配一個東西，three restaurants 是複數。
說某處有某物用 There are，不說 There has。

mc.q: My school is ___ the park.
mc.why: near 是在附近：我的學校在公園附近。
wn: of 是…的，不能單獨表示位置。
between 要兩個地點，這裡只有公園。

mc.q: Is there a bank here? — Yes, there ___.
mc.why: 問句 Is there a bank 用 is，簡答也用 is：Yes, there is。
wn: 問的是一間 a bank，回答用 is，不用 are。
Is there 問句用 be 動詞回答，不用 do。

mc.q: Are there any hospitals in this town? — No, there ___.
mc.why: 問句 Are there any hospitals 是複數，否定回答用 No, there aren't.
wn: isn't 配單數，hospitals 是複數。
there 句型用 be 動詞回答，不用 don't。

mc.q: There is a bus stop ___ front of the supermarket.
mc.why: 在…前面是固定說法 in front of，front 前面一定用 in。
wn: 沒有 on front of 這種說法。
沒有 at front of 這種說法。

mc.q: How many schools ___ there in your city?
mc.why: How many schools 問數量，schools 是複數，後面接 are there。
wn: schools 是複數，不能用 is。
There 問句用 be 動詞，不用 do。

mc.q: There is ___ old hospital near the river.
mc.why: old 開頭是母音的音，前面用 an：an old hospital。
wn: a 用在子音開頭的字前；old 是母音開頭，要用 an。
some 配複數或不可數，hospital 是一間（單數）。

mc.q: There is ___ new supermarket next to my house.
mc.why: new 是子音 n 開頭，一個東西前面用 a：a new supermarket。
wn: an 只用在母音開頭的字前，new 是子音開頭。
any 用在否定句和問句；肯定句說一個東西用 a。

mc.q: There aren't ___ restaurants near the station.
mc.why: 否定句 There aren't 後面，複數名詞前用 any。
wn: some 用在肯定句；否定句要改成 any。
a 只配一個東西，restaurants 是複數。

mc.q: There are ___ trees in the park.
mc.why: 肯定句，trees 是可以數的複數名詞，用 some（一些）。
wn: a 只配一個東西，trees 是複數。
much 配不可數名詞（例如 water），trees 可以數。

mc.q: The bank is ___ the supermarket.
mc.why: 銀行在超市的後面，用 behind the supermarket。
wn: of 是…的，不能單獨表示位置。
at 只說在某個地點，說不出前後的位置。

mc.q: There ___ a station and a park in this town.
mc.why: There 後面第一個名詞 a station 是單數，這題跟著它用 is。
wn: be 是原形，句子裡要用 is。
說某處有東西用 There is，不說 There have。

mc.q: There are many people ___ the park.
mc.why: 在公園裡面用 in：in the park。
wn: of 是…的，不能表示在某地。
to 是往某處去，要有移動；這裡只是說人在那裡。

mc.q: There is a big sign ___ the bank door.
mc.why: 招牌貼在門的表面上，用 on the bank door。
wn: in 是在裡面，招牌不會在門裡面。
under 是在下面，招牌是在門上。

mc.q: There ___ no banks in this small village.
mc.why: no banks 的 banks 有 s，是複數，用 There are no banks（一間都沒有）。
wn: banks 是複數，is 只配單數。
be 要變成 are 才能放進句子。

mc.q: Is there a park near your school? — No, there ___.
mc.why: 問句 Is there a park 是單數，否定回答用 No, there isn't.
wn: aren't 配複數，a park 是單數。
there 句型用 be 動詞回答，不用 doesn't。

mc.q: Are there two stations here? — Yes, there ___.
mc.why: 問句 Are there two stations 用 are，簡答也用 are：Yes, there are。
wn: 問的是複數 two stations，回答要用 are。
Are there 問句用 be 動詞回答，不用 do。

mc.q: There is a restaurant ___ the second floor.
mc.why: 說在第幾樓用 on：on the second floor（在二樓）。
wn: 樓層不用 in，要說 on the second floor。
under 是在下面，不是說在哪一層樓。

mc.q: The hospital is ___ the school and the station.
mc.zh: 醫院在學校和車站中間。
mc.why: 線索是 the school and the station 兩個地方，夾在中間用 between。
wn: next 單獨不能表示旁邊，要說 next to。
behind 是在後面；夾在 A and B 中間用 between。

mc.q: There ___ four shops next to the supermarket.
mc.why: four shops 是四家店，複數，用 There are。
wn: is 配單數，這裡有 four 四家。
說某處有東西用 There are，不用 has。

wn: 沒有 on front of 的說法，要說 in front of。
沒有 at front of 的說法，要說 in front of。

wn: Are 配複數，a supermarket 只有一間。

說某處有人用 There are，不用 has。

between 要兩個地點，這裡只有醫院。

wn: under 是在下面，銀行不會在餐廳底下。

there 句型的否定用 be 動詞，不用 do。

reading.title: 短文 1
reading.text: There are many places near my house. There is a big supermarket next to the school. There is a small park between the school and the hospital. There is a bank near the station, and there is a post office next to the bank. There is a nice restaurant in front of the park. There isn't a museum in my town, but there is a library near the church. I often go to the park and the library.

qs.q: What is next to the school?
qs.why: 原文：There is a big supermarket next to the school. 學校旁邊是一間大超市。
wn: 醫院和學校中間隔著公園，兩者不是緊鄰。
教堂旁邊的是圖書館，和學校無關。

qs.q: Where is the park?
opts: Between the school and the hospital
qs.why: 原文：There is a small park between the school and the hospital. 公園在學校和醫院中間。
wn: 銀行旁邊的是郵局（post office next to the bank）。
公園前面有餐廳；圖書館在教堂附近，和公園無關。

qs.q: Is there a museum in the town?
qs.why: 原文：There isn't a museum in my town. 鎮上沒有博物館，回答 No, there isn't。
wn: 原文說 There isn't a museum，沒有博物館。
原文說沒有博物館；而且問 Is there 要用 is 回答。

qs.q: Where is the restaurant?
qs.why: 原文：There is a nice restaurant in front of the park. 餐廳在公園前面。
wn: 銀行旁邊的是郵局，不是餐廳。
文中沒有這個說法，車站附近的是銀行。

qs.q: Where is the library?
qs.why: 原文：there is a library near the church. 圖書館在教堂附近。
wn: 超市旁邊是學校，不是圖書館。
文中沒說學校前面有圖書館，圖書館在教堂附近。

reading.title: 短文 2
reading.text: I live in a small town near the sea. There is one main street in my town. On this street there is a bank, a post office and two restaurants. The supermarket is next to the bank. There is a school behind the supermarket, and there is a small park in front of the school. There isn't a hospital in my town, so people go to the city. There is a bus stop near the park. Every morning many people wait there. My town is quiet, but there are enough shops for everybody.

qs.q: How many restaurants are there on the main street?
qs.why: 原文：there is a bank, a post office and two restaurants. 大街上有兩間餐廳。
wn: one 是大街的數量（one main street），餐廳是 two。
原文是 two restaurants 兩間，不是三間。

qs.q: Where is the supermarket?
qs.why: 原文：The supermarket is next to the bank. 超市在銀行旁邊。
wn: 方向反了：是學校在超市後面（school behind the supermarket）。
公園在學校前面，不是超市的位置。

qs.q: Is there a hospital in the town?
qs.why: 原文：There isn't a hospital in my town. 鎮上沒有醫院，要去城市看病。
wn: 原文說 There isn't a hospital，沒有醫院。
原文說 There isn't a hospital，一間都沒有。

qs.q: What is in front of the school?
qs.why: 原文：there is a small park in front of the school. 學校前面有一座小公園。
wn: 公車站在公園附近（near the park），不是學校前面。
郵局在大街上，文中沒說在學校前面。

qs.q: Where is the bus stop?
qs.why: 原文：There is a bus stop near the park. 公車站在公園附近。
wn: 文中沒說銀行後面有公車站，原文是 near the park。
公車站不會在超市裡，原文是 near the park。

reading.title: 短文 3
reading.text: My name is Jun. My school is in the middle of the city. There is a big park next to my school. In the park there are many trees and a small lake. After class my friends and I often sit there. There is a supermarket in front of the school gate, and there is a station five minutes from here. There are three restaurants near the station. There isn't a bank on this street, but there is one behind the hospital. The hospital is between the station and my school. I like this part of the city very much.

qs.q: Where is Jun's school?
opts: In the middle of the city
qs.why: 原文：My school is in the middle of the city. 學校在市中心。
wn: 文中沒有提到海，學校在市中心。
文中沒說學校在車站後面，車站離學校五分鐘。

qs.q: What is in the park?
opts: Many trees and a small lake
qs.why: 原文：In the park there are many trees and a small lake. 公園裡有很多樹和一個小湖。
wn: 三間餐廳在車站附近（near the station），不在公園裡。
超市在學校大門前面，不在公園裡。

qs.q: How many restaurants are there near the station?
qs.why: 原文：There are three restaurants near the station. 車站附近有三間餐廳。
wn: 原文是 three restaurants 三間，不是兩間。
five 是車站離學校的分鐘數（five minutes），不是餐廳數量。

qs.q: Is there a bank on this street?
qs.why: 原文：There isn't a bank on this street. 這條街沒有銀行，銀行在醫院後面。
wn: 原文說 There isn't a bank on this street，這條街沒有。
原文說這條街沒有銀行，只有醫院後面有一間。

qs.q: Where is the hospital?
opts: Between the station and the school
qs.why: 原文：The hospital is between the station and my school. 醫院在車站和學校中間。
wn: 公園裡是樹和小湖，沒有醫院。
文中沒說醫院在超市旁，它在車站和學校中間。

reading.title: 短文 4
reading.text: Today my mother and I are in the city centre. There are a lot of people here. There is a big supermarket on the corner, and there is a market behind it. In the market there are many fruit shops. Next to the market there is a small library. There aren't any parks in the city centre, but there is a park near the river. We have lunch in a restaurant in front of the station. After lunch we go to the bank, because my mother needs money. The bank is between the library and the post office.

qs.q: Where is the market?
qs.why: 原文：there is a market behind it. it 指前一句的超市，市場在超市後面。
wn: 車站前面的是餐廳，她們在那裡吃午餐。
河邊的是公園（a park near the river）。

qs.q: What is next to the market?
qs.why: 原文：Next to the market there is a small library. 市場旁邊有一間小圖書館。
wn: 銀行在圖書館和郵局中間，不是緊鄰市場；big 的是超市。
公園在河邊，原文說市中心沒有公園。

qs.q: Are there any parks in the city centre?
opts: Yes, there is a big one.
qs.why: 原文：There aren't any parks in the city centre. 市中心沒有公園。
wn: 原文說 There aren't any parks，市中心一座都沒有。
市中心沒有公園，唯一的公園在河邊（near the river）。

qs.q: Where do they have lunch?
opts: In a restaurant in front of the station
qs.why: 原文：We have lunch in a restaurant in front of the station. 她們在車站前的餐廳吃午餐。
wn: 市場裡是水果店，文中沒說在那裡吃午餐。
圖書館在市場旁邊，不是吃午餐的地方。

qs.q: Where is the bank?
opts: Between the library and the post office
qs.why: 原文：The bank is between the library and the post office. 銀行在圖書館和郵局中間。
wn: 市場在超市後面，銀行不在市場後面。
河邊的是公園，不是銀行。

a: There is a traffic light on the corner.
There is a traffic light at the corner.
translate.why: 一個紅綠燈 There is a traffic light；在轉角 on the corner。

a: There are two banks on this street.
translate.why: 兩家銀行是複數，用 There are two banks；在街上用 on this street，不用 in。

a: Is there a post office near here?
Is there a post office around here?
translate.why: 問有沒有一間，用 Is there a post office…？；這附近 near here 或 around here。

a: Are there any taxis in front of the station?
translate.why: 問有沒有計程車（不確定幾台）：Are there any taxis…？；在車站前面 in front of the station。

a: There aren't any traffic lights on this street.

translate.why: 一個也沒有：There aren't any 或 There are no + 複數 traffic lights；在街上用 on。

a: The bus stop is in front of the hotel.
translate.why: 主詞 The bus stop 用 is；在前面 in front of the hotel，of 不能漏。

a: The police station is between the bank and the hotel.

a: There is a crosswalk near the station.

error.s: The bus stop is in front the school.
error.correct: The bus stop is in front of the school.
error.why: in front 後面要加 of

error.s: There is a police station between the bank.
error.correct: There is a police station between the bank and the hotel.
error.why: between 要接兩個地方

error.s: Are there a crosswalk near the station?
error.why: 單數疑問句用 Is there
error.full: Is there a crosswalk near the station?

error.s: There is many taxis at the station.
error.why: many 後面是複數，要用 There are
error.full: There are many taxis at the station.

error.s: There are a street sign on the corner.
error.why: a + 單數名詞要用 There is
error.full: There is a street sign on the corner.

error.s: Is there a bank near here? Yes, there are.
error.why: 簡答要跟著問句的 be 動詞
error.full: Is there a bank near here? Yes, there is.

error.s: There is a coffee shop in the corner.
error.why: 街角用 on the corner
error.full: There is a coffee shop on the corner.

error.s: It has a bus stop near my school.

reorder.a: The bank is next to the supermarket.
reorder.why: 主詞 The bank 用 is；在旁邊 next to the supermarket。

reorder.a: There is a traffic light on the corner.
reorder.why: 一個紅綠燈 There is a traffic light；在轉角 on the corner。

reorder.a: There are two banks on this street.
reorder.why: 兩家銀行是複數，用 There are two banks；在街上用 on this street，不用 in。

reorder.a: Is there a post office near here?
reorder.why: 問有沒有一間，用 Is there a post office…？；這附近 near here 或 around here。

reorder.a: Are there any taxis in front of the station?
reorder.why: 問有沒有計程車（不確定幾台）：Are there any taxis…？；在車站前面 in front of the station。

reorder.a: There isn't a bus stop near here.
reorder.why: 沒有一個公車站：There isn't a bus stop 或 There is no bus stop；這附近 near here。

reorder.a: There aren't any traffic lights on this street.
reorder.why: 一個也沒有：There aren't any 或 There are no + 複數 traffic lights；在街上用 on。

reorder.a: The bus stop is in front of the hotel.
reorder.why: 主詞 The bus stop 用 is；在前面 in front of the hotel，of 不能漏。

reorder.a: The post office is behind the park.
reorder.why: 主詞 The post office 用 is；在後面 behind the park。郵局是 post office。

reorder.a: The police station is between the bank and the hotel.
reorder.why: 主詞 The police station 用 is；在 A 和 B 之間 between the bank and the hotel。

reorder.a: There is a map on the wall.
reorder.why: 一張地圖用 There is a map；掛在牆上用 on the wall。

reorder.a: Turn right at the traffic light.
reorder.why: 指路用命令句，動詞 Turn 放開頭；右轉 turn right；在紅綠燈那裡用 at the traffic light。

reorder.a: Go straight for two blocks.
reorder.why: 指路用命令句，動詞放開頭：Go straight；走兩個街區 for two blocks（for 可省略），block 加 s。

reorder.a: There is a crosswalk near the station.
reorder.why: 有一條斑馬線用 There is a；斑馬線是 crosswalk；車站附近 near the station。

reorder.a: The coffee shop is next to the bus stop.
reorder.why: 主詞 The coffee shop 用 is；在公車站旁邊 next to the bus stop。

reading.title: 短文 1
reading.text: Excuse me, is there a bank near here? Yes, there is. Go straight and turn left at the corner. There is a traffic light next to the bank. Cross the street at the crosswalk. The bank is opposite the school. There isn't a bridge on this street, but there is a small park after the intersection. There is a bus stop in front of the park. Thank you for your help!

qs.q: Is there a bank near here?
qs.why: 原文：Is there a bank near here? Yes, there is. 對方直接回答附近有銀行。
wn: 原文回答 Yes, there is，附近有銀行。
問 Is there a bank 是一間，回答要用 is，不用 are。

qs.q: Where do you turn left?
qs.why: 原文：Go straight and turn left at the corner. 直走，在轉角左轉。
wn: 原文說 There isn't a bridge，這條街沒有橋。
公園在十字路口之後，左轉是在轉角（at the corner）。

qs.q: Where is the bank?
qs.why: 原文：The bank is opposite the school. opposite 是在對面，銀行在學校對面。
wn: 原文說 There isn't a bridge，沒有橋。
原文是紅綠燈在銀行旁邊（next to the bank），不是下面。

qs.q: Is there a bridge on this street?
qs.why: 原文：There isn't a bridge on this street. 這條街沒有橋。
wn: 原文說 There isn't a bridge，沒有橋。
原文說沒有橋；而且問 Is there 要用 is 回答。

qs.q: What is in front of the park?
qs.why: 原文：There is a bus stop in front of the park. 公園前面有公車站。
wn: 銀行在學校對面，不在公園前面。
斑馬線是過馬路的地方，文中沒說在公園前面。

reading.title: 短文 2
reading.text: Excuse me. Is there a bank near here? Yes, there is. Go straight for two blocks. Then turn right at the traffic light. The bank is on the left. It is next to a small hotel. There is a bus stop in front of the bank. There are many taxis there, too. The post office is behind the bank. It is not far. You can walk. It takes about ten minutes. Is there a map at the station? Yes, there is one on the wall.

qs.q: Where is the bank?
qs.why: 原文：It is next to a small hotel. It 指銀行，銀行在一間小旅館旁邊。
wn: 文中沒有提到公園，原文是 next to a small hotel。
文中沒有提到橋，原文是 next to a small hotel。

qs.q: What is in front of the bank?
qs.why: 原文：There is a bus stop in front of the bank. 銀行前面有公車站。
wn: 文中沒有提到學校，銀行前面是公車站。
文中沒有提到市場，銀行前面是公車站。

qs.q: Where is the post office?
qs.why: 原文：The post office is behind the bank. 郵局在銀行後面。
wn: 銀行前面的是公車站，郵局在後面（behind）。
文中沒有提到學校，郵局在銀行後面。

qs.q: How long is the walk?
qs.why: 原文：You can walk. It takes about ten minutes. 走路大約十分鐘。
wn: 原文說 It is not far，只要 about ten minutes。
原文說 about ten minutes；two 是走兩個街區（two blocks）。

qs.q: Where is the map?
qs.why: 原文：Yes, there is one on the wall. one 指地圖，地圖在牆上。
wn: 文中沒有提到椅子，地圖在牆上。
文中沒有提到包包，地圖在牆上。

reading.title: 短文 3
reading.text: Anna is new in the city. She wants to buy stamps. She asks a man on the street. Is there a post office near here? The man says yes. Cross the street at the crosswalk. Then go straight. There is a big park on the right. The post office is behind the park. There are two street signs on the corner. They are easy to see. There isn't a bus stop near the post office, so Anna walks. She is happy because the walk is short and the day is warm.

qs.q: What does Anna want to buy?
qs.why: 原文：She wants to buy stamps. 她想買郵票，所以要找郵局。
wn: 文中沒有提到麵包，她要買的是 stamps 郵票。
文中沒有提到鞋子，她要買的是 stamps 郵票。

qs.q: Where is the post office?
qs.why: 原文：The post office is behind the park. 郵局在公園後面。
wn: in front of 是前面，原文是 behind 後面。
under 是在下面，郵局不會在公園底下；原文是 behind。

qs.q: How many street signs are on the corner?
qs.why: 原文：There are two street signs on the corner. 轉角有兩個路標。
wn: 原文是 two street signs 兩個，不是一個。
原文是 two street signs 兩個，不是五個。

qs.q: Is there a bus stop near the post office?
qs.why: 原文：There isn't a bus stop near the post office. 郵局附近沒有公車站。
wn: 原文說 There isn't a bus stop，沒有公車站。
原文說 There isn't a bus stop，一個都沒有。

qs.q: How does Anna go there?
qs.why: 原文：There isn't a bus stop near the post office, so Anna walks. 所以她走路去。
wn: 文中沒有說她開車，原文是 Anna walks。
文中沒有說她搭計程車，原文是 Anna walks。

reading.title: 短文 4
reading.text: My office is easy to find. Come out of the train station. There are four taxis in front of the station. Don't take a taxi. Just turn left and go straight. There is a traffic light on the corner. Cross the street there. My office is next to a coffee shop. There is a police station between the bank and the hotel. My building is behind it. There aren't any big signs, so please call me. I can wait for you at the door of the coffee shop.

qs.q: What is in front of the station?
qs.why: 原文：There are four taxis in front of the station. 車站前面有四台計程車。
wn: 文中沒有提到公車，車站前面是計程車。
文中沒有提到市場，車站前面是計程車。

qs.q: Where do you turn?
qs.why: 原文：Just turn left and go straight. 出車站後左轉再直走。
wn: 原文是 turn left 左轉，不是右轉。
原文說 turn left and go straight，沒有叫人往回走。

qs.q: What is on the corner?
qs.why: 原文：There is a traffic light on the corner. 轉角有紅綠燈。
wn: 文中沒有提到公園，轉角是紅綠燈。
文中沒有提到學校，轉角是紅綠燈。

qs.q: The office is next to what?
qs.why: 原文：My office is next to a coffee shop. 辦公室在咖啡店旁邊。
wn: 文中沒有提到圖書館，辦公室在咖啡店旁。
旅館旁邊是警察局（between the bank and the hotel），不是辦公室。

qs.q: Are there any big signs?
qs.why: 原文：There aren't any big signs, so please call me. 沒有大招牌，所以請打電話給他。
wn: 原文說 There aren't any big signs，一個都沒有。
原文說 aren't any，連一個大招牌都沒有。

mc.q: The cat is ___ the box.
mc.zh: 貓在盒子裡。
mc.why: 貓在盒子裡面，用 in the box。

under 是在盒子底下，意思不同。

mc.q: The book is ___ the table.
mc.why: 書放在桌面上，用 on the table。
wn: in 是在裡面，書不會在桌子裡面。
between 要接兩樣東西，這裡只有桌子。

mc.q: The ball is ___ the chair.
mc.zh: 球在椅子底下。
mc.why: 球在椅子底下，用 under the chair。
wn: above 是在上方懸空，球一般不會在椅子上空。
near 是在附近；中文說的是在椅子底下。

mc.q: The lamp is ___ the bed.
mc.zh: 檯燈在床旁邊。
mc.why: 檯燈就在床的旁邊，next to 是緊鄰在旁邊。
wn: between 要接兩樣東西，這裡只有 the bed。
far from 是離很遠；中文說的是在床旁邊。

mc.q: The park is ___ the school and the bank.
mc.zh: 公園在學校和銀行中間。
mc.why: 句中有 the school and the bank 兩個地點，在兩者中間用 between A and B。
wn: near 只是在附近；中文說的是在兩者中間。
on 是在上面，公園不會在學校上面。

mc.q: There is a garden ___ the house.
mc.why: 花園在房子的後面，用 behind the house。
wn: above 是在上方，花園不會在房子上空。
through 是穿過，用在動作，不表示位置。

mc.q: There are trees ___ the house.
mc.why: around 是在…周圍。樹圍繞在房子四周，用 around the house。
wn: under 是在下面，樹不會長在房子底下。
at the house 只說在房子那裡，表達不出圍繞四周。

mc.q: The station is ___ my house.
mc.why: far from 是離…很遠：車站離我家很遠。
wn: in 是在裡面，車站不會在我家裡。
on 是在上面，車站不會在我家上面。

mc.q: There ___ a cat under the table.
mc.why: a cat 是一隻貓，單數，用 There is。
wn: are 配複數，a cat 只有一隻。
be 是原形，要用 is 或 are。

mc.q: There ___ two bags next to the chair.
mc.why: two bags 是兩個包包，複數，用 There are。
wn: is 配單數，這裡有 two 兩個。
am 只配 I，There 句型不用。

reading.title: 短文 1
reading.text: My town is small and nice. There is a park near my house. There is a bank across from the park, and there is a school next to the bank. There is a small garden behind my house, and there are trees around the garden. There is a bridge over the river, and there is a station far from my house. There isn't a hospital in my town, but there is a small clinic beside the school. I like my quiet town.

qs.q: Where is the bank?
qs.why: 原文：There is a bank across from the park. across from 是在對面，銀行在公園對面。
wn: 房子後面是小花園，不是銀行。
文中只說橋在河上，沒說銀行在橋下。

qs.q: What is next to the bank?
qs.why: 原文：there is a school next to the bank. 銀行旁邊是學校。
wn: 車站離作者家很遠（far from my house），不在銀行旁。
河上面有橋，文中沒說河在銀行旁邊。

qs.q: What is behind the house?
qs.why: 原文：There is a small garden behind my house. 房子後面有小花園。
wn: 銀行在公園對面，不在房子後面。
橋在河上（over the river），不在房子後面。

qs.q: Is there a hospital in the town?
qs.why: 原文：There isn't a hospital in my town. 沒有醫院，只有小診所 clinic。
wn: 原文說 There isn't a hospital；有的是 clinic 診所，不是醫院。
原文說沒有醫院；而且問 Is there 要用 is 回答。

qs.q: Where is the station?
qs.why: 原文：there is a station far from my house. far from 是離…很遠，車站離家很遠。
wn: 公園在作者家附近，車站離家很遠，不在公園旁。
文中沒說車站在橋下，原文是 far from my house。

reading.title: 短文 2
reading.text: This is my small room. There is a bed next to the window. There is a desk in front of the bed. On the desk there are three books and a lamp. There is a cat under the desk. Her name is Mimi. She sleeps all day. There are four pictures on the wall. My bag is next to the chair. My keys are in the drawer. There isn't a TV in my room, but there is a clock near the window. I like my room. It is small and quiet.

qs.q: Where is the bed?
qs.why: 原文：There is a bed next to the window. 床在窗戶旁邊。
wn: 書桌下面的是貓 Mimi，不是床。
文中沒有提到門，床在窗戶旁。

qs.q: What is on the desk?
qs.why: 原文：On the desk there are three books and a lamp. 書桌上有三本書和一盞檯燈。
wn: 貓在書桌下面（under the desk），文中也沒有球。
文中只有一個包包，在椅子旁邊。

qs.q: Where is the cat?
qs.why: 原文：There is a cat under the desk. 貓在書桌下面。
wn: 文中沒說貓在床上，原文是 under the desk。
抽屜裡的是鑰匙（keys are in the drawer）。

qs.q: How many pictures are on the wall?
qs.why: 原文：There are four pictures on the wall. 牆上有四幅畫。
wn: 原文是 four pictures 四幅，不是兩幅。
three 是書的數量（three books），畫是 four。

qs.q: Is there a TV in the room?
qs.why: 原文：There isn't a TV in my room. 房間沒有電視，回答 No, there isn't。
wn: 原文說 There isn't a TV，沒有電視；窗邊的是時鐘。
原文說 There isn't a TV，一台都沒有。

reading.title: 短文 3
reading.text: Tom cannot find his phone. He looks on the desk, but there isn't a phone there. There are only books and a cup. He looks under the bed. There is a ball under the bed, but there isn't a phone. He looks behind the door. There is a bag behind the door. His keys are in the bag, but the phone isn't there. Then his mother calls him. Look in the box next to the chair, she says. Tom opens the box. Yes! There is his phone. He is very happy.

qs.q: What is on the desk?
qs.why: 原文：There are only books and a cup. 書桌上只有書和杯子。
wn: 原文說 there isn't a phone there，書桌上沒有手機。
球在床底下（a ball under the bed），不在書桌上。

qs.q: What is under the bed?
qs.why: 原文：There is a ball under the bed, but there isn't a phone. 床底下有一顆球，沒有手機。
wn: 原文說床底下 there isn't a phone。
包包在門後面（behind the door），不在床底下。

qs.q: Where is the bag?
qs.why: 原文：There is a bag behind the door. 包包在門後面。
wn: 文中沒說包包在牆上，原文是 behind the door。
文中沒有提到抽屜，包包在門後面。

qs.q: What is in the bag?
qs.why: 原文：His keys are in the bag, but the phone isn't there. 包包裡是鑰匙，不是手機。
wn: 原文說 the phone isn't there，手機不在包包裡。
書在書桌上，不在包包裡。

qs.q: Where is the phone?
opts: In the box next to the chair
qs.why: 原文：Look in the box next to the chair... There is his phone. 手機在椅子旁的盒子裡。
wn: 文中沒有提到桌子下面，手機在盒子裡。
文中沒有提到窗戶，手機在椅子旁的盒子裡。

reading.title: 短文 4
reading.text: Our classroom is big. There are twenty desks in the room. The teacher's desk is in front of the board. There is a clock near the window. There are two maps on the wall. My seat is between Lisa and Ken. My bag is under my chair. There isn't a computer in our classroom, but there is a small library behind the door. There are many books there. After class, there are three cars in front of the school. They wait for the students.

qs.q: How many desks are in the room?
qs.why: 原文：There are twenty desks in the room. 教室裡有二十張桌子。
wn: 原文是 twenty 二十，不是 ten 十。
原文是 twenty 二十，不是 thirty 三十。

qs.q: Where is the teacher's desk?
qs.why: 原文：The teacher's desk is in front of the board. 老師的桌子在黑板前面。
wn: 門後面的是小圖書區（small library behind the door）。
窗戶附近的是時鐘（clock near the window）。

qs.q: Where does the writer sit?
qs.why: 原文：My seat is between Lisa and Ken. 作者坐在 Lisa 和 Ken 中間。
wn: 文中沒說作者坐老師旁邊，原文是 between Lisa and Ken。
between 是在兩人中間，不是在 Ken 後面。

qs.q: What is behind the door?
qs.why: 原文：there is a small library behind the door. 門後面有一個小圖書區。
wn: 原文說 There isn't a computer，教室沒有電腦。
時鐘在窗戶附近（near the window），不在門後。

qs.q: What is in front of the school after class?
qs.why: 原文：After class, there are three cars in front of the school. 放學後學校前面有三台車。
wn: 文中沒有提到公車，是 three cars。
文中沒有提到腳踏車，是 three cars。

mc.q: ___ a park near my house.
mc.zh: 我家附近有一座公園。
mc.why: a park 是一個公園，單數，說有一個公園用 There is。
wn: There are 配複數，a park 只有一個。
There isn't 是「沒有」；中文說家附近有一座公園。

mc.q: ___ five rooms in my house.
mc.why: five rooms 是五個房間（複數），句尾是句號，用肯定句 There are。
wn: There is 配單數，five rooms 是複數。
句尾是句號，這是直述句，不是問句。

mc.q: There ___ a supermarket near my apartment.
mc.why: a supermarket 是一間超市，單數，用 There is。
wn: are 配複數，a supermarket 只有一間。
am 只配 I，There 句型不用 am。

mc.q: ___ there a bank near your house?
mc.why: a bank 是一間銀行，單數，問句用 Is there…?
wn: Are 配複數，a bank 只有一間。
There 問句用 be 動詞開頭，不用 Do。

mc.q: The table is ___ the sofa and the window.
mc.why: 句中有 the sofa and the window 兩樣東西，在中間用 between A and B。
wn: on 是在上面，桌子不會在沙發和窗戶上面。
under 是在下面，桌子不會在它們底下。

mc.q: My neighborhood is ___ and safe.
mc.why: 空格在 is 後面，又和 safe 用 and 連起來，要填形容詞；quiet 是安靜的。
wn: between 是在兩者之間，是介系詞，不能形容社區。
under 是在下面，是介系詞，不能形容社區。

mc.q: The school is ___ the park.
mc.why: in front of 是在…前面：學校在公園前面。
wn: under 是在下面，學校不會在公園底下。
between 要兩個地點，這裡只有公園。

mc.q: There ___ much furniture in my room.
mc.why: furniture 家具不可數，當單數看；否定用 There isn't much…。
wn: furniture 不可數，不能用複數的 aren't。
There 句型否定用 be 動詞，不用 doesn't。

mc.q: There is a nice view ___ my window.
mc.why: 從窗戶看出去的風景，用 from：a view from my window。
wn: in my window 是在窗戶裡面，不是從窗戶看出去。
on 是在表面上，風景不在窗戶上面。

mc.q: ___ there any restaurants near the station?
mc.why: any restaurants 是複數，問有沒有用 Are there…?
wn: restaurants 有 s 是複數，不用 Is。
there 句型用 be 動詞問，不用 Do。

mc.q: There ___ two markets next to my school.
mc.why: two markets 是兩個市場（複數），用 There are。
wn: is 配一個東西，two markets 是複數。
am 只配 I，不用在 there 句型。

mc.q: ___ there a window in the kitchen?
mc.why: a window 是一扇窗（單數），問有沒有用 Is there…?
wn: Are there 配複數，a window 是單數。
there 句型用 be 動詞問，不用 Do。

mc.q: ___ there any bikes behind the door?

There 問句用 be 動詞，不用 Does。

mc.q: There ___ a sofa in my bedroom.

there 句型的否定用 isn't，不用 don't。

mc.q: There ___ any schools between the park and the library.

there 句型的否定用 be 動詞，不用 doesn't。

mc.q: The tree is ___ my house.
mc.why: 樹在房子的前面，用 in front of my house。
wn: in 是在裡面，樹不會長在房子裡。
on 是在表面上，樹不會在房子上面。

mc.q: Is there a park near my house? Yes, ___.
mc.why: 問句是 Is there a park…?，簡答照樣用 there is：Yes, there is。
wn: 問的是一個 a park，回答用 is，不用 are。
Is there 問有沒有，回答用 there is，不用 it is。

mc.q: There ___ a bed in my bedroom.

wn: are 配複數，a bed 只有一張。

mc.q: ___ there a garden behind the house?

wn: Are there 配複數，a garden 是單數。
there 句型用 be 動詞問，不用 Do。

mc.q: ___ there any markets next to my school?

wn: markets 有 s 是複數，不用 Is。
there 句型用 be 動詞問，不用 Does。

mc.q: There ___ a window in the bathroom.

wn: aren't 配複數，a window 是單數。
there 句型的否定用 isn't，不用 don't。

mc.q: There ___ any bikes behind the door.

There 句型否定用 be 動詞，不用 doesn't。

mc.q: The sofa is ___ the living room.
mc.why: 在房間裡面用 in：in the living room。
wn: under 是在下面，沙發不會在客廳底下。
between 要兩個東西：between A and B，這裡只有客廳。

mc.q: Is there a school between the park and the library? Yes, ___.
mc.why: 問句是 Is there a school…? 回答照樣用 there：Yes, there is.

Is there 問有沒有，回答用 there is，不用 it is。

mc.q: There ___ a tree in front of my house.

be 是原形，句子裡要變成 is 或 are。

mc.why: two parks 是兩個公園（複數），用 There are。

am 只配 I，不用在 there 句型。

mc.q: ___ there a bed in my bedroom?
mc.why: a bed 是一張床，單數，問句用 Is there…?
wn: Are 配複數，a bed 只有一張。
There 問句用 be 動詞開頭，不用 Do。

translate.zh: 房子後面有一個小花園。
a: There is a small garden behind the house.

a: There is a park near my house.
translate.why: 中文的有表示某處存在東西，要用 There is，不用 have；一個公園 a park；附近 near my house。

a: There is a sofa in the living room.
translate.why: 一張沙發 There is a sofa；在客廳裡 in the living room。

a: The market is next to my school.
translate.why: 主詞 The market 用 is；在旁邊 next to my school。

There are two beds in my room.

translate.zh: 學校在公園和圖書館之間。
a: The school is between the park and the library.
translate.why: 在 A 和 B 之間 = between A and B，中間用 and 連，不用 or；兩個地點前都加 the。

a: There are three windows in the kitchen.
translate.why: 三扇窗戶是複數，用 There are three windows；在廚房裡 in the kitchen。

a: There are four trees in front of my house.

translate.why: 兩台腳踏車是複數，用 There are two bikes；在門後面 behind the door。

a: There isn't a hospital near my house.
There is no hospital near my house.
translate.why: 沒有一家醫院：There isn't a hospital 或 There is no hospital；附近 near my house。

translate.zh: 我的社區裡沒有電影院。
a: There aren't any movie theaters in my neighborhood.
There isn't a movie theater in my neighborhood.
There are no movie theaters in my neighborhood.
There is no movie theater in my neighborhood.
translate.why: 沒有電影院：There aren't any movie theaters 或 There isn't a movie theater；社區裡用 in。

a: Is there a market near your house?
translate.why: 問有沒有一個，用 Is there a market…？；你家附近 near your house。

a: Are there any parks in your neighborhood?
Is there a park in your neighborhood?
translate.why: 問有沒有：Is there a park…？或 Are there any parks…？；在社區裡 in your neighborhood。

translate.zh: 有，我家後面有一個小花園。
a: Yes, there is a small garden behind my house.
translate.why: 有一個用 there is；小花園 a small garden，形容詞放名詞前；在我家後面 behind my house 放句尾。
社區 neighborhood 是一個，用 is；中文的很不一定要翻 very，直接 is quiet 就好。

a: There is a TV in the living room.
translate.why: 一台電視 There is a TV；在客廳裡 in the living room。

translate.zh: 我家和學校之間有一家商店。

translate.why: 一家商店 There is a shop；在 A 和 B 之間 between my house and the school。

a: The kitchen is behind the living room.
translate.why: 說東西在哪裡：主詞 + is + 位置。在後面 = behind：The kitchen is behind the living room。

translate.zh: 我喜歡我的社區，因為它很安靜。
a: I like my neighborhood because it is quiet.
translate.why: 因為 = because，連接兩句；後半句要有主詞和動詞：it is quiet，it 指社區。

reading.title: 短文 1
reading.text: I live in a small apartment in a quiet neighborhood. There are three rooms: a bedroom, a kitchen, and a living room. There is a comfortable sofa and a table in the living room. There is a nice view from my window. Near my apartment, there is a supermarket and a small park. There is a bank between the park and the school. There isn't a restaurant near my house, but there is a good one near the station. My neighborhood is quiet and convenient.

qs.q: How many rooms are there in the apartment?
qs.why: 原文：There are three rooms: a bedroom, a kitchen, and a living room. 共三個房間。
wn: 原文列了臥室、廚房、客廳三個，不是兩個。
原文說 three rooms，沒有第四個。

qs.q: What is in the living room?
qs.why: 原文：There is a comfortable sofa and a table in the living room. 客廳有沙發和桌子。
wn: 床一般在臥室，文中說客廳是沙發和桌子。
冰箱和爐子是廚房的東西，文中沒提；客廳是沙發和桌子。

qs.q: What is near the apartment?
qs.why: 原文：Near my apartment, there is a supermarket and a small park. 附近有超市和公園。
wn: 文中沒有提到醫院和博物館。

qs.q: Is there a restaurant near the house?
qs.why: 原文：There isn't a restaurant near my house. 家附近沒有餐廳，好餐廳在車站附近。
wn: 原文說家附近 There isn't a restaurant；好餐廳在車站附近。
原文說沒有；而且問 Is there 要用 is 回答。

qs.q: What is the neighborhood like?
qs.why: 原文：My neighborhood is quiet and convenient. 社區安靜又方便。
wn: 正好相反，原文說 quiet 安靜。
small 是說公寓，文中沒說社區又舊又小。

reading.title: 短文 2
reading.text: I live in a small house with my family. There are two bedrooms and one bathroom. There is a big sofa in the living room. The kitchen is behind the living room. There are three windows in the kitchen, so it is bright. There is a small garden behind the house. There are four trees in front of the house. My bike is behind the door. There isn't a garage, so I park my bike there. I like my house because it is quiet and warm.

qs.q: How many bedrooms are in the house?
qs.why: 原文：There are two bedrooms and one bathroom. 有兩間臥室。
wn: one 是浴室的數量（one bathroom），臥室是 two。
three 是廚房窗戶的數量，臥室是 two。

qs.q: Where is the kitchen?
qs.why: 原文：The kitchen is behind the living room. 廚房在客廳後面。
wn: 文中沒這樣說；花園在房子後面，廚房在客廳後面。
文中沒說廚房在浴室旁邊。

qs.q: Why is the kitchen bright?
qs.why: 原文：There are three windows in the kitchen, so it is bright. 因為有三扇窗。
wn: 文中沒有提到燈，明亮是因為三扇窗。
文中沒說門開著，明亮是因為三扇窗。

qs.q: Where is the bike?
qs.why: 原文：My bike is behind the door. 腳踏車在門後面。
wn: 文中沒說腳踏車在花園，原文是 behind the door。
腳踏車放不進沙發底下，原文是 behind the door。

qs.q: Is there a garage?
qs.why: 原文：There isn't a garage, so I park my bike there. 沒有車庫，所以腳踏車放門後。
wn: 原文說 There isn't a garage，沒有車庫。
原文說 There isn't a garage，一個都沒有。

reading.title: 短文 3
reading.text: My neighborhood is not big, but it is nice. There is a park near my house. There are two markets on my street. One market is next to my school. The school is between the park and the library. The library is in front of the station, so it is easy to find. There aren't any movie theaters in my neighborhood. There isn't a big hospital here, but there is a small clinic behind the post office. My neighborhood is quiet at night. I like it very much.

qs.q: How many markets are on the street?
qs.why: 原文：There are two markets on my street. 這條街上有兩個市場。
wn: 原文是 two markets；One market 只是在講其中一個。
原文是 two markets 兩個，不是四個。

qs.q: Where is the school?
opts: Between the park and the library
qs.why: 原文：The school is between the park and the library. 學校在公園和圖書館中間。
wn: 車站前面是圖書館，文中沒說學校在車站後面。

qs.q: Where is the library?
qs.why: 原文：The library is in front of the station. 圖書館在車站前面。
wn: 市場旁邊的是學校（One market is next to my school）。
文中沒說圖書館在公園後面，公園和圖書館中間隔著學校。

qs.q: Are there any movie theaters?
qs.why: 原文：There aren't any movie theaters in my neighborhood. 社區裡沒有電影院。
wn: 原文說 There aren't any，一間都沒有；two 是市場的數量。
原文說 aren't any，連一間都沒有。

qs.q: Where is the small clinic?
qs.why: 原文：there is a small clinic behind the post office. 小診所在郵局後面。
wn: 文中沒說診所在公園裡，原文是 behind the post office。
學校旁邊的是市場，不是診所。

reading.title: 短文 4
reading.text: Ken lives on the tenth floor. From his window he can see the whole street. There is a bus stop in front of his building. There are many bikes next to the bus stop. There is a coffee shop on the corner. In the morning there are many people there. There is a small park behind the building. There are five trees in the park. Children play there after school. There isn't a supermarket near here, so Ken goes to the market next to the station. He walks there every Sunday.

qs.q: Where does Ken live?
qs.why: 原文：Ken lives on the tenth floor. Ken 住在十樓。
wn: 原文是 tenth floor 十樓，不是 first floor 一樓。
原文說 There isn't a supermarket near here，附近沒有超市。

qs.q: What is in front of his building?
qs.why: 原文：There is a bus stop in front of his building. 大樓前面有公車站。
wn: 文中沒有提到花園，大樓後面是小公園。
文中沒有提到學校，大樓前面是公車站。

qs.q: What is on the corner?
qs.why: 原文：There is a coffee shop on the corner. 轉角有一間咖啡店。
wn: 市場在車站旁邊（next to the station），不在轉角。
文中沒有提到圖書館，轉角是咖啡店。

qs.q: How many trees are in the small park?
qs.why: 原文：There are five trees in the park. 公園裡有五棵樹。
wn: 原文是 five trees 五棵，不是三棵。
原文是 five trees 五棵，不是四棵。

qs.q: Where is the market?
qs.why: 原文：Ken goes to the market next to the station. 市場在車站旁邊。
wn: 文中沒說咖啡店後面有市場，原文是 next to the station。
文中沒說公園前面有市場，原文是 next to the station。

mc.q: ___ a table in the kitchen.
mc.why: 說某處有某物用 There is；a table 是一張，單數。
wn: There are 配複數，a table 只有一張。
It is 是說這是什麼；說某處有東西要用 There is。

mc.q: There ___ a garden behind the house.
mc.why: a garden 是一個花園（單數），用 There is。
wn: are 配複數，a garden 只有一個。
be 是原形，句子裡要變成 is 或 are。

mc.q: ___ there a park near your house?
mc.why: a park 是一個公園，單數，問句用 Is there…?
wn: Are 配複數，a park 只有一個。
There 問句用 Is／Are，不用 Do。

mc.q: ___ there two bathrooms in the flat?
mc.why: two bathrooms 是兩間浴室（複數），問有沒有用 Are there…?
wn: Is there 配單數，two bathrooms 是複數。
there 句型用 be 動詞問，不用 Do。

mc.q: There ___ two windows in the living room.
mc.why: two windows 是兩扇窗，複數，用 There are。
wn: is 配單數，這裡有 two 兩扇。
說某處有某物用 There are，不用 has。

mc.q: There ___ any chairs in the garden.
mc.why: any chairs 是複數，否定用 are not，縮寫成 aren't。
wn: isn't 配單數，chairs 是好幾張。
not 要放在 are 後面：are not 或 aren't。

mc.q: There are some boxes ___ the garage.
mc.why: 箱子放在車庫這個空間裡，用 in the garage。
wn: at 指一個地點，說東西放在空間裡面用 in。
of 是…的，不能表示位置。

mc.q: There is a cat ___ the sofa in the living room.
mc.why: 貓在沙發底下，用 under the sofa。
wn: of 是…的，不能表示位置。
between 要接兩樣東西，這裡只有 the sofa。

mc.q: There is ___ garage next to my house.
mc.why: garage 是子音 g 開頭的單數名詞，前面用 a。
wn: an 只用在母音開頭的字前，garage 是子音開頭。
some 配複數或不可數，garage 是一間（單數）。

mc.q: Is there a TV in the living room? — Yes, there ___.
mc.why: 問句 Is there a TV 是單數，肯定回答用 Yes, there is.
wn: are 配複數，a TV 只有一台。
there 句型用 be 動詞回答，不用 do。

mc.q: There is a big window ___ my bedroom.
mc.why: 窗戶在房間裡（是房間的一部分），用 in my bedroom。
wn: on 是在表面上，說房間要用 in。
at 用在一個點或地址，在房間裡面用 in。

mc.q: ___ there a fridge in the kitchen?
mc.why: a fridge 是一台冰箱，單數；問句把 is 搬到 there 前面：Is there…?
wn: Are 配複數，a fridge 只有一台。
There 句型的問句用 be 動詞開頭，不用 Do。

mc.q: ___ there a wardrobe in your bedroom?
mc.why: a wardrobe 是一個衣櫃（單數），問有沒有用 Is there…?
wn: Are there 配複數，a wardrobe 是單數。
there 句型用 be 動詞問，不用 Do。

mc.q: The chair is ___ the table and the bed.
mc.why: 句中有 the table and the bed 兩樣東西，在中間用 between A and B。
wn: under 是在下面，椅子不會同時在桌子和床底下。
on 是在上面，椅子不會在桌子和床上面。

mc.q: There is a big fridge ___ the kitchen.
mc.why: 冰箱放在廚房這個空間裡面，用 in the kitchen。

under 是在下面，冰箱不會在廚房底下。

any 用在否定句和問句；肯定句說一張床用 a。

mc.q: There are some books ___ the table.
mc.why: 書放在桌面上，用 on the table。

of 是…的，不能表示位置。

mc.q: There ___ not any chairs near the door.
mc.why: any chairs 是複數，用 There are not any，也就是 There aren't any。
wn: is 配單數，chairs 是複數。
there 句型的否定用 are not，不用 do not。

mc.q: There is a big TV ___ the wall.

mc.q: There is a chair ___ front of the TV.

沒有 at front of 這種說法。

mc.q: ___ many restaurants in this city.
mc.why: many restaurants 是複數，句尾是句號不是問號，用肯定句 There are。
wn: There is 配單數，many restaurants 是很多間。
句尾是句號，這是直述句，不是問句。

mc.q: The café is ___ the bank and the library.
mc.why: 線索是 the bank and the library 兩個地方，夾在中間用 between A and B。
wn: in 是在裡面，不能表示在兩個地方中間。
on 是在表面上，不能表示在兩者中間。

mc.q: There ___ two supermarkets in this town.
mc.why: two supermarkets 是兩間超市，複數，用 There are。
wn: is 配單數，這裡有 two 兩間。
說某地有某物用 There are，不用 has。

mc.q: There ___ not a restaurant on this street.
mc.why: a restaurant 是一間餐廳（單數），否定用 There is not。
wn: are 配複數，a restaurant 只有一間。
there 句型的否定用 be 動詞，不用 do。

mc.q: My school is ___ the park.
mc.why: near 是在附近：我的學校在公園附近。
wn: of 是…的，不能單獨表示位置。
between 要兩個地點，這裡只有公園。

mc.q: There is ___ old hospital near the river.
mc.why: old 開頭是母音的音，前面用 an：an old hospital。
wn: a 用在子音開頭的字前；old 是母音開頭，要用 an。
some 配複數或不可數，hospital 是一間（單數）。

mc.q: There ___ a station and a park in this town.
mc.why: There 後面第一個名詞 a station 是單數，這題跟著它用 is。

mc.q: Are there two stations here? — Yes, there ___.
mc.why: 問句 Are there two stations 用 are，簡答也用 are：Yes, there are。
wn: 問的是複數 two stations，回答要用 are。
Are there 問句用 be 動詞回答，不用 do。

mc.q: ___ there a supermarket on this street?
mc.why: a supermarket 是一間超市，單數，問句用 Is there…?
wn: Are 配複數，a supermarket 只有一間。
There 問句用 be 動詞開頭，不用 Do。

mc.q: There ___ one school in my village.
mc.why: one school 只有一間學校，單數，用 There is。
wn: are 配複數，這裡 one 只有一間。
be 是原形，要用 is 或 are。

mc.q: ___ a bank on the corner.

mc.q: The bank is ___ the school.

mc.q: ___ there a roundabout near the station?
mc.why: a roundabout 是一個圓環，單數，問句用 Is there…?
wn: Are 配複數，a roundabout 只有一個。
There 問句用 be 動詞，不用 Do。

mc.q: There ___ a bus stop near here.
mc.why: a bus stop 是一個公車站（單數），否定用 There isn't。
wn: aren't 配複數，a bus stop 是單數。
there 句型的否定用 be 動詞 isn't，不用 don't。

mc.q: There ___ four taxis in front of the train station.

mc.q: There ___ a bus stop in front of the hotel.
mc.why: a bus stop 是一個公車站，單數，用 There is。

be 要變成 is 或 are 才能用。

mc.q: There ___ a map near here.

be 是原形，要用 is 或 are。

mc.q: ___ there a cat under the table?
mc.why: a cat 是一隻貓（單數），問有沒有用 Is there…?
wn: Are there 配複數，a cat 是單數。
there 句型用 be 動詞問，不用 Do。

mc.q: The ball is ___ the door.
mc.why: 球在門的後面，用 behind the door。
wn: on 是在表面上，球不會在門上。
between 要接兩樣東西，這裡只有 the door。

mc.q: ___ there any lamps between the bed and the desk?
mc.why: any lamps 是複數，問有沒有用 Are there…?
wn: lamps 有 s 是複數，不用 Is。
there 句型用 be 動詞問，不用 Does。

mc.q: There ___ a ball behind the door.
mc.why: a ball 是一顆球，單數，用 There is。
wn: are 配複數，a ball 只有一顆。
be 要變成 is 或 are 才能用。

mc.q: There ___ any lamps between the bed and the desk.
mc.why: any lamps 是好幾盞燈（複數），否定用 There aren't any lamps。

There 句型用 be 動詞否定，不用 doesn't。

mc.q: ___ there a ball behind the door?
mc.why: a ball 是一顆球（單數），問有沒有用 Is there…?
wn: Are there 配複數，a ball 是單數。
there 句型用 be 動詞問，不用 Do。

mc.q: Is there a lamp between the bed and the desk? Yes, ___.
mc.why: 問 Is there a lamp…? 回答照樣用 there：Yes, there is.
wn: a lamp 是一盞，單數用 there is。
問有沒有要用 there is 回答，不用 it is。

mc.q: The table is ___ the sofa and the window.
mc.why: 句中有 the sofa and the window 兩樣東西，在中間用 between A and B。
wn: on 是在上面，桌子不會在沙發和窗戶上面。
under 是在下面，桌子不會在它們底下。

mc.q: ___ there any restaurants near the station?
mc.why: any restaurants 是複數，問有沒有用 Are there…?
wn: restaurants 有 s 是複數，不用 Is。
there 句型用 be 動詞問，不用 Do。

mc.q: There ___ a sofa in my bedroom.
mc.why: a sofa 是一張沙發（單數），否定用 There isn't。
wn: aren't 配複數，a sofa 是單數。
there 句型的否定用 isn't，不用 don't。

mc.q: There ___ two libraries in front of the station.
mc.why: two libraries 是兩間圖書館，複數，用 There are。
wn: is 配單數，這裡有 two 兩間。
am 只配 I，There 句型不用。

mc.q: The sofa is ___ the living room.
mc.why: 在房間裡面用 in：in the living room。
wn: under 是在下面，沙發不會在客廳底下。
between 要兩個東西：between A and B，這裡只有客廳。

mc.q: ___ there any libraries in front of the station?
mc.why: libraries 是 library 的複數，問句用 Are there…?
wn: Is 配單數，libraries 是好幾間。
There 問句用 be 動詞開頭，不用 Does。

mc.q: There ___ a sofa in the living room.
mc.why: a sofa 是一張沙發（單數），用 There is。
wn: are 配複數，a sofa 只有一張。
be 是原形，句子裡要變成 is 或 are。

mc.q: There ___ any libraries in front of the station.
mc.why: any libraries 是複數，否定用 There aren't。
wn: isn't 配單數，libraries 是複數。
there 句型的否定用 be 動詞，不用 doesn't。

mc.q: ___ there any schools between the park and the library?
mc.why: any schools 是複數，問有沒有用 Are there…?
wn: schools 有 s 是複數，不用 Is。
there 句型用 be 動詞問，不用 Does。

How many beds does your house have?

reading.title: 短文 1
reading.text: My house is small but nice. There is a living room, a kitchen, and a bedroom. There is a sofa in the living room and a TV on the wall. There is a table in the dining room. In the kitchen, there is a fridge next to the window. There is one bathroom near the bedroom. There isn't a garage, but there is a small garden behind the house. There are many flowers in the garden. I like my house very much.

qs.q: Where is the sofa?
qs.why: 原文：There is a sofa in the living room. 沙發在客廳。
wn: 廚房裡的是冰箱（a fridge），不是沙發。
花園裡的是花（many flowers），不是沙發。

qs.q: What is on the wall?
qs.why: 原文：a TV on the wall. on the wall 是在牆上，牆上有一台電視。
wn: 窗戶是在廚房冰箱旁邊提到的，不是在牆上的東西。
文中沒有提到燈，牆上是電視。

qs.q: Is there a garage?
qs.why: 原文：There isn't a garage. 沒有車庫，用 there is 問就用 No, there isn't 回答。
wn: 原文說 There isn't a garage，沒有車庫。
原文說沒有車庫；而且 garage 是一個，也不用 are。

qs.q: Where is the fridge?
qs.why: 原文：there is a fridge next to the window. 冰箱在窗戶旁邊。
wn: 原文是 next to the window 窗戶旁邊，不是門旁邊。
文中沒有說冰箱在桌子下面，原文是 next to the window。

qs.q: What is behind the house?
qs.why: 原文：there is a small garden behind the house. behind 是在後面，房子後面有花園。
wn: 原文說 There isn't a garage，根本沒有車庫。
浴室在臥室附近（near the bedroom），不在房子後面。

reading.title: 短文 2
reading.text: My bedroom is small. There is a bed next to the window. There is a wardrobe between the bed and the door. There is a desk near the window, and there is a lamp on the desk. There are two shelves above the desk, with many books on them. There isn't a TV in my bedroom, but there is a small fan under the desk. I like my quiet room very much.

qs.q: Where is the bed?
qs.why: 原文：There is a bed next to the window. 床在窗戶旁邊。
wn: 門旁邊的是衣櫃（wardrobe between the bed and the door）。
書桌下面的是電扇（a small fan under the desk）。

qs.q: What is between the bed and the door?
qs.why: 原文：There is a wardrobe between the bed and the door. 床和門中間是衣櫃。
wn: 書桌在窗戶附近（near the window），不在床和門中間。
文中沒有提到沙發，中間是衣櫃 wardrobe。

qs.q: Is there a TV in the bedroom?
qs.why: 原文：There isn't a TV in my bedroom. 房間沒有電視，回答 No, there isn't。
wn: 原文說 There isn't a TV，沒有電視。
原文說沒有電視；而且問 Is there 要用 is 回答，不用 are。

qs.q: Where is the lamp?
qs.why: 原文：there is a lamp on the desk. on the desk 是在書桌上。
wn: 原文是 on the desk 書桌上，不是床上。
原文是 on the desk 書桌上，窗戶旁邊的是床和書桌。

qs.q: Where is the fan?
qs.why: 原文：there is a small fan under the desk. under 是在下面，電扇在書桌下面。
wn: 書桌上的是檯燈（a lamp on the desk），電扇在下面。
門旁邊是衣櫃，電扇在書桌下面。

reading.title: 短文 3
reading.text: There are many places near my house. There is a big supermarket next to the school. There is a small park between the school and the hospital. There is a bank near the station, and there is a post office next to the bank. There is a nice restaurant in front of the park. There isn't a museum in my town, but there is a library near the church. I often go to the park and the library.

qs.q: What is next to the school?
qs.why: 原文：There is a big supermarket next to the school. 學校旁邊是一間大超市。
wn: 醫院和學校中間隔著公園，兩者不是緊鄰。
教堂旁邊的是圖書館，和學校無關。

qs.q: Where is the park?
opts: Between the school and the hospital
qs.why: 原文：There is a small park between the school and the hospital. 公園在學校和醫院中間。
wn: 銀行旁邊的是郵局（post office next to the bank）。
公園前面有餐廳；圖書館在教堂附近，和公園無關。

qs.q: Is there a museum in the town?
qs.why: 原文：There isn't a museum in my town. 鎮上沒有博物館，回答 No, there isn't。
wn: 原文說 There isn't a museum，沒有博物館。
原文說沒有博物館；而且問 Is there 要用 is 回答。

qs.q: Where is the restaurant?
qs.why: 原文：There is a nice restaurant in front of the park. 餐廳在公園前面。
wn: 銀行旁邊的是郵局，不是餐廳。
文中沒有這個說法，車站附近的是銀行。

qs.q: Where is the library?
qs.why: 原文：there is a library near the church. 圖書館在教堂附近。
wn: 超市旁邊是學校，不是圖書館。
文中沒說學校前面有圖書館，圖書館在教堂附近。

reading.title: 短文 4
reading.text: Excuse me, is there a bank near here? Yes, there is. Go straight and turn left at the corner. There is a traffic light next to the bank. Cross the street at the crosswalk. The bank is opposite the school. There isn't a bridge on this street, but there is a small park after the intersection. There is a bus stop in front of the park. Thank you for your help!

qs.q: Is there a bank near here?
qs.why: 原文：Is there a bank near here? Yes, there is. 對方直接回答附近有銀行。
wn: 原文回答 Yes, there is，附近有銀行。
問 Is there a bank 是一間，回答要用 is，不用 are。

qs.q: Where do you turn left?
qs.why: 原文：Go straight and turn left at the corner. 直走，在轉角左轉。
wn: 原文說 There isn't a bridge，這條街沒有橋。
公園在十字路口之後，左轉是在轉角（at the corner）。

qs.q: Where is the bank?
qs.why: 原文：The bank is opposite the school. opposite 是在對面，銀行在學校對面。
wn: 原文說 There isn't a bridge，沒有橋。
原文是紅綠燈在銀行旁邊（next to the bank），不是下面。

qs.q: Is there a bridge on this street?
qs.why: 原文：There isn't a bridge on this street. 這條街沒有橋。
wn: 原文說 There isn't a bridge，沒有橋。
原文說沒有橋；而且問 Is there 要用 is 回答。

qs.q: What is in front of the park?
qs.why: 原文：There is a bus stop in front of the park. 公園前面有公車站。
wn: 銀行在學校對面，不在公園前面。
斑馬線是過馬路的地方，文中沒說在公園前面。

reading.title: 短文 5
reading.text: My town is small and nice. There is a park near my house. There is a bank across from the park, and there is a school next to the bank. There is a small garden behind my house, and there are trees around the garden. There is a bridge over the river, and there is a station far from my house. There isn't a hospital in my town, but there is a small clinic beside the school. I like my quiet town.

qs.q: Where is the bank?
qs.why: 原文：There is a bank across from the park. across from 是在對面，銀行在公園對面。
wn: 房子後面是小花園，不是銀行。
文中只說橋在河上，沒說銀行在橋下。

qs.q: What is next to the bank?
qs.why: 原文：there is a school next to the bank. 銀行旁邊是學校。
wn: 車站離作者家很遠（far from my house），不在銀行旁。
河上面有橋，文中沒說河在銀行旁邊。

qs.q: What is behind the house?
qs.why: 原文：There is a small garden behind my house. 房子後面有小花園。
wn: 銀行在公園對面，不在房子後面。
橋在河上（over the river），不在房子後面。

qs.q: Is there a hospital in the town?
qs.why: 原文：There isn't a hospital in my town. 沒有醫院，只有小診所 clinic。
wn: 原文說 There isn't a hospital；有的是 clinic 診所，不是醫院。
原文說沒有醫院；而且問 Is there 要用 is 回答。

qs.q: Where is the station?
qs.why: 原文：there is a station far from my house. far from 是離…很遠，車站離家很遠。
wn: 公園在作者家附近，車站離家很遠，不在公園旁。
文中沒說車站在橋下，原文是 far from my house。

reading.title: 短文 6
reading.text: I live in a small apartment in a quiet neighborhood. There are three rooms: a bedroom, a kitchen, and a living room. There is a comfortable sofa and a table in the living room. There is a nice view from my window. Near my apartment, there is a supermarket and a small park. There is a bank between the park and the school. There isn't a restaurant near my house, but there is a good one near the station. My neighborhood is quiet and convenient.

qs.q: How many rooms are there in the apartment?
qs.why: 原文：There are three rooms: a bedroom, a kitchen, and a living room. 共三個房間。
wn: 原文列了臥室、廚房、客廳三個，不是兩個。
原文說 three rooms，沒有第四個。

qs.q: What is in the living room?
qs.why: 原文：There is a comfortable sofa and a table in the living room. 客廳有沙發和桌子。
wn: 床一般在臥室，文中說客廳是沙發和桌子。
冰箱和爐子是廚房的東西，文中沒提；客廳是沙發和桌子。

qs.q: What is near the apartment?
qs.why: 原文：Near my apartment, there is a supermarket and a small park. 附近有超市和公園。
wn: 文中沒有提到醫院和博物館。

qs.q: Is there a restaurant near the house?
qs.why: 原文：There isn't a restaurant near my house. 家附近沒有餐廳，好餐廳在車站附近。
wn: 原文說家附近 There isn't a restaurant；好餐廳在車站附近。
原文說沒有；而且問 Is there 要用 is 回答。

qs.q: What is the neighborhood like?
qs.why: 原文：My neighborhood is quiet and convenient. 社區安靜又方便。
wn: 正好相反，原文說 quiet 安靜。
small 是說公寓，文中沒說社區又舊又小。

mc.q: I would like ___ bread.
mc.why: bread 不可數，肯定句表示一些用 some：I would like some bread.
wn: bread 不可數，不能說 a bread。
many 只接可數複數，bread 是不可數。

mc.q: Do you have ___ milk?
mc.why: Do you have…? 是問句，用 any；milk 不可數。
wn: milk 不可數，前面不能放 a。
many 配可數複數，milk 不可數。

mc.q: ___ much rice do you want?
mc.why: 問多少用 How much；rice 不可數，所以是 How much rice。
wn: 空格後已有 much，How many much 重複了。
What much 不是英文，問多少要用 How much。

mc.q: ___ eggs do you need?
mc.why: eggs 可以數，問數量用 How many eggs。
wn: How 後面要加 many 才能問數量：How many eggs。
How much 接不可數；eggs 可以數，用 How many。

mc.q: I would like ___ coffee, please.
mc.why: coffee 當飲料的量時不可數，肯定的請求用 some coffee。
wn: many 接可數複數，coffee 在這裡當不可數。
an 用在母音開頭的字前面，coffee 是子音開頭。

mc.q: There isn't ___ salt in the soup.
mc.why: isn't 是否定句，salt 不可數，否定句用 any。
wn: some 用在肯定句；這句是 isn't 否定。
many 接可數複數，salt 不可數。

mc.q: I would like ___ egg.
mc.why: egg 可數單數，開頭 e 是母音的音，用 an：an egg。
wn: some 接複數或不可數；一顆 egg 用 an。
any 用在否定或問句，不接單數 egg。

mc.q: Would you like ___ tea?
mc.why: Would you like…? 是請別人吃喝東西（提議），這時用 some；tea 不可數。
wn: a few 配可數複數，tea 不可數。
many 配可數複數，tea 不可數。

mc.q: How ___ cheese do you want?
mc.why: cheese 不可數，問量用 How much。
wn: many 接可數複數，cheese 不可數。
How some 不是英文說法，問量用 How much。

mc.q: I don't want ___ meat.
mc.why: don't 是否定句，meat 不可數，否定句用 any。
wn: some 用在肯定句；這句有 don't。
meat 不可數，不能說 a meat。

mc.q: ___ eggs do you want?
mc.why: eggs 是可數複數，問數量用 How many。
wn: How much 配不可數，eggs 可以數。
How long 問多長或多久，不是問數量。

mc.q: ___ rice do we need?
mc.why: rice 不可數，問多少量用 How much。
wn: How many 配可數複數，rice 不可數。
How old 問年紀，不是問量。

mc.q: There are ten ___ in the box.
mc.why: ten 是十個，egg 要加 s 變複數 eggs。
wn: ten 十個要用複數，egg 要加 s。
rice 不可數，不能說 ten rice。

mc.q: We don't have ___ bread.
mc.why: don't have 是否定句，bread 不可數，用 any bread。
wn: 否定句用 any，不用 some。
bread 不可數，前面不加 a。

mc.q: She would like ___ cup of tea.
mc.why: cup 可數，一杯茶 a cup of tea，單數可數名詞前用 a。
wn: some 不接單數 cup；要說 a cup of tea。
any 用在否定或問句，這句是肯定的。

mc.q: There is ___ water in the glass.
mc.why: There is 是肯定句，water 不可數，肯定句用 some。
wn: any 用在否定或問句，這句是肯定的。
many 接可數複數，water 不可數。

mc.q: How much ___ do you drink every day?
mc.why: How much 後面接不可數名詞；water 不可數，不加 s 也不加 a。
wn: How much 後面不接 a；water 不可數。

mc.q: I eat ___ egg every morning.
mc.why: egg 可數單數，開頭 e 是母音的音，用 an：an egg。
wn: any 用在否定或問句，不接單數 egg。
some 接複數或不可數；一顆 egg 用 an。

mc.q: He doesn't drink ___ coffee.
mc.why: doesn't 是否定句，coffee 不可數，否定句用 any。
wn: some 用在肯定句；這句有 doesn't。
coffee 不可數，不能說 a coffee。

mc.q: ___ is good for breakfast.
mc.why: bread 是不可數名詞，前面不加 a，也不加 s，直接用 Bread。

many 接可數複數，rice 不可數。

many 接可數複數，bread 不可數。

mc.q: She has ___ eggs and some milk.

much 接不可數，eggs 可以數。

reading.title: 短文 1
reading.text: My name is Mei. Every morning, I would like some bread and an egg for breakfast. I also like a cup of coffee, but my brother would like some tea. We don't have any juice at home today. At lunch, I eat some rice with chicken or fish. My mother asks, 'How much rice do you want?' and I say, 'Just a little, please.' In the evening, my family has soup and noodles. We don't eat a lot of meat, but we like cheese and butter. I would like a piece of cake after dinner.

qs.q: What does Mei have for breakfast?
qs.why: 原文：I would like some bread and an egg for breakfast. 早餐吃麵包和一顆蛋。
wn: 麵是晚餐，魚是午餐，都不是早餐。
文中沒有三明治，而且原文說 We don't have any juice。

qs.q: What does Mei's brother like to drink?
qs.why: 原文：my brother would like some tea. 哥哥（弟弟）想喝茶。
wn: 想喝咖啡的是 Mei 自己（I also like a cup of coffee）。
原文說 We don't have any juice，家裡沒有果汁。

qs.q: Do they have any juice at home today?
qs.why: 原文：We don't have any juice at home today. 今天家裡沒有果汁。
wn: 原文說 don't have any juice，一點都沒有。
原文說 don't have any，連一點點都沒有；a little 是她要的飯量。

qs.q: What does Mei eat at lunch?
qs.why: 原文：At lunch, I eat some rice with chicken or fish. 午餐吃飯配雞肉或魚。
wn: 麵包是早餐，起司只說喜歡，不是午餐。
湯是晚餐，蛋糕是晚餐後，不是午餐。

qs.q: What does Mei's mother ask about rice?
opts: How many rice do you want?
How much rice do you want?
qs.why: 原文：My mother asks, 'How much rice do you want?' rice 不可數，問量用 How much。
wn: rice 是不可數名詞，不能用 How many；原文也是 How much。
媽媽問的是要多少飯，不是喜不喜歡。

reading.title: 短文 2
reading.text: Anna gets up at seven o'clock. She is hungry. She goes to the kitchen. There is some bread on the table. There is some milk in the fridge, but there isn't any coffee. Anna eats two eggs and some bread. She drinks a glass of milk. Then her brother Tom comes in. Anna asks, "Would you like some tea?" Tom says, "No, thank you. I would like some water, please." Anna gives him a glass of water. They are happy.

qs.q: What time does Anna get up?
qs.why: 原文：Anna gets up at seven o'clock. Anna 七點起床。
wn: 原文是 seven o'clock 七點，不是八點。
原文是 seven o'clock 七點，不是六點。

qs.q: What is in the fridge?
qs.why: 原文：There is some milk in the fridge. 冰箱裡有牛奶。
wn: 原文說 there isn't any coffee，沒有咖啡。

qs.q: How many eggs does Anna eat?
qs.why: 原文：Anna eats two eggs and some bread. 她吃了兩顆蛋。
wn: 原文是 two eggs 兩顆，不是一顆。
原文是 two eggs 兩顆，不是三顆。

qs.q: What does Tom want?
qs.why: 原文：I would like some water, please. Tom 想要水。
wn: Anna 問他要不要茶，他說 No, thank you。
喝牛奶的是 Anna，Tom 要的是水。

qs.q: Is there any coffee in the kitchen?
qs.why: 原文：there isn't any coffee. 廚房裡沒有咖啡。
wn: 原文說 there isn't any coffee，沒有咖啡。
原文說沒有咖啡；而且 coffee 不可數，不說 two。

reading.title: 短文 3
reading.text: Mr. Lin works in a small shop near my house. He sells bread, milk, eggs, and tea. Every morning he makes some coffee for himself. Today a woman comes in. She asks, "How much is the milk?" "Forty dollars," Mr. Lin says. The woman buys some milk and ten eggs. She doesn't buy any bread. Then she asks, "Do you have any tea today?" "No, I don't have any tea today," Mr. Lin says. The woman says thank you and goes home.

qs.q: Where does Mr. Lin work?
qs.why: 原文：Mr. Lin works in a small shop near my house. 林先生在一家小店工作。
wn: 文中沒有提到學校，他在 small shop 工作。
文中沒有提到餐廳，他在 small shop 工作。

qs.q: What does Mr. Lin make every morning?
qs.why: 原文：Every morning he makes some coffee for himself. 他每天早上煮咖啡給自己喝。
wn: 麵包是他賣的東西（He sells bread），不是他每天早上做的。
文中沒有提到湯，他每天早上煮的是咖啡。

qs.q: How many eggs does the woman buy?
qs.why: 原文：The woman buys some milk and ten eggs. 她買了十顆蛋。
wn: 原文是 ten eggs 十顆，不是四顆。
forty 是牛奶的價錢（Forty dollars），不是蛋的數量。

qs.q: Does the shop have any tea today?
qs.why: 原文：No, I don't have any tea today. 林先生說今天沒有茶。
wn: 林先生說 I don't have any tea today，今天沒有茶。
今天一點茶都沒有，所以不是 two。

qs.q: What does the woman not buy?
qs.why: 原文：She doesn't buy any bread. 她沒有買麵包。
wn: 原文說 The woman buys some milk，她有買牛奶。
原文說她買了 ten eggs，有買蛋。

reading.title: 短文 4
reading.text: My name is Ben. I am a student in Taipei. I like food very much. For breakfast I eat some bread and one egg, and I drink some milk. I don't drink any coffee, because I am young. For lunch I eat rice and meat. My mother makes very good soup. In the evening my family drinks tea together. My sister would like some juice, but we don't have any juice at home. On Sunday we buy some fruit and some meat at the market.

qs.q: Where is Ben a student?
qs.why: 原文：I am a student in Taipei. Ben 在台北當學生。
wn: 原文是 Taipei 台北，不是台南。
原文是 Taipei 台北，不是台中。

qs.q: What does Ben drink for breakfast?
qs.why: 原文：and I drink some milk. 這句講早餐，Ben 早餐喝牛奶。
wn: 原文說 I don't drink any coffee，他不喝咖啡。
想要果汁的是妹妹（姊姊），而且家裡沒有果汁。

qs.q: How many eggs does Ben eat for breakfast?
qs.why: 原文：I eat some bread and one egg. 早餐吃一顆蛋。
wn: 原文是 one egg 一顆，不是兩顆。
原文是 one egg 一顆，不是三顆。

qs.q: What does Ben's sister want?
qs.why: 原文：My sister would like some juice. would like 是想要，妹妹（姊姊）想要果汁。
wn: 茶是全家晚上一起喝的，不是她特別想要的。
麵包是 Ben 的早餐，不是妹妹想要的。

qs.q: What does the family buy on Sunday?
qs.why: 原文：On Sunday we buy some fruit and some meat at the market. 星期天買水果和肉。
wn: 麵包和茶是平常吃喝的，星期天買的是水果和肉。
牛奶和蛋是早餐，星期天買的是水果和肉。

mc.q: I would like ___ apples.
mc.why: apples 是複數，肯定句說想要一些用 some apples。
wn: a 只配一個，apples 是複數。
an 只配一個，apples 是複數。

mc.q: How ___ bananas do you have?
mc.why: bananas 是複數、可以數，問幾根用 How many。
wn: How much 接不可數，bananas 可以數。
How a 不是英文說法，問數量用 How many。

mc.q: How ___ water do you need?
mc.why: water 不可數，問量用 How much。
wn: many 接可數複數，water 不可數。
How some 不是英文說法，問量用 How much。

mc.why: carrots 是複數，There are 的否定是 aren't：There aren't any carrots.
wn: isn't 配單數或不可數；carrots 是複數。
There 句型用 be 動詞，不用 don't。

mc.why: orange 可數單數，開頭 o 是母音的音，用 an：an orange。

some 接複數或不可數；一顆 orange 用 an。

rice 沒有複數形，也不是複數名詞。

Apple 是單數形，複數才是 apples。

much 配不可數，tomatoes 可以數。

some 和 a 不能連在一起用，some a salad 是錯的。

mc.q: How much lettuce ___ we need?

wn: does 配 he／she／it；主詞是 we。
need 是一般動詞，問句用 do，不用 is。

mc.q: How many potatoes ___ he want?

wn: do 配 I／you／we／they；主詞 he 要用 does。
後面 want 是一般動詞，問句要用 does，不用 is。

much 配不可數，grapes 是可數複數。

many 接可數複數，juice 不可數。

reading.title: 短文 1
reading.text: On Saturday, I go to the market with my mother. We buy some apples, bananas, and oranges. My mother asks, 'How many tomatoes do we need?' I say, 'We need five tomatoes.' We also buy some potatoes and carrots, but we don't buy any onions today. My mother says, 'How much rice do we have at home?' I say, 'Not much. We need some rice too.' At home, I wash the fruit and vegetables. In the evening, we eat a fresh salad with cucumbers and tomatoes. I would like some watermelon for dessert.

qs.q: Where does the family go on Saturday?
qs.why: 原文：On Saturday, I go to the market with my mother. 星期六去市場。
wn: 文中沒有提到餐廳，晚餐是在家吃沙拉。
文中沒有提到學校，星期六去的是市場。

qs.q: How many tomatoes do they need?
qs.why: 原文：We need five tomatoes. 他們需要五顆番茄。
wn: 原文是 five tomatoes 五顆，不是三顆。
原文是 five tomatoes 五顆，不是十顆。

qs.q: Do they buy any onions today?
qs.why: 原文：we don't buy any onions today. 今天沒有買洋蔥。
wn: 原文說 don't buy any onions，沒有買。
原文說 don't buy any，一顆都沒買。

qs.q: What do they eat in the evening?
qs.why: 原文：In the evening, we eat a fresh salad. 晚上吃新鮮沙拉。
wn: 文中沒有提到湯，晚上吃的是沙拉。
文中沒有提到三明治，晚上吃的是沙拉。

qs.q: What does the speaker want for dessert?
qs.why: 原文：I would like some watermelon for dessert. 甜點想吃西瓜。
wn: 文中沒有提到蛋糕，甜點是西瓜。
文中沒有提到餅乾，甜點是西瓜。

reading.title: 短文 2
reading.text: Mrs. Wang goes to the market every Saturday morning. Today she needs some vegetables. She buys four tomatoes, two onions, and six potatoes. She wants some fruit, too. "How much are the apples?" she asks. "Thirty dollars for one kilo," the man says. Mrs. Wang buys one kilo of apples and some grapes. She doesn't buy any bananas, because her son doesn't like them. At home she makes a big salad. Her family eats a lot of vegetables every day.

qs.q: When does Mrs. Wang go to the market?
qs.why: 原文：Mrs. Wang goes to the market every Saturday morning. 她每週六早上去市場。
wn: 原文是 Saturday morning 星期六早上，不是星期天晚上。
原文是 Saturday 星期六，不是星期一。

qs.q: How many potatoes does she buy?
qs.why: 原文：She buys four tomatoes, two onions, and six potatoes. 馬鈴薯是六顆。
wn: four 是番茄的數量（four tomatoes），不是馬鈴薯。
two 是洋蔥的數量（two onions），不是馬鈴薯。

qs.q: How much is one kilo of apples?
qs.why: 原文：Thirty dollars for one kilo. thirty 是三十。
wn: thirteen 是十三，原文是 thirty 三十，字尾 -ty 和 -teen 要分清楚。
three 是三，原文是 thirty 三十。

qs.q: Why doesn't she buy any bananas?
qs.why: 原文：because her son doesn't like them. because 後面是原因：兒子不喜歡香蕉。
wn: 文中沒說香蕉太舊，原因是兒子不喜歡。
文中沒說店裡沒香蕉，原因是兒子不喜歡。

qs.q: What does she make at home?
qs.why: 原文：At home she makes a big salad. 她回家做了一大盤沙拉。
wn: 文中沒有提到湯，她做的是沙拉。
文中沒有提到麵包，她做的是沙拉。

reading.title: 短文 3
reading.text: I am Kevin. I don't eat many vegetables, and my mother is not happy. "How much fruit do you eat every day?" she asks. "One apple," I say. "That is not enough," she says. Now I eat some fruit every morning. I have an orange or a banana. For lunch I eat some salad with tomatoes and lettuce. I don't put any onions in my salad, because I don't like them. I also drink some juice. Now I feel very good, and my mother is happy.

qs.q: Who is not happy at the beginning?
qs.why: 原文：I don't eat many vegetables, and my mother is not happy. 不開心的是 Kevin 的媽媽。
wn: 文中沒有出現老師，不開心的是 my mother。
文中沒有提到姊妹，不開心的是 my mother。

qs.q: How much fruit does Kevin eat at first?
qs.why: 原文：How much fruit do you eat every day? / One apple. 一開始 Kevin 每天只吃一顆蘋果。
wn: 香蕉是後來早上才吃的，而且是 an orange or a banana，不是兩根。
他有吃水果，只是很少：One apple。

qs.q: What does Kevin eat every morning now?
qs.why: 原文：Now I eat some fruit every morning. 現在他每天早上吃一些水果（柳丁或香蕉）。
wn: 文中早上吃的是 fruit，沒有提到肉。
文中早上吃的是 fruit，沒有提到麵包。

qs.q: What is in Kevin's salad?
qs.why: 原文：I eat some salad with tomatoes and lettuce. 沙拉裡有番茄和生菜。
wn: 文中說 I don't put any onions in my salad，沒放洋蔥，也沒提紅蘿蔔。
文中沙拉裡是 tomatoes and lettuce，沒有馬鈴薯和葡萄。

qs.q: Why doesn't Kevin put any onions in his salad?
qs.why: 原文：…because I don't like them. because 後面就是原因：他不喜歡洋蔥。
wn: 文中沒說洋蔥太大，because 後面是 I don't like them。
文中沒說洋蔥不新鮮，原因是他不喜歡。

reading.title: 短文 4
reading.text: There is a small fruit shop near my school. It opens at nine o'clock every day. The shop has a lot of fruit. There are apples, oranges, bananas, and grapes. There isn't any juice in this shop, but there is a lot of fresh fruit. After school I often buy some grapes for my family. My father likes oranges very much. He eats two oranges every evening. My mother says, "How many oranges do we need this week?" My father says, "Fourteen, please!"

qs.q: Where is the fruit shop?
qs.why: 原文：There is a small fruit shop near my school. 水果店在學校附近。
wn: 文中是 near my school，不是家附近。
文中是 near my school，沒有提到市場。

qs.q: What time does the shop open?
qs.why: 原文：It opens at nine o'clock every day. 店每天九點開門。
wn: 文中是 nine o'clock 九點，不是十點。
文中是 nine o'clock 九點，不是七點。

qs.q: Is there any juice in the shop?
qs.why: 原文：There isn't any juice in this shop. 店裡沒有果汁，所以回答 No, there isn't.
wn: 文中說 There isn't any juice，店裡沒有果汁。
文中說店裡完全沒有果汁（isn't any），不是兩瓶。

qs.q: What does the writer often buy?
qs.why: 原文：After school I often buy some grapes for my family. 作者常買的是葡萄。
wn: 店裡有蘋果，但作者常買的是 grapes。
店裡有香蕉，但作者常買的是 grapes。

qs.q: How many oranges does the father eat every evening?
qs.why: 原文：He eats two oranges every evening. 爸爸每天晚上吃兩顆柳丁。
wn: 文中是 two oranges，不是四顆。
Fourteen 是一整週要買的數量，每天晚上是 two。

mc.q: We would like ___ table for two.
mc.why: table 可數單數，開頭 t 是子音，用 a：a table for two。
wn: an 用在母音開頭的字，table 是 t 開頭。

mc.q: Can I have ___ menu, please?
mc.why: 在餐廳裡大家知道是哪一份菜單，用 the menu。
wn: an 用在母音開頭的字前面，menu 是 m 開頭。
menu 是可數單數，前面不能用 some。

mc.q: ___ would you like to drink?
mc.why: 問想喝「什麼」，用 What。
wn: How much 問多少量或多少錢，不是問喝什麼。
How many 問數量，這裡問的是想喝什麼。

mc.q: I would like to ___ some soup.
mc.why: would like to 後面接原形動詞：would like to order。
wn: to 後面用原形，不加 s。

mc.q: Are there ___ seats by the window?
mc.why: Are there…? 是問句，seats 是複數，問句一般用 any。
wn: much 配不可數，seats 可以數。
a lot 後面要加 of 才能接名詞：a lot of seats。

mc.q: Would you like ___ dessert?
mc.why: Would you like…? 是提議、請客，習慣用 some：some dessert。
wn: an 用在母音開頭的字前面，dessert 是 d 開頭。
many 要接複數名詞，dessert 這裡是單數。

mc.q: Can we have ___ bill, please?
mc.why: 在餐廳要的是自己這桌的帳單，雙方都知道是哪一張，用 the bill。
wn: 要的是這桌特定的帳單，用 the。

mc.q: I need ___ knife and a fork.
mc.why: knife 可數單數；knife 開頭是子音（k 不發音，唸 n），用 a。
wn: an 用在母音開頭的音；knife 唸 /naɪf/，是子音開頭。
knife 是一把，單數要用 a；後面也是 a fork。

mc.q: Are there ___ napkins on the table?
mc.why: Are there…? 是問句，napkins 是複數，問句一般用 any。
wn: a 只配一個（單數），napkins 是複數。
much 配不可數，napkins 可以數。

mc.q: We have ___ reservation for two.
mc.why: reservation 可數單數，開頭 r 是子音，用 a：a reservation。
wn: an 用在母音開頭的字，reservation 是 r 開頭。
some 不接單數名詞；一筆訂位用 a。

mc.q: I would like a table ___ two, please.
mc.why: 訂位說幾個人用 for：a table for two（兩人的桌位）。
wn: a table to two 不通；給幾個人用 for。
a table of two 不是訂位的說法，要用 for。

mc.q: Would you like ___ soup?
mc.why: Would you like…? 是提議、請客，期待對方說好，用 some：some soup。
wn: a lot 後面要加 of 才能接名詞：a lot of soup。
many 接可數複數，soup 不可數。

mc.q: We don't have ___ dessert today.
mc.why: don't 是否定句，dessert 這裡當不可數，否定句用 any。
wn: some 用在肯定句；這句有 don't。
dessert 沒有加 s，不配 many。

mc.q: How ___ is the bill?
mc.why: 問金額、價錢用 How much：How much is the bill? 帳單多少錢。
wn: How many 問可數的數量，問金額用 How much。
How old 問年紀，不是問錢。

mc.q: How ___ people are in your group?
mc.why: people 是複數、可以數，問人數用 How many。
wn: How much 接不可數，people 可以數。
How long 問時間或長度，不是人數。

mc.q: The waiter brings ___ menu.
mc.why: menu 可數單數，開頭 m 是子音，一份菜單用 a：a menu。
wn: any 用在否定或問句，這句是肯定的。

mc.q: There ___ two menus on the table.
mc.why: two menus 是複數，There 句型配複數用 are。
wn: is 配單數；two menus 是複數。
be 是原形，這裡要用 are。

mc.q: There ___ some soup in the bowl.
mc.why: soup 不可數，看成單數，There 句型用 is。
wn: are 配可數複數；soup 不可數，用 is。

mc.q: Do you have ___ noodles?
mc.why: Do you have…? 是問句，noodles 是複數，問句用 any。
wn: noodles 是複數，不能放 a。
much 接不可數，noodles 可以數。

mc.q: I would like ___ glass of water, please.
mc.why: glass 可數單數，一杯水 a glass of water，前面用 a。
wn: any 用在否定或問句，這是肯定的點餐。

mc.q: Can I have ___ water, please?
mc.why: Can I have…? 是請求，希望對方給，用 some；water 不可數。
wn: 請求東西時習慣用 some，不用 any。
many 接可數複數，water 不可數。

mc.q: We would like ___ order now.
mc.why: would like 後面接動作時要用 to + 原形動詞：would like to order。
wn: some 接名詞，這裡後面是動詞 order。
any 接名詞，不能接動詞 order。

mc.q: How many ___ would you like?
mc.why: How many 後面要接可數複數名詞：desserts。
wn: How many 後面要用複數 desserts。
soup 不可數，要用 How much。

mc.q: How much ___ would you like?
mc.why: How much 後面接不可數名詞；soup 不可數，用 soup。
wn: soup 一般不加 s，How much 接不可數。
noodles 是可數複數，要用 How many。

mc.q: There aren't ___ free tables now.
mc.why: aren't 是否定句，tables 是複數，否定句用 any。
wn: some 用在肯定句；這句有 aren't。
much 接不可數，tables 可以數。

mc.q: The waiter asks, "Would you like ___ dessert?"
mc.why: 服務生在提議、請客（Would you like…?），期待對方說好，用 some。
wn: an 用在母音開頭的字前面，dessert 是 d 開頭。
many 接可數複數，這裡 dessert 當一份甜點，不用 many。

mc.q: I don't want ___ soup, thank you.
mc.why: don't want 是否定句，用 any：I don't want any soup。
wn: 否定句用 any，some 多用在肯定句。
soup 這裡當不可數，前面不加 a。

mc.q: ___ is the bill, please?
mc.why: 問金額多少用 How much：How much is the bill?
wn: How many 問數量，不能問金額。
How old 問年紀，不是問金額。

mc.q: We would like some noodles and ___ soup.
mc.why: soup 不可數，肯定的點餐說一些用 some，和前面 some noodles 一樣。
wn: any 用在否定或問句；這是肯定句。
soup 一般不可數，不說 a soup；一碗是 a bowl of soup。

mc.q: She would ___ a cup of tea after dinner.
mc.why: would 後面接原形：would like。
wn: would 後面接原形，不加 s。

mc.q: Are there ___ free tables?
mc.why: Are there…? 是問句，tables 是複數，問句用 any。
wn: 一般問句多用 any，不用 some。
much 接不可數，tables 可以數。

mc.q: Is there ___ water on the table?
mc.why: Is there…? 是問句，water 不可數，問句用 any。
wn: 一般問句多用 any，不用 some。
many 接可數複數，water 不可數。

mc.q: How many waiters ___ in this restaurant?
mc.why: 主詞 waiters 是複數（有 s），be 動詞用 are。
wn: is 配單數；waiters 是複數。
後面沒有動詞，在這裡是 be 動詞的位置，用 are。

mc.q: The bill ___ four hundred dollars.
mc.why: 主詞 The bill 是一張帳單，單數，用 is（金額看成一個總數）。
wn: are 配複數主詞；The bill 是單數。
be 是原形，句子裡要用 is。

mc.q: The noodles ___ very good.
mc.why: noodles 有 s，是複數（很多條麵），be 動詞用 are。
wn: is 配單數；noodles 是複數。
be 是原形，主詞後面要變成 am／is／are。

mc.q: I would like ___ soup and a salad.
mc.why: soup 不可數，肯定的點餐說一些用 some：some soup。
wn: soup 一般不可數，不說 a soup；一碗是 a bowl of soup。
any 用在否定或問句，這句是肯定的點餐。

mc.q: We don't need ___ menu, thank you.
mc.why: menu 是可數單數，否定句裡單數可數名詞仍要用 a：don't need a menu。
wn: any 接複數或不可數；menu 是單數。
some 用在肯定句，也不接單數 menu。

mc.q: How much money ___ you have?
mc.why: 問句主詞是 you，助動詞用 do：do you have?
wn: does 配 he／she／it；主詞是 you。
後面 have 是一般動詞，問句用 do，不用 is。

mc.q: How many desserts ___ she want?
mc.why: 問句主詞是 she，一個人（第三人稱單數），助動詞用 does。
wn: do 配 I／you／we／they；主詞 she 要用 does。
後面 want 是一般動詞，問句用 does，不用 is。

mc.q: Would you like ___ more water?
mc.why: Would you like…? 是提議再來一點，用 some more：some more water。
wn: many 接可數複數，water 不可數。
much more water 少這樣問，提議用 some more。

mc.q: There is ___ rice with the meat.
mc.why: There is 是肯定句，rice 不可數，用 some。
wn: any 用在否定句和問句，這句是肯定句。
many 配可數複數，rice 不可數。

mc.q: They would like ___ table near the window.
mc.why: table 可數單數，一張桌子用 a：a table near the window。
wn: any 用在否定或問句，這句是肯定的。

mc.q: Can we have ___ menus, please?
mc.why: Can we have…? 是請求，menus 是複數，請求用 some。
wn: 請求東西時習慣用 some，不用 any。
much 接不可數，menus 可以數。

mc.q: I don't have ___ money today.
mc.why: don't 是否定句，money 不可數，否定句用 any。
wn: some 用在肯定句；這句有 don't。
many 接可數複數，money 不可數。

mc.q: ___ menus do you need?
mc.why: menus 是複數、可以數，問幾份用 How many。
wn: How much 問不可數的量或價錢，menus 可以數。
How old 問年紀，不是問數量。

mc.q: The waiter would like ___ help us.
mc.why: would like 後面接動作要用 to + 原形動詞：would like to help。
wn: some 接名詞，後面 help 這裡是動詞。
any 接名詞，不能接動詞 help。

mc.q: There isn't ___ soup in the pot.
mc.why: isn't 是否定句，soup 不可數，否定句用 any。
wn: some 用在肯定句；這句是 isn't 否定。
many 接可數複數，soup 不可數。

mc.q: How much is ___ dessert?
mc.why: 問這份甜點多少錢，指特定那一份，用 the。
wn: many 配可數複數，dessert 是單數。
問價錢要指特定那一份，用 the，不說 some dessert。

mc.q: Excuse me, can I see ___ menu?
mc.why: 在餐廳要看的是店裡那份菜單，雙方都知道是哪一份，用 the menu。
wn: any 不接單數 menu；請求也不用 any。

fill.q: We ___ like a table for two.
fill.why: 想要什麼的客氣說法是 would like，we 後面接 would：We would like…

fill.q: Can I have ___ menu, please?
fill.why: 在餐廳跟店員要菜單，說 the menu（店裡的菜單）或 a menu（一份）都可以。

fill.q: I would like to ___ some soup.
fill.why: would like to 後面接原形動詞；在餐廳點餐用 order，order some soup 就是點湯。

fill.q: Is there ___ seat by the window?
fill.why: seat 是可數單數，問有沒有一個位子用 a：Is there a seat…?；any 要接複數或不可數。

fill.q: Would you like ___ dessert?
fill.why: Would you like…? 是主動提供東西，雖然是問句也用 some：some dessert。

fill.q: Can we have ___ bill?
