reading.title: 短文 1
reading.text: Today, my friend and I go to a restaurant for dinner. We have a reservation for two. The waiter says, 'Would you like a table by the window?' We say, 'Yes, please.' He gives us the menu. I would like to order some soup and a dish of chicken. My friend says, 'I would like some fish, please.' We ask, 'Is there any dessert today?' The waiter says, 'Yes, we have some cake.' After dinner, we ask for the bill. The service is very good, and the food is delicious too.

qs.q: How many people have the reservation?
qs.why: 原文：We have a reservation for two. 我和朋友兩個人訂位，for two 就是兩位。
wn: 文中是 my friend and I，訂位 for two，是兩個人。
文中只有作者和朋友，for two 是兩位。

qs.q: What does the waiter give them?
qs.why: 原文：He gives us the menu. 服務生給他們的是菜單。
wn: 帳單是吃完飯後他們自己要的（ask for the bill），不是服務生先給。
文中沒有提到餐巾，服務生給的是 the menu。

qs.q: What does the speaker order?
qs.why: 原文：I would like to order some soup and a dish of chicken. 作者點湯和雞肉。
wn: 點魚的是朋友，也沒有提到飯。
cake 是店裡的甜點，不是作者點的主餐，文中也沒提茶。

qs.q: What does the friend order?
qs.why: 原文：My friend says, I would like some fish, please. 朋友點的是魚。
wn: 湯是作者（I）點的，不是朋友。
文中沒有提到麵包，朋友點的是 fish。

qs.q: Do they have any dessert?
qs.why: 原文：Is there any dessert today? / Yes, we have some cake. 有甜點，是蛋糕。
wn: 服務生回答 Yes, we have some cake，有甜點。
文中他們有問：Is there any dessert today?

reading.title: 短文 2
reading.text: It is seven o'clock. Amy and her friend go to a small restaurant. "A table for two, please," Amy says. The waiter says, "This way, please." He gives them two menus. Amy would like some noodles and some soup. Her friend would like rice and some vegetables. "Would you like any dessert?" the waiter asks. "No, thank you," Amy says. "But we would like some tea, please." After dinner Amy asks, "How much is the bill?" It is five hundred dollars.

qs.q: What time is it in the story?
qs.why: 原文第一句：It is seven o'clock. 故事時間是七點。
wn: 文中是 seven o'clock，five 是帳單 five hundred 裡的數字。
文中是 seven o'clock 七點，不是九點。

qs.q: What does Amy ask for at the door?
qs.why: 原文：A table for two, please, Amy says. Amy 和朋友兩個人，要兩人桌。
wn: 文中是 a table for two，只有 Amy 和朋友兩人。
帳單是吃完飯後才問的，不是在門口。

qs.q: What does Amy order?
qs.why: 原文：Amy would like some noodles and some soup. Amy 點麵和湯。
wn: 飯和蔬菜是 Amy 的朋友點的。
Amy 說 No, thank you 不要甜點，只要了茶。

qs.q: Do they want any dessert?
qs.why: 原文：Would you like any dessert? / No, thank you. 他們不要甜點，所以回答 No, they don't.
wn: Amy 回答 No, thank you，不要甜點。
他們不要甜點，只要了 some tea。

qs.q: How much is the bill?
qs.why: 原文：How much is the bill? It is five hundred dollars. 帳單是五百元。
wn: 文中是 five hundred，不是 two hundred。
seven 是時間七點，帳單是 five hundred dollars。

reading.title: 短文 3
reading.text: My uncle is a waiter in a big restaurant in Taipei. He works from five to ten every evening. He gives the menu to the customers and takes their orders. People often ask him, "How much is this soup?" or "Do you have any noodles?" He is always friendly. On Friday the restaurant is very busy, and there aren't any free tables. My uncle says, "I like my job, but I am very tired on Friday night." I want to visit his restaurant next week.

qs.q: What is the uncle's job?
qs.why: 原文：My uncle is a waiter in a big restaurant. 叔叔是服務生。
wn: 他在餐廳工作，但職業是 waiter 服務生，不是廚師。
文中說他是 a waiter，不是老師。

qs.q: When does he work?
opts: From nine to five in the day.
From five to ten in the evening.
From ten to twelve at night.
qs.why: 原文：He works from five to ten every evening. 他每天晚上五點到十點上班。
wn: 文中是 every evening，晚上五點到十點，不是白天。
文中是 from five to ten，十點就下班了。

qs.q: What does he give the customers?
qs.why: 原文：He gives the menu to the customers. 他給客人的是菜單。
wn: 文中沒說他給客人錢，給的是 the menu。
文中沒有提到甜點，給的是 the menu。

qs.q: What day is very busy?
qs.why: 原文：On Friday the restaurant is very busy. 星期五餐廳很忙。
wn: 文中說很忙的是 Friday，沒提到星期一。
文中說很忙的是 Friday，沒提到星期日。

qs.q: How does the uncle feel on Friday night?
qs.why: 原文：I am very tired on Friday night. 叔叔星期五晚上很累。
wn: 文中是 very tired 很累，不是餓。
他說 I like my job，不是生氣，是 very tired。

reading.title: 短文 4
reading.text: Today is my mother's birthday. My father, my sister, and I take her to a restaurant. We would like a table for four, but there aren't any free tables. We wait for ten minutes. Then a waiter comes and says, "This table is free now." My mother would like some soup and some fish. My sister asks, "How many desserts can we have?" My father says, "Four, one for everybody!" We are very happy. The bill is one thousand dollars, and my father pays.

qs.q: Why do they go to a restaurant?
qs.why: 原文：Today is my mother's birthday. 是媽媽生日，所以帶她去餐廳。
wn: 文中是 my mother's birthday，不是姊妹的。
文中是 my mother's birthday，不是爸爸的。

qs.q: How many people are in the family group?
qs.why: 原文：We would like a table for four. 爸爸、姊妹、我，再加媽媽，一共四個人。
wn: My father, my sister, and I 是三人，還要加上媽媽 her，共四人。
一家只有四人，所以要 a table for four。

qs.q: How long do they wait?
qs.why: 原文：We wait for ten minutes. 他們等了十分鐘。
wn: 文中是 ten minutes，不是二十分鐘。
文中是 ten minutes 十分鐘，不是一小時。

qs.q: What does the mother order?
qs.why: 原文：My mother would like some soup and some fish. 媽媽點湯和魚。
wn: 文中媽媽要的是 soup and fish，沒提到麵和茶。
文中媽媽要的是 soup and fish，不是飯和肉。

qs.q: Who pays the bill?
qs.why: 原文：The bill is one thousand dollars, and my father pays. 付錢的是爸爸。
wn: 今天是媽媽生日，付錢的是 my father。
姊妹只問了甜點，付錢的是 my father。

speaking.model: She would like a cup of tea after dinner.

writing.prompt: 請想像你在餐廳點餐，用今天學到的單字與 would like 句型，寫 3-5 句英文對話或描述。
writing.sample: I would like a table for two, please. Can I have the menu? I would like to order some soup and a dish of chicken. Would you like some dessert? Can we have the bill, please?

writing.prompt: 用 3-5 句英文寫出你在餐廳點餐的對話（要用 would like 和 some/any）。
writing.sample: Good evening. We would like a table for two, please. Can I see the menu? I would like some soup and some noodles. We don't want any dessert, thank you.

writing.prompt: 寫 3-5 句英文，描述一次和家人去餐廳吃飯（用 how much 和 how many 各一次）。
writing.sample: On Sunday my family goes to a restaurant. How many people are in my family? We are four. My mother would like some fish and some rice. How much is the bill? It is eight hundred dollars.

writing.prompt: 寫 3-5 句英文，介紹你喜歡的餐廳（用 there is / there are 和 some/any）。
writing.sample: There is a small restaurant near my house. The waiters are very friendly. There are some good noodles and some soup. On Friday there aren't any free tables.

mc.q: ___ is this shirt?
mc.why: 問價錢固定說 How much is…?：How much is this shirt?
wn: How many 問數量，不能問價錢。
What price is…? 不自然；可說 What is the price?

mc.q: This bag is very ___.
mc.why: be 動詞 is 後面描述東西要用形容詞 cheap（便宜的）。
wn: cheaply 是副詞，修飾動作，不放在 is 後面形容東西。
cheaper than 是比較，後面要接比較的對象。

mc.q: Can I pay by ___ card?
mc.why: 刷卡付款的卡叫 credit card（信用卡）：pay by credit card。
wn: cash 是現金，沒有 cash card 這種說法。
money card 不是英文，要說 credit card。

mc.q: Is there ___ discount today?
mc.why: Is there…? 是問句，問句用 any：Is there any discount?
wn: 一般問句多用 any，不用 some。
much 多用在不可數的量，問有沒有折扣不用 much。

mc.q: I ___ like to pay with cash.
mc.why: 客氣地說想要、想做用 would like to…：I would like to pay。
wn: will like 不是想要的意思，客氣說想要用 would like。
am 後面不能接動詞原形 like。

mc.q: How ___ money do you have?
mc.why: money 不可數（不能說 two moneys），問多少錢用 How much money。
wn: many 接可數複數，money 是不可數。
How 後面不能接 a lot，問量要用 How much。

mc.q: Do you ___ any milk here?
mc.why: 問店家有沒有在賣，用 sell（賣）：Do you sell any milk?
wn: buy 是買；問店家要問有沒有賣 sell。
pay 是付錢，後面不直接接 milk。

mc.q: I would like to ___ this bag.
mc.why: 客人想要這個包包，自己花錢買是 buy：I would like to buy this bag.
wn: sell 是賣出去，客人是要買。
pay 是付錢，要說 pay for this bag。

mc.q: This watch is too ___. I don't have enough money.
mc.why: 後面說 I don't have enough money（錢不夠），所以是太貴：too expensive。
wn: too cheap 是太便宜，不會因此錢不夠。
free 是免費，不會說 too free。

mc.q: Can I have ___ receipt, please?
mc.why: receipt 可數單數，開頭 r 是子音，用 a：a receipt。
wn: an 用在母音開頭的字，receipt 是 r 開頭。

mc.q: How ___ is this shirt?
mc.why: 問價錢固定說 How much is…?：How much is this shirt?
wn: How many 問數量，不能問價錢。
How old 問年紀，不是價錢。

mc.q: How ___ shirts do you want?
mc.why: shirts 是可數複數，問數量用 How many。
wn: much 配不可數，shirts 可以一件件數。
How long 問多長或多久，不是問數量。

mc.q: I would like ___ water, please.
mc.why: water 不可數，肯定的點餐說一些用 some：some water。
wn: water 不可數，不說 a water；一杯是 a glass of water。
many 接可數複數，water 不可數。

mc.q: Do you have ___ black shoes?
mc.why: Do you have…? 是問句，shoes 是複數，問句用 any。
wn: much 接不可數，shoes 可以數。
shoes 是複數，不能放 a。

mc.q: How much ___ these socks?
mc.why: 問價錢 How much + be 動詞 + 東西；these socks 是複數，用 are。
wn: is 配單數，例如 this sock；these socks 是複數。
How much 問價錢後面接 be 動詞，不用 do。

mc.q: I don't have ___ cash with me.
mc.why: don't have 是否定句，用 any；cash 現金不可數。
wn: 否定句用 any，不用 some。
many 配可數複數，cash 不可數。

mc.q: ___ you like a small bag?
mc.why: 禮貌提議、詢問要不要，用 Would you like…?
wn: Are you like 不是英文，like 是動詞不配 are。
Is 配單數主詞，而且 like 是動詞不配 be 動詞。

mc.q: How many ___ are in the shop?
mc.why: How many 後面要接可數複數名詞；people 是 person 的複數，可以數。
wn: milk 不可數，要用 How much。
money 不可數，要用 How much。

mc.q: How much ___ do you need?
mc.why: How much 後面接不可數名詞；money 不可數，用 money。
wn: dollars 可數複數，要用 How many。
coins 可數複數，要用 How many。

mc.q: She would like ___ new hat.
mc.why: hat 可數，而且是一頂，單數可數名詞前面要加 a。
wn: some 配不可數或複數；a new hat 是一頂帽子。
any 用在否定句或問句，而且 hat 是單數。

mc.q: There aren't ___ cheap shirts here.
mc.why: aren't 是否定句，shirts 是複數，用 any。
wn: 否定句用 any，不用 some。
much 配不可數，shirts 是可數複數。

mc.q: I want ___ bananas.
mc.why: bananas 是複數，肯定句說一些用 some。
wn: bananas 是複數，不能放 a。
much 接不可數，bananas 可以數。

mc.q: We have ___ bread at home.
mc.why: 肯定句 We have…，bread 不可數，用 some。
wn: bread 不可數，不能說 a bread。
many 配可數複數，bread 不可數。

mc.q: ___ much is the coffee?
mc.why: 問價錢的固定說法是 How much：How much is the coffee? 咖啡多少錢。
wn: 沒有 What much 的說法，問價錢用 How much。
Who 問人是誰，不能接 much。

mc.q: How many ___ do you have?
mc.why: How many 後面要接可數複數；credit cards 可以一張張數。
wn: cash 現金不可數，要用 How much。
money 不可數，要用 How much。

mc.q: Would you like ___ big bag?
mc.why: bag 是可數名詞，這裡是一個 big bag，單數可數名詞前面要放 a。
wn: any 多用在否定句或問句接複數／不可數名詞，不接一個 bag。
much 只接不可數名詞（如 water），bag 是可數的。

mc.q: I don't want ___ sugar in my coffee.
mc.why: don't 是否定句，用 any；sugar 不可數。
wn: some 用在肯定句；否定句 don't 配 any。
sugar 不可數，不能說 a sugar。

mc.q: How much ___ do you spend every day?
mc.why: How much 後面接不可數名詞；money 不可數，用 money。
wn: money 一般不加複數，說 money 就好。
dollars 可數複數，要用 How many。

mc.q: There is ___ milk in the fridge.
mc.why: There is 是肯定句，milk 不可數，肯定句用 some。
wn: any 用在否定或問句，這句是肯定的。
many 接可數複數，milk 不可數。

mc.q: Do we need ___ rice?
mc.why: Do we need…? 是問句，rice 不可數，問句用 any。
wn: rice 不可數，不能說 a rice。
many 接可數複數，rice 不可數。

mc.q: He would like ___ apples.
mc.why: apples 是複數，肯定句說一些用 some。
wn: apples 是複數，不能放 a。
much 接不可數，apples 可以數。

mc.q: How ___ oranges are in the bag?
mc.why: oranges 是複數、可以數，問幾顆用 How many。
wn: How much 接不可數，oranges 可以數。
How old 問年紀，不是數量。

mc.q: I have ___ money, but not much.
mc.why: 肯定句，money 不可數，說有一些用 some（後面 not much 也提示不可數）。
wn: any 用在否定或問句，這句是肯定的。
many 接可數複數，money 不可數。

mc.q: The shop doesn't have ___ small hats.
mc.why: doesn't 是否定句，hats 是複數，否定句用 any。
wn: some 用在肯定句；這句有 doesn't。
much 接不可數，hats 可以數。

mc.q: How much ___ the tickets?
mc.why: 問價錢 How much + be 動詞；the tickets 是複數，用 are。
wn: is 配單數；tickets 是複數。
How much 問價錢後面接 be 動詞，不用 do。

mc.q: I need ___ new shoes.
mc.why: shoes 是複數，肯定句說一些用 some：some new shoes。
wn: shoes 是複數，不能放 a。
much 接不可數，shoes 可以數。

mc.q: We don't have ___ time to shop today.
mc.why: don't 是否定句，time 這裡不可數，否定句用 any。
wn: some 用在肯定句；這句有 don't。
many 接可數複數，time 在這裡不可數。

mc.q: How many ___ do you buy every week?
mc.why: How many 後面接可數複數，eggs 可以一顆顆數。
wn: milk 牛奶不可數，問量要用 How much。
bread 麵包不可數，要用 How much。

mc.q: How much ___ is in your bag?
mc.why: How much 後面接不可數，cash 現金不可數，動詞也剛好是 is。
wn: coins 是可數複數，要用 How many，動詞用 are。
cards 是可數複數，要用 How many…are。

mc.q: Sam would like ___ cheese, please.
mc.why: 肯定句 would like，cheese 不可數，用 some。
wn: cheese 不可數，不能說 a cheese。
many 配可數複數，cheese 不可數。

mc.q: Are there ___ cheap phones here?
mc.why: Are there…? 是問句，phones 是複數，問句用 any。
wn: much 接不可數，phones 可以數。
phones 是複數，不能放 a。

mc.q: I would like ___ pay by card.
mc.why: would like 後面接動作要用 to + 原形動詞：would like to pay。
wn: would like 後面不接 for + 動詞。
would like 後面不接 of；接動作用 to。

mc.q: How much ___ this jacket cost?
mc.why: 後面有動詞 cost，主詞 this jacket 是單數，問句用 does。
wn: do 配複數或 I／you；this jacket 是一件。
後面有一般動詞 cost，問句用 does，不用 is。

mc.q: She doesn't have ___ credit card.
mc.why: credit card 可數單數，開頭 c 是子音，否定句也用 a：a credit card。
wn: any 接複數或不可數；card 是單數。
some 用在肯定句，也不接單數 card。

mc.why: help 這裡是名詞，不可數，請求一點幫忙用 some help。

mc.q: How ___ bags of rice do you need?

mc.q: There isn't ___ bread in this shop.
mc.why: There isn't 是否定句，用 any；bread 不可數。
wn: some 用在肯定句；否定句 isn't 配 any。
many 配可數複數，bread 不可數。

mc.why: two 表示兩杯，咖啡用 cup 數，要變複數 cups。

mc.why: How much 後面接不可數名詞，juice 不可數，用原形不加 s。

reading.title: 短文 1
reading.text: Yesterday, I go to a new store near my house. There is a big sale today. I see a nice bag. I ask, 'How much is this bag?' The shop worker says, 'It's only ten dollars. It's very cheap.' I say, 'I would like to buy this bag, please.' I ask, 'Can I pay by credit card?' She says, 'Yes, of course.' She gives me a receipt. I don't have any cash today, but I have my credit card in my wallet. The bag is cheap, and I am very happy.

qs.q: Where does the speaker go yesterday?
qs.why: 原文：Yesterday, I go to a new store near my house. 作者去的是一家新開的店。
wn: 文中是 a new store 商店，不是餐廳。
文中是 a new store near my house，不是學校。

qs.q: How much is the bag?
qs.why: 原文：It's only ten dollars. 這個包包只要十元。
wn: 店員說 ten dollars，不是五元。
店員說 ten dollars，不是二十元。

qs.q: How does the speaker pay?
qs.why: 原文：Can I pay by credit card? / Yes, of course. 作者用信用卡付錢。
wn: 文中說 I don't have any cash today，沒有現金。
文中沒有提到硬幣，是用 credit card 付。

qs.q: Does the speaker have any cash today?
qs.why: 原文：I don't have any cash today. 今天沒有現金，所以答 No。
wn: 文中說 I don't have any cash，沒有現金。
don't have any 是完全沒有，不是很多。

qs.q: Is the bag expensive?
qs.why: 原文：It's only ten dollars. It's very cheap. 包包很便宜，不貴。
wn: 店員說 It's very cheap，很便宜，不是很貴。

reading.title: 短文 2
reading.text: Anna goes to a small shop near her home. She wants some bread and some milk. She asks the man, "How much is this bread?" The man says, "It is forty dollars." Anna says, "That is cheap. I would like two, please." She also wants some apples. She asks, "How many apples are in the bag?" The man says, "Six." Anna does not have any cash today, so she pays by credit card. The man gives her a big bag for the food. Anna says thank you and goes home.

qs.q: Where does Anna go?
qs.why: 原文：Anna goes to a small shop near her home. Anna 去家附近的小商店。
wn: 文中是 a small shop，不是學校。
文中是 a small shop，沒有提到公車站。

qs.q: How much is the bread?
qs.why: 原文：It is forty dollars. 麵包四十元。forty 是 40。
wn: fourteen 是 14，文中是 forty 40，兩個字很像要分清楚。

qs.q: How many apples are in the bag?
qs.why: 原文：How many apples are in the bag? / Six. 袋子裡有六顆蘋果。
wn: two 是 Anna 要買的麵包數量（I would like two），不是蘋果。
老闆回答 Six，不是十顆。

qs.q: How does Anna pay?
qs.why: 原文：Anna does not have any cash today, so she pays by credit card. 她用信用卡付。
wn: 文中說她 does not have any cash，沒有現金。
文中說 she pays by credit card，她有付錢。

qs.q: What does the man give Anna?
qs.why: 原文：The man gives her a big bag for the food. 老闆給她一個大袋子裝東西。
wn: 文中老闆給的是 a big bag，不是錢。
文中沒有提到茶，給的是 a big bag。

reading.title: 短文 3
reading.text: Ben wants a new jacket. He goes to a shop in the city. He sees a black jacket and asks, "How much is this jacket?" The woman says, "It is three thousand dollars." Ben says, "That is very expensive." Then he sees a blue jacket. It is only eight hundred dollars. It is cheap and it is nice. Ben would like the blue one. He has some cash in his bag, so he pays with cash. He does not need any credit cards today. Ben is very happy with his new blue jacket.

qs.q: What does Ben want?
qs.why: 原文第一句：Ben wants a new jacket. Ben 想要一件新外套。
wn: 文中是 a new jacket，沒有提到手機。
文中是 a new jacket，沒有提到麵包。

qs.q: How much is the black jacket?
qs.why: 原文：It is three thousand dollars. 黑色外套三千元。
wn: 八百元是藍色外套的價錢，不是黑色的。
文中沒有八十元，黑色外套是 three thousand。

qs.q: Which jacket does Ben buy?
qs.why: 原文：Ben would like the blue one. 黑色太貴，他買藍色那件。
wn: 黑色外套 very expensive，他沒買。
文中沒有紅色外套，他買的是 the blue one。

qs.q: How does Ben pay?
qs.why: 原文：He has some cash in his bag, so he pays with cash. 他用現金付。
wn: 文中說 He does not need any credit cards today，沒用信用卡。
文中是 pays with cash，沒有特別提到硬幣。

qs.q: How does Ben feel?
qs.why: 原文：Ben is very happy with his new blue jacket. Ben 很開心。
wn: 文中說 very happy，不是難過。
文中說 very happy，沒有說他累。

reading.title: 短文 4
reading.text: It is Saturday morning. Lisa and her brother go to the supermarket. Lisa has a list. She needs some rice, some eggs and some tea. Her brother asks, "How many eggs do we need?" Lisa says, "Ten, please." They do not need any sugar because they have some at home. The rice is not expensive today. Lisa says, "It is very cheap. I would like two bags." At the counter, they pay two hundred dollars. They walk home with two big bags of food.

qs.q: What day is it?
qs.why: 原文第一句：It is Saturday morning. 今天是星期六。
wn: 文中是 Saturday 星期六，不是星期日。
文中是 Saturday 星期六，不是星期一。

qs.q: Who goes with Lisa?
qs.why: 原文：Lisa and her brother go to the supermarket. 和 Lisa 一起去的是她弟弟或哥哥。
wn: 文中是 her brother，沒有提到媽媽。
文中是 her brother，不是朋友。

qs.q: How many eggs do they need?
qs.why: 原文：How many eggs do we need? / Ten, please. 他們要十顆蛋。
wn: two 是米的袋數（two bags），蛋是 ten。
Lisa 回答 Ten，不是十二顆。

qs.q: Why don't they buy sugar?
qs.why: 原文：They do not need any sugar because they have some at home. 家裡還有糖。
wn: 文中沒說糖貴，because 後面是 they have some at home。
他們在超市買東西，店有開；原因是家裡有糖。

qs.q: How much do they pay?
qs.why: 原文：At the counter, they pay two hundred dollars. 他們付了兩百元。
wn: 文中是 two hundred 兩百，不是 thousand 兩千。
文中是 two hundred 兩百，不是二十。

wallet＝錢包。例句：He has a wallet.
元／美金＝dollar。例句：This shirt is ten dollars.

mc.q: We use 'some' in ___.
mc.why: some 用在肯定句（I have some tea.）和提議句（Would you like some tea?）。
wn: 否定句用 any：I don't have any tea.
一般問句多用 any；some 不是只用在問句。

mc.q: We use 'any' in ___ sentences.
mc.why: any 用在否定句（I don't have any.）和問句（Do you have any?）。
wn: 肯定句一般用 some，不用 any。
提議、請客習慣用 some，不是 any。

wn: any 用在否定句和問句，這句是肯定句。
many 配可數複數，tea 不可數。

mc.q: Do you have ___ tea?

問有沒有，用 any；much 是問多不多。

mc.q: ___ you like some coffee?
mc.why: 禮貌提議、詢問要不要，用 Would you like…?
wn: Do you like 是問喜不喜歡，不是請對方喝。
Are you like 不是英文，like 是動詞不配 are。

mc.q: I don't have ___ money.
mc.why: don't have 是否定句，money 錢不可數，用 any money。
wn: 否定句用 any，不用 some。
money 不可數，前面不加 a。

mc.q: How ___ water do you want?
mc.why: water 不可數，問量用 How much。
wn: many 接可數複數，water 不可數。

mc.q: Would you like ___ bread?
mc.why: Would you like…? 是提議、請對方吃東西，用 some；bread 不可數。
wn: 提議、請客的問句習慣用 some。
much 多用在否定句和問多少，請人吃東西用 some。

mc.q: I would like ___ soup, please.
mc.why: soup 不可數，肯定的點餐說一些用 some：some soup。

many 接可數複數，soup 不可數。

mc.q: Do you want ___ noodles?
mc.why: Do you want…? 是問句，noodles 是複數，問句用 any。
wn: much 接不可數，noodles 可以數。
noodles 是複數，不能放 a。

mc.q: Would you like ___ orange juice?
mc.why: orange juice 是果汁，不可數；提議 Would you like…? 用 some。
wn: 這裡是 juice 果汁，不可數，不是一顆 orange。
many 接可數複數，juice 不可數。

mc.q: We don't have ___ eggs in the fridge.

wn: some 用在肯定句；這句有 don't。
much 接不可數，eggs 可以數。

mc.q: She would like ___ bottle of water.

wn: any 用在否定或問句，這句是肯定的。

mc.q: There is ___ rice on the table.

wn: any 用在否定或問句，這句是肯定的。
many 接可數複數，rice 不可數。

mc.q: Is there ___ tea in the pot?
mc.why: Is there…? 是問句，用 any；tea 不可數。
wn: tea 不可數，不能說 a tea in the pot。
many 配可數複數，tea 不可數。

mc.q: I would like ___ eat now.

would like 後面接 to＋動詞，不接 of。

wn: some 用在肯定句；這句有 doesn't。
sugar 不可數，不能說 a sugar。

wn: some 用在肯定句；這句有 aren't。

many 接可數複數，help 不可數。

any 用在否定或問句，這句是肯定的。

ice 不可數，不能說 a ice。

many 接可數複數，coffee 不可數。

wn: some 用在肯定句；這句有 don't。
many 接可數複數，time 在這裡不可數。

many 接可數複數，tea 不可數。

much 接不可數，menus 可以數。

translate.why: 湯不可數，說 some soup，不加 a 也不加 s；想要用 would like。

a: Would you like a cup of tea?
translate.why: 問對方要不要，用 Would you like…？；一杯茶 a cup of tea，茶要用 cup 來數。

a: We don't have any bread at home.
translate.why: 否定句的任何用 any：don't have any bread；麵包不可數，不加 s；在家裡 at home。

a: Are there any eggs in the fridge?
translate.why: 問有沒有蛋（可數、不確定幾顆），用 Are there any eggs…？；在冰箱裡 in the fridge。

a: There is some rice in the bowl.
translate.why: 飯 rice 不可數，用 There is some rice（is，不加 s）；在碗裡 in the bowl。

a: She would like a bottle of water.
She'd like a bottle of water.
translate.why: 想要用 would like（She'd like），like 不加 s；一瓶水 a bottle of water。

a: I would like to order now.
translate.why: 想要做某事用 would like to＋原形動詞：would like to order。
主詞 He 是一個人，否定用 doesn't want，want 不加 s；任何用 any。

a: Would you like some more rice?
Do you want some more rice?
translate.why: 再來一些是 some more；請對方吃的問句用 some；rice 不可數，不加 s。

a: Can I have some water, please?
translate.why: 請求要東西用 Can I have…?；請求的問句裡用 some，不用 any，please 放句尾。

a: Is there any fish on the menu?
translate.why: 魚當食物不可數，問句用 Is there any fish…？；在菜單上用 on the menu。

translate.zh: 服務生給我們一些冰水。
a: The waiter gives us some cold water.
The waiter gives us some ice water.
The waiter gives us some iced water.
translate.why: 主詞 The waiter 是一個人，現在式 give 加 s；給我們用 gives us，不是 we。

translate.zh: 我不需要任何幫忙，謝謝。
a: I don't need any help, thank you.
translate.why: 否定句的任何用 any：don't need any help；幫忙 help 不可數，不加 a。

a: My mother would like a slice of cake.
My mother would like a piece of cake.
translate.why: 蛋糕切成一片要用 a slice of 或 a piece of cake；想要用 would like，mother 後面不加 s。

a: Do you have any small plates?
translate.why: 問店家有沒有用 Do you have any…?；plates 可以數，要用複數。

a: There are some menus on the table.
translate.why: menus 是複數，用 There are；肯定句的一些用 some，地點 on the table 放後面。

a: I would like two bottles of juice.
I'd like two bottles of juice.
translate.why: 果汁不可數，用瓶子來數：two bottles of juice，要加 s 的是 bottle，不是 juice。

translate.zh: 我們不要飲料裡有冰塊。
a: We don't want any ice in our drinks.
translate.why: 不要用 don't want，否定句的任何用 any；ice 冰塊不可數，不加 s。

a: Would you like some tea or some coffee?
Would you like tea or coffee?
translate.why: 問對方要哪個，用 Would you like A or B？；茶、咖啡不可數，前面不加 a。

a: He would like a big bowl of noodles.
He'd like a big bowl of noodles.
translate.why: 一大碗麵 a big bowl of noodles，big 放 bowl 前；麵是 noodles，要加 s。

error.why: noodles 通常用複數。
error.full: They would like some noodles.

error.s: I would like two bottle of juice.
error.why: two 後面名詞要用複數 bottles。
error.full: I would like two bottles of juice.

error.s: Do you have some small plates?
error.why: 一般疑問句用 any。
error.full: Do you have any small plates?

error.s: There are some rice on the table.
error.why: rice 不可數，動詞用 is。
error.full: There is some rice on the table.

reorder.a: I would like some soup.
reorder.why: 湯不可數，說 some soup，不加 a 也不加 s；想要用 would like。

reorder.a: Would you like a cup of tea?
reorder.why: 問對方要不要，用 Would you like…？；一杯茶 a cup of tea，茶要用 cup 來數。

reorder.a: We don't have any bread at home.
reorder.why: 否定句的任何用 any：don't have any bread；麵包不可數，不加 s；在家裡 at home。

reorder.a: Are there any eggs in the fridge?
reorder.why: 問有沒有蛋（可數、不確定幾顆），用 Are there any eggs…？；在冰箱裡 in the fridge。

reorder.a: There is some rice in the bowl.
reorder.why: 飯 rice 不可數，用 There is some rice（is，不加 s）；在碗裡 in the bowl。

reorder.a: She would like a bottle of water.
reorder.why: 想要用 would like（She'd like），like 不加 s；一瓶水 a bottle of water。

reorder.a: I would like to order now.
reorder.why: 想要做某事用 would like to＋原形動詞：would like to order。

reorder.a: He doesn't want any sugar.
reorder.why: 主詞 He 是一個人，否定用 doesn't want，want 不加 s；任何用 any。

reorder.a: Would you like some more rice?
reorder.why: 再來一些是 some more；請對方吃的問句用 some；rice 不可數，不加 s。

reorder.a: Can I have some water, please?
reorder.why: 請求要東西用 Can I have…?；請求的問句裡用 some，不用 any，please 放句尾。

reorder.a: Is there any fish on the menu?
reorder.why: 魚當食物不可數，問句用 Is there any fish…？；在菜單上用 on the menu。

reorder.a: The waiter gives us some cold water.
reorder.why: 主詞 The waiter 是一個人，現在式 give 加 s；給我們用 gives us，不是 we。

reorder.a: I don't need any help, thank you.
reorder.why: 否定句的任何用 any：don't need any help；幫忙 help 不可數，不加 a。

reorder.a: My mother would like a slice of cake.
reorder.why: 蛋糕切成一片要用 a slice of 或 a piece of cake；想要用 would like，mother 後面不加 s。

reorder.a: Do you have any small plates?
reorder.why: 問店家有沒有用 Do you have any…?；plates 可以數，要用複數。

reading.title: 短文 1
reading.text: At home, my mother asks, 'Would you like some tea?' I say, 'Yes, please. I would like a cup of tea.' She asks, 'Would you like some bread too?' I say, 'Yes, I would like a piece of bread.' Then I ask, 'Do we have any milk?' She says, 'No, we don't have any milk today.' I ask, 'Do we have any juice?' She says, 'Yes, we have some juice in the fridge.' I say, 'I would like a glass of juice, please.' My mother says, 'Here you are.'

qs.q: What does the speaker want to drink first?
qs.why: 原文：Would you like some tea? / Yes, please. I would like a cup of tea. 先要喝的是茶。
wn: 文中沒有提到咖啡，媽媽先問的是 tea。
果汁是最後才要的，一開始喝的是 tea。

qs.q: What does the speaker want to eat?
qs.why: 原文：I would like a piece of bread. 作者想吃一片麵包。
wn: 文中沒有提到湯，要吃的是 a piece of bread。
文中是 a piece of bread 一片麵包，不是三明治。

qs.q: Do they have any milk today?
qs.why: 原文：No, we don't have any milk today. 今天沒有牛奶，所以答 No。
wn: 媽媽說 we don't have any milk，沒有牛奶。
don't have any 是一點都沒有，不是 a little 一點點。

qs.q: Do they have any juice?
qs.why: 原文：Yes, we have some juice in the fridge. 冰箱裡有果汁。
wn: 沒有的是牛奶；果汁媽媽說 Yes, we have some。
文中只說 some juice，沒說只剩一點點。

qs.q: What does the speaker want at the end?
qs.why: 原文：I would like a glass of juice, please. 最後作者要一杯果汁。
wn: 茶是一開始要的，最後要的是 a glass of juice。
文中沒有提到水，最後要的是 juice。

reading.title: 短文 2
reading.text: Mia and Tom are in a small restaurant. The waiter gives them a menu and some cold water. Tom would like some noodles and some hot tea. Mia does not want any noodles. She would like some rice and some chicken. The waiter asks, "Would you like any soup?" Mia says, "Yes, please. I would like some soup." Tom does not want any soup. He is not very hungry today. The food is good and it is not expensive. After lunch, they pay and say thank you to the waiter.

qs.q: Where are Mia and Tom?
qs.why: 原文第一句：Mia and Tom are in a small restaurant. 他們在餐廳裡。
wn: 文中是 a small restaurant 餐廳，不是商店。
文中是 a small restaurant，不是學校。

qs.q: What does Tom want?
qs.why: 原文：Tom would like some noodles and some hot tea. Tom 要麵和熱茶。
wn: 飯和湯是 Mia 要的，Tom 不要湯。
文中沒有提到蛋糕，Tom 要 noodles and tea。

qs.q: Who would like some soup?
qs.why: 原文：Mia says, Yes, please. I would like some soup. 要湯的是 Mia。
wn: 文中說 Tom does not want any soup，Tom 不要湯。
服務生是問問題的人（Would you like any soup?），不是他要喝。

qs.q: What does the waiter bring first?
qs.why: 原文：The waiter gives them a menu and some cold water. 一開始服務生先給菜單和冰水。
wn: 麵是 Tom 後來點的，不是服務生最先拿來的。
帳單是吃完午餐才付的，不是一開始。

qs.q: Is the food expensive?
qs.why: 原文：The food is good and it is not expensive. 食物不貴，所以答 No, it is not.
wn: 文中說 it is not expensive，不貴。
文中有說：it is not expensive。

reading.title: 短文 3
reading.text: It is Sunday morning. Emma makes breakfast for her family. She has some bread, some eggs and some milk. She does not have any cheese, so she goes to the small shop near her home. She buys some cheese and a bottle of orange juice. At home, her son asks, "Can I have some juice, please?" Emma says, "Yes, of course." Her husband would like a cup of coffee. He does not want any sugar in it. They all eat together and talk about their day.

qs.q: What day is it?
qs.why: 原文第一句：It is Sunday morning. 今天是星期日。
wn: 文中是 Sunday 星期日，不是星期六。
文中是 Sunday 星期日，不是星期五。

qs.q: What does Emma not have at home?
qs.why: 原文：She does not have any cheese, so she goes to the small shop. 家裡沒有的是起司。
wn: 文中說 She has some bread, some eggs，蛋家裡有。
文中說 She has some bread，麵包家裡有。

qs.q: What does Emma buy?
qs.why: 原文：She buys some cheese and a bottle of orange juice. 她買了起司和一瓶柳橙汁。
wn: 牛奶和蛋家裡本來就有（She has），不用買。
文中沒有提到茶和蛋糕，她買的是 cheese 和 orange juice。

qs.q: What does her son ask for?
qs.why: 原文：Her son asks, Can I have some juice, please? 兒子要的是果汁。
wn: 要咖啡的是她先生 husband，不是兒子。
兒子問的是 Can I have some juice，不是麵包。

qs.q: What does her husband want in his coffee?
qs.why: 原文：He does not want any sugar in it. 先生的咖啡不要加糖。
wn: 文中說 does not want any sugar，他不要糖。
文中沒有說要加牛奶，只說不要糖。

reading.title: 短文 4
reading.text: Leo works in a coffee shop. He asks every customer, "Would you like some coffee or some tea?" Today a woman comes in. She would like a big cup of black coffee. She does not want any milk. A man wants some hot tea and two slices of cake. Leo says, "I am sorry, we don't have any cake today." The man is not happy, but he takes some bread. Leo gives him a glass of water too. The shop is busy, but Leo likes his work.

qs.q: Where does Leo work?
qs.why: 原文第一句：Leo works in a coffee shop. Leo 在咖啡店工作。
wn: 文中是 a coffee shop 咖啡店，不是餐廳。
文中是 a coffee shop，不是超市。

qs.q: What does the woman want?
qs.why: 原文：She would like a big cup of black coffee. 那位女士要黑咖啡。
wn: 熱茶是那位男士 a man 要的，不是女士。
蛋糕是男士想要的，而且店裡今天沒有。

qs.q: Does the shop have any cake today?
qs.why: 原文：I am sorry, we don't have any cake today. 今天店裡沒有蛋糕。
wn: Leo 說 we don't have any cake today，沒有蛋糕。
don't have any 是一片都沒有。two slices 是男士想點的數量。

qs.q: What does the man take?
qs.why: 原文：The man is not happy, but he takes some bread. 沒有蛋糕，男士改拿麵包。
wn: 店裡今天沒有蛋糕（don't have any cake），他拿不到。
文中沒有提到飯，他拿的是 some bread。

qs.q: How does Leo feel about his work?
qs.why: 原文：The shop is busy, but Leo likes his work. Leo 喜歡他的工作。
wn: 文中說 Leo likes his work，不是討厭。
文中只說店很忙，沒說他厭倦；他是 likes his work。

vocab_review.why: bank＝銀行。例句：There is a bank near the station.
醫院＝hospital。例句：He works in a hospital.
station＝車站。例句：There is a station in the city.
郵局＝post office。例句：There is a post office next to the bank.
wn: any 是「一些（用於否定句/疑問句）」

vocab_review.why: cinema＝電影院。例句：There is a cinema near the restaurant.
wn: 「一些蘋果（疑問/否定）」是 any apples

vocab_review.why: 飯店＝hotel。例句：There is a hotel between the park and the museum.
police station＝警察局。例句：There is a police station near the school.
街道＝street。例句：I live on Zhongshan Street.
go straight＝直走。例句：Go straight to the station.
紅綠燈＝traffic light。例句：There is a traffic light near the school.
block＝街區。例句：The bank is one block from here.
橋＝bridge。例句：There is a bridge over the river.
direction＝方向。例句：This is the wrong direction.
對面＝opposite。例句：The bank is opposite the school.
in＝在...裡面。例句：There is a cat in the box.
在...旁邊＝next to。例句：There is a lamp next to the bed.
behind＝在...後面。例句：There is a garden behind the house.
在...下方＝below。例句：There is a bag below the table.
across from＝在...對面。例句：The bank is across from the school.
在...上方(跨越)＝over。例句：There is a bridge over the river.
wn: a cup of tea 是「一杯茶」

vocab_review.why: at＝在(某點)。例句：There is a man at the door.
公寓＝apartment。例句：They have a small apartment.
furniture＝家具。例句：There isn't much furniture in my room.
臥室＝bedroom。例句：There is a bed in the bedroom.
wn: a glass of 是「一杯（玻璃杯）」

vocab_review.why: quiet＝安靜的。例句：The classroom is quiet.
方便的＝convenient。例句：My neighborhood is convenient for shopping.
wn: some 是「一些（用於肯定句/邀請）」

vocab_review.why: bread＝麵包。例句：I would like some bread.
水＝water。例句：I would like some water, please.

a cup of tea 是「一杯茶」

vocab_review.why: egg＝蛋。例句：How many eggs do you need?
起司＝cheese。例句：I would like some cheese, please.

vocab_review.why: salt＝鹽。例句：There isn't any salt in the soup.

vocab_review.why: 雞肉＝chicken。例句：Would you like some chicken?
wn: cross the street 是「過馬路」

vocab_review.why: cake＝蛋糕。例句：I would like a piece of cake.
蘋果＝apple。例句：I would like an apple.
grape＝葡萄。例句：I would like some grapes.
wn: 「一杯茶」是 a cup of tea

vocab_review.why: 馬鈴薯＝potato。例句：I would like some potatoes.
vegetable＝蔬菜。例句：I would like some vegetables.
檸檬＝lemon。例句：Do you have any lemons?
cabbage＝高麗菜。例句：I don't want any cabbage.
蘑菇＝mushroom。例句：Are there any mushrooms in the soup?
waiter＝服務生（男）。例句：The waiter brings some water.
座位＝seat。例句：Is there any seat by the window?
wn: much 是「多少（不可數疑問）」
a piece of 是「一片／一塊」

vocab_review.why: spoon＝湯匙。例句：Can I have a spoon, please?
wn: 「一杯茶」是 a cup of tea

vocab_review.why: 盤子＝plate。例句：Can I have a clean plate?
reservation＝訂位。例句：We have a reservation for two.
wn: 「一些咖啡（疑問/否定）」是 any coffee

vocab_review.why: 飲品＝beverage。例句：What beverage would you like?
how much＝多少錢。例句：How much is this shirt?
付錢＝pay。例句：How do you want to pay?
price＝價錢。例句：What is the price of this bag?

sale＝特賣。例句：This shop has a big sale.

vocab_review.q: 一些（用於否定句/疑問句）
vocab_review.why: 一些（用於否定句/疑問句）＝any。例句：Do you have any tea?
I'd like＝我想要。例句：I'd like some water, please.
多少（不可數疑問）＝much。例句：How much water do you want?

vocab_review.why: a bottle of＝一瓶。例句：Can I have a bottle of water?

mc.q: ___ me, how much is this apple?
mc.why: 跟陌生人搭話、引起注意，固定說 Excuse me。
wn: Sorry for 是為某件事道歉，後面要接事情，不是用來搭話。
英文沒有 Please for me 這種說法。

mc.q: I would like ___ buy some fruit.
mc.why: would like 後面接動作要用 to + 原形動詞：would like to buy。
wn: would like 後面不接 for + 動詞。
would like 後面不接 of；接動作要用 to。

mc.q: Do you have ___ apples today?
mc.why: Do you have…? 是問句，apples 是複數，問句用 any。
wn: 一般問句多用 any，不用 some。
much 接不可數，apples 可以數。

mc.q: Do you have apples? Yes, we ___. They are fresh.
mc.why: 回答 Do you…? 的問句，主詞 we，簡答用 do：Yes, we do.
wn: does 配 he／she／it；主詞是 we。
這是回答 Do you have…? 一類問句，要用 do。

mc.q: How ___ is this bag?
mc.why: 問價錢固定說 How much is…?：How much is this bag?
wn: How many 問數量，不能問價錢。
How price 不是英文；可說 What is the price?

mc.q: ___ or card?
mc.why: 結帳時問付現還是刷卡，固定說 Cash or card?
wn: money 是錢的總稱，付款方式的付現要說 cash。
coin 是硬幣，不是付款方式的說法。

mc.q: That's expensive! Do you have a ___ one?
mc.why: 前面說太貴，想要比較便宜的，用比較級 cheaper：a cheaper one。
wn: cheap 是短的字，比較級直接加 er，不說 more cheap。
cheapest 是最便宜，前面要用 the，不用 a。

mc.q: I would like ___ some rice.
mc.why: would like 後面接 to＋動詞原形：would like to buy。
wn: would like 後面要先有 to，不能直接接 buy。
would like 後面接 to＋原形，不接 -ing。

mc.q: ___ we don't have any milk today.
mc.why: 回答不要、沒有，開頭用 No：No, we don't have any milk today.
wn: Not 不能單獨放句首當回答，要用 No。
None 是一個都沒有，不放在句子前面當回答。

mc.q: Thank you, have a nice ___!
mc.why: 道別的固定說法：Have a nice day!，前面有 a，用單數 day。
wn: 前面有 a，只能接單數 day。
daily 是形容詞（每天的），a nice 後面要接名詞。

mc.q: Customer: ___ much is this bag? Clerk: Six hundred dollars.
mc.why: 空格後是 much，店員回答價錢，問價錢用 How much。
wn: What much 不是英文；問價錢說 How much。
Who 問人是誰，不是問價錢。

mc.q: Clerk: How ___ apples would you like? Customer: Five, please.
mc.why: apples 可以數，客人回答 Five 也是數量，問幾顆用 How many。
wn: How much 接不可數，apples 可以數。
How long 問時間或長度，不是數量。

mc.q: Waiter: Would you like ___ soup? Customer: Yes, please.
mc.why: 服務生提議，客人回答 Yes, please，提議時用 some：some soup。
wn: soup 一般當不可數，要一碗說 a bowl of soup。
many 配可數複數，soup 不可數。

mc.q: Customer: Do you have ___ big sizes? Clerk: Yes, we do.
mc.why: Do you have…? 是問句，sizes 是複數，用 any。
wn: much 配不可數，sizes 可以數。
a 只配單數，sizes 是複數。

mc.q: Clerk: Here is your ___. Customer: Thank you.
mc.why: 店員找錢給客人，找的零錢叫 change：Here is your change.
wn: cheap 是形容詞便宜的，不能放在 your 後面當東西。
size 是尺寸，找錢時不會說 Here is your size。

mc.q: Customer: I would like ___ pay by card.
mc.why: would like 後面接動作要用 to + 原形動詞：would like to pay。
wn: would like 後面不接 for + 動詞。
the 接名詞，後面 pay 是動詞。

mc.q: Clerk: How much rice ___ you need?
mc.why: 問句主詞是 you，後面 need 是一般動詞，助動詞用 do：do you need?
wn: does 配 he／she／it；主詞是 you。
need 是一般動詞，問句用 do，不用 are。

mc.q: Customer: I don't have ___ cash today.
mc.why: don't have 是否定句，用 any；cash 現金不可數。
wn: 否定句用 any，不用 some。
many 配可數複數，cash 不可數。

mc.q: Waiter: ___ you like a table for two?
mc.why: 禮貌提議、詢問要不要，用 Would you like…?
wn: Are you like 不是英文，like 是動詞不配 are。
Do you like 是問喜不喜歡，不是問要不要。

mc.q: Customer: How much ___ these two shirts?
mc.why: 問價錢 How much + be 動詞；these two shirts 是複數，用 are。
wn: is 配單數；two shirts 是複數。
How much 問價錢後面接 be 動詞，不用 do。

mc.q: Clerk: We don't have ___ small bags today.
mc.why: don't 是否定句，bags 是複數，否定句用 any。
wn: some 用在肯定句；這句有 don't。
much 接不可數，bags 可以數。

mc.q: Customer: I would like two ___ of apples, please.
mc.why: two 是兩公斤，單位 kilo 也要加 s：two kilos。
wn: two 是兩個單位，kilo 要加 s。
kilogram 也是單數，兩公斤要說 kilograms。

mc.q: Waiter: Would you like ___ receipt?
mc.why: receipt 是一張收據，可數單數，前面加 a。
wn: receipt 是單數可數名詞，前面用 a。
receipt 是單數可數名詞，前面用 a。

mc.q: Customer: Is there ___ milk in this coffee?
mc.why: Is there…? 是問句，milk 不可數，問句用 any。
wn: milk 不可數，不能說 a milk。
many 接可數複數，milk 不可數。

mc.q: Clerk: How ___ bottles of water do you want?
mc.why: bottles 是複數、可以一瓶一瓶數，問數量用 How many。
wn: How much 問不可數的量；bottles 可以一瓶瓶數。
How long 問時間或長度多久，不是問數量。

mc.q: Customer: There isn't ___ sugar on the table.
mc.why: isn't 是否定句，sugar 不可數，否定句用 any。
wn: some 用在肯定句；這句是 isn't 否定。
many 接可數複數，sugar 不可數。

mc.q: Waiter: We have ___ good fish today.
mc.why: fish 當食物不可數，肯定句說有一些用 some：some good fish。
wn: fish 當食物是不可數，不說 a good fish。
many 接可數複數；這裡 fish 是食物，不可數。

mc.q: Customer: How much ___ do I need?
mc.why: money 不可數，問多少錢用 How much money。
wn: money 一般不加複數，說 money 就好。
coins 可數複數，要用 How many。

mc.q: Clerk: Would you like ___ bigger size?
mc.why: size 可數單數，bigger 開頭 b 是子音，用 a：a bigger size。
wn: some 不接單數 size；一個尺寸用 a。
提議 Would you like…? 不用 any，而且 size 是單數。

mc.q: Customer: My friend would like ___ tea, please.
mc.why: tea 不可數，肯定的點餐說一些用 some：some tea。
wn: an 用在母音開頭的字前面，tea 是 t 開頭。
many 接可數複數，tea 不可數。

mc.q: Waiter: Do you want ___ ice in your drink?
mc.why: Do you want…? 是問句，ice 不可數，問句用 any。
wn: ice 不可數，不能說 a ice。
many 接可數複數，ice 不可數。

mc.q: Clerk: How ___ cheese do you want?
mc.why: cheese 不可數，問量用 How much。
wn: many 接可數複數，cheese 不可數。
How old 問年紀，不是問量。

mc.q: Clerk: There are ___ cheap shoes over there.
mc.why: There are 是肯定句，shoes 是複數，肯定句用 some。
wn: any 用在否定或問句，這句是肯定的。
much 接不可數，shoes 可以數。

mc.q: Customer: I would like ___ see the menu, please.
mc.why: would like 後面接動作要用 to + 原形動詞：would like to see。
wn: would like 後面不接 for + 動詞。
a 接名詞，後面 see 是動詞。

mc.q: Waiter: How ___ people are in your group?
mc.why: people 是複數、可以數，問幾個人用 How many。
wn: How much 接不可數，people 可以數。
How long 問時間或長度，不是人數。

mc.q: Customer: We don't want ___ soup, thank you.
mc.why: don't want 是否定句，用 any：We don't want any soup。
wn: some 多用在肯定句；否定句用 any。
soup 這裡當不可數，前面不加 a。

mc.q: Clerk: This shirt is only 200 dollars. It is very ___.
mc.why: only 200 dollars 表示價錢低，用 cheap（便宜的）。
wn: expensive 是貴，和 only 200 dollars 不合。
many 表示數量多，不能形容價錢。

mc.q: Customer: That watch is 50,000 dollars. It is too ___.
mc.why: 50,000 dollars 買手錶很貴，too 表示太過頭，用 expensive。
wn: cheap 是便宜，和五萬元的價錢不合。
little 是小或少，不能說價錢太貴。

mc.q: Waiter: Would you like ___ apple juice?
mc.why: apple juice 是果汁，不可數；提議 Would you like…? 用 some。
wn: 這裡是 juice 果汁，不可數，不是一顆 apple。
many 接可數複數，juice 不可數。

mc.q: Customer: Do you have ___ hot water?
mc.why: Do you have…? 是問句，問有沒有東西用 any；water 不可數。
wn: water 不可數，不能說 a water。
many 只配可數名詞複數（many cups），water 不可數。

mc.q: Clerk: How much ___ this jacket cost?
mc.why: 後面有動詞 cost，主詞 this jacket 是單數，問句用 does。
wn: do 配複數或 I／you；this jacket 是一件。
後面有一般動詞 cost，問句用 does，不用 is。

mc.q: Customer: I have ___ coins, but not many.
mc.why: 肯定句，coins 是複數，說有一些用 some（後面 not many 也提示可數）。
wn: any 用在否定或問句，這句是肯定的。
much 接不可數，coins 可以數。

mc.q: Waiter: There aren't ___ tables now. Please wait.
mc.why: aren't 是否定句，tables 是複數，用 any：現在沒有空桌。
wn: 否定句用 any，不用 some。
much 配不可數，tables 可以數。

mc.q: Customer: I would like a ___ of bread, please.
mc.why: 麵包常用 a slice of bread（一片麵包）來數，是點餐、買麵包的常用說法。
wn: a cup of 用在飲料，像 a cup of tea，不用在麵包。
a bottle of 是一瓶，用在飲料，麵包不裝在瓶子裡。

mc.q: Clerk: How many ___ would you like?
mc.why: How many 後面要接可數複數名詞：eggs。
wn: rice 不可數，要用 How much。
water 不可數，要用 How much。

mc.q: Customer: Can I have ___ bottle of milk?
mc.why: bottle 可數單數，一瓶要加 a：a bottle of milk。
wn: bottle 是單數，前面用 a。
bottle 是單數可數名詞，前面用 a。

mc.q: Waiter: Would you like ___ more rice?
mc.why: rice 不可數，提議再來一點用 some more rice。
wn: rice 不可數，不能說 a rice。
many 接可數複數，rice 不可數。

mc.q: Customer: How much ___ is in the bottle?
mc.why: How much 後面接不可數名詞；juice 不可數，用 juice。
wn: juice 一般不加 s，How much 接不可數。
bottles 可數，要用 How many；而且問的是瓶裡裝多少。

mc.q: Clerk: We have ___ new hats in a small size.
mc.why: 店員說有貨，是肯定句，用 some：We have some new hats。
wn: any 多用在否定句和問句，這是肯定句。
much 配不可數，hats 是可數複數。

mc.q: Customer: I don't need ___ bag, thank you.
mc.why: bag 可數單數，一個袋子要加 a；否定句也可以說 a bag。
wn: bag 是單數可數名詞，前面用 a。
much 配不可數名詞，bag 可數。

a: How much does this jacket cost?
How much does this coat cost?
translate.why: 問價錢用 How much is…?；這件外套是一件，用 this jacket＋is。

a: How many eggs would you like?
How many eggs do you want?
translate.why: eggs 可以數，問幾顆用 How many＋複數；客氣問法是 would you like。
請對方吃東西的問句，some 不改成 any：Would you like some soup？

a: Do you have any big sizes?
Do you have any large sizes?
Do you have a large size?
translate.why: 問店家有沒有用 Do you have any…?；sizes 要用複數，問句裡用 any。
找零的錢英文叫 change；把東西遞給對方時說 Here is your…。

a: I would like to pay by credit card.
I'd like to pay by credit card.
I want to pay by credit card.
I would like to pay with a credit card.
I'd like to pay with a credit card.
I want to pay with a credit card.
translate.why: 想要做某事用 would like to＋原形；用信用卡付錢是 pay by credit card，不用 the。

a: I don't have any cash with me.
I have no cash with me.
I don't have any cash on me.
I have no cash on me.
I don't have cash with me.
translate.why: 否定句用 don't have any cash；身上帶著的說法是 with me，放句尾。

a: Would you like a table for two?
translate.why: 問對方要不要，用 Would you like + 名詞？；兩人的桌子 a table for two。

a: How much are these two shirts?
translate.why: 兩件襯衫是複數，用 How much are…?，這些用 these，不是 this。

a: I would like two kilos of apples.
I'd like two kilos of apples.
I want two kilos of apples.
I would like two kilograms of apples.
I want two kilograms of apples.
translate.why: 想要用 would like（I'd like）；兩公斤是 two kilos，of 後面的 apples 要加 s。
客氣問對方要不要用 Would you like…?；收據是一張，要加 a：a receipt。

a: Is there any milk in the coffee?
translate.why: milk 不可數，問有沒有用 Is there any…?；咖啡裡是 in the coffee。

a: There isn't any sugar on the table.
There is no sugar on the table.
translate.why: sugar 不可數，否定用 There isn't any sugar，不是 There aren't。

a: How much money do I pay?
translate.why: 問要付多少錢用 How much；後面接 do I pay，money 可以省略。

a: How much cheese do you want?
How much cheese would you like?
translate.why: 起司不可數，問多少用 How much，不用 How many；cheese 不加 s。

translate.zh: 那邊有一些便宜的鞋子。
a: There are some cheap shoes over there.
translate.why: 鞋子是複數 shoes，用 There are some；便宜的 cheap 放 shoes 前；那邊 over there 放句尾。

a: Can I see the menu, please?
translate.why: 客氣請求用 Can I + 原形動詞？；看菜單 see the menu，句尾加 please 更有禮貌。

a: How many people are in your group?
How many of you are there?
How many people are there in your group?
translate.why: 人可以數，問幾個用 How many people；餐廳問人數常說 How many people are in your group？
這件 this shirt；一件用 is；便宜是形容詞 cheap，放 is 後面。

a: I would like some more rice.
translate.why: 再一些是 some more，放在名詞前：some more rice；rice 不可數，不加 s。

reorder.why: 否定句用 don't have any cash；身上帶著的說法是 with me，放句尾。

reorder.a: Would you like a table for two?
reorder.why: 問對方要不要，用 Would you like + 名詞？；兩人的桌子 a table for two。

reorder.a: How much are these two shirts?
reorder.why: 兩件襯衫是複數，用 How much are…?，這些用 these，不是 this。

reorder.a: I would like two kilos of apples.
reorder.why: 想要用 would like（I'd like）；兩公斤是 two kilos，of 後面的 apples 要加 s。

reorder.a: Would you like a receipt?
reorder.why: 客氣問對方要不要用 Would you like…?；收據是一張，要加 a：a receipt。

reorder.a: Is there any milk in the coffee?
reorder.why: milk 不可數，問有沒有用 Is there any…?；咖啡裡是 in the coffee。

reorder.a: There isn't any sugar on the table.
reorder.why: sugar 不可數，否定用 There isn't any sugar，不是 There aren't。

reorder.a: How much money do I pay?
reorder.why: 問要付多少錢用 How much；後面接 do I pay，money 可以省略。

reorder.a: How much cheese do you want?
reorder.why: 起司不可數，問多少用 How much，不用 How many；cheese 不加 s。

reading.title: 短文 1
reading.text: Mrs. Lin goes to the market to buy some food. She says, 'Excuse me, do you have any apples today?' The seller says, 'Yes, we do. They are very fresh.' Mrs. Lin asks, 'How much are they?' The seller says, 'They are two dollars.' Mrs. Lin says, 'That's cheap! I would like to buy five apples, please.' She also asks, 'Do you have any milk?' The seller says, 'No, we don't have any milk today.' Mrs. Lin says, 'That's all, thank you.' She pays with cash and says, 'Keep the change.' The seller says, 'Thank you, have a nice day!'

qs.q: What does Mrs. Lin want to buy first?
qs.why: 原文：Excuse me, do you have any apples today? 林太太第一個問的是蘋果。
wn: 文中沒有提到香蕉，她先問的是 apples。
文中沒有提到麵包，她先問 apples，後來才問 milk。

qs.q: Are the apples fresh?
qs.why: 原文：Yes, we do. They are very fresh. 老闆說蘋果很新鮮。
wn: 老闆說 They are very fresh，很新鮮。
老闆有說：They are very fresh。

qs.q: How much are the apples?
qs.why: 原文：How much are they? / They are two dollars. 蘋果兩元。
wn: 老闆說 two dollars，不是一元。
five 是她要買的蘋果數量（five apples），不是價錢。

qs.q: Does the seller have any milk?
qs.why: 原文：No, we don't have any milk today. 今天沒有牛奶，所以答 No。
wn: 老闆說 we don't have any milk，沒有牛奶。
don't have any 是完全沒有，不是一點點。

qs.q: How does Mrs. Lin pay?
qs.why: 原文：She pays with cash and says, Keep the change. 她付現金，還說零錢不用找。
wn: 文中是 pays with cash，沒有用信用卡。
文中只說 with cash 現金，沒說用一枚硬幣；keep the change 是不用找零。

reading.title: 短文 2
reading.text: Kate is in a clothes shop. She likes a white shirt, but it is too small. She asks the clerk, "Do you have any big sizes?" The clerk says, "Yes, we have some." Kate asks, "How much is this shirt?" It is five hundred dollars. Kate says, "That is not expensive. I would like two, please." She pays one thousand dollars with cash. The clerk gives her the change and a receipt. Kate does not need any bags because she has one in her hand.

qs.q: Where is Kate?
qs.why: 原文第一句：Kate is in a clothes shop. Kate 在服飾店。
wn: 文中是 a clothes shop 服飾店，不是餐廳。
文中是 a clothes shop，她在買襯衫，不是咖啡店。

qs.q: What is the problem with the first shirt?
qs.why: 原文：She likes a white shirt, but it is too small. 第一件襯衫太小。
wn: 文中是 too small 太小，所以她才問有沒有 big sizes。
Kate 說 That is not expensive，不貴。

qs.q: How much is one shirt?
qs.why: 原文：How much is this shirt? It is five hundred dollars. 一件五百元。
wn: 一千元是兩件的總價（I would like two），一件是五百。
文中是 five hundred 五百，不是 fifty 五十。

qs.q: How does Kate pay?
qs.why: 原文：She pays one thousand dollars with cash. 她用現金付款。
wn: 文中是 with cash，不是信用卡。
文中說 She pays one thousand dollars，她有付錢。

qs.q: Why doesn't Kate need a bag?
opts: She has one in her hand
qs.why: 原文：Kate does not need any bags because she has one in her hand. 她手上已經有袋子。
wn: 她有付現金，因為 because 後面是 she has one in her hand。
文中沒說店裡沒袋子，是她自己手上有一個。

reading.title: 短文 3
reading.text: Peter and his wife go out for dinner. The waiter says, "Would you like a table for two?" They say yes. Peter would like some fish and some rice. His wife does not want any fish. She would like some noodles and a bowl of soup. The waiter asks, "Would you like some water or some tea?" They would like some hot tea. The food comes in ten minutes. After dinner, Peter asks, "How much is it?" The waiter says, "Eight hundred dollars." Peter pays and takes the receipt.

qs.q: Who goes out for dinner?
qs.why: 原文第一句：Peter and his wife go out for dinner. Peter 和太太一起去吃晚餐。
wn: 文中是 his wife 太太，不是兒子。
文中是 his wife 太太，不是朋友。

qs.q: What does Peter order?
qs.why: 原文：Peter would like some fish and some rice. Peter 點魚和飯。
wn: 文中沒有提到麵包和起司。

qs.q: What does his wife not want?
qs.why: 原文：His wife does not want any fish. 太太不要的是魚。
wn: 太太有點湯：a bowl of soup。

qs.q: What do they drink?
qs.why: 原文：They would like some hot tea. 他們喝熱茶。
wn: 服務生問 water or tea，他們選的是 hot tea。
文中沒有提到柳橙汁，他們喝 hot tea。

qs.q: How much is the dinner?
qs.why: 原文：How much is it? / Eight hundred dollars. 晚餐八百元。
wn: 文中是 eight hundred 八百，不是 eighty 八十。
文中是 eight hundred 八百，不是 thousand 八千。

reading.title: 短文 4
reading.text: Every Sunday, Grace goes to the market near her house. She takes some cash and a big bag. Today she wants two kilos of apples and some fish. She asks a woman, "How much are the apples?" The woman says, "One hundred dollars for one kilo." Grace says, "That is cheap." She also asks, "Do you have any small fish?" The woman has some. Grace does not buy any rice today, because she has a lot at home. She pays three hundred dollars and walks home with her food.

qs.q: When does Grace go to the market?
qs.why: 原文第一句：Every Sunday, Grace goes to the market. 她每個星期日去市場。
wn: 文中是 Every Sunday，不是星期一。
文中是每個星期日，不是每天。

qs.q: What does Grace take with her?
qs.why: 原文：She takes some cash and a big bag. 她帶了現金和一個大袋子。
wn: 文中說她帶的是 cash 現金，沒有信用卡。
文中是 a big bag 大袋子，不是小盒子。

qs.q: How much is one kilo of apples?
qs.why: 原文：One hundred dollars for one kilo. 一公斤蘋果一百元。
wn: two 是她要買的公斤數（two kilos），一公斤是一百元。
文中是 one hundred dollars，不是十元。

qs.q: What does Grace not buy today?
qs.why: 原文：Grace does not buy any rice today, because she has a lot at home. 今天沒買米。
wn: 她有買魚，攤販有 small fish。
她有買蘋果，要買 two kilos。

qs.q: How much does Grace pay?
qs.why: 原文：She pays three hundred dollars. 她付了三百元。
wn: 文中是 three hundred 三百，不是 thousand 三千。
文中是 three hundred 三百，不是 thirty 三十。

translate.why: 兩件襯衫是複數，用 How much are…?，這些用 these，不是 this。

a: There isn't any sugar on the table.
There is no sugar on the table.
translate.why: sugar 不可數，否定用 There isn't any sugar，不是 There aren't。

a: Can I see the menu, please?
translate.why: 客氣請求用 Can I + 原形動詞？；看菜單 see the menu，句尾加 please 更有禮貌。

error.full: There is some fruit on the table.

error.full: I don't have any cash.

reorder.a: I would like some coffee.
reorder.why: 想要用 would like 比較客氣（I'd like）；coffee 不可數，一些用 some，不加 s。

reorder.a: There is some water in the fridge.
reorder.why: water 不可數，不加 s，用 There is；冰箱是 the fridge，前面用 in。

reorder.a: My mother would like a cup of tea.
reorder.why: 想要用 would like，主詞是誰都不加 s：My mother would like；一杯茶 a cup of tea。

reorder.a: How much milk is in the bottle?
reorder.why: 牛奶不可數，問多少用 How much milk，後面接 is in the bottle 或 is there in the bottle。

reorder.a: How much meat do you eat every week?
reorder.why: 肉不可數，問多少用 How much meat；後面接 do you eat；每個禮拜 every week 放句尾。

reorder.a: I would like some apples.
reorder.why: 蘋果可以數，一些蘋果要用複數 some apples，apple 加 s。

reorder.a: There are some carrots in the bag.
reorder.why: carrots 是複數，用 There are；肯定句的一些用 some，in the bag 放句尾。

reorder.a: My sister would like some juice.
reorder.why: 果汁不可數，用 some juice，不加 s；想要用 would like，sister 後 like 不加 s。

reorder.a: Vegetables are good for you.
reorder.why: 蔬菜泛指用複數 vegetables，所以用 are；對…好 be good for，for 不能漏。

reorder.a: We don't need any potatoes today.
reorder.why: 不需要用 don't need，否定句的任何用 any；potato 複數加 es：potatoes。

reorder.a: We would like a table for two.
reorder.why: 想要（客氣說法）用 would like，可縮寫成 We'd like；兩人的桌位是 a table for two，for 不能漏。

reorder.a: How many people are in your group?
reorder.why: 人可以數，問人數用 How many people；後面接 are in your group 或 are there。

reorder.a: I would like a glass of water, thank you.
reorder.why: 水不可數，要用容器來數：a glass of water；想要用 would like 或 I'd like。

reorder.a: I don't want any soup, thank you.
reorder.why: 否定句用 any：I don't want any soup；湯不可數，不加 a；thank you 前加逗號。

reorder.a: I don't have any money today.
reorder.why: 否定句的任何用 any：don't have any money；錢不可數，money 不加 s；today 放句尾。

reading.title: 短文 1
reading.text: My name is Mei. Every morning, I would like some bread and an egg for breakfast. I also like a cup of coffee, but my brother would like some tea. We don't have any juice at home today. At lunch, I eat some rice with chicken or fish. My mother asks, 'How much rice do you want?' and I say, 'Just a little, please.' In the evening, my family has soup and noodles. We don't eat a lot of meat, but we like cheese and butter. I would like a piece of cake after dinner.

qs.q: What does Mei have for breakfast?
qs.why: 原文：I would like some bread and an egg for breakfast. 早餐吃麵包和一顆蛋。
wn: 麵是晚餐，魚是午餐，都不是早餐。
文中沒有三明治，而且原文說 We don't have any juice。

qs.q: What does Mei's brother like to drink?
qs.why: 原文：my brother would like some tea. 哥哥（弟弟）想喝茶。
wn: 想喝咖啡的是 Mei 自己（I also like a cup of coffee）。
原文說 We don't have any juice，家裡沒有果汁。

qs.q: Do they have any juice at home today?
qs.why: 原文：We don't have any juice at home today. 今天家裡沒有果汁。
wn: 原文說 don't have any juice，一點都沒有。
原文說 don't have any，連一點點都沒有；a little 是她要的飯量。

qs.q: What does Mei eat at lunch?
qs.why: 原文：At lunch, I eat some rice with chicken or fish. 午餐吃飯配雞肉或魚。
wn: 麵包是早餐，起司只說喜歡，不是午餐。
湯是晚餐，蛋糕是晚餐後，不是午餐。

qs.q: What does Mei's mother ask about rice?
opts: How many rice do you want?
How much rice do you want?
qs.why: 原文：My mother asks, 'How much rice do you want?' rice 不可數，問量用 How much。
wn: rice 是不可數名詞，不能用 How many；原文也是 How much。
媽媽問的是要多少飯，不是喜不喜歡。

reading.title: 短文 2
reading.text: On Saturday, I go to the market with my mother. We buy some apples, bananas, and oranges. My mother asks, 'How many tomatoes do we need?' I say, 'We need five tomatoes.' We also buy some potatoes and carrots, but we don't buy any onions today. My mother says, 'How much rice do we have at home?' I say, 'Not much. We need some rice too.' At home, I wash the fruit and vegetables. In the evening, we eat a fresh salad with cucumbers and tomatoes. I would like some watermelon for dessert.

qs.q: Where does the family go on Saturday?
qs.why: 原文：On Saturday, I go to the market with my mother. 星期六去市場。
wn: 文中沒有提到餐廳，晚餐是在家吃沙拉。
文中沒有提到學校，星期六去的是市場。

qs.q: How many tomatoes do they need?
qs.why: 原文：We need five tomatoes. 他們需要五顆番茄。
wn: 原文是 five tomatoes 五顆，不是三顆。
原文是 five tomatoes 五顆，不是十顆。

qs.q: Do they buy any onions today?
qs.why: 原文：we don't buy any onions today. 今天沒有買洋蔥。
wn: 原文說 don't buy any onions，沒有買。
原文說 don't buy any，一顆都沒買。

qs.q: What do they eat in the evening?
qs.why: 原文：In the evening, we eat a fresh salad. 晚上吃新鮮沙拉。
wn: 文中沒有提到湯，晚上吃的是沙拉。
文中沒有提到三明治，晚上吃的是沙拉。

qs.q: What does the speaker want for dessert?
qs.why: 原文：I would like some watermelon for dessert. 甜點想吃西瓜。
wn: 文中沒有提到蛋糕，甜點是西瓜。
文中沒有提到餅乾，甜點是西瓜。

reading.title: 短文 3
reading.text: Today, my friend and I go to a restaurant for dinner. We have a reservation for two. The waiter says, 'Would you like a table by the window?' We say, 'Yes, please.' He gives us the menu. I would like to order some soup and a dish of chicken. My friend says, 'I would like some fish, please.' We ask, 'Is there any dessert today?' The waiter says, 'Yes, we have some cake.' After dinner, we ask for the bill. The service is very good, and the food is delicious too.

qs.q: How many people have the reservation?
qs.why: 原文：We have a reservation for two. 我和朋友兩個人訂位，for two 就是兩位。
wn: 文中是 my friend and I，訂位 for two，是兩個人。
文中只有作者和朋友，for two 是兩位。

qs.q: What does the waiter give them?
qs.why: 原文：He gives us the menu. 服務生給他們的是菜單。
wn: 帳單是吃完飯後他們自己要的（ask for the bill），不是服務生先給。
文中沒有提到餐巾，服務生給的是 the menu。

qs.q: What does the speaker order?
qs.why: 原文：I would like to order some soup and a dish of chicken. 作者點湯和雞肉。
wn: 點魚的是朋友，也沒有提到飯。
cake 是店裡的甜點，不是作者點的主餐，文中也沒提茶。

qs.q: What does the friend order?
qs.why: 原文：My friend says, I would like some fish, please. 朋友點的是魚。
wn: 湯是作者（I）點的，不是朋友。
文中沒有提到麵包，朋友點的是 fish。

qs.q: Do they have any dessert?
qs.why: 原文：Is there any dessert today? / Yes, we have some cake. 有甜點，是蛋糕。
wn: 服務生回答 Yes, we have some cake，有甜點。
文中他們有問：Is there any dessert today?

reading.title: 短文 4
reading.text: Yesterday, I go to a new store near my house. There is a big sale today. I see a nice bag. I ask, 'How much is this bag?' The shop worker says, 'It's only ten dollars. It's very cheap.' I say, 'I would like to buy this bag, please.' I ask, 'Can I pay by credit card?' She says, 'Yes, of course.' She gives me a receipt. I don't have any cash today, but I have my credit card in my wallet. The bag is cheap, and I am very happy.

qs.q: Where does the speaker go yesterday?
qs.why: 原文：Yesterday, I go to a new store near my house. 作者去的是一家新開的店。
wn: 文中是 a new store 商店，不是餐廳。
文中是 a new store near my house，不是學校。

qs.q: How much is the bag?
qs.why: 原文：It's only ten dollars. 這個包包只要十元。
wn: 店員說 ten dollars，不是五元。
店員說 ten dollars，不是二十元。

qs.q: How does the speaker pay?
qs.why: 原文：Can I pay by credit card? / Yes, of course. 作者用信用卡付錢。
wn: 文中說 I don't have any cash today，沒有現金。
文中沒有提到硬幣，是用 credit card 付。

qs.q: Does the speaker have any cash today?
qs.why: 原文：I don't have any cash today. 今天沒有現金，所以答 No。
wn: 文中說 I don't have any cash，沒有現金。
don't have any 是完全沒有，不是很多。

qs.q: Is the bag expensive?
qs.why: 原文：It's only ten dollars. It's very cheap. 包包很便宜，不貴。
wn: 店員說 It's very cheap，很便宜，不是很貴。

reading.title: 短文 5
reading.text: At home, my mother asks, 'Would you like some tea?' I say, 'Yes, please. I would like a cup of tea.' She asks, 'Would you like some bread too?' I say, 'Yes, I would like a piece of bread.' Then I ask, 'Do we have any milk?' She says, 'No, we don't have any milk today.' I ask, 'Do we have any juice?' She says, 'Yes, we have some juice in the fridge.' I say, 'I would like a glass of juice, please.' My mother says, 'Here you are.'

qs.q: What does the speaker want to drink first?
qs.why: 原文：Would you like some tea? / Yes, please. I would like a cup of tea. 先要喝的是茶。
wn: 文中沒有提到咖啡，媽媽先問的是 tea。
果汁是最後才要的，一開始喝的是 tea。

qs.q: What does the speaker want to eat?
qs.why: 原文：I would like a piece of bread. 作者想吃一片麵包。
wn: 文中沒有提到湯，要吃的是 a piece of bread。
文中是 a piece of bread 一片麵包，不是三明治。

qs.q: Do they have any milk today?
qs.why: 原文：No, we don't have any milk today. 今天沒有牛奶，所以答 No。
wn: 媽媽說 we don't have any milk，沒有牛奶。
don't have any 是一點都沒有，不是 a little 一點點。

qs.q: Do they have any juice?
qs.why: 原文：Yes, we have some juice in the fridge. 冰箱裡有果汁。
wn: 沒有的是牛奶；果汁媽媽說 Yes, we have some。
文中只說 some juice，沒說只剩一點點。

qs.q: What does the speaker want at the end?
qs.why: 原文：I would like a glass of juice, please. 最後作者要一杯果汁。
wn: 茶是一開始要的，最後要的是 a glass of juice。
文中沒有提到水，最後要的是 juice。

reading.title: 短文 6
reading.text: Mrs. Lin goes to the market to buy some food. She says, 'Excuse me, do you have any apples today?' The seller says, 'Yes, we do. They are very fresh.' Mrs. Lin asks, 'How much are they?' The seller says, 'They are two dollars.' Mrs. Lin says, 'That's cheap! I would like to buy five apples, please.' She also asks, 'Do you have any milk?' The seller says, 'No, we don't have any milk today.' Mrs. Lin says, 'That's all, thank you.' She pays with cash and says, 'Keep the change.' The seller says, 'Thank you, have a nice day!'

qs.q: What does Mrs. Lin want to buy first?
qs.why: 原文：Excuse me, do you have any apples today? 林太太第一個問的是蘋果。
wn: 文中沒有提到香蕉，她先問的是 apples。
文中沒有提到麵包，她先問 apples，後來才問 milk。

qs.q: Are the apples fresh?
qs.why: 原文：Yes, we do. They are very fresh. 老闆說蘋果很新鮮。
wn: 老闆說 They are very fresh，很新鮮。
老闆有說：They are very fresh。

qs.q: How much are the apples?
qs.why: 原文：How much are they? / They are two dollars. 蘋果兩元。
wn: 老闆說 two dollars，不是一元。
five 是她要買的蘋果數量（five apples），不是價錢。

qs.q: Does the seller have any milk?
qs.why: 原文：No, we don't have any milk today. 今天沒有牛奶，所以答 No。
wn: 老闆說 we don't have any milk，沒有牛奶。
don't have any 是完全沒有，不是一點點。

qs.q: How does Mrs. Lin pay?
qs.why: 原文：She pays with cash and says, Keep the change. 她付現金，還說零錢不用找。
wn: 文中是 pays with cash，沒有用信用卡。
文中只說 with cash 現金，沒說用一枚硬幣；keep the change 是不用找零。

reading.title: 短文 1
reading.text: Yesterday was a busy day for Amy. In the morning, she was at the office. She was very busy. At noon, she was hungry, so she had lunch with her friend. In the afternoon, she was tired, but she was still happy. At night, she was at home with her family. She was happy to see them.

qs.q: Where was Amy in the morning?
qs.why: 原文：In the morning, she was at the office. 早上 Amy 在辦公室。
wn: 在家是晚上 At night，不是早上。
文中是 at the office 辦公室，不是學校。

qs.q: How did Amy feel at noon?
qs.why: 原文：At noon, she was hungry. 中午她肚子餓了。
wn: 文中中午是 hungry 餓，沒說冷。
文中中午是 hungry 餓，沒說難過。

qs.q: How did Amy feel in the afternoon?
qs.why: 原文：In the afternoon, she was tired, but she was still happy. 下午又累又開心。
wn: 她不只開心，還很累：she was tired, but…happy。
文中說 tired 累，不是生病。

qs.q: Where was Amy at night?
qs.why: 原文：At night, she was at home with her family. 晚上她在家。
wn: 文中沒有提到醫院，晚上她 at home。
辦公室是早上待的地方，晚上她 at home。

qs.q: Who was Amy with at night?
qs.why: 原文：At night, she was at home with her family. 晚上和家人在一起。
wn: 和朋友是中午一起吃午餐，晚上是 her family。
文中沒有提到老師，晚上是 with her family。

reading.title: 短文 2
reading.text: Last Saturday was a busy day for me. In the morning I was at the market with my mother. The market was very crowded, and the fruit was fresh and cheap. At noon we were at a small noodle shop near my house. The soup was hot and delicious. In the afternoon my brother was at home, but he was not happy. He was tired because his test was hard. In the evening we were all at my grandmother's house. The food was great, and everyone was happy.

qs.q: Where was the writer in the morning?
qs.why: 原文：In the morning I was at the market with my mother. 早上作者在市場。
wn: 文中早上是 at the market，不是學校。
文中早上是 at the market，不是辦公室。

qs.q: How was the market?
qs.why: 原文：The market was very crowded. 市場很擁擠，人很多。
wn: crowded 是人很多，empty 是空的，意思相反。
他們有在市場裡，水果又新鮮又便宜，市場有開。

qs.q: Where were they at noon?
qs.why: 原文：At noon we were at a small noodle shop near my house. 中午在麵店。
wn: 文中中午是 a noodle shop 麵店，不是咖啡店。
文中中午是 a noodle shop，沒提到公園。

qs.q: Why was the brother not happy?
qs.why: 原文：He was tired because his test was hard. 弟弟或哥哥不開心，因為考試很難。
wn: 文中沒說他生病，because 後面是 his test was hard。
文中沒說他餓，原因是考試很難。

qs.q: How was everyone in the evening?
qs.why: 原文：The food was great, and everyone was happy. 晚上大家都很開心。
wn: 文中說 everyone was happy，沒人生氣。
文中說 everyone was happy，不是無聊。

reading.title: 短文 3
reading.text: Last year I was a student in Taichung. My school was small, but the teachers were very kind. My best friend was Amy. We were in the same class for one year. On Mondays we were always tired, because our first class was at seven o'clock. On Fridays we were happy. After class we were often at a coffee shop near the school. The coffee was cheap and the cake was good. Last month I was in Taichung again, and the coffee shop was still there.

qs.q: Where was the writer a student?
qs.why: 原文第一句：Last year I was a student in Taichung. 作者去年在台中當學生。
wn: 文中是 Taichung 台中，不是台北。
文中是 Taichung 台中，不是台南。

qs.q: How were the teachers?
qs.why: 原文：The teachers were very kind. 老師們很親切。
wn: 文中說 very kind 很親切，不是生氣。
文中說 very kind，沒說懶惰。

qs.q: Why were they tired on Mondays?
opts: The first class was very early.
qs.why: 原文：because our first class was at seven o'clock. 第一堂課七點就開始，很早。
wn: 文中沒提到作業，because 後面是第一堂課七點。
文中沒說學校很遠，原因是第一堂課太早。

qs.q: Where were they after class on Fridays?
qs.why: 原文：After class we were often at a coffee shop near the school. 下課後常在咖啡店。
wn: 文中沒提到圖書館，下課後是 at a coffee shop。
文中沒提到健身房，下課後是 at a coffee shop。

qs.q: Was the coffee shop still there last month?
qs.why: 原文：Last month…the coffee shop was still there. still there 是還在。
wn: 文中說 still there 還在，沒說關了。
文中說咖啡店 still there 還在，沒變成銀行。

reading.title: 短文 4
reading.text: Yesterday was my birthday. I was very excited in the morning. My parents were not at home, so I was alone until noon. The house was quiet. At one o'clock my friends were at my door with a big cake. I was so surprised. The cake was chocolate, and it was delicious. We were in the living room all afternoon. The music was loud, but nobody was angry. At night I was tired but happy. It was a wonderful day for me.

qs.q: What day was yesterday?
qs.why: 原文第一句：Yesterday was my birthday. 昨天是作者的生日。
wn: 文中說是 my birthday，作者整天在家，沒提上學。
文中說是 my birthday，不是新年。

qs.q: Where were the parents in the morning?
qs.why: 原文：My parents were not at home, so I was alone until noon. 早上爸媽不在家。
wn: 文中說 not at home，他們不在家，不會在廚房。
文中說 not at home，沒提到花園。

qs.q: What time were the friends at the door?
qs.why: 原文：At one o'clock my friends were at my door. 朋友一點到門口。
wn: 文中是 one o'clock 一點，不是七點。
文中是 one o'clock 一點，不是十點。

qs.q: What kind of cake was it?
qs.why: 原文：The cake was chocolate. 是巧克力蛋糕。
wn: 文中是 chocolate 巧克力，不是水果蛋糕。
文中是 chocolate 巧克力，不是起司蛋糕。

qs.q: How was the writer at night?
qs.why: 原文：At night I was tired but happy. 晚上又累又開心。
wn: 文中說 nobody was angry，晚上是 tired but happy。
文中說 happy，沒說難過或餓。

reading.title: 短文 1
reading.text: Last night, Ken had a busy evening. First, he cooked dinner for his family. Then he cleaned the kitchen. After that, he called his mother and talked for ten minutes. Later, he studied English for one hour. Finally, he watched a movie and listened to some music before bed.

qs.q: What did Ken do first?
qs.why: 原文：First, he cooked dinner for his family. First 是第一件事：煮晚餐。
wn: 打掃廚房是 Then 之後做的，第二件事。
打電話是 After that，第三件事。

qs.q: Who did Ken call?
qs.why: 原文：he called his mother and talked for ten minutes. 他打給媽媽。
wn: 文中是 his mother，不是朋友。
文中是 his mother，不是老師。

qs.q: How long did Ken study English?
qs.why: 原文：he studied English for one hour. 他讀了一小時英文。
wn: 十分鐘是他和媽媽講電話的時間，不是讀英文。
文中是 one hour，不是兩小時。

qs.q: What did Ken do before bed?
qs.why: 原文：Finally, he watched a movie and listened to some music before bed. 睡前看電影。
wn: 文中沒說他睡前工作，是看電影、聽音樂。
煮飯是 First 第一件事，不是睡前。

qs.q: Did Ken clean the kitchen?
qs.why: 原文：Then he cleaned the kitchen. 他有打掃廚房，所以答 Yes, he did.
wn: 文中說 he cleaned the kitchen，他有打掃。
文中有寫：Then he cleaned the kitchen。

reading.title: 短文 2
reading.text: Last weekend I stayed at home. On Saturday morning I cleaned my room and washed my clothes. Then I cooked lunch for my family. In the afternoon I studied English for two hours. I also watched a movie on my computer. On Sunday I visited my grandmother. We talked for a long time, and she showed me some old photos. Later we walked in the park near her house. I returned home at six o'clock. I did not work last weekend, so I relaxed a lot.

qs.q: What did the writer do on Saturday morning?
opts: Cleaned the room and washed clothes.
qs.why: 原文：On Saturday morning I cleaned my room and washed my clothes. 星期六早上打掃房間、洗衣服。
wn: 作者週末待在家，星期日去的是奶奶家，不是朋友。
文中說 I did not work last weekend，週末沒上班。

qs.q: How long did the writer study English?
qs.why: 原文：In the afternoon I studied English for two hours. 讀了兩小時英文。
wn: six 是回家的時間六點，讀英文是 two hours。
文中是 two hours，不是十分鐘。

qs.q: Who did the writer visit on Sunday?
qs.why: 原文：On Sunday I visited my grandmother. 星期日去看奶奶。
wn: English 是星期六讀的科目，星期日看的是 grandmother。
文中沒有提到同學，星期日看的是 grandmother。

qs.q: What did the grandmother show?
qs.why: 原文：she showed me some old photos. 奶奶給作者看一些舊照片。
wn: 文中是 old photos 舊照片，不是新手機。
old 是在說照片 old photos，沒有提到腳踏車。

qs.q: What time did the writer return home?
qs.why: 原文：I returned home at six o'clock. 作者六點回到家。
wn: 文中是 six o'clock 六點，不是九點。
文中是 six o'clock，不是中午。

reading.title: 短文 3
reading.text: My friend Kevin worked in a small shop last year. He started work at nine o'clock every morning. He cleaned the shelves and helped the customers. At noon he cooked noodles for lunch. After work he played basketball with his friends. On Sundays he did not work. He visited his parents and watched TV with them. Last month he stopped that job. He wanted to study computers, so he moved to Taipei. He liked the shop, but he needed a change.

qs.q: Where did Kevin work last year?
qs.why: 原文第一句：Kevin worked in a small shop last year. 去年他在一家小店工作。
wn: 文中是 a small shop 小店，不是大飯店。
文中是 a small shop，不是學校。

qs.q: What time did he start work?
qs.why: 原文：He started work at nine o'clock every morning. 每天早上九點開始上班。
wn: 文中是 nine o'clock 九點，不是七點。
文中是 nine o'clock 九點，不是十一點。

qs.q: What did he cook at noon?
qs.why: 原文：At noon he cooked noodles for lunch. 中午煮麵。
wn: 文中是 noodles 麵，不是飯。
文中是 noodles 麵，沒提到湯和麵包。

qs.q: What did he do on Sundays?
qs.why: 原文：On Sundays he did not work. He visited his parents. 星期日他去看爸媽。
wn: 擦架子是平日上班做的，星期日 he did not work。
文中說 On Sundays he did not work，星期日不上班。

qs.q: Why did he move to Taipei?
qs.why: 原文：He wanted to study computers, so he moved to Taipei. so 前面就是原因：想學電腦。
wn: 文中說他 liked the shop，搬家是為了 study computers。
文中沒說爸媽住台北，原因是想學電腦。

reading.title: 短文 4
reading.text: Yesterday was a rainy day, so we stayed inside. My sister and I cleaned the kitchen in the morning. My mother cooked a big lunch for us. After lunch I studied for my English test. My sister watched a video about cats. At three o'clock my uncle visited us. He carried a box of oranges. We talked and laughed for two hours. In the evening my father returned from work. We watched a movie together and enjoyed the quiet night.

qs.q: Why did they stay inside?
qs.why: 原文：Yesterday was a rainy day, so we stayed inside. 下雨天，所以待在家。
wn: 文中沒說生病，so 前面是 a rainy day。
文中沒提商店關門，原因是下雨。

qs.q: Who cleaned the kitchen?
qs.why: 原文：My sister and I cleaned the kitchen in the morning. 打掃廚房的是作者和姊妹。
wn: 媽媽是煮午餐的人（cooked a big lunch），不是打掃。
叔叔三點才來，帶了柳丁，沒有打掃廚房。

qs.q: What did the sister watch?
qs.why: 原文：My sister watched a video about cats. 姊妹看了一支關於貓的影片。
wn: 文中是 a video about cats，不是足球賽。
文中是 a video about cats，不是新聞。

qs.q: What did the uncle bring?
qs.why: 原文：He carried a box of oranges. 叔叔帶來一箱柳丁。
wn: 文中是 a box of oranges，不是蛋糕。
文中叔叔帶的是 oranges，沒提到照片。

qs.q: What did the family do in the evening?
qs.why: 原文：We watched a movie together and enjoyed the quiet night. 晚上一起看電影。
wn: 文中只說媽媽煮了午餐 lunch，晚上是看電影。
那天下雨待在家 stayed inside，沒去公園。

reading.title: 短文 1
reading.text: Yesterday was a special day for Lily. She went to the night market with her friend. They ate noodles and drank tea. Lily saw many nice clothes and bought a new shirt. She also got a small gift from a shop. Later, her friend came to her house, and they had a good talk. It was a fun day.

qs.q: Where did Lily go yesterday?
qs.why: 原文：She went to the night market with her friend. Lily 去了夜市。
wn: 文中是 the night market 夜市，不是學校。
文中是 the night market，沒有提到醫院。

qs.q: What did Lily and her friend eat?
qs.why: 原文：They ate noodles and drank tea. 她們吃了麵。
wn: 文中是 noodles 麵，不是飯。
文中是 noodles 麵，沒提到魚。

qs.q: What did Lily buy?
qs.why: 原文：Lily saw many nice clothes and bought a new shirt. 她買了一件新襯衫。
wn: 文中是 a new shirt，沒有買手機。
文中是 a new shirt，沒有買書。

qs.q: Who came to Lily's house?
qs.why: 原文：Later, her friend came to her house. 來 Lily 家的是她朋友。
wn: 文中是 her friend，不是媽媽。
文中是 her friend，不是老師。

qs.q: How was Lily's day?
qs.why: 原文最後一句：It was a fun day. 這是好玩的一天。
wn: 文中說 fun 好玩，boring 是無聊，意思相反。
文中說 a fun day，沒說難過。

reading.title: 短文 2
reading.text: Last Sunday I went to the night market with my brother. We got there at seven o'clock. The market was full of people. We ate fried chicken and had cold tea. My brother had a bowl of beef noodles. Then we saw a small dog under a table. It was hungry, so we gave it some food. I made a short video of the dog with my phone. We went home at ten o'clock. I did my homework and went to bed.

qs.q: Where did the writer go last Sunday?
qs.why: 原文第一句：Last Sunday I went to the night market with my brother. 去了夜市。
wn: 文中是 the night market 夜市，不是海邊。
文中是 the night market，不是圖書館。

qs.q: What time did they get there?
qs.why: 原文：We got there at seven o'clock. 他們七點到。
wn: 十點是回家的時間 went home，不是到達時間。
文中是 seven o'clock 七點，不是五點。

qs.q: What did the brother have?
qs.why: 原文：My brother had a bowl of beef noodles. 哥哥或弟弟吃了一碗牛肉麵。
wn: fried 是炸雞 fried chicken，沒有炒飯；他吃的是 beef noodles。
文中沒有提到蛋糕，他吃的是 beef noodles。

qs.q: What did they see under a table?
qs.why: 原文：we saw a small dog under a table. 桌子底下有一隻小狗。
wn: 文中是 a small dog 狗，不是貓。
手機是作者自己拿來拍影片的，桌下是一隻狗。

qs.q: What did the writer do at home?
qs.why: 原文：I did my homework and went to bed. 回家後寫功課。
wn: 文中沒說洗碗，回家後是 did my homework。
作者拍的是小狗影片，回家後做的是 homework。

reading.title: 短文 3
reading.text: Last month my family went to Kaohsiung for three days. We got up early and went to the train station. The trip was long but fun. On the first day we saw the harbor and ate seafood. On the second day we went to an old temple. My mother made a small gift for my aunt there. We had dinner at my aunt's house. On the last day I got a nice hat at a shop. We did a lot of things, and we were tired but happy.

qs.q: Where did the family go last month?
qs.why: 原文第一句：Last month my family went to Kaohsiung. 全家去了高雄。
wn: 文中是 Kaohsiung 高雄，不是台中。
文中是 Kaohsiung 高雄，不是花蓮。

qs.q: How did they travel?
qs.why: 原文：We got up early and went to the train station. 去火車站，表示搭火車去。
wn: 文中去的是 train station 火車站，不是機場。
文中去的是火車站，搭火車，不是騎車。

qs.q: What did they eat on the first day?
qs.why: 原文：On the first day we saw the harbor and ate seafood. 第一天吃海鮮。
wn: 文中第一天是 seafood 海鮮，不是麵。
文中第一天是 seafood 海鮮，不是炸雞。

qs.q: What did the mother make?
opts: A small gift for the aunt.
qs.why: 原文：My mother made a small gift for my aunt there. 媽媽做了小禮物給阿姨。
wn: 文中是送給 my aunt 的 a small gift，不是給作者的蛋糕。
文中是 a small gift，沒提到包包。

qs.q: What did the writer get on the last day?
qs.why: 原文：On the last day I got a nice hat at a shop. 最後一天買了一頂帽子。
wn: 文中是 a nice hat，不是手機。
文中是 a nice hat，不是書。

reading.title: 短文 4
reading.text: Yesterday I had a busy day. I got up at six o'clock and made breakfast for my family. Then I went to work by bus. At the office I did a lot of work. At noon I ate lunch with my friend Lisa. We saw our old teacher in the restaurant. She was very happy to see us. After work I went to the supermarket and got some fruit. At home I made dinner. I did not watch TV, because I was very tired.

qs.q: What time did the writer get up?
qs.why: 原文：I got up at six o'clock. 作者六點起床。
wn: 文中是 six o'clock 六點，不是八點。
文中是 six o'clock 六點，不是五點。

qs.q: How did the writer go to work?
qs.why: 原文：Then I went to work by bus. 搭公車上班。
wn: 文中是 by bus 公車，不是開車。
文中是 by bus 搭公車，不是走路。

qs.q: Who did the writer eat lunch with?
qs.why: 原文：At noon I ate lunch with my friend Lisa. 和朋友 Lisa 吃午餐。
wn: 老師是在餐廳碰到的，一起吃飯的是 Lisa。
文中沒提到老闆，是 my friend Lisa。

qs.q: Who did they see in the restaurant?
qs.why: 原文：We saw our old teacher in the restaurant. 在餐廳碰到以前的老師。
wn: 文中碰到的是 our old teacher，不是 Lisa 的媽媽。
文中碰到的是 our old teacher，沒提到歌手。

qs.q: Why didn't the writer watch TV?
opts: Because the writer was very tired.
qs.why: 原文：I did not watch TV, because I was very tired. because 後面就是原因：太累了。
wn: 文中沒說電視壞了，原因是 I was very tired。
文中沒說太晚，because 後面是 very tired。

reorder.why: yesterday 是過去，問句用 Did you＋原形 buy，不是 bought。

reorder.a: She didn't finish her homework.

reading.title: 短文 1
reading.text: Tom had a bad day yesterday. He didn't sleep well last night, so he got up late. He didn't eat breakfast because he was late for work. Did he arrive on time? No, he didn't. His boss asked, "Did you finish the report?" Tom said, "No, I didn't. I forgot my computer at home." It was not a good day for Tom.

qs.q: Did Tom sleep well last night?
qs.why: 原文：He didn't sleep well last night. 沒睡好，所以答 No, he didn't.
wn: 文中說 He didn't sleep well，他沒睡好。
文中有寫：He didn't sleep well last night。

qs.q: Why didn't Tom eat breakfast?
qs.why: 原文：He didn't eat breakfast because he was late for work. 因為上班快遲到了。
wn: 文中沒說他不餓，because 後面是 he was late。
他忘記的是電腦，沒吃早餐是因為遲到。

qs.q: Did Tom arrive on time?
qs.why: 原文：Did he arrive on time? No, he didn't. 他沒有準時到。
wn: 文中直接回答 No, he didn't，他沒準時。
文中有明確答案：No, he didn't。

qs.q: What did Tom forget?
qs.why: 原文：I forgot my computer at home. Tom 把電腦忘在家裡。
wn: 文中是 my computer 電腦，不是手機。
文中是 my computer 電腦，不是鑰匙。

qs.q: Did Tom finish the report?
qs.why: 原文：Did you finish the report? / No, I didn't. 報告沒做完。
wn: Tom 回答 No, I didn't，沒做完。

reading.title: 短文 2
reading.text: Last Monday was a bad day for Amy. She didn't hear her alarm clock, so she got up late. She didn't eat breakfast at home. She ran to the bus stop, but the bus wasn't there. She waited for twenty minutes. At school, her teacher asked, "Did you finish your homework?" Amy didn't answer. She forgot her book at home. After class, her friend Ben said, "Was your morning bad?" Amy said, "Yes, it was. But now I am fine." They ate lunch together, and Amy felt happy again.

qs.q: Did Amy hear her alarm clock?
qs.why: 原文：She didn't hear her alarm clock, so she got up late. 她沒聽到鬧鐘。
wn: 文中說 She didn't hear her alarm clock，沒聽到。
文中說 her alarm clock，她有鬧鐘，只是沒聽到。

qs.q: Why didn't Amy take the bus on time?
qs.why: 原文：but the bus wasn't there. She waited for twenty minutes. 她到站時公車還沒來，只好等。
wn: 文中沒說她掉錢，是公車還沒來。
她是跑去公車站等車，不是走路上學。

qs.q: How long did Amy wait?
qs.why: 原文：She waited for twenty minutes. 她等了二十分鐘。
wn: 文中是 twenty minutes 二十分鐘，不是十分鐘。
文中是 twenty minutes，不是一小時。

qs.q: What did Amy forget?
qs.why: 原文：She forgot her book at home. 她把書忘在家。
wn: 文中是 her book 書，不是手機。
文中是 her book 書，不是包包。

qs.q: Was Amy happy at lunch?
qs.why: 原文：They ate lunch together, and Amy felt happy again. 午餐時她又開心了。
wn: 文中說 Amy felt happy again，她開心了。
文中說 They ate lunch together，她有吃午餐。

reading.title: 短文 3
reading.text: Ben called his friend Kevin on Saturday night. "Did you go to the baseball game?" Ben asked. "No, I didn't," Kevin said. "I wasn't free. I worked all day." Ben was surprised. "Was your office open on Saturday?" "Yes, it was. We were very busy." Ben said, "I didn't know that. I watched the game on TV. Our team didn't win, but the game was fun." Kevin laughed. "Next time I will go with you." They talked for ten minutes, and then Kevin went to bed. He was very tired.

qs.q: Did Kevin go to the baseball game?
qs.why: 原文：Did you go to the baseball game? / No, I didn't. Kevin 沒去。
wn: Kevin 回答 No, I didn't，他沒去。
Ben 是在家看電視轉播，Kevin 也沒去。

qs.q: Why didn't Kevin go?
qs.why: 原文：I wasn't free. I worked all day. 他整天在工作，沒空。
wn: 文中沒說他生病，是 I worked all day。
他說 Next time I will go，不是不喜歡棒球。

qs.q: Was Kevin's office open on Saturday?
qs.why: 原文：Was your office open on Saturday? / Yes, it was. 星期六辦公室有開。
wn: Kevin 回答 Yes, it was，有開。
文中有寫：Yes, it was. We were very busy.

qs.q: Did Ben's team win?
qs.why: 原文：Our team didn't win, but the game was fun. 球隊沒贏。
wn: Ben 說 Our team didn't win，沒贏。
文中沒說比賽沒打完，是 didn't win 沒贏。

qs.q: How did Kevin feel at the end?
qs.why: 原文最後一句：He was very tired. 最後 Kevin 很累，就去睡了。
wn: 文中是 very tired 累，不是餓。
Kevin 還笑了 laughed，不是生氣，是 very tired。

reading.title: 短文 4
reading.text: Yesterday my mother asked me many questions. "Did you clean your room?" she said. I didn't clean it, so I said no. "Did you wash the dishes?" I didn't wash them, either. She wasn't angry, but she wasn't happy. Then she asked, "Were you at the library?" I said, "Yes, I was. I studied for three hours." My mother smiled. "That is good," she said. "But please clean your room now." I cleaned my room after dinner. It took thirty minutes, and my mother said thank you.

qs.q: Did the writer clean his room before dinner?
qs.why: 原文：I didn't clean it… I cleaned my room after dinner. 晚餐後才打掃，晚餐前沒有掃。
wn: 原文說 I didn't clean it，是 after dinner 晚餐後才打掃。
是作者自己 after dinner 打掃的，不是媽媽。

qs.q: Did the writer wash the dishes?
qs.why: 原文：Did you wash the dishes? / I didn't wash them, either. 碗也沒洗。
wn: 文中說 I didn't wash them，沒有洗。
them 指全部的碗，一個都沒洗。

qs.q: Where was the writer?
qs.why: 原文：Were you at the library? / Yes, I was. 作者在圖書館。
wn: 文中是 at the library 圖書館，不是公園。
文中是 at the library 圖書館，不是學校。

qs.q: How long did he study?
qs.why: 原文：I studied for three hours. 他讀了三小時。
wn: 三十分鐘是打掃房間花的時間，不是讀書。
文中是 three hours，不是一小時。

qs.q: When did he clean his room?
qs.why: 原文：I cleaned my room after dinner. 晚餐後打掃房間。
wn: 文中是 after dinner 晚餐後，不是晚餐前。
文中是當天 after dinner 就打掃了。

writing.prompt: 請用 didn't 和 Did you...? 寫 3-5 句英文，說說你昨天沒做的事，並問朋友一個過去式問句。
writing.sample: I didn't go to school yesterday. I didn't eat breakfast in the morning. I forgot my umbrella. Did you have a good day yesterday? Did it rain at your place?

writing.prompt: 用 3-5 句英文寫下昨天你「沒有做」的三件事，都用 didn't。
writing.sample: I didn't get up early yesterday. I didn't eat breakfast at home. I didn't go to the gym after work. I was very tired. I went to bed at ten.

writing.prompt: 寫 3-5 句英文，問你的朋友三個關於上週的問題（用 Did 或 Was/Were 開頭）。
writing.sample: Did you go to the movies last week? Was the movie good? Were your friends with you? Did you eat dinner after the movie? Please tell me about it.

writing.prompt: 用 3-5 句英文寫一段對話：一個人問過去的事，另一個人用否定句回答。
writing.sample: A: Did you clean your room yesterday? B: No, I didn't. I was very busy. A: Were you at work? B: Yes, I was. I didn't have any free time.

mc.why: last Saturday 是上週六，用過去式；watch 加 ed 變 watched。
wn: She 是一個人，原形 watch 不行。
watches 是現在式，說習慣；這裡說看過了。

mc.q: We ___ shopping at the night market.
mc.why: go shopping 的過去式是 went shopping。
wn: 主詞 We 不加 es，而且這裡要用過去式。
-ing 不能單獨當動詞，前面要有 be 動詞。

mc.q: ___ you go to the park last Sunday?
