wn: Do 是現在式，跟 last Sunday 對不上。
Were 是 be 動詞，後面不能直接接 go。

mc.q: They ___ at the movie theater at seven.
mc.why: 主詞 They 是複數，後面是地點，過去 be 動詞用 were。
wn: was 配 I／he／she／it；they 用 were。
後面是地點，沒有一般動詞，要用 be 動詞。

mc.q: My brother ___ a new shirt last Saturday.
mc.why: last Saturday 是上週六；buy 不規則，過去式是 bought。
wn: buy 是現在式，跟 last Saturday 對不上。
buys 是現在式，要改成過去式 bought。

mc.q: I didn't ___ my friends last weekend.
mc.why: didn't 後面動詞用原形 meet。
wn: didn't 已經是過去式，後面不再用 met。
didn't 後面接原形，不加 s。

mc.q: The park ___ very busy on Sunday.
mc.why: 主詞 The park 是單數，後面是形容詞 busy，用 was。
wn: the park 是單數，用 was。
後面是形容詞 busy，沒有一般動詞，要用 be 動詞。

mc.q: We ___ a picnic in the park last Sunday.
mc.why: last Sunday 是上週日，用過去式；have 不規則，過去式是 had。
wn: 這裡講過去的事，用過去式 had。
主詞 We 不用 has，而且這裡要用過去式。

mc.q: My mother ___ dinner for the whole family.
mc.why: 講過去煮晚餐給全家，cook 加 ed 變 cooked。
wn: 主詞 My mother 現在式也要 cooks；這裡用過去式 cooked。
-ing 不能單獨當動詞，前面要有 be 動詞。

mc.q: They didn't ___ shopping on Sunday.
mc.why: didn't 後面動詞用原形 go。
wn: didn't 已經是過去式，後面不再用 went。
didn't 後面接原形，不加 es。

mc.q: I ___ my grandmother last Saturday morning.
mc.why: last Saturday 是過去，visit 加 ed 變 visited。
wn: 有 last Saturday，要用過去式 visited。
visits 是現在式，而且主詞 I 不加 s。

mc.q: ___ your friends at the party?
mc.why: your friends 是好幾個人（複數），be 動詞過去式用 Were。
wn: was 配一個人，friends 有 s 是複數。
句子沒有動作，at the party 前要用 be 動詞。

mc.q: He ___ soccer in the park with his son last Sunday.
mc.why: last Sunday 是過去的時間，用過去式；play 加 ed 變 played。
wn: He 是一個人，原形 play 不行；last Sunday 也要用過去式。
plays 是現在式說習慣；last Sunday 是過去，用 played。

mc.q: We ___ home at ten o'clock on Saturday night.
mc.why: 說星期六晚上幾點到家，是發生過的事；come 不規則，過去式是 came。
wn: come 是現在式，這裡講已經過去的那個晚上。
We 是複數不加 s，也要改成過去式 came。

mc.q: Did you ___ any photos at the park?
mc.why: Did 已經表示過去，後面動詞用原形 take。
wn: Did 已經是過去式，後面不再用 took。
Did 後面接原形，不加 s。

mc.q: The tickets ___ cheap, so we were happy.
mc.why: 後半句 we were happy 是過去；主詞 tickets 複數，用 were。
wn: tickets 有 s 是複數，用 were。
後面是形容詞 cheap，沒有一般動詞，要用 be 動詞。

mc.q: She ___ a new dress at the shopping mall.
mc.why: 講過去在百貨公司找到洋裝，find 的過去式是 found。
wn: 主詞 She 現在式也要 finds；這裡用過去式 found。
finds 是現在式；這裡講過去發生的事。

mc.q: I ___ coffee with my sister last Sunday afternoon.
mc.why: last Sunday afternoon 是上週日下午，用過去式；drink 不規則，過去式是 drank。
wn: 這裡講過去的事，用過去式 drank。
主詞 I 不加 s，而且這裡要用過去式。

mc.q: ___ he stay at home last weekend?
mc.why: last weekend 是過去，後面是一般動詞 stay，問句用 Did。
wn: 後面是一般動詞 stay，不用 be 動詞，用 Did。
Does 是現在式；last weekend 要用 Did。

mc.q: My father ___ the car last Saturday morning.
mc.why: last Saturday morning 是上週六早上，用過去式；wash 加 ed 變 washed。
wn: My father 是一個人，原形 wash 不行。
washes 是現在式，說習慣；這裡說洗過了。

mc.q: We didn't ___ the movie. It was too late.
mc.why: didn't 後面接原形，所以是 didn't see；太晚了所以沒看電影。
wn: didn't 已經表示過去，不能再接過去式 saw。
didn't 後面用原形，不加 s。

mc.q: The children ___ in the park all afternoon yesterday.
mc.why: yesterday 是昨天，講昨天整個下午的事，用過去式；run 的過去式是 ran。
wn: run 是現在式，說平常；這裡講那個下午。
children 是很多小孩（複數），不加 s。

mc.q: ___ your family at home last Sunday?
mc.why: last Sunday 已經過去，用過去式；at home 前要 be 動詞，一個家庭用 Was。
wn: Is 是現在式；last Sunday 已經過去，要用 Was。
句子沒有動作，at home 前要用 be 動詞。

mc.q: I ___ a book on the bus to the mall.
mc.why: read 的過去式拼法一樣是 read（唸成 red）；主詞 I 也配 read。
wn: 主詞 I 不加 s。
reading 前面要有 am／was，不能單獨用。

mc.q: They ___ noodles at a small shop yesterday.
mc.why: yesterday 是昨天，用過去式；eat 不規則，過去式是 ate。
wn: eat 是現在式，說平常；這裡說吃過了。

mc.q: ___ you meet your friends on Saturday?
mc.why: on Saturday 指上週六，後面是一般動詞 meet，問句用 Did。
wn: 後面是一般動詞 meet，不用 be 動詞，用 Did。
這裡問過去的週六，用過去式 Did。

mc.q: My sister ___ me a bag from the night market.
mc.why: 講姊姊過去送了一個包包，give 的過去式是不規則的 gave。
wn: 主詞 My sister 現在式也要 gives；這裡用過去式 gave。
gives 是現在式；這裡講過去發生的事。

mc.q: It ___ rainy last Sunday, so we stayed inside.
mc.why: rainy 是形容詞，用 be 動詞；last Sunday 是過去，It 用 was。
wn: were 配複數，It 是單數。
rainy 是形容詞，不是動作，要用 be 動詞。

mc.q: We ___ to music in the park last Sunday.
mc.why: last Sunday 是上週日，用過去式；listen 加 ed 變 listened。
wn: listen 是現在式，說平常；這裡說聽過了。

mc.q: He didn't ___ his family last weekend.
mc.why: didn't 後面接原形 call：上週末沒打給家人。
wn: didn't 已經表示過去，call 不能再加 ed。
有 didn't 時，主詞 He 也不加 s。

mc.q: ___ the shopping mall crowded?
mc.why: 主詞 the shopping mall 是單數，後面是形容詞，用 Was。
wn: the shopping mall 是單數，用 was。
後面是形容詞 crowded，沒有一般動詞，要用 be 動詞。

mc.q: I ___ my old friend at the movie theater.
mc.why: 講過去在電影院遇到朋友，see 的過去式是 saw。
wn: 這裡講過去發生的事，用過去式 saw。
sees 是現在式，而且主詞 I 不加 s。

mc.q: They ___ a taxi home after the movie last night.
mc.why: last night 是昨晚，用過去式；take 不規則，過去式是 took。
wn: 這裡講過去的事，用過去式 took。
主詞 They 不加 s，而且這裡要用過去式。

mc.q: My friends and I ___ very tired on Sunday night.
mc.why: My friends and I 是好幾個人，等於 we，過去用 were。
wn: 主詞是好幾個人（等於 we），要用 were。
後面是形容詞 tired，沒有一般動詞，要用 be 動詞。

mc.q: Did your mother ___ shopping with you?
mc.why: Did 後面動詞用原形 go。
wn: Did 已經是過去式，後面不再用 went。
Did 後面接原形，不加 es。

mc.q: She ___ some fruit at the market.
mc.why: 在市場買了水果是發生過的事；buy 不規則，過去式是 bought。
wn: She 是一個人，原形 buy 不行。
buying 前面要有 is／was，不能單獨用。

mc.q: We didn't ___ at home last weekend.
mc.why: didn't 後面接原形，所以是 didn't stay（上週末沒待在家）。
wn: didn't 已經表示過去，不能再加 ed。
didn't 後面用原形，不加 s。

mc.why: far 是形容詞（很遠），問句用 be 動詞；the park 是一個地方，用 Was。
wn: were 配複數，the park 只有一個。
far 不是動作，前面要用 be 動詞。

translate.zh: 上週末我和家人去了公園。
a: Last weekend I went to the park with my family.
I went to the park with my family last weekend.
Last weekend, I went to the park with my family.
My family and I went to the park last weekend.
Last weekend, my family and I went to the park.
Last weekend my family and I went to the park.
translate.why: go 的過去式是 went；去公園是 go to the park；和家人一起是 with my family。

translate.zh: 她星期六看了一部電影。
a: She watched a movie on Saturday.
She saw a movie on Saturday.
translate.why: 看了表示過去，watch 加 ed 或用 see 的過去式 saw；星期六前面用 on。

translate.zh: 我們昨晚去夜市買東西。
a: We went shopping at the night market last night.
Last night, we went shopping at the night market.
Last night we went shopping at the night market.
translate.why: 昨晚是過去，go 的過去式是 went；去買東西是 go shopping；在夜市用 at the night market。

a: Did you go to the park last Sunday?
translate.why: 上週日是過去，問句用 Did you＋原形 go；last Sunday 前面不加 on。

a: The park was busy last Sunday.
The park was crowded last Sunday.
There were a lot of people in the park last Sunday.
There were many people in the park last Sunday.
Last Sunday, the park was busy.
Last Sunday, the park was crowded.
Last Sunday, there were a lot of people in the park.
Last Sunday, there were many people in the park.
translate.why: 上星期天是過去，公園一個地方用 was；很多人可說 busy 或 crowded；last Sunday 不加 on。

translate.zh: 我哥哥買了一件新襯衫。
a: My brother bought a new shirt.
translate.why: buy 的過去式不規則，是 bought；一件新襯衫是 a new shirt。

translate.zh: 我上週末沒有跟朋友見面。
a: I didn't meet my friends last weekend.
I didn't see my friends last weekend.
translate.why: 過去的否定用 didn't＋原形 meet 或 see，不是 met；朋友們要加 s。

translate.zh: （說昨天看的電影）那部電影好看嗎？
translate.why: 電影是昨天看的，已經過去，用 Was 放句首：Was the movie good?；好看用 good。

translate.zh: 我媽媽為全家人做了晚餐。
a: My mother cooked dinner for the whole family.
My mom made dinner for the whole family.
My mom cooked dinner for the whole family.
My mother made dinner for the whole family.
translate.why: cook 過去式加 ed：cooked；全家人是 the whole family，前面用 for。

translate.zh: 我們上週末在公園野餐。
a: We had a picnic in the park last weekend.
Last weekend, we had a picnic in the park.
Last weekend we had a picnic in the park.
We had a picnic at the park last weekend.
translate.why: 上週末是過去；野餐說 have a picnic，過去式是 had；在公園 in the park。

translate.zh: 他們星期天沒有去買東西。
a: They didn't go shopping on Sunday.
translate.why: 沒有去表示過去，用 didn't＋原形 go；去買東西是 go shopping。

translate.zh: 我上星期六去看我奶奶。
a: I visited my grandmother last Saturday.
I went to see my grandmother last Saturday.
I visited my grandma last Saturday.
I went to see my grandma last Saturday.
translate.why: 去看奶奶就是拜訪，用 visit，過去式 visited；last Saturday 不加 on。

translate.zh: 你的朋友們昨晚在派對上嗎？
a: Were your friends at the party last night?
translate.why: 昨晚是過去，問在不在場用 Were 放句首；your friends 是複數用 were；last night 放句尾。

translate.zh: 我們看完電影後搭計程車回家。
a: We took a taxi home after the movie.
translate.why: take 過去式不規則，是 took；搭計程車回家是 took a taxi home，home 不加 to。

translate.zh: 上星期天下雨，所以我們待在家裡。
a: It was rainy last Sunday, so we stayed at home.
It rained last Sunday, so we stayed at home.
It rained last Sunday, so we stayed home.
It was rainy last Sunday, so we stayed home.
translate.why: 天氣用 It was rainy，待在家 stay 加 ed：stayed；前因後果用 so 連接。

a: Did you take photos at the park?
Did you take pictures at the park?
Did you take photos in the park?
Did you take pictures in the park?
translate.why: 問過去的事用 Did you＋原形 take；拍照是 take photos，photos 加 s。

a: The tickets were cheap last time.
Last time, the tickets were cheap.
Last time the tickets were cheap.
translate.why: 上次是過去；tickets 是複數，be 動詞用 were；便宜是 cheap。

translate.zh: 我在電影院遇到我的老朋友。
a: I saw my old friend at the movie theater.
I met my old friend at the movie theater.
translate.why: 遇到可以用 met 或 saw，都是不規則過去式；電影院是 the movie theater。

a: We had a good time last weekend.
translate.why: 玩得開心常說 had a good time，也可以說 were happy；We 是複數用 were。

translate.zh: 你媽媽昨天跟你一起去購物嗎？
a: Did your mother go shopping with you yesterday?
Did your mom go shopping with you yesterday?

reading.title: 短文 1
reading.text: Last weekend was very fun for Mia. On Saturday morning, she went to the park with her family. They had a picnic and rode a bike together. In the afternoon, they went shopping at the mall. On Sunday, Mia met her friend at a coffee shop. Then they watched a movie and had dinner at a restaurant. It was a great weekend.

reading.text: Last weekend was great for Lisa. On Saturday morning she went to the park with her family. The weather was sunny and warm. They had a picnic under a big tree. reading.title: 短文 3
reading.text: My weekend wasn't very exciting, but it was nice. On Saturday I didn't go out. I stayed at home and cleaned my small apartment. It took three hours. In the evening my sister came and we watched a movie on TV. We didn't cook, so we ordered pizza. On Sunday morning I went to the park near my office. I walked for forty minutes and listened to music. Then I met my friend Tina at a coffee shop. We drank coffee and talked about our jobs. I was home by six o'clock.

qs.q: Did the writer go out on Saturday?
opts: Yes, he went to the park.

文中沒提到購物，星期六 didn't go out。

qs.why: 原文：We didn't cook, so we ordered pizza. 星期六晚上沒煮飯，叫了披薩。
wn: 文中沒提到麵，他們叫的是 pizza。
他們 didn't cook，沒煮飯菜，是叫 pizza。

reading.title: 短文 4
reading.text: Peter and his family had a busy Sunday. In the morning they visited his grandmother. She cooked a big lunch for everyone. Peter's children were very happy because she made their favorite soup. After lunch, Peter's wife went shopping with her mother. They bought fruit and two new towels. Peter didn't go with them. They came home at seven, and everyone was tired but happy.

文中沒提到兄弟，他們拜訪的是 grandmother。

那天是星期天，文中沒用上學當原因；原因是湯。

qs.why: 原文：Peter didn't go with them... and washed the dishes. 午餐後 Peter 留下來洗碗。
wn: 去購物的是太太和她媽媽，Peter didn't go。
文中沒說睡覺，他是在洗碗（washed the dishes）。

wn: 四點是去公園的時間，回家是七點。
文中沒提到九點，回家是 at seven。

mc.q: Yes, I ___ it in my bag.
mc.why: 回答過去有沒有找到，find 的過去式是不規則的 found。
wn: 這是回答過去的事，用過去式 found。
主詞 I 不加 s，而且這裡要用過去式。

mc.q: We ___ the food very much last night.
mc.why: last night 是昨晚，用過去式；enjoy 是母音＋y，直接加 ed：enjoyed。
wn: 這裡講過去的事，用過去式 enjoyed。
主詞 We 不加 s，而且這裡要用過去式。

mc.q: ___ you go home by bus yesterday?
mc.why: yesterday 是昨天，有動作 go，問過去用 Did 開頭，go 用原形。
wn: Was 是 be 動詞，不能接 go；you 也不配 was。
Do 問現在或平常；問過去要用 Did。

mc.q: The trip ___ amazing.
mc.why: 主詞 The trip 是單數，後面是形容詞 amazing，用 was。
wn: the trip 是單數，用 was。
後面是形容詞 amazing，沒有一般動詞，要用 be 動詞。

mc.q: One day, I ___ a small problem.
mc.why: One day 是說過去某一天，用過去式；have 不規則，過去式是 had。
wn: have 是現在式；說故事要用 had。
has 配單數；主詞 I 不用 has。

mc.q: One day, a man ___ a small dog on the street.
mc.why: One day 是說故事的開頭，用過去式；find 不規則，過去式是 found。
wn: a man 是一個人，原形 find 不行。
finds 是現在式；說故事要用過去式 found。

mc.q: Yesterday was busy. First, I ___ up at six o'clock.
mc.why: 前面說 Yesterday，First 在講昨天的經過，用過去式；get 不規則，過去式是 got。
wn: get 是現在式；講那天的經過要用 got。
主詞 I 不加 s。

mc.q: Yesterday morning, we ___ breakfast together.
mc.why: Yesterday morning 是昨天早上，用過去式；eat 不規則，過去式是 ate。
wn: eat 是現在式；講經過要用 ate。

mc.q: After breakfast yesterday, she ___ to the office by bus.
mc.why: yesterday 是昨天，講那天的經過用過去式；go 不規則，過去式是 went。
wn: she 是一個人，原形 go 不行。
goes 是現在式；講經過要用 went。

mc.q: Finally, they ___ home at nine last night.
mc.why: last night 是昨晚，Finally 講那晚最後一步，用過去式；come 的過去式是 came。
wn: come 是現在式；講事情經過要用 came。

mc.q: The story ___ very interesting.
mc.why: 主詞 The story 是單數，後面是形容詞，用 was。
wn: the story 是單數，用 was。
後面是形容詞 interesting，沒有一般動詞，要用 be 動詞。

mc.q: Last night I ___ a strange dream.
mc.why: Last night 是過去；have a dream 的過去式是 had。
wn: 有 Last night，要用過去式 had。
主詞 I 不用 has，而且這裡要用過去式。

mc.q: ___ you tell your friend the story?
mc.why: 有動作 tell，問有沒有把故事告訴朋友，用 Did 開頭，tell 用原形。
wn: Do 問平常的習慣；問說了沒要用 Did。
Were 是 be 動詞，後面不能直接接 tell。

mc.q: He ___ the door and walked outside.
mc.why: 後面 walked 是過去式，前後一致，open 加 ed 變 opened。
wn: He 是一個人，原形 open 不行，而且要過去式。
opens 是現在式，和後面的 walked 不一致。

mc.q: The two boys ___ very excited.
mc.why: The two boys 是兩個人（複數），be 動詞過去式用 were。
wn: was 配一個人；two boys 是兩個人。
excited 是形容詞，前面要用 be 動詞，不用 did。

mc.q: I didn't ___ what to say.
mc.why: didn't 後面動詞用原形 know。
wn: didn't 已經是過去式，後面不再用 knew。
didn't 後面接原形，不加 s。

mc.q: She ___ me a long story about her trip.
mc.why: 講她說了旅行的故事，tell 的過去式是不規則的 told。
wn: 主詞 She 現在式也要 tells；這裡用過去式 told。
tells 是現在式；講過去的旅行故事用 told。

mc.q: ___ the weather good on that day?
mc.why: good 是形容詞，用 be 動詞；on that day 是過去，weather 單數用 Was。
wn: were 配複數，the weather 是單數。
good 不是動作，前面要用 be 動詞。

mc.q: Yesterday, we ___ for the bus for thirty minutes.
mc.why: Yesterday 是昨天，用過去式；wait 加 ed 變 waited。
wn: wait 是現在式，說平常；這裡講那一次。

mc.q: My phone ___ in my bag, so I didn't hear it.
mc.why: 後半句 didn't hear 是過去；phone 單數，後面是地點，用 was。
wn: my phone 是單數，用 was。
後面是地點 in my bag，沒有一般動詞，要用 be 動詞。

mc.q: In class yesterday, the teacher ___ a question.
mc.why: yesterday 是昨天，講課堂上發生的事，用過去式；ask 加 ed 變 asked。
wn: the teacher 是一個人，原形 ask 不行。
asks 是現在式；講經過要用過去式 asked。

mc.q: They didn't ___ the answer.
mc.why: didn't 已經表示過去，後面的動詞要用原形：didn't give。
wn: 過去的意思在 didn't 上了，不能再用 gave。
didn't 後面接原形，give 不加 s。

mc.q: Last summer we ___ to Kaohsiung by train.
mc.why: Last summer 是去年夏天，用過去式，travel 加 ed 變 traveled。
wn: travel 是現在式，跟 Last summer 對不上。
we 是複數不加 s，而且要用過去式。

mc.q: ___ your parents happy about the story?
mc.why: 主詞 parents 複數，後面是形容詞 happy，用 Were。
wn: 後面是形容詞 happy，沒有一般動詞，要用 be 動詞。

mc.q: The little girl ___ because she was afraid.
mc.why: 後面 she was afraid 是過去，cry 是子音＋y 結尾，y 改 i 加 ed：cried。
wn: The little girl 是一個人，原形 cry 不行。
cries 是現在式，和後面的 was 不一致。

mc.q: After lunch, I ___ my friend a message.
mc.why: After lunch 講的是那天午餐後，send 的過去式是不規則的 sent。
wn: 這裡講過去那天的事，用過去式 sent。
主詞 I 不加 s，而且這裡要用過去式。

mc.q: ___ he finish the work on time yesterday?
mc.why: yesterday 是昨天，有動作 finish，問過去用 Did 開頭，finish 用原形。
wn: Was 是 be 動詞，後面不能接原形 finish。
Does 問平常的習慣；問那次做完沒用 Did。

mc.q: The old man ___ under a big tree yesterday.
mc.why: yesterday 是昨天，用過去式；sit 不規則，過去式是 sat。
wn: The old man 是一個人，原形 sit 不行。
sits 是現在式；這裡說過去的情景，用 sat。

mc.q: We ___ not ready for the test.
mc.why: 主詞 We 複數，後面 not ready 是狀態，過去用 were。
wn: was 配 I／he／she／it；we 用 were。
後面是 not ready，沒有一般動詞，要用 be 動詞。

mc.q: She ___ her keys, so she called her sister.
mc.why: 後半句 she called 是過去，前面也用過去式；lose 的過去式是 lost。
wn: 後面 called 是過去式，前面也要用過去式 lost。
loses 是現在式；整句講過去發生的事。

mc.q: First, he ___ the water, and then he made tea.
mc.why: 後半句 he made tea 是過去式，前後要一致，boil 加 ed 變 boiled。
wn: 主詞 he 不配原形 boil，而且後面 made 是過去式。
boils 是現在式，和後面的 made 時間不一致。

mc.q: I ___ the news on TV last night.
mc.why: last night 是昨晚，see 的過去式是 saw，不是加 ed。
wn: see 是現在式，跟 last night 對不上。
主詞 I 不加 s，而且要用過去式。

mc.q: ___ the shop still open at nine?
mc.why: open 在這裡是形容詞（開著的），用 be 動詞；the shop 單數用 Was。
wn: were 配複數，the shop 只有一家。
這裡的 open 是開著的狀態，要用 be 動詞。

mc.q: The children ___ a beautiful picture for their mother.
mc.why: 講孩子們過去畫了一幅畫，draw 的過去式是不規則的 drew。
wn: 這裡講過去做的事，用過去式 drew。
主詞 children 是複數，不加 s；而且要用過去式。

mc.q: We didn't ___ the end of the movie.
mc.why: didn't 後面動詞用原形 watch。
wn: didn't 已經是過去式，後面不再用 watched。
didn't 後面接原形，不加 es。

mc.q: Then my brother ___ the room and said hello.
mc.why: 後面 said 是過去式，前面也用過去式；enter 加 ed 變 entered。
wn: 後面 said 是過去式，前面也要用過去式 entered。
enters 是現在式；整句講過去發生的事。

mc.q: ___ they at the station on time?
mc.why: 主詞 they 複數，後面是地點，問過去用 Were。
wn: was 配 I／he／she／it；they 用 were。
後面是地點 at the station，沒有一般動詞，要用 be 動詞。

mc.q: She ___ very hard last year.
mc.why: last year 是過去；study 去 y 加 ied：studied。
wn: 有 last year，要用過去式 studied。
studies 是現在式；last year 要用過去式。

mc.q: The dog ___ after the boy for two minutes.
mc.why: 狗追了男孩兩分鐘，是發生過的事；run 不規則，過去式是 ran。
wn: The dog 是一隻狗，原形 run 不行，要用過去式 ran。
runs 是現在式；追了兩分鐘是過去的事。

mc.q: Did you ___ your grandmother the good news?
mc.why: Did 後面動詞用原形 tell。
wn: Did 已經是過去式，後面不再用 told。
Did 後面接原形，不加 s。

mc.q: It ___ a long day, but it was fun.
mc.why: 後半句 it was fun 用 was，前後一致；It 是單數，用 was。
wn: were 配複數，It 是單數。
a long day 是名詞，前面要用 be 動詞。

mc.q: They ___ many photos on their trip last week.
mc.why: last week 是上週，那趟旅行已經結束，用過去式；take 的過去式是 took。
wn: take 是現在式；那趟旅行已經結束，用 took。

mc.q: I didn't ___ my bag on the train.
mc.why: didn't 後面動詞用原形 leave。
wn: didn't 已經是過去式，後面不再用 left。
didn't 後面接原形，不加 s。

mc.q: ___ you at the party until the end?
mc.why: 主詞 you，後面是地點 at the party，問過去用 Were。
wn: you 不管一個人或多人，都用 were。
後面是地點，沒有一般動詞，要用 be 動詞。

mc.q: At last, everybody ___ happy.
mc.why: everybody 雖然指大家，文法上當單數，用 was。
wn: everybody 當單數，用 was，不用 were。
後面是形容詞 happy，沒有一般動詞，要用 be 動詞。

fill.q: Last month, we ___ (go) to Japan.
fill.why: Last month 上個月是過去；go 是不規則動詞，過去式 went。

fill.q: First, we ___ (arrive) at the airport yesterday.
fill.why: yesterday 是過去，用過去式；arrive 字尾已經有 e，只加 d 變 arrived。

fill.q: Last summer, we ___ (stay) at a small hotel.
fill.why: Last summer 是去年夏天，用過去式；stay 是母音加 y，直接加 ed 變 stayed。

fill.q: One day, I ___ (lose) my ticket.
fill.why: One day 是故事開頭，說過去的事；lose 是不規則動詞，過去式 lost。

fill.q: Ten minutes ago, I ___ (find) it in my bag.
fill.why: Ten minutes ago 是十分鐘前，過去的事；find 是不規則動詞，過去式是 found。

fill.q: We ___ (have) a small problem yesterday.
fill.why: yesterday 是過去；have 是不規則動詞，過去式 had。

fill.q: We ___ (enjoy) the food very much last night.
fill.why: last night 是昨晚，用過去式；enjoy 是母音加 y，直接加 ed 變 enjoyed。

fill.q: ___ (you/have) a good trip?
fill.why: 過去式問句是 Did＋主詞＋原形動詞：Did you have…?，have 不變。

fill.q: Did you like the concert? Yes, it ___ (be) amazing.
fill.why: 問句用 Did，問的是過去的事，回答也用過去式；it 是單數，be 的過去式用 was。

fill.q: Finally, we ___ (come) home last night.
fill.why: last night 是過去；come 是不規則動詞，過去式是 came，不是 comed。

fill.q: One day, a young man ___ a small dog on the street.
fill.why: One day 是故事開頭，說過去的事；find 過去式 found，see 是 saw。

fill.q: Yesterday, I ___ up at six o'clock.
fill.why: Yesterday 是過去；起床是 get up 或 wake up，過去式是 got up／woke up。

fill.q: Then we ___ breakfast at a small shop yesterday morning.
fill.why: yesterday morning 是過去；吃早餐是 eat／have breakfast，過去式 ate 或 had。

fill.q: Yesterday she had breakfast. After that, she ___ to work by bus.
fill.why: 前面 Yesterday 說的是昨天，After that 接著說，也用過去式；go 的過去式是 went。

fill.q: Finally, they ___ home at nine o'clock last night.
fill.why: last night 是過去，用過去式；come 過去式 came，go 是 went，get 是 got。

fill.q: The story you told us yesterday ___ very interesting.
fill.why: yesterday 是過去，說昨天聽的故事；主詞 the story 單數，過去式 be 動詞用 was。

fill.q: Last night I ___ a strange dream.
fill.why: Last night 是過去；做夢說 have a dream，have 的過去式是 had。

fill.q: ___ you tell your friend the story yesterday?
fill.why: yesterday 是過去，後面 tell 是原形，問句用助動詞 Did 放句首。

fill.q: He ___ the door and walked outside.
fill.why: 後面 walked 是過去式，前後兩個動作時態要一樣；open 加 ed 變 opened。

fill.q: The two boys ___ very excited at the party last night.
fill.why: last night 是過去；主詞 the two boys 複數，過去式 be 動詞用 were。

fill.q: I didn't ___ what to say.
fill.why: didn't 後面一律接原形動詞：didn't know，不寫 knew。

fill.q: Yesterday, she ___ me about her trip to Japan.
fill.why: Yesterday 是昨天，用過去式；tell 是不規則動詞，過去式是 told。

fill.q: ___ the weather good on that day?
fill.why: on that day 指過去的那一天；the weather 是一件事，問句用 Was 開頭。

fill.q: We ___ for the bus for thirty minutes yesterday.
fill.why: yesterday 是過去；wait 加 ed 變 waited。等公車是 wait for the bus。

fill.q: Then the teacher ___ us a question yesterday.
fill.why: yesterday 是過去；ask 是規則動詞，加 ed 變 asked。

fill.q: They didn't ___ me the answer.
fill.why: didn't 後面一律接原形動詞：didn't give、didn't tell。

fill.q: Last summer we ___ to Kaohsiung by train.
fill.why: Last summer 是過去；go 是不規則動詞，過去式 went。

fill.q: ___ your parents at home when you came back?
fill.why: 後面 when you came back 是過去；主詞 your parents 複數，用 Were。

fill.q: The little girl ___ because she was afraid.
fill.zh: 小女孩哭了，因為她很害怕。
fill.why: 後半句 she was afraid 是過去；cry 是子音＋y，y 改 i 再加 ed：cried。

fill.q: After lunch yesterday, I ___ my friend a message.
fill.why: yesterday 是過去，說昨天午餐後的事用過去式；send 是不規則動詞，過去式 sent。

fill.q: ___ he finish the work on time yesterday?
fill.why: yesterday 是過去；後面 finish 是原形，問過去有沒有做到，用 Did 放句首。

fill.q: Yesterday afternoon, the old man ___ under a big tree.
fill.why: Yesterday afternoon 是過去，用過去式；sit 是不規則動詞，過去式是 sat。

fill.q: We ___ not ready for the test last week.
fill.why: last week 是過去；主詞 we 複數，be 動詞用 were，not 放後面。

fill.q: She ___ her keys, so she called her sister.
fill.why: 後面 called 是過去式，前後時態一致；lose 的過去式是 lost。

fill.q: I ___ the news on TV last night.
fill.why: last night 是過去；see 過去式 saw，watch 加 ed 變 watched。

fill.q: ___ the shop still open at nine last night?
fill.why: last night 是過去；the shop 是一間店，問句用 Was 開頭。

fill.q: The children ___ a picture for their mother last Sunday.
fill.why: last Sunday 是過去，用過去式；draw 是不規則動詞，過去式 drew（made、painted 也可以）。

fill.q: We didn't ___ the end of the movie.
fill.why: didn't 後面一律接原形動詞：didn't watch、didn't see。

fill.q: Then my brother ___ into the room and said hello.
fill.why: 後面 said 是過去式，前後動作時態要一致；come 的過去式是 came。

fill.q: ___ they at the station on time yesterday?
fill.why: yesterday 是過去；主詞 they 複數，be 動詞問句放句首，過去式用 Were。

fill.q: She ___ very hard for the exam last year.
fill.why: last year 是過去；study 變 studied（y 改 i 加 ed），也可以用 worked。

fill.q: Yesterday, the dog ___ after the boy for two minutes.
fill.why: Yesterday 是過去，用過去式；run 是不規則動詞，過去式是 ran。

fill.q: Did you ___ your grandmother the good news?
fill.why: Did 已經表示過去，後面動詞用原形；告訴某人消息用 tell。

fill.q: It ___ a long day, but it was fun.
fill.why: 後半句 it was fun 是過去，前面也要一致；It 是一件事，用 was。

fill.q: They ___ many photos on their trip last summer.
fill.why: last summer 是過去，用過去式；拍照是 take photos，take 的過去式是不規則的 took。

fill.q: I didn't ___ my bag on the train.
fill.why: didn't 後面一律接原形動詞：didn't leave，不寫 left。

fill.q: ___ you at the party until the end?
fill.why: 在問派對有沒有待到最後，是過去的事；主詞 you 用 Were 放句首。

fill.q: At last, everybody ___ happy.
fill.why: At last 是故事結尾；everybody 當單數看，過去式 be 動詞用 was。

fill.q: My mother ___ the story to my little sister last night.
fill.why: last night 是過去，用過去式；tell 的過去式是 told，read 過去式拼法不變。

fill.q: The train ___ late, so we missed the movie.
fill.why: 後面 missed 是過去式；主詞 the train 單數，be 動詞用 was。

translate.zh: 有一天，一個男人在街上撿到一隻小狗。
a: One day, a man found a small dog on the street.
translate.why: One day 開頭講故事，用過去式；撿到是 find，過去式 found。

translate.zh: （說昨天的事）首先，我六點起床。
a: First, I got up at six.
First, I got up at six o'clock.
First I got up at six.
First I got up at six o'clock.
translate.why: 說的是昨天的事，get up 過去式是 got up；First 後面加逗點。

translate.zh: 然後我們一起吃了早餐。
translate.why: 吃了表示過去，eat 用 ate，或 have 用 had；Then 放句首；一起 together 放句尾。

translate.zh: （說她昨天做的事）之後，她搭公車去上班。
a: After that, she went to work by bus.
After that, she took the bus to work.
After that she took the bus to work.
translate.why: 說的是昨天的事，go 的過去式是 went；搭公車去上班是 go to work by bus。

translate.zh: 最後，他們昨晚九點回到家。
a: Finally, they came home at nine last night.
Finally, they got home at nine last night.
Finally, they came home at nine o'clock last night.
Finally, they got home at nine o'clock last night.
translate.why: 昨晚是過去，回到家說 came home 或 got home，home 前面不加 to。

translate.zh: （說昨天聽到的故事）那個故事很有趣。
translate.why: 故事是昨天聽的，已經過去，用 was；有趣是 interesting，前面可加 very。

translate.zh: 我昨晚做了一個奇怪的夢。
a: I had a strange dream last night.
translate.why: 做夢英文說 have a dream，過去式是 had；奇怪的夢是 a strange dream。

translate.zh: 你把這個故事告訴你的朋友了嗎？
a: Did you tell your friend the story?
translate.why: 問過去的事用 Did you＋原形 tell；告訴朋友這個故事是 tell your friend the story。

translate.zh: 那兩個男孩昨天很興奮。
a: The two boys were very excited yesterday.
Those two boys were very excited yesterday.
Yesterday, the two boys were very excited.
Yesterday the two boys were very excited.
Yesterday, those two boys were very excited.
Yesterday those two boys were very excited.
translate.why: 昨天是過去；The two boys 是複數，be 動詞用 were；很興奮是 very excited。

translate.zh: 我當時不知道要說什麼。
a: I didn't know what to say.
I didn't know what to say then.
I didn't know what to say at that time.
At that time, I didn't know what to say.
At that time I didn't know what to say.

reading.title: 短文 1
reading.text: Last month, my family had a trip to Taichung. First, we arrived at the hotel in the morning. Then, we visited a park and took a lot of photos. After that, we ate lunch at a small restaurant. In the afternoon, we went shopping. One day, I lost my hat, but I found it at the hotel. We stayed there for two days. We enjoyed the trip very much. It was an amazing weekend.

qs.q: Where did the family go?
qs.why: 原文：Last month, my family had a trip to Taichung. 全家去台中旅行。
wn: 文中說 a trip to Taichung，是台中不是台北。
文中說 a trip to Taichung，是台中不是台南。

qs.q: What did they do after they arrived?
qs.why: 原文：we arrived at the hotel... Then, we visited a park. 抵達後接著去公園。
wn: 文中沒說抵達後睡覺，Then 後面是去公園。
購物是下午的事，抵達後先去公園。

qs.q: What did they do after lunch?
qs.why: 原文：we ate lunch... In the afternoon, we went shopping. 午餐後下午去購物。
wn: 文中說他們住了兩天，午餐後是去購物。
這是旅行，文中沒提到讀書；午餐後去購物。

qs.q: What did the writer lose?
qs.why: 原文：One day, I lost my hat, but I found it at the hotel. 作者弄丟的是帽子（hat）。
wn: 文中說 lost my hat，丟的是帽子不是手機。
文中說 lost my hat，丟的是帽子不是票。

qs.q: How long did they stay?
qs.why: 原文：We stayed there for two days. 他們在那裡待了兩天。
wn: 原文說 for two days，是兩天。
原文說 for two days，是兩天不是三天。

reading.title: 短文 2
reading.text: Last month I had a small adventure. On Saturday morning I took the train to Hualien. The trip was three hours long, but the view was beautiful. When I arrived, I was hungry, so I ate a big lunch near the station. After lunch I rented a bike and rode along the sea for two hours. The wind was strong, and I was tired. In the evening I found a small hotel. It wasn't expensive. I slept very well. The next morning I took the train home and told my family everything.

qs.q: How did the writer travel to Hualien?
qs.why: 原文：On Saturday morning I took the train to Hualien. took the train 就是搭火車去。
wn: 文中說 took the train，是搭火車，不是公車。
文中說 took the train，是搭火車，不是開車。

qs.q: How long was the trip?
qs.why: 原文：The trip was three hours long. 火車車程三小時。
wn: 兩小時是騎腳踏車的時間，車程是三小時。
原文說 three hours long，是三小時。

qs.q: What did the writer do after lunch?
qs.why: 原文：After lunch I rented a bike and rode along the sea. 午餐後租腳踏車沿海騎。
wn: 文中沒提到博物館，午餐後是騎腳踏車。
睡覺是晚上在旅館，午餐後是騎腳踏車。

qs.q: Was the hotel expensive?
qs.why: 原文：In the evening I found a small hotel. It wasn't expensive. 旅館不貴。
wn: 原文說 It wasn't expensive，不貴。
文中說 found a small hotel，是住旅館不是朋友家。

qs.q: What did he do the next morning?
qs.why: 原文：The next morning I took the train home. 隔天早上搭火車回家。
wn: 租腳踏車是前一天午餐後，隔天早上是回家。
原文說隔天早上就搭火車回家，沒有多待。

reading.title: 短文 3
reading.text: Ken's Monday started badly. First, his alarm didn't ring, so he woke up at eight. Then he couldn't find his keys. He looked in his bag and on the table, but the keys weren't there. Finally, he found them under his bed. He ran to the bus stop, but the bus was already gone. He didn't want to be late, so he took a taxi. It was expensive. At the office, his boss wasn't angry. She said, "Don't worry. The meeting is at ten." Ken smiled and drank two cups of coffee.

qs.q: Why did Ken wake up late?
qs.why: 原文：his alarm didn't ring, so he woke up at eight. 鬧鐘沒響，所以晚起。
wn: 文中沒說晚睡，原因是鬧鐘沒響。
文中沒說生病，原因是 alarm didn't ring。

qs.q: Where were his keys?
qs.why: 原文：Finally, he found them under his bed. 鑰匙最後在床底下找到。
wn: 他找過包包，但 the keys weren't there 不在那裡。
他找過桌上，但 the keys weren't there 不在那裡。

qs.q: Did Ken take the bus?
qs.why: 原文：the bus was already gone... so he took a taxi. 公車已經開走，他改搭計程車。
wn: 公車 was already gone，已經開走，他沒搭到。
文中沒說走路，他是搭計程車（took a taxi）。

qs.q: Was Ken's boss angry?
qs.why: 原文：At the office, his boss wasn't angry. 老闆沒生氣，所以回答 No, she wasn't.
wn: 原文說 his boss wasn't angry，沒生氣。
老闆在辦公室，還跟他說 Don't worry。

qs.q: When was the meeting?
qs.why: 原文：She said, "Don't worry. The meeting is at ten." 會議是十點。
wn: 八點是 Ken 起床的時間，會議是十點。
文中沒提到九點，會議是 at ten。

reading.title: 短文 4
reading.text: Two years ago, Mei moved to a new city for her job. At first, she wasn't happy. She didn't know anybody, and her apartment was very small. She often called her mother at night. Then one day a neighbor knocked on her door. Her name was Anna, and she gave Mei some fruit. They talked for an hour. After that, Mei and Anna often cooked dinner together. Mei joined a running group, too, and she made many friends. Last month Mei said, "This city is my home now." She wasn't lonely anymore.

qs.q: Why did Mei move to a new city?
qs.why: 原文：Mei moved to a new city for her job. for her job 是為了工作。
wn: 文中說 for her job，是為了工作，不是上學。
文中說 for her job；家人沒有一起搬，她晚上常打電話給媽媽。

qs.q: How did Mei feel at first?
qs.why: 原文：At first, she wasn't happy. 一開始她不開心，因為不認識人、房子又小。
wn: 原文說 At first, she wasn't happy，一開始不開心。
文中沒說生氣，是不開心、孤單。

qs.q: Who knocked on Mei's door?
qs.why: 原文：a neighbor knocked on her door. Her name was Anna. 敲門的是鄰居 Anna。
wn: 媽媽是她晚上打電話的對象，敲門的是鄰居 Anna。
文中沒提到老闆，敲門的是 a neighbor。

qs.q: What did Anna give Mei?
qs.why: 原文：she gave Mei some fruit. Anna 送給 Mei 一些水果。
wn: 文中說 gave Mei some fruit，給的是水果不是錢。
文中說 some fruit，給的是水果不是書。

qs.q: How does Mei feel now?
qs.why: 原文："This city is my home now." She wasn't lonely anymore. 現在她不再孤單了。
wn: 她說 This city is my home now，已經把這裡當家了。
文中沒提到想念舊工作，她現在不孤單了。

fill.q: I didn't ___ my bag on the train.
fill.why: didn't 後面一律接原形動詞：didn't leave，不寫 left。

a: I watched a movie last night.

a: He didn't watch TV last night.

過去的問句用 Did＋主詞＋原形動詞；Did 後面用 clean，不是 cleaned。

a: I finished my work at six o'clock.
I finished my work at six.
translate.why: 完成了表示過去，finish 加 ed：finished；幾點用 at six (o'clock)。

a: I went to the market yesterday.

a: They did their homework after dinner.

有看到…嗎是問過去，用 Did you＋原形 see；鑰匙通常不只一把，用 keys。

translate.zh: 他們上星期六辦了一個派對。

translate.zh: 我們昨天沒有時間吃午餐。

We didn't have time to have lunch yesterday.
Yesterday, we didn't have time for lunch.
Yesterday we didn't have time for lunch.
Yesterday, we didn't have time to eat lunch.
Yesterday we didn't have time to eat lunch.
Yesterday, we didn't have time to have lunch.
Yesterday we didn't have time to have lunch.

translate.zh: 我的朋友們昨天不在學校。

translate.why: My friends 是複數，過去的否定用 weren't；在學校是 at school，不加 the。

a: Last weekend I went to the park with my family.
I went to the park with my family last weekend.
Last weekend, I went to the park with my family.
My family and I went to the park last weekend.
Last weekend, my family and I went to the park.
Last weekend my family and I went to the park.

a: The park was busy last Sunday.
The park was crowded last Sunday.
There were a lot of people in the park last Sunday.
There were many people in the park last Sunday.
Last Sunday, the park was busy.
Last Sunday, the park was crowded.
Last Sunday, there were a lot of people in the park.
Last Sunday, there were many people in the park.

translate.zh: 我媽媽為全家人做了晚餐。
a: My mother cooked dinner for the whole family.
My mom made dinner for the whole family.
My mom cooked dinner for the whole family.
My mother made dinner for the whole family.

translate.zh: 你的朋友們昨晚在派對上嗎？
a: Were your friends at the party last night?
translate.why: 昨晚是過去，問在不在場用 Were 放句首；your friends 是複數用 were；last night 放句尾。

a: The tickets were cheap last time.
Last time, the tickets were cheap.
Last time the tickets were cheap.
translate.why: 上次是過去；tickets 是複數，be 動詞用 were；便宜是 cheap。

translate.zh: 有一天，一個男人在街上撿到一隻小狗。
a: One day, a man found a small dog on the street.
translate.why: One day 開頭講故事，用過去式；撿到是 find，過去式 found。

translate.zh: 最後，他們昨晚九點回到家。
a: Finally, they came home at nine last night.
Finally, they got home at nine last night.
Finally, they came home at nine o'clock last night.
Finally, they got home at nine o'clock last night.
translate.why: 昨晚是過去，回到家說 came home 或 got home，home 前面不加 to。

translate.zh: 那兩個男孩昨天很興奮。
a: The two boys were very excited yesterday.
Those two boys were very excited yesterday.
Yesterday, the two boys were very excited.
Yesterday the two boys were very excited.
Yesterday, those two boys were very excited.
Yesterday those two boys were very excited.
translate.why: 昨天是過去；The two boys 是複數，be 動詞用 were；很興奮是 very excited。

translate.zh: 去年夏天我們搭火車去高雄。
a: Last summer we went to Kaohsiung by train.
We went to Kaohsiung by train last summer.
Last summer, we went to Kaohsiung by train.
We took the train to Kaohsiung last summer.
translate.why: go 的過去式是 went；搭火車用 by train，不加 the；去年夏天是 last summer。

translate.zh: 我沒有把包包留在火車上。
a: I didn't leave my bag on the train.
translate.why: 過去的否定用 didn't＋原形 leave，不是 left；留在火車上是 on the train。

reading.title: 短文 1
reading.text: Yesterday was a busy day for Amy. In the morning, she was at the office. She was very busy. At noon, she was hungry, so she had lunch with her friend. In the afternoon, she was tired, but she was still happy. At night, she was at home with her family. She was happy to see them.

qs.q: Where was Amy in the morning?
qs.why: 原文：In the morning, she was at the office. 早上 Amy 在辦公室。
wn: 在家是晚上 At night，不是早上。
文中是 at the office 辦公室，不是學校。

qs.q: How did Amy feel at noon?
qs.why: 原文：At noon, she was hungry. 中午她肚子餓了。
wn: 文中中午是 hungry 餓，沒說冷。
文中中午是 hungry 餓，沒說難過。

qs.q: How did Amy feel in the afternoon?
qs.why: 原文：In the afternoon, she was tired, but she was still happy. 下午又累又開心。
wn: 她不只開心，還很累：she was tired, but…happy。
文中說 tired 累，不是生病。

qs.q: Where was Amy at night?
qs.why: 原文：At night, she was at home with her family. 晚上她在家。
wn: 文中沒有提到醫院，晚上她 at home。
辦公室是早上待的地方，晚上她 at home。

qs.q: Who was Amy with at night?
qs.why: 原文：At night, she was at home with her family. 晚上和家人在一起。
wn: 和朋友是中午一起吃午餐，晚上是 her family。
文中沒有提到老師，晚上是 with her family。

reading.title: 短文 2
reading.text: Last night, Ken had a busy evening. First, he cooked dinner for his family. Then he cleaned the kitchen. After that, he called his mother and talked for ten minutes. Later, he studied English for one hour. Finally, he watched a movie and listened to some music before bed.

qs.q: What did Ken do first?
qs.why: 原文：First, he cooked dinner for his family. First 是第一件事：煮晚餐。
wn: 打掃廚房是 Then 之後做的，第二件事。
打電話是 After that，第三件事。

qs.q: Who did Ken call?
qs.why: 原文：he called his mother and talked for ten minutes. 他打給媽媽。
wn: 文中是 his mother，不是朋友。
文中是 his mother，不是老師。

qs.q: How long did Ken study English?
qs.why: 原文：he studied English for one hour. 他讀了一小時英文。
wn: 十分鐘是他和媽媽講電話的時間，不是讀英文。
文中是 one hour，不是兩小時。

qs.q: What did Ken do before bed?
qs.why: 原文：Finally, he watched a movie and listened to some music before bed. 睡前看電影。
wn: 文中沒說他睡前工作，是看電影、聽音樂。
煮飯是 First 第一件事，不是睡前。

qs.q: Did Ken clean the kitchen?
qs.why: 原文：Then he cleaned the kitchen. 他有打掃廚房，所以答 Yes, he did.
wn: 文中說 he cleaned the kitchen，他有打掃。
文中有寫：Then he cleaned the kitchen。

reading.title: 短文 3
reading.text: Yesterday was a special day for Lily. She went to the night market with her friend. They ate noodles and drank tea. Lily saw many nice clothes and bought a new shirt. She also got a small gift from a shop. Later, her friend came to her house, and they had a good talk. It was a fun day.

qs.q: Where did Lily go yesterday?
qs.why: 原文：She went to the night market with her friend. Lily 去了夜市。
wn: 文中是 the night market 夜市，不是學校。
文中是 the night market，沒有提到醫院。

qs.q: What did Lily and her friend eat?
qs.why: 原文：They ate noodles and drank tea. 她們吃了麵。
wn: 文中是 noodles 麵，不是飯。
文中是 noodles 麵，沒提到魚。

qs.q: What did Lily buy?
qs.why: 原文：Lily saw many nice clothes and bought a new shirt. 她買了一件新襯衫。
wn: 文中是 a new shirt，沒有買手機。
文中是 a new shirt，沒有買書。

qs.q: Who came to Lily's house?
qs.why: 原文：Later, her friend came to her house. 來 Lily 家的是她朋友。
wn: 文中是 her friend，不是媽媽。
文中是 her friend，不是老師。

qs.q: How was Lily's day?
qs.why: 原文最後一句：It was a fun day. 這是好玩的一天。
wn: 文中說 fun 好玩，boring 是無聊，意思相反。
文中說 a fun day，沒說難過。

reading.title: 短文 4
reading.text: Tom had a bad day yesterday. He didn't sleep well last night, so he got up late. He didn't eat breakfast because he was late for work. Did he arrive on time? No, he didn't. His boss asked, "Did you finish the report?" Tom said, "No, I didn't. I forgot my computer at home." It was not a good day for Tom.

qs.q: Did Tom sleep well last night?
qs.why: 原文：He didn't sleep well last night. 沒睡好，所以答 No, he didn't.
wn: 文中說 He didn't sleep well，他沒睡好。
文中有寫：He didn't sleep well last night。

qs.q: Why didn't Tom eat breakfast?
qs.why: 原文：He didn't eat breakfast because he was late for work. 因為上班快遲到了。
wn: 文中沒說他不餓，because 後面是 he was late。
他忘記的是電腦，沒吃早餐是因為遲到。

qs.q: Did Tom arrive on time?
qs.why: 原文：Did he arrive on time? No, he didn't. 他沒有準時到。
wn: 文中直接回答 No, he didn't，他沒準時。
文中有明確答案：No, he didn't。

qs.q: What did Tom forget?
qs.why: 原文：I forgot my computer at home. Tom 把電腦忘在家裡。
wn: 文中是 my computer 電腦，不是手機。
文中是 my computer 電腦，不是鑰匙。

qs.q: Did Tom finish the report?
qs.why: 原文：Did you finish the report? / No, I didn't. 報告沒做完。
wn: Tom 回答 No, I didn't，沒做完。

reading.title: 短文 5
reading.text: Last weekend was very fun for Mia. On Saturday morning, she went to the park with her family. They had a picnic and rode a bike together. In the afternoon, they went shopping at the mall. On Sunday, Mia met her friend at a coffee shop. Then they watched a movie and had dinner at a restaurant. It was a great weekend.

qs.q: Where did Mia go on Saturday morning?
qs.why: 原文：On Saturday morning, she went to the park. 星期六早上 Mia 去了公園。
wn: 文中沒有提到海灘，她去的是 the park。
文中沒有提到博物館，她去的是 the park。

qs.q: What did Mia's family do at the park?
qs.why: 原文：They had a picnic and rode a bike together. 他們在公園野餐，還一起騎車。
wn: 文中沒說游泳，他們是野餐和騎腳踏車。
文中沒說讀書，他們是野餐和騎腳踏車。

qs.q: What did they do in the afternoon?
qs.why: 原文：In the afternoon, they went shopping at the mall. 下午他們去購物中心逛街。
wn: 文中沒說下午回家，下午是去 mall 逛街。
這是週末出遊，文中沒提到工作；下午是去逛街。

qs.q: Who did Mia meet on Sunday?
qs.why: 原文：On Sunday, Mia met her friend at a coffee shop. 星期天 Mia 在咖啡店見了她的朋友。
wn: 文中說 met her friend，見的是朋友，不是老師。
文中說 met her friend，見的是朋友，不是老闆。

qs.q: Where did they have dinner?
qs.why: 原文：Then they watched a movie and had dinner at a restaurant. 他們看完電影後在餐廳吃晚餐。
wn: 文中說 had dinner at a restaurant，是在餐廳吃，不是在家。
文中說 at a restaurant，是在餐廳，不是學校。

reading.title: 短文 6
reading.text: Last month, my family had a trip to Taichung. First, we arrived at the hotel in the morning. Then, we visited a park and took a lot of photos. After that, we ate lunch at a small restaurant. In the afternoon, we went shopping. One day, I lost my hat, but I found it at the hotel. We stayed there for two days. We enjoyed the trip very much. It was an amazing weekend.

qs.q: Where did the family go?
qs.why: 原文：Last month, my family had a trip to Taichung. 全家去台中旅行。
wn: 文中說 a trip to Taichung，是台中不是台北。
文中說 a trip to Taichung，是台中不是台南。

qs.q: What did they do after they arrived?
qs.why: 原文：we arrived at the hotel... Then, we visited a park. 抵達後接著去公園。
wn: 文中沒說抵達後睡覺，Then 後面是去公園。
購物是下午的事，抵達後先去公園。

qs.q: What did they do after lunch?
qs.why: 原文：we ate lunch... In the afternoon, we went shopping. 午餐後下午去購物。
wn: 文中說他們住了兩天，午餐後是去購物。
這是旅行，文中沒提到讀書；午餐後去購物。

qs.q: What did the writer lose?
qs.why: 原文：One day, I lost my hat, but I found it at the hotel. 作者弄丟的是帽子（hat）。
wn: 文中說 lost my hat，丟的是帽子不是手機。
文中說 lost my hat，丟的是帽子不是票。

qs.q: How long did they stay?
qs.why: 原文：We stayed there for two days. 他們在那裡待了兩天。
wn: 原文說 for two days，是兩天。
原文說 for two days，是兩天不是三天。

reading.title: 短文 1
reading.text: Hi, I'm Amy. Tomorrow I am going to visit my grandmother. Next week, I am going to start a new English class. My brother is going to travel to Japan next month. He is going to stay there for two weeks. On the weekend, my family is going to meet at a restaurant. We are going to eat dinner together. After dinner, we are going to watch a movie. Next year, I am going to study abroad in Canada. I am very excited about my plans!

qs.q: What is Amy going to do tomorrow?
qs.why: 原文：Tomorrow I am going to visit my grandmother. 明天 Amy 要去看祖母。
wn: 看電影是週末晚餐後的計畫，不是明天。
文中沒提到買書，明天是去看祖母。

qs.q: What is Amy going to start next week?
qs.why: 原文：Next week, I am going to start a new English class. 下週要開始上新的英文課。
wn: 文中說 a new English class，是英文課不是烹飪課。
文中說 a new English class，是英文課不是舞蹈課。

qs.q: Where is Amy's brother going to travel?
qs.why: 原文：My brother is going to travel to Japan next month. 哥哥下個月要去日本。
wn: 文中說 travel to Japan，是日本不是韓國。
文中說 travel to Japan，是日本不是中國。

qs.q: What is the family going to do on the weekend?
qs.why: 原文：On the weekend, my family is going to meet at a restaurant. 週末全家在餐廳聚餐。
wn: 文中沒提到週末去學校，是在餐廳見面吃飯。
文中沒提到打掃，週末是在餐廳聚餐。

qs.q: Where is Amy going to study next year?
qs.why: 原文：Next year, I am going to study abroad in Canada. 明年要去加拿大留學。
wn: 去日本的是哥哥（旅行），Amy 是去 Canada 讀書。
文中說 study abroad in Canada，是出國去加拿大。

reading.title: 短文 2
reading.text: Hi, I am Mei. I live in Taichung. Next week is a holiday, so I have a big plan. On Monday I am going to visit my grandmother in Tainan. She is eighty years old. On Tuesday my brother and I are going to go to the beach. We are going to swim and eat seafood. On Wednesday I am going to stay home and read three books. I am not going to work next week. On Friday my friends are going to come to my house for dinner. I am going to cook noodles for them.

qs.q: Where does Mei live?
qs.why: 原文：Hi, I am Mei. I live in Taichung. Mei 住在台中。
wn: 台南是祖母住的地方，Mei 住在 Taichung。
文中沒提到台北，Mei 說 I live in Taichung。

qs.q: Who is she going to visit on Monday?
qs.why: 原文：On Monday I am going to visit my grandmother in Tainan. 星期一要去台南看祖母。
wn: 弟弟是星期二一起去海邊的人，星期一是看祖母。
朋友是星期五來家裡吃飯，星期一是看祖母。

qs.q: What are Mei and her brother going to do on Tuesday?
qs.why: 原文：On Tuesday my brother and I are going to go to the beach. 星期二和弟弟去海邊。
wn: 看書是星期三 Mei 自己在家做的事。
煮麵是星期五請朋友吃，不是星期二。

qs.q: Is Mei going to work next week?
qs.why: 原文：I am not going to work next week. 下週不上班，所以回答 No, she isn't.
wn: 原文說 I am not going to work next week，不上班。
星期五是朋友來吃晚餐，她整週都不上班。

qs.q: What is Mei going to cook on Friday?
qs.why: 原文：I am going to cook noodles for them. 星期五要煮麵給朋友吃。
wn: 海鮮是星期二在海邊吃的，星期五是煮麵。
文中沒提到蛋糕，她要煮的是 noodles。

reading.title: 短文 3
reading.text: Ken is a student in Kaohsiung. This summer he is going to travel to Japan with his family. They are going to fly to Tokyo on July 5. They are going to stay in a small hotel near a park. Ken is going to take many photos. His mother is going to buy gifts for her friends. His father is going to visit an old temple. They are not going to drive a car in Japan. They are going to take the train every day. Ken is very happy about the plan.

qs.q: Where is Ken going to travel?
qs.why: 原文：This summer he is going to travel to Japan with his family. Ken 要和家人去日本。
wn: 文中說 travel to Japan，是日本不是韓國。
文中說 travel to Japan；Ken 住在高雄。

qs.q: When are they going to fly to Tokyo?
qs.why: 原文：They are going to fly to Tokyo on July 5. 七月五日飛東京。
wn: 原文是 July 5 七月，不是 June 六月。
原文是 July 5 五號，不是 15 號。

qs.q: What is Ken going to do in Japan?
qs.why: 原文：Ken is going to take many photos. Ken 要拍很多照片。
wn: 買禮物的是 His mother 媽媽，不是 Ken。
去寺廟的是 His father 爸爸，不是 Ken。

qs.q: How are they going to travel in Japan?
qs.why: 原文：They are going to take the train every day. 他們不開車，每天搭火車。
wn: 原文說 not going to drive a car，不開車。
文中沒提到騎腳踏車，是每天搭火車。

qs.q: Where are they going to stay?
qs.why: 原文：They are going to stay in a small hotel near a park. 住在公園附近的小旅館。
wn: 文中說 a small hotel，是小旅館不是大房子。
文中說住 a small hotel，沒說住朋友家。

reading.title: 短文 4
reading.text: Linda works in an office in Taipei. She is very busy every day. Next month she is going to change her life. She is going to get up at six every morning. She is going to walk to work, and she is not going to take the bus. After work, she is going to study English for one hour. On Saturdays she is going to cook at home. She is not going to eat fast food. Her friend Amy is going to help her. They are going to make a plan together this Sunday.

qs.q: Where does Linda work?
qs.why: 原文：Linda works in an office in Taipei. Linda 在台北的辦公室上班。
wn: 原文是 an office in Taipei，不是台南的學校。
原文是 an office in Taipei，不是台中的商店。

qs.q: What time is she going to get up next month?
qs.why: 原文：She is going to get up at six every morning. 下個月起每天六點起床。
wn: 原文說 get up at six，是六點。
原文說 get up at six，是六點。

qs.q: How is she going to go to work?
opts: She is going to take the bus.
qs.why: 原文：She is going to walk to work. 她要走路上班，不搭公車。
wn: 原文說 not going to take the bus，不搭公車。
文中沒提到開車，她要走路上班。

qs.q: What is she going to do after work?
qs.why: 原文：After work, she is going to study English for one hour. 下班後讀英文一小時。
wn: 煮飯是星期六的事，下班後是讀英文。
她是走路上班，下班後是讀英文，沒提公園。

qs.q: Who is going to help Linda?
qs.why: 原文：Her friend Amy is going to help her. 朋友 Amy 會幫她。
wn: 文中沒提到姊妹，幫忙的是朋友 Amy。
文中沒提到老師，幫忙的是 Her friend Amy。

reading.title: 短文 1
reading.text: My name is Tom. I can swim very well, but I can't ski. My sister can cook delicious food, and she can also speak English and Chinese. My father can drive a car, but he can't ride a bike. My mother can play the piano and sing beautiful songs. My little brother can't swim yet, but he can run very fast. On weekends, we like to do things together. I can't dance well, but I am going to learn dancing next month!

qs.q: What can Tom do very well?
qs.why: 原文：I can swim very well, but I can't ski. Tom 游泳很厲害。
wn: 會煮好吃的菜的是 Tom 的姊妹，不是 Tom。
Tom 說 I can't dance well，他跳舞不好。

qs.q: What can Tom's sister do?
qs.why: 原文：My sister can cook delicious food. 姊妹會煮好吃的菜。
wn: 會開車的是 Tom 的爸爸，不是姊妹。
文中只說 Tom can't ski，沒說姊妹會滑雪。

qs.q: What can Tom's father do?
qs.why: 原文：My father can drive a car, but he can't ride a bike. 爸爸會開車。
wn: 原文說 he can't ride a bike，爸爸不會騎腳踏車。
會唱歌的是媽媽，不是爸爸。

qs.q: What can Tom's mother do?
qs.why: 原文：My mother can play the piano and sing beautiful songs. 媽媽會彈鋼琴、唱歌。
wn: 游泳很好的是 Tom，不是媽媽。
文中沒有人提到修電腦。

qs.q: What is Tom going to do next month?
qs.why: 原文：I can't dance well, but I am going to learn dancing next month! 下個月要學跳舞。
wn: Tom 已經很會游泳了，下個月是學跳舞。
文中沒說要學煮飯，下個月是學跳舞。

reading.title: 短文 2
reading.text: My name is Wei. I am twenty-five years old. I can do many things, but I can't do everything. I can swim very well. I go to the pool every Saturday. I can also cook. I can make noodles and soup for my family. But I can't drive a car. I am going to take a driving class next month. I can speak Chinese and English, but I can't speak Japanese. My sister can play the guitar. She can't swim, so I am going to teach her this summer.

qs.q: What can Wei do very well?
qs.why: 原文：I can swim very well. I go to the pool every Saturday. Wei 很會游泳。
wn: 原文說 I can't drive a car，他不會開車。
會彈吉他的是他姊妹，不是 Wei。

qs.q: What can't Wei do?
qs.why: 原文：But I can't drive a car. Wei 不會開車。
wn: 原文說 I can also cook，他會煮麵和湯。
原文說 I can swim very well，他很會游泳。

qs.q: What is Wei going to do next month?
qs.why: 原文：I am going to take a driving class next month. 下個月要上駕訓課。
wn: 他只說 can't speak Japanese，沒說要學。
文中沒說買吉他；彈吉他的是姊妹。

qs.q: What languages can Wei speak?
qs.why: 原文：I can speak Chinese and English, but I can't speak Japanese. 會中文和英文。
wn: 原文說 can't speak Japanese，不會日文。
原文說 can't speak Japanese，不會日文。

qs.q: What can Wei's sister do?
qs.why: 原文：My sister can play the guitar. 姊妹會彈吉他。
wn: 原文說 She can't swim，所以 Wei 要教她。

reading.title: 短文 3
reading.text: Anna is a teacher in Taipei. She works with young students. Anna can speak three languages: Chinese, English and a little Korean. Her students love her English class. Anna can sing and she can play the piano, so the class often sings songs. Anna can't play the guitar, but her friend Ben can. Ben comes to the school on Fridays. He can play many songs for the children. Anna is going to learn the guitar this year. Ben is going to teach her every Friday after class.

qs.q: What is Anna's job?
qs.why: 原文：Anna is a teacher in Taipei. Anna 是台北的老師。
wn: 她會唱歌，但工作是 a teacher 老師。
文中說 Anna is a teacher，不是醫生。

qs.q: How many languages can Anna speak?
qs.why: 原文：Anna can speak three languages. 中文、英文和一點韓文，共三種。
wn: 冒號後列了中文、英文、韓文，共三種。
原文說 three languages，只有三種。

qs.q: What can Anna play?
qs.why: 原文：Anna can sing and she can play the piano. Anna 會彈鋼琴。
wn: 原文說 Anna can't play the guitar，今年才要學。
文中沒提到小提琴，她會的是 the piano。

qs.q: When does Ben come to the school?
qs.why: 原文：Ben comes to the school on Fridays. Ben 每週五來學校。
wn: 原文說 on Fridays，是星期五。
原文說 on Fridays，是星期五。

qs.q: What is Anna going to learn this year?
qs.why: 原文：Anna is going to learn the guitar this year. 今年要學吉他，Ben 會教她。
wn: 她已經會一點韓文，今年要學的是吉他。
她已經會彈鋼琴了，今年要學的是吉他。

reading.title: 短文 4
reading.text: The Chen family lives in Tainan. Mr. Chen can drive a bus. He works six days a week. Mrs. Chen can't drive, but she can ride a bike. She rides to the market every morning. Their son Kai is ten. He can swim and he can run very fast, but he can't cook. Their daughter Ping is six. She can't read English yet, but she can sing many English songs. Next summer the family is going to travel to Kenting. They are going to swim in the sea every day.

qs.q: What can Mr. Chen drive?
qs.why: 原文：Mr. Chen can drive a bus. 陳先生會開公車。
wn: 原文說 drive a bus，是公車不是卡車。
原文說 drive a bus，是公車不是計程車。

qs.q: How does Mrs. Chen go to the market?
qs.why: 原文：she can ride a bike. She rides to the market every morning. 她騎腳踏車去市場。
wn: 原文說 Mrs. Chen can't drive，她不會開車。
開公車的是陳先生；她是騎腳踏車去市場。

qs.q: What can Kai do?
opts: He can swim and run fast.
qs.why: 原文：He can swim and he can run very fast, but he can't cook. Kai 會游泳、跑很快。
wn: 原文說 he can't cook，Kai 不會煮飯。
Kai 才十歲，會開車的是爸爸。

qs.q: What can Ping do?
qs.why: 原文：she can sing many English songs. Ping 還不會讀英文，但會唱英文歌。
wn: 原文說 She can't read English yet，還不會讀。
會騎腳踏車的是媽媽，不是 Ping。

qs.q: Where is the family going to travel next summer?
qs.why: 原文：Next summer the family is going to travel to Kenting. 明年夏天去墾丁。
wn: 原文說 travel to Kenting，是墾丁不是台北。
原文說 travel to Kenting，是墾丁不是日本。

translate.why: 嗜好是 hobby；做某件事當名詞，動詞加 ing：reading。

a: Would you like to play basketball with me?
Do you want to play basketball with me?
translate.why: 邀請別人用 Would you like to＋原形 play…?；打籃球 play basketball，不加 the。

a: I am going to paint a picture tonight.
I'm going to paint a picture tonight.
translate.why: 今晚的計畫用 am going to 加原形 paint；一幅畫 a picture，a 不能漏。

a: He is very good at cooking.
translate.why: 很會做某事可以說 can＋動詞＋very well；well 放句尾，不用 good。

translate.zh: 旅行是我最喜歡的嗜好。
translate.why: 旅行當主詞要加 ing 變名詞：Traveling；最喜歡的 favorite 放在 hobby 前，be 動詞用 is。

a: Would you like to watch a movie tonight?
Do you want to watch a movie tonight?
Would you like to see a movie tonight?
Do you want to see a movie tonight?
translate.why: 邀請別人用 Would you like to 加原形動詞：to watch a movie；tonight 放句尾。

translate.zh: 我不會畫畫，但我喜歡美術課。
a: I can't paint, but I like art class.
I can't draw, but I like art class.
translate.why: 不會用 can't＋原形 paint；後半是喜歡，用 like；兩句意思相反用 but。

translate.zh: 他們要加入一個讀書會。
a: They are going to join a book club.
translate.why: 打算做的事用 are going to＋原形 join；讀書會是 a book club。
問會不會用 Can you play；彈樂器要加 the：the guitar。

a: I am going to read three books this month.
I'm going to read three books this month.
translate.why: 這個月的打算用 am going to read；三本書是複數 books；this month 前面不加 in。

translate.zh: 你想跟我們一起吃晚餐嗎？
a: Would you like to have dinner with us?
Do you want to have dinner with us?
Would you like to eat dinner with us?
Do you want to eat dinner with us?
translate.why: 邀請用 Would you like to have dinner；跟我們一起是 with us（受詞），不是 with we。

translate.zh: 我喜歡跟我弟弟玩電動。
a: I like playing video games with my brother.
translate.why: 喜歡做某事用 like＋動詞 ing：like playing；玩電動是 play video games。

translate.zh: 我的嗜好是煮飯和閱讀。
a: My hobbies are cooking and reading.
translate.why: 嗜好有兩個，用複數 hobbies，be 動詞用 are；動作當名詞要加 ing：cooking、reading。

a: She is going to take a photo class.
She's going to take a photography class.
translate.why: 計畫用 is going to＋原形；上課是 take a class，攝影課是 photography class。

translate.zh: 我們這個週末要去野餐。
a: We are going to have a picnic this weekend.
We're going to have a picnic this weekend.
translate.why: 週末計畫用 are going to＋原形；野餐是 have a picnic。

a: Would you like to go to the museum?
Do you want to go to the museum?
translate.why: 邀請別人用 Would you like to＋原形 go…?；博物館前面加 the。

translate.zh: 我會唱歌，但我不會跳舞。
a: I can sing, but I can't dance.
translate.why: 會做的事用 can，不會用 can't，後面都接原形動詞；兩句意思相反用 but。

translate.zh: 我爸爸喜歡在公園散步。
a: My father likes walking in the park.

translate.why: 主詞 My father 是一個人，like 加 s；喜歡做某事用 likes＋動詞 ing：walking。

I want to learn how to paint.

I would like to learn how to draw.

error.full: Would you like to play games?

error.s: Do you would like to join us?
error.correct: Would you like to join us?
error.why: Would 放句首，不用 do。

error.s: My hobby is read books.
error.why: 當名詞用時要用 -ing 形式。
error.full: My hobby is reading books.

error.s: I am going to painting a picture.
error.why: going to 後面用原形動詞。
error.full: I am going to paint a picture.

error.s: She can plays basketball well.
error.why: can 後面用原形動詞。
error.full: She can play basketball well.

error.s: They going to join a book club.
error.correct: They are going to join a book club.
error.why: 別漏掉 be 動詞 are。

error.s: I like play video games.
error.why: like 後面常接 -ing 形式。
error.full: I like playing video games.

error.s: He can to cook Chinese food.
error.correct: He can cook Chinese food.
error.why: can 後面不加 to。

error.s: Traveling are my favorite hobby.
error.why: 主詞是單數，要用 is。
error.full: Traveling is my favorite hobby.

error.s: Is she going to takes a photo class?
error.why: going to 後面的動詞不加 s。
error.full: Is she going to take a photo class?

error.s: I don't can paint.
error.correct: I can't paint.
error.why: 否定用 can't。

error.s: Would you like to went to the museum?
error.why: to 後面不用過去式。
error.full: Would you like to go to the museum?

error.s: My hobbies is cooking and reading.
error.why: 複數主詞 hobbies 要用 are。
error.full: My hobbies are cooking and reading.

error.why: 主詞 We 要用 are。
error.full: We are going to have a picnic.

reorder.a: My hobby is reading.
reorder.why: 嗜好是 hobby；做某件事當名詞，動詞加 ing：reading。

reorder.a: Would you like to play basketball with me?
reorder.why: 邀請別人用 Would you like to＋原形 play…?；打籃球 play basketball，不加 the。

reorder.a: I am going to paint a picture tonight.
reorder.why: 今晚的計畫用 am going to 加原形 paint；一幅畫 a picture，a 不能漏。

reorder.a: He can cook very well.
reorder.why: 很會做某事可以說 can＋動詞＋very well；well 放句尾，不用 good。

reorder.a: Traveling is my favorite hobby.
reorder.why: 旅行當主詞要加 ing 變名詞：Traveling；最喜歡的 favorite 放在 hobby 前，be 動詞用 is。

reorder.a: Would you like to watch a movie tonight?
reorder.why: 邀請別人用 Would you like to 加原形動詞：to watch a movie；tonight 放句尾。

reorder.a: I can't paint, but I like art class.
reorder.why: 不會用 can't＋原形 paint；後半是喜歡，用 like；兩句意思相反用 but。

reorder.a: They are going to join a book club.
reorder.why: 打算做的事用 are going to＋原形 join；讀書會是 a book club。

reorder.a: Can you play the guitar?
reorder.why: 問會不會用 Can you play；彈樂器要加 the：the guitar。

reorder.a: I am going to read three books this month.
reorder.why: 這個月的打算用 am going to read；三本書是複數 books；this month 前面不加 in。

reorder.a: Would you like to have dinner with us?
reorder.why: 邀請用 Would you like to have dinner；跟我們一起是 with us（受詞），不是 with we。

reorder.a: I like playing video games with my brother.
reorder.why: 喜歡做某事用 like＋動詞 ing：like playing；玩電動是 play video games。

reorder.a: My hobbies are cooking and reading.
reorder.why: 嗜好有兩個，用複數 hobbies，be 動詞用 are；動作當名詞要加 ing：cooking、reading。

reorder.a: She is going to take a photo class.
reorder.why: 計畫用 is going to＋原形；上課是 take a class，攝影課是 photography class。

reorder.a: We are going to have a picnic this weekend.
reorder.why: 週末計畫用 are going to＋原形；野餐是 have a picnic。

reading.title: 短文 1
reading.text: Hi, I'm Lisa. My hobby is painting. In my free time, I also like reading and listening to music. My brother's hobby is different. He likes gaming and photography. On the weekend, he is going to go fishing with our father. My mother enjoys gardening and cooking. She can cook many delicious dishes. Next month, our family is going to go camping in the mountains. We are also going to go hiking. I am very excited about our trip!

qs.q: What is Lisa's hobby?
qs.why: 原文：Hi, I'm Lisa. My hobby is painting. Lisa 的嗜好是畫畫。
wn: 去釣魚的是哥哥和爸爸，不是 Lisa 的嗜好。
打電玩是哥哥的嗜好，不是 Lisa。

qs.q: What does Lisa's brother like?
qs.why: 原文：He likes gaming and photography. 哥哥喜歡打電玩和攝影。
wn: 閱讀是 Lisa 喜歡的，煮飯是媽媽喜歡的。
園藝是媽媽的嗜好，露營是全家的計畫。

qs.q: What is the brother going to do on the weekend?
qs.why: 原文：On the weekend, he is going to go fishing with our father. 週末和爸爸去釣魚。
wn: 文中沒提到購物，週末是去釣魚。
文中沒提到跳舞，週末是去釣魚。

qs.q: What does Lisa's mother enjoy?
qs.why: 原文：My mother enjoys gardening and cooking. 媽媽喜歡園藝和煮飯。
wn: 畫畫和閱讀是 Lisa 喜歡的，不是媽媽。
打電玩、釣魚和哥哥有關，不是媽媽。

qs.q: What is the family going to do next month?
qs.why: 原文：our family is going to go camping in the mountains. 下個月去山上露營。
wn: 文中沒提到游泳，是露營和健行。
文中沒提到購物，是去山上露營。

reading.title: 短文 2
reading.text: I am Jia. I have three hobbies: reading, cooking and painting. I read one book every week. I like books about other countries. I can cook Taiwanese food, and I often cook for my family on Sundays. I can't paint well, but I like it very much. Next month I am going to take a painting class near my house. My friend Rita is going to come with me. She can paint very well. Would you like to join us? The class is on Saturday morning.

qs.q: How many hobbies does Jia have?
qs.why: 原文：I have three hobbies: reading, cooking and painting. Jia 有三個嗜好。
wn: 原文說 three hobbies，列了閱讀、煮飯、畫畫三個。
原文說 three hobbies，只有三個。

qs.q: How often does Jia read a book?
qs.why: 原文：I read one book every week. 每週讀一本書。
wn: 原文是 every week 每週，不是每個月。
原文是 every week 每週，不是每天。

qs.q: What can Jia cook?
qs.why: 原文：I can cook Taiwanese food. Jia 會煮台灣菜。
wn: 原文說 Taiwanese food，是台灣菜不是日本菜。
原文說 Taiwanese food，是台灣菜不是義大利菜。

qs.q: What is Jia going to do next month?
qs.why: 原文：Next month I am going to take a painting class near my house. 下個月上畫畫課。
wn: 她已經會煮台灣菜，要上的是 painting class。
她只是喜歡看外國的書，沒說要出國。

qs.q: When is the class?
qs.why: 原文：The class is on Saturday morning. 課在星期六早上。
wn: 星期天是她煮飯給家人吃，上課是星期六。
原文說 on Saturday morning，不是星期五晚上。

reading.title: 短文 3
reading.text: Peter loves basketball. He plays every Saturday with his friends in the park. He can run fast and he can shoot well. He can't swim, but he doesn't mind. His sister Mia has a different hobby. She likes painting and photography. She can take beautiful photos of flowers. This weekend Peter is going to play basketball at nine, and Mia is going to paint at home. On Sunday they are going to visit a museum together. Would you like to come? Mia says the art there is very good.

qs.q: When does Peter play basketball?
qs.why: 原文：He plays every Saturday with his friends in the park. 每週六打籃球。
wn: 原文說 every Saturday，是星期六。
原文說 every Saturday，是星期六。

qs.q: What can't Peter do?
qs.why: 原文：He can't swim, but he doesn't mind. Peter 不會游泳。
wn: 原文說 He can run fast，他會跑而且很快。
原文說 he can shoot well，他投籃很準。

qs.q: What are Mia's hobbies?
qs.why: 原文：She likes painting and photography. Mia 喜歡畫畫和攝影。
wn: 籃球是 Peter 的嗜好，而且 Peter 不會游泳。
文中沒提到閱讀和煮飯，是畫畫和攝影。

qs.q: What is Mia going to do on Saturday?
qs.why: 原文：This weekend... Mia is going to paint at home. 星期天另有安排，所以星期六她在家畫畫。
wn: 打籃球的是 Peter，Mia 是在家畫畫。
去博物館是星期天（On Sunday），不是星期六。

qs.q: Where are they going to go on Sunday?
qs.why: 原文：On Sunday they are going to visit a museum together. 星期天一起去博物館。
wn: 公園是 Peter 星期六打球的地方，星期天去博物館。
文中沒提到海邊，星期天是去博物館。

reading.title: 短文 4
reading.text: My grandfather is seventy years old, but he is very busy. His hobby is gardening. He can grow tomatoes and flowers. He can also cook, and he makes soup with his tomatoes. He can't use a computer, so he doesn't play games. My grandmother likes traveling. She is going to visit Japan with her friends next spring. She can speak a little Japanese. Next weekend they are going to have a small party in the garden. Would you like to come? We are going to eat, sing and take photos.

qs.q: What is the grandfather's hobby?
qs.why: 原文：His hobby is gardening. 祖父的嗜好是園藝。
wn: 喜歡旅行的是祖母，不是祖父。
原文說他 doesn't play games，不玩遊戲。

qs.q: What can the grandfather grow?
qs.why: 原文：He can grow tomatoes and flowers. 他會種番茄和花。
wn: 文中沒提到稻米和茶，是番茄和花。
原文說 tomatoes，是番茄不是蘋果。

qs.q: Why doesn't he play games?
qs.why: 原文：He can't use a computer, so he doesn't play games. so 前面就是原因：不會用電腦。
wn: 文中沒說不喜歡，原因是 can't use a computer。
他確實很忙，但文中不玩遊戲的原因是不會用電腦。

qs.q: Where is the grandmother going to travel next spring?
qs.why: 原文：She is going to visit Japan with her friends next spring. 明年春天去日本。
wn: 原文說 visit Japan，是日本不是韓國。
原文說 visit Japan；她還會一點日文。

qs.q: What are they going to do next weekend?
opts: Have a party in the garden.
qs.why: 原文：Next weekend they are going to have a small party in the garden. 花園派對。
wn: 去日本是祖母明年春天的計畫，不是下週末。
文中沒提到博物館，下週末是花園派對。

mc.q: Tomorrow is going to ___ sunny.
mc.why: going to 後面接原形動詞，be 動詞的原形是 be：going to be sunny。
wn: going to 後面要原形 be，不能用 is。
going to 後面要原形 be，不能用 are。

mc.q: It is going to ___ rainy this weekend.
mc.why: going to 後面接原形動詞；is、am、are 的原形是 be：going to be rainy。
wn: going to 後面要原形，is 的原形是 be。
going to 後面不接 ing，要用 be。

mc.q: If it's sunny, we are going to go ___.
mc.why: 去做某種活動的固定說法是 go＋V-ing：go hiking 去健行。
wn: go 後面不能再接原形動詞，要說 go hiking。
go 後面不接加 s 的動詞，固定是 go hiking。

mc.q: The weather ___ says it will rain.
mc.why: 天氣預報是 weather forecast，是一份預報，所以後面用 says。
wn: forecasts 是複數，動詞要用 say，不是 says。
天氣預報的固定說法是 weather forecast。

mc.q: You should wear a ___. It's cold.
mc.why: 前面有 a 表示一件，接單數名詞 jacket；天冷要穿外套。
wn: a 後面只能接單數，jackets 是複數。
jacketed 不是名詞，a 後面要接東西的名稱。

mc.q: I need an ___ today. It's rainy.
mc.why: 前面是 an，後面要接母音開頭的單數名詞：an umbrella。
wn: an 表示一個，後面不能接複數 umbrellas。
沒有這個字，umbrella 是名詞，不能加 ing。

mc.q: We are going to go to the ___ this weekend.
mc.why: 去海邊的固定說法是 go to the beach，用單數 beach。
wn: 去海邊習慣說 the beach 單數，不說 the beaches。
beached 是動詞變化，不是地點；the 後面要接名詞。

mc.q: It's too hot to play ___.
mc.why: 太熱了不適合在外面玩：play outside，outside 放動詞後當副詞。
wn: 室內不會曬，太熱不能玩的地方應該是外面。
indoor 是形容詞，要放名詞前（indoor games），不能放句尾。

mc.q: We are going to have a ___ on Saturday.
mc.why: 前面有 a，表示一個，後面要接單數名詞 picnic。
wn: a 後面只能接單數，picnics 是複數。
a 後面要接名詞，have a picnic 是固定說法。

mc.q: How is the ___ today?
mc.why: How is the weather today? 問今天天氣怎樣，天氣拼作 weather。
wn: whether 是是否，發音很像，但不是天氣。
少了 a，天氣要拼成 weather。

mc.q: It is sunny today. We ___ go to the beach.
mc.why: 主詞 We 是複數，be going to 的 be 用 are：We are going to。
wn: is 配一個人或一件事；We 是好幾個人，用 are。
am 只配 I，主詞 We 要用 are。

mc.q: ___ you like to go hiking on Saturday?
mc.why: 邀請別人用 Would you like to…?，Would 放句首。
wn: do 和 would 不能一起用，Would 直接放句首。
Are you like 不成立，are 後面不能直接接動詞 like。

mc.q: It is going to ___ tomorrow, so take an umbrella.
mc.why: going to 後面接原形動詞：It is going to rain。
wn: going to 後面的動詞不加 s。
going to 後面不接 ing，要用原形。

mc.q: Amy ___ going to stay home today.
mc.why: 主詞 Amy 是一個人（等於 she），be 動詞用 is。
wn: am 只配 I；Amy 是另一個人，用 is。
are 配 you／we／they；Amy 只有一個人。

mc.q: I can't ___ in cold water.
mc.why: can't 後面接原形動詞：can't swim。
wn: can't 後面不接 V-ing，要原形 swim。
can't 後面直接接原形，不加 to。

mc.q: They ___ going to play tennis in the park.
mc.why: 主詞 They 是複數，be 動詞用 are：are going to play。
wn: is 配單數，They 是複數。

mc.q: Would you like to ___ to the beach with me?
mc.why: Would you like to 後面接原形動詞：to go to the beach。
wn: to 後面要接原形，不加 es。
to 後面要接原形，不接 ing。

mc.q: It is very hot today. I ___ go outside.
mc.why: 天氣太熱，決定不出門；否定是 am not going to + 原形 go。
wn: going to 不能少了 ing，要說 am not going to。
not 要放在 am 後面：am not going to。

mc.q: ___ he going to bring an umbrella?
mc.why: 問他打不打算帶傘，be 動詞放最前面；he 單數用 Is。
wn: Are 配複數或 you，he 是一個人。
going to 前面要 be 動詞，不用 Do。

mc.q: My sister can ___ a bike, but I can't.
mc.why: can 後面接原形動詞：can ride a bike。
wn: can 後面不接 V-ing，要原形 ride。
can 後面不加 s，My sister 也一樣。

mc.q: We are going to ___ hiking on Sunday morning.
mc.why: going to 後面接原形；去健行是 go hiking。
wn: going to 後面不接 V-ing，要原形 go。
went 是過去式，going to 後面只能接原形。

mc.q: It's rainy, so we ___ play soccer today.
mc.why: 線索是 rainy, so：下雨所以不能踢球，用 can't＋原形。
wn: can't 後面直接接原形，不加 to。
can 的否定是 can't，不用 don't 幫忙。

mc.q: ___ like to have a picnic tomorrow?
mc.why: 邀請別人用 Would you like to…?，would 本身就放在句首。
wn: would 和 are 不能一起用，直接 Would you 開頭。
would 和 do 不能一起用，Would 自己移到句首就好。

mc.q: The weather is cold. Tom is going to ___ a coat.
mc.why: is going to 後面接原形動詞 wear（穿），主詞 Tom 也不加 s。
wn: going to 後面要原形，不能加 s。
to 後面接原形 wear，不接 ing。

mc.q: I ___ going to visit my grandmother this weekend.
mc.why: 主詞是 I，be 動詞一定用 am：I am going to…（我打算…）。
wn: is 配 he／she／it 一個人或一件事，I 要用 am。
are 配 you／we／they，I 要用 am。

mc.q: Can you ___ the mountain in one day?
mc.why: Can 問句，主詞後面接原形：Can you climb…?
wn: Can 句子裡動詞用原形，不加 s。
Can 後面的動詞要原形，不接 V-ing。

mc.q: What ___ you going to do on Saturday?
mc.why: 主詞是 you，be going to 問句用 are：What are you going to do?
wn: is 配 he／she／it，主詞 you 用 are。
有 going to 就要用 be 動詞，不用 do。

mc.q: She ___ going to work on Sunday.
mc.why: 主詞 She 是一個人，be 動詞用 is，否定是 isn't going to。
wn: aren't 配 you、we、they，She 要用 isn't。
英文沒有 amn't 這個縮寫，She 也不配 am。

mc.q: Would you like ___ go to the beach?
mc.why: Would you like 後面接 to＋原形動詞：like to go。
wn: going go 變成兩個動詞連在一起，要用 like to go。
like 後面接動詞要用 to，不用 for。

mc.q: It is going to be ___ tomorrow, so take a jacket.
mc.why: be 後面要接形容詞來描述天氣，cold（冷的）是形容詞：be cold。
wn: coldly 是副詞，形容動作，不能放在 be 後面描述天氣。
colds 是名詞感冒的複數，這裡要形容詞 cold。

mc.q: I can speak English, but I ___ speak French.
mc.why: but 表示前後相反：會說英文，但不會說法文，用 can't。
wn: can 自己就能變否定，不用 don't。
not 要放在 can 後面，寫成 can't。

mc.q: We ___ going to have a picnic. It is rainy today.
mc.why: 下雨所以不去野餐；be going to 的否定是 are not going to。
wn: 有 going to 要用 be 動詞否定，不用 do not。
not 要放在 are 後面：are not。

mc.q: Where ___ they going to go this weekend?
mc.why: Where 後面接 be 動詞；主詞 they 是複數，用 are。
wn: is 配單數，they 是複數。
going to 前面要 be 動詞，不用 do。

mc.q: Would you like to join ___?
mc.why: join 後面是要加入的對象，放在動詞後要用 us（我們）。
wn: we 只能當主詞放在動詞前面；動詞後面要用 us。
our 是我們的，後面要接名詞，例如 our club。

mc.q: My brother ___ swim in the sea.
mc.why: 後面 swim 是原形，表示會游泳，用 can。
wn: can 不加 s，My brother 是一個人也一樣。
can 後面直接接原形，不加 to。

mc.q: It's sunny! Let's ___ to the park.
mc.why: Let's（我們一起…吧）後面接原形動詞：Let's go。
wn: Let's 後面不接 V-ing，要原形 go。
Let's 後面不加 es，要原形 go。

mc.q: I am going to ___ my bike to the beach.
mc.why: be going to 後面接原形動詞：am going to ride。
wn: going to 後面不接 ing，要用原形。
going to 說未來，不能接過去式 rode。

mc.q: ___ it going to snow tonight?
mc.why: 問天氣預測用 be going to；天氣主詞 it 是單數，用 Is。
wn: going to 前面要 be 動詞，不用 Does。
Are 配複數或 you，it 是單數。

mc.q: They can't ___ hiking today because it is rainy.
mc.why: can't 後面接原形，去健行是 go hiking：can't go hiking。
wn: can't 後面直接接原形，不加 to。
can't 後面不接 V-ing，要原形 go。

mc.q: Kevin and I ___ going to watch a movie at home.
mc.why: Kevin and I 是兩個人，等於 we，be 動詞用 are。
wn: is 配一個人；Kevin and I 是兩個人。
am 只配 I 自己；主詞有 Kevin 和 I 兩個人。

mc.q: Would you like ___ tea?
mc.why: Would you like…? 是請別人吃喝東西（提議），這時用 some；tea 不可數。
wn: many 配可數複數，tea 不可數。
tea 不可數，前面不放 an；an 也只用在母音開頭的字前。

mc.q: It is windy today. We ___ fly a kite.
mc.why: 有風所以可以放風箏；fly 是原形，前面用 can。
wn: can 後面直接接原形，不加 to。
are 和 can 不能一起用，只要 can。

mc.q: She is going to ___ at home all day.
mc.why: going to 後面接原形動詞：going to stay。
wn: going to 後面要原形，she 也不加 s。
going to 後面不接 V-ing，要原形 stay。

mc.q: I ___ going to be late for the trip.
mc.why: be going to 的否定是在 be 後面加 not：I am not going to。
wn: 句子有 going to，要用 am not 否定，不用 don't。
not 要放在 am 後面：am not，不能放前面。

mc.q: Can Lisa ___ well?
mc.why: Can 問句，主詞後面接原形：Can Lisa cook…?
wn: 有 Can 時動詞用原形，Lisa 雖是一個人也不加 s。
Can 後面的動詞要原形，不接 V-ing。

mc.q: What is the weather going to ___ like tomorrow?
mc.why: going to 後面接原形，is 的原形是 be：going to be like。
wn: going to 後面要原形 be，不能用 is。
going to 後面不接 V-ing，要原形 be。

mc.q: We are going to the beach ___ Saturday.
mc.why: 星期幾前面用介系詞 on：on Saturday。
wn: at 用在幾點，例如 at nine。
in 用在月份、年份，例如 in May。

mc.q: Would you like to go running ___ me?
mc.why: 跟某人一起做事用 with：go running with me。
wn: to 表示方向或對象，跟某人一起要用 with。
for me 是為了我，不是跟我一起跑步。

mc.q: It is hot, so I ___ going to wear my coat.
mc.why: 天氣熱所以不穿外套；主詞 I 配 am，not 放在 am 後面。
wn: not 要放在 be 動詞後面：am not。
is 配 he、she、it，主詞 I 要用 am。

fill.q: Tomorrow is going to be ___.
fill.why: be going to be 後面接形容詞；講明天天氣，晴天是 sunny。

fill.q: It is going to be ___ this weekend.
fill.why: be going to be 後面接形容詞；講天氣，下雨的是 rainy。

fill.q: You should wear a ___. It's cold.
fill.why: 後面說很冷，應該穿外套或毛衣：jacket、coat、sweater；a 後面接單數名詞。

fill.q: It's raining. I need an ___ today.
fill.why: 下雨了需要雨傘 umbrella；它以母音 u 音開頭，前面用 an。

fill.q: We are going to go to the ___ this weekend.
fill.zh: 我們這個週末要去海邊。
fill.why: 去海邊是 go to the beach；the 後面接地點名詞。

fill.q: Let's go to the ___ tomorrow.
fill.why: 去公園是 go to the park；the 後面接地點名詞。

fill.q: We are going to have a ___ on Saturday.
fill.why: 去野餐的固定說法是 have a picnic；a 後面接單數名詞。

fill.q: It's too hot to play ___.
fill.why: play outside 是在外面玩；outside 當副詞，說明在哪裡玩。

fill.q: We are going to stay ___ today because it's raining.
fill.why: 下雨待在室內：stay indoors、inside、in 或 home 都可以；不說 in indoors。

fill.q: I can swim in the ___.
fill.why: 在游泳池游泳是 swim in the pool；the 後面接地點名詞。

fill.q: It is sunny today. Let's ___ to the beach.
fill.why: 前面說天氣晴朗，邀大家去海邊：Let's＋原形動詞 go。

fill.q: I am going ___ study English tonight.
fill.why: be going to 的 to 不能省，後面接原形動詞：going to study。

fill.q: ___ you like to go hiking with us?
fill.why: 客氣地邀請別人，用 Would you like to…？所以句首填 Would。

fill.q: We ___ going to have a picnic on Sunday.
fill.why: We 是複數，be going to 的 be 動詞用 are。

fill.q: I ___ swim, but my brother can.
fill.why: but 後面說哥哥會，前面相反：我不會，用 can't。

fill.q: Would you like ___ join us?
fill.why: 固定說法 Would you like to＋原形動詞，to 不能省：to join us。

fill.q: ___ is going to be cold tomorrow.
fill.why: 講天氣時主詞用 It：It is going to be cold tomorrow.

fill.q: Tom is going to ___ a coat because it is cold.
fill.why: 天冷所以要穿外套，穿衣服用 wear；be going to 後面接原形。

fill.q: Are you going ___ go to the park?
fill.why: be going to 的 to 不能省，後面接原形動詞：going to go。

fill.q: My mother can ___ delicious food.
fill.why: can 後面接原形動詞，不加 s；做菜用 cook 或 make。

fill.q: It is rainy, so we can't ___ hiking.
fill.why: 下雨不能去健行；去健行固定說 go hiking，can't 後面接原形。

fill.q: What ___ you going to do this weekend?
fill.why: 疑問詞 What 開頭，後面主詞 you 配 are：What are you going to do？

fill.q: I am going to ___ my bike in the park.
fill.why: 騎腳踏車的固定說法是 ride a bike；be going to 後面接原形。

fill.q: He ___ going to stay home today.
fill.why: He 是一個人，be going to 的 be 動詞用 is。

fill.q: Would you like to go to the ___ this weekend?
fill.why: 去海邊或公園是 go to the beach／park；the 後面接地點名詞。

fill.q: It is windy. We can ___ a kite.
fill.why: 前面說有風，可以放風箏；放風箏的固定說法是 fly a kite。

fill.q: They ___ not going to play soccer today.
fill.why: 主詞 They 是複數，用 are；否定把 not 放在 are 後面。

fill.q: The weather is ___ today, so I want ice cream.
fill.why: 後面說想吃冰淇淋，線索指向天氣很熱，用形容詞 hot。

fill.q: I am going to ___ at home and read a book.
fill.why: be going to 後面接原形；待在家是 stay at home。

fill.q: ___ she going to come with us?
fill.why: be going to 的問句把 be 動詞放句首；主詞 she 是一個人，用 Is。

fill.q: We can't go to the beach because it is ___.
fill.why: because 後面是不能去海邊的原因；下雨天用形容詞 rainy，也可用 raining。

fill.q: Would you ___ to have coffee with me?
fill.why: 客氣邀請的固定說法是 Would you like to…？所以空格填 like。

fill.q: It ___ going to snow tonight.
fill.why: be going to 也能預測天氣；天氣的主詞用 It，be 動詞用 is。

fill.q: My father can't ___, so we take the bus.
fill.why: 後面說只好搭公車，表示爸爸不會開車：can't＋原形 drive。

fill.q: Let's ___ hiking on Saturday morning.
fill.why: Let's 後面接原形動詞；去健行的固定說法是 go hiking。

fill.q: I ___ going to bring my camera.
fill.why: 主詞 I 只配 am：I am going to bring…。

fill.q: Where ___ you going to go tomorrow?
fill.why: 主詞 you 用 are；問句 Where are you going to go?

fill.q: It is a sunny day. The children can ___ outside.
fill.why: 前面說天氣晴朗，小孩可以在外面玩；can 後面接原形 play。

fill.q: She is going to ___ a picnic in the park.
fill.why: be going to 後面接原形；去野餐的固定說法是 have a picnic。

fill.q: Can your sister ___ a bike?
fill.why: Can 問句後面接原形；騎腳踏車固定說 ride a bike。

fill.q: We are going to meet ___ Saturday.
fill.why: 星期幾前面用 on：on Saturday。

fill.q: It is very cold, so I ___ going to swim.
fill.why: 前面說很冷，所以不打算游泳；I 配 am，否定把 not 放在後面：am not。

fill.q: Would you like to ___ a movie tonight?
fill.why: Would you like to 後面接原形；看電影用 watch 或 see a movie。

fill.q: He can ___ the mountain in three hours.
fill.why: can 後面接原形動詞；爬山是 climb the mountain。

fill.q: They are going to go to the beach ___ bus.
fill.why: 搭交通工具用 by＋交通工具，中間不加 a 或 the：by bus。

fill.q: Sorry, I ___ go with you today. I am busy.
fill.why: 後面說 I am busy，所以今天不能去；不能是 can't 或 cannot＋原形。

fill.q: The weather ___ going to be nice this weekend.
fill.why: The weather 是一件事，be going to 的 be 動詞用 is。

translate.why: 有空用 free；問對方狀態，Are 放句首；這個週末是 this weekend。

a: It is going to rain tomorrow.
translate.why: 天氣用 It 當主詞；看得出來快要發生用 is going to＋原形 rain。

translate.zh: 我這個星期六要去健行。
a: I am going to go hiking this Saturday.
I'm going to go hiking on Saturday.
translate.why: 週末計畫用 am going to＋原形 go；去健行是 go hiking，hiking 加 ing。
問會不會，把 Can 放句首，後面接 you 和原形 swim：Can you swim?
不會開車是沒有這個能力，用 can't 或 cannot 加原形 drive；cannot 要連在一起寫。

a: Would you like to go to the beach?
Do you want to go to the beach?
translate.why: 邀請用 Would you like to 加原形 go；去海邊是 go to the beach，beach 前要加 the。
說天氣用 It 當主詞：It is very hot；今天 today 放句尾。

translate.zh: 我們星期天要去公園野餐。
a: We are going to have a picnic in the park on Sunday.
translate.why: 計畫用 are going to have a picnic；先放地點 in the park，再放時間 on Sunday。

a: He is not going to go out.
He isn't going to go out.
translate.why: 不打算就是 is not going to＋原形；出門是 go out。

translate.zh: 今天風很大，我們可以放風箏。
a: It is windy today, so we can fly a kite.
translate.why: 天氣用 It is windy；可以做某事用 can＋原形 fly；兩句用 so 連接。

a: What are you going to do tomorrow?
translate.why: 問打算做什麼：What are you going to do tomorrow?；疑問句 are 要放在 you 前面。
會煮用 can cook；很好吃的菜寫 delicious food，形容詞放在名詞前面。

translate.zh: 因為下雨，我們不能去打籃球。
a: We can't play basketball because it is rainy.
We can't play basketball because it is raining.
Because it is raining, we can't play basketball.
Because it is rainy, we can't play basketball.
translate.why: 不能用 can't＋原形 play；原因用 because；下雨可說 it is raining 或 it is rainy。

translate.zh: 你想跟我一起看電影嗎？
a: Would you like to watch a movie with me?
Do you want to watch a movie with me?
Would you like to see a movie with me?
Do you want to see a movie with me?
translate.why: 邀請別人用 Would you like to＋原形 watch…?；跟我一起是 with me。

a: I am going to stay home and read a book.
I'm going to stay at home and read a book.
translate.why: 待在家是計畫，用 am going to stay（或 stay at home），再用 and 接 read a book。

a: It is cold, so wear a coat.
It is cold, so remember to wear a coat.
It is cold, so wear a jacket.
It is cold, so remember to wear a jacket.
translate.why: 天氣用 It is cold，so 接結果；叫人做事用原形 wear，記得可寫 remember to wear。

a: They are going to go to Tainan next week.
They are going to Tainan next week.
translate.why: 下星期的計畫用 are going to；going to go to Tainan 可省略成 going to Tainan。

translate.zh: 我哥哥會騎腳踏車，但我不會。
a: My brother can ride a bike, but I can't.
translate.why: 會騎用 can ride，騎腳踏車 ride a bike；後半句不用重複動詞，只寫 but I can't 就好。

a: Is it going to be sunny tomorrow?
translate.why: 天氣用 It 當主詞；問未來的天氣，Is 放句首：Is it going to be sunny…?

a: We are going to meet at eight in the morning.
We are going to meet at 8 a.m.
translate.why: 約好的計畫用 are going to meet；早上八點是 at eight in the morning 或 at 8 a.m.

error.s: I am going to studying English.
error.why: going to 後面要用原形動詞。
error.full: I am going to study English.

error.s: It is going to rains tomorrow.
error.why: going to 後面用原形動詞 rain。
error.full: It is going to rain tomorrow.

error.why: can 的問句直接把 can 放句首。
