reorder.a: She can cook delicious food.
reorder.why: 會煮用 can cook；很好吃的菜寫 delicious food，形容詞放在名詞前面。

reorder.a: We can't play basketball because it is rainy.
reorder.why: 不能用 can't＋原形 play；原因用 because；下雨可說 it is raining 或 it is rainy。

reorder.a: Would you like to watch a movie with me?
reorder.why: 邀請別人用 Would you like to＋原形 watch…?；跟我一起是 with me。

reorder.a: I am going to stay home and read a book.
reorder.why: 待在家是計畫，用 am going to stay（或 stay at home），再用 and 接 read a book。

reorder.a: It is cold, so wear a coat.
reorder.why: 天氣用 It is cold，so 接結果；叫人做事用原形 wear，記得可寫 remember to wear。

reorder.a: They are going to go to Tainan next week.
reorder.why: 下星期的計畫用 are going to；going to go to Tainan 可省略成 going to Tainan。

reorder.a: My brother can ride a bike, but I can't.
reorder.why: 會騎用 can ride，騎腳踏車 ride a bike；後半句不用重複動詞，只寫 but I can't 就好。

reading.title: 短文 1
reading.text: This weekend, the weather is going to be nice. Saturday is going to be sunny and warm, so we are going to go to the beach. We are going to swim in the pool and have a picnic in the park. Sunday is going to be different. The forecast says it is going to be cold and rainy. We are going to stay indoors and watch movies. I need to bring my jacket and umbrella. I am excited about our weekend plans!

qs.q: What is the weather going to be like on Saturday?
qs.why: 原文：Saturday is going to be sunny and warm. 星期六晴朗溫暖。
wn: 又冷又下雨是星期天的天氣，不是星期六。
文中沒提到下雪，星期六是晴天。

qs.q: Where are they going to go on Saturday?
qs.why: 原文：Saturday is going to be sunny... so we are going to go to the beach. 去海邊。
wn: 文中沒提到山上，星期六是去海邊。
這是週末計畫，文中沒提到學校。

qs.q: What are they going to do in the park?
qs.why: 原文：We are going to... have a picnic in the park. 他們要在公園野餐。
wn: 文中沒提到購物，公園裡是野餐。
文中沒提到籃球，公園裡是野餐。

qs.q: What is the weather going to be like on Sunday?
qs.why: 原文：The forecast says it is going to be cold and rainy. 星期天又冷又下雨。
wn: 晴天是星期六，星期天會又冷又下雨。
文中沒提到颳風，星期天是 cold and rainy。

qs.q: What are they going to bring?
qs.why: 原文：I need to bring my jacket and umbrella. 要帶外套和雨傘，因為星期天會冷又下雨。
wn: 文中沒提到相機和地圖，要帶外套和雨傘。
文中沒提到樂器，要帶外套和雨傘。

reading.title: 短文 2
reading.text: Hello. My name is Mia. This weekend is going to be sunny and warm. On Saturday morning, I am going to go hiking with my brother. We can walk for three hours. My brother can take good photos, so he is going to bring his camera. On Sunday, we are going to go to the beach. I can swim, but my brother can't swim. He is going to play volleyball with his friends. Would you like to come with us? Please call me tonight.

qs.q: What is the weather going to be like this weekend?
qs.why: 原文：This weekend is going to be sunny and warm. 這週末晴朗溫暖。
wn: 原文說 sunny and warm，不是又冷又下雨。
原文說 sunny and warm，沒提到颳風涼爽。

qs.q: What is Mia going to do on Saturday morning?
qs.why: 原文：On Saturday morning, I am going to go hiking with my brother. 星期六早上去健行。
wn: 原文說 Saturday morning 要去 hiking，不是待在家。
去海邊是星期天（On Sunday），不是星期六。

qs.q: Who can take good photos?
qs.why: 原文：My brother can take good photos. 會拍照的是 Mia 的兄弟。
wn: Mia 說的是 My brother，不是她自己。
朋友只是一起打排球，會拍照的是 brother。

qs.q: Who can't swim?
qs.why: 原文：I can swim, but my brother can't swim. 不會游泳的是她兄弟。
wn: Mia 說 I can swim，她會游泳。
有人不會：my brother can't swim。

qs.q: What is her brother going to do at the beach?
qs.why: 原文：He is going to play volleyball with his friends. 他在海邊要和朋友打排球。
wn: 文中沒提到看書，他是打排球。
原文說 my brother can't swim，他不會游泳。

reading.title: 短文 3
reading.text: It is Friday night. Tomorrow is going to be rainy and cold in Taipei. Ben and Lily are not going to go to the park. They are going to stay at home. Ben can cook, so he is going to make hot soup for lunch. Lily can't cook, but she can bake a cake. In the afternoon, they are going to watch a movie. On Sunday, the sun is going to come out. Then they are going to ride their bikes by the river.

qs.q: What is the weather going to be like tomorrow?
qs.why: 原文：Tomorrow is going to be rainy and cold in Taipei. 明天又下雨又冷。
wn: 原文說 rainy and cold，不是颳風溫暖。
原文說 rainy and cold；出太陽是星期天。

qs.q: Where are Ben and Lily going to stay tomorrow?
qs.why: 原文：They are going to stay at home. 明天下雨，他們要待在家。
wn: 原文說 not going to go to the park，不去公園。
文中沒提到海邊，他們待在家。

qs.q: Who can cook?
qs.why: 原文：Ben can cook, so he is going to make hot soup for lunch. 會煮飯的是 Ben。
wn: 原文說 Lily can't cook，她會的是烤蛋糕。

qs.q: What can Lily do?
qs.why: 原文：Lily can't cook, but she can bake a cake. Lily 會烤蛋糕。
wn: 文中沒提到開車，Lily 會的是烤蛋糕。
煮湯的是 Ben，Lily can't cook。

qs.q: What are they going to do on Sunday?
qs.why: 原文：On Sunday... they are going to ride their bikes. 星期天去河邊騎腳踏車。
wn: 看電影是明天（星期六）下午的事。
煮湯是明天午餐，不是星期天。

reading.title: 短文 4
reading.text: My family is going to have a picnic next Saturday. The weather is going to be hot and sunny, so we are going to go to the park early. My mother is going to make sandwiches. My father can play the guitar, and he is going to bring it. My little sister can't ride a bike yet, so she is going to walk with me. After lunch, we are going to play badminton. Would you like to join us? There is going to be a lot of food.

qs.q: When is the picnic going to be?
qs.why: 原文：My family is going to have a picnic next Saturday. 野餐在下週六。
wn: 原文說 next Saturday，是星期六不是星期天。
原文說 next Saturday，不是明天。

qs.q: What is the weather going to be like?
qs.why: 原文：The weather is going to be hot and sunny. 天氣會又熱又晴朗。
wn: 原文說 hot and sunny，不是又冷又下雨。
原文說 hot and sunny，不是涼爽有風。

qs.q: Who is going to make sandwiches?
qs.why: 原文：My mother is going to make sandwiches. 做三明治的是媽媽。
wn: 妹妹是要和作者一起走路，不是做三明治。
爸爸是要帶吉他，做三明治的是媽媽。

qs.q: What can the writer's father do?
qs.why: 原文：My father can play the guitar, and he is going to bring it. 爸爸會彈吉他。
wn: 文中只說妹妹 can't ride a bike，沒說爸爸會騎。

qs.q: What are they going to do after lunch?
qs.why: 原文：After lunch, we are going to play badminton. 午餐後打羽毛球。
wn: 文中沒提到游泳，午餐後是打羽毛球。
文中沒說午餐後回家，是打 badminton。

cooked＝煮了。例句：I cooked noodles last night.

call＝打電話。例句：Please call me.
走了路＝walked。例句：I walked to the park yesterday.
eat＝吃。例句：I eat breakfast every morning.
有了；吃了＝had。例句：I had a cat last year.
do＝做。例句：I do my homework every night.
做；製作＝make。例句：I make coffee every morning.

拿；搭乘＝take。例句：I take the bus every day.
bought＝買了。例句：I bought fruit yesterday.
你有沒有…？＝Did you...?。例句：Did you watch TV last night?

forget＝忘記。例句：I forgot my phone yesterday.

回答＝answer。例句：He didn't answer my question.

mc.q: ___ you like to come to my party?
mc.why: 邀請別人來派對用 Would you like to…?，是禮貌的固定說法。
wn: Do you like to come 是問平常喜不喜歡，不是邀請。
Are you like 不成立，are 後面不能直接接動詞 like。

mc.q: Would you like to ___ a movie with me?
mc.why: like to 的 to 後面接原形動詞：to watch a movie。
wn: to 後面要原形，不加 es。
to 後面不接 V-ing，要原形 watch。

mc.q: ___ have dinner together.
mc.why: 提議一起做某事用 Let's（Let us 縮寫），撇號在 t 和 s 中間。
wn: 撇號位置錯了，要寫 Let's。
Let have dinner 少了 us，要用 Let's。

mc.q: Sorry, I ___ busy tomorrow.
mc.why: busy 是形容詞，前面要有 be 動詞；主詞 I 配 am。
wn: is 配 he／she／it，I 用 am。
are 配 you／we／they，I 用 am。

mc.q: Are you ___ tonight?
mc.why: free 是形容詞（有空），放在 be 動詞 Are 後面，不變化。
wn: 形容詞不加 s，free 保持原樣。
形容詞不加 ed，有空就是 free。

mc.q: Would you like to ___ us?
mc.why: like to 的 to 後面接原形動詞：to join。
wn: to 後面要原形，不加 s。
joined 是過去式，to 後面只能接原形。

mc.q: That ___ great!
mc.why: 主詞 That 是一件事（第三人稱單數），動詞加 s：That sounds great!
wn: 主詞 That 是一件事，現在式動詞要加 s。
前面沒有 is，sounding 不能單獨當動詞。

mc.q: ___ go to a café.
mc.why: 提議一起做某事用 Let's，是 Let us 的縮寫，要有撇號。
wn: 少了撇號，Lets 是 let 加 s，意思不同；要寫 Let's。
Let go to a café 少了 us，要用 Let's 才是我們一起。

mc.q: Would you ___ to go to a concert?
mc.why: Would 後面接原形動詞，固定說法是 Would you like to…?
wn: would 後面要原形，不加 s。
would 後面不接 V-ing，要原形 like。

mc.q: Sorry, I'm busy today. Maybe ___ time.
mc.why: 今天很忙去不了，用 Maybe next time.（下次吧）婉拒邀請，是固定說法。
wn: last time 是上次，已經過去了，不能用來約之後。
前面說今天很忙，這次不行，不說 this time，要說 next time。

mc.q: ___ you like to have dinner with me tonight?
mc.why: 邀請別人吃晚餐用 Would you like to…?，Would 放句首。
wn: Do you like to 是問平常喜不喜歡，不是今晚的邀請。
Are you like 不成立，are 後面不能直接接動詞 like。

mc.q: Yes, I ___ love to.
mc.why: 回答 Would you like to…? 的邀請，固定說 Yes, I would love to.
wn: am 是 be 動詞，後面不能直接接 love。
回答 Would you like…? 要用 would 對應。

mc.q: Sorry, I ___ come tonight. I am busy.
mc.why: I am busy 所以不能來；can 的否定是直接加 not：can't。
wn: can 自己就能變否定，不用 don't 幫忙。
not 要放在 can 後面，寫成 can't。

mc.q: Let's ___ at seven o'clock.
mc.why: Let's 後面接原形動詞：Let's meet。
wn: Let's 後面不接 V-ing，要原形 meet。
Let's 後面要原形，不加 s。

mc.q: Are you ___ on Friday night?
mc.why: Are you free? 問有沒有空，be 動詞後面接形容詞 free。
wn: free 是形容詞，前面不加 a；a 後面要接名詞。
freely 是副詞（自由地），不能放在 are 後面表示有空。

mc.q: I am ___ to be busy tomorrow.
mc.why: 未來的說法是 am going to＋原形：I am going to be busy。
wn: am 後面不能直接接 go，要 going to。
am 後面不能接 goes，固定說法是 am going to。

mc.q: Would you like to ___ us for lunch?
mc.why: like to 的 to 後面接原形動詞：to join us。
wn: to 後面要原形，不接 V-ing。
to 後面要原形，不加 s。

mc.q: ___ go to the movies tonight.
mc.why: Let's 是 let us 的縮寫，後面直接接原形動詞：Let's go。
wn: Let's 後面不加 to，直接接 go。
Let's 要有撇號，後面也不加 to。

mc.q: Thank you, but I ___ go. I have class.
mc.why: but 和 I have class 表示要拒絕：要上課所以不能去，用 can't＋原形 go。
wn: can 的否定後面直接接原形，不加 to；可寫 cannot go。
can 的否定直接加 not（can't），不用 don't 幫忙。

mc.q: What time ___ we going to meet?
mc.why: 主詞 we 是複數，be 動詞用 are：What time are we going to meet?
wn: is 配一個人或一件事，we 用 are。
有 going to 要用 be 動詞，不用 do。

mc.q: She ___ going to come to my party.
mc.why: She 是一個人，be 動詞用 is：She is going to come。
wn: am 只配 I，She 要用 is。
are 配 you／we／they，She 一個人用 is。

mc.q: I can meet you ___ six o'clock.
mc.why: 幾點鐘前面用 at：at six o'clock。
wn: on 用在星期幾或日期，例如 on Monday，幾點用 at。
in 用在月份、年份或 in the morning，幾點用 at。

mc.q: ___ we going to have dinner together?
mc.why: 主詞 we 是複數，be going to 的問句把 Are 移到句首：Are we going to…?
wn: going to 前面要用 be 動詞，不能用 Do。
is 配一個人或一件事，主詞 we 是複數要用 are。

mc.q: That ___ great! See you then.
mc.why: 主詞 That 是一件事（第三人稱單數），動詞加 s：That sounds great（聽起來很棒）。
wn: That 是一件事，動詞要加 s 變 sounds。
sounding 前面沒有 is，不能單獨當句子的動詞。

mc.q: I ___ going to be at home tonight.
mc.why: 主詞 I 的 be 動詞是 am：I am going to be at home。

mc.q: Can you ___ me at the station?
mc.why: Can 問句，主詞後面接原形：Can you meet me…?
wn: can 後面直接接原形，不加 to。
can 後面不接 V-ing，要原形 meet。

mc.q: Would you like to go shopping ___ Saturday?
mc.why: 星期幾前面用 on：on Saturday。
wn: in 用在月份、年份、季節，星期幾不用 in。
at 用在幾點，星期幾要用 on。

mc.q: Sorry, I am going to ___ my grandmother tomorrow.
mc.why: going to 後面接原形動詞：going to visit。
wn: going to 後面不接 V-ing，要原形 visit。
going to 後面要原形，不加 s。

mc.q: Let's ___ a movie this weekend.
mc.why: Let's 後面接原形動詞：Let's watch。
wn: Let's 後面要原形，不加 es。
Let's 後面不接 V-ing，要原形 watch。

mc.q: ___ your brother going to come with us?
mc.why: 主詞 your brother 是一個人，be going to 問句用 Is 開頭。
wn: Are 配 you／we／they，your brother 是一個人用 Is。
有 going to 要用 be 動詞開頭，不用 Do。

mc.q: I'm sorry, I can't. I ___ going to work late.
mc.why: 主詞 I 的 be 動詞是 am：I am going to work late。

mc.q: Would you like to ___ a cup of tea?
mc.why: Would you like to 後面接原形；喝杯茶常說 have a cup of tea。
wn: to 後面要原形；has 是配 he／she 的形式。
like to 的 to 後面接原形，不接 V-ing。

mc.q: We ___ going to meet in front of the station.
mc.why: 主詞 We 是複數，be 動詞用 are。
wn: is 配一個人或一件事，We 要用 are。
am 只配 I，We 要用 are。

mc.q: Can we ___ the plan to Sunday?
mc.why: Can 的問句，主詞後面接原形動詞：Can we change…?
wn: can 後面不接 V-ing，要原形 change。
can 後面不加 s，主詞 we 也不加 s。

mc.q: ___ like to come to my birthday party?
mc.why: 邀請別人用 Would you like to…?，would 放在 you 前面。
wn: are 後面不能直接接動詞 like，句子不成立。
do 和 would 不能一起用，直接 Would you 開頭。

mc.q: He can't come ___ he is sick.
mc.why: 他生病是不能來的原因，說原因用 because（因為）。
wn: so 是所以，後面接結果；生病是原因不是結果。
but 是但是，前後意思相反才用。

mc.q: I am going to call you ___ eight tonight.
mc.why: 幾點鐘前面用 at：at eight。
wn: on 用在星期幾或日期，幾點用 at。
in 用在月份、年份或 in the evening，幾點用 at。

mc.q: Would you like to go to the night market ___ me?
mc.why: 和某人一起用 with：with me 跟我一起。
wn: for me 是為了我，不是跟我一起去。
to 表示去的方向，跟某人一起要用 with。

mc.q: Let's meet ___ the coffee shop.
mc.why: 約在某個地點碰面，把地點當成一個點，用 at：meet at the coffee shop。
wn: on 是在表面上（例：on the table），不用來說約在某家店。

mc.q: They are ___ going to come to the party.
mc.why: be going to 的否定在 are 後面加 not：are not going to。
wn: no 不能否定動詞，be 動詞後面用 not。
已經有 are 了，不能再加 don't，用 not。

mc.q: ___ you free next Tuesday?
mc.why: free 是形容詞（有空的），前面要 be 動詞；主詞 you 配 are，問句把 Are 放句首。
wn: is 配 he／she／it，主詞 you 要用 are。
free 是形容詞不是動詞，要用 be 動詞 Are，不用 Do。

mc.q: I can help you ___ Saturday morning.
mc.why: Saturday morning 是某一天的早上，有星期幾就用 on。
wn: in the morning 才用 in；前面加了星期幾就改用 on。
at 用在幾點，例如 at nine，星期幾的早上用 on。

mc.q: Would you like to ___ tennis after work?
mc.why: like to 的 to 後面接原形；打網球說 play tennis。
wn: to 後面不接 V-ing，要原形 play。
to 後面要原形，不加 s。

mc.q: Sorry, I am busy today. ___ we meet on Sunday?
mc.why: 今天沒空，想改約星期天，用 Can we…? 詢問可不可以，後面接原形 meet。
wn: Are 後面不能直接接原形動詞 meet，Are we meet 不對。
Do we meet 是問固定習慣，這裡是在提議改天見面。

mc.q: My friends ___ going to come at six.
mc.why: 主詞 My friends 有 s，是好幾個人，be 動詞用 are。
wn: friends 是複數，不能用 is。
am 只配 I，主詞是 My friends。

mc.q: Let's not ___ late for the movie.
mc.why: Let's not 後面也接原形；late 是形容詞，前面要 be：be late。
wn: Let's not 後面要原形，不接 V-ing。
Let's not 後面直接接原形，不加 to。

mc.q: I ___ going to bring a cake to the party.
mc.why: 主詞是 I，be 動詞用 am。
wn: are 配 you／we／they，I 用 am。
is 配 he／she／it，I 用 am。

mc.q: Would you like to eat Japanese food ___ Chinese food?
mc.why: 問兩個選一個（日本菜還是中國菜），用 or。
wn: and 是兩個都要；問對方選哪一個要用 or。
but 表示轉折（但是），不用在選擇問句。

mc.q: Great! I ___ see you tomorrow at noon.
mc.why: 後面 see 是原形，表示可以見面，用 can。
wn: can 不加 s，任何主詞都一樣。
can 後面直接接原形，不加 to。

fill.q: ___ you like to come to my party?
fill.why: 客氣地邀請別人，用 Would you like to…？所以句首填 Would。

fill.q: ___ have dinner together tonight.
fill.why: 邀大家今晚一起吃晚餐：Let's＋原形動詞 have dinner。

fill.q: Sorry, I am ___ tomorrow.
fill.why: Sorry 表示要拒絕，原因是明天很忙，忙是形容詞 busy。

fill.q: Are you ___ tonight?
fill.why: 約人時問今晚有沒有空，有空是 free；be 動詞 are 後面接形容詞。

fill.q: Would you like to ___ us for lunch?
fill.why: Would you like to 後面接原形；加入我們一起吃午餐是 join us。

fill.q: That ___ great!
fill.why: That sounds great! 是固定說法，意思是聽起來很棒；主詞 That 是一件事，sound 加 s。

fill.q: ___ go to the museum together.
fill.why: 邀大家一起做某事，用 Let's＋原形動詞：Let's go。

fill.q: I want to ___ you to my party.
fill.why: want to 後面接原形；邀請某人來派對是 invite 某人 to the party。

fill.q: Would you like to go to a ___?
fill.why: 邀請去聽音樂會，音樂會是 concert；a 後面接單數名詞。

fill.q: ___ you like to have dinner with me?
fill.why: Would you like to…? 是禮貌邀請：要不要跟我吃晚餐？

fill.q: Yes, I would ___ to.
fill.why: 回答邀請的固定說法：Yes, I would love to.（我很樂意）。

fill.q: Sorry, I ___ come tonight. I am busy.
fill.why: 後面說 I am busy，所以今晚不能來；不能是 can't 或 cannot＋原形。

fill.q: ___ meet at the station at six.
fill.why: 邀對方一起做某事，用 Let's＋原形動詞：Let's meet（我們碰面吧）。

fill.q: Are you ___ this Friday night?
fill.zh: 你這個星期五晚上有空嗎？
fill.why: 約人時問這週五晚上有沒有空，有空是 free。

fill.q: I am going ___ study tonight.
fill.why: be going to 的 to 不能省，後面接原形動詞：going to study。

fill.q: What time are ___ going to meet?
fill.why: are 後面少了主詞；能配 are 的是 we 或 you：What time are we going to…？

fill.q: She ___ going to come to the party.
fill.why: be going to 表示打算要做；She 是一個人，be 動詞用 is。

fill.q: Thank you. That ___ great!
fill.why: That sounds great! 是固定說法：聽起來很棒；That 是一件事，sound 加 s。

fill.q: Can you ___ me in front of the school?
fill.why: Can 後面接原形動詞；約在學校前面見面用 meet。

fill.q: We are going to meet ___ Saturday morning.
fill.why: 星期幾（包括星期六早上）前面用 on：on Saturday morning。

fill.q: I can meet you ___ seven o'clock.
fill.why: 幾點鐘前面用 at：at seven o'clock。

fill.q: ___ we going to eat together tonight?
fill.why: 主詞 we 是複數，be going to 的問句把 Are 放句首。

fill.q: Sorry, I ___ busy tomorrow.
fill.why: 主詞是 I，be 動詞用 am；I am busy 是我很忙。

fill.q: Let's ___ a movie this weekend.
fill.why: Let's 後面接原形動詞；看電影用 watch 或 see a movie。

fill.q: I am going to ___ my grandmother on Sunday.
fill.why: be going to 後面接原形；探望奶奶用 visit 或 see。

fill.q: Would you like ___ come to my house?
fill.why: 固定說法 Would you like to＋原形動詞，to 不能省：to come。

fill.q: He ___ come because he is sick.
fill.why: 後面說他生病了，所以不能來；不能是 can't 或 cannot＋原形。

fill.q: ___ your sister going to join us?
fill.why: be going to 的問句把 be 動詞放句首；your sister 是一個人，用 Is。

fill.q: They ___ going to be late.
fill.why: 主詞 They 是複數，用 are going to be late（會遲到）。

fill.q: I would like to ___ you again next week.
fill.why: would like to 後面接原形動詞；再見到你用 meet 或 see you again。

fill.q: Let's meet ___ the coffee shop near the park.
fill.why: 在某個地點碰面用 at：at the coffee shop；指在店裡面也可以用 in。

fill.q: Would you like to play tennis ___ me?
fill.why: 和某人一起做事用 with：play tennis with me。

fill.q: I ___ not going to work on Sunday.
fill.why: 主詞 I 只配 am，否定把 not 放後面：am not going to。

fill.q: Can we ___ the time to eight o'clock?
fill.why: Can 後面接原形；把時間改成八點是 change the time to eight。

fill.q: Would you like a cup ___ tea?
fill.why: 茶不能直接數，要用杯子算：a cup of tea，cup 和 tea 中間要有 of。

fill.q: I am going to ___ you tonight at nine.
fill.zh: 我今晚九點會打電話給你。
fill.why: am going to 後面接原形動詞；打電話給某人說 call you。

fill.q: Sorry, I ___ go with you. I have class.
fill.why: 後面說要上課，所以不能一起去；不能是 can't 或 cannot＋原形。

fill.q: ___ is going to be a party on Friday.
fill.why: 講將會有一個派對，用 There is going to be…（將會有）。

fill.q: We ___ going to have dinner at my house.
fill.why: We 是複數，be going to 的 be 動詞用 are。

fill.q: Let's ___ hiking next Saturday.
fill.why: Let's 後面接原形動詞；去健行的固定說法是 go hiking。

fill.q: I can't come, ___ thank you for asking.
fill.why: 前面說不能來，後面卻道謝，意思轉了一個彎，用 but（但是）。

fill.q: ___ you like to go shopping with me?
fill.why: 客氣地邀請別人，用 Would you like to…？所以句首填 Would。

fill.q: My friends are going to ___ at seven.
fill.why: be going to 後面接原形；到達用 arrive，也可以說 come。

fill.q: It is going to ___ fun!
fill.why: be going to 後面接原形動詞，is 的原形是 be：going to be fun。

fill.q: I am ___ to bring a cake.
fill.why: 句型是 am going to＋原形動詞，表示打算帶蛋糕，所以空格填 going。

fill.q: Would you like to eat pizza ___ noodles?
fill.why: 問對方二選一，用 or（還是）：pizza or noodles。

fill.q: Great! I ___ see you tomorrow at noon.
fill.why: 答應見面，可用 can（可以、有空）或 will＋原形 see。

translate.zh: 你今天晚上想跟我一起吃飯嗎？
a: Would you like to have dinner with me tonight?
Do you want to have dinner with me tonight?
Would you like to eat dinner with me tonight?
Do you want to eat dinner with me tonight?
translate.why: 邀請用 Would you like to have dinner；跟我一起 with me，今天晚上 tonight 放最後。
接受邀請的固定說法：I would love to，可縮成 I'd love to；to 後面不用再接動詞。
現在的狀態用 be 動詞，主詞 I 用 am：I am busy；Sorry 後面加逗點。

translate.zh: 我們六點在車站見面吧。
a: Let's meet at the station at six.
Let's meet at six at the station.
translate.why: 提議用 Let's＋原形 meet；地點 at the station 和時間 at six 都用 at。

a: Are you free on Friday night?
translate.why: 有沒有空用 be 動詞加 free：Are you free?；星期幾前面用 on：on Friday night。

a: Would you like to join us?
Would you like to come with us?
Do you want to come with us?
Do you want to join us?
translate.why: 邀請別人一起用 Would you like to join us? 或 come with us?
不能去用 can't 加原形 go；對不起可以用 Sorry 或 I'm sorry 開頭，後面加逗號。

a: I am going to visit my grandmother tomorrow.
I am going to see my grandmother tomorrow.
I am going to visit my grandma tomorrow.
I am going to see my grandma tomorrow.
translate.why: 明天的計畫用 am going to＋原形；去看奶奶用 visit 或 see 都可以。
提議一起做某事用 Let's＋原形；看電影可以說 go to the movies 或 watch a movie。

a: Can you come to my house at seven?
translate.why: 請別人做事用 Can you＋原形 come…?；來我家是 come to my house。
回應別人的提議說 That sounds great!；sound 是聽起來，主詞 That 一件事要加 s。

translate.zh: 我要帶一個蛋糕去派對。
a: I am going to bring a cake to the party.
I'm going to bring a cake to the party.
translate.why: 已決定的計畫用 am going to bring；一個蛋糕 a cake；帶去派對是 to the party，要有 the。

a: He is sick, so he can't come.
translate.why: 先說原因 He is sick（生病用 be 動詞加 sick），再用 so 接結果：he can't come。

a: Would you like a cup of tea?
Do you want a cup of tea?
Would you like to have a cup of tea?
translate.why: 請對方喝東西用 Would you like＋東西：a cup of tea，不用加 drink。

translate.zh: 我們可以改到星期天嗎？
a: Can we change it to Sunday?
Can we meet on Sunday instead?
translate.why: 徵求同意用 Can we…?；改到星期天是 change it to Sunday。

translate.zh: 我今天晚上要工作到很晚。
a: I am going to work late tonight.
translate.why: 今晚的計畫用 am going to＋原形；工作到很晚是 work late，late 放動詞後面。

a: What time are we going to meet?
translate.why: 問幾點用 What time 開頭，接 are we going to＋原形 meet。

translate.zh: 我要邀請我的朋友來我的生日派對。
a: I am going to invite my friends to my birthday party.
translate.why: 打算做的事用 am going to＋原形 invite；邀請來派對是 invite…to my party。
Thank you for 後面接動詞要加 ing：for inviting；被邀請的是我，用受詞 me 放最後。
道別說 See you＋時間：See you tomorrow!，不用加 I。

error.s: Would you like coming to my party?
error.correct: Would you like to come to my party?
error.why: Would you like 後面接 to + 原形動詞。

error.s: Do you would like to have dinner?
error.correct: Would you like to have dinner?
error.why: Would 本身就是助動詞，不用加 do。

error.s: I am going to meeting you at six.
error.why: going to 後面用原形動詞 meet。
error.full: I am going to meet you at six.

error.s: Sorry, I not can come tonight.
error.correct: Sorry, I can't come tonight.
error.why: can 的否定是 can't，not 要放在 can 後面。

error.s: Let's to go to the movies.
error.correct: Let's go to the movies.
error.why: Let's 後面直接接原形動詞。

error.s: She are going to join us.
error.why: 主詞 She 要用 is。
error.full: She is going to join us.

error.s: Would you like to played tennis?
error.why: to 後面要用原形動詞 play。
error.full: Would you like to play tennis?

error.s: I going to call you tonight.
error.correct: I am going to call you tonight.
error.why: be going to 不能少了 am。

error.s: Can we to meet on Sunday?
error.correct: Can we meet on Sunday?
error.why: can 後面不加 to。

error.s: What time we are going to meet?
error.correct: What time are we going to meet?
error.why: 疑問句要把 are 放在主詞前面。

error.s: He can't comes to the party.
error.why: can't 後面用原形動詞 come。
error.full: He can't come to the party.

error.s: Are you going to free tomorrow?
error.correct: Are you going to be free tomorrow?
error.why: free 是形容詞，前面需要 be。

error.s: I am going to not go to the party.
error.correct: I am not going to go to the party.
error.why: not 要放在 am 後面。

error.s: Would you like join us for lunch?
error.correct: Would you like to join us for lunch?
error.why: like 後面漏了 to。

error.s: They is going to be late.
error.why: 主詞 They 要用 are。
error.full: They are going to be late.

reading.title: 短文 1
reading.text: Amy calls her friend Ben. 'Would you like to come to my party on Saturday?' she asks. Ben says, 'Sure, I would love to! What time?' Amy says, 'Seven o'clock. Let's have dinner together first.' Ben says, 'Sounds great!' Then Amy asks, 'Are you free on Sunday too? Would you like to go to the museum?' Ben says, 'Sorry, I am busy on Sunday. Maybe next time.' Amy says, 'That's okay. Let's hang out next week instead.' Ben says, 'Great idea!'

qs.q: What does Amy invite Ben to on Saturday?
qs.why: 原文：Would you like to come to my party on Saturday? Amy 先邀 Ben 參加星期六的派對。
wn: 文中沒提到音樂會，Amy 邀的是派對。
博物館是 Amy 邀 Ben 星期天（Sunday）去的，不是星期六。

qs.q: What time is the party?
qs.why: 原文：Amy says, 'Seven o'clock.' Ben 問幾點，Amy 回答七點。
wn: 原文說 Seven o'clock，是七點。
原文說 Seven o'clock，是七點。

qs.q: What are they going to do before the party?
qs.why: 原文：Let's have dinner together first. first 表示先一起吃晚餐。
wn: 文中沒提到看電影，先做的是吃晚餐。
文中沒提到購物，先做的是吃晚餐。

qs.q: Is Ben free on Sunday?
qs.why: 原文：Ben says, 'Sorry, I am busy on Sunday.' 星期天 Ben 很忙。
wn: Ben 說 I am busy on Sunday，他沒空。
Ben 說得很清楚：I am busy on Sunday。

qs.q: What do they plan to do next week?
qs.why: 原文：Let's hang out next week instead. 改成下週一起出去玩。
wn: 博物館是 Amy 問星期天的，Ben 沒空。
派對是這星期六，下週是 hang out。

reading.title: 短文 2
reading.text: Hi Anna. My birthday is next Saturday. I am going to have a small party at my house. It is going to start at six in the evening. My mother is going to make noodles and a big cake. My brother can play the guitar, so we are going to sing together. Would you like to come? Please bring your sister, too. I am going to invite five friends. Sorry, we can't play music after ten. Please call me before Friday. Thank you! Lucy

qs.q: When is the party going to be?
qs.why: 原文：My birthday is next Saturday. I am going to have a small party. 派對在下週六。
wn: 原文說 next Saturday，是星期六不是星期天。
星期五是請 Anna 回電的期限，不是派對日。

qs.q: What time is the party going to start?
qs.why: 原文：It is going to start at six in the evening. 晚上六點開始。
wn: 原文說 in the evening，是晚上不是早上。
十點是不能再放音樂的時間，不是開始時間。

qs.q: Who can play the guitar?
qs.why: 原文：My brother can play the guitar. 寫信的是 Lucy，所以是 Lucy 的兄弟會彈吉他。
wn: 媽媽是要煮麵和做蛋糕，不是彈吉他。
Anna 的姊妹只是被邀請，文中沒說她會彈吉他。

qs.q: How many friends is Lucy going to invite?
qs.why: 原文：I am going to invite five friends. 要邀請五位朋友。
wn: 六是派對開始的時間（六點），朋友是五位。
十是十點不能放音樂，朋友是五位。

qs.q: What can't they do after ten?
qs.why: 原文：Sorry, we can't play music after ten. 十點以後不能放音樂。
wn: 文中說不能的是 play music，沒說不能唱歌。
文中沒限制吃蛋糕，十點後不能的是放音樂。

reading.title: 短文 3
reading.text: Mark wants to see a movie on Friday night. He calls his friend Jen. "Would you like to see a movie with me?" he asks. Jen says, "Sorry, I can't. I am going to work late on Friday." Mark asks, "Are you free on Saturday?" Jen says, "Yes, I am. I would love to go." They are going to meet in front of the cinema at seven. Mark is going to buy the tickets. Jen can't drive, so she is going to take the bus.

qs.q: What does Mark want to do?
qs.why: 原文：Mark wants to see a movie on Friday night. Mark 想看電影。
wn: 文中沒提到健行，Mark 想看電影。
文中沒提到吃晚餐，Mark 想看電影。

qs.q: Why can't Jen come on Friday?
opts: She is going to work late
qs.why: 原文：Sorry, I can't. I am going to work late on Friday. 星期五要加班。
wn: 文中沒說生病，原因是要 work late。
文中沒說上課，原因是要工作到很晚。

qs.q: What day are they going to meet?
qs.why: 原文：Are you free on Saturday? Jen says, Yes, I am. 他們改約星期六。
wn: Jen 星期五要加班，所以沒約星期五。
文中沒提到星期天，他們約星期六。

qs.q: Where are they going to meet?
qs.why: 原文：They are going to meet in front of the cinema at seven. 在電影院前面碰面。
wn: Jen 只是搭公車去，碰面地點是電影院前。
文中沒說去 Jen 家，是電影院前面。

qs.q: How is Jen going to go there?
qs.why: 原文：Jen can't drive, so she is going to take the bus. Jen 搭公車去。
wn: 原文說 Jen can't drive，她不會開車。
文中沒說走路，她是搭公車（take the bus）。

reading.title: 短文 4
reading.text: Emma and Kate are classmates. On Monday, Emma says, "Would you like to study English with me this week?" Kate says, "Yes! When are you free?" Emma is going to be busy on Tuesday and Wednesday. Kate can't come on Thursday. So they are going to meet on Friday afternoon at the library. Emma can bring two dictionaries. Kate is going to bring her notebook and some snacks. They are going to study for two hours. After that, they are going to have dinner together.

qs.q: What are the girls going to do together?
qs.why: 原文：Would you like to study English with me this week? 兩人要一起讀英文。
wn: 文中沒提到網球，她們是一起讀英文。
文中沒提到電影，她們是一起讀英文。

qs.q: When is Emma going to be busy?
qs.why: 原文：Emma is going to be busy on Tuesday and Wednesday. Emma 星期二和星期三很忙。
wn: 星期五是她們見面讀書的日子，Emma 有空。
星期一 Emma 在約 Kate，文中沒說她忙。

qs.q: When are they going to meet?
qs.why: 原文：So they are going to meet on Friday afternoon at the library. 星期五下午見面。
wn: 星期一只是 Emma 開口約，不是見面時間。
原文說 Kate can't come on Thursday，星期四不行。

qs.q: What is Kate going to bring?
qs.why: 原文：Kate is going to bring her notebook and some snacks. Kate 帶筆記本和零食。
wn: 帶兩本字典的是 Emma，不是 Kate。
文中沒提到吉他，Kate 帶筆記本和零食。

qs.q: What are they going to do after studying?
qs.why: 原文：After that, they are going to have dinner together. 讀完書後一起吃晚餐。
wn: 文中說 After that 是一起吃晚餐，不是回家。
文中沒提到購物，讀完書是一起吃晚餐。

來＝come。例句：She comes to my house every week.

買了＝bought。例句：I bought fruit yesterday.
Did you...?＝你有沒有…？。例句：Did you watch TV last night?
任何事物＝anything。例句：I didn't do anything yesterday.
late＝遲；晚。例句：He comes home late on Friday.
忘記＝forget。例句：I forgot my phone yesterday.
rain＝下雨。例句：Did it rain yesterday?
開始＝start。例句：Did the movie start at seven?
answer＝回答。例句：He didn't answer my question.
週末＝weekend。例句：Are you free this weekend?
park＝公園。例句：There is a park near my house.
朋友＝friend。例句：I met my friend on Sunday.
mountain＝山。例句：We climbed a mountain on Saturday.
咖啡店＝coffee shop。例句：I met my friend at a coffee shop.
birthday party＝生日派對。例句：We went to a birthday party.
游泳＝swim。例句：I swam at the pool on Sunday.
rode＝騎了。例句：I rode a bike last Saturday.
拜訪＝visit。例句：We visited our grandmother.
vacation＝假期。例句：I went to Japan on vacation.
首先＝first。例句：First, I woke up early.
wn: happen 是「發生（過去式 happened）」

vocab_review.why: after that＝之後。例句：After that, we had lunch.
停留；住＝stay。例句：We stayed at a hotel.
enjoyed＝享受了。例句：We enjoyed the food there.
找到＝find。例句：I find my keys every morning.
happen＝發生（過去式 happened）。例句：What happened last night?
今晚＝tonight。例句：She is going to cook dinner tonight.
next year＝明年。例句：They are going to travel to Japan next year.
讀書；學習＝study。例句：There is a desk in the study.

vocab_review.why: meet＝見面。例句：Nice to meet you again.

English＝英文。例句：Can you speak English?

paint＝畫畫(顏料)。例句：She can paint beautiful pictures.
使用＝use。例句：I can use a computer.
reading＝閱讀。例句：My hobby is reading books.
籃球＝basketball。例句：I can play basketball well.
photography＝攝影。例句：I am interested in photography.
露營＝camping。例句：We are going to go camping this weekend.
gardening＝園藝。例句：My mother enjoys gardening every morning.
看電影＝watching movies。例句：My hobby is watching movies.
wn: happen 是「發生（過去式 happened）」

晴朗的＝sunny。例句：Tomorrow is going to be sunny.
windy＝有風的。例句：It is very windy outside.
熱的＝hot。例句：It was hot last week.

pool＝游泳池。例句：I can swim in the pool.

mc.q: We ___ going to go on a trip.
mc.why: 主詞 We 是複數，be 動詞用 are。
wn: is 配一個人或一件事，We 用 are。
am 只配 I，We 用 are。

mc.q: I am going to ___ a ticket.
mc.why: going to 後面接原形動詞：going to buy。
wn: going to 後面要原形，不加 s。
bought 是過去式，going to 後面只能接原形。

mc.q: Can you ___ a map?
mc.why: Can 問句，主詞後接原形動詞：Can you read a map?
wn: Can 句子裡動詞用原形，不加 s。
Can 後面的動詞要原形，不接 V-ing。

mc.q: Our flight is going to ___ at noon.
mc.why: going to 後面接原形動詞：going to leave。
wn: going to 後面要原形，不加 s。
left 是過去式，going to 後面只能接原形。

mc.q: ___ you like to join the tour?
mc.why: 邀請別人參加用 Would you like to…?，是禮貌的固定說法。
wn: Do you like to join 是問平常喜不喜歡，不是邀請。
不說 Can you like，邀請要說 Would you like。

mc.q: I can ___ a suitcase by myself.
mc.why: can 後面接原形動詞 carry（自己提得動行李箱）。
wn: can 後面的動詞不加 es。
can 後面不能用過去式，要用原形。

mc.q: We are going to ___ at the hotel.
mc.why: be going to 後面接原形動詞：are going to stay。
wn: going to 後面的動詞不加 s。
going to 說未來，不能接過去式。

mc.q: Let's ___ a taxi to the airport.
mc.why: Let's 後面接原形；搭計程車說 take a taxi。
wn: Let's 後面要原形，不加 s。
Let's 後面不接 V-ing，要原形 take。

mc.q: When ___ you going to return?
mc.why: 主詞 you 配 are；有 going to 要用 be 動詞：When are you…?
wn: is 配 he／she／it，主詞 you 用 are。
有 going to 要用 be 動詞，不用 do。

mc.q: I am not going to ___ my passport.
mc.why: am not going to 後面接原形 forget，表示不會忘記。
wn: going to 後面要原形，不加 s。
forgot 是過去式；going to 後面只能接原形。

mc.q: My family ___ going to take a trip to Japan next month.
mc.why: My family 當成一個家庭（單數），be 動詞用 is。
wn: be 是原形，不能直接當句子的動詞，要變成 is。

mc.q: ___ you like to see my photos?
mc.why: 客氣地問對方想不想做某事，用 Would you like to…?
wn: Do you like…? 是問平常喜不喜歡，不是邀請。
like 是動詞，前面不用 be 動詞 Are。

mc.q: We are going to ___ hard for the test.
mc.why: going to 後面接原形動詞：going to study。
wn: going to 後面不接 V-ing，要原形 study。
going to 後面要原形，不用 studies。

mc.q: He ___ going to buy a new bike next week.
mc.why: 主詞 He 是一個人，be 動詞用 is。
wn: am 只配 I，He 用 is。
are 配 you／we／they，He 用 is。

mc.q: Can your father ___ Japanese?
mc.why: Can 問句裡，動詞用原形：Can your father speak…?
wn: can 後面不加 s，就算主詞是 your father。
can 後面直接接原形，不加 to。

mc.q: They ___ going to move to Taichung.
mc.why: 主詞 They 是複數，be 動詞用 are：are going to move。
wn: is 配單數，They 是複數。

mc.q: I am going to ___ my English every day.
mc.why: going to 後面接原形動詞：going to practice。
wn: going to 後面要原形，不加 s。
going to 後面不接 V-ing，要原形 practice。

mc.q: ___ she going to start a new job?
mc.why: 主詞 she 是一個人，be going to 問句用 Is 開頭。
wn: Are 配 you／we／they，she 用 Is。
有 going to 要用 be 動詞開頭，不用 Do。

mc.q: Would you like to ___ this book?
mc.why: like to 的 to 後面接原形動詞：to read。
wn: to 後面要原形，不接 V-ing。
to 後面要原形，不加 s。

mc.q: I ___ play the piano, but I can sing.
mc.why: 線索是 but I can sing：前後相反，前半是不會彈，用 can't。
wn: 英文否定不說 no can，要說 can't。
can 的否定直接加 not，寫成 can't，不用 don't。

mc.q: What are you going to do ___ Monday?
mc.why: 星期幾前面用 on：on Monday。
wn: in 用在月份、年份、季節，例如 in May，星期幾不用 in。
at 用在幾點，例如 at six，星期幾要用 on。

mc.q: Sam and I ___ going to run in the morning.
mc.why: Sam and I 是兩個人，等於 we，be 動詞用 are。
wn: is 配一個人；Sam and I 是兩個人。
am 只配 I 自己；主詞是 Sam and I 兩個人。

mc.q: We can ___ the train at eight.
mc.why: can 後面接原形；搭火車說 take the train。
wn: can 後面不接 V-ing，要原形 take。
can 後面不加 s，主詞 we 也不加。

mc.q: My mother is going to ___ me at the airport.
mc.why: going to 後面接原形動詞：going to meet。
wn: going to 後面不接 V-ing，要原形 meet。
going to 後面要原形，不加 s。

mc.q: I am not going to ___ TV tonight.
mc.why: 否定的 am not going to 後面一樣接原形：watch TV。
wn: going to 後面不接 ing，要用原形。
going to 後面的動詞不加 es。

mc.q: ___ they going to come back on Sunday?
mc.why: be going to 的問句 be 動詞放前面；they 是複數，用 Are。
wn: going to 前面要 be 動詞，不用 Do。
Is 配單數，they 是複數。

mc.q: She can ___ a car, but she can't ride a bike.
mc.why: can 後面接原形；開車說 drive a car。
wn: can 後面不加 s，主詞 she 也一樣。
can 後面不接 V-ing，要原形 drive。

mc.q: Would you like to ___ the museum with me?
mc.why: like to 的 to 後面接原形動詞：to visit。
wn: to 後面要原形，不接 V-ing。
to 後面要原形，不加 s。

mc.q: I ___ going to be a nurse.
mc.why: 主詞是 I，be 動詞用 am。
wn: are 配 you／we／they，I 用 am。
is 配 he／she／it，I 用 am。

mc.q: He is going to ___ a new phone next month.
mc.why: be going to 後面接原形動詞，主詞是 He 也不加 s：is going to buy。
wn: going to 後面要原形，不能加 s。
going to 的 to 後面接原形 buy，不接 ing。

mc.q: Can you ___ me with my homework?
mc.why: Can 問句，主詞後接原形：Can you help me…?
wn: Can 句子裡動詞用原形，不加 s。
Can 後面的動詞要原形，不接 V-ing。

mc.q: Next year, we ___ going to learn Japanese.
mc.why: 主詞 we 是複數，be 動詞用 are。
wn: am 只配 I，we 用 are。
is 配一個人或一件事，we 用 are。

mc.q: I ___ going to work tomorrow. It is a holiday.
mc.why: 放假所以不上班；be going to 的否定：I am not going to。
wn: not 要放在 am 後面：am not。
句中有 going to，用 am not 否定，不用 don't。

mc.q: ___ your plan for this summer?
mc.why: 問計畫是什麼用 What；主詞 your plan 是一個，用 is。
wn: plan 是單數一個計畫，be 動詞用 is，不用 are。
How 問狀況好不好；問計畫內容是什麼要用 What。

mc.q: Lisa can ___ the guitar very well.
mc.why: can 後面接原形；彈吉他說 play the guitar。
wn: can 後面不接 V-ing，要原形 play。
can 後面不加 s，Lisa 也一樣。

mc.q: They are going to ___ dinner at seven.
mc.why: be going to 後面接原形動詞：are going to have dinner。
wn: going to 後面不接 ing，要用原形 have。
going to 後面用原形；They 也不配 has。

mc.q: Would you like ___ practice English with me?
mc.why: would like 後面接 to 加原形動詞：Would you like to practice…?（想不想…）
wn: would like 後面接動詞要用 to，不用 for。
at 用在地點或時間，would like 接動詞要用 to。

mc.q: I can't ___ tonight. I have a lot of work.
mc.why: can't 後面接原形動詞：can't come。
wn: can't 後面不接 V-ing，要原形 come。
can't 後面要原形，不加 s。

mc.q: My brother ___ going to study in Canada.
mc.why: 主詞 My brother 是一個人，be 動詞用 is。
wn: are 配 you／we／they，My brother 用 is。
am 只配 I，My brother 用 is。

mc.q: We are going to ___ our grandparents this weekend.
mc.why: be going to 後面接原形動詞：are going to visit。
wn: going to 後面的動詞不加 s。
going to 後面不接 ing，要用原形。

mc.q: Can she ___ early tomorrow?
mc.why: Can 問句，主詞後接原形動詞：Can she get up…?
wn: Can 後面的動詞要原形，不接 V-ing。
Can 句子裡動詞用原形，she 也不加 s。

mc.q: I am going to ___ a letter to my friend.
mc.why: going to 後面接原形動詞：going to write。
wn: going to 後面要原形，不加 s。
going to 後面不接 V-ing，要原形 write。

mc.q: ___ he going to join the English club?
mc.why: be going to 的問句把 be 動詞放前面；he 是一個人，用 Is。
wn: Are 配 you、we、they，he 要用 Is。
going to 前面要 be 動詞，不用 Do。

mc.q: We ___ not going to take a taxi.
mc.why: 主詞 We 是複數用 are，否定把 not 放在 are 後面。
wn: is 配單數，We 是複數。

mc.q: Would you like to ___ some water?
mc.why: Would you like to 的 to 後面接原形動詞：to drink。
wn: to 後面要原形，不接 V-ing。
to 後面要原形，不加 s。

mc.why: be going to 後面接原形動詞；get up 是起床：am going to get up。
wn: to 後面接原形 get，不接 ing。
going to 後面要原形，不加 s。

mc.q: How ___ you going to go to Taipei?
mc.why: 句中有 going to，前面要 be 動詞；主詞是 you，所以用 are。
wn: is 配 he／she／it 一個人或一件事，主詞 you 要用 are。
be going to 的問句把 be 動詞提前，不用 do。

mc.q: She can't ___ tonight because she is tired.
mc.why: can't 後面接原形動詞 study：她累了，今晚不能讀書。
wn: can't 後面的動詞不加 es。
can't 後面不接 ing，要用原形。

fill.q: We are going to go on a ___.
fill.why: 去旅行的固定說法是 go on a trip；a 後面接單數名詞 trip。

fill.q: I am going to buy a ___.
fill.why: a 後面接單數可數名詞；買票說 buy a ticket。

fill.q: Don't forget your ___.
fill.why: 出國別忘了帶護照，護照是 passport；your 後面接名詞。

fill.q: We are going to stay at a ___.
fill.why: 旅行住在飯店是 stay at a hotel；a 後面接單數名詞。

fill.q: Our flight is going to ___ at noon.
fill.zh: 我們的班機中午要出發。
fill.why: 講班機中午起飛，離開用 leave；be going to 後面接原形。

fill.q: Can you ___ a map?
fill.why: Can 後面接原形；看地圖的固定說法是 read a map。

fill.q: We are going to take the ___ to the city.
fill.why: the 後面接名詞；搭火車去市區說 take the train。

fill.q: I am going to pack my ___ tonight.
fill.why: 打包行李是 pack my suitcase，也可說 bag(s) 或 luggage；my 後面接名詞。

fill.q: I am going to buy a ___ for my friend.
fill.zh: 我要買一個紀念品給我的朋友。
fill.why: 旅行時買給朋友的紀念品叫 souvenir；a 後面接一個單數名詞。

fill.q: When are you going to ___ home?
fill.why: be going to 後面接原形；回家可說 come、go、get 或 return home。

fill.q: I ___ going to visit my aunt next week.
fill.why: 主詞 I 只配 am：I am going to visit…。

fill.q: ___ you like to come to the museum with us?
fill.why: 客氣地邀請別人，用 Would you like to…？所以句首填 Would。

fill.q: We are going ___ take a trip to Japan.
fill.why: be going to 是固定組合，going 後面一定要接 to，再接原形 take。

fill.q: He is going to ___ a new bike next month.
fill.why: be going to 後面接原形；買新腳踏車用 buy 或 get。

fill.q: I can't ___ the piano, but I can sing.
fill.why: 彈鋼琴用 play the piano；can't 後面接原形。

fill.q: ___ she going to move to Taichung?
fill.why: be going to 的問句把 be 動詞放句首；she 是一個人，用 Is。

fill.q: They ___ going to study together tonight.
fill.why: They 是複數，be going to 的 be 動詞用 are。

fill.q: I am going to ___ English every day.
fill.why: be going to 後面接原形；練習英文用 practice 或 study。

fill.q: My father ___ drive, but my mother can't.
fill.why: but 後面說媽媽不會，前面相反：爸爸會，用 can。

fill.q: What ___ you going to do next Monday?
fill.why: 主詞 you 用 are；問句 What are you going to do?

fill.q: Let's ___ a plan for the summer.
fill.why: Let's 後面接原形動詞；訂計畫的固定說法是 make a plan。

fill.q: We can ___ the train at eight o'clock.
fill.why: can 後面接原形；搭火車說 take the train，也可以說 catch the train。

fill.q: She is going to ___ me at the airport.
fill.why: is going to 後面接原形動詞；meet me at the airport 是去機場接我。

fill.q: I am ___ going to watch TV tonight.
fill.why: be going to 的否定，把 not 放在 am 後面：am not going to。

fill.q: ___ they going to come back on Sunday?
fill.why: be going to 的問句把 be 動詞放句首；they 是複數，用 Are。

fill.q: Would you like ___ practice English with me?
fill.why: Would you like 後面接動作時要加 to：like to practice。

fill.q: He can speak Japanese ___ English.
fill.why: 兩種語言都會，用 and（和）把 Japanese 跟 English 連起來。

fill.q: Next year, I am going to ___ a new job.
fill.why: be going to 後面接原形；找新工作是 find 或 get a new job。

fill.q: ___ is going to be my birthday next Friday.
fill.why: 講日期、生日用 It 當主詞：It is going to be my birthday.

fill.q: We are going to have dinner ___ seven.
fill.why: 在幾點鐘用介系詞 at：at seven。

fill.q: Can she ___ up early tomorrow?
fill.why: Can 問句後面接原形；早起是 get up early 或 wake up early。

fill.q: I am going to ___ a letter to my friend.
fill.why: am going to 後面接原形動詞；寫信用 write，寄信用 send。

fill.q: My sister ___ going to be a nurse.
fill.why: My sister 是一個人，be going to 的 be 動詞用 is。

fill.q: You ___ use my computer.
fill.why: 允許別人做某事用 can（可以）＋原形：You can use my computer.

fill.q: We ___ not going to take a taxi.
fill.why: We 是複數，be 動詞用 are；否定把 not 放在 are 後面。

fill.q: How ___ you going to go to Taipei?
fill.why: 疑問詞 How 後面接問句語序，主詞 you 配 are：How are you going to go…？

fill.q: She can't come ___ she is tired.
fill.why: 後面 she is tired 是不能來的原因，用 because（因為）。

fill.q: I am going to get ___ at six tomorrow.
fill.why: 起床是 get up，固定搭配，get 後面要接 up。

fill.q: They are going to ___ their grandparents this weekend.
fill.why: be going to 後面接原形；探望祖父母用 visit 或 see。

fill.q: Would you like ___ cup of coffee?
fill.why: cup 可以數，一杯就用 a：a cup of coffee。

fill.q: He is going to study ___ Canada next year.
fill.why: 在某個國家或城市裡面用 in：in Canada。

fill.q: I can ___ a little English.
fill.why: can 後面接原形動詞；說一種語言用 speak，例：speak English。

fill.q: We are going to move ___ a new house.
fill.why: 搬到新家用 move to，也可以用 move into（搬進）：move into a new house。

fill.q: ___ you going to be busy tomorrow?
fill.why: be going to 的問句把 be 動詞放句首；you 配 Are。

fill.q: My plan ___ going to change.
fill.why: My plan 是一件事，be going to 的 be 動詞用 is。

fill.q: Let's ___ English together every Friday.
fill.why: Let's 後面接原形動詞；一起讀英文用 study 或 practice。

fill.q: Don't worry. I ___ going to be late for the meeting.
fill.why: Don't worry 表示不用擔心，所以是否定；I 配 am，not 放後面：am not。

fill.q: Can your brother ___ a car?
fill.why: Can 問句後面接原形動詞；開車是 drive a car。

fill.q: They are going to ___ home at nine.
fill.why: be going to 後面接原形；回家說 go home 或 come home，home 前不加 to。

a: What are you going to do next week?
translate.why: 問計畫用 What 開頭，接 are you going to do；next week 前面不加 on。

translate.zh: 我下個月要去日本旅行。
a: I am going to take a trip to Japan next month.
I'm going to travel to Japan next month.
translate.why: 下個月的計畫用 am going to；去旅行是 take a trip to 或 travel to Japan。

a: I can speak a little English.
translate.why: 會說用 can speak，speak 用原形；一點英文是 a little English。

translate.zh: 你想跟我一起練習英文嗎？
a: Would you like to practice English with me?
Do you want to practice English with me?
translate.why: 邀請用 Would you like to 加原形 practice；跟我一起是 with me，放在 English 後面。

a: She is going to be a nurse next year.
translate.why: 明年的打算用 is going to；當護士是 be a nurse，be 不能省略，nurse 前要加 a。
不會用 can't 或 cannot＋原形 play；彈樂器要加 the：the piano。

a: We are going to study together.
translate.why: 計畫用 are going to＋原形 study；一起是 together，放句尾。

a: Can you help me with my homework?
translate.why: 請別人幫忙用 Can you help me…?；幫某人做功課是 help me with my homework。

a: They are not going to come back on Sunday.
translate.why: 預定不做的事用 are not going to＋原形 come back；星期天前面用 on。

translate.zh: 我明天要早上六點起床。
a: I am going to get up at six tomorrow.
translate.why: 明天的計畫用 am going to＋原形 get up；幾點起床用 at six，tomorrow 放句尾。

a: Are you going to be free tomorrow?
translate.why: 有空英文用 free；問對方現在或明天的狀態，Are 放句首：Are you free tomorrow?

translate.zh: 我哥哥要去加拿大念書。
a: My brother is going to study in Canada.
translate.why: 計畫用 is going to＋原形 study；在國家裡念書用 in Canada。

a: I am not going to watch TV tonight.
I'm not going to watch TV tonight.
translate.why: 今晚決定不做的事用 am not going to＋原形 watch；看電視 watch TV。

a: How are you going to go to Taipei?
How are you going to get to Taipei?
translate.why: 問方式用 How 開頭，接 are you going to＋原形；到台北可用 go to 或 get to。

translate.zh: 她會開車，但是不會騎腳踏車。
a: She can drive, but she can't ride a bike.
translate.why: 會用 can、不會用 can't，都接原形；騎腳踏車是 ride a bike，後半要補主詞 she。

a: Would you like to see my photos?
Do you want to see my photos?
Would you like to see my pictures?
Do you want to see my pictures?
translate.why: 邀請對方用 Would you like to＋原形 see…?；照片多張用 photos。

translate.zh: 我今天晚上不能來，我很忙。
a: I can't come tonight. I am busy.
I can't come tonight because I'm busy.
translate.why: 不能來是 can't come；說原因可以分兩句，或用 because 連接：because I'm busy。

a: We are going to have dinner at seven.
translate.why: 計畫用 are going to have dinner；幾點鐘前面用 at：at seven。
可以（允許）用 can 加原形 use；前面已有 my，就不用再加 a：my computer。

a: I am going to find a new job next week.
I am going to look for a new job next week.
translate.why: 下星期的計畫用 am going to＋原形；新工作是 a new job。

reading.title: 短文 1
reading.text: Next month, my family is going to go on a trip to Korea. We are going to fly from Taipei. Our flight is going to depart at nine in the morning. I can speak a little Korean, so I am going to help my family. We are going to stay at a nice hotel near the city. Would you like to join us? We are going to visit a museum and go shopping. My sister can take great photos, so she is going to bring her camera. Let's plan our schedule together before we go!

qs.q: Where is the family going to go next month?
qs.why: 原文：Next month, my family is going to go on a trip to Korea. 下個月全家去韓國。
wn: 原文說 a trip to Korea，是韓國不是日本。
原文說 a trip to Korea，是韓國不是加拿大。

qs.q: What time is the flight going to depart?
qs.why: 原文：Our flight is going to depart at nine in the morning. 班機早上九點起飛。
wn: 原文說 nine in the morning，是早上九點不是中午。
原文說 in the morning，是早上不是晚上。

qs.q: Why is the writer going to help the family?
opts: The writer can speak a little Korean
qs.why: 原文：I can speak a little Korean, so I am going to help my family. so 前面就是原因。
wn: 文中沒提到地圖，原因是會說一點韓文。
他們是搭飛機去，文中沒提到車子。

qs.q: Where are they going to stay?
qs.why: 原文：We are going to stay at a nice hotel near the city. 住在市區附近的好旅館。
wn: 文中說 stay at a nice hotel，不是朋友家。
文中說 a nice hotel，不是帳篷。

qs.q: Who is going to bring a camera?
qs.why: 原文：My sister... is going to bring her camera. 姊妹很會拍照，由她帶相機。
wn: 文中沒提到爸爸帶相機，帶的是 sister。
作者是負責說韓文幫忙，帶相機的是 sister。

reading.title: 短文 2
reading.text: Next month, my family is going to take a trip to Hualien. We are going to take the train on Saturday morning. My father can drive, but the train is faster. We are going to stay in a small hotel near the sea. I can swim, so I am going to swim every morning. My mother is going to take a lot of photos. On Sunday, we are going to ride bikes by the sea. Would you like to come with us? It is going to be fun.

qs.q: Where is the family going to go?
qs.why: 原文：Next month, my family is going to take a trip to Hualien. 全家要去花蓮。
wn: 原文說 a trip to Hualien，是花蓮不是台北。
原文說 a trip to Hualien，是花蓮不是日本。

qs.q: How are they going to travel?
qs.why: 原文：We are going to take the train... the train is faster. 火車比較快，所以搭火車。
wn: 文中沒提到公車，他們搭火車。
爸爸會開車，但 the train is faster，所以搭火車。

qs.q: Where are they going to stay?
opts: In a small hotel near the sea
qs.why: 原文：We are going to stay in a small hotel near the sea. 住在海邊的小旅館。
wn: 文中說 a small hotel，不是朋友家。
原文是 small hotel near the sea，小旅館而且在海邊。

qs.q: What is the writer going to do every morning?
qs.why: 原文：I can swim, so I am going to swim every morning. 作者每天早上游泳。
wn: 拍照的是媽媽，不是作者。
騎腳踏車是星期天全家一起，不是每天早上。

qs.q: What are they going to do on Sunday?
qs.why: 原文：On Sunday, we are going to ride bikes by the sea. 星期天在海邊騎腳踏車。
wn: 文中沒提到購物，星期天是騎腳踏車。
文中沒說星期天搭車回家，說的是騎腳踏車。

reading.title: 短文 3
reading.text: My name is Wei. This year I am going to study English every day. I can read easy books, but I can't speak well. So I am going to practice speaking with my friend Ann. We are going to meet at the library on Tuesday and Friday. Ann can speak English very well. She is going to help me. In December, I am going to take an English test. I am not going to be lazy. Would you like to study with us? You can come, too.

qs.q: What is Wei going to do this year?
qs.why: 原文：This year I am going to study English every day. 今年每天讀英文。
wn: 文中沒提到旅行，今年是每天讀英文。
文中沒提到日文，他要學的是英文。

qs.q: What can Wei do now?
qs.why: 原文：I can read easy books, but I can't speak well. 他現在會讀簡單的書。
wn: 原文說 I can't speak well，口說還不好。
文中沒提到寫信，他會的是讀簡單的書。

qs.q: Where are Wei and Ann going to meet?
qs.why: 原文：We are going to meet at the library on Tuesday and Friday. 在圖書館碰面。
wn: 原文說 at the library，是圖書館不是學校。
原文說 at the library，不是 Ann 家。

qs.q: How often are they going to meet?
qs.why: 原文：on Tuesday and Friday. 每週二和週五，一週兩次，就是 twice a week。
wn: 每週見兩天，不是一個月一次。
每天讀英文是 Wei 自己，和 Ann 只見週二、週五。

qs.q: When is Wei going to take the test?
qs.why: 原文：In December, I am going to take an English test. 十二月考英文。
wn: 原文說 In December，是十二月不是一月。
星期二是和 Ann 練習的日子，考試在十二月。

reading.title: 短文 4
reading.text: Peter is going to change his job next month. Now he is a waiter, but he is going to be a bus driver. He can drive well, and he can talk to people. He is not going to work at night, so he is going to have dinner with his family every day. On weekends, he is going to learn English at a school near his house. He can't speak English now, but he is not worried. "I am going to try," he says.

qs.q: What is Peter going to do next month?
qs.why: 原文：Peter is going to change his job next month. 下個月要換工作。
wn: 文中沒說搬家，他還要去家附近的學校上課。
文中沒提到旅行，下個月是換工作。

qs.q: What is Peter's job now?
qs.why: 原文：Now he is a waiter, but he is going to be a bus driver. 現在是服務生。
wn: 公車司機是他以後的工作，不是現在。
文中沒提到老師，他現在是 waiter。

qs.q: What can Peter do well?
qs.why: 原文：He can drive well, and he can talk to people. 他很會開車。
wn: 原文說 He can't speak English now，現在還不會。

qs.q: What is he going to do every day after the change?
qs.why: 原文：he is going to have dinner with his family every day. 不上夜班，每天和家人吃晚餐。
wn: 原文說 not going to work at night，不上夜班。
上學學英文是週末，不是每天。

qs.q: What is he going to do on weekends?
qs.why: 原文：On weekends, he is going to learn English at a school. 週末去學英文。
wn: 開公車是他的新工作，文中週末的安排是學英文。
文中沒說週末休息，他要去學校學英文。

We are not going to take a taxi today.
What are you going to do next Monday?
He can drive, but he can't ride a bike.
They are going to meet me at the airport.

writing.prompt: 請綜合運用本週學過的「be going to」、「can/can't」及邀約用語，寫 3 到 5 句英文，描述你下個月的旅行計畫。
writing.sample: Next month, I am going to travel to Japan. I can speak a little Japanese, so I am not worried. We are going to stay at a hotel near Tokyo. Would you like to join me? Let's plan our trip together!

writing.prompt: 用 3 到 5 句英文寫下你下個月的計畫，至少使用兩次 be going to。
writing.sample: Next month, I am going to take a trip to Hualien. I am going to go there by train. I can swim, so I am going to swim in the sea. I am going to take a lot of photos. I am not going to work for three days.

writing.prompt: 用 3 到 5 句英文介紹你會做和不會做的事，以及你打算怎麼練習。
writing.sample: I can read easy English books. I can't speak English well. So I am going to practice with my friend every week. We are going to meet at the library on Friday. I am going to take a test in December.

writing.prompt: 用 3 到 5 句英文寫下你和家人這個週末的計畫，並邀請朋友一起參加。
writing.sample: My family is going to have a picnic this Sunday. We are going to go to the park at ten. My father can play the guitar, and we are going to sing together. Would you like to come with us? Please call me on Saturday night.

今晚＝tonight。例句：She is going to cook dinner tonight.

週末＝weekend。例句：Are you free this weekend?

vacation＝假期。例句：I went to Japan on vacation.
煮飯＝cook。例句：My father is a cook.
speak＝說(語言)。例句：I can speak English a little.

唱歌＝sing。例句：She can sing very well.
run＝跑步。例句：He can run very fast.
腳踏車＝bike。例句：He has a bike.
skate＝溜冰。例句：He can skate on the ice.
修理＝fix。例句：He can fix a computer.
computer＝電腦。例句：I have a computer.
閱讀＝reading。例句：My hobby is reading books.

繪畫＝painting。例句：My sister enjoys painting pictures.
photography＝攝影。例句：I am interested in photography.
露營＝camping。例句：We are going to go camping this weekend.

園藝＝gardening。例句：My mother enjoys gardening every morning.

聽音樂＝listening to music。例句：I like listening to music at night.
hobby＝嗜好。例句：What is your hobby?
加入＝join。例句：They are going to join a book club.
rainy＝下雨的。例句：It is going to be rainy this weekend.
有風的＝windy。例句：It is very windy outside.

外套＝jacket。例句：You should wear a jacket. It's cold.

戶外＝outside。例句：There is a dog outside the house.
pool＝游泳池。例句：I can swim in the pool.
邀請＝invite。例句：I want to invite you to my party.
movie＝電影。例句：We like this movie.

busy＝忙碌的。例句：My job is busy.
也許＝maybe。例句：Maybe next time.
together＝一起。例句：We are together at school.
咖啡廳＝café。例句：There is a café next to the library.
museum＝博物館。例句：There is a museum in the city.
我們一起…吧＝let's。例句：Let's go to the movies.

airport＝機場。例句：We are going to go to the airport.
飯店＝hotel。例句：There is a hotel between the park and the museum.

旅遊行程＝tour。例句：We are going to join a city tour.

火車＝train。例句：We are going to take the train.

mc.q: I ___ going to study tonight.
mc.why: 主詞 I 的 be 動詞是 am：I am going to study tonight。

mc.q: He is going to ___ a new job.
mc.why: going to 後面接原形動詞：going to start。
wn: going to 後面要原形，不加 s。
started 是過去式，going to 後面只能接原形。

mc.q: We are going to ___ next month.
mc.why: be going to 後面接原形動詞：are going to move（要搬家）。
wn: going to 後面的動詞不加 s。
next month 是未來，不能用過去式。

mc.q: ___ you going to work tomorrow?
mc.why: 主詞是 you，be 動詞用 are；問句把 Are 放句首：Are you going to…?
wn: is 配 he／she／it，you 要用 are。
am 只配 I，you 要用 are。

mc.q: Tom and Amy ___ going to move next month.
mc.why: Tom and Amy 是兩個人，等於 they，be 動詞用 are。
wn: is 配一個人；Tom and Amy 是兩個人。
am 只配 I，主詞是 Tom and Amy。

mc.q: They are going to ___ a new house next year.
mc.why: going to 後面接原形動詞：going to buy。
wn: bought 是過去式，next year 是未來，要用原形。
going to 後面不接 V-ing，要原形 buy。

mc.q: I am going to ___ my homework after dinner.
mc.why: going to 後面接原形；寫功課說 do my homework。
wn: going to 後面要原形，不用 does。
going to 後面不接 V-ing，要原形 do。

mc.q: The students ___ going to take a test tomorrow.
mc.why: 主詞 The students 有 s，是很多學生，be 動詞用 are。
wn: students 是複數，不能用 is。
am 只配 I，主詞是 The students。

mc.q: We are going to ___ to Hualien by train.
mc.why: be going to 加原形動詞 travel，表示打算要做的事，不用過去式。
wn: going to 後面要原形，不加 s。
traveled 是過去式；going to 講未來計畫，用原形 travel。

mc.q: It ___ going to rain tomorrow.
mc.why: 主詞 It 是一件事（第三人稱單數），be 動詞用 is。
wn: are 配 you／we／they，It 用 is。
am 只配 I，It 用 is。

mc.q: Who ___ going to drive tomorrow?
mc.why: Who 當主詞問是誰，當作一個人看，be 動詞用 is。
wn: Who 問誰要做時當單數，用 is，不用 are。
am 只配 I，Who 問句用 is。

mc.q: I ___ ski. It's difficult for me.
mc.why: 後面說滑雪對我很難，表示不會滑雪，用 can't。
wn: 會滑雪就不會說很難，前後意思不合。
can 不加 s，而且這裡要否定 can't。

mc.q: I can ___ a computer.
mc.why: can 後面接原形動詞：can use。
wn: used 是過去式，can 後面只能接原形。

mc.q: My mother ___ cook Italian food.
mc.why: 說會不會做某事用 can，後面直接接原形 cook。
wn: can 後面直接接動詞，不加 to。
can 不管主詞是誰都不加 s。

mc.q: ___ Amy speak French?
mc.why: 問會不會說法文，Can 放句首，後接主詞和原形 speak。
wn: does 和 can 不能一起用，只要 Can。
is 和 can 不能一起用，只要 Can。

mc.q: Can you ___ me, please?
mc.why: can 後面接原形動詞：Can you help me? 主詞是誰都不變。
wn: can 後面的動詞不加 s。
can 後面不接 ing，要用原形 help。

mc.q: Ben ___ play basketball, but he can play tennis.
mc.why: but he can play tennis 對比，前面說不會打籃球，用 can't。
wn: can 自己就能變否定，不用 doesn't。
not 要放在 can 後面，寫成 can't。

mc.q: We can ___ dinner for you tonight.
mc.why: can 後面接原形動詞：We can cook dinner。
wn: can 後面用原形，不加 s。
can 後面不接 V-ing，要原形 cook。

mc.q: She is going to ___ Korean next year.
mc.why: going to 後面接原形：going to study，主詞 she 也不加 s。
wn: going to 後面要原形，不用 studies。
going to 後面不接 V-ing，要原形 study。

mc.q: Can you ___ this word for me?
mc.why: Can 問句，主詞後接原形：Can you read…?
wn: Can 句子裡動詞用原形，不加 s。
Can 後面的動詞要原形，不接 V-ing。

mc.q: We can't ___ you. Please speak louder.
mc.why: can't 後面接原形；聽不到所以請大聲點：can't hear。
wn: can't 後面要原形，不加 s。
can't 後面不接 V-ing，要原形 hear。

mc.q: He is going to go ___ next Saturday.
mc.why: 去健行的固定說法是 go hiking，go 後面接 ing 形式。
wn: go 後面說活動要用 ing：go hiking。
go 後面不接加 s 的形式，要說 go hiking。

mc.q: I am going to go ___ with my friends.
mc.why: 去做某種活動用 go＋V-ing：go shopping 去逛街。
wn: go 後面不能直接再接原形動詞，固定說 go shopping。
go 後面不接加 s 的字，要說 go shopping。

mc.q: Can you ___ basketball?
mc.why: Can 問句裡，主詞後面接原形動詞：Can you play…?
wn: can 後面的動詞不加 s。
can 後面不接 ing，要用原形 play。

mc.q: I can't ___ well, but I like art class.
mc.why: can't 後面接原形動詞：can't paint。
wn: can't 後面要原形，不加 s。
can't 後面不接 V-ing，要原形 paint。

mc.q: I love ___ video games with my brother.
mc.why: love 後面接做某件事，可用 V-ing：love playing。
wn: love 後面不能直接接原形，要 playing 或 to play。
love 已經是動詞，後面不能再接 plays。

mc.q: Would you like to ___ a coffee with me?
mc.why: like to 的 to 後面接原形；喝咖啡常說 have a coffee。
wn: to 後面要原形；has 是配 he／she 的形式。
to 後面不接 V-ing，要原形 have。

mc.q: Would you like to ___ painting with me?
mc.why: like to 的 to 後面接原形動詞：to try。
wn: to 後面要原形，不加 s。
to 後面不接 V-ing，要原形 try。

mc.q: Can you ___ a picture for me?
mc.why: Can 問句裡動詞用原形：Can you draw a picture…?
wn: can 後面的動詞不加 s。
can 後面不接 ing，要用原形。

mc.q: Is she going to ___ a photo class?
mc.why: be going to 問句裡，going to 後面接原形：take a class。
wn: going to 後面的動詞不加 s。
going to 後面不接 ing，要用原形。

mc.q: Would you like to ___ to the museum?
mc.why: like to 的 to 後面接原形動詞：to go。
wn: to 後面要原形，不加 es。
to 後面不接 V-ing，要原形 go。

mc.q: The weather ___ says it will rain.
mc.why: 天氣預報是 weather forecast，是一份預報，所以後面用 says。
wn: forecasts 是複數，動詞要用 say，不是 says。
天氣預報的固定說法是 weather forecast。

mc.q: We are going to have a ___ on Saturday.
mc.why: 前面有 a，表示一個，後面要接單數名詞 picnic。
wn: a 後面只能接單數，picnics 是複數。
a 後面要接名詞，have a picnic 是固定說法。

mc.q: Amy ___ going to stay home today.
mc.why: 主詞 Amy 是一個人（等於 she），be 動詞用 is。
wn: am 只配 I；Amy 是另一個人，用 is。
are 配 you／we／they；Amy 只有一個人。

mc.q: ___ he going to bring an umbrella?
mc.why: 問他打不打算帶傘，be 動詞放最前面；he 單數用 Is。
wn: Are 配複數或 you，he 是一個人。
going to 前面要 be 動詞，不用 Do。

mc.q: The weather is cold. Tom is going to ___ a coat.
mc.why: is going to 後面接原形動詞 wear（穿），主詞 Tom 也不加 s。
wn: going to 後面要原形，不能加 s。
to 後面接原形 wear，不接 ing。

mc.q: Would you like ___ go to the beach?
mc.why: Would you like 後面接 to＋原形動詞：like to go。
wn: going go 變成兩個動詞連在一起，要用 like to go。
like 後面接動詞要用 to，不用 for。

mc.q: Where ___ they going to go this weekend?
mc.why: Where 後面接 be 動詞；主詞 they 是複數，用 are。
wn: is 配單數，they 是複數。
going to 前面要 be 動詞，不用 do。

mc.q: ___ it going to snow tonight?
mc.why: 問天氣預測用 be going to；天氣主詞 it 是單數，用 Is。
wn: going to 前面要 be 動詞，不用 Does。
Are 配複數或 you，it 是單數。

mc.q: She is going to ___ at home all day.
mc.why: going to 後面接原形動詞：going to stay。
wn: going to 後面要原形，she 也不加 s。
going to 後面不接 V-ing，要原形 stay。

mc.q: Would you like to go running ___ me?
mc.why: 跟某人一起做事用 with：go running with me。
wn: to 表示方向或對象，跟某人一起要用 with。
for me 是為了我，不是跟我一起跑步。

mc.q: Sorry, I ___ busy tomorrow.
mc.why: busy 是形容詞，前面要有 be 動詞；主詞 I 配 am。
wn: is 配 he／she／it，I 用 am。
are 配 you／we／they，I 用 am。

mc.q: Would you ___ to go to a concert?
mc.why: Would 後面接原形動詞，固定說法是 Would you like to…?
wn: would 後面要原形，不加 s。
would 後面不接 V-ing，要原形 like。

mc.q: Let's ___ at seven o'clock.
mc.why: Let's 後面接原形動詞：Let's meet。
wn: Let's 後面不接 V-ing，要原形 meet。
Let's 後面要原形，不加 s。

mc.q: Thank you, but I ___ go. I have class.
mc.why: but 和 I have class 表示要拒絕：要上課所以不能去，用 can't＋原形 go。
wn: can 的否定後面直接接原形，不加 to；可寫 cannot go。
can 的否定直接加 not（can't），不用 don't 幫忙。

mc.q: That ___ great! See you then.
mc.why: 主詞 That 是一件事（第三人稱單數），動詞加 s：That sounds great（聽起來很棒）。
wn: That 是一件事，動詞要加 s 變 sounds。
sounding 前面沒有 is，不能單獨當句子的動詞。

mc.q: Let's ___ a movie this weekend.
mc.why: Let's 後面接原形動詞：Let's watch。
wn: Let's 後面要原形，不加 es。
Let's 後面不接 V-ing，要原形 watch。

mc.q: Can we ___ the plan to Sunday?
mc.why: Can 的問句，主詞後面接原形動詞：Can we change…?
wn: can 後面不接 V-ing，要原形 change。
can 後面不加 s，主詞 we 也不加 s。

mc.q: Let's meet ___ the coffee shop.
mc.why: 約在某個地點碰面，把地點當成一個點，用 at：meet at the coffee shop。
wn: on 是在表面上（例：on the table），不用來說約在某家店。

mc.q: Would you like to ___ tennis after work?
mc.why: like to 的 to 後面接原形；打網球說 play tennis。
wn: to 後面不接 V-ing，要原形 play。
to 後面要原形，不加 s。

mc.q: Would you like to eat Japanese food ___ Chinese food?
mc.why: 問兩個選一個（日本菜還是中國菜），用 or。
wn: and 是兩個都要；問對方選哪一個要用 or。
but 表示轉折（但是），不用在選擇問句。

mc.q: Our flight is going to ___ at noon.
mc.why: going to 後面接原形動詞：going to leave。
wn: going to 後面要原形，不加 s。
left 是過去式，going to 後面只能接原形。

mc.q: When ___ you going to return?
mc.why: 主詞 you 配 are；有 going to 要用 be 動詞：When are you…?
wn: is 配 he／she／it，主詞 you 用 are。
有 going to 要用 be 動詞，不用 do。

mc.q: He ___ going to buy a new bike next week.
mc.why: 主詞 He 是一個人，be 動詞用 is。
wn: am 只配 I，He 用 is。
are 配 you／we／they，He 用 is。

mc.q: Would you like to ___ this book?
mc.why: like to 的 to 後面接原形動詞：to read。
wn: to 後面要原形，不接 V-ing。
to 後面要原形，不加 s。

mc.q: My mother is going to ___ me at the airport.
mc.why: going to 後面接原形動詞：going to meet。
wn: going to 後面不接 V-ing，要原形 meet。
going to 後面要原形，不加 s。

mc.q: I ___ going to be a nurse.
mc.why: 主詞是 I，be 動詞用 am。
wn: are 配 you／we／they，I 用 am。
is 配 he／she／it，I 用 am。

mc.q: ___ your plan for this summer?
mc.why: 問計畫是什麼用 What；主詞 your plan 是一個，用 is。
wn: plan 是單數一個計畫，be 動詞用 is，不用 are。
How 問狀況好不好；問計畫內容是什麼要用 What。

mc.q: My brother ___ going to study in Canada.
mc.why: 主詞 My brother 是一個人，be 動詞用 is。
wn: are 配 you／we／they，My brother 用 is。
am 只配 I，My brother 用 is。

mc.q: We ___ not going to take a taxi.
mc.why: 主詞 We 是複數用 are，否定把 not 放在 are 後面。
wn: is 配單數，We 是複數。

fill.q: I am going to ___ my parents next week.
fill.why: am going to 後面接原形動詞；去探望父母用 visit 或 see。

fill.q: They are going to ___ to a new house.
fill.why: be going to 後面接原形；搬家到新房子是 move to a new house。

fill.q: He is going to ___ at eight o'clock.
fill.why: be going to 後面接原形；八點出發、離開用 leave。

fill.q: ___ you going to work on Monday?
fill.why: be going to 的問句把 be 動詞放句首；you 配 Are。

fill.q: Sam and Lily ___ going to move next week.
fill.why: Sam and Lily 是兩個人（複數），be 動詞用 are。

fill.q: My sister is going to ___ a new phone.
fill.why: be going to 後面接原形動詞；買新手機用 buy 或 get。

fill.q: They are going to ___ a party on Saturday.
fill.why: be going to 後面接原形；開派對的固定說法是 have a party。

fill.q: I am going to ___ a book this weekend.
fill.zh: 我這個週末要看一本書。
fill.why: am going to 後面接原形動詞；看書說 read a book。

fill.q: Next week I am going to ___ a new job.
fill.why: be going to 後面接原形；開始新工作是 start a new job。

fill.q: She ___ not going to work today.
fill.why: She 是一個人用 is；否定把 not 放在 is 後面：is not going to。

fill.q: He is going to ___ a bike next month.
fill.why: be going to 後面接原形動詞；買腳踏車用 buy 或 get，不加 s。

fill.q: Can you ___ English?
fill.why: Can 後面接原形動詞；會說英文用 speak English。

fill.q: I can't ___. It's too hard.
fill.why: can't 後面接原形動詞；滑雪是 ski，原形不加 s。

fill.q: He ___ cook. He always eats out.
fill.why: 後面說他總是外食，表示他不會煮飯；不會是 can't 或 cannot＋原形。

fill.q: We ___ speak a little English.
fill.why: 會說一點英文是能力，用 can＋原形 speak；can 不管主詞是誰都不變。

fill.q: Can they swim? Yes, they ___.
fill.why: Can 開頭的問句，簡答也用 can：Yes, they can. 後面不用再接動詞。

fill.q: He can run fast, ___ he can't swim.
fill.why: 前面說會跑、後面說不會游泳，意思相反，用 but（但是）連接。

fill.q: ___ your teacher speak English? Yes, she can.
fill.why: 回答是 Yes, she can.，所以問句用 Can 放句首，後面 speak 用原形。

fill.q: My son can't ___ yet. He is only two.
fill.why: 後面說他才兩歲，所以還不會走路或說話：can't walk／talk。

fill.q: I am going to ___ swimming next month.
fill.why: be going to 後面接原形；學游泳用 learn swimming，也可以說 start。

fill.q: I can speak English, ___ I can't speak French.
fill.why: 會英文、不會法文，前後意思相反，用 but（但是）。

fill.q: She likes ___ on weekends.
fill.why: like 後面接動作，用 V-ing 或 to＋原形；cook 加 ing 變 cooking，或 to cook。

fill.q: I like ___ stamps.
fill.why: like 後面接動詞要加 ing；集郵是 collect stamps，變成 collecting。

fill.q: I ___ going to paint a picture tonight.
fill.why: 主詞 I 只配 am：I am going to paint…。

fill.q: ___ you like to join our club?
fill.why: Would you like to…? 是禮貌邀請的固定說法：要不要…？

fill.q: Would you like to ___ lunch with us?
fill.why: Would you like to 後面接原形；吃午餐是 have lunch 或 eat lunch。

fill.q: My hobbies ___ cooking and reading.
fill.why: My hobbies 是兩個嗜好（複數），be 動詞用 are。

fill.q: My mother likes ___ in the park.
fill.why: like 後面接動作，用 V-ing 或 to＋原形：walking、running 或 to walk、to run。

fill.q: Can Mark ___ Japanese?
fill.why: 說某種語言用 speak：speak Japanese；Can 後面接原形。

fill.q: I can ___ a picture of my cat.
fill.why: can 後面接原形動詞；畫一張貓的圖用 draw 或 paint a picture。

fill.q: We can ___ dinner together tonight.
fill.why: can 後面接原形；一起煮晚餐用 cook 或 make，一起吃用 have dinner。

fill.q: You should wear a ___. It's cold.
fill.why: 後面說很冷，應該穿外套或毛衣：jacket、coat、sweater；a 後面接單數名詞。

fill.q: It's too hot to play ___.
fill.why: play outside 是在外面玩；outside 當副詞，說明在哪裡玩。

fill.q: ___ you like to go hiking with us?
fill.why: 客氣地邀請別人，用 Would you like to…？所以句首填 Would。

fill.q: ___ is going to be cold tomorrow.
fill.why: 講天氣時主詞用 It：It is going to be cold tomorrow.

fill.q: What ___ you going to do this weekend?
fill.why: 疑問詞 What 開頭，後面主詞 you 配 are：What are you going to do？

fill.q: They ___ not going to play soccer today.
fill.why: 主詞 They 是複數，用 are；否定把 not 放在 are 後面。

fill.q: Would you ___ to have coffee with me?
fill.why: 客氣邀請的固定說法是 Would you like to…？所以空格填 like。

fill.q: Where ___ you going to go tomorrow?
fill.why: 主詞 you 用 are；問句 Where are you going to go?

fill.q: It is very cold, so I ___ going to swim.
fill.why: 前面說很冷，所以不打算游泳；I 配 am，否定把 not 放在後面：am not。

fill.q: The weather ___ going to be nice this weekend.
fill.why: The weather 是一件事，be going to 的 be 動詞用 is。

fill.q: Are you ___ tonight?
fill.why: 約人時問今晚有沒有空，有空是 free；be 動詞 are 後面接形容詞。

fill.q: Would you like to go to a ___?
fill.why: 邀請去聽音樂會，音樂會是 concert；a 後面接單數名詞。

fill.q: Are you ___ this Friday night?
fill.zh: 你這個星期五晚上有空嗎？
fill.why: 約人時問這週五晚上有沒有空，有空是 free。

fill.q: Can you ___ me in front of the school?
fill.why: Can 後面接原形動詞；約在學校前面見面用 meet。

fill.q: Let's ___ a movie this weekend.
fill.why: Let's 後面接原形動詞；看電影用 watch 或 see a movie。

fill.q: They ___ going to be late.
fill.why: 主詞 They 是複數，用 are going to be late（會遲到）。

fill.q: I ___ not going to work on Sunday.
fill.why: 主詞 I 只配 am，否定把 not 放後面：am not going to。

fill.q: ___ is going to be a party on Friday.
fill.why: 講將會有一個派對，用 There is going to be…（將會有）。

fill.q: My friends are going to ___ at seven.
fill.why: be going to 後面接原形；到達用 arrive，也可以說 come。

fill.q: We are going to go on a ___.
fill.why: 去旅行的固定說法是 go on a trip；a 後面接單數名詞 trip。

fill.q: Can you ___ a map?
fill.why: Can 後面接原形；看地圖的固定說法是 read a map。

fill.q: I ___ going to visit my aunt next week.
fill.why: 主詞 I 只配 am：I am going to visit…。

fill.q: ___ she going to move to Taichung?
fill.why: be going to 的問句把 be 動詞放句首；she 是一個人，用 Is。

fill.q: What ___ you going to do next Monday?
fill.why: 主詞 you 用 are；問句 What are you going to do?

fill.q: ___ they going to come back on Sunday?
fill.why: be going to 的問句把 be 動詞放句首；they 是複數，用 Are。

fill.q: We are going to have dinner ___ seven.
fill.why: 在幾點鐘用介系詞 at：at seven。

fill.q: We ___ not going to take a taxi.
fill.why: We 是複數，be 動詞用 are；否定把 not 放在 are 後面。

fill.q: Would you like ___ cup of coffee?
fill.why: cup 可以數，一杯就用 a：a cup of coffee。

fill.q: My plan ___ going to change.
fill.why: My plan 是一件事，be going to 的 be 動詞用 is。

a: I am going to study English tomorrow.
I'm going to study English tomorrow.
translate.why: 明天的計畫用 am going to 加原形 study；念英文是 study English，tomorrow 放句尾。

a: Are you going to work tomorrow?
translate.why: 問明天的計畫，把 Are 移到句首：Are you going to work tomorrow?

a: What are you going to do this weekend?
translate.why: 問計畫用 What are you going to do；這個週末是 this weekend，前面不加 in 或 on。

a: They are going to have a party on Saturday.
They're going to have a party on Saturday.
translate.why: 計畫用 are going to＋原形；開派對是 have a party；星期六前面用 on。

a: I am going to start a new job next week.
I'm going to start a new job next week.
translate.why: 下週的計畫用 am going to＋原形 start；新工作是 a new job。
會某種能力用 can＋原形：I can swim，不用 I am swim。

translate.zh: 我媽媽會煮很好吃的湯。
a: My mother can make very good soup.
My mom can cook very good soup.
translate.why: 會煮用 can＋原形 make 或 cook；soup 不可數，前面不加 a。
問會不會，Can 放句首，後面接原形 ride；騎腳踏車 ride a bike。
請別人幫忙用 Can you 加原形 help；幫的對象是受詞，用 me，不用 I。

translate.zh: 我們聽不到你，請大聲一點。
a: We can't hear you. Please speak louder.
translate.why: 聽不到用 can't hear；大聲一點用比較級 louder；請對方做事用 Please 加原形 speak。
嗜好是 hobby；做某件事當名詞，動詞加 ing：reading。

translate.zh: 旅行是我最喜歡的嗜好。
translate.why: 旅行當主詞要加 ing 變名詞：Traveling；最喜歡的 favorite 放在 hobby 前，be 動詞用 is。
問會不會用 Can you play；彈樂器要加 the：the guitar。

translate.zh: 我的嗜好是煮飯和閱讀。
a: My hobbies are cooking and reading.
translate.why: 嗜好有兩個，用複數 hobbies，be 動詞用 are；動作當名詞要加 ing：cooking、reading。

translate.zh: 我會唱歌，但我不會跳舞。
a: I can sing, but I can't dance.
translate.why: 會做的事用 can，不會用 can't，後面都接原形動詞；兩句意思相反用 but。
有空用 free；問對方狀態，Are 放句首；這個週末是 this weekend。
不會開車是沒有這個能力，用 can't 或 cannot 加原形 drive；cannot 要連在一起寫。

a: He is not going to go out.
He isn't going to go out.
translate.why: 不打算就是 is not going to＋原形；出門是 go out。

translate.zh: 因為下雨，我們不能去打籃球。
a: We can't play basketball because it is rainy.
We can't play basketball because it is raining.
Because it is raining, we can't play basketball.
Because it is rainy, we can't play basketball.
translate.why: 不能用 can't＋原形 play；原因用 because；下雨可說 it is raining 或 it is rainy。

a: They are going to go to Tainan next week.
They are going to Tainan next week.
translate.why: 下星期的計畫用 are going to；going to go to Tainan 可省略成 going to Tainan。

translate.zh: 你今天晚上想跟我一起吃飯嗎？
a: Would you like to have dinner with me tonight?
Do you want to have dinner with me tonight?
Would you like to eat dinner with me tonight?
Do you want to eat dinner with me tonight?
translate.why: 邀請用 Would you like to have dinner；跟我一起 with me，今天晚上 tonight 放最後。

a: Are you free on Friday night?
translate.why: 有沒有空用 be 動詞加 free：Are you free?；星期幾前面用 on：on Friday night。
提議一起做某事用 Let's＋原形；看電影可以說 go to the movies 或 watch a movie。

a: He is sick, so he can't come.
translate.why: 先說原因 He is sick（生病用 be 動詞加 sick），再用 so 接結果：he can't come。

a: What time are we going to meet?
translate.why: 問幾點用 What time 開頭，接 are we going to＋原形 meet。

a: What are you going to do next week?
translate.why: 問計畫用 What 開頭，接 are you going to do；next week 前面不加 on。

a: She is going to be a nurse next year.
translate.why: 明年的打算用 is going to；當護士是 be a nurse，be 不能省略，nurse 前要加 a。

a: They are not going to come back on Sunday.
translate.why: 預定不做的事用 are not going to＋原形 come back；星期天前面用 on。

a: I am not going to watch TV tonight.
I'm not going to watch TV tonight.
translate.why: 今晚決定不做的事用 am not going to＋原形 watch；看電視 watch TV。

translate.zh: 我今天晚上不能來，我很忙。
a: I can't come tonight. I am busy.
I can't come tonight because I'm busy.
translate.why: 不能來是 can't come；說原因可以分兩句，或用 because 連接：because I'm busy。

error.s: I am going to studying English.
error.why: going to 後面要用原形動詞。
error.full: I am going to study English.

error.s: He is going to buys a car.
error.why: going to 後面的動詞不加 s。
error.full: He is going to buy a car.

error.s: My sister are going to buy a phone.
error.why: 單數主詞用 is。
error.full: My sister is going to buy a phone.

error.s: He is not going to going home.
error.why: going to 後面要用原形 go。
error.full: He is not going to go home.

error.s: Do you can drive?
error.correct: Can you drive?
error.why: 疑問句把 Can 放句首，不用 do。

error.s: Are you can swim?
error.correct: Can you swim?
error.why: can 的疑問句不需要 be 動詞。

error.s: She can't to sing.
error.correct: She can't sing.
error.why: can't 後面直接接原形動詞。

error.s: Would you like to playing games?
error.why: to 後面要用原形動詞。
error.full: Would you like to play games?

error.s: They going to join a book club.
error.correct: They are going to join a book club.
error.why: 別漏掉 be 動詞 are。

error.s: Is she going to takes a photo class?
error.why: going to 後面的動詞不加 s。
error.full: Is she going to take a photo class?

error.s: I am going to studying English.
error.why: going to 後面要用原形動詞。
error.full: I am going to study English.

error.s: I can to ride a bike.
error.correct: I can ride a bike.
error.why: can 後面不加 to。

error.s: I am going to not go outside.
error.correct: I am not going to go outside.
error.why: not 要放在 be 動詞後面。

error.s: It is going be cold tomorrow.
error.correct: It is going to be cold tomorrow.
error.why: going 後面要加 to。

error.s: Sorry, I not can come tonight.
error.correct: Sorry, I can't come tonight.
error.why: can 的否定是 can't，not 要放在 can 後面。

error.s: I going to call you tonight.
error.correct: I am going to call you tonight.
error.why: be going to 不能少了 am。

error.s: I am going to not go to the party.
error.correct: I am not going to go to the party.
error.why: not 要放在 am 後面。

error.s: She can speaks Japanese.
error.why: can 後面要用原形動詞。
error.full: She can speak Japanese.

error.s: What you are going to do next week?
error.correct: What are you going to do next week?
error.why: 疑問句要把 are 放在主詞前面。

error.s: Do you can drive a car?
error.correct: Can you drive a car?
error.why: can 的問句把 can 放句首，不用 do。

reorder.a: Are you going to work tomorrow?
reorder.why: 問明天的計畫，把 Are 移到句首：Are you going to work tomorrow?

reorder.a: Can she ride a bike?

reorder.a: Are you free this weekend?

reading.title: 短文 1
reading.text: Hi, I'm Amy. Tomorrow I am going to visit my grandmother. Next week, I am going to start a new English class. My brother is going to travel to Japan next month. He is going to stay there for two weeks. On the weekend, my family is going to meet at a restaurant. We are going to eat dinner together. After dinner, we are going to watch a movie. Next year, I am going to study abroad in Canada. I am very excited about my plans!

qs.q: What is Amy going to do tomorrow?
qs.why: 原文：Tomorrow I am going to visit my grandmother. 明天 Amy 要去看祖母。
wn: 看電影是週末晚餐後的計畫，不是明天。
文中沒提到買書，明天是去看祖母。

qs.q: What is Amy going to start next week?
qs.why: 原文：Next week, I am going to start a new English class. 下週要開始上新的英文課。
wn: 文中說 a new English class，是英文課不是烹飪課。
文中說 a new English class，是英文課不是舞蹈課。

qs.q: Where is Amy's brother going to travel?
qs.why: 原文：My brother is going to travel to Japan next month. 哥哥下個月要去日本。
wn: 文中說 travel to Japan，是日本不是韓國。
文中說 travel to Japan，是日本不是中國。

qs.q: What is the family going to do on the weekend?
qs.why: 原文：On the weekend, my family is going to meet at a restaurant. 週末全家在餐廳聚餐。
wn: 文中沒提到週末去學校，是在餐廳見面吃飯。
文中沒提到打掃，週末是在餐廳聚餐。

qs.q: Where is Amy going to study next year?
qs.why: 原文：Next year, I am going to study abroad in Canada. 明年要去加拿大留學。
wn: 去日本的是哥哥（旅行），Amy 是去 Canada 讀書。
文中說 study abroad in Canada，是出國去加拿大。

reading.title: 短文 2
reading.text: My name is Tom. I can swim very well, but I can't ski. My sister can cook delicious food, and she can also speak English and Chinese. My father can drive a car, but he can't ride a bike. My mother can play the piano and sing beautiful songs. My little brother can't swim yet, but he can run very fast. On weekends, we like to do things together. I can't dance well, but I am going to learn dancing next month!

qs.q: What can Tom do very well?
qs.why: 原文：I can swim very well, but I can't ski. Tom 游泳很厲害。
wn: 會煮好吃的菜的是 Tom 的姊妹，不是 Tom。
Tom 說 I can't dance well，他跳舞不好。

qs.q: What can Tom's sister do?
qs.why: 原文：My sister can cook delicious food. 姊妹會煮好吃的菜。
wn: 會開車的是 Tom 的爸爸，不是姊妹。
文中只說 Tom can't ski，沒說姊妹會滑雪。

qs.q: What can Tom's father do?
qs.why: 原文：My father can drive a car, but he can't ride a bike. 爸爸會開車。
wn: 原文說 he can't ride a bike，爸爸不會騎腳踏車。
會唱歌的是媽媽，不是爸爸。

qs.q: What can Tom's mother do?
qs.why: 原文：My mother can play the piano and sing beautiful songs. 媽媽會彈鋼琴、唱歌。
wn: 游泳很好的是 Tom，不是媽媽。
文中沒有人提到修電腦。

qs.q: What is Tom going to do next month?
qs.why: 原文：I can't dance well, but I am going to learn dancing next month! 下個月要學跳舞。
wn: Tom 已經很會游泳了，下個月是學跳舞。
文中沒說要學煮飯，下個月是學跳舞。

reading.title: 短文 3
reading.text: Hi, I'm Lisa. My hobby is painting. In my free time, I also like reading and listening to music. My brother's hobby is different. He likes gaming and photography. On the weekend, he is going to go fishing with our father. My mother enjoys gardening and cooking. She can cook many delicious dishes. Next month, our family is going to go camping in the mountains. We are also going to go hiking. I am very excited about our trip!

qs.q: What is Lisa's hobby?
qs.why: 原文：Hi, I'm Lisa. My hobby is painting. Lisa 的嗜好是畫畫。
wn: 去釣魚的是哥哥和爸爸，不是 Lisa 的嗜好。
打電玩是哥哥的嗜好，不是 Lisa。

qs.q: What does Lisa's brother like?
qs.why: 原文：He likes gaming and photography. 哥哥喜歡打電玩和攝影。
wn: 閱讀是 Lisa 喜歡的，煮飯是媽媽喜歡的。
園藝是媽媽的嗜好，露營是全家的計畫。

qs.q: What is the brother going to do on the weekend?
qs.why: 原文：On the weekend, he is going to go fishing with our father. 週末和爸爸去釣魚。
wn: 文中沒提到購物，週末是去釣魚。
文中沒提到跳舞，週末是去釣魚。

qs.q: What does Lisa's mother enjoy?
qs.why: 原文：My mother enjoys gardening and cooking. 媽媽喜歡園藝和煮飯。
wn: 畫畫和閱讀是 Lisa 喜歡的，不是媽媽。
打電玩、釣魚和哥哥有關，不是媽媽。

qs.q: What is the family going to do next month?
qs.why: 原文：our family is going to go camping in the mountains. 下個月去山上露營。
wn: 文中沒提到游泳，是露營和健行。
文中沒提到購物，是去山上露營。

reading.title: 短文 4
reading.text: This weekend, the weather is going to be nice. Saturday is going to be sunny and warm, so we are going to go to the beach. We are going to swim in the pool and have a picnic in the park. Sunday is going to be different. The forecast says it is going to be cold and rainy. We are going to stay indoors and watch movies. I need to bring my jacket and umbrella. I am excited about our weekend plans!

qs.q: What is the weather going to be like on Saturday?
qs.why: 原文：Saturday is going to be sunny and warm. 星期六晴朗溫暖。
wn: 又冷又下雨是星期天的天氣，不是星期六。
文中沒提到下雪，星期六是晴天。

qs.q: Where are they going to go on Saturday?
qs.why: 原文：Saturday is going to be sunny... so we are going to go to the beach. 去海邊。
wn: 文中沒提到山上，星期六是去海邊。
這是週末計畫，文中沒提到學校。

qs.q: What are they going to do in the park?
qs.why: 原文：We are going to... have a picnic in the park. 他們要在公園野餐。
wn: 文中沒提到購物，公園裡是野餐。
文中沒提到籃球，公園裡是野餐。

qs.q: What is the weather going to be like on Sunday?
qs.why: 原文：The forecast says it is going to be cold and rainy. 星期天又冷又下雨。
wn: 晴天是星期六，星期天會又冷又下雨。
文中沒提到颳風，星期天是 cold and rainy。

qs.q: What are they going to bring?
qs.why: 原文：I need to bring my jacket and umbrella. 要帶外套和雨傘，因為星期天會冷又下雨。
wn: 文中沒提到相機和地圖，要帶外套和雨傘。
文中沒提到樂器，要帶外套和雨傘。

reading.title: 短文 5
reading.text: Amy calls her friend Ben. 'Would you like to come to my party on Saturday?' she asks. Ben says, 'Sure, I would love to! What time?' Amy says, 'Seven o'clock. Let's have dinner together first.' Ben says, 'Sounds great!' Then Amy asks, 'Are you free on Sunday too? Would you like to go to the museum?' Ben says, 'Sorry, I am busy on Sunday. Maybe next time.' Amy says, 'That's okay. Let's hang out next week instead.' Ben says, 'Great idea!'

qs.q: What does Amy invite Ben to on Saturday?
qs.why: 原文：Would you like to come to my party on Saturday? Amy 先邀 Ben 參加星期六的派對。
wn: 文中沒提到音樂會，Amy 邀的是派對。
博物館是 Amy 邀 Ben 星期天（Sunday）去的，不是星期六。

qs.q: What time is the party?
qs.why: 原文：Amy says, 'Seven o'clock.' Ben 問幾點，Amy 回答七點。
wn: 原文說 Seven o'clock，是七點。
原文說 Seven o'clock，是七點。

qs.q: What are they going to do before the party?
qs.why: 原文：Let's have dinner together first. first 表示先一起吃晚餐。
wn: 文中沒提到看電影，先做的是吃晚餐。
文中沒提到購物，先做的是吃晚餐。

qs.q: Is Ben free on Sunday?
qs.why: 原文：Ben says, 'Sorry, I am busy on Sunday.' 星期天 Ben 很忙。
wn: Ben 說 I am busy on Sunday，他沒空。
Ben 說得很清楚：I am busy on Sunday。

qs.q: What do they plan to do next week?
qs.why: 原文：Let's hang out next week instead. 改成下週一起出去玩。
wn: 博物館是 Amy 問星期天的，Ben 沒空。
派對是這星期六，下週是 hang out。

reading.title: 短文 6
reading.text: Next month, my family is going to go on a trip to Korea. We are going to fly from Taipei. Our flight is going to depart at nine in the morning. I can speak a little Korean, so I am going to help my family. We are going to stay at a nice hotel near the city. Would you like to join us? We are going to visit a museum and go shopping. My sister can take great photos, so she is going to bring her camera. Let's plan our schedule together before we go!

qs.q: Where is the family going to go next month?
qs.why: 原文：Next month, my family is going to go on a trip to Korea. 下個月全家去韓國。
wn: 原文說 a trip to Korea，是韓國不是日本。
原文說 a trip to Korea，是韓國不是加拿大。

qs.q: What time is the flight going to depart?
qs.why: 原文：Our flight is going to depart at nine in the morning. 班機早上九點起飛。
wn: 原文說 nine in the morning，是早上九點不是中午。
原文說 in the morning，是早上不是晚上。

qs.q: Why is the writer going to help the family?
opts: The writer can speak a little Korean
qs.why: 原文：I can speak a little Korean, so I am going to help my family. so 前面就是原因。
wn: 文中沒提到地圖，原因是會說一點韓文。
他們是搭飛機去，文中沒提到車子。

qs.q: Where are they going to stay?
qs.why: 原文：We are going to stay at a nice hotel near the city. 住在市區附近的好旅館。
wn: 文中說 stay at a nice hotel，不是朋友家。
文中說 a nice hotel，不是帳篷。

qs.q: Who is going to bring a camera?
qs.why: 原文：My sister... is going to bring her camera. 姊妹很會拍照，由她帶相機。
wn: 文中沒提到爸爸帶相機，帶的是 sister。
作者是負責說韓文幫忙，帶相機的是 sister。
