writing.prompt: 請用「be going to」句型，寫 3 到 5 句英文，描述你下週的計畫。
writing.sample: Next week, I am going to visit my friend. We are going to eat dinner together. I am also going to study English every day. On the weekend, I am going to watch a movie.

writing.prompt: 請用「can / can't」句型，寫 3 到 5 句英文，介紹你會做和不會做的事。
writing.sample: I can speak English and Chinese. I can cook simple food, but I can't cook Italian food. I can ride a bike. I can't drive a car yet. I want to learn how to drive next year.

writing.prompt: 用 3 到 5 句英文介紹你的嗜好。請使用 can 和 be going to。
writing.sample: My hobby is cooking. I can make noodles and soup. I can't bake a cake, but I want to learn. Next month I am going to take a cooking class. My sister is going to come with me.

writing.prompt: 用 3 到 5 句英文描述明天的天氣，以及你因為天氣要做或不做的事。
writing.sample: It is going to rain tomorrow. I am not going to go hiking. I am going to stay at home. I can cook noodles for lunch. In the afternoon, I am going to watch a movie.

writing.prompt: 用 3 到 5 句英文寫下你和朋友的一個約定，說明你們要做什麼、幾點見面。
writing.sample: My friend and I are going to see a movie on Saturday. We are going to meet at seven in front of the cinema. I am going to buy the tickets. She can't drive, so she is going to take the bus. After the movie, we are going to have dinner.

50.topic: 綜合選擇題與情境短文

vocab_new.ex: I wake up at seven every day.
He goes to work at nine.
There is a table in the kitchen.
Is there a supermarket near here?
She was at home last night.
I am going to study tomorrow.
We are going to travel next week.
I can speak a little English.
There are flowers in the garden.
My neighbour is a nice old man.
My street is very quiet at night.
We cook dinner together on Sunday.

vocab_review.why: weekend＝週末。例句：Are you free this weekend?
公園＝park。例句：There is a park near my house.
friend＝朋友。例句：I met my friend on Sunday.
海邊＝beach。例句：They went to the beach last weekend.
museum＝博物館。例句：There is a museum in the city.
運動＝exercise。例句：He exercises three times a week.
picnic＝野餐。例句：We had a picnic at the park.
游泳了＝swam。例句：We swam at the beach last weekend.
shopping mall＝購物中心。例句：We went to the shopping mall on Saturday.
拜訪＝visit。例句：We visited our grandmother.
wn: ride a bike 是「騎腳踏車」

vocab_review.why: vacation＝假期。例句：I went to Japan on vacation.
有一天＝one day。例句：One day, I lost my phone.
after that＝之後。例句：After that, we had lunch.
抵達＝arrive。例句：Did she arrive on time?
stayed＝停留了。例句：We stayed there for three days.
享受了＝enjoyed。例句：We enjoyed the food there.
find＝找到。例句：I find my keys every morning.
很棒的＝amazing。例句：The trip was amazing.
tonight＝今晚。例句：She is going to cook dinner tonight.
下個月＝next month。例句：He is going to start a new job next month.
going to＝將要。例句：I am going to buy a new phone.
旅行＝travel。例句：She is going to travel to Korea next month.
start＝開始。例句：Did the movie start at seven?
見面＝meet。例句：Nice to meet you again.
drive＝開車。例句：He can drive a car.
英文＝English。例句：Can you speak English?
piano＝鋼琴。例句：I can play the piano.
唱歌＝sing。例句：She can sing very well.
ride＝騎(車)。例句：I can ride a bike.
滑雪＝ski。例句：I can't ski.
fix＝修理。例句：He can fix a computer.
電腦＝computer。例句：I have a computer.
cooking＝烹飪。例句：She likes cooking on weekends.
籃球＝basketball。例句：I can play basketball well.
photography＝攝影。例句：I am interested in photography.
露營＝camping。例句：We are going to go camping this weekend.
gardening＝園藝。例句：My mother enjoys gardening every morning.
收集＝collecting。例句：I like collecting stamps.
writing＝寫作。例句：She likes writing short stories.
空閒時間＝free time。例句：In my free time, I like reading.
rainy＝下雨的。例句：It is going to be rainy this weekend.
有風的＝windy。例句：It is very windy outside.
warm＝溫暖的。例句：The weather is warm in spring.
天氣＝weather。例句：The weather is nice today.
jacket＝外套。例句：You should wear a jacket. It's cold.
室內＝indoors。例句：We are going to stay indoors today.
invite＝邀請。例句：I want to invite you to my party.
晚餐＝dinner。例句：Let's have dinner together tonight.
busy＝忙碌的。例句：My job is busy.
也許＝maybe。例句：Maybe next time.
hang out＝出去玩。例句：Would you like to hang out this weekend?
演唱會＝concert。例句：Would you like to go to a concert?
wn: sounds great 是「聽起來很棒」

vocab_review.why: sounds great＝聽起來很棒。例句：That sounds great!
約會；預約＝appointment。例句：I have an appointment next week.
wn: happen 是「發生（過去式 happened）」

vocab_review.why: ticket＝票。例句：I am going to buy a ticket.
護照＝passport。例句：Don't forget your passport.
tour＝旅遊行程。例句：We are going to join a city tour.
紀念品＝souvenir。例句：I am going to buy a souvenir for you.
wn: sounds great 是「聽起來很棒」

vocab_review.why: bus＝公車。例句：Can you take the bus alone?
出發＝depart。例句：The bus is going to depart at nine.

mc.q: I ___ a student.
mc.why: 主詞是 I，be 動詞一定是 am。
wn: is 配 he／she／it，I 用 am。
are 配 you／we／they，I 用 am。

mc.q: She ___ two brothers.
mc.why: She 是一個人，表示擁有用 has。
wn: She 要配 has，have 配 I／you／we／they。
is 不表示擁有，She is two brothers 不通。

mc.q: He ___ to work every day.
mc.why: every day 是習慣，用現在簡單式；主詞 He 是一個人，go 加 es 變 goes。
wn: 主詞 He 是一個人，動詞要加 es 變 goes。
going 前面沒有 is，不能單獨當動詞；習慣用 goes。

mc.q: ___ a bank near here?
mc.why: 問某處有沒有某物，用 Is there 加單數名詞：Is there a bank…?
wn: a bank 只有一間，用 Is there。
少了 there，Is a bank near here? 不是問有沒有。

mc.q: I would like ___ coffee.
mc.why: coffee 當不可數名詞，想要一些用 some：I would like some coffee。
wn: many 配可數複數名詞，coffee 不可數，不用 many。
any 多用在否定句和問句，這是肯定的請求，用 some。

mc.q: I ___ to the park yesterday.
mc.why: yesterday 是昨天；go 不規則，過去式是 went。
wn: go 是現在式，跟 yesterday 對不上。
主詞 I 不加 es，而且要用過去式。

mc.q: We are going to ___ dinner tonight.
mc.why: are going to 後面接原形動詞 cook，tonight 是今晚的計畫。
wn: going to 後面要原形，不加 s。
cooked 是過去式，tonight 是未來計畫，要用原形。

mc.q: ___ you swim?
mc.why: 問對方會不會一項能力（會不會游泳），用 Can you＋原形動詞。
wn: Are you 後面不能接原形 swim，要接 -ing 或形容詞。
主詞 you 不配 Does，Does you swim 不對。

mc.q: They ___ from Taiwan.
mc.why: They 是複數，be 動詞用 are。
wn: is 配一個人或一件事，They 要用 are。

mc.q: There ___ two chairs in the room.
mc.why: two chairs 是兩張（複數），There are 加複數名詞。
wn: is 用在一個東西，two chairs 是複數要用 are。
be 是原形，句子裡要變成 are。

mc.q: My name ___ Wei. I am from Taipei.
mc.why: My name 是一件事（單數），be 動詞用 is：My name is Wei。
wn: are 配複數或 you，My name 只有一個用 is。
am 只配 I，這裡主詞是 My name，不是 I。

mc.q: Tom and I ___ good friends.
mc.why: Tom and I 是兩個人，等於 we，be 動詞用 are。
wn: is 配一個人，Tom and I 是兩個人。
am 只配 I 一個人，這裡還加了 Tom。

mc.q: ___ your sister a nurse?
mc.why: 句中沒有一般動詞，a nurse 是名詞，要用 be 動詞；your sister 單數用 Is。
wn: 句子沒有一般動詞，問身分要用 be 動詞 Is。
Does 要配一般動詞，這裡沒有動詞，要用 Is。

mc.q: This is ___ bag. It is not yours.
mc.why: bag 前面表示我的，用所有格 my；後句 not yours 也說明是我的。
wn: me 是受詞，不能放在名詞 bag 前面。
I 是主詞，不能放在名詞前面。

mc.q: She ___ two cats and one dog.
mc.why: She 是一個人（第三人稱單數），擁有用 has。
wn: She 是一個人，要用 has。
表示擁有用 has，不用 is。

mc.q: They ___ a big house near the park.
mc.why: 主詞 They 是複數，表示擁有用 have：They have a big house。
wn: has 配 he／she／it 一個人，They 要用 have。
表示擁有東西要用 have，而且 They 也不配 is。

mc.q: Peter loves ___ new bike.
mc.why: Peter 是男生，他的用 his：his new bike。
wn: her 是她的，Peter 是男生要用 his。
their 是他們的，Peter 只有一個人。

mc.q: My parents drive ___ car to work.
mc.why: My parents 是兩個人，car 前面表示他們的，用所有格 their。
wn: they 是主詞（他們），不能放在名詞前面。
them 是受詞，不能修飾名詞 car。

mc.q: Anna ___ coffee every morning.
mc.why: every morning 是習慣，用現在簡單式；Anna 是一個人，drink 加 s。
wn: Anna 是一個人（她），動詞要加 s：drinks。
drinking 前面要有 is，單獨不能當動詞。

mc.q: I ___ like cold weather.
mc.why: like 是一般動詞，否定要用 do／does＋not；主詞 I 用 don't。
wn: doesn't 只配 he／she／it，主詞是 I。
like 是一般動詞，不能用 am not 來否定。

mc.q: My brother ___ watch TV after ten o'clock.
mc.why: My brother 是一個人，一般動詞 watch 的否定用 doesn't 加原形。
wn: don't 配複數或 I／you，My brother 用 doesn't。
watch 是一般動詞，否定不用 isn't。

mc.q: We ___ to the market on Saturday.
mc.why: 頻率副詞 often 放在一般動詞 go 前面：We often go to the market。
wn: We 是複數，動詞不加 es，要用 go。
只填 often，句子會少了動詞 go。

mc.q: ___ there a bank near here?
mc.why: a bank 是一個，There is 的問句把 Is 放到前面：Is there a bank…?
wn: a bank 只有一個，要用 Is there，不用 Are there。
問某處有沒有東西用 Is there，不用 Have。

mc.q: There ___ four chairs in the kitchen.
mc.why: four chairs 是四張（複數），用 There are。
wn: four chairs 是複數，用 are。
說某地有東西用 There are，不說 There has。

mc.q: The keys are ___ the table.
mc.why: on 是在…上面（貼著表面），鑰匙放在桌上用 on the table。
wn: in front 要加 of 才完整，而且意思是在前面。
後面已經有 the，會變成 the the，也不是在上面。

mc.q: My office is ___ the second floor.
mc.why: 說在第幾樓固定用 on：on the second floor。
wn: 樓層要說 on the second floor，不用 in。
樓層固定用 on，不用 at。

mc.q: I would like ___ water, please.
mc.why: water 不可數，肯定的點餐說一些用 some：some water。
wn: water 不可數，不說 a water；一杯是 a glass of water。
many 接可數複數，water 不可數。

mc.q: We don't have ___ milk at home.
mc.why: don't 是否定句，否定句用 any；milk 不可數，也是用 any。
wn: some 用在肯定句，否定句要改成 any。
milk 不可數，不能加 a。

mc.q: ___ eggs do you need?
mc.why: eggs 可以一顆一顆數（複數），問數量用 How many。
wn: How much 問不可數的量或價錢，eggs 可數。
How long 問時間多久或東西多長。

mc.q: ___ is this shirt?
mc.why: 問價錢固定說 How much is…?：How much is this shirt?
wn: How many 問數量，不能問價錢。
How old 問年紀，不是價錢。

mc.q: I ___ very tired last night.
mc.why: last night 是過去；主詞 I 的 be 動詞過去式是 was。
wn: am 是現在式，last night 是過去。
were 配 you／we／they，主詞 I 用 was。

mc.q: They ___ at the beach yesterday.
mc.why: yesterday 是過去；主詞 They 是複數，be 動詞過去式用 were。
wn: was 配 I 或 he／she／it 一個人，They 是複數。
are 是現在式，有 yesterday 要用過去式。

mc.q: We ___ a movie last Friday.
mc.why: last Friday 是過去，規則動詞加 ed：watch 變 watched。
wn: watch 是原形，last Friday 要用過去式 watched。
watches 是現在式，而且 We 不加 es。

mc.q: She ___ to Tainan last month.
mc.why: last month 是過去；go 是不規則動詞，過去式是 went。
wn: go 是原形，last month 要用 went。
goes 是現在式，last month 是過去。

mc.q: I ___ eat breakfast this morning.
mc.why: this morning 已經過去，沒吃早餐是過去的事，用 didn't 加原形 eat。
wn: don't 講平常習慣，今天早上沒吃是過去的事。
eat 是一般動詞，否定用 didn't，不用 wasn't。

mc.q: ___ you call your mother last night?
mc.why: last night 是過去，句子有動作 call，問句用 Did 開頭，call 用原形。
wn: Do 是現在式，跟 last night 對不上。
Are 是 be 動詞現在式，不能接原形 call。

mc.q: I ___ visit my grandmother next Sunday.
mc.why: next Sunday 是未來的計畫，用 be going to；主詞 I 配 am：I am going to。
wn: 少了 be 動詞 am，I going to 不完整。
next Sunday 是計畫，要用 am going to，不是 go to。

mc.q: He ___ swim very well.
mc.why: can 不管主詞是誰都不變，後面直接接原形動詞：He can swim。
wn: can 不加 s，主詞是 He 也一樣。
can 後面直接接原形動詞，不加 to。

mc.q: Sorry, I ___ come to your party tomorrow.
mc.why: 表示不能做某事用 can't＋原形動詞；can 的否定直接寫 can't（cannot）。
wn: can 不跟 do 一起用，否定直接寫 can't。
not 要放在 can 後面，變成 cannot 或 can't。

mc.q: What ___ you going to do this weekend?
mc.why: 主詞 you 配 are：What are you going to do?
wn: 有 going to 要用 be 動詞，不用 do。
is 配 he／she／it，主詞 you 用 are。

mc.q: My teacher ___ from Canada.
mc.why: My teacher 是一位老師，單數用 is；be from 表示來自哪裡。
wn: are 用在複數或 you，老師只有一位。
be 是原形，句子裡要改成 is，不能直接放 be。

mc.q: How many brothers ___ you have?
mc.why: 主詞 you 配助動詞 do，have 是一般動詞：How many brothers do you have?
wn: does 配 he／she／it，主詞 you 要用 do。
have 是一般動詞，問句要用 do，不用 are。

mc.q: There ___ any bread in the box.
mc.why: bread 是不可數名詞，當單數看，否定用 There isn't any bread。
wn: bread 不可數，當單數，要用 isn't。
There is 句型的否定是 isn't，不用 don't。

mc.q: She is ___ late for class.
mc.why: 頻率副詞放在 be 動詞後面：She is never late。
wn: 句子已經有 is，再填 is 會重複；never 要放在 is 後面。
not 和 never 都是否定，不能放在一起。

mc.q: Last year I ___ a student in Taichung.
mc.why: Last year 是過去；主詞 I 的 be 動詞過去式是 was。
wn: am 是現在式，Last year 是過去要用 was。
were 配 you／we／they，I 用 was。

mc.q: We ___ dinner at seven every day.
mc.why: every day 是習慣，用現在簡單式；主詞 We 是複數，動詞用原形 eat。
wn: 只有一個人或一件事才加 s，We 用 eat。
eating 前面沒有 are，不能單獨當動詞。

mc.q: Can I ___ your dictionary?
mc.why: Can I 後面接原形動詞，借東西說 Can I borrow…?
wn: can 後面不接 ing，要用原形 borrow。
can 後面的動詞不加 s。

mc.q: The children ___ in the park now.
mc.why: now 是現在；children 是 child 的複數，用 are。
wn: children 是很多小孩，要用 are。
was 是過去式，now 是現在。

mc.q: My sister ___ her homework last night.
mc.why: last night 是過去，do（做）的過去式是 did：did her homework。
wn: do 是現在式，last night 是過去要用 did。
does 是現在式，last night 要用過去式 did。

mc.q: It ___ going to rain this afternoon.
mc.why: 主詞 It 是一件事（第三人稱單數），be 動詞用 is：It is going to rain。
wn: are 配複數或 you，It 要用 is。
be 是原形，句子裡要變成 is，It be 不對。

fill.q: My name ___ Leo.
fill.why: 主詞 My name 是一個，be 動詞用 is。

fill.q: She ___ one sister.
fill.why: 主詞 She 是一個人，擁有用 has。

fill.q: I usually ___ at 7.
fill.why: usually 是習慣；主詞 I 用原形，起床說 wake up 或 get up。

fill.q: ___ a table in the kitchen.
fill.why: a table 是一張，句首用 There is。

fill.q: Is there ___ milk?
fill.why: 問句問有沒有牛奶，用 any；milk 不可數。

fill.q: He ___ go to work yesterday.
fill.why: yesterday 是過去，否定用 didn't，後面 go 用原形。

fill.q: I ___ speak a little English.
fill.why: can 表示會，後面接原形 speak。

fill.q: We are going to ___ next week.
fill.why: are going to 後面接原形動詞；travel 是去旅行。

fill.q: They ___ happy today.
fill.why: today 是現在；主詞 They 是複數，用 are。

fill.q: I ___ dinner with my family every night.
fill.why: every night 是習慣，用現在簡單式；主詞 I 用原形 have（吃晚餐）。

fill.q: I ___ a student at a small school.
fill.why: 主詞 I 的 be 動詞用 am。

fill.q: My father ___ a taxi driver.
fill.why: 主詞 My father 是一個人，等於 he，be 動詞用 is；後面 a taxi driver 是他的職業。

fill.q: We ___ happy today.
fill.why: 主詞 We 是複數，be 動詞用 are。

fill.q: ___ you a teacher?
fill.why: 主詞 you 的 be 動詞用 are，問句把 Are 放句首。

fill.q: This is ___ book. It is Mary's book.
fill.why: 後面說是 Mary 的書，Mary 是女生，所有格用 her。

fill.q: Ben and Tim wash ___ hands before dinner.
fill.why: Ben and Tim 是兩個人，所有格用 their。

fill.q: I ___ a small dog at home.
fill.why: 主詞 I，擁有用 have。

fill.q: My uncle ___ three children.
fill.why: 主詞 My uncle 是一個人，擁有用 has。

fill.q: She ___ (get) up at six every morning.
fill.why: every morning 是習慣；主詞 She 是一個人，get 加 s 變 gets。

fill.q: They ___ (live) in a small town.
fill.why: 主詞 They 是複數，現在簡單式用原形 live，不加 s。

fill.q: He ___ like spicy food.
fill.why: 主詞 He 是一個人，否定用 doesn't，後面 like 用原形。

fill.q: We ___ watch TV on Monday.
fill.why: 主詞 We 是複數，現在簡單式否定用 don't，後面接原形 watch。

fill.q: My mother ___ goes to the market on Sunday.
fill.why: 頻率副詞放在一般動詞 goes 前面，例：My mother always goes…。

fill.q: There ___ a big tree in front of my house.
fill.why: a big tree 是一棵，用 There is。

fill.q: There ___ two beds in the room.
fill.why: two beds 是複數，用 There are。

fill.q: The cat is ___ the box.
fill.why: 貓在盒子裡面，用 in：in the box。

fill.q: My school is ___ to the post office.
fill.why: 在…旁邊固定說 next to；空格後面已經有 to，只填 next。

fill.q: I would ___ a cup of tea, please.
fill.why: I would like… 是禮貌點東西的說法：我想要一杯茶。

fill.q: Do you have ___ questions?
fill.why: 問句問有沒有問題，用 any，後面接複數 questions。

fill.q: I want ___ sugar in my coffee.
fill.why: 肯定句、想要一些，用 some；sugar 不可數。

fill.q: How ___ money do you have?
fill.why: money 不可數，問多少用 How much。

fill.q: How ___ apples are there?
fill.why: apples 是可數名詞複數，問多少個用 How many。

fill.q: I ___ at home yesterday.
fill.why: yesterday 是過去；主詞 I 用 was。

fill.q: They ___ very busy last week.
fill.why: last week 是過去；主詞 They 是複數，用 were。

fill.q: We ___ (play) basketball last Sunday.
fill.why: last Sunday 是過去，play 加 ed 變 played。

fill.q: She ___ (buy) a new phone last month.
fill.why: last month 是過去，buy 的過去式不規則，變 bought。

fill.q: I ___ go to school last Saturday.
fill.why: last Saturday 是過去，否定用 didn't，後面 go 用原形。

fill.q: ___ you see the film last night?
fill.why: last night 是過去，問句用 Did 放句首，後面 see 用原形。

fill.q: He is going ___ study English tonight.
fill.why: be going to 是固定組合，going 後面要接 to，再接原形 study。

fill.q: They ___ going to move to Kaohsiung.
fill.why: 主詞 They 是複數，be going to 的 be 動詞用 are。

fill.q: I ___ ride a bike, but I can't drive a car.
fill.why: but 後面說不會開車，前面相反：會騎腳踏車，用 can。

fill.q: My brother ___ cook. He only makes toast.
fill.why: 後面說他只會做吐司，所以他不會煮菜，用 can't。

fill.q: My friends ___ (be) from Japan.
fill.why: 主詞 My friends 是複數，be 動詞用 are。

fill.q: Does she ___ (work) on Saturday?
fill.why: Does 已經放在句首，後面的動詞用原形 work，不加 s。

fill.q: There ___ any chairs in the classroom.
fill.why: 後面有 any 和複數 chairs，是否定句，用 There aren't。

fill.q: What ___ you do last weekend?
fill.why: last weekend 是過去，問句用 did：What did you do?

fill.q: My keys are ___ my bag.
fill.why: 鑰匙在包包裡面，用 in 或 inside。

fill.q: I am going to ___ (visit) my aunt tomorrow.
fill.why: am going to 後面接原形動詞 visit，不加 s、不加 ing。

fill.q: He ___ (not be) at work yesterday.
fill.why: yesterday 是過去；主詞 He 用 was，否定是 wasn't。

fill.q: Sam and I ___ (walk) to school every day.
fill.why: every day 是習慣；Sam and I 是兩個人，walk 用原形不加 s。

translate.why: I 配 am；一名就是 a，職業前要加 a：a nurse。
She 是一個人，用 has；兩個哥哥是複數：two brothers。
這是用 This is；我的用所有格 my，前面有 my 就不用再加 an。

a: He gets up at seven every day.
translate.why: every day 是習慣；主詞 He 一個人，get 加 s：gets up；七點用 at seven。
主詞 I，否定用 don't like；咖啡在這裡是總稱，不加 a 也不加 s。
often 是常常，放在動詞前；主詞 My mother 一個人，cook 加 s：often cooks。

a: There is a book on the table.
translate.why: 一本書用 There is a book；在桌上 on the table。

a: There are two shops near my house.
There are two stores near my house.
translate.why: 兩間是複數，用 There are two shops；我家附近 near my house。

a: I would like a cup of tea.
I'd like a cup of tea.
translate.why: 禮貌點東西用 I would like；茶不可數，一杯要說 a cup of tea。

a: There isn't any milk in the fridge.
There is no milk in the fridge.
translate.why: 沒有牛奶用 There isn't any milk 或 There is no milk；milk 不可數不加 s。

a: How many eggs do you need?
translate.why: 雞蛋可數，問多少用 How many 加複數 eggs，後面接 do you need。

a: How much does this jacket cost?
How much does this coat cost?
translate.why: 問價錢用 How much is…?；這件外套是一件，用 this jacket＋is。
昨天是過去，I 的 be 動詞過去式用 was；累 tired。

translate.zh: 我們上個週末看了電影。
a: We watched a movie last weekend.
translate.why: 上個週末是過去，watch 加 ed 變 watched；看電影 watch a movie。

a: She went to Tainan last month.
translate.why: 上個月是過去，go 的過去式是 went；去台南 went to Tainan。
過去否定用 didn't 加原形 study，不能寫 didn't studied。

translate.zh: 你昨晚打電話給他了嗎？
a: Did you call him last night?
translate.why: 昨晚是過去，疑問句用 Did 開頭，後接原形 call；打電話給他是 call him，不用加 to。

a: I am going to see a doctor tomorrow.
I'm going to see the doctor tomorrow.
translate.why: 明天的計畫用 am going to 加原形 see；看醫生是 see a doctor 或 see the doctor。
會某種能力用 can＋原形：I can swim，不用 I am swim。
不會開車用 can't 或 cannot 加原形 drive；主詞是 He，can 後面的動詞也不加 s。

error.s: I am have a new bag.
error.correct: I have a new bag.
error.why: have 是動詞，不需要再加 be 動詞

error.s: She have three cats.
error.why: 第三人稱單數用 has
error.full: She has three cats.

error.s: My friends is very kind.
error.why: 複數主詞要用 are
error.full: My friends are very kind.

error.s: This is she book.
error.why: 所有格要用 her，不是 she
error.full: This is her book.

error.s: He go to work by bus.
error.why: 第三人稱單數動詞要加 -s
error.full: He goes to work by bus.

error.s: I don't likes tea.
error.why: don't 後面用動詞原形
error.full: I don't like tea.

error.s: She doesn't has a car.
error.why: doesn't 後面用動詞原形 have
error.full: She doesn't have a car.

error.s: There is two windows in my room.
error.why: 複數名詞要用 There are
error.full: There are two windows in my room.

error.s: The book is in the table.
error.why: 平面上要用 on
error.full: The book is on the table.

error.s: I would like some waters.
error.why: water 是不可數名詞，不加 -s
error.full: I would like some water.

error.s: How much apples do you want?
error.why: 可數名詞用 how many
error.full: How many apples do you want?

error.s: We was at home last night.
error.why: we 要用 were
error.full: We were at home last night.

error.s: I didn't went to school.
error.why: didn't 後面用動詞原形
error.full: I didn't go to school.

error.s: I going to call you tomorrow.
error.correct: I am going to call you tomorrow.
error.why: be going to 不能省略 be 動詞

error.s: He cans play the piano.
error.why: can 不隨人稱變化，後面接原形動詞
error.full: He can play the piano.

reading.title: 短文 1
reading.text: Hi, my name is Mia. I am from Taiwan. Every day, I go to work at nine o'clock. Yesterday, I had a meeting and went to lunch with my friend. We ate noodles and talked for an hour. Tonight, I am going to cook dinner for my family. Tomorrow, I am going to visit my parents. I can cook simple food, but I can't cook big meals yet. My mother has a small garden, and there are many flowers in it. I love my family very much.

qs.q: Where is Mia from?
qs.why: 原文：Hi, my name is Mia. I am from Taiwan. Mia 來自台灣。
wn: 原文說 I am from Taiwan，不是日本。
原文說 I am from Taiwan，不是韓國。

qs.q: What did Mia do yesterday?
opts: Had a meeting and lunch with a friend
qs.why: 原文：Yesterday, I had a meeting and went to lunch with my friend. 昨天開會和吃午餐。
wn: 文中沒提到購物，昨天是開會和吃午餐。
看父母是明天（Tomorrow）的計畫，不是昨天。

qs.q: What is Mia going to do tonight?
qs.why: 原文：Tonight, I am going to cook dinner for my family. 今晚要煮晚餐給家人吃。
wn: 上班是每天九點，今晚是煮晚餐。
文中沒提到讀英文，今晚是煮晚餐。

qs.q: Can Mia cook big meals?
qs.why: 原文：I can't cook big meals yet. 還不會煮大餐，所以是 No, not yet.
wn: 原文說 can't cook big meals yet，還不會。
文章有寫：can't cook big meals yet。

qs.q: What is in Mia's mother's garden?
qs.why: 原文：My mother has a small garden, and there are many flowers in it. 花園裡有很多花。
wn: 文中說 many flowers，是花不是蔬菜。
文中說 many flowers，沒提到樹。

reading.title: 短文 2
reading.text: Hello. My name is Amy. I am twenty-five years old. I live in Taipei with my mother and my brother. I am a nurse and I work at a small hospital. I usually start work at eight in the morning. I don't work on Sunday. Last Sunday I went to the night market with my brother. We ate noodles and drank tea. It was fun. Next Saturday I am going to visit my grandmother in Hualien. She has a small garden. I can't cook well, but I can make good soup.

qs.q: Where does Amy live?
qs.why: 原文：I live in Taipei with my mother and my brother. Amy 住在台北。
wn: 花蓮是祖母住的地方，Amy 住台北。
文中沒提到台南，Amy 住在 Taipei。

qs.q: What is Amy's job?
qs.why: 原文：I am a nurse and I work at a small hospital. Amy 是護理師。
wn: 原文說 I am a nurse，不是老師。
原文說 I am a nurse，不是司機。

qs.q: What did Amy do last Sunday?
opts: She went to the night market
qs.why: 原文：Last Sunday I went to the night market with my brother. 上週日去夜市。
wn: 原文說 I don't work on Sunday，星期天不上班。
看祖母是下週六（Next Saturday）的計畫。

qs.q: What is Amy going to do next Saturday?
qs.why: 原文：Next Saturday I am going to visit my grandmother in Hualien. 下週六去花蓮看祖母。
wn: 文中沒提到新工作，她現在是護理師。
麵是上週日在夜市吃的，不是下週六煮。

qs.q: What can Amy do?
qs.why: 原文：I can't cook well, but I can make good soup. 她會煮好喝的湯。
wn: 原文說 I can't cook well，她不太會煮飯。
文中沒提到開公車，她是護理師。

reading.title: 短文 3
reading.text: My name is Kevin. I am a student. My family has four people: my father, my mother, my sister and me. Our flat is small but nice. There are two bedrooms and one bathroom. My room is next to the kitchen. I get up at six thirty every day and I always take the bus to school. I don't like the bus, but it is cheap. Last week I was sick, so I didn't go to school for two days. Tomorrow I am going to play basketball with my friends.

qs.q: How many people are in Kevin's family?
qs.why: 原文：My family has four people. 家裡有四個人，包含 Kevin 自己。
wn: 文中說 four people，要把 Kevin 自己 me 也算進去。
文中只列出爸、媽、姊妹和 me，共四個人。

qs.q: How many bedrooms are in the flat?
qs.why: 原文：There are two bedrooms and one bathroom. 臥室 bedroom 有兩間。
wn: one 是在說浴室 one bathroom，臥室是 two bedrooms。
文中說 two bedrooms，沒有三間。

qs.q: How does Kevin go to school?
qs.why: 原文：I always take the bus to school. take the bus 就是搭公車，所以是 By bus。
wn: 文中說 take the bus，不是騎腳踏車 bike。
on foot 是走路；文中說他每天搭公車 take the bus。

qs.q: Why didn't Kevin go to school last week?
qs.why: 原文：Last week I was sick, so I didn't go to school. so 前面就是原因：他生病了 sick。
wn: 文中沒說他很忙 busy，原因是 I was sick。
文中沒提到放假 holiday，是因為生病 sick 才沒去。

qs.q: What is Kevin going to do tomorrow?
qs.why: 原文：Tomorrow I am going to play basketball with my friends. 明天要和朋友打籃球。
wn: 文中沒提到考試 test，明天是要打籃球。
文中只說 My room is next to the kitchen，沒說要打掃房間。

reading.title: 短文 4
reading.text: Mr. Lin is my neighbour. He is sixty years old and he is very kind. He has a big black dog. Every morning he walks his dog in the park near our street. The park is quiet and there are many trees. Mr. Lin doesn't drive; he always rides his old bike. Yesterday he helped me carry a heavy box up the stairs. I said thank you. Next month he is going to travel to Japan with his wife. He can speak a little Japanese.

qs.q: How old is Mr. Lin?
qs.why: 原文：He is sixty years old. sixty 是六十，所以他 60 歲。
wn: sixteen 是十六，文中是 sixty 六十，拼字很像要看清楚。
fifty 是五十，文中說的是 sixty 六十。

qs.q: What does Mr. Lin do every morning?
qs.why: 原文：Every morning he walks his dog in the park. 每天早上他在公園遛狗。
wn: 文中說 Mr. Lin doesn't drive，他不開車。
他是在公園遛狗 walks his dog，文中沒說他在看書。

qs.q: How does Mr. Lin travel around?
qs.why: 原文：Mr. Lin doesn't drive; he always rides his old bike. 他總是騎他的舊腳踏車。
wn: 文中說 Mr. Lin doesn't drive，他不開車。
文中沒提到公車，他都騎腳踏車 rides his old bike。

qs.q: What did Mr. Lin do yesterday?
opts: He helped with a heavy box
qs.why: 原文：Yesterday he helped me carry a heavy box up the stairs. 昨天他幫忙把重箱子搬上樓。
wn: 他本來就有一隻狗 He has a big black dog，文中沒說昨天買狗。
去日本是 Next month 下個月的計畫，不是昨天。

qs.q: What language can Mr. Lin speak a little?
qs.why: 原文：He can speak a little Japanese. a little 是一點點，他會說一點日文。
wn: 文中沒提到法文 French，是 Japanese 日文。
文中沒提到韓文 Korean，他會一點的是 Japanese。

writing.prompt: 請用今天的綜合練習，寫一段 5 句左右的英文，內容包含：你是誰（be 動詞）、你有什麼家人（have/has）、你平常做什麼（現在簡單式）、你昨天做了什麼（過去式）、你下週的計畫（be going to）。
writing.sample: My name is Ken. I have one sister. I usually go to work at eight o'clock. Yesterday, I visited my friend and we watched a movie. Next week, I am going to travel to Taichung.

writing.prompt: 用 3-5 句英文介紹你自己：姓名、年齡、住哪裡、工作或學校。
writing.sample: My name is David. I am thirty years old. I live in Taichung with my family. I am a cook and I work at a small restaurant. I like my job.

writing.prompt: 用 3-5 句英文寫你上個週末做了什麼。
writing.sample: Last weekend I was very busy. On Saturday I cleaned my room and washed my clothes. On Sunday I went to the park with my friend. We ate lunch there. It was a nice day.

writing.prompt: 用 3-5 句英文寫你下週的計畫，並說一件你會做和一件你不會做的事。
writing.sample: Next week I am going to start a new class. I am going to study English every evening. I can use a computer well. I can't speak Japanese. I want to learn more.

vocab_review.why: story＝故事。例句：I want to tell you a story.
假期＝vacation。例句：I went to Japan on vacation.
first＝首先。例句：First, I woke up early.
之後＝after that。例句：After that, we had lunch.
arrived＝抵達了。例句：We arrived at the airport early.
享受＝enjoy。例句：I enjoyed the trip.
problem＝問題。例句：We had a small problem.
找到了＝found。例句：I found my ticket in my bag.
happen＝發生（過去式 happened）。例句：What happened last night?
下週＝next week。例句：We are going to visit Taipei next week.
weekend＝週末。例句：Are you free this weekend?
將要＝going to。例句：I am going to buy a new phone.
travel＝旅行。例句：She is going to travel to Korea next month.
買＝buy。例句：I would like to buy some apples.
meet＝見面。例句：Nice to meet you again.
煮飯＝cook。例句：My father is a cook.
speak＝說(語言)。例句：I can speak English a little.
演奏；玩＝play。例句：We played basketball yesterday.
guitar＝吉他。例句：My brother has an old guitar.
跑步＝run。例句：He can run very fast.
ski＝滑雪。例句：I can't ski.
畫畫(顏料)＝paint。例句：She can paint beautiful pictures.
computer＝電腦。例句：I have a computer.
閱讀＝reading。例句：My hobby is reading books.
basketball＝籃球。例句：I can play basketball well.
攝影＝photography。例句：I am interested in photography.
camping＝露營。例句：We are going to go camping this weekend.
健行＝hiking。例句：We are going to go hiking on Saturday.
drawing＝畫畫(素描)。例句：He can do drawing very well.
聽音樂＝listening to music。例句：I like listening to music at night.
free time＝空閒時間。例句：In my free time, I like reading.
晴朗的＝sunny。例句：Tomorrow is going to be sunny.
windy＝有風的。例句：It is very windy outside.
熱的＝hot。例句：It was hot last week.
weather＝天氣。例句：The weather is nice today.
外套＝jacket。例句：You should wear a jacket. It's cold.
park＝公園。例句：There is a park near my house.
室內＝indoors。例句：We are going to stay indoors today.
go hiking＝去健行、爬山。例句：Would you like to go hiking with me on Sunday?
電影＝movie。例句：We like this movie.
wn: listening to music 是「聽音樂」

vocab_review.why: sorry＝抱歉。例句：Sorry, I am late.
有空的＝free。例句：Are you free now?
together＝一起。例句：We are together at school.
咖啡廳＝café。例句：There is a café next to the library.
would like＝想要。例句：I would like a sandwich.
行程表＝schedule。例句：My schedule is busy on Mondays.
holiday＝假期。例句：Are you free during the holiday?
飯店＝hotel。例句：There is a hotel between the park and the museum.
suitcase＝行李箱。例句：I am going to pack my suitcase tonight.
相機＝camera。例句：We have a camera.
train＝火車。例句：We are going to take the train.
計程車＝taxi。例句：We are going to take a taxi to the airport.
practice＝練習。例句：I am going to practice English every day.
老師＝teacher。例句：She is a teacher.
wn: sister 是「姊妹（姊姊或妹妹）」

vocab_review.why: wake up＝起床。例句：I wake up at 7 o'clock.
超市＝supermarket。例句：There is a supermarket next to the school.
water＝水。例句：I would like some water, please.
能夠＝can。例句：I can speak a little English.
garden＝花園。例句：There are flowers in the garden.
安靜的＝quiet。例句：The classroom is quiet.

mc.q: This is ___ mother.
mc.why: 後面接名詞 mother，要用所有格 my（我的）：my mother。
wn: I 是主詞，不能放在名詞前面。
me 是受詞，不能修飾名詞 mother。

mc.q: ___ a bed in the bedroom.
mc.why: 說某地方有某東西用 There is／are；a bed 是一張，所以用 There is。
wn: a bed 只有一張，要用 There is。
It is 是它是；要說房間裡有一張床用 There is。

mc.q: The bank is ___ the supermarket.
mc.why: next to 是在…旁邊，用來說銀行的位置在超市旁邊。
wn: between 要接兩個地方（A and B），這裡只有超市一個。
句子已經有 is，不能再加 are，are 也不表示位置。

mc.q: I would like ___ rice.
mc.why: rice 是不可數名詞（米飯不一粒一粒數），想要一些用 some。
wn: rice 不可數，不能加 a。
肯定的請求用 some，any 多用在否定句或問句。

mc.q: Is there ___ milk?
mc.why: Is there…? 是疑問句，問有沒有時通常用 any；milk 是不可數名詞。
wn: many 配可數複數名詞，milk 不可數，不用 many。
milk 是不可數名詞，不能加 a。

mc.q: I ___ at home last night.
mc.why: last night 是過去；I 的 be 動詞過去式是 was。
wn: were 配 you／we／they，I 用 was。
am 是現在式，last night 是過去。

mc.q: They ___ at the park yesterday.
mc.why: yesterday 是過去；They 是複數，be 過去式用 were。
wn: was 配一個人或一件事，They 要用 were。
are 是現在式，yesterday 是過去。

mc.q: He ___ go to work yesterday.
mc.why: yesterday 是過去；一般動詞否定用 didn't 加原形，主詞是誰都一樣。
wn: don't 是現在式，yesterday 要用 didn't。
doesn't 是現在式，yesterday 要用 didn't。

mc.q: My brother ___ speak French.
mc.why: can 後面接原形 speak，主詞是一個人 can 也不變。
wn: 這裡的 can 是會，不加 ing。

mc.q: We ___ visit Taipei next week.
mc.why: next week 是未來的計畫，用 be going to 加原形；主詞 We 配 are。
wn: is 配一個人或一件事，We 是複數要用 are。
go 是現在習慣的說法；next week 的計畫用 are going to。

mc.q: That shop ___ open on Sunday.
mc.why: open 在這裡是形容詞（開著的），配 be 動詞；That shop 單數，否定用 isn't。
wn: That shop 只有一間，用 isn't。
be 動詞的否定直接加 not，不和 doesn't 一起用。

mc.q: The apples ___ fresh today.
mc.why: apples 字尾有 s，是很多個（複數），be 動詞用 are。
wn: is 配一個人或一件事，apples 是複數要用 are。

mc.q: ___ I your new teacher?
mc.why: 主詞 I 的 be 動詞是 am；問句把 Am 放到句首：Am I…?
wn: Is 配 he／she／it，主詞是 I。
句子只有名詞 teacher，沒有一般動詞，要用 be 動詞。

mc.q: My mother has ___ own shop.
mc.why: own 前面要用所有格：her own shop（她自己的店）；My mother 是女生用 her。
wn: she 是主詞，不能放在名詞前面。
hers 是她的東西，單獨使用，後面不能再接名詞。

mc.q: We ___ enough money for the bus.
mc.why: 主詞 We 是複數，擁有用 have。
wn: has 配一個人或一件事，We 用 have。
句子需要真正的動詞，having 不能單獨當動詞。

mc.q: The dog is hungry. ___ bowl is empty.
mc.why: 指狗的碗，它的用所有格 Its，Its 沒有 ' 符號。
wn: It 是主詞（它），不能放在名詞 bowl 前面。
It's 是 It is 的縮寫，It is bowl 不通；它的是 Its。

mc.q: My brother and I share ___ room.
mc.why: My brother and I 等於 we，我們的用所有格 our，後面接名詞 room。
wn: us 是受詞（我們），不能放在名詞前面。
ours 是我們的東西，單獨使用，後面不接名詞。

mc.q: The shop ___ at nine every morning.
mc.why: every morning 是習慣；The shop 是一間（單數），動詞加 s：opens。
wn: The shop 是單數，動詞要加 s 變 opens。
opening 前面沒有 is，不能單獨當動詞。

mc.q: I ___ shopping on Friday evening.
mc.why: 主詞是 I，現在簡單式的動詞用原形：I go shopping（我去購物）。
wn: 只有 he／she／it 才加 es，I 用 go。
going 前面沒有 am，不能單獨當動詞。

mc.q: My father ___ buy new clothes very often.
mc.why: buy 是一般動詞，否定用 don't／doesn't；My father 是一個人，用 doesn't。
wn: don't 配 I／you／we／they，My father 是一個人。
isn't 是 be 動詞的否定，buy 是一般動詞。

mc.q: She ___ pays with a credit card.
mc.why: 頻率副詞 usually（通常）放在一般動詞 pays 前面。
wn: usual 是形容詞，放在動詞前面要用副詞 usually。
pays 是一般動詞，前面不能再加 is。

mc.q: ___ your mother work in a bank?
mc.why: your mother 是一個人，一般動詞 work 的問句用 Does，後面動詞用原形。
wn: Do 配 I／you／we／they，your mother 用 Does。
work 是一般動詞，問句用 Does，不用 Is。

mc.q: There ___ a supermarket next to my flat.
mc.why: a supermarket 是一間（單數），用 There is。
wn: a supermarket 只有一間，用 is。
說某處有東西用 There is，不說 There have。

mc.q: There ___ many people in the shop today.
mc.why: many people 是很多人（複數），There 後面用 are；today 是現在。
wn: is 配一個或不可數的東西，many people 是複數。
was 是單數又是過去式，today 和 many people 都不合。

mc.q: The bread is ___ the bottom shelf.
mc.why: 東西放在架子的平面上，用 on：on the shelf。
wn: in 是在裡面；架子是平面，東西是放在上面。
at 指一個點或地點，放在架子上要用 on。

mc.q: My bag is ___ the chair.
mc.why: under 是在…下面，說包包放在椅子底下。
wn: of 是…的，不能單獨表示位置。
字的順序亂掉，不成一個說法；在下面用 under。

mc.q: Can I have ___ rice, please?
mc.why: rice 是不可數名詞，不能加 a／an；點餐要一些時用 some。
wn: rice 不可數，不能說 a rice。
an 用在母音開頭的可數名詞前，rice 不可數。

mc.q: I don't want ___ sugar in my tea.
mc.why: don't 是否定句，用 any；sugar 是不可數名詞。
wn: sugar 不可數，不能加 a。
many 配可數複數，sugar 不可數。

mc.q: ___ bananas would you like?
mc.why: bananas 可以一根一根數（複數），問數量用 How many。
wn: How much 問不可數的量或價錢，bananas 可數用 How many。
How old 問年紀，不是問數量。

mc.q: ___ is a bottle of water here?
mc.why: 問價錢用 How much；How much is…? 意思是…多少錢。
wn: How many 問有幾個，後面要接複數名詞。
How long 問多久或多長，不是問價錢。

mc.q: I ___ like two kilos of apples.
mc.why: 買東西時客氣地說想要，用 I would like…（我想要）。
wn: will like 是將會喜歡，不是想要買。
am 後面不能接原形動詞 like。

mc.q: The shop ___ very busy yesterday.
mc.why: yesterday 是過去；The shop 是一家店（單數），be 動詞過去式用 was。
wn: is 是現在式，有 yesterday 要用過去式。
were 配複數或 you，The shop 只有一家。

mc.q: We ___ in the market this morning.
mc.why: this morning 指今天早上，已經過去了；主詞 We 是複數，be 過去式用 were。
wn: was 配 I／he／she／it，We 要用 were。
be 動詞只能有一個，are 和 was 不能一起用。

mc.q: She ___ a new dress last week.
mc.why: last week 是過去；buy 是不規則動詞，過去式是 bought。
wn: buy 是原形，last week 要用過去式 bought。
buys 是現在式，last week 是過去要用 bought。

mc.q: They ___ the bill and left.
mc.why: 後面 left（離開了）是過去式，前面也用過去式；pay 的過去式是 paid。
wn: 後面 left 是過去式，前面也要過去式 paid。
pays 是現在式，而且 They 不加 s。

mc.q: I ___ buy the shoes because they were too big.
mc.why: 後面 they were 是過去，沒買鞋是過去的事，用 didn't 加原形 buy。
wn: don't 是現在式，後面 were 表示過去，要用 didn't。
buy 是一般動詞，否定用 didn't，不用 wasn't。

mc.q: ___ she find her wallet yesterday?
mc.why: yesterday 是過去，問昨天找到錢包了沒，用 Did 加原形 find。
wn: find 是一般動詞，問句用 Did，不用 Was。
Does 問平常習慣；yesterday 是過去，要用 Did。

mc.q: We ___ going to cook dinner at home tonight.
mc.why: 主詞 We 是複數，be 動詞用 are：We are going to cook。
wn: is 配一個人或一件事，We 要用 are。
am 只配 I，We 要用 are。

mc.q: He is going to ___ a cake for her birthday.
mc.why: be going to 後面一定接原形動詞：is going to make。
wn: going to 後面不加 s，只用原形 make。
made 是過去式；going to 講未來，要接原形。

mc.q: I ___ carry this box. It is too heavy.
mc.why: 箱子太重搬不動，能力上做不到，用 can't 加原形 carry。
wn: 後面說 too heavy 太重了，要用否定 can't。
can 不和 don't 一起用，直接說 can't。

mc.q: ___ you help me, please?
mc.why: 請別人幫忙用 Can you 加原形動詞：Can you help me?
wn: Are 後面不能接原形動詞 help，Are you help 不對。
can 不和 do 一起用，Can 直接放句首就好。

mc.q: How many bottles ___ there in the box?
mc.why: How many bottles 是複數，所以用 are there；問某處有沒有東西用 there 句型。
wn: bottles 是複數，不能用 is。
問某處有什麼用 there is／are，不用 have。

mc.q: My sister ___ a small pink purse.
mc.why: My sister 是一個人，擁有用 has。
wn: My sister 是一個人，要用 has。
is 和 have 不能一起用，直接說 has。

mc.q: There isn't ___ cheese in the fridge.
mc.why: isn't 是否定句，否定句用 any；cheese 是不可數名詞。
wn: some 用在肯定句，否定句要用 any。

mc.q: This shirt is cheap, but that one ___ expensive.
mc.why: that one 指那一件襯衫，是單數，be 動詞用 is。
wn: that one 只有一件，用 is 不用 are。
be 是原形，句子裡要變成 is。

mc.q: Last Saturday my parents ___ at the market.
mc.why: Last Saturday 是過去；my parents 是兩個人，be 過去式用 were。
wn: my parents 是複數，要用 were。
are 是現在式，Last Saturday 是過去。

mc.q: I ___ fast food. (never / eat)
mc.why: never 是頻率副詞，放在一般動詞前面：never eat；主詞 I，eat 不加 s。
wn: 頻率副詞要放在一般動詞前面，不是後面。
主詞是 I，動詞不加 s；加 s 只配 he／she／it。

mc.q: What time ___ the shop close?
mc.why: the shop 是一間店（單數），一般動詞 close 的問句用 does。
wn: do 配複數或 I／you，the shop 一間用 does。
close 是一般動詞，問句用 does，不用 is。

mc.q: We ___ going to buy a new table next month.
mc.why: next month 是未來；主詞 We 是複數，用 are going to。
wn: is 配一個人或一件事，We 要用 are。
were 是過去式，next month 是未來，用 are。

mc.q: She gave the receipt to ___ customer.
mc.why: customer 是單數可數名詞，前面需要冠詞；指那位客人用 the：to the customer。
wn: she 是代名詞，不能放在名詞 customer 前面。
her 和 the 不能連著用，名詞前只能選一個。

fill.q: This is ___ father.
fill.why: 名詞 father 前面要放所有格，my 是我的：my father。

fill.q: ___ two chairs in the room.
fill.why: two chairs 是複數，句首用 There are。

fill.q: The kitchen is ___ the living room.
fill.why: next to 是在旁邊，兩個字一起用，後面接地點。

fill.q: I would like ___ water.
fill.why: 肯定句、想要一些用 some；water 不可數，不加 s。

fill.q: Is there ___ bread?
fill.why: 問句問有沒有麵包，用 any；bread 不可數。

fill.q: She ___ busy yesterday.
fill.why: yesterday 是過去；主詞 She 用 was。

fill.q: They ___ happy last week.
fill.why: last week 是過去；主詞 They 是複數，用 were。

fill.q: He ___ finish his homework yesterday.
fill.why: yesterday 是過去，否定用 didn't，後面 finish 用原形。

fill.q: My sister ___ cook, but she can bake.
fill.why: but 後面說她會烤，前面相反：不會煮，用 can't。

fill.q: We are ___ visit our grandparents next month.
fill.why: next month 是未來的計畫，are 後面接 going to，再接原形 visit。

fill.q: The market ___ near my house.
fill.why: 主詞 The market 是一個地方，be 動詞用 is。

fill.q: These bags ___ very cheap.
fill.why: 主詞 These bags 是複數，be 動詞用 are。

fill.q: I ___ a customer at this shop.
fill.why: 主詞 I 的 be 動詞用 am。

fill.q: That is ___ money, not mine.
fill.why: not mine 表示是別人的，用所有格 your、his、her 或 their。

fill.q: My sister ___ a new umbrella.
fill.why: 主詞 My sister 是一個人，擁有用 has。

fill.q: We ___ two bags of rice at home.
fill.why: 主詞 We 是複數，擁有用 have。

fill.q: The shop ___ (close) at nine every night.
fill.why: every night 是習慣；主詞 The shop 是一間，close 加 s 變 closes。

fill.q: My parents ___ (shop) on Saturday morning.
fill.why: on Saturday morning 是習慣；主詞 My parents 是複數，shop 用原形。

fill.q: He ___ want a big size.
fill.why: 主詞 He 是一個人，否定用 doesn't，後面 want 用原形。

fill.q: I ___ buy meat on Monday.
fill.why: 主詞 I，現在簡單式否定用 don't，後面接原形 buy。

fill.q: She ___ goes to the market on Sunday.
fill.why: 頻率副詞放在一般動詞 goes 前面，例：She always goes…。

fill.q: There ___ a long line at the counter.
fill.why: a long line 是一條隊伍，用 There is。

fill.q: There ___ five customers in the shop.
fill.why: five customers 是複數，用 There are。

fill.q: The milk is ___ the fridge.
fill.why: 牛奶在冰箱裡面，用 in 或 inside the fridge。

fill.q: The eggs are ___ the top shelf.
fill.why: 放在架子上面用 on：on the top shelf。

fill.q: I would ___ two cups of coffee.
fill.why: I would like… 是禮貌點東西的說法：我想要兩杯咖啡。

fill.q: Do you have ___ small bags?
fill.why: 問句問有沒有，用 any，後面接複數 small bags。

fill.q: I need ___ bread for breakfast.
fill.why: 肯定句、需要一些，用 some；bread 不可數，不加 s。

fill.q: How ___ is this jacket?
fill.why: 問價錢用 How much：How much is this jacket?

fill.q: How ___ oranges do you want?
fill.why: oranges 是可數名詞複數，問多少個用 How many。

fill.q: The shop ___ closed last Monday.
fill.why: last Monday 是過去；主詞 The shop 是一間，用 was。

fill.q: We ___ at the night market last night.
fill.why: last night 是過去；主詞 We 是複數，用 were。

fill.q: She ___ (pay) fifty dollars for the book.
fill.why: for the book 是已經付過錢，pay 的過去式不規則，變 paid。

fill.q: They ___ (cook) dinner together last night.
fill.why: last night 是過去，cook 加 ed 變 cooked。

fill.q: I ___ take my wallet this morning.
fill.why: this morning 已經過去，否定用 didn't，後面 take 用原形。

fill.q: ___ you buy the shoes yesterday?
fill.why: yesterday 是過去，問句用 Did 放句首，後面 buy 用原形。

fill.q: He is ___ to buy a new phone next week.
fill.why: next week 是未來的計畫，is 後面接 going to。

fill.q: We are going ___ visit my aunt on Sunday.
fill.why: be going to 是固定組合，going 後面要接 to，再接原形 visit。

fill.q: I ___ speak English a little.
fill.why: can 表示會，後面接原形 speak。

fill.q: She ___ come today. She is sick.
fill.why: 後面說她生病了，所以不能來，用 can't，後面接原形 come。

fill.q: My father ___ (be) a shop owner ten years ago.
fill.why: ten years ago 是過去；主詞 My father 是一個人，用 was。

fill.q: There ___ any milk in the bottle.
fill.why: 後面有 any，是否定句；milk 不可數，用 There isn't。

fill.q: ___ your mother like this colour?
fill.why: 主詞 your mother 是一個人，一般動詞 like 的問句用 Does 放句首。

fill.q: The children ___ (be) in the toy shop now.
fill.why: now 是現在；The children 是複數，用 are。

fill.q: I bought a ___ of water at the station.
fill.why: 水不可數，要用容器來數：a bottle of water（一瓶水）。

fill.q: Please keep your ___ after you pay.
fill.why: 付錢之後拿到的是收據 receipt；your 後面接名詞。

fill.q: How much ___ these two books?
fill.why: these two books 是複數，How much 後面的 be 動詞用 are。

fill.q: Last week we ___ (go) shopping in Taipei.
fill.why: Last week 是過去，go 的過去式不規則，變 went。

fill.q: They are going to ___ (open) a new shop here.
fill.why: are going to 後面接原形動詞，open 不加 s、不加 ing。

fill.q: My brother ___ (not like) shopping.
fill.why: 主詞 My brother 是一個人，否定用 doesn't，後面 like 用原形。

這是用 This is；她的要用所有格 her，不是 she：her receipt。
開門是固定時間，用現在簡單式；The shop 一間，open 加 s；九點用 at nine。

a: There is a coffee machine next to the counter.

a: There are many customers in the shop.
There are a lot of customers in the shop.
There are lots of customers in the shop.
There are many customers in the store.
There are a lot of customers in the store.

a: I would like a bottle of water.
I'd like a bottle of water.
translate.why: 禮貌說想要用 I would like（I'd like）；水不可數，一瓶要說 a bottle of water。
否定句的一點都不要用 any：don't want any sugar；糖不可數，不加 s。

a: How many apples do you want?
translate.why: apples 可以數，問幾顆用 How many＋複數；後面接問句語序 do you want。
鞋子一雙是複數 shoes，所以用 are 和 these：How much are these shoes?
昨天是過去；The shop 一間，be 動詞過去式用 was；忙 busy。

a: We were at the night market last night.
translate.why: 昨晚是過去，We 的 be 動詞過去式用 were；在夜市 at the night market，要加 the。

過去否定用 didn't 加原形 pay；昨天 yesterday 放句尾。
過去疑問句用 Did you 加原形 go；去購物的固定說法是 go shopping。

提不動就是沒辦法搬，用 can't 加原形 carry；這個箱子 this box。

reading.title: 短文 1
reading.text: Last weekend, my family went shopping together. We went to a big supermarket near our house. My mother bought some bread, milk, and eggs. My father wanted to buy a new bag, but it was too expensive, so he didn't buy it. My little sister saw a cheap toy and asked, 'Can I have this, please?' We said yes. After shopping, we went to a small restaurant next to the supermarket and had lunch together. It was a fun day for our family.

qs.q: Where did the family go?
qs.why: 原文：We went to a big supermarket near our house. 他們去了家附近的大超市。
wn: 文中沒提到學校，他們是去超市 supermarket 購物。
文中沒提到醫院 hospital，他們去的是 supermarket。

qs.q: What did the mother buy?
qs.why: 原文：My mother bought some bread, milk, and eggs. 媽媽買了麵包、牛奶和蛋。
wn: 想買新包包的是爸爸 My father，而且他最後沒買。
看到玩具的是妹妹 My little sister，不是媽媽。

qs.q: Did the father buy a new bag?
qs.why: 原文：it was too expensive, so he didn't buy it. 包包太貴，所以爸爸沒買。
wn: 文中說 he didn't buy it，他沒有買。
文中有寫清楚 he didn't buy it，所以知道答案是沒買。

qs.q: What did the little sister want?
qs.why: 原文：My little sister saw a cheap toy and asked, Can I have this? 妹妹想要便宜的玩具。
wn: 麵包是媽媽買的 My mother bought some bread，不是妹妹想要的。
想要新包包的是爸爸 My father wanted to buy a new bag。

qs.q: Where did they have lunch?
opts: A restaurant next to the supermarket
qs.why: 原文：we went to a small restaurant next to the supermarket. 在超市旁的餐廳吃午餐。
wn: 文中說他們去 a small restaurant 吃，不是在家吃。
文中沒提到公園，午餐是在超市旁邊的餐廳。

reading.title: 短文 2
reading.text: My name is Ling. I work in a small fruit shop in Chiayi. The shop is next to a post office. It opens at eight in the morning and closes at eight at night. We have apples, bananas and oranges. Bananas are cheap this week. Many customers come after work. Yesterday a customer bought five kilos of apples. He paid with a credit card. I gave him a receipt. Next month my boss is going to open a second shop. I can drive, so I am going to help him.

qs.q: Where is the shop?
qs.why: 原文：The shop is next to a post office. next to 是在旁邊，店在郵局旁。
wn: 文中說 next to a post office，是郵局，不是學校。
文中說旁邊是 post office 郵局，不是銀行 bank。

qs.q: What time does the shop close?
qs.why: 原文：It… closes at eight at night. close 是關門，晚上八點關。
wn: 早上八點是開門 opens，題目問的是關門 close。
文中沒有五點，關門是 at eight at night。

qs.q: What is cheap this week?
qs.why: 原文：Bananas are cheap this week. 這週便宜的是香蕉。
wn: 文中只說有賣蘋果，便宜的是 Bananas。
文中只說有賣柳橙，這週便宜的是 Bananas。

qs.q: How did the customer pay yesterday?
qs.why: 原文：He paid with a credit card. 昨天那位客人用信用卡付錢。
wn: 文中說 paid with a credit card，不是現金 cash。
文中沒提到用手機付款，是 a credit card。

qs.q: Why is Ling going to help her boss?
qs.why: 原文：I can drive, so I am going to help him. so 前面是原因：Ling 會開車。
wn: 文中沒說她會煮飯 cook，原因是 I can drive。
她在水果店工作，文中沒說她有車行。

reading.title: 短文 3
reading.text: The Wang family lives in a flat in Taipei. There are four people in the family. Mrs. Wang usually does the shopping on Saturday morning. She always makes a list. Last Saturday she bought rice, eggs, milk and some vegetables. She didn't buy meat because it was expensive. Her son wanted chocolate, but she said no. They came home at eleven. Next weekend the family is going to have a big dinner. Mr. Wang can cook fish very well, so he is going to cook.

qs.q: When does Mrs. Wang usually do the shopping?
qs.why: 原文：Mrs. Wang usually does the shopping on Saturday morning. 她通常週六早上買東西。
wn: 文中說 Saturday morning 週六早上，不是週日晚上。
文中說 Saturday morning，不是週五晚上。

qs.q: What did she NOT buy last Saturday?
qs.why: 原文：She didn't buy meat because it was expensive. NOT 是問沒買的東西，答案是肉。
wn: 文中說 she bought rice, eggs, milk，蛋有買。
米有買 she bought rice，題目問的是沒買的 NOT。

qs.q: Why didn't she buy it?
qs.why: 原文：She didn't buy meat because it was expensive. because 後面是原因：肉太貴。
wn: 文中沒說店沒開，原因是 it was expensive。
她都會寫清單 makes a list，沒說忘記；原因是太貴。

qs.q: What did her son want?
qs.why: 原文：Her son wanted chocolate, but she said no. 兒子想要巧克力。
wn: 牛奶是媽媽買的東西之一，兒子想要的是 chocolate。
蔬菜是媽媽買的，兒子想要的是 chocolate。

qs.q: Who is going to cook next weekend?
qs.why: 原文：Mr. Wang can cook fish very well, so he is going to cook. 王先生會煮魚，所以他來煮。
wn: 王太太負責買東西，文中說 he is going to cook，是王先生。
兒子只提到想要巧克力，下廚的是 Mr. Wang。

reading.title: 短文 4
reading.text: Jenny is a student. She doesn't have much money, so she likes cheap shops. There is a small clothes shop near her school. The shirts there are two hundred dollars. Last week she went there with her friend Mia. Jenny bought a blue shirt and a black bag. Mia didn't buy anything. She only looked. The shop was very busy and they waited ten minutes at the counter. Tomorrow Jenny is going to wear her new shirt to a party. She can't dance well, but she likes music.

qs.q: What kind of shops does Jenny like?
qs.why: 原文：She doesn't have much money, so she likes cheap shops. 她錢不多，喜歡便宜的店。
wn: 文中說 cheap shops，她去的反而是 a small clothes shop。
文中沒提到老店 old，是 cheap 便宜的店。

qs.q: What did Jenny buy?
qs.why: 原文：Jenny bought a blue shirt and a black bag. 她買了一件襯衫和一個包包。
wn: 文中是 a blue shirt 一件襯衫，加上一個包包，不是兩件襯衫。
她除了 a black bag，也買了 a blue shirt，不是只有包包。

qs.q: What did Mia do in the shop?
qs.why: 原文：Mia didn't buy anything. She only looked. Mia 什麼都沒買，只是看看。
wn: 文中說 Mia didn't buy anything，買襯衫的是 Jenny。
文中沒說 Mia 幫忙付錢，她什麼都沒買。

qs.q: How long did they wait at the counter?
qs.why: 原文：they waited ten minutes at the counter. 在櫃台等了十分鐘。
wn: 文中是 ten minutes 十分鐘，不是兩分鐘。
文中是 ten 十，不是 twenty 二十。

qs.q: What is Jenny going to do tomorrow?
opts: Wear her new shirt to a party
qs.why: 原文：Tomorrow Jenny is going to wear her new shirt to a party. 明天穿新襯衫去派對。
wn: 文中只說店在學校附近，沒說明天要早到學校。
文中沒提到賣舊包包，她是新買了一個包包。

writing.prompt: 請寫一段 3-5 句的英文，描述你上次去購物或去朋友家的經驗，試著用到 was/were、some/any、next to 其中至少兩種。
writing.sample: Last weekend, I went shopping with my friend. There was a nice shop next to the station. I bought some clothes, but they were a little expensive. We had lunch together after shopping.

writing.prompt: 用 3-5 句英文寫你上次去購物的經驗：去哪裡、買了什麼、花了多少錢。
writing.sample: Last Saturday I went to a small shop near my house. I bought some rice, milk and two apples. It was about three hundred dollars. The shop was very busy. I came home at eleven.

writing.prompt: 用 3-5 句英文介紹你家附近的一家店：位置、營業時間、賣什麼。
writing.sample: There is a fruit shop near my flat. It is next to the post office. It opens at eight and closes at eight. They have apples, bananas and oranges. The bananas are very cheap.

writing.prompt: 用 3-5 句英文寫你家人這個週末的計畫，並用一次 can 或 can't。
writing.sample: This weekend my family is going to have a big dinner. My mother is going to buy fish and vegetables. My father can cook very well. I can't cook, so I am going to wash the dishes.

vocab_new.ex: I usually have breakfast at seven.
Sometimes I go to the gym.
I like to travel on weekends.
What is your plan for tomorrow?
I want to invite you to my party.
Would you like to come to my party?
I like to relax on Sundays.
I read a book every night.
We clean the house on weekends.
We are going to have a picnic in the park.
I read books in my free time.
We had a short trip to the sea.

vocab_review.why: tomorrow＝明天。例句：I am going to study English tomorrow.
下週＝next week。例句：We are going to visit Taipei next week.
weekend＝週末。例句：Are you free this weekend?
將要＝going to。例句：I am going to buy a new phone.
travel＝旅行。例句：She is going to travel to Korea next month.
開始＝start。例句：Did the movie start at seven?
meet＝見面。例句：Nice to meet you again.
到達＝arrive。例句：Did she arrive on time?
cook＝煮飯。例句：My father is a cook.
說(語言)＝speak。例句：I can speak English a little.
play＝演奏；玩。例句：We played basketball yesterday.
唱歌＝sing。例句：She can sing very well.
wn: any 是「一些（用於否定句/疑問句）」
sounds great 是「聽起來很棒」

vocab_review.why: run＝跑步。例句：He can run very fast.
滑雪＝ski。例句：I can't ski.
fix＝修理。例句：He can fix a computer.
電腦＝computer。例句：I have a computer.
cooking＝烹飪。例句：She likes cooking on weekends.
繪畫＝painting。例句：My sister enjoys painting pictures.
photography＝攝影。例句：I am interested in photography.
購物＝shopping。例句：She went shopping last weekend.
wn: sounds great 是「聽起來很棒」

vocab_review.why: gardening＝園藝。例句：My mother enjoys gardening every morning.
收集＝collecting。例句：I like collecting stamps.
writing＝寫作。例句：She likes writing short stories.
空閒時間＝free time。例句：In my free time, I like reading.
rainy＝下雨的。例句：It is going to be rainy this weekend.
冷的＝cold。例句：It was cold yesterday.
warm＝溫暖的。例句：The weather is warm in spring.
天氣預報＝forecast。例句：The weather forecast says it will rain.
wn: go to work 是「去上班」

vocab_review.why: beach＝海灘。例句：They went to the beach last weekend.
野餐＝picnic。例句：We had a picnic at the park.
wn: sister 是「姊妹（姊姊或妹妹）」

vocab_review.why: pool＝游泳池。例句：I can swim in the pool.
派對＝party。例句：Would you like to come to my party?
wn: go to work 是「去上班」

vocab_review.why: dinner＝晚餐。例句：Let's have dinner together tonight.
忙碌的＝busy。例句：My job is busy.
later＝稍後。例句：Let's meet later.
出去玩＝hang out。例句：Would you like to hang out this weekend?
wn: go to work 是「去上班」

vocab_review.why: museum＝博物館。例句：There is a museum in the city.
聽起來很棒＝sounds great。例句：That sounds great!
wn: brother 是「兄弟（哥哥或弟弟）」

vocab_review.why: appointment＝約會；預約。例句：I have an appointment next week.
機場＝airport。例句：We are going to go to the airport.
passport＝護照。例句：Don't forget your passport.
地圖＝map。例句：There is a map on the wall.
souvenir＝紀念品。例句：I am going to buy a souvenir for you.
火車＝train。例句：We are going to take the train.
depart＝出發。例句：The bus is going to depart at nine.
學生＝student。例句：He is a student.
brother＝兄弟。例句：I have one brother.
去上班＝go to work。例句：He goes to work at 8 o'clock.
bread＝麵包。例句：I would like some bread.
昨天＝yesterday。例句：I was at home yesterday.
happy＝快樂的。例句：I am happy today.
鄰居＝neighbour。例句：My neighbour is a nice old man.
borrow＝借（入）。例句：Can I borrow your pen?
爸爸＝father。例句：This is my father.
how much＝多少錢。例句：How much is this shirt?
任何＝any。例句：Do you have any tea?
didn't＝沒有（過去否定）。例句：I didn't go to school yesterday.
餐廳＝restaurant。例句：There is a restaurant next to the cinema.
cheap＝便宜的。例句：This bag is very cheap.
收據＝receipt。例句：Can I have a receipt, please?
wn: brother 是「兄弟（哥哥或弟弟）」

mc.q: I ___ have breakfast at seven.
mc.why: 空格在 I 和動詞 have 中間，要說多常做，用頻率副詞 usually（通常）。
wn: usual 是形容詞，要放在名詞前面，不能修飾動詞。
uses 是動詞（使用），句子已經有動詞 have。

mc.q: She ___ wakes up early.
mc.why: 頻率副詞 always 放在一般動詞 wakes 前面：She always wakes up early。
wn: wakes 是一般動詞，前面不能再加 is。
句子已經有動詞 wakes，不能再加 be。

mc.q: He ___ eats fast food.
mc.why: never（從不）是頻率副詞，放在一般動詞 eats 前面。
wn: no 不能直接放在動詞前面表示否定。
not 不能直接放在 eats 前面，要說 doesn't eat。

mc.q: What ___ you do on weekends?
mc.why: 主詞 you 配助動詞 do；句尾的 do 是動詞做：What do you do?
wn: does 配 he／she／it，you 用 do。
do（做）是一般動詞，問句用 do，不用 is。

mc.q: It ___ sunny today.
mc.why: 說天氣時主詞用 It，It 是單數配 is；today 是現在。
wn: are 配複數或 you，It 用 is。

mc.q: ___ you like to come to my party?
mc.why: 邀請別人來派對用 Would you like to…?，是禮貌的固定說法。
wn: Do you like to come 是問平常喜不喜歡，不是邀請。
Are you like 不成立，are 後面不能直接接動詞 like。

mc.q: I am going to ___ tomorrow.
mc.why: am going to 後面接原形動詞 relax。
wn: going to 後面要原形；而且 relax 加 s 要寫 relaxes。
relaxed 是過去式，tomorrow 是未來。

mc.q: My brother ___ cook very well.
mc.why: can 不管主詞是誰都不變，後面接原形 cook。
wn: can 不加 s，主詞是一個人也一樣。
這裡的 can 是會，不加 ing。

mc.q: We ___ the house every weekend.
mc.why: every weekend 是習慣；主詞 We 是複數，動詞用原形 clean。
wn: 只有一個人或一件事才加 s，We 用 clean。
cleaning 前面沒有 are，不能單獨當動詞。

mc.q: Are you ___ this weekend?
mc.why: be 動詞 Are 後面接形容詞 free（有空的）。
wn: free 當形容詞不加 s。
freely 是副詞（自由地），不放在 be 後面說有空。

mc.q: The weather ___ nice today.
mc.why: The weather（天氣）是一件事，等於 it，be 動詞用 is。
wn: are 配 you／we／they 或複數；weather 是單一件事。
be 是原形，句子裡要變成 am／is／are，不能直接用 be。

mc.q: My hobbies ___ reading and running.
mc.why: hobbies 是複數（興趣不只一個），be 動詞用 are。

mc.q: ___ you free this Sunday?
mc.why: free 是形容詞（有空），要用 be 動詞；you 配 are，問句 Are 放句首。
wn: free 不是動詞，要用 be 動詞 Are，不用 Do。
Have you free 不成立，問有沒有空說 Are you free。

mc.q: I like ___ new camera very much.
mc.why: 名詞 camera 前面要用所有格表示我的：my new camera。
wn: I 是主詞，放在句首當我，不能放在名詞前面。
me 是受詞，放在動詞後面（like me），不能修飾名詞。

mc.q: Sara and Mia ride ___ bikes to school.
mc.why: Sara and Mia 是兩個人，她們的用所有格 their。
wn: her 是一個女生的，這裡是兩個人，要用 their。
them 是受詞，不能放在名詞 bikes 前面。

mc.q: He ___ a guitar and a small drum.
mc.why: He 是一個人（第三人稱單數），擁有用 has。
wn: He 是一個人，have 要變 has。
句子需要真正的動詞，having 不能單獨當動詞。

mc.q: We ___ a lot of free time on Sunday.
mc.why: 主詞 We 是複數，表示擁有用 have。
wn: has 配一個人或一件事，We 要用 have。
表示擁有要用 have，而且 We 也不配 is。

mc.q: My father ___ the newspaper every morning.
mc.why: every morning 是習慣；My father 是一個人，read 加 s 變 reads。
wn: My father 是一個人，動詞要加 s。
reading 前面沒有 is，不能單獨當動詞。

mc.q: They ___ (not) play tennis in winter.
mc.why: play 是一般動詞，否定要用 do／does 加 not；主詞 They 是複數，用 don't。
wn: doesn't 配 he／she／it 一個人，They 要用 don't。
play 是一般動詞，否定不用 be 動詞，要用 don't。

mc.q: She ___ swims in the sea in summer.
mc.why: sometimes（有時候）是頻率副詞，一個字，放在 swims 前面。
wn: 分開寫的 some times 是好幾次，頻率副詞是一個字 sometimes。
sometime 是某個時候（例如未來某天），不是有時候。

mc.q: ___ he like cold weather?
mc.why: he 是一個人，一般動詞 like 的問句用 Does，後面 like 用原形。
wn: Do 配 I／you／we／they，he 用 Does。
like 是一般動詞，問句用 Does，不用 Is。

mc.q: There ___ a small lake near my town.
mc.why: a small lake 是一個，There is 加單數名詞，表示某處有某物。
wn: are 用在後面是複數時，a lake 只有一個用 is。
說某地方有東西用 There is，不說 There have。

mc.q: There ___ many birds in the tree.
mc.why: many birds 是很多隻鳥（複數），There 後面用 are。
wn: is 配一個或不可數的東西，many birds 是複數。
was 配單數，many birds 是複數。

mc.q: My bike is ___ the house.
mc.why: behind 是在…後面，說腳踏車放在房子後面。
wn: of 是…的，不能單獨表示位置。
from 是從…來，不表示東西放在哪裡。

mc.q: The museum is ___ the river.
mc.why: near 是介系詞，意思是在…附近：near the river。
wn: 沒有 in of 這種說法；在…前面是 in front of。
on 和 near 都是介系詞，不能兩個連在一起。

mc.q: I would like ___ tea after dinner.
mc.why: tea 是不可數名詞，想要一些用 some：I would like some tea。
wn: an 用在母音開頭的字前面；tea 不可數，也不能加 an。
many 配可數複數名詞，tea 不可數不用 many。

mc.q: We didn't take ___ photos on the trip.
mc.why: didn't 是否定句，否定句裡用 any 表示一點都沒有：didn't take any photos。
wn: some 通常用在肯定句，否定句要改成 any。
much 配不可數名詞，photos 可以數，不用 much。

mc.q: ___ hours do you sleep every night?
mc.why: hours 是可數複數（幾個小時），問數量用 How many。
wn: hours 可數，用 How many，不用 How much。

mc.q: ___ time do you have?
mc.why: time 當時間講是不可數的，問有多少用 How much。
wn: time 當時間講不可數，不用 How many。
How often 問多常做某事，後面不接名詞 time。

mc.q: It ___ rainy all day yesterday.
mc.why: yesterday 是過去；主詞 It 是單數，be 動詞過去式用 was。
wn: is 是現在式，有 yesterday 要用過去式。
were 配複數或 you，It 要用 was。

mc.q: My friends ___ at the park last Saturday.
mc.why: last Saturday 是過去；My friends 是複數，be 過去式用 were。
wn: My friends 是複數，要用 were。
are 是現在式，last Saturday 是過去。

mc.q: We ___ football in the rain last week.
mc.why: last week 是過去；play 加 ed 變 played。
wn: play 是原形，last week 要用過去式 played。
plays 是現在式，而且 We 不加 s。

mc.q: She ___ a beautiful song last night.
mc.why: last night 是過去；sing 是不規則動詞，過去式是 sang。
wn: sing 是原形，last night 要用過去式 sang。
sings 是現在式，last night 要用 sang。

mc.q: I ___ go running yesterday because I was tired.
mc.why: yesterday 是過去，一般動詞的否定用 didn't 加原形 go。
wn: don't 是現在式，yesterday 是過去要用 didn't。
go 是一般動詞，否定用 didn't，不用 wasn't。

mc.q: ___ they enjoy the trip last week?
mc.why: last week 是過去，問旅行開不開心用過去式問句：Did 加原形 enjoy。
wn: enjoy 是一般動詞，問句用 Did；而且 they 也不配 was。
Do 問現在的習慣；last week 是過去，要用 Did。

mc.q: I ___ going to stay at home this weekend.
mc.why: 主詞是 I，be 動詞用 am：I am going to stay。
wn: is 配 he／she／it，I 要用 am。
are 配 you／we／they，I 要用 am。

mc.q: They are going to ___ a bike trip on Sunday.
mc.why: are going to 後面接原形動詞；take a trip 是去旅行。
wn: took 是過去式，going to 要接原形。
going to 後面要原形，不加 s。

mc.q: My mother ___ paint very well.
mc.why: can 不管主詞是誰都不變，後面接原形 paint。
wn: can 不加 s，主詞是一個人也一樣。
can 後面直接接原形，不加 to。

mc.q: I ___ play the piano. I never learned.
mc.why: 沒學過所以不會彈，用 can't 加原形動詞 play。
wn: can 不和 do／don't 一起用，直接說 can't。
not 不放在 can 前面，要說 can't 或 cannot。

mc.q: What ___ you going to do on your holiday?
mc.why: be going to 問句把 be 動詞移到前面；you 配 are：What are you going to do?
wn: going to 前面要用 be 動詞，不能用 do。
is 配 he／she／it，主詞是 you。

mc.q: It ___ very cold last winter.
mc.why: last winter 是過去；主詞 It 是單數，be 過去式用 was。
wn: is 是現在式，last winter 是過去要用 was。
were 配複數或 you，It 用 was。

mc.q: My brother ___ TV in the evening.
mc.why: 說平常習慣用現在簡單式；My brother 是一個人，watch 加 es。
wn: My brother 是一個人，要加 es 變 watches。
watching 前面沒有 is，不能單獨當動詞。

mc.q: There ___ any snow in my city.
mc.why: snow 是不可數名詞，當單數看，所以用 There isn't any。
wn: aren't 配複數名詞，snow 不可數，要用 isn't。
There 句型要用 be 動詞，不用 doesn't。

mc.q: How often ___ you go swimming?
mc.why: 主詞 you 配助動詞 do；go 是一般動詞，問句要用 do：How often do you go…?
wn: does 配 he／she／it，主詞 you 要用 do。
go 是一般動詞，問句要用 do，不用 are。

mc.q: Last summer we ___ to the beach every week.
mc.why: Last summer 是過去的時間，go 的過去式是不規則的 went。
wn: go 是現在式，Last summer 已經過去了。
goes 是現在式，而且主詞 we 也不加 s。

mc.q: She is going to ___ a new hobby next month.
mc.why: is going to 後面接原形 start，主詞 She 也不加 s。
wn: going to 後面要原形，不加 s。
started 是過去式，next month 是未來，要用原形。

mc.q: The children ___ happy at the picnic yesterday.
mc.why: yesterday 是過去；children 是很多小孩（複數），be 過去式用 were。
wn: are 是現在式，yesterday 是過去要用 were。
children 是 child 的複數，要用 were。

mc.q: I ___ never late for work.
mc.why: late 是形容詞，前面要 be 動詞；主詞 I 用 am，never 放在 am 後面。
wn: late 是形容詞不是動詞，要用 be 動詞 am。
have 是擁有，I have late 說不通。

mc.q: My dog sleeps ___ my bed.
mc.why: under 是在…下面，狗睡在床底下。
wn: to 是往某處去，不表示睡在哪裡。

mc.q: We ___ (not) have any plans for tonight.
mc.why: have 是一般動詞，否定用 don't／doesn't；主詞 We 是複數，用 don't。
wn: doesn't 配 he／she／it，We 是複數。
aren't 是 be 動詞的否定，have 是一般動詞，要用 don't。

fill.q: I ___ have breakfast at seven.
fill.why: 頻率副詞放在一般動詞 have 前面；usually 是通常。

fill.q: She ___ wakes up early.
fill.why: 頻率副詞放在一般動詞 wakes 前面；always 是總是。

fill.q: He ___ eats fast food.
fill.why: 頻率副詞放在一般動詞 eats 前面；never 是從不。

fill.q: What ___ you do on weekends?
fill.why: on weekends 是習慣；主詞 you，一般動詞問句用 do：What do you do?

fill.q: It ___ sunny today.
fill.why: today 是現在；天氣用 It 當主詞，be 動詞用 is。

fill.q: ___ you like to come to my party?
fill.why: 客氣地邀請別人，用 Would you like to…？所以句首填 Would。

fill.q: I am going to ___ tomorrow.
fill.zh: 我明天要好好放鬆一下。
fill.why: am going to 後面接原形動詞；relax 是放鬆、休息。

fill.q: My brother ___ cook very well.
fill.why: can 表示會，後面接原形 cook，不加 s。

fill.q: We ___ the house every weekend.
fill.why: every weekend 是習慣；主詞 We 用原形 clean，不加 s。

fill.q: I am ___ after work.
fill.why: 下班後的感覺，用形容詞 tired（累的）放在 am 後面。

fill.q: The weather ___ hot in summer.
fill.why: in summer 是一般事實；主詞 The weather 是一件事，用 is。

fill.q: My hobbies ___ music and running.
fill.why: 主詞 My hobbies 是複數（有兩個嗜好），be 動詞用 are。

fill.q: I ___ free every Sunday afternoon.
fill.why: every Sunday 是習慣；主詞 I 的 be 動詞用 am。

fill.q: This is ___ camera. It belongs to Peter.
fill.why: 後面說屬於 Peter，Peter 是男生，所有格用 his。

fill.q: The girls clean ___ room every week.
fill.why: The girls 是複數，所有格用 their（她們的）。

fill.q: My sister ___ a beautiful garden.
fill.why: 主詞 My sister 是一個人（第三人稱單數），擁有用 has。

fill.q: We ___ two bikes at home.
fill.why: 主詞 We 是複數，擁有用 have。

fill.q: He ___ (run) in the park every morning.
fill.why: every morning 是習慣；主詞 He 是一個人，run 加 s 變 runs。

fill.q: They ___ (get) up late on Sunday.
fill.why: on Sunday 是習慣；主詞 They 是複數，get 用原形不加 s。

fill.q: She ___ like rainy days.
fill.why: 主詞 She 是一個人，否定用 doesn't，後面 like 用原形。

fill.q: We ___ swim in winter.
fill.why: 主詞 We 是複數，現在簡單式否定用 don't，後面接原形 swim。

fill.q: He ___ plays basketball after school.
fill.why: 頻率副詞放在一般動詞 plays 前面，例：He often plays…。

fill.q: There ___ a small park behind my school.
fill.why: a small park 是一個，用 There is。

fill.q: There ___ three cafes on this street.
fill.why: three cafes 是複數，用 There are。

fill.q: The cat is sleeping ___ the sofa.
fill.why: 貓睡在沙發上用 on，睡在沙發下面用 under。

fill.q: My house is ___ the river.
fill.why: 房子在河的附近或旁邊，用 near、beside 或 next to。

fill.q: I would ___ some fruit after lunch.
fill.why: would like 是想要；I would like some fruit 我想吃點水果。

fill.q: We didn't take ___ photos on the trip.
fill.why: 否定句 didn't take 後面用 any：any photos。

fill.q: I bought ___ new shoes for running.
fill.why: 肯定句、買了一些，用 some，後面接複數 shoes。

fill.q: How ___ hours do you sleep?
fill.why: hours 是可數名詞複數，問幾個小時用 How many。

fill.q: How ___ free time do you have today?
fill.why: free time 不可數，問多少時間用 How much。

fill.q: It ___ very windy yesterday.
fill.why: yesterday 是過去；主詞 It 用 was。

fill.q: My friends ___ at the beach last Sunday.
fill.why: last Sunday 是過去；主詞 My friends 是複數，用 were。

fill.q: We ___ (walk) in the mountains last weekend.
fill.why: last weekend 是過去，walk 加 ed 變 walked。

fill.q: She ___ (sing) two songs at the party.
fill.why: at the party 是已經發生的事，sing 的過去式不規則，變 sang。

fill.q: I ___ go out last night. It was raining.
fill.why: 後面說在下雨，所以沒出門；last night 是過去，用 didn't。

fill.q: ___ you have a good weekend?
fill.why: 問上週末過得好嗎，是過去，Did 放句首，後面 have 用原形。

fill.q: I am ___ to read a book tonight.
fill.why: tonight 是今晚的計畫，am 後面接 going to。

fill.q: They are going ___ take a trip in July.
fill.why: be going to 是固定組合，going 後面要接 to，再接原形 take。

fill.q: My mother ___ paint very well.
fill.why: can 表示會，後面接原形 paint，不加 s。

fill.q: I ___ play the piano. I never learned.
fill.why: 後面說從沒學過，所以不會彈：can't，後面接原形 play。

fill.q: It ___ (be) cloudy this morning.
fill.why: this morning 若已過去用 was；還在早上就用 is，兩個都可以。

fill.q: My brother ___ (watch) TV every evening.
fill.why: every evening 是習慣；主詞 My brother 是一個人，watch 加 es 變 watches。

fill.q: There ___ any snow in my city.
fill.why: 後面有 any，是否定句；snow 不可數，用 There isn't。

fill.q: How often ___ she go swimming?
fill.why: 主詞 she 是一個人，問句用 does，後面 go 用原形。

fill.q: Last summer we ___ (go) to the sea every week.
fill.why: Last summer 是過去，go 的過去式不規則，變 went。

fill.q: She is going to ___ (start) a new hobby.
fill.why: is going to 後面接原形動詞 start，不加 s、不加 ing。

fill.q: The children ___ (be) happy at the picnic yesterday.
fill.why: yesterday 是過去；The children 是複數，用 were。

fill.q: My favourite ___ is drawing pictures.
fill.why: My favourite 後面接單數名詞，is 也表示一個，用 hobby（嗜好）。

fill.q: We had a short ___ to the mountains.
fill.why: a short 後面接單數名詞；去山上的短程旅行用 trip。

translate.why: 天氣當主詞用 The weather，要加 the，be 動詞用 is；很好 nice 或 good。
嗜好一個用 My hobby is；畫畫當名詞要加 ing：drawing 或 painting。
這是用 This is；他的要用所有格 his：his camera。
every morning 是習慣；主詞 My brother 一個人，run 加 s：runs。

translate.zh: 我通常星期天很晚起床。
a: I usually get up late on Sunday.
I usually get up late on Sundays.

translate.zh: 我學校後面有一個公園。
a: There is a park behind my school.
translate.why: 某處有一個東西用 There is a park；在學校後面是 behind my school，放句尾。

translate.zh: 這條街上有三家咖啡店。
a: There are three cafes on this street.
translate.why: 三家是複數，用 There are 加複數 cafes；在這條街上用 on this street。

translate.zh: 我午餐後想要一些水果。
a: I would like some fruit after lunch.
I'd like some fruit after lunch.
translate.why: 想要用 I would like；fruit 當總稱不可數，用 some fruit，不加 s；午餐後 after lunch。

a: We did not take any photos.
translate.why: 過去否定用 didn't 加原形 take；否定句的任何用 any，照片是複數 photos。

a: How many hours do you sleep every night?
translate.why: 小時可數，問幾個用 How many 加複數 hours，後面接 do you sleep；每晚 every night。
昨天是過去，天氣用 It 當主詞，be 動詞用 was；風很大用形容詞 windy。

translate.zh: 我朋友上星期天在海邊。
a: My friends were at the beach last Sunday.
My friend was at the beach last Sunday.
translate.why: 上星期天是過去；朋友們是複數，be 動詞用 were；在海邊 at the beach。

translate.zh: 我們上週末去山上健行。
a: We walked in the mountains last weekend.
We went hiking in the mountains last weekend.
We hiked in the mountains last weekend.
translate.why: 上週末是過去：健行說 went hiking 或 hiked，也可用 walked；在山上 in the mountains。

a: She sang two songs last night.
translate.why: 昨晚是過去，sing 是不規則動詞，過去式是 sang；兩首歌是複數 songs。

a: I didn't go out last night.

translate.why: 過去否定用 didn't 加原形 go out；出門是 go out，out 不能漏。

a: Did you have a good weekend?
translate.why: 問過去的事用 Did you 加原形 have；過得好是 have a good weekend，a 不能漏。

a: I am going to read a book tonight.

reading.title: 短文 1
reading.text: My name is Jack. I usually wake up at seven and go to work at eight. I never eat breakfast at the office because I like to eat at home. On weekends, I like to relax. Sometimes I read a book, and sometimes I go hiking with my friends. This weekend, the weather is going to be sunny, so we are going to have a picnic in the park. My friend Amy is going to bring some food, and I am going to bring drinks. After the picnic, we are going to clean up together. I think it will be a great weekend.

qs.q: What time does Jack usually go to work?
qs.why: 原文：I usually wake up at seven and go to work at eight. 去上班是八點。
wn: 七點是起床 wake up 的時間，上班是 at eight。
文中沒有九點，上班時間是 at eight。

qs.q: Does Jack eat breakfast at the office?
qs.why: 原文：I never eat breakfast at the office. never 是從來不，所以答 No。
wn: 文中用 never 從來不，他都在家吃早餐。
never 是一次都沒有，不是 sometimes 有時候。

qs.q: What is the weather going to be like this weekend?
qs.why: 原文：This weekend, the weather is going to be sunny. 這週末會是晴天。
wn: 文中說 sunny 晴天，不是下雨 rainy。
文中沒說冷，說的是 sunny 晴天。

qs.q: What is Amy going to bring?
qs.why: 原文：My friend Amy is going to bring some food. Amy 負責帶食物。
wn: 帶飲料的是 Jack：I am going to bring drinks。
看書是 Jack 週末有時會做的事，Amy 帶的是 food。

qs.q: What are they going to do after the picnic?
qs.why: 原文：After the picnic, we are going to clean up together. 野餐後一起收拾乾淨。
wn: 文中說 together 一起，不是一個人 alone 回家。
健行是 Jack 平常週末有時做的事，野餐後是 clean up。

reading.title: 短文 2
reading.text: I am Ryan. I am thirty years old and I work in an office in Hsinchu. My days are always the same. I get up at six thirty and I take the train to work. I don't eat a big lunch. In my free time I like running. There is a nice park near my flat, and I run there three times a week. Last Saturday the weather was cold and rainy, so I stayed at home and watched a film. Next weekend I am going to run in a small race. I can run ten kilometres.

qs.q: How does Ryan go to work?
qs.why: 原文：I take the train to work. take the train 是搭火車去上班。
wn: 文中說 take the train，不是開車。
文中說 take the train，不是騎腳踏車。

qs.q: What does Ryan like doing in his free time?
qs.why: 原文：In my free time I like running. free time 是空閒時間，他喜歡跑步。
wn: 文中沒提到煮飯，空閒時喜歡的是 running。
文中沒提到畫畫，他喜歡 running 跑步。

qs.q: How often does he run in the park?
qs.why: 原文：I run there three times a week. three times a week 是一週三次。
wn: every day 是每天，文中是一週三次。
once 是一次，文中是 three times 三次。

qs.q: What was the weather like last Saturday?
qs.why: 原文：Last Saturday the weather was cold and rainy. 上週六又冷又下雨。
wn: 文中說 cold and rainy，剛好相反，不是熱又晴。
文中說 cold and rainy，沒說溫暖或有風。

qs.q: What is Ryan going to do next weekend?
qs.why: 原文：Next weekend I am going to run in a small race. 下週末要參加小型賽跑。
wn: 看電影是上週六 Last Saturday 下雨時做的事，不是下週末。
文中沒說週末要去辦公室，下週末是 run in a race。

reading.title: 短文 3
reading.text: My name is Mei. I live in a small town with my husband and our son. Our house has a garden. There are many flowers in it. My son is seven. He loves animals and he has a small rabbit. Every Sunday we have a picnic in the park if the weather is sunny. Last Sunday it was cloudy, so we stayed inside and played games. My son didn't like that. Next Sunday we are going to go to the zoo. He can't wait.

qs.q: Who does Mei live with?
qs.why: 原文：I live in a small town with my husband and our son. 她和先生、兒子一起住。
wn: 文中沒提到她父母，是 my husband and our son。
文中沒提到姊妹，她和 husband and son 住。

qs.q: What pet does her son have?
qs.why: 原文：He loves animals and he has a small rabbit. 兒子養了一隻小兔子。
wn: 文中說 a small rabbit，是兔子不是貓。
文中說 a small rabbit，是兔子不是鳥。

qs.q: What do they do on sunny Sundays?
opts: Have a picnic in the park
qs.why: 原文：we have a picnic in the park if the weather is sunny. 晴天的週日去公園野餐。
wn: 在家玩遊戲是上週日陰天 cloudy 才做的，不是晴天。
去動物園是下週日 Next Sunday 的計畫，不是晴天週日的習慣。

qs.q: What was the weather like last Sunday?
qs.why: 原文：Last Sunday it was cloudy, so we stayed inside. 上週日是陰天。
wn: 如果是晴天他們會去野餐，上週日是 cloudy 陰天。
文中說 cloudy 陰天，沒說下雨 rainy。

qs.q: Where are they going next Sunday?
qs.why: 原文：Next Sunday we are going to go to the zoo. 下週日要去動物園。
wn: 公園是晴天週日野餐的地方，下週日是去 the zoo。
文中沒提到海邊 beach，是去 the zoo。

reading.title: 短文 4
reading.text: Hi, I am Jason. I am a student and I have a part-time job at a cafe. I work there on Friday and Saturday. My boss is friendly. The cafe is small; there are only eight tables. I usually make coffee and clean the tables. I don't work in the morning. Last Friday it was very busy and I was tired after work. My friend came and we ate cake together. Next month I am going to take a short trip to Kenting with two friends. We can all swim, so we are going to swim every day.

qs.q: When does Jason work at the cafe?
qs.why: 原文：I work there on Friday and Saturday. 他週五和週六在咖啡店打工。
wn: 文中說 Friday and Saturday，不是週一和週二。
他是 part-time 兼職，只有週五、週六上班，不是每天。

qs.q: How many tables are in the cafe?
qs.why: 原文：there are only eight tables. 店很小，只有八張桌子。
wn: 文中是 eight 八，不是 five 五。
文中是 eight 八，不是 ten 十。

qs.q: What does Jason usually do at work?
qs.why: 原文：I usually make coffee and clean the tables. 他通常煮咖啡和擦桌子。
wn: 文中沒提到煮飯，他做的是 make coffee。
他擦的是桌子 clean the tables，不是洗窗戶。

qs.q: How did Jason feel after work last Friday?
qs.why: 原文：it was very busy and I was tired after work. 下班後很累。
wn: 文中沒說他生氣，說的是 tired 累。
他和朋友吃了蛋糕，但文中說的感覺是 tired，不是餓。

qs.q: What are Jason and his friends going to do in Kenting?
qs.why: 原文：We can all swim, so we are going to swim every day. 他們在墾丁每天都要游泳。
wn: 文中沒提到讀英文，去墾丁是要 swim every day。
在咖啡店工作是他平常的打工，不是去墾丁要做的事。
