邀請＝invite。例句：I want to invite you to my party.
dinner＝晚餐。例句：Let's have dinner together tonight.
抱歉＝sorry。例句：Sorry, I am late.
maybe＝也許。例句：Maybe next time.
出去玩＝hang out。例句：Would you like to hang out this weekend?
museum＝博物館。例句：There is a museum in the city.
聽起來很棒＝sounds great。例句：That sounds great!
appointment＝約會；預約。例句：I have an appointment next week.
機場＝airport。例句：We are going to go to the airport.
passport＝護照。例句：Don't forget your passport.
旅遊行程＝tour。例句：We are going to join a city tour.
flight＝班機。例句：Our flight is going to leave at noon.
公車＝bus。例句：Can you take the bus alone?
return＝回來。例句：When are you going to return?
老師＝teacher。例句：She is a teacher.
wake up＝起床。例句：I wake up at 7 o'clock.
廚房＝kitchen。例句：There is a fridge in the kitchen.
water＝水。例句：I would like some water, please.
能夠＝can。例句：I can speak a little English.
meeting＝會議。例句：We have a meeting every Monday.
借（入）＝borrow。例句：Can I borrow your pen?
wn: any 是「一些（用於否定句/疑問句）」

vocab_review.why: father＝爸爸。例句：This is my father.
在旁邊＝next to。例句：There is a lamp next to the bed.
wn: were 是「是（第二人稱/複數過去）」

vocab_review.why: any＝任何。例句：Do you have any tea?
沒有（過去否定）＝didn't。例句：I didn't go to school yesterday.
restaurant＝餐廳。例句：There is a restaurant next to the cinema.
昂貴的＝expensive。例句：That watch is too expensive.
receipt＝收據。例句：Can I have a receipt, please?
通常＝usually。例句：She usually has breakfast at home.
wn: go to work 是「去上班」

vocab_review.why: never＝從不。例句：I never drink coffee at night.
運動＝exercise。例句：He exercises three times a week.
wn: was 是「是（第一/三人稱過去）」

mc.q: ___ is the bank?
mc.why: 問銀行在哪裡，問地點用 Where。
wn: What 問是什麼東西，不是問位置。

mc.q: ___ is your birthday?
mc.why: 問生日是哪一天，問時間用 When。
wn: Where 問地點，生日是時間。
Why 問原因，不是問日期。

mc.q: ___ are you happy?
mc.why: 問開心的原因，用 Why（為什麼）：Why are you happy?
wn: How 問狀況或方法；問為什麼開心要用 Why。
Who 問人是誰，不是問原因。

mc.q: ___ are you today?
mc.why: How are you? 是問候對方好不好、狀況怎麼樣的固定說法。
wn: What are you? 是問對方是什麼，不是問好不好。
Where are you? 是問人在哪裡，不是問候。

mc.q: ___ is that man?
mc.why: that man 是一個人，問那個人是誰用 Who。
wn: What 問東西或事情；問人是誰用 Who。
When 問什麼時候，不是問人。

mc.q: Turn ___ at the corner.
mc.why: turn left 是左轉的固定說法，left 不加任何字尾。
wn: 方向的 left 不加 s。
left 不加 ing，說 turn left 就好。

mc.q: Can you ___ more slowly?
mc.why: Can 後面一定接原形動詞，不加 s，也不變過去式。
wn: can 後面的動詞不加 s。
spoke 是過去式，can 後面只能接原形。

mc.q: Can you ___ that, please?
mc.why: can 後面接原形動詞：Can you repeat that?（可以再說一次嗎）
wn: can 後面的動詞不加 s。
can 後面不用過去式，要用原形 repeat。

mc.q: What is your ___ number?
mc.why: phone number 是電話號碼，phone 放在 number 前面當說明，用原形 phone。
wn: 放在名詞前面當說明的名詞不用複數，說 phone number。
phoning 是打電話的動作，電話號碼是 phone number。

mc.q: I will ___ you tomorrow.
mc.why: will 後面接原形動詞：will call（會打電話給對方），tomorrow 是未來。
wn: will 後面的動詞不加 s。
will 講未來，後面不用過去式。

mc.q: ___ is the bus stop?
mc.why: 問公車站在哪裡，問地點用 Where。
wn: When 問時間，不是問地點。
Who 問人，公車站不是人。

mc.q: ___ your name Kevin?
mc.why: 主詞是 your name（一件事，單數），be 動詞用 is；問句把 Is 放句首。
wn: 主詞是 your name，不是 you，單數要用 Is。

mc.q: My brother and I ___ at the bus station now.
mc.why: My brother and I 是兩個人，等於 we，be 動詞用 are。
wn: 主詞是兩個人，不是一個，要用 are。
am 只配 I 一個人，這裡是兩個人。

mc.q: Excuse me, ___ this the right way to the park?
mc.why: this（這個）是單數，be 動詞用 is；問句把 is 放到 this 前面。

mc.q: The post office ___ next to the bank.
mc.why: The post office 是一間（單數），be 動詞用 is。
wn: post office 只有一間，用 is。
be 要變成 is，不能直接用原形。

mc.q: ___ you free on Friday morning?
mc.why: free 是形容詞（有空），要用 be 動詞；主詞 you 配 are，問句 Are 放句首。
wn: is 配一個人或一件事，you 要用 are。
am 只配 I，you 要用 are。

mc.q: I ___ sorry, I don't understand.
mc.why: 主詞是 I，be 動詞用 am；sorry 是形容詞：I am sorry。
wn: is 配 he／she／it，I 用 am。
are 配 you／we／they，I 用 am。

mc.q: What is ___ phone number?
mc.why: 空格後面有名詞 phone number，要用所有格 your（你的）。
wn: you 是主詞或受詞，不能放在名詞前表示你的。
yours 後面不接名詞，例如 It is yours。

mc.q: She ___ a new address.
mc.why: 主詞 She 是一個人（第三人稱單數），have 要變 has。
wn: She 是一個人，have 要變成 has。
have 的第三人稱是 has，沒有 haves 這個字。

mc.q: This is Peter and this is ___ sister.
mc.why: 指 Peter 的姊妹，Peter 是男生，他的用 his。
wn: her 是她的，這裡是 Peter（男生）的姊妹。
he 是主詞（他），不能放在名詞前面。

mc.q: We ___ two maps in the car.
mc.why: 主詞 We 是複數，表示擁有用 have；has 只給 he／she／it。
wn: has 只配 he／she／it 一個人或一件事，We 是複數。
having 前面要有 be 動詞，單獨不能當動詞。

mc.q: Anna is my friend. ___ house is near the school.
mc.why: Anna 是女生，house 前面表示她的，用 Her。
wn: His 是他的，Anna 是女生。
She 是主詞，不能放在名詞 house 前面。

mc.q: They ___ a big office on Green Road.
mc.why: 主詞 They 是複數，表示擁有用 have。
wn: has 配一個人或一件事，They 要用 have。
表示擁有要用 have，而且 They 也不配 is。

mc.q: How ___ she go to work?
mc.why: she 是一個人，一般動詞 go 的問句用 does，後面 go 用原形。
wn: do 配 I／you／we／they，she 用 does。
go 是一般動詞，問句用 does，不用 is。

mc.q: He ___ speak Chinese.
mc.why: speak 是一般動詞，否定用 do／does 加 not；He 是一個人，用 doesn't。
wn: don't 配 I／you／we／they，He 要用 doesn't。
speak 是一般動詞，否定不用 isn't。

mc.q: I ___ go to the market on Sunday.
mc.why: 頻率副詞 often 放在一般動詞 go 前面：I often go…（我常去）。
wn: go 是一般動詞，前面不用 am，直接 I often go。
肯定句不需要 do，直接說 I often go。

mc.q: ___ they live near the station?
mc.why: they 是複數，一般動詞 live 的問句用 Do，後面接原形。
wn: Does 配 he／she／it，they 用 Do。
live 是一般動詞，問句用 Do，不用 Are。

mc.q: Sam ___ late for class.
mc.why: late 是形容詞，要配 be 動詞；頻率副詞 never 放在 is 後面：is never late。
wn: 頻率副詞放在 be 動詞後面，不放前面。
never 本身就是否定，不再加 not。

mc.q: ___ a hospital on this street.
mc.why: a hospital 是一間（單數），用 There is。
wn: a hospital 只有一間，用 There is。
be 要變成 is，不能直接用原形 be。

mc.q: ___ two banks near my house.
mc.why: two banks 是兩間（複數），說某處有東西用 There are。
wn: two banks 是複數，要用 There are。
It is 是它是；說附近有兩間銀行用 There are。

mc.q: The bookstore is ___ the coffee shop and the bank.
mc.why: 句中有 the coffee shop and the bank 兩個地方，在兩者中間用 between…and。
wn: next 要說 next to 才是旁邊，而且後面有兩個地方。
in front 要加 of；而且在兩個地方中間要用 between。

mc.q: Turn left ___ the traffic lights.
mc.why: 在某個點轉彎用 at：turn left at the traffic lights（在紅綠燈左轉）。
wn: on 是在表面上，轉彎的地點用 at。
into 是進入裡面，紅綠燈不能走進去。

mc.q: Is ___ a toilet here?
mc.why: 問某處有沒有某物用 Is there…?：Is there a toilet here?
wn: they 是他們，Is they 文法不對，也不是問有沒有。
their 是他們的，發音像 there，但意思不同。

mc.q: My office is ___ the third floor.
mc.why: 說在第幾樓固定用 on：on the third floor。
wn: into 是進入裡面的動作，不表示在某一樓。

mc.q: Do you have ___ questions?
mc.why: 問句裡問有沒有，用 any；questions 是可數複數。
wn: much 配不可數名詞，questions 可數。
questions 是複數，不能加 a。

mc.q: ___ does this map cost?
mc.why: cost 是花費多少錢，問價錢用 How much：How much does this map cost?
wn: How many 問可數的數量，問價錢要用 How much。
How long 問多久或多長，不是問價錢。

mc.q: ___ people are there in your class?
mc.why: people 可數（複數），問有多少人用 How many。
wn: How much 問不可數的量或價錢，people 可數。
How old 問年紀，不是人數。

mc.q: She ___ a cup of tea.
mc.why: would like 是想要的禮貌說法，would 後面的 like 用原形，主詞 She 也不加 s。
wn: would 後面接原形 like，不加 s。

mc.q: They ___ to Tainan last weekend.
mc.why: last weekend 是過去；go 是不規則動詞，過去式是 went。
wn: go 是原形，last weekend 要用過去式 went。
go 不規則，過去式不是加 ed，而是 went。

mc.q: ___ you call me yesterday?
mc.why: yesterday 是過去；一般動詞 call 的過去問句用 Did，後面用原形。
wn: Do 問現在的習慣，yesterday 是過去要用 Did。
call 是一般動詞，問句用 Did，不用 Were。

mc.q: We ___ the museum two days ago.
mc.why: two days ago 是過去；visit 加 ed 變 visited。
wn: visit 是原形，two days ago 要用過去式。
visits 是現在式，而且 We 不加 s。

mc.q: He ___ hear the question in class yesterday.
mc.why: yesterday 是過去，一般動詞的過去否定用 didn't 加原形 hear。
wn: doesn't 講平常習慣；yesterday 是過去，要用 didn't。
hear 是一般動詞，否定用 didn't，不用 wasn't。

mc.q: The shops ___ open last Monday.
mc.why: last Monday 是過去；open 在這裡是形容詞（開著的），配 be 動詞，shops 複數用 weren't。
wn: aren't 是現在式；last Monday 是過去，要用 weren't。

mc.q: I ___ going to meet my teacher at six.
mc.why: 主詞是 I，be 動詞用 am：I am going to meet。
wn: is 配 he／she／it，I 用 am。
are 配 you／we／they，I 用 am。

mc.q: ___ you speak more slowly, please?
mc.why: 句尾有 please，是在拜託對方；請別人做事用 Can you＋原形動詞…?
wn: Do you speak… 是問平常有沒有這習慣，不是拜託別人。
Are you 後面要接形容詞或 -ing，不能接原形 speak。

mc.q: She can't ___ the map.
mc.why: can't 後面接原形動詞，主詞 She 也不加 s：can't read。
wn: can't 後面的動詞不加 s。
can't 後面不接 ing，要用原形 read。

mc.q: We are going to ___ a taxi.
mc.why: are going to 後面接原形動詞；搭計程車說 take a taxi。
wn: going to 後面要原形，不加 s。
took 是過去式，going to 要接原形 take。

fill.q: ___ is the bank?
fill.why: 問銀行在哪裡，問地點用 Where。

fill.q: ___ is your birthday?
fill.why: 問生日是哪一天，問時間用 When。

fill.q: ___ are you happy today?
fill.why: 問原因，用 Why：為什麼你今天很開心？

fill.q: ___ are you today?
fill.why: 問對方今天好不好，用 How are you?

fill.q: Turn ___ at the corner.
fill.why: 在轉角左轉說 Turn left；left 是左邊。

fill.q: Go ___ for two blocks.
fill.why: 直走固定說 go straight。

fill.q: Can you ___ more slowly?
fill.why: Can 後面接原形動詞；說慢一點用 speak more slowly。

fill.q: Can you ___ that, please?
fill.why: 請對方再說一次，用 repeat；Can 後面接原形。

fill.q: What is your ___ number?
fill.why: 電話號碼固定說 phone number。

fill.q: I will ___ you later.
fill.why: will 後面接原形動詞；text you later 是晚點傳訊息給你。

fill.q: ___ is your address?
fill.why: 問地址是什麼，用 What。

fill.q: Where ___ the train station?
fill.why: 主詞 the train station 是一個地方，be 動詞用 is。

fill.q: My parents ___ at home now.
fill.why: now 是現在；主詞 My parents 是複數，用 are。

fill.q: ___ this seat free?
fill.why: 主詞 this seat 是一個，be 動詞問句用 Is 放句首。

fill.q: I ___ a student from Taipei.
fill.why: 主詞 I 的 be 動詞用 am。

fill.q: Kevin is my friend. ___ sister is a nurse. (他的)
fill.why: 提示是他的，Kevin 是男生，所有格用 His；句首大寫。

fill.q: She ___ two brothers.
fill.why: 主詞 She 是一個人，擁有用 has。

fill.q: We ___ a new car.
fill.why: 主詞 We 是複數，擁有用 have。

fill.q: This is my map. That is ___ map. (你的)
fill.why: 提示是你的，用所有格 your，後面接 map。

fill.q: The students put ___ books on the desk. (他們的)
fill.why: 提示是他們的，The students 是複數，所有格用 their。

fill.q: Anna and I love ___ new office. (我們的)
fill.why: Anna and I 等於 we，所有格用 our（我們的）。

fill.q: He ___ to work by MRT every day.
fill.why: every day 是習慣；主詞 He 是一個人，go 加 es 變 goes。

fill.q: She ___ like coffee.
fill.why: 主詞 She 是一個人，否定用 doesn't，後面 like 用原形。

fill.q: ___ you speak English?
fill.why: 一般動詞 speak 的問句，主詞 you 用 Do 放句首。

fill.q: My sister ___ never late.
fill.why: 主詞 My sister 是一個人，be 動詞用 is；never 放在 is 後面。

fill.q: I ___ get up at six o'clock. (通常)
fill.why: 提示是通常，用 usually，放在一般動詞 get 前面。

fill.q: ___ does your class start? (什麼時候)
fill.why: 提示是什麼時候，問時間用 When。

fill.q: ___ is a park near my house.
fill.why: 後面 is a park，表示有一座公園，句首用 There。

fill.q: There ___ three buses to the airport.
fill.why: three buses 是複數，用 There are。

fill.q: The bank is ___ front of the hotel.
fill.why: 在…前面固定說 in front of，開頭用 in。

fill.q: Turn right ___ the corner.
fill.why: 在轉角固定說 at the corner，介系詞用 at。

fill.q: My hotel is ___ Number 12, Green Road.
fill.why: 完整的門牌地址前面用 at：at Number 12。

fill.q: The map is ___ the table.
fill.why: 放在桌面上，用 on the table。

fill.q: Would you like ___ tea?
fill.why: Would you like…? 是請人吃喝的客氣問句，用 some 不用 any。

fill.q: I don't have ___ money today.
fill.why: don't have 是否定句，否定句裡用 any：any money。

fill.q: How ___ is this ticket?
fill.why: 問價錢用 How much：How much is this ticket?

fill.q: How ___ people are in your family?
fill.why: people 是可數名詞的複數，問幾個人用 How many。

fill.q: I would ___ a map of the city, please.
fill.why: I would like… 是禮貌要東西的說法：我想要一張地圖。

fill.q: Yesterday I ___ very tired.
fill.why: Yesterday 是過去；主詞 I 的過去 be 動詞用 was。

fill.q: They ___ at the party last night.
fill.why: last night 是過去；主詞 They 是複數，用 were。

fill.q: We ___ dinner at seven yesterday.
fill.why: yesterday 是過去；吃晚餐 have dinner 過去式是 had，也可用 ate。

fill.q: ___ you go to the market last Sunday?
fill.why: last Sunday 是過去，問句用 Did 放句首，後面 go 用原形。

fill.q: He ___ answer the phone last night.
fill.why: last night 是過去，否定用 didn't，後面 answer 用原形。

fill.q: She ___ me her new address last week.
fill.why: last week 是過去；給地址用 gave，告訴用 told，都是不規則變化。

fill.q: I am ___ to call the doctor tomorrow.
fill.why: tomorrow 是未來的計畫，am 後面接 going to。

fill.q: ___ you help me, please?
fill.why: 請別人幫忙，用 Can 或 Could 放句首，後面接原形 help。

fill.q: We are going to ___ the museum on Saturday.
fill.why: are going to 後面接原形動詞；參觀博物館用 visit 或 see。

fill.q: Sorry, I ___ hear you. Please speak louder.
fill.why: 後面請對方大聲一點，表示聽不到，用 can't，後面接原形 hear。

fill.q: She is going ___ take the train at nine.
fill.why: be going to 是固定組合，going 後面要接 to，再接原形 take。

fill.q: Who ___ your English teacher this year?
fill.why: this year 是現在；主詞 your English teacher 是一個人，用 is。

translate.why: 請求用 Can you 或 Could you 加原形 speak；慢一點修飾動詞，用副詞 more slowly。
問地點用 Where is；郵局是 post office，前面要加 the。
問號碼用 What，不是 How many：What is your phone number?
請再說一次：Please say that again，或用 Can you say that again? 禮貌地請求。

a: I live at Number 12, Green Road.
translate.why: 住在某個門牌地址用 at：live at；英文地址先寫號碼，再寫路名。

a: There is a hospital near the station.
translate.why: 一家醫院用 There is a hospital；附近用 near，車站前加 the：near the station。

a: There are two banks on this street.
translate.why: 兩間是複數，用 There are two banks；在街上介系詞用 on：on this street。
問原因用 Why；遲到是 be late，昨天用過去式 were：Why were you late?

a: I was at home last night.
translate.why: 昨天晚上是過去，I 的 be 動詞過去式用 was；在家 at home，last night 前不加 in。

a: She takes the bus to work every day.
She goes to work by bus every day.
She takes a bus to work every day.
translate.why: every day 是習慣；主詞 She 一個人，take 加 s：takes the bus to work。
不會說用 can't speak；can 後面接原形，主詞是 He 也不能寫 can't speaks。

a: I am going to see the doctor tomorrow.
translate.why: 明天的計畫用 am going to 加原形 see；看醫生是 see a doctor 或 see the doctor。

a: Where did you go last weekend?
translate.why: 問地點用 Where；過去的疑問句用 did，後面 go 用原形：Where did you go?

a: I would like a map of the city.
I would like a city map.
I want a map of the city.
translate.why: 禮貌說想要用 I would like；一張地圖 a map，城市的地圖是 a map of the city。
問價錢用 How much；一張車票是單數，用 is：How much is this ticket?

a: How many people are there in your class?
translate.why: 問有幾個人用 How many people are there；你們班上 in your class 放最後。

a: Turn right at the traffic lights.
translate.why: 指路用命令句，動詞 Turn 放開頭；右轉 turn right；在紅綠燈那裡用 at the traffic light。

a: My sister has a new phone.
translate.why: 主詞 My sister 一個人，有用 has；一支新手機 a new phone。
這裡的聽不懂是不懂意思，用 don't understand，不是 can't hear。
請別人幫忙用 Can you 加原形 help；幫的對象是受詞，用 me，不用 I。

error.s: She go to work by bus.
error.why: 第三人稱單數的動詞要加 -s
error.full: She goes to work by bus.

error.s: Where you live?
error.correct: Where do you live?
error.why: 現在簡單式的 wh- 問句要用 do

error.s: There is two banks on this street.
error.why: 複數名詞要用 There are
error.full: There are two banks on this street.

error.s: I am go to call you tomorrow.
error.why: be going to 中間要用 going
error.full: I am going to call you tomorrow.

error.s: Can you speaking more slowly?
error.why: can 後面要接原形動詞
error.full: Can you speak more slowly?

error.s: My sister have a new phone.
error.why: 第三人稱單數要用 has
error.full: My sister has a new phone.

error.s: I no understand.
error.why: 現在簡單式的否定要用 don't
error.full: I don't understand.

error.s: Did you went to the park?
error.why: Did 後面的動詞要用原形
error.full: Did you go to the park?

error.s: What is you phone number?
error.why: 名詞前面要用所有格 your
error.full: What is your phone number?

error.s: We was at the station.
error.why: 複數主詞的過去式 be 動詞要用 were
error.full: We were at the station.

error.s: How much people are in your class?
error.why: 可數名詞要用 how many
error.full: How many people are in your class?

error.s: I would like a water.
error.why: water 是不可數名詞，要用 some
error.full: I would like some water.

error.s: Turn right in the traffic lights.
error.why: 指某一個地點要用介系詞 at
error.full: Turn right at the traffic lights.

error.s: He don't live near the station.
error.why: 第三人稱單數的否定要用 doesn't
error.full: He doesn't live near the station.

error.s: Do you can help me?
error.correct: Can you help me?
error.why: can 是助動詞，直接放句首，不用 do

reorder.a: Can you speak more slowly?
reorder.why: 請求用 Can you 或 Could you 加原形 speak；慢一點修飾動詞，用副詞 more slowly。

reorder.a: Where is the post office?
reorder.why: 問地點用 Where is；郵局是 post office，前面要加 the。

reorder.a: What is your phone number?
reorder.why: 問號碼用 What，不是 How many：What is your phone number?

reorder.a: Please say that again.
reorder.why: 請再說一次：Please say that again，或用 Can you say that again? 禮貌地請求。

reorder.a: I live at Number 12, Green Road.
reorder.why: 住在某個門牌地址用 at：live at；英文地址先寫號碼，再寫路名。

reorder.a: There is a hospital near the station.
reorder.why: 一家醫院用 There is a hospital；附近用 near，車站前加 the：near the station。

reorder.a: There are two banks on this street.
reorder.why: 兩間是複數，用 There are two banks；在街上介系詞用 on：on this street。

reorder.a: Why were you late yesterday?
reorder.why: 問原因用 Why；遲到是 be late，昨天用過去式 were：Why were you late?

reorder.a: I was at home last night.
reorder.why: 昨天晚上是過去，I 的 be 動詞過去式用 was；在家 at home，last night 前不加 in。

reorder.a: She takes the bus to work every day.
reorder.why: every day 是習慣；主詞 She 一個人，take 加 s：takes the bus to work。

reorder.a: He can't speak English.
reorder.why: 不會說用 can't speak；can 後面接原形，主詞是 He 也不能寫 can't speaks。

reorder.a: I am going to see the doctor tomorrow.
reorder.why: 明天的計畫用 am going to 加原形 see；看醫生是 see a doctor 或 see the doctor。

reorder.a: Where did you go last weekend?
reorder.why: 問地點用 Where；過去的疑問句用 did，後面 go 用原形：Where did you go?

reorder.a: I would like a map of the city.
reorder.why: 禮貌說想要用 I would like；一張地圖 a map，城市的地圖是 a map of the city。

reorder.a: How much is this ticket?
reorder.why: 問價錢用 How much；一張車票是單數，用 is：How much is this ticket?

reading.title: 短文 1
reading.text: Excuse me, where is the post office? Go straight for two blocks, then turn left at the corner. The post office is next to a small restaurant. If you have any questions, you can call the information desk. Their phone number is on the sign. You can also text them or send an email. When I visited last week, I asked a man for directions. He was very kind and answered all my questions. Now I know how to get there easily.

qs.q: How do you get to the post office?
opts: Go straight two blocks, then turn left
qs.why: 原文：Go straight for two blocks, then turn left at the corner. 直走兩個路口再左轉。
wn: 文中是先直走，再 turn left 左轉，沒有右轉 right。
文中是 two blocks 兩個路口，不是 one block。

qs.q: Where is the post office?
qs.why: 原文：The post office is next to a small restaurant. 郵局在小餐廳旁邊。
wn: 文中說 next to a small restaurant，不是銀行。
文中沒有提到 Park Street 這條路名。

qs.q: How can people contact the information desk?
qs.why: 原文：You can also text them or send an email. 除了打電話 call，傳簡訊、寄信也可以。
wn: 文中有 also，除了打電話也能 text 或 email，不是只有電話。
email 只是其中一種，也可以 call 或 text。

qs.q: Who did the writer ask for directions?
qs.why: 原文：I asked a man for directions. 作者問路的對象是一位男士。
wn: 文中說 a man 男士，不是 woman 女士。
文中只說 a man，沒說他是警察。

qs.q: Was the man helpful?
qs.why: 原文：He was very kind and answered all my questions. 他很親切又回答所有問題，所以有幫上忙。
wn: 文中說他 very kind，還回答了所有問題，是有幫忙的。
文中寫了 answered all my questions，可以知道他有幫忙。

reading.title: 短文 2
reading.text: Mei is new in Taichung. Yesterday she wanted to go to the city library. She asked a man at the bus stop. "Excuse me, where is the library?" The man spoke very fast, so Mei said, "Sorry, can you speak more slowly?" The man smiled. He said, "Take bus number 12. There is a big park near the library, and the library is behind the park." Mei said thank you. She took the bus and she found the library at ten o'clock. She is going to go there again next Saturday.

qs.q: Where did Mei want to go?
qs.why: 原文：Yesterday she wanted to go to the city library. 她想去市立圖書館。
wn: 她是在公車站 bus stop 問路，要去的是 library。
文中沒提到郵局，她要去的是 the city library。

qs.q: Why did Mei ask the man to speak more slowly?
qs.why: 原文：The man spoke very fast, so Mei said, can you speak more slowly? 他講太快了。
wn: 文中說 The man smiled，他在笑，沒有生氣。
文中沒說她遲到，原因是 he spoke very fast。

qs.q: Which bus did Mei take?
qs.why: 原文：Take bus number 12. 搭 12 號公車。
wn: 文中是 12 號，不是 20 號。
文中是 12 號，不是 2 號，數字要看完整。

qs.q: Where is the library?
qs.why: 原文：the library is behind the park. behind 是在後面，圖書館在公園後面。
wn: 文中沒提到銀行，圖書館是 behind the park。
文中沒提到學校，圖書館在公園後面。

qs.q: What is Mei going to do next Saturday?
qs.why: 原文：She is going to go there again next Saturday. there 指圖書館，下週六要再去。
wn: 她已經搬來台中 new in Taichung，文中沒說要再搬家。
文中沒提到買地圖，她是要再去圖書館。

reading.title: 短文 3
reading.text: Leo works in a small hotel. He answers the phone every day. This morning a woman called. She said, "Good morning. I would like a room for two nights." Leo asked, "What is your name and your phone number?" The woman spoke quickly, so Leo said, "Sorry, can you say that again?" Her name was Amy Chen and her number was 0912 345 678. Amy asked, "Where is the hotel?" Leo said, "We are at Number 8, Lake Road. There is a small park in front of us." Amy is going to come on Friday.

qs.q: Where does Leo work?
qs.why: 原文：Leo works in a small hotel. Leo 在一間小旅館工作。
wn: 文中說 a small hotel，不是學校。
文中說 hotel 旅館，不是 hospital 醫院，兩個字很像要看清楚。

qs.q: What does Amy want?
qs.why: 原文：I would like a room for two nights. would like 是想要，她要訂兩晚的房間。
wn: 她是打電話來訂房，不是要買新手機。
文中沒提到地圖，她只問了旅館在哪裡。

qs.q: Why did Leo say "Can you say that again?"
qs.why: 原文：The woman spoke quickly, so Leo said, can you say that again? 她講太快。
wn: 文中沒說 Amy 生氣，原因是 she spoke quickly。
文中沒說客滿，Leo 還在問她的資料。

qs.q: Where is the hotel?
qs.why: 原文：We are at Number 8, Lake Road. 旅館在 Lake Road 8 號。
wn: 文中是 8 號 Lake Road，不是 18 號 Green Road。
文中說前面有小公園 a small park in front of us，沒提到火車站。

qs.q: When is Amy going to come?
qs.why: 原文：Amy is going to come on Friday. Amy 週五要來。
wn: 文中說 on Friday 週五，不是週一。
文中說 on Friday 週五，不是週日。

reading.title: 短文 4
reading.text: Last Saturday my family went to the beach by train. My father drove us to the station, and we took the 8:30 train. My little brother asked many questions. "When are we going to arrive? Why is the train slow? Who lives near the sea?" My mother laughed and she answered all of them. There were many people on the beach, but the water was very clean. We had noodles for lunch. I didn't swim because I was tired, but I took some photos. Next month we are going to go there again.

qs.q: How did the family go to the beach?
qs.why: 原文：my family went to the beach by train. 他們搭火車去海邊。
wn: 文中說 by train，沒有搭公車。
文中說 we took the 8:30 train，是火車不是飛機。

qs.q: Who asked many questions?
qs.why: 原文：My little brother asked many questions. 問很多問題的是弟弟。
wn: 媽媽是回答問題的人 she answered all of them，不是發問的人。
爸爸只是開車送他們到車站，發問的是 little brother。

qs.q: What did they have for lunch?
qs.why: 原文：We had noodles for lunch. 午餐吃麵。
wn: 文中說 noodles 麵，不是飯。
文中說 noodles 麵，不是麵包。

qs.q: Why didn't the writer swim?
qs.why: 原文：I didn't swim because I was tired. because 後面是原因：作者很累。
wn: 文中說 the water was very clean，水很乾淨。
海灘有開，文中說 There were many people on the beach。

qs.q: What are they going to do next month?
opts: Buy a new train ticket for work
qs.why: 原文：Next month we are going to go there again. there 指海邊，下個月要再去。
wn: 文中沒提到買上班用的車票，是要再去海邊。
文中沒說要搬到海邊住，只是要再去玩。

writing.prompt: 請寫一段 3-5 句的英文，想像有人問你怎麼去某個地方（例如車站或超市），你要怎麼指路。
writing.sample: Excuse me, how do I get to the station? Go straight for one block, then turn left. The station is next to a coffee shop. You can't miss it.

writing.prompt: 寫 3-5 句英文：你在路上向路人問去火車站的路，並請對方說慢一點。
writing.sample: Excuse me, I am new here. Where is the train station? Sorry, can you speak more slowly? Is it near the post office? Thank you very much.

writing.prompt: 寫 3-5 句英文：介紹你家附近有什麼（請使用 There is / There are 和地方介系詞）。
writing.sample: I live on Green Road. There is a small park in front of my house. There are two shops next to the park. The bus stop is behind the school. I walk there every morning.

writing.prompt: 寫 3-5 句英文：說說你上週末去了哪裡，以及下週末的計畫（請使用過去簡單式和 be going to）。
writing.sample: Last weekend I went to Tainan by train. I visited an old temple and I ate noodles. The weather was hot, but I was happy. Next weekend I am going to stay at home. I am going to call my parents.

54.topic: 寫作總複習與情境對話

vocab_new.ex: I work for a big company.
I take the bus to work.

I am proud of my son.
He was surprised by the news.
I am tired because I worked late.
I like tea, but I don't like coffee.
I have a brother and a sister.
Do you want tea or coffee?
It was raining, so I stayed home.
I can also speak a little French.
I am excited about my new job.
She was nervous before the test.
My parents are proud of me.
We were surprised by the good news.
My sister is an engineer in Taipei.

vocab_review.why: swim＝游泳。例句：I swam at the pool on Sunday.
開車＝drive。例句：He can drive a car.
Chinese＝中文。例句：She can speak Chinese and English.
吉他＝guitar。例句：My brother has an old guitar.
run＝跑步。例句：He can run very fast.
滑雪＝ski。例句：I can't ski.
fix＝修理。例句：He can fix a computer.
語言＝language。例句：She can speak three languages.
traveling＝旅行(興趣)。例句：He is going to go traveling next month.
玩電玩＝gaming。例句：My brother likes gaming at night.
wn: brother 是「兄弟（哥哥或弟弟）」

vocab_review.why: camping＝露營。例句：We are going to go camping this weekend.
健行＝hiking。例句：We are going to go hiking on Saturday.
collecting＝收集。例句：I like collecting stamps.
寫作＝writing。例句：She likes writing short stories.
join＝加入。例句：They are going to join a book club.
多雲的＝cloudy。例句：The sky is cloudy today.
hot＝熱的。例句：It was hot last week.
天氣＝weather。例句：The weather is nice today.
jacket＝外套。例句：You should wear a jacket. It's cold.
野餐＝picnic。例句：We had a picnic at the park.
pool＝游泳池。例句：I can swim in the pool.
去健行、爬山＝go hiking。例句：Would you like to go hiking with me on Sunday?
wn: any 是「一些（用於否定句/疑問句）」

vocab_review.why: movie＝電影。例句：We like this movie.
抱歉＝sorry。例句：Sorry, I am late.
maybe＝也許。例句：Maybe next time.
計畫＝plan。例句：What is your plan for tomorrow?
concert＝演唱會。例句：Would you like to go to a concert?
我們一起…吧＝let's。例句：Let's go to the movies.
schedule＝行程表。例句：My schedule is busy on Mondays.
假期＝holiday。例句：Are you free during the holiday?
hotel＝飯店。例句：There is a hotel between the park and the museum.
地圖＝map。例句：There is a map on the wall.
souvenir＝紀念品。例句：I am going to buy a souvenir for you.
公車＝bus。例句：Can you take the bus alone?
wn: brother 是「兄弟（哥哥或弟弟）」

vocab_review.why: arrive＝到達。例句：Did she arrive on time?
下星期＝next week。例句：We are going to visit Taipei next week.
wn: go hiking 是「去健行、爬山」

vocab_review.why: brother＝兄弟。例句：I have one brother.
去上班＝go to work。例句：He goes to work at 8 o'clock.
bread＝麵包。例句：I would like some bread.
昨晚＝last night。例句：She was tired last night.
happy＝快樂的。例句：I am happy today.
會議＝meeting。例句：We have a meeting every Monday.
borrow＝借（入）。例句：Can I borrow your pen?
爸爸＝father。例句：This is my father.
wn: didn't 是「沒有（did not 縮寫）」

vocab_review.why: how much＝多少錢。例句：How much is this shirt?
買＝buy。例句：I would like to buy some apples.
didn't＝沒有（過去否定）。例句：I didn't go to school yesterday.
朋友＝friend。例句：I met my friend on Sunday.
cheap＝便宜的。例句：This bag is very cheap.
收據＝receipt。例句：Can I have a receipt, please?
usually＝通常。例句：She usually has breakfast at home.
從不＝never。例句：I never drink coffee at night.
wn: were 是「是（第二人稱/複數過去）」

vocab_review.why: relax＝放鬆。例句：I relax after dinner.
打掃＝clean。例句：I cleaned my room yesterday.
why＝為什麼。例句：Why are you happy?
左轉＝turn left。例句：Turn left at the corner.
corner＝轉角。例句：There is a bank on the corner.
電話號碼＝phone number。例句：What is your phone number?
wn: some 是「一些（用於肯定句/邀請）」

vocab_review.why: text＝傳訊息。例句：I will text you later.
聽＝listen。例句：I listened to music last night.

mc.q: I like tea, ___ I don't like coffee.
mc.why: 喜歡茶、不喜歡咖啡，前後意思相反，用 but（但是）。
wn: 前後意思相反，用 but 才自然，and 只是並列。
so 是所以，不喜歡咖啡不是喜歡茶的結果。

mc.q: I have a brother ___ a sister.
mc.why: 兩個都有（一個兄弟和一個姊妹），用 and（和）連接。
wn: or 是二選一，這裡是兩個都有。
but 用在相反的情況，這裡只是並列。

mc.q: Do you want tea ___ coffee?
mc.why: 問要茶還是咖啡，是二選一，用 or。
wn: and 是兩個都要，這裡是問選哪一個。
but 是但是，不能連接兩個選項。

mc.q: It was raining, ___ I stayed home.
mc.why: 下雨是原因，待在家是結果；表示所以用 so。
wn: but 是但是，下雨和待在家並不是相反的事。
or 是或者，用來二選一，這裡不是選擇。

mc.q: I am tired ___ I worked late.
mc.why: 後半句 I worked late 是累的原因，說原因用 because（因為）。
wn: so 是所以，後面接結果；這裡後半句是原因。
and 只是並列，說不出工作到很晚是累的原因。

mc.q: I can speak English. I ___ speak a little French.
mc.why: also（也）放在動詞前面，表示除了英文，也會說一點法文。
wn: too 也是也，但要放在句尾：…French too。
either 用在否定句（也不），這裡是肯定句。

mc.q: She ___ to work by bus every day.
mc.why: every day 是習慣；主詞 She 是一個人，go 加 es 變 goes。
wn: She 是一個人，動詞要加 es 變 goes。
going 前面沒有 is，不能單獨當動詞。

mc.q: He ___ to the gym yesterday.
mc.why: yesterday 是過去；go 是不規則動詞，過去式是 went。
wn: go 是原形，yesterday 要用 went。
goes 是現在式，yesterday 是過去。

mc.q: We are going to ___ a trip next month.
mc.why: be going to 後接原形動詞；take a trip 是去旅行的固定說法。
wn: going to 後面只能接原形，不加 s。
took 是過去式；next month 是未來，要接原形。

mc.q: ___ you drive?
mc.why: 問會不會開車（能力），用 Can 放句首，後面接原形 drive。
wn: 主詞 you 不配 Does，Does you drive 不對。
Are 後面不能接原形動詞 drive。

mc.q: My sister ___ a nurse.
mc.why: My sister 是一個人，be 動詞用 is。
wn: are 配複數或 you，My sister 一個人用 is。

mc.q: We ___ very excited about the trip.
mc.why: excited 是形容詞，前面要 be 動詞；主詞 We 是複數用 are。
wn: is 配一個人或一件事，We 要用 are。
am 只配 I，We 要用 are。

mc.q: ___ your father a bus driver?
mc.why: 句子沒有一般動詞，只有名詞 a bus driver，要用 be 動詞；your father 一個人用 Is。
wn: Are 配複數或 you，your father 是一個人。
Do 要搭配一般動詞，這句沒有一般動詞。

mc.q: I ___ nervous before the test.
mc.why: 主詞是 I，be 動詞一定用 am；nervous（緊張的）是形容詞。
wn: is 配一個人或一件事，I 要用 am。
are 配 you／we／they，I 要用 am。

mc.q: The taxi ___ fast, but it is not cheap.
mc.why: 主詞 The taxi 是一台車（一件事），be 動詞用 is；後半句 it is not cheap 也用 is。
wn: are 配複數或 you；The taxi 只有一台。
am 只配 I，這裡主詞是 The taxi。

mc.q: My brother is a cook and ___ wife is a teacher.
mc.why: 指我哥哥的太太，My brother 是男生，他的用 his。
wn: her 是她的，這裡是哥哥（男生）的太太。
he 是主詞，不能放在名詞 wife 前面。

mc.q: She ___ a new scooter.
mc.why: She 是一個人（第三人稱單數），have 要變 has。
wn: She 是一個人，要用 has。
have 的第三人稱是 has，沒有 haves 這個字。

mc.q: We ___ two cars, but we take the bus.
mc.why: 主詞 We 是複數，擁有用 have；後半句 we take 也是現在式。
wn: has 配一個人或一件事，We 要用 have。
句子需要真正的動詞，having 不能單獨當動詞。

mc.q: The drivers love ___ job.
mc.why: The drivers 是複數，job 前面表示他們的，用所有格 their。
wn: there 是那裡，發音像 their，但不是所有格。
they 是主詞，不能放在名詞 job 前面。

mc.q: This is Emma. ___ job is very hard.
mc.why: Emma 是女生，job 前面表示她的，用所有格 Her。
wn: His 是他的，Emma 是女生要用 Her。
She 是主詞，不能放在名詞 job 前面。

mc.q: He ___ to work by MRT.
mc.why: 說平常怎麼上班，用現在簡單式；He 是一個人，go 加 es 變 goes。
wn: He 是一個人，動詞要加 es 變 goes。
going 前面沒有 is，不能單獨當動詞。

mc.q: I ___ drive, so I take the train.
mc.why: drive 是一般動詞，主詞 I 的否定用 don't 加原形 drive。
wn: doesn't 配 he／she／it，I 要用 don't。
drive 是一般動詞，否定不用 am not。

mc.q: My mother ___ works on Sunday.
mc.why: never 是頻率副詞，放在一般動詞 works 前面：never works（從不上班）。
wn: works 是一般動詞，前面不能加 is。
not 不能直接放在 works 前面，要說 doesn't work。

mc.q: ___ your brother work in a hospital?
mc.why: your brother 是一個人，一般動詞 work 的問句用 Does。
wn: Do 配 I／you／we／they，your brother 用 Does。
work 是一般動詞，問句用 Does，不用 Is。

mc.q: She ___ happy because she likes her job.
mc.why: 後半句 she likes 是現在簡單式；主詞 She 是一個人，feel 也要加 s 變 feels。
wn: 主詞 She 是一個人，動詞要加 s。
feeling 前面要有 is，單獨不能當動詞。

mc.q: They ___ the bus every morning.
mc.why: every morning 是每天的習慣，用現在簡單式；主詞 They 是複數，動詞用原形 take。
wn: 加 s 只用在 he／she／it 一個人或一件事，They 是複數。
taking 前面要有 are 才能用，單獨不能當動詞。

mc.q: ___ a bus stop in front of my office.
mc.why: a bus stop 是一個（單數），用 There is。
wn: a bus stop 只有一個，用 There is。
be 要變成 is，不能用原形 be。

mc.q: ___ many jobs in this city.
mc.why: many jobs 是很多份工作（複數），說某地有很多東西用 There are。
wn: jobs 是複數，要用 There are。
It is 是它是；說城市裡有很多工作用 There are。

mc.q: There ___ a taxi behind the bus.
mc.why: a taxi 是一台，There is 加單數名詞，表示某處有某物。
wn: a taxi 只有一台，用 is 不用 are。
說某處有東西用 There is，不說 There have。

mc.q: There are two hospitals ___ my town.
mc.why: 在城鎮、城市這種範圍裡面，用 in：in my town。
wn: of 是…的，不表示在某地方裡面。
to 表示往某地方去，不是在那裡。

mc.q: I would like ___ coffee, because I am tired.
mc.why: coffee 當不可數名詞，想要一些用 some：I would like some coffee。
wn: an 用在母音開頭的字前面；coffee 不可數，也不能加 an。
many 配可數複數，coffee 不可數。

mc.q: We don't have ___ time, so we take a taxi.
mc.why: 前面有 don't，是否定句，否定句用 any；time 當時間是不可數名詞。
wn: many 只配可數的複數名詞，time 當時間不可數。
time 當時間不可數，不能說 a time。

mc.q: ___ is a train ticket to Tainan?
mc.why: 問車票多少錢，問價錢用 How much。
wn: How many 問數量，問價錢要用 How much。
How long 問多久或多長，不是價錢。

mc.q: ___ people work in your office?
mc.why: people 是可以一個一個數的（複數），問數量用 How many。
wn: How much 問不可數的量或價錢，people 可數用 How many。
How old 問年紀，不是問人數。

mc.q: He would ___ to be a doctor.
mc.why: would like to 是想要的固定說法，would 後面接原形 like，不加 s。
wn: would 後面接原形，不加 s。
would 後面不接 ing，要用 like。

mc.q: Yesterday I ___ very proud of my son.
mc.why: Yesterday 是過去；I 的 be 動詞過去式是 was。
wn: were 配 you／we／they，I 用 was。
am 是現在式，Yesterday 是過去。

mc.q: They ___ surprised, but they were happy.
mc.why: 後半句 they were happy 是過去，前半句也用過去；They 配 were。
wn: was 配一個人或一件事，They 用 were。
後面 were 是過去，前面也要用過去 were。

mc.q: She ___ a taxi because it rained.
mc.why: 後半句 it rained 是過去，搭車也是過去的事；take 的過去式是不規則的 took。
wn: take 是現在式，rained 說明這是過去的事。
takes 是現在式，這句講的是過去。

mc.q: ___ you feel nervous last week?
mc.why: last week 是過去；一般動詞 feel 的問句用 Did，後面接原形。
wn: Do 是現在式，last week 要用 Did。
feel 是一般動詞，問句用 Did，不用 Are。

mc.q: We ___ go to work yesterday.
mc.why: yesterday 是過去；一般動詞 go 的否定用 didn't 加原形。
wn: don't 是現在式，yesterday 要用 didn't。
go 是一般動詞，否定用 didn't，不用 weren't。

mc.q: He ___ a teacher ten years ago.
mc.why: ten years ago 是過去；主詞 He 是一個人，be 動詞過去式用 was。
wn: were 配 you／we／they，He 一個人用 was。
is 是現在式，ten years ago 是過去要用 was。

mc.q: I ___ going to be a nurse.
mc.why: 主詞是 I，be 動詞用 am。
wn: is 配 he／she／it，I 用 am。
are 配 you／we／they，I 用 am。

mc.q: She ___ drive, but she can ride a bike.
mc.why: 後半句 she can ride，前半句是相反的不會，用 can't 加原形 drive。
wn: can 不和 do／does 一起用，否定直接說 can't。
not 不放在 can 前面，要說 can't 或 cannot。

mc.q: We are going to ___ by plane.
mc.why: are going to 後面接原形動詞 travel，表示打算要做的事。
wn: going to 後面要原形，不加 s。
travelled 是過去式，going to 講未來，要用原形。

mc.q: ___ you help me with my homework?
mc.why: 請人幫忙用 Can you 加原形動詞：Can you help me…?
wn: Do you help me 是問習慣，請人幫忙要用 Can。
Are 後面不能接原形動詞 help。

mc.q: I like my job, ___ it is very busy.
mc.why: 喜歡工作但是很忙，前後有轉折，用 but。
wn: 忙不是喜歡工作的原因，前後是轉折。
or 是二選一，這裡不是選擇。

mc.q: He was tired, ___ he went home early.
mc.why: 累了是原因，早點回家是結果，接結果用 so（所以）。
wn: but 是但是，用在相反的情況；累了早回家是順理成章。
or 是或者，用在選擇，不是因果。

mc.q: I take the bus ___ the MRT is closed.
mc.why: MRT 關閉是搭公車的原因，表示原因用 because（因為）。
wn: but 是但是，前後意思相反才用；這裡是在說原因。
or 是或者，用來二選一，這裡不是在選擇。

mc.q: Do you go to work by car ___ by bus?
mc.why: 問兩個選擇中的哪一個（開車還是搭公車），用 or（還是、或）。
wn: and 是兩個都要，這裡是二選一，用 or。
so 是所以，表示結果，不能連接兩個選項。

mc.q: My father is a driver ___ my mother is a cook.
mc.why: 兩件事並列說明（爸爸是司機、媽媽是廚師），用 and 連接。
wn: but 用在相反或意外，這兩句沒有對比。
because 說原因，媽媽是廚師不是爸爸當司機的原因。

fill.q: I like tea, ___ I don't like coffee.
fill.why: 喜歡茶但不喜歡咖啡，意思相反，用 but。

fill.q: I have a brother ___ a sister.
fill.why: 有哥哥也有姊姊，兩樣都有，用 and 連接。

fill.q: Do you want tea ___ coffee?
fill.why: 問二選一，茶或咖啡，用 or。

fill.q: It was raining, ___ I stayed home.
fill.why: 下雨是原因，待在家是結果，用 so（所以）。

fill.q: I am tired ___ I worked late.
fill.why: 後半句說明累的原因（工作到很晚），用 because（因為）。

fill.q: She ___ to work by bus every day.
fill.why: every day 是習慣；主詞 She 是一個人，go 加 es 變 goes。

fill.q: He ___ to the gym yesterday.
fill.why: yesterday 是過去，go 的過去式不規則，變 went。

fill.q: I am ___ about the trip.
fill.why: 對旅行感到興奮，用 excited；人的感覺用 -ed 形容詞。

fill.q: She was ___ by the news.
fill.why: 人感到驚訝用 -ed 形容詞 surprised；by the news 是因為消息。

fill.q: I am very ___ of my son.
fill.why: 以某人為榮固定說 proud of。

fill.q: My brother ___ a police officer.
fill.why: 主詞 My brother 是一個人，be 動詞用 is。

fill.q: We ___ excited about the trip.
fill.why: 主詞 We 是複數，be 動詞用 are。

fill.q: I ___ a little nervous today.
fill.why: today 是現在；主詞 I 的 be 動詞用 am。

fill.q: My friends ___ proud of me.
fill.why: 主詞 My friends 是複數，be 動詞用 are。

fill.q: This is my sister and this is ___ husband. (她的)
fill.why: 提示是她的，用所有格 her，後面接 husband。

fill.q: He ___ a new job in Taipei.
fill.why: 主詞 He 是一個人，have 要變 has。

fill.q: They ___ two bikes.
fill.why: 主詞 They 是複數，擁有用 have，不用 has。

fill.q: The drivers wash ___ cars on Sunday. (他們的)
fill.why: 提示是他們的，主詞 The drivers 是複數，所有格用 their。

fill.q: My name is Ann and this is ___ office. (我的)
fill.why: 提示是我的，所有格用 my。

fill.q: I ___ like long trips.
fill.why: 主詞 I，現在簡單式否定用 don't，後面 like 用原形。

fill.q: My father ___ drive a truck.
fill.why: 主詞 My father 是一個人，否定用 doesn't，後面 drive 用原形。

fill.q: ___ your sister work in a bank?
fill.why: 主詞 your sister 是一個人，一般動詞 work 的問句用 Does 放句首。

fill.q: He is ___ late for work. (從不)
fill.why: 提示是從不，用 never，放在 be 動詞 is 後面。

fill.q: We ___ take the MRT on Monday. (總是)
fill.why: 提示是總是，用 always，放在一般動詞 take 前面。

fill.q: ___ are three buses to the airport.
fill.why: 後面 are three buses，表示有三班公車，句首用 There。

fill.q: There ___ a small shop near my office.
fill.why: a small shop 是一間，用 There is。

fill.q: There is a bike ___ front of the house.
fill.why: 在…前面固定說 in front of，開頭用 in。

fill.q: There are many jobs ___ this city.
fill.why: 在城市裡用 in this city。

fill.q: I would like ___ bread, please.
fill.why: would like 是肯定句，要一些用 some；bread 不可數，不能用 a。

fill.q: We don't have ___ money for a taxi.
fill.why: 否定句 don't have 後面用 any；money 不可數，不加 s。

fill.q: How ___ is a ticket to Taipei?
fill.why: 問價錢用 How much：How much is a ticket?

fill.q: How ___ people work in your shop?
fill.why: people 是可數名詞的複數，問幾個人用 How many。

fill.q: She would ___ to be an engineer.
fill.why: would like to 是想要；She would like to be… 她想當工程師。

fill.q: Last week I ___ very happy.
fill.why: Last week 是過去；主詞 I 用 was。

fill.q: They ___ surprised at the news.
fill.why: at the news 是聽到消息當時；主詞 They 是複數，過去用 were。

fill.q: I ___ the train to Tainan yesterday.
fill.why: yesterday 是過去，take 的過去式不規則，變 took。

fill.q: ___ you work last Saturday?
fill.why: last Saturday 是過去，問句用 Did 放句首，後面 work 用原形。

fill.q: He ___ come to the party last night.
fill.why: last night 是過去，否定用 didn't，後面 come 用原形。

fill.q: We ___ going to buy a new car.
fill.why: 主詞 We 是複數，be going to 的 be 動詞用 are。

fill.q: She is going ___ study English next year.
fill.why: be going to 是固定組合，going 後面要接 to，再接原形 study。

fill.q: I ___ ride a bike, but I can't drive.
fill.why: but 後面說不會開車，前面相反：會騎腳踏車，用 can。

fill.q: Sorry, I ___ come to your party tomorrow.
fill.why: Sorry 表示沒辦法來，用 can't，後面接原形 come。

fill.q: I am tired, ___ I am happy.
fill.why: 累但是開心，意思相反，用 but 連接。

fill.q: It rained, ___ we took a taxi.
fill.why: 下雨是原因，搭計程車是結果，用 so（所以）。

fill.q: I like my job ___ my boss is kind.
fill.why: 後半句說明喜歡工作的原因（老闆人好），用 because。

fill.q: Do you go to work by bus ___ by MRT?
fill.why: 問搭公車還是捷運，二選一用 or。

fill.q: My mother is a nurse ___ my father is a cook.
fill.why: 兩句話都是介紹家人，沒有相反，用 and 連接。

fill.q: She was nervous, ___ she was also excited.
fill.why: 緊張但也很興奮，兩種感覺相反，用 but。

translate.zh: 我很興奮，因為我要去日本。
a: I am excited because I am going to Japan.
translate.why: 原因用 because 連接；要去日本是計畫，用 am going to；興奮是 excited，不是 exciting。
主詞 My sister 用 is；職業前要加 a：a nurse。

a: He goes to work by MRT.
He takes the MRT to work.
translate.why: 主詞 He，動詞加 s：goes 或 takes；搭捷運可寫 by MRT（by 後不加 the），或 take the MRT。

a: I am tired, but I am happy.
translate.why: 前後意思轉折用 but 連接；兩句都要有 be 動詞：I am tired, but I am happy。

translate.zh: 昨天下雨，所以我們搭計程車。
a: It rained yesterday, so we took a taxi.
Yesterday it rained, so we took a taxi.
Yesterday, it rained, so we took a taxi.
It was rainy yesterday, so we took a taxi.
translate.why: 昨天是過去：rain 加 ed 變 rained，take 變 took；後面用 so 接結果。

translate.zh: 你搭公車還是走路去上班？
a: Do you go to work by bus or on foot?
translate.why: 二選一用 or 連接；搭公車 by bus，走路 on foot；主詞 you，疑問句用 Do 開頭。

translate.zh: 我爸爸是司機，我媽媽是老師。
a: My father is a driver and my mother is a teacher.
translate.why: 職業前要加 a：a driver、a teacher；兩句用 and 連接，每句都要有 is。
昨天是過去，I 的 be 動詞過去式用 was；緊張 nervous 是形容詞，放 was 後面。

a: They are proud of their son.
translate.why: 感到驕傲的固定說法是 be proud of；主詞 They 用 are；他們的兒子 their son。
不會開車是沒有這個能力，用 can't 或 cannot 加原形 drive；cannot 要連在一起寫。

translate.zh: 我下個月要開始新工作。
a: I am going to start a new job next month.
translate.why: 下個月的計畫用 am going to start；新工作 a new job，a 放在 new 前面。

a: I went to Tainan last week.
Last week I went to Tainan.
translate.why: 上週是過去，go 的過去式是不規則的 went；去台南 went to Tainan。

a: She didn't go to work yesterday.
translate.why: 昨天是過去，否定用 didn't 加原形 go，不能寫 didn't went；去上班 go to work。

a: I would like a cup of coffee.
translate.why: 禮貌點餐用 I would like；咖啡一杯要說 a cup of coffee。

a: How many people are there in your office?
translate.why: 問有幾個人用 How many people are there，地點 in your office 放最後。

a: There is a shop in front of the station.
translate.why: 一家店用 There is a shop；在什麼前面是 in front of，車站前加 the。

translate.zh: 我媽媽從不在星期天工作。
a: My mother never works on Sunday.
My mother never works on Sundays.
My mom never works on Sunday.
My mom never works on Sundays.
translate.why: never 是從不，放在動詞前；主詞 My mother 是一個人，work 要加 s：never works。

translate.zh: 昨天我們很驚訝，但是我們很高興。
a: Yesterday we were surprised, but we were happy.
Yesterday, we were surprised, but we were happy.
We were surprised yesterday, but we were happy.
translate.why: 昨天是過去，We 的 be 動詞過去式是 were；轉折用 but 連接兩句。

a: How much is this train ticket?
translate.why: 問價錢用 How much；一張票是單數，be 動詞用 is：How much is this train ticket?

a: My brother has a new scooter.
My brother has a new motorcycle.
My brother has a new motorbike.
translate.why: 主詞 My brother 一個人，有用 has，不是 have；新機車 a new scooter，new 放在 a 後面。

error.s: She is nurse.
error.correct: She is a nurse.
error.why: 單數職業名詞前面要加冠詞 a

error.s: I am tired, so I am happy.
error.why: 前後語意相反時要用 but
error.full: I am tired, but I am happy.

error.s: He goes to work by the MRT.
error.correct: He goes to work by MRT.
error.why: by + 交通工具中間不加 the

error.s: My father don't drive.
error.why: 第三人稱單數的否定要用 doesn't
error.full: My father doesn't drive.

error.s: We was surprised.
error.why: 複數主詞的過去式 be 動詞要用 were
error.full: We were surprised.

error.s: They are proud of they son.
error.why: 名詞前面要用所有格 their
error.full: They are proud of their son.

error.s: I am going to studying English.
error.why: be going to 後面要接原形動詞
error.full: I am going to study English.

error.s: It rained, because we took a taxi.
error.why: 表示結果要用 so
error.full: It rained, so we took a taxi.

error.s: There is many jobs in this city.
error.why: 複數名詞要用 There are
error.full: There are many jobs in this city.

error.s: How much people work here?
error.why: 可數名詞要用 how many
error.full: How many people work here?

error.s: I didn't went to work.
error.why: didn't 後面的動詞要用原形
error.full: I didn't go to work.

error.s: She can drives a bus.
error.why: can 後面要接原形動詞
error.full: She can drive a bus.

error.s: My sister have two children.
error.why: 第三人稱單數要用 has
error.full: My sister has two children.

error.s: I don't have some money.
error.why: 否定句要用 any
error.full: I don't have any money.

error.s: Last week I am very busy.
error.why: 過去的時間要用過去式 was
error.full: Last week I was very busy.

reorder.a: I am excited because I am going to Japan.
reorder.why: 原因用 because 連接；要去日本是計畫，用 am going to；興奮是 excited，不是 exciting。

reorder.a: My sister is a nurse.
reorder.why: 主詞 My sister 用 is；職業前要加 a：a nurse。

reorder.a: He goes to work by MRT.
reorder.why: 主詞 He，動詞加 s：goes 或 takes；搭捷運可寫 by MRT（by 後不加 the），或 take the MRT。

reorder.a: I am tired, but I am happy.
reorder.why: 前後意思轉折用 but 連接；兩句都要有 be 動詞：I am tired, but I am happy。

reorder.a: It rained, so we took a taxi.
Do you go to work by bus or on foot?
reorder.why: 二選一用 or 連接；搭公車 by bus，走路 on foot；主詞 you，疑問句用 Do 開頭。

reorder.a: I was nervous yesterday.
reorder.why: 昨天是過去，I 的 be 動詞過去式用 was；緊張 nervous 是形容詞，放 was 後面。

reorder.a: They are proud of their son.
reorder.why: 感到驕傲的固定說法是 be proud of；主詞 They 用 are；他們的兒子 their son。

reorder.a: I am going to start a new job next month.
reorder.why: 下個月的計畫用 am going to start；新工作 a new job，a 放在 new 前面。

reorder.a: I went to Tainan last week.
reorder.why: 上週是過去，go 的過去式是不規則的 went；去台南 went to Tainan。

reorder.a: She didn't go to work yesterday.
reorder.why: 昨天是過去，否定用 didn't 加原形 go，不能寫 didn't went；去上班 go to work。

reorder.a: I would like a cup of coffee.
reorder.why: 禮貌點餐用 I would like；咖啡一杯要說 a cup of coffee。

reorder.a: How many people are there in your office?
reorder.why: 問有幾個人用 How many people are there，地點 in your office 放最後。

reorder.a: There is a shop in front of the station.
reorder.why: 一家店用 There is a shop；在什麼前面是 in front of，車站前加 the。

reorder.a: My mother never works on Sunday.
reorder.why: never 是從不，放在動詞前；主詞 My mother 是一個人，work 要加 s：never works。

reading.title: 短文 1
reading.text: Last month, I got a new job at a small company. I was very excited, but I was also a little nervous. On my first day, I took the bus to work because my car was not ready yet. My new boss was very kind, and my co-workers were friendly too. After work, I called my mother and told her the good news. She was proud of me. Next month, I am going to start a new project, so I am practicing my English every day. I know it will be difficult, but I am ready for it.

qs.q: What happened last month?
opts: The writer got a new job
The writer went on a trip
qs.why: 原文：Last month, I got a new job at a small company. 上個月作者找到新工作。
wn: 文中沒提到搬家，上個月是 got a new job。
文中沒提到旅行，是找到了新工作。

qs.q: How did the writer get to work on the first day?
qs.why: 原文：I took the bus to work because my car was not ready yet. 第一天搭公車上班。
wn: 文中說 my car was not ready yet，車還沒好，所以沒開車。
文中說 took the bus，不是火車。

qs.q: How did the writer feel about the new job?
qs.why: 原文：I was very excited, but I was also a little nervous. 很興奮，但也有點緊張。
wn: 文中說 excited 興奮，不是無聊 bored。
文中沒說生氣，說的是 excited 和 a little nervous。

qs.q: Who did the writer call after work?
qs.why: 原文：After work, I called my mother and told her the good news. 下班後打給媽媽。
wn: 文中說 I called my mother，不是朋友。
同事只是說很友善 friendly，下班後打電話的對象是媽媽。

qs.q: What is the writer going to do next month?
qs.why: 原文：Next month, I am going to start a new project. 下個月要開始新專案。
wn: 文中沒提到休假，下個月是 start a new project。
作者剛換新工作，文中沒說又要換。

reading.title: 短文 2
reading.text: Ivy is a nurse and she works in a big hospital in Kaohsiung. She goes to work by scooter, because the hospital is far from her home. Ivy is often tired, but she loves her job. Last Monday she was very nervous, because it was her first day in a new office. Her boss was kind and her friends helped her, so she felt happy at night. Ivy has two children and they are proud of their mother. Next week Ivy is going to work in the morning, and she is going to study English at night.

qs.q: What is Ivy's job?
qs.why: 原文：Ivy is a nurse and she works in a big hospital. nurse 是護理師。
wn: 文中說 Ivy is a nurse，不是老師。
她騎機車上班，但工作是 nurse，不是司機。

qs.q: How does Ivy go to work?
qs.why: 原文：She goes to work by scooter. scooter 是機車。
wn: 文中說 by scooter 騎機車，不是公車。
文中說 by scooter，而且醫院很遠，不是走路。

qs.q: Why does she go to work by scooter?
opts: Because the hospital is far from her home
qs.why: 原文：because the hospital is far from her home. 醫院離家很遠。
wn: 文中沒說她不喜歡公車，原因是醫院很遠。
文中沒說辦公室關門，原因是 far from her home。

qs.q: How did Ivy feel on her first day in the new office?
qs.why: 原文：Last Monday she was very nervous. 新辦公室第一天，她很緊張。
wn: 文中說 nervous 緊張，不是無聊。
文中說 nervous 緊張，晚上還 felt happy，沒有生氣。

qs.q: What is Ivy going to do at night next week?
qs.why: 原文：she is going to study English at night. 下週晚上要讀英文。
wn: 下週她是早上 in the morning 上班，晚上是讀英文。
文中只說老闆很好，沒說要去拜訪老闆。

reading.title: 短文 3
reading.text: My name is Tom and I am a cook. I work in a small restaurant near the train station. I don't drive, so I take the MRT to work every day. My wife is a teacher and she takes the bus. Last week we were very excited, because our son got a new job. He is a driver now. On Sunday we had dinner together and my son paid for it. I was surprised, but I was also proud. Next month we are going to visit my parents in Hualien by train.

qs.q: What is Tom's job?
qs.why: 原文：My name is Tom and I am a cook. cook 當名詞是廚師。
wn: teacher 是 Tom 的太太 My wife is a teacher。
driver 是 Tom 的兒子 He is a driver now。

qs.q: How does Tom go to work?
qs.why: 原文：I don't drive, so I take the MRT to work every day. 他搭捷運上班。
wn: 文中說 I don't drive，他不開車。
文中說 take the MRT，不是騎腳踏車。

qs.q: What does Tom's wife do?
qs.why: 原文：My wife is a teacher and she takes the bus. 太太是老師。
wn: cook 廚師是 Tom 自己，不是他太太。
文中說 My wife is a teacher，不是護理師。

qs.q: Why were they excited last week?
opts: Because their son got a new job
qs.why: 原文：we were very excited, because our son got a new job. 兒子找到新工作。
wn: 文中沒說買車，Tom 甚至不開車。
花蓮是爸媽住的地方，下個月才要去拜訪，不是搬家。

qs.q: How are they going to go to Hualien?
qs.why: 原文：we are going to visit my parents in Hualien by train. 搭火車去花蓮。
wn: 文中說 by train，不是搭飛機。
文中說 by train，沒提到騎機車。

reading.title: 短文 4
reading.text: Last Sunday was a busy day for Ann. In the morning she was excited, because her sister came back from Japan. Ann went to the airport by taxi, but the road was busy, so she arrived late. Her sister waited for twenty minutes and she wasn't angry. They had lunch in a small shop and they talked about their jobs. Ann is an office worker and her sister is an engineer. In the evening Ann was tired but happy. Next Sunday they are going to go shopping together, or they are going to see a movie.

qs.q: Why was Ann excited?
opts: Because she got a new job
Because her sister came back from Japan
qs.why: 原文：she was excited, because her sister came back from Japan. 姊妹從日本回來。
wn: 文中只說她是上班族，沒說找到新工作。
文中沒說買車，她是搭計程車去機場。

qs.q: How did Ann go to the airport?
qs.why: 原文：Ann went to the airport by taxi. 她搭計程車去機場。
wn: 文中說 by taxi，不是公車。
文中說 by taxi，不是火車。

qs.q: Why did Ann arrive late?
qs.why: 原文：the road was busy, so she arrived late. road was busy 是路上車很多、塞車。
wn: 文中沒說她晚起床，原因是 the road was busy。
文中沒說計程車很舊，是路上很塞。

qs.q: What is Ann's sister's job?
qs.why: 原文：Ann is an office worker and her sister is an engineer. 姊妹是工程師。
wn: 文中說 her sister is an engineer，不是護理師。
文中說 an engineer 工程師，不是廚師。

qs.q: What are they going to do next Sunday?
opts: Go shopping or see a movie
qs.why: 原文：they are going to go shopping…, or… see a movie. 下週日逛街或看電影。
wn: 是姊妹剛從日本回來，文中沒說下週日要去日本。
Ann 在辦公室上班，但下週日是要逛街或看電影。

dictation.s: I was nervous, but everyone was very friendly.
She goes to work by train because it is faster.
My sister is a nurse in a big hospital.
I take the MRT to work every day.

It rained, so we took a taxi home.
There are many jobs in this small town.
My father drove a bus for twenty years.
We are going to travel by train next month.
I like my job because my boss is kind.
