writing.prompt: 這是本階段最後的寫作練習：請寫一篇 6-8 句的短文，自我介紹你自己，內容包含：你是誰、你的家人、你平常的生活、你上個月/上週做過的一件事、還有你下個月的計畫。盡量用到這 8 週學過的不同文法。
writing.sample: Hello, my name is Wei. I am from Taiwan, and I work at a small company. I have one brother and one sister. I usually wake up at seven and go to work at nine. Last month, I visited my grandparents in Tainan, and we had a wonderful time together. I can cook simple food, but I can't cook big meals yet. Next month, I am going to start learning English more seriously because I want to study abroad. I am excited and a little nervous, but I am ready for this new chapter.

writing.prompt: 寫 3-5 句英文：介紹你的工作（或你想做的工作），並使用 and / but / because。
writing.sample: I am an office worker in Taipei. I like my job, because my boss is kind. The work is busy, but it is interesting. I go to work by MRT and I come home at seven. I would like to be a manager one day.

writing.prompt: 寫 3-5 句英文：描述一次讓你緊張或興奮的經驗（請使用過去簡單式和情緒形容詞）。
writing.sample: Last month I had my first English test. I was very nervous in the morning. My teacher was kind, so I felt better. I got a good score and my family was proud of me. I was excited all day.

writing.prompt: 期末總複習任務：寫 6-8 句英文自我介紹，內容要包含你是誰、你的家人、你的日常作息、你上個月做了什麼，以及你下個月的計畫。
writing.sample: Hello, my name is Ivy Lin and I am from Taichung. I work in a small hospital and I am a nurse. I have a husband and one son, and my son is six years old. My mother lives with us and she cooks dinner every evening. I get up at six o'clock and I go to work by scooter. I usually finish work at five, but on Friday I am very busy. Last month I visited my sister in Kaohsiung and we went to the beach together. Next month I am going to study English at night, because I would like to work in another country.

55.topic: 全程總複習與自我檢測

vocab_new.ex: She usually has breakfast at home.
She gets up at half past six.
There is a bathroom on the second floor.
There is a police station near the school.
There are trees around the house.
How much sugar do you want in your tea?
What would you like to drink?
I would like a little sugar.
I cleaned my room this morning.
I found my ticket in my bag.
He can skate on the ice.
We are going to go hiking if it's sunny.

vocab_review.why: hello＝你好。例句：Hello! Nice to meet you.
謝謝＝thank you。例句：Thank you for your help.
nationality＝國籍。例句：What is your nationality?
wn: 「現金還是刷卡」是 cash or card

vocab_review.why: 住＝live。例句：I live in Taipei.
police officer＝警察。例句：He is a police officer.
二＝two。例句：I have two pens.
wn: favorite color 是「最喜歡的顏色」

vocab_review.why: email＝電子郵件。例句：What is your email?
快樂的＝happy。例句：I am happy today.
meet＝遇見。例句：Nice to meet you again.
也（句尾）＝too。例句：I am happy too.
parents＝父母。例句：These are my parents.
男孩＝boy。例句：This boy is my son.
wife＝妻子。例句：She is his wife.
狗＝dog。例句：I have a dog.
camera＝相機。例句：We have a camera.
棕色眼睛＝brown eyes。例句：I have brown eyes.
likes＝喜歡（第三人稱）。例句：She likes movies.
洗臉＝wash face。例句：I wash my face every morning.
check the phone＝看手機。例句：He checks his phone in bed.
下班＝finish work。例句：He finishes work at 6.
write a report＝寫報告。例句：I write a report every week.
玩遊戲＝play games。例句：They play games after dinner.
late＝晚；遲。例句：He comes home late on Friday.
在平日＝on weekdays。例句：I work on weekdays.
wn: make the bed 是「整理床鋪」

vocab_review.why: Friday＝星期五。例句：They go shopping on Friday.
時間表＝schedule。例句：My schedule is busy on Mondays.
relax＝放鬆。例句：I relax after dinner.
廚房＝kitchen。例句：There is a fridge in the kitchen.
door＝門。例句：There is a door next to the window.
wn: 「是（第二人稱/複數過去）」是 were

vocab_review.why: 書桌＝desk。例句：There is a desk near the window.
bookshelf＝書架。例句：There are many books on the bookshelf.
飯店＝hotel。例句：There is a hotel between the park and the museum.
map＝地圖。例句：There is a map on the wall.
wn: 「祝你有美好的一天」是 have a nice day

vocab_review.why: 在...上面＝on。例句：There is a book on the table.
beside＝在...旁邊。例句：There is a chair beside the bed.
牛奶＝milk。例句：Do you have any milk?
wn: any 是「一些（用於否定句/疑問句）」

vocab_review.why: chicken＝雞肉。例句：Would you like some chicken?
紅蘿蔔＝carrot。例句：There aren't any carrots in the fridge.
waiter＝服務生（男）。例句：The waiter brings some water.
wn: 「一些（用於肯定句/邀請）」是 some

vocab_review.why: 服務＝service。例句：The service here is very good.
wn: sister 是「姊妹（姊姊或妹妹）」

vocab_review.why: store＝商店。例句：I would like to go to the store.
你想要嗎＝would you like。例句：Would you like some coffee?
any apples＝一些蘋果（疑問/否定）。例句：Do you have any apples?
請給我收據＝receipt please。例句：Receipt, please.
kilo＝公斤。例句：I would like two kilos of apples.
看了＝watched。例句：She watched a movie yesterday.
wn: go hiking 是「去健行、爬山」

vocab_review.why: walk＝走路。例句：We walked to school.
做；製作＝make。例句：I make coffee every morning.
no, I didn't＝不，我沒有。例句：Did you go home? No, I didn't.
wn: 「你有…嗎」是 do you have any

vocab_review.why: 回答＝answer。例句：He didn't answer my question.
wn: answer emails 是「回覆電子郵件」
different day 是「不同的日子」

vocab_review.why: shopping mall＝購物中心。例句：We went to the shopping mall on Saturday.
停留了＝stayed。例句：We stayed there for three days.
next year＝明年。例句：They are going to travel to Japan next year.
wn: 「不，我們沒有」是 no we don't

vocab_review.why: 跑步＝run。例句：He can run very fast.
painting＝繪畫。例句：My sister enjoys painting pictures.
空閒時間＝free time。例句：In my free time, I like reading.
invite＝邀請。例句：I want to invite you to my party.
票＝ticket。例句：I am going to buy a ticket.
neighbour＝鄰居。例句：My neighbour is a nice old man.
問題＝question。例句：I have a question.

mc.q: ___ a new student.
mc.why: 句子缺主詞和動詞；I 配 am，所以是 I am a new student.
wn: is 配 he／she／it，I 只配 am。
be 是原形，句子裡要變成 am：I am。

mc.q: Sorry, the teacher ___ in the room now.
mc.why: The teacher 是一個人，單數；說老師現在不在教室，用否定 isn't（is not）。
wn: aren't 配 you 或複數，The teacher 只有一位。
am not 只配 I，主詞是 The teacher。

mc.q: ___ your friend Korean?
mc.why: 主詞 your friend 是一個人，問句用 Is 開頭。
wn: 主詞是 friend（沒有 s），不是 you，用 Is。

mc.q: ___ he a police officer?
mc.why: 主詞 he 是一個人，問句用 Is 開頭：Is he a police officer?
wn: Are 配 you 或複數，he 要用 Is。
Am 只配 I，主詞是 he。

mc.q: It ___ eight o'clock now.
mc.why: 說時間用 It 當主詞，配 is：It is eight o'clock.（現在八點）
wn: am 只配 I，說時間要用 It is。
eight 不是主詞；主詞 It 單數，用 is。

mc.q: What ___ your room number?
mc.why: 主詞 your room number 是一個號碼，單數用 is。
wn: 主詞是 room number，不是 you，用 is。

mc.q: We ___ happy in this class.
mc.why: 主詞 We 是複數，be 動詞用 are。
wn: this class 不是主詞；We 是我們，用 are。

mc.q: We ___ not tired today.
mc.why: We 是複數主詞，配 are；否定 We are not tired。
wn: is 只配單數，We 是好幾個人。

mc.q: My father is tall. ___ eyes are brown.
mc.why: My father 是男生，說他的眼睛用 His（他的）。
wn: Her 是「她的」，father 是男生。
Its 指東西或動物，不用來指爸爸。

mc.q: This is ___ family reunion.
mc.why: 後面接名詞 family reunion，要用所有格 our（我們的）。
wn: we 是主詞，不能放在名詞前面。
us 是受詞，不能修飾名詞。

mc.q: This is my aunt. ___ is very kind.
mc.why: my aunt 是女生，放在句首當主詞用 She。
wn: He 指男生，aunt 是阿姨／姑姑，是女生。
Her 是受詞或所有格，句首當主詞要用 She。

mc.q: My friend ___ a nice bike.
mc.why: My friend 是一個人，表示擁有用 has。
wn: My friend 是一個人（他／她），要用 has。
having 不能單獨當句子的動詞。

mc.q: My cousins ___ blue eyes.
mc.why: My cousins 有 s 是複數，說眼睛顏色用 have。
wn: has 只配一個人，cousins 是複數。
is 不表示擁有，而且複數不配 is。

mc.q: Lisa is my aunt. ___ favorite food is pizza.
mc.why: Lisa 是阿姨（女生），她最喜歡的食物用 Her。
wn: His 是男生的，Lisa 是女生。
Our 是我們的，這裡說的是 Lisa 喜歡的食物。

mc.q: Let me introduce ___ family.
mc.why: 空格後有名詞 family，用所有格 my（我的）。
wn: I 是主詞，不能放在名詞前面。
me 是受詞，不能放在名詞前面。

mc.q: My mother's mother is my ___.
mc.why: 媽媽的媽媽是外婆，英文是 grandmother。
wn: aunt 是阿姨或姑姑，是媽媽的姊妹。
sister 是我的姊妹，不是媽媽的媽媽。

mc.q: Do you ___ breakfast at seven?
mc.why: 問句已經有 Do，後面動詞用原形 have。have breakfast 是吃早餐。
wn: Do 後面一律用原形；has 只用在 he／she 的肯定句。

mc.q: My boss ___ has a meeting at ten.
mc.why: has 是一般動詞，頻率副詞 usually 直接放在 has 前面。
wn: 已經有 has，再加 is 就多了一個動詞。
usual 是形容詞（平常的），放在動詞前要用副詞 usually。

mc.q: ___ she check her email at night?
mc.why: 主詞 she 是一個人，check 是原形一般動詞，問句用 Does 開頭。
wn: Do 配 I／you／we／they，she 要用 Does。
check 是一般動詞，要用 Does 問，不用 Is。

mc.q: My son ___ his homework after dinner.
mc.why: do homework 是寫功課；My son 是一個人，do 加 es 變 does。
wn: 前面沒有 is，不能只用 -ing。
My son 是一個人，do 要變 does。

mc.q: She ___ often cook at home.
mc.why: She 是一個人，cook 是原形一般動詞，否定用 doesn't。
wn: cook 是一般動詞，否定用 doesn't，不用 isn't。
don't 配 I／you／we／they，She 用 doesn't。

mc.why: 7:30 是七點過半小時，英文說 half past seven（past 是過了）。
wn: 英文不說 seven half，要說 half past seven。
o'clock 只用在整點，例如 seven o'clock。

mc.q: After that, he ___ a shower.
mc.why: he 是一個人，在說平常的流程，take a shower（洗澡）的 take 加 s。
wn: he 是一個人，take 要加 s。
前面沒有 is，不能只用 -ing。

mc.q: ___ a table in the kitchen.
mc.why: 說某處有某物用 There is；a table 是一張，單數。
wn: There are 配複數，a table 只有一張。
It is 是說這是什麼；說某處有東西要用 There is。

mc.q: There is ___ garage next to my house.
mc.why: garage 是子音 g 開頭的單數名詞，前面用 a。
wn: an 只用在母音開頭的字前，garage 是子音開頭。
some 配複數或不可數，garage 是一間（單數）。

mc.q: There are some books ___ the table.
mc.why: 書放在桌面上，用 on the table。
wn: at 指一個地點，放在桌面上要用 on。
of 是…的，不能表示位置。

mc.q: There ___ three restaurants on this street.
mc.why: three restaurants 是三間（複數），用 There are。
wn: is 配一個東西，three restaurants 是複數。
說某處有某物用 There are，不說 There has。

mc.q: There ___ a crosswalk near the school.
mc.why: a crosswalk 是一條斑馬線，單數，否定用 There isn't。
wn: aren't 配複數，a crosswalk 只有一條。
There 句型否定用 be 動詞，不用 doesn't。

mc.q: There ___ a street sign near here.
mc.why: a street sign 是一個路標（單數），否定用 There isn't。
wn: aren't 配複數，a street sign 是單數。
there 句型的否定用 isn't，不用 don't。

mc.q: ___ there a car in front of the house?
mc.why: a car 是一台車，單數，問句用 Is there…?
wn: Are 配複數，a car 只有一台。
There 問句用 be 動詞開頭，不用 Do。

mc.q: There ___ a tree in front of my house.
mc.why: a tree 是一棵樹，單數，用 There is。
wn: are 配複數，a tree 只有一棵。
be 是原形，句子裡要變成 is 或 are。

mc.q: There is ___ water in the glass.
mc.why: There is 是肯定句，water 不可數，肯定句用 some。
wn: any 用在否定或問句，這句是肯定的。
many 接可數複數，water 不可數。

mc.q: Apple is ___ noun.
mc.why: apple 可以數（one apple, two apples），是可數名詞；countable 是子音開頭，用 a。
wn: apple 可以數，不是不可數名詞。
Apple 是單數形，複數才是 apples。

mc.q: We don't need ___ potatoes today.
mc.why: don't 是否定句，否定句接複數名詞用 any：don't need any potatoes。
wn: some 用在肯定句；這句有 don't。
much 接不可數，potatoes 可以數。

mc.q: The bill ___ four hundred dollars.
mc.why: 主詞 The bill 是一張帳單，單數，用 is（金額看成一個總數）。
wn: are 配複數主詞；The bill 是單數。
be 是原形，句子裡要用 is。

mc.q: ___ much is the coffee?
mc.why: 問價錢的固定說法是 How much：How much is the coffee? 咖啡多少錢。
wn: 沒有 What much 的說法，問價錢用 How much。
Who 問人是誰，不能接 much。

mc.q: She would like ___ bottle of water.
mc.why: bottle 可數單數，一瓶水 a bottle of water，前面用 a。
wn: any 用在否定或問句，這句是肯定的。

mc.q: How ___ is this bag?
mc.why: 問價錢固定說 How much is…?：How much is this bag?
wn: How many 問數量，不能問價錢。
How price 不是英文；可說 What is the price?

mc.q: Customer: I would like a ___ of bread, please.
mc.why: 麵包常用 a slice of bread（一片麵包）來數，是點餐、買麵包的常用說法。
wn: a cup of 用在飲料，像 a cup of tea，不用在麵包。

mc.q: It ___ not rainy yesterday.
mc.why: yesterday 是過去；天氣主詞 It 是單數，be 動詞用 was。
wn: were 配複數或 you，It 是單數。
is 是現在式，跟 yesterday 對不上。

mc.q: ___ they visit the museum last weekend?
mc.why: last weekend 是上週末，有動作 visit，問過去用 Did 開頭，visit 用原形。
wn: Do 問平常的習慣；問去過了沒用 Did。
Were 是 be 動詞，後面不能直接接 visit。

mc.q: I ___ to the park yesterday.
mc.why: yesterday 是昨天；go 不規則，過去式是 went。
wn: go 是現在式，跟 yesterday 對不上。
go 不規則，沒有 goed，要用 went。

mc.q: She ___ her old friend in Taipei.
mc.why: 講過去在台北見到老朋友，see 的過去式是 saw。
wn: 主詞 She 現在式也要 sees；這裡用過去式 saw。
sees 是現在式；這裡講過去發生的事。

mc.q: The food ___ good, but it was cheap.
mc.why: good 是形容詞，用 be 動詞；food 當單數，後面也用 it was，所以是 wasn't。
wn: food 是不可數，當單數用，配 wasn't。
didn't 後面要接動作，good 是形容詞。

mc.q: The tickets ___ cheap, so we were happy.
mc.why: 後半句 we were happy 是過去；主詞 tickets 複數，用 were。
wn: tickets 有 s 是複數，用 were。
後面是形容詞 cheap，沒有一般動詞，要用 be 動詞。

mc.q: Last night I ___ a strange dream.
mc.why: Last night 是過去；have a dream 的過去式是 had。
wn: 有 Last night，要用過去式 had。
主詞 I 不用 has，而且這裡要用過去式。

mc.q: He is going to ___ a new job.
mc.why: going to 後面接原形動詞：going to start。
wn: going to 後面要原形，不加 s。
started 是過去式，going to 後面只能接原形。

mc.q: Are you going to ___ your friends tonight?
mc.why: going to 後面接原形動詞：going to meet。
wn: going to 後面要原形，不加 s。
going to 後面不接 V-ing，要原形 meet。

mc.q: Can she drive? No, she ___.
mc.why: 用什麼問就用什麼答：Can 問句，否定回答用 can't。
wn: 問句用 Can，回答也要用 can，不用 doesn't。
問句用 Can，不是 Is，回答要用 can't。

mc.q: ___ you like to join us on Sunday?
mc.why: 邀請別人用 Would you like to…?，Would 放句首。
wn: do 和 would 不能一起用，Would 直接放句首。
Are you like 不成立，are 後面不能直接接動詞 like。

mc.q: How is the ___ today?
mc.why: How is the weather today? 問今天天氣怎樣，天氣拼作 weather。
wn: whether 是是否，發音很像，但不是天氣。
少了 a，天氣要拼成 weather。

mc.q: Would you like to go running ___ me?
mc.why: 跟某人一起做事用 with：go running with me。
wn: to 表示方向或對象，跟某人一起要用 with。
for me 是為了我，不是跟我一起跑步。

mc.q: I am going to call you ___ eight tonight.
mc.why: 幾點鐘前面用 at：at eight。
wn: on 用在星期幾或日期，幾點用 at。
in 用在月份、年份或 in the evening，幾點用 at。

mc.q: She can ___ a car, but she can't ride a bike.
mc.why: can 後面接原形；開車說 drive a car。
wn: can 後面不加 s，主詞 she 也一樣。
can 後面不接 V-ing，要原形 drive。

mc.q: Peter loves ___ new bike.
mc.why: Peter 是男生，他的用 his：his new bike。
wn: her 是她的，Peter 是男生要用 his。
their 是他們的，Peter 只有一個人。

mc.q: I ___ at home last night.
mc.why: last night 是過去；I 的 be 動詞過去式是 was。
wn: were 配 you／we／they，I 用 was。
am 是現在式，last night 是過去。

mc.q: There isn't ___ cheese in the fridge.
mc.why: isn't 是否定句，否定句用 any；cheese 是不可數名詞。
wn: some 用在肯定句，否定句要用 any。

mc.q: We ___ football in the rain last week.
mc.why: last week 是過去；play 加 ed 變 played。
wn: play 是原形，last week 要用過去式 played。
plays 是現在式，而且 We 不加 s。

mc.q: We ___ two maps in the car.
mc.why: 主詞 We 是複數，表示擁有用 have；has 只給 he／she／it。
wn: has 只配 he／she／it 一個人或一件事，We 是複數。
having 前面要有 be 動詞，單獨不能當動詞。

mc.q: We ___ very excited about the trip.
mc.why: excited 是形容詞，前面要 be 動詞；主詞 We 是複數用 are。
wn: is 配一個人或一件事，We 要用 are。
am 只配 I，We 要用 are。

fill.q: Hello, my name ___ Anna.
fill.why: 主詞是 my name，不是 I，所以用 is：My name is Anna.

fill.q: My sister ___ not at school today.
fill.why: 主詞 My sister 是一個人，用 is；否定 is not。

fill.q: We ___ not from this city.
fill.why: 主詞 We 是複數，用 are；否定在 are 後面加 not。

fill.q: ___ he a police officer?
fill.why: 主詞 he 是一個人，問句句首用 Is：Is he a police officer?

fill.q: There ___ ten people here.
fill.why: There is/are 看後面的東西：ten people 是十個人，複數用 are。

fill.q: ___ we in the right room?
fill.why: 主詞 we 是複數，問句句首用 Are：Are we in the right room?

fill.q: The two nurses ___ very kind.
fill.why: The two nurses 有 two 又有 s，是兩位護理師，複數用 are。

fill.q: I ___ a cook.
fill.why: 主詞是 I，用 am：I am a cook.（我是廚師）

fill.q: Leo has a daughter. ___ daughter is two. (he)
fill.why: 括號提示 he，Leo 是男生，所有格用 His：His daughter。

fill.q: This is ___ grandmother. (I)
fill.why: 括號提示 I，「我的」要用所有格 my，後面接名詞 grandmother，不能寫 I 或 me。

fill.q: Is ___ man over there your husband?
fill.why: over there 表示在那邊、比較遠，一個人用 that（那位）。

fill.q: ___ your mother have a phone?
fill.why: 主詞 your mother 是一個人，問句用 Does 開頭，後面 have 用原形。

fill.q: My brothers ___ have long hair.
fill.why: My brothers 是複數，後面 have 是原形，否定用 don't。

fill.q: My brother is funny. ___ jokes are great.
fill.why: My brother 是男生，他的笑話就是 His jokes。

fill.q: We ___ a dog and a cat.
fill.why: 主詞 We 用 have，不用 has；has 只配 he／she／it。

fill.q: Every Sunday my family eats dinner ___.
fill.why: 一家人一起吃晚餐，一起是 together，放在句尾。

fill.q: They ___ get dressed after breakfast.
fill.why: 頻率副詞放在一般動詞 get 前面：They usually get dressed；always、never 等也可以。

fill.q: She ___ her homework after school.
fill.why: She 是一個人，寫功課說 do homework，do 加 es 變 does；也可填 finishes。

fill.q: ___ you watch TV at night?
fill.why: 主詞是 you，問平常的習慣用 Do 開頭：Do you watch TV…?

fill.q: He ___ goes to the gym.
fill.why: often 是常常，頻率副詞放在一般動詞 goes 前面：He often goes to the gym。

fill.q: He ___ (not study) on Saturday nights.
fill.why: He 是一個人，否定用 doesn't，後面 study 用原形，不變 studies。

fill.q: What time ___ your father come home?
fill.why: 主詞 your father 是一個人，What time 問句用 does，後面 come 用原形。

fill.q: Tom ___ (have) breakfast on the train.
fill.why: Tom 是一個人，have 要變成 has；have breakfast 是吃早餐。

fill.q: The shoes are ___ the bed.
fill.why: 鞋子在床的下面，用 under：under the bed。

fill.q: Is there a garden here? No, there ___.
fill.why: 回答是 No，後面要用否定：No, there isn't.

fill.q: Is there a bed here? No, there ___.
fill.why: 回答是 No，後面要用否定：No, there isn't.

fill.q: There is ___ new supermarket here.
fill.why: supermarket 是一間、可數；new 開頭是子音，用 a：a new supermarket。

fill.q: ___ there a police station between the bank and the hotel?
fill.why: a police station 是單數，問句用 Is there…?；bank、hotel 只是位置。

fill.q: The cat is ___ the box.
fill.why: 貓在盒子裡面，用 in：in the box。

fill.q: Is there a bag next to the chair? — Yes, there ___.
fill.why: 問句是 Is there…?，簡答用 Yes, there is.

fill.q: There ___ a garden near here. (否定)
fill.why: a garden 是單數用 is；題目要否定，加 not：isn't（is not）。

fill.q: We need ___ meat for dinner.
fill.why: We need 是肯定句，要一些用 some；meat 肉不可數，不能用 a。

fill.q: Are there ___ mushrooms in the soup?
fill.why: Are there…? 是問句，問有沒有，用 any：any mushrooms。

fill.q: There are three ___ in the bag.
fill.why: three 是三個，後面接可數名詞複數，apple 要加 s 變 apples。

fill.q: How many desserts ___ she want?
fill.why: 主詞 she 是一個人，現在式問句用 does，後面 want 用原形。

fill.q: This shirt is only 100 dollars. It is very ___.
fill.why: only 100 dollars 表示價錢很低，所以是 very cheap 很便宜。

fill.q: I would like ___ order now, please.
fill.why: would like 後面接動作要加 to：would like to order。

fill.q: That's expensive! Do you have a ___ one?
fill.why: 前面說太貴，要找比較便宜的，用比較級 cheaper：a cheaper one。

fill.q: Waiter: Would you like ___ more rice?
fill.why: Would you like…? 是主動提供東西，雖然是問句也用 some：some more rice。

fill.q: The bus ___ full of people yesterday.
fill.why: yesterday 是過去；主詞 the bus 是一台，單數，過去式 be 動詞用 was。

fill.q: She didn't ___ (cook) breakfast today.
fill.why: didn't 已經表示過去，後面動詞用原形 cook，不加 ed。

fill.q: I ___ (go) to the market yesterday.
fill.why: yesterday 是過去；go 是不規則動詞，過去式 went。

fill.q: She ___ (see) her old friend in Taipei last week.
fill.why: last week 是上週，用過去式；see 是不規則動詞，過去式是 saw。

fill.q: Did your brother ___ his room?
fill.why: 問句開頭已經有 Did，後面動詞用原形 clean，不要再加 ed。

fill.q: My mother ___ dinner for us last Saturday.
fill.why: last Saturday 是過去；cook 加 ed 變 cooked，或用 make 的過去式 made。

fill.q: Yesterday she had breakfast. After that, she ___ to work by bus.
fill.why: 前面 Yesterday 說的是昨天，After that 接著說，也用過去式；go 的過去式是 went。

fill.q: We are going to ___ to Japan next year.
fill.why: be going to 後面接原形動詞；去日本可以說 travel、go 或 fly to Japan。

fill.q: ___ he going to help us?
fill.why: be going to 的問句把 be 動詞放句首；he 是一個人，用 Is。

fill.q: My grandmother ___ use a computer.
fill.why: 講奶奶不會用電腦，不會是 can't 或 cannot＋原形 use。

fill.q: My brother is going to ___ a new hobby.
fill.why: be going to 後面接原形；開始一個新嗜好用 start 或 try。

fill.q: It's too hot to play ___.
fill.why: play outside 是在外面玩；outside 當副詞，說明在哪裡玩。

fill.q: Sorry, I ___ go with you today. I am busy.
fill.why: 後面說 I am busy，所以今天不能去；不能是 can't 或 cannot＋原形。

fill.q: ___ is going to be a party on Friday.
fill.why: 講將會有一個派對，用 There is going to be…（將會有）。

fill.q: ___ is going to be my birthday next Friday.
fill.why: 講日期、生日用 It 當主詞：It is going to be my birthday.

fill.q: My uncle ___ three children.
fill.why: 主詞 My uncle 是一個人，擁有用 has。

fill.q: They ___ happy last week.
fill.why: last week 是過去；主詞 They 是複數，用 were。

fill.q: I bought a ___ of water at the station.
fill.why: 水不可數，要用容器來數：a bottle of water（一瓶水）。

fill.q: My friends ___ at the beach last Sunday.
fill.why: last Sunday 是過去；主詞 My friends 是複數，用 were。

fill.q: He ___ to work by MRT every day.
fill.why: every day 是習慣；主詞 He 是一個人，go 加 es 變 goes。

fill.q: I am very ___ of my son.
fill.why: 以某人為榮固定說 proud of。

a: Good morning! I am Li Ming.
translate.why: 早安說 Good morning；我是用 I am。人名 Li Ming 每個字開頭都大寫。
問年紀固定用 How old：How old are you? 不是 How many years。
在幾號房用 in room + 數字：in room seven，room 前面不加 the。
我很…用 I am，中文的很不用翻成 very 也可以。兩個形容詞用 and 連起來：young and happy。
He 是一個人，用 has，不是 have：He has a daughter。
他們的用 Their；阿姨一個人，用 is。
他們的用 Their；hair 不可數，配 is，不是 are。

translate.zh: 我爸爸沒有很多空閒時間。
a: My father doesn't have much free time.
translate.why: My father 一個人，否定用 doesn't have；time 不可數，很多用 much。

a: She usually washes her face in the morning.
translate.why: usually 放在動詞前；She 一個人，wash 字尾 sh 加 es：washes her face。

a: My mother cooks dinner every day.
My mother makes dinner every day.
translate.why: My mother 是一個人，cook 或 make 要加 s；煮晚餐 cook dinner，dinner 前不加 a。

a: She is always busy on Sundays.
She is always busy on Sunday.
She is always very busy on Sundays.
She is always very busy on Sunday.
translate.why: 忙 busy 是形容詞，要配 be 動詞：She is busy；always 放在 is 後面。

a: My father goes to work by car.
translate.why: 開車上班 drive to work，或 go to work by car（by 後不加 a）；My father 是一個人，動詞加 s。

a: My bag is behind the door.
translate.why: 主詞 My bag 用 is；在門後面 behind the door。

translate.zh: 醫院在學校和公園中間。
a: The hospital is between the school and the park.
translate.why: 中間也是 between A and B：between the school and the park，兩邊都加 the。

translate.zh: 請在公車站附近過馬路。
a: Please cross the street near the bus stop.
translate.why: 請求用 Please + 原形動詞開頭；過馬路 cross the street；附近 near the bus stop。

a: There isn't a hospital near my house.
There is no hospital near my house.
translate.why: 沒有一家醫院：There isn't a hospital 或 There is no hospital；附近 near my house。

a: We do not have any tomatoes.
translate.why: 否定句的任何用 any；tomato 的複數要加 es：tomatoes。

a: I don't want any soup, thank you.
translate.why: 否定句用 any：I don't want any soup；湯不可數，不加 a；thank you 前加逗號。

a: There is some rice in the bowl.
translate.why: 飯 rice 不可數，用 There is some rice（is，不加 s）；在碗裡 in the bowl。

translate.zh: 那邊有一些便宜的鞋子。
a: There are some cheap shoes over there.
translate.why: 鞋子是複數 shoes，用 There are some；便宜的 cheap 放 shoes 前；那邊 over there 放句尾。

translate.zh: 我今天早上打掃了房間。
a: I cleaned my room this morning.
translate.why: 打掃了表示過去，clean 加 ed：cleaned；我的房間是 my room。

translate.zh: 我們上週末坐公車去海邊。
a: We went to the beach by bus last weekend.
We took the bus to the beach last weekend.
Last weekend, we went to the beach by bus.
Last weekend we went to the beach by bus.
Last weekend, we took the bus to the beach.
Last weekend we took the bus to the beach.
translate.why: 上週末是過去，go 的過去式是 went；搭公車用 by bus，bus 前面不加 the。

translate.zh: 我們上週末在公園野餐。
a: We had a picnic in the park last weekend.
Last weekend, we had a picnic in the park.
Last weekend we had a picnic in the park.
We had a picnic at the park last weekend.
translate.why: 上週末是過去；野餐說 have a picnic，過去式是 had；在公園 in the park。

a: I am going to study English tomorrow.
I'm going to study English tomorrow.
translate.why: 明天的計畫用 am going to 加原形 study；念英文是 study English，tomorrow 放句尾。
請別人幫忙用 Can you 加原形 help；幫的對象是受詞，用 me，不用 I。
問會不會，把 Can 放句首，後面接 you 和原形 swim：Can you swim?

translate.zh: 我們可以改到星期天嗎？
a: Can we change it to Sunday?
Can we meet on Sunday instead?
translate.why: 徵求同意用 Can we…?；改到星期天是 change it to Sunday。

a: There is a book on the table.
translate.why: 一本書用 There is a book；在桌上 on the table。

translate.zh: 我們下週要買一張新桌子。
a: We are going to buy a new table next week.
translate.why: 下週的計畫用 are going to buy；一張新桌子 a new table，next week 放句尾。

a: I was at home last night.
translate.why: 昨天晚上是過去，I 的 be 動詞過去式用 was；在家 at home，last night 前不加 in。

error.s: I is fine, thank you.
error.why: 主詞 I 要用 am。
error.full: I am fine, thank you.

error.s: We is at the office.
error.why: 主詞 we 要用 are。
error.full: We are at the office.

error.s: It are a nice day.
error.why: 主詞 it 要搭配 is
error.full: It is a nice day.

error.s: My uncle have three children.
error.why: 單數主詞用 has
error.full: My uncle has three children.

error.s: Do your brother have curly hair?
error.why: 第三人稱單數疑問句要用 Does
error.full: Does your brother have curly hair?

error.s: My grandmother don't live with us.
error.why: 第三人稱單數否定用 doesn't
error.full: My grandmother doesn't live with us.

error.s: My mother don't cook dinner on Friday.
error.why: 第三人稱單數否定要用 doesn't
error.full: My mother doesn't cook dinner on Friday.

error.s: We doesn't go to school on Sunday.
error.why: 主詞 we 要用 don't
error.full: We don't go to school on Sunday.

error.s: There is a lamp in the wall.
error.why: 「在牆上」要用 on the wall。
error.full: There is a lamp on the wall.

error.s: Is there any taxis near here?
error.why: 複數疑問句用 Are there
error.full: Are there any taxis near here?

error.s: The library is in front the station.
error.correct: The library is in front of the station.
error.why: in front 後面要加 of

error.s: I don't want some onions in my salad.
error.why: 否定句用 any
error.full: I don't want any onions in my salad.

error.s: Are there some eggs in the fridge?
error.why: 疑問句用 any。
error.full: Are there any eggs in the fridge?

error.s: My parents was at the market.
error.why: parents 是複數，要用 were。
error.full: My parents were at the market.

error.s: They gots home at midnight.
error.why: 過去式動詞不隨主詞加 s。
error.full: They got home at midnight.

error.s: The story were very interesting.
error.why: the story 是單數，用 was
error.full: The story was very interesting.

error.s: He no can come tonight.
error.correct: He can't come tonight.
error.why: 否定要用 can't。

error.s: My sister cans cook.
error.why: can 沒有第三人稱單數的 s。
error.full: My sister can cook.

error.s: He go to work by bus.
error.why: 第三人稱單數動詞要加 -s
error.full: He goes to work by bus.

error.s: How many time do you have?
error.why: time 是不可數名詞，用 how much
error.full: How much time do you have?

reorder.a: Good morning! I am Li Ming.
reorder.why: 早安說 Good morning；我是用 I am。人名 Li Ming 每個字開頭都大寫。

reorder.a: How old are you?
reorder.why: 問年紀固定用 How old：How old are you? 不是 How many years。

reorder.a: I am in room seven.
reorder.why: 在幾號房用 in room + 數字：in room seven，room 前面不加 the。

reorder.a: I am young and happy.
reorder.why: 我很…用 I am，中文的很不用翻成 very 也可以。兩個形容詞用 and 連起來：young and happy。

reorder.a: He has a daughter.
reorder.why: He 是一個人，用 has，不是 have：He has a daughter。

reorder.a: Their aunt is busy.
reorder.why: 他們的用 Their；阿姨一個人，用 is。

reorder.a: Their hair is black.
reorder.why: 他們的用 Their；hair 不可數，配 is，不是 are。

reorder.a: My father doesn't have much free time.
reorder.why: My father 一個人，否定用 doesn't have；time 不可數，很多用 much。

reorder.a: She usually washes her face in the morning.
reorder.why: usually 放在動詞前；She 一個人，wash 字尾 sh 加 es：washes her face。

reorder.a: My mother cooks dinner every day.
reorder.why: My mother 是一個人，cook 或 make 要加 s；煮晚餐 cook dinner，dinner 前不加 a。

reorder.a: She is always busy on Sundays.
reorder.why: 忙 busy 是形容詞，要配 be 動詞：She is busy；always 放在 is 後面。

reorder.a: My father goes to work by car.
reorder.why: 開車上班 drive to work，或 go to work by car（by 後不加 a）；My father 是一個人，動詞加 s。

reorder.a: My bag is behind the door.
reorder.why: 主詞 My bag 用 is；在門後面 behind the door。

reorder.a: The hospital is between the school and the park.
reorder.why: 中間也是 between A and B：between the school and the park，兩邊都加 the。

reorder.a: Please cross the street near the bus stop.
reorder.why: 請求用 Please + 原形動詞開頭；過馬路 cross the street；附近 near the bus stop。

reading.title: 短文 1
reading.text: Hi! My name is Mia. I am a new student. Today is my first day at school. I say, 'Good morning!' to my teacher. She is very kind. Then I meet a boy. His name is Tom. He says, 'Hi, nice to meet you.' I say, 'Nice to meet you too.' We are not shy now. At the end of the day, we say, 'Goodbye! See you tomorrow.' I am happy today, and I am not tired at all.

qs.q: Is Mia a new student?
qs.why: 原文：I am a new student. Mia 自己說她是新學生，所以回答 Yes, she is.
wn: 原文說 I am a new student，她是新學生。
老師是另一個人，Mia 是學生；而且 Is 開頭的問句要用 Yes／No 回答。

qs.q: How is Mia's teacher?
qs.why: 原文：She is very kind. 這裡的 She 指前一句的 my teacher，老師很親切。
wn: 文中沒說老師很忙，只說 She is very kind。
文中沒說老師累；最後的 not tired 是在說 Mia 自己。

qs.q: What is the boy's name?
qs.why: 原文：Then I meet a boy. His name is Tom. 男孩的名字是 Tom。
wn: 文中沒有 Anna 這個人，男孩叫 Tom。
文中沒有 Mr. Lee；而且 Mr. 是稱呼大人，不是男孩。

qs.q: What do they say at the end of the day?
qs.why: 原文：At the end of the day, we say, 'Goodbye! See you tomorrow.' 一天結束時說再見。
wn: Good morning 是早上對老師說的，不是放學時。
文中放學時說的是 Goodbye，沒有 Thank you。

qs.q: How does Mia feel today?
qs.why: 原文：I am happy today, and I am not tired at all. Mia 今天很開心。
wn: 原文說 I am happy today，她很開心，不是難過。
原文說 I am not tired at all，not…at all 是一點也不累。

reading.title: 短文 2
reading.text: Sara is a wife and a mother. Her husband's name is Dan. They have one son and one daughter. Sara has a big family. She has three brothers and two sisters. Her brothers have children too. So Sara has many nephews and nieces. Her nieces are Ann and Joy. Her nephew is Max. Every summer, all the relatives come to her grandmother's house. Her grandmother is ninety years old. She is happy to see her family. They take a big photo every year.

qs.q: What is Sara's husband's name?
qs.why: 原文：Her husband's name is Dan. Sara 的先生叫 Dan。
wn: Max 是她的姪子：Her nephew is Max。
Ann 是她的姪女之一：Her nieces are Ann and Joy。

qs.q: How many brothers does Sara have?
qs.why: 原文：She has three brothers and two sisters. Sara 有三個兄弟。
wn: two 是姊妹的數目 two sisters，兄弟是 three。
one 是兒子或女兒的數目，兄弟是 three。

qs.q: Who is Max?
qs.why: 原文：Her nephew is Max. nephew 是兄弟姊妹的兒子（姪子／外甥）。
wn: 文中有 one son 但沒寫名字；Max 是 nephew，不是兒子。
uncle 是叔伯舅舅；原文說 Max 是 her nephew。

qs.q: Whose house do the relatives visit?
qs.why: 原文：all the relatives come to her grandmother's house. 親戚都到奶奶家。
wn: 原文說去 her grandmother's house，不是 Sara 自己家。
文中沒說去哥哥家，是 grandmother's house。

qs.q: How old is her grandmother?
qs.why: 原文：Her grandmother is ninety years old. 奶奶九十歲。

reading.title: 短文 3
reading.text: Ben is a student. He usually gets up late. He often has no time for breakfast. He rides his bike to school because the bus is slow. Ben always sits near the window in class. He sometimes talks with his friend Tom, but the teacher does not like that. After school, Ben often plays basketball for one hour. He never plays computer games before dinner. His mother always cooks rice and vegetables. Ben usually does his homework at eight. He is sometimes tired, so he goes to bed early.

qs.q: How does Ben go to school?
qs.why: 原文：He rides his bike to school. ride a bike 是騎腳踏車。
wn: 文中沒說坐車；他是 rides his bike。
原文說 the bus is slow，所以他不搭公車。

qs.q: Why does Ben not take the bus?
qs.why: 原文：because the bus is slow. because 後面就是原因。
wn: 文中沒說公車很擠；原因是 the bus is slow。
文中沒說公車很貴；原因是 the bus is slow。

qs.q: What does Ben often do after school?
qs.why: 原文：After school, Ben often plays basketball. 放學後常打籃球。
wn: 文中沒說 Ben 看書；他放學後打籃球。
晚餐前他 never plays computer games。

qs.q: What does Ben's mother always cook?
qs.why: 原文：His mother always cooks rice and vegetables. 媽媽都煮飯和青菜。
wn: 文中沒有麵包和蛋；媽媽煮 rice and vegetables。
文中沒有麵和魚；媽媽煮 rice and vegetables。

qs.q: When does Ben usually do his homework?
qs.why: 原文：Ben usually does his homework at eight. Ben 通常八點寫功課。
wn: 文中沒有十點；寫功課是 at eight。
文中沒有六點；寫功課是 at eight。

reading.title: 短文 4
reading.text: My neighborhood is not big, but it is nice. There is a park near my house. There are two markets on my street. One market is next to my school. The school is between the park and the library. The library is in front of the station, so it is easy to find. There aren't any movie theaters in my neighborhood. There isn't a big hospital here, but there is a small clinic behind the post office. My neighborhood is quiet at night. I like it very much.

qs.q: How many markets are on the street?
qs.why: 原文：There are two markets on my street. 這條街上有兩個市場。
wn: 原文是 two markets；One market 只是在講其中一個。
原文是 two markets 兩個，不是四個。

qs.q: Where is the school?
opts: Between the park and the library
qs.why: 原文：The school is between the park and the library. 學校在公園和圖書館中間。
wn: 車站前面是圖書館，文中沒說學校在車站後面。

qs.q: Where is the library?
qs.why: 原文：The library is in front of the station. 圖書館在車站前面。
wn: 市場旁邊的是學校（One market is next to my school）。
文中沒說圖書館在公園後面，公園和圖書館中間隔著學校。

qs.q: Are there any movie theaters?
qs.why: 原文：There aren't any movie theaters in my neighborhood. 社區裡沒有電影院。
wn: 原文說 There aren't any，一間都沒有；two 是市場的數量。
原文說 aren't any，連一間都沒有。

qs.q: Where is the small clinic?
qs.why: 原文：there is a small clinic behind the post office. 小診所在郵局後面。
wn: 文中沒說診所在公園裡，原文是 behind the post office。
學校旁邊的是市場，不是診所。

reading.title: 短文 5
reading.text: Last weekend I stayed at home. On Saturday morning I cleaned my room and washed my clothes. Then I cooked lunch for my family. In the afternoon I studied English for two hours. I also watched a movie on my computer. On Sunday I visited my grandmother. We talked for a long time, and she showed me some old photos. Later we walked in the park near her house. I returned home at six o'clock. I did not work last weekend, so I relaxed a lot.

qs.q: What did the writer do on Saturday morning?
opts: Cleaned the room and washed clothes.
qs.why: 原文：On Saturday morning I cleaned my room and washed my clothes. 星期六早上打掃房間、洗衣服。
wn: 作者週末待在家，星期日去的是奶奶家，不是朋友。
文中說 I did not work last weekend，週末沒上班。

qs.q: How long did the writer study English?
qs.why: 原文：In the afternoon I studied English for two hours. 讀了兩小時英文。
wn: six 是回家的時間六點，讀英文是 two hours。
文中是 two hours，不是十分鐘。

qs.q: Who did the writer visit on Sunday?
qs.why: 原文：On Sunday I visited my grandmother. 星期日去看奶奶。
wn: English 是星期六讀的科目，星期日看的是 grandmother。
文中沒有提到同學，星期日看的是 grandmother。

qs.q: What did the grandmother show?
qs.why: 原文：she showed me some old photos. 奶奶給作者看一些舊照片。
wn: 文中是 old photos 舊照片，不是新手機。
old 是在說照片 old photos，沒有提到腳踏車。

qs.q: What time did the writer return home?
qs.why: 原文：I returned home at six o'clock. 作者六點回到家。
wn: 文中是 six o'clock 六點，不是九點。
文中是 six o'clock，不是中午。

reading.title: 短文 6
reading.text: This weekend, the weather is going to be nice. Saturday is going to be sunny and warm, so we are going to go to the beach. We are going to swim in the pool and have a picnic in the park. Sunday is going to be different. The forecast says it is going to be cold and rainy. We are going to stay indoors and watch movies. I need to bring my jacket and umbrella. I am excited about our weekend plans!

qs.q: What is the weather going to be like on Saturday?
qs.why: 原文：Saturday is going to be sunny and warm. 星期六晴朗溫暖。
wn: 又冷又下雨是星期天的天氣，不是星期六。
文中沒提到下雪，星期六是晴天。

qs.q: Where are they going to go on Saturday?
qs.why: 原文：Saturday is going to be sunny... so we are going to go to the beach. 去海邊。
wn: 文中沒提到山上，星期六是去海邊。
這是週末計畫，文中沒提到學校。

qs.q: What are they going to do in the park?
qs.why: 原文：We are going to... have a picnic in the park. 他們要在公園野餐。
wn: 文中沒提到購物，公園裡是野餐。
文中沒提到籃球，公園裡是野餐。

qs.q: What is the weather going to be like on Sunday?
qs.why: 原文：The forecast says it is going to be cold and rainy. 星期天又冷又下雨。
wn: 晴天是星期六，星期天會又冷又下雨。
文中沒提到颳風，星期天是 cold and rainy。

qs.q: What are they going to bring?
qs.why: 原文：I need to bring my jacket and umbrella. 要帶外套和雨傘，因為星期天會冷又下雨。
wn: 文中沒提到相機和地圖，要帶外套和雨傘。
文中沒提到樂器，要帶外套和雨傘。

writing.prompt: 請用今天學到的問候語和 be 動詞，寫 3-5 句英文，介紹你如何跟新朋友打招呼與道別。
writing.sample: Hello! My name is Ken. I am a new student. Nice to meet you. I am happy today. See you tomorrow.

writing.prompt: 用 3-5 句英文描述你爸爸或媽媽的外表（身高、頭髮、眼睛、眼鏡）。
writing.sample: This is my mother. She is short. She has short black hair and brown eyes. She wears glasses at work. I look like her.

writing.sample: Would you like some tea? Yes, I would like a cup of tea. Do you have any milk? No, we don't have any milk today. I would like some juice, please.

writing.prompt: 用 3 到 5 句英文介紹你的家人會做什麼。請使用 can 和 can't。
writing.sample: My father can drive a bus. My mother can't drive, but she can ride a bike. My sister can play the guitar very well. She can't swim. I am going to teach her this summer.

reading.title: Mia 的星期六
reading.text: It is Saturday afternoon. Mia is in the living room. It is snowing outside. She is making coffee now. She usually cooks soup on Saturdays, but today she isn't cooking soup. Her mother is with her. The mother is reading a book. They are happy because they are not busy today.

qs.q: What is Mia doing now?
qs.why: 原文：She is making coffee now. now 表示現在正在做的事，Mia 正在煮咖啡。
wn: 文中沒提到信；在看書的是媽媽，而且是 a book。
文中沒有人在寫故事，Mia 正在 making coffee。
文中沒提到音樂，Mia 現在在煮咖啡。

qs.q: Where is Mia?
qs.why: 原文：Mia is in the living room. living room 是客廳，她在客廳。
wn: bedroom 是臥室，原文說的是 living room 客廳。
今天星期六下午，她在家裡的客廳，不在學校。
雖然她在煮咖啡，但原文說她在 living room，不是廚房。

qs.q: What does Mia usually do on Saturdays?
qs.why: 原文：She usually cooks soup on Saturdays. usually 是平常的習慣，她平常星期六煮湯。
wn: 文中沒提到玩遊戲，她平常是 cooks soup。
咖啡是她今天正在煮的（making coffee），不是平常的習慣。
文中沒提到收音機，平常的習慣是 cooks soup。

qs.q: What is Mia's mother doing?
qs.why: 原文：The mother is reading a book. 媽媽正在看書。
wn: 媽媽是在讀（reading），不是寫；也沒有報告。
媽媽在 reading a book 看書，不是寫訊息。
媽媽是在看書，不是寫故事；read 是讀，write 是寫。

qs.q: How is the weather?
qs.why: 原文：It is snowing outside. 外面正在下雪，天氣就是 snowy。
wn: windy 是颳風，文中說的是 snowing 下雪。
sunny 是晴天，文中沒說出太陽，說的是下雪。
rainy 是下雨，原文是 snowing 下雪，不是 raining。

reading.title: Ken 的星期六
reading.text: It is Saturday afternoon. Ken is in the living room. It is snowing outside. He is playing the guitar now. He usually eats lunch on Saturdays, but today he isn't eating lunch. His sister is with him. The sister is drinking water. They are happy because they are not busy today.

qs.q: What is Ken doing now?
qs.why: 原文：He is playing the guitar now. Ken 現在正在彈吉他。
wn: 文中沒有咖啡；在喝東西的是 sister，喝的是水。
文中沒有人寫訊息，Ken 正在彈吉他。
文中沒提到 email，Ken 現在是 playing the guitar。

qs.q: Where is Ken?
qs.why: 原文：Ken is in the living room. Ken 在客廳。
wn: 外面在下雪，Ken 在客廳裡，不在公園。
kitchen 是廚房，原文說他在 living room 客廳。
café 是咖啡店，原文說他在 living room。

qs.q: What does Ken usually do on Saturdays?
qs.why: 原文：He usually eats lunch on Saturdays. 平常星期六他會吃午餐，今天沒有。
wn: breakfast 是早餐，原文說的是 lunch 午餐。
文中沒有咖啡；他平常是 eats lunch。
文中沒提到數學，平常的習慣是吃午餐。

qs.q: What is Ken's sister doing?
qs.why: 原文：The sister is drinking water. 他的姊妹正在喝水。
wn: 文中沒有人在讀數學，sister 在喝水。
文中沒提到電影，sister 正在 drinking water。
sister 在喝水，不是寫訊息。

qs.q: How is the weather?
qs.why: 原文：It is snowing outside. snowing 是正在下雪，所以天氣是 snowy。
wn: rainy 是下雨天，原文說 snowing，是下雪。
文中沒說颳風（windy），只說在下雪。
文中沒有 The sun is shining，是下雪天，不是晴天。

reading.title: Lisa 的星期六
reading.text: It is Saturday afternoon. Lisa is in the bedroom. The sun is shining. She is studying English now. She usually reads a letter on Saturdays, but today she isn't reading a letter. Her sister is with her. The sister is cooking lunch. They are happy because they are not busy today.

qs.q: What is Lisa doing now?
qs.why: 原文：She is studying English now. Lisa 現在正在念英文。
wn: 文中沒提到新聞，Lisa 現在在 studying English。
文中沒有報告，她正在念英文。
文中沒提到早餐，而且現在是下午；她在念英文。

qs.q: Where is Lisa?
qs.why: 原文：Lisa is in the bedroom. bedroom 是臥室，她在臥室。
wn: 原文說 in the bedroom，她在家裡臥室，不在公園。
kitchen 是廚房，原文說 Lisa 在 bedroom 臥室。
今天星期六，她在臥室念英文，不在學校。

qs.q: What does Lisa usually do on Saturdays?
qs.why: 原文：She usually reads a letter on Saturdays. usually 是平常，她平常星期六讀信。
wn: 文中沒有晚餐；煮東西的是 sister，煮的是 lunch。
文中沒提到早餐，她平常是 reads a letter。
文中沒提到收音機，平常的習慣是讀信。

qs.q: What is Lisa's sister doing?
qs.why: 原文：The sister is cooking lunch. 她的姊妹正在煮午餐。
wn: 原文是 cooking 煮，不是 eating 吃。
文中沒提到收音機，sister 在煮午餐。
文中沒有咖啡，sister 正在 cooking lunch。

qs.q: How is the weather?
qs.why: 原文：The sun is shining. 太陽正在照耀，就是晴天 sunny。
wn: 文中沒說下雪，說的是 The sun is shining 出太陽。
有太陽在照，不是下雨天。
文中沒提到風，只說出太陽，是 sunny。

reading.title: Ben 的星期六
reading.text: It is Saturday afternoon. Ben is in the kitchen. The sun is shining. He is writing a message now. He usually watches TV on Saturdays, but today he isn't watching TV. His sister is with him. The sister is playing a game. They are happy because they are not busy today.

qs.q: What is Ben doing now?
qs.why: 原文：He is writing a message now. Ben 現在正在寫訊息。
wn: 文中沒提到看比賽，他正在寫訊息。
文中沒有人拍影片，Ben 在 writing a message。
Ben 是在寫（writing），不是讀；也不是信，是訊息。

qs.q: Where is Ben?
qs.why: 原文：Ben is in the kitchen. kitchen 是廚房，他在廚房。
wn: 原文說 in the kitchen，他在廚房，不在公園。
bedroom 是臥室，原文是 kitchen 廚房。
今天星期六，他在廚房，不在學校。

qs.q: What does Ben usually do on Saturdays?
qs.why: 原文：He usually watches TV on Saturdays. 他平常星期六看電視，今天沒看。
wn: 文中沒提到書，他平常是 watches TV。
文中沒提到喝水，平常的習慣是看電視。
他在廚房，但文中沒說他煮晚餐；平常是看電視。

qs.q: What is Ben's sister doing?
qs.why: 原文：The sister is playing a game. 他的姊妹正在玩遊戲。
wn: 文中沒提到電影，sister 在 playing a game。
文中沒有人在讀數學，sister 在玩遊戲。
文中沒有影片，sister 正在玩遊戲。

qs.q: How is the weather?
qs.why: 原文：The sun is shining. 出太陽了，天氣是 sunny 晴天。
wn: 文中沒說 snowing 下雪，是出太陽。
原文說 The sun is shining，不是下雨。
文中沒提到颳風，只說太陽在照。

mc.q: You ___ washing the dishes now.
mc.why: You 配 are；後面是 washing，進行式否定用 aren't。
mc.zh: 你現在沒有在洗碗。
wn: isn't 配他／她／它，You 要用 are。
doesn't 是現在簡單式，也不配 You。
don't 後面接原形，這裡是 washing，要用 aren't。

mc.q: He ___ writing a message at the moment.
mc.gp: 簡單式 vs 進行式
mc.why: He 是一個人，at the moment 正在做，用 is＋-ing。
mc.zh: 他目前在寫訊息。
wn: 原形 be 不能直接用，要變成 is。
are 配複數或 you，He 是一個人。

mc.gp: 簡單式 vs 進行式
mc.why: on Sundays 是每週日的習慣，用現在簡單式；Ken and Lisa 是複數，用原形 cook。
mc.zh: Ken 和 Lisa 每個星期日煮晚餐。
wn: 前面沒有 be 動詞，-ing 不能單獨當動詞。
on Sundays 是習慣，不用進行式；is 也不配兩個人。
加 s 只給一個人，Ken and Lisa 是兩個人。

mc.why: 主詞 You 一律配 are，後面接 listening：You are listening。

wn: be 是原形，句子裡要變成 are。
is 配他／她／它，You 用 are。

wn: 原形 be 不能直接用，要變成 are。
is 配 he／she／it，You 要用 are。

reading.title: Mia 的星期六
reading.text: It is Saturday afternoon. Mia is in the living room. The sun is shining. She is cooking soup now. She usually eats breakfast on Saturdays, but today she isn't eating breakfast. Her brother is with her. The brother is making coffee. They are happy because they are not busy today.

qs.q: What is Mia doing now?
qs.why: 原文：She is cooking soup now. Mia 現在正在煮湯。
wn: 文中沒有人玩遊戲，她在 cooking soup。
文中沒提到數學，她正在煮湯。
她是在煮東西沒錯，但原文說煮的是 soup 湯，沒說午餐。

qs.q: Where is Mia?
qs.why: 原文：Mia is in the living room. 雖然她在煮湯，原文寫的是她在客廳。
wn: 原文說 in the living room，她在客廳，不在公園。
今天星期六，她在客廳，不在學校。
煮湯容易想到廚房，但原文寫的是 living room 客廳。

qs.q: What does Mia usually do on Saturdays?
qs.why: 原文：She usually eats breakfast on Saturdays. 她平常星期六吃早餐，今天沒吃。
wn: 文中沒提到電影，她平常是 eats breakfast。
文中沒有影片，平常的習慣是吃早餐。
煮咖啡的是她的 brother，而且是現在，不是 Mia 的習慣。

qs.q: What is Mia's brother doing?
qs.why: 原文：The brother is making coffee. 她的兄弟正在煮咖啡。
wn: 吃早餐是 Mia 平常的習慣，不是 brother 現在做的事。
文中沒提到比賽，brother 在 making coffee。
文中沒有人念英文，brother 在煮咖啡。

qs.q: How is the weather?
qs.why: 原文：The sun is shining. 太陽在照，天氣是 sunny 晴天。
wn: 文中沒說颳風，說的是出太陽。
文中沒有 snowing，是出太陽的晴天。
原文說 The sun is shining，不是下雨。

reading.text: It is Saturday afternoon. Ken is at the café. It is raining outside. He is playing a game now. He usually cooks soup on Saturdays, but today he isn't cooking soup. His sister is with him. The sister is drinking coffee. They are happy because they are not busy today.

qs.q: What is Ken doing now?
qs.why: 原文：He is playing a game now. Ken 現在正在玩遊戲。
wn: 文中沒有蛋糕，他在 playing a game。
文中沒提到電視，他正在玩遊戲。
文中沒有影片，Ken 在玩遊戲。

qs.q: Where is Ken?
qs.why: 原文：Ken is at the café. 他在咖啡店。
wn: 外面在下雨，他在咖啡店裡，不在公園。
bedroom 是臥室，原文說 at the café。
living room 是家裡的客廳，原文說他在 café。

qs.q: What does Ken usually do on Saturdays?
qs.why: 原文：He usually cooks soup on Saturdays. 他平常星期六煮湯，今天沒煮。
wn: 文中沒提到新聞，他平常是 cooks soup。
文中沒提到電影，平常的習慣是煮湯。
文中沒提到比賽，他平常是煮湯。

qs.q: What is Ken's sister doing?
qs.why: 原文：The sister is drinking coffee. 他的姊妹正在喝咖啡。
wn: 玩遊戲的是 Ken，不是 sister。
有咖啡沒錯，但 sister 是 drinking 喝，不是 making 煮。
文中沒提到電視，sister 在喝咖啡。

qs.q: How is the weather?
qs.why: 原文：It is raining outside. 外面在下雨，天氣是 rainy。
wn: 正在下雨，文中沒說出太陽。
原文是 raining，不是 snowing 下雪。
文中沒說颳風，說的是下雨。

reading.text: It is Saturday afternoon. Lisa is at the café. It is snowing outside. She is playing a game now. She usually eats lunch on Saturdays, but today she isn't eating lunch. Her father is with her. The father is cooking lunch. They are happy because they are not busy today.

qs.q: What is Lisa doing now?

wn: 文中沒提到訊息，她在 playing a game。
文中沒有晚餐；在煮東西的是爸爸，煮的是 lunch。
文中沒提到信，她正在玩遊戲。

qs.q: Where is Lisa?
qs.why: 原文：Lisa is at the café. 她在咖啡店。
wn: 今天星期六，她在 café，不在學校。
bedroom 是臥室，原文說 at the café。
外面在下雪，她在咖啡店裡，不在公園。

qs.q: What does Lisa usually do on Saturdays?
qs.why: 原文：She usually eats lunch on Saturdays. 她平常星期六吃午餐，今天沒吃。
wn: 文中沒有蛋糕，她平常是 eats lunch。
文中沒有晚餐，平常的習慣是吃午餐。
文中沒提到書，她平常是吃午餐。

qs.q: What is Lisa's father doing?
qs.why: 原文：The father is cooking lunch. 爸爸正在煮午餐。
wn: 文中沒提到 email，爸爸在 cooking lunch。
文中沒提到信，爸爸在煮午餐。
文中沒提到音樂，爸爸正在煮午餐。

qs.q: How is the weather?
qs.why: 原文：It is snowing outside. 外面在下雪，天氣是 snowy。
wn: 文中沒說出太陽，是在下雪。
文中沒提到颳風，說的是 snowing。
原文是 snowing 下雪，不是 raining 下雨。

reading.title: Ben 的星期六
reading.text: It is Saturday afternoon. Ben is in the kitchen. The sun is shining. He is writing a story now. He usually makes coffee on Saturdays, but today he isn't making coffee. His mother is with him. The mother is listening to music. They are happy because they are not busy today.

qs.q: What is Ben doing now?
qs.why: 原文：He is writing a story now. Ben 現在正在寫故事。
wn: 文中沒有人玩遊戲，他在 writing a story。
原文是 writing 寫，不是 reading 讀；寫的是故事。
他是在寫沒錯，但寫的是 a story 故事，不是報告。

qs.q: Where is Ben?
qs.why: 原文：Ben is in the kitchen. 他在廚房。
wn: living room 是客廳，原文說 in the kitchen。
bedroom 是臥室，原文說的是廚房。
café 是咖啡店，原文說他在 kitchen 廚房。

qs.q: What does Ben usually do on Saturdays?
qs.why: 原文：He usually makes coffee on Saturdays. 他平常星期六煮咖啡，今天沒煮。
wn: 文中沒提到收音機；在聽東西的是媽媽，聽的是音樂。
他在廚房，但文中沒說煮午餐；平常是 makes coffee。
文中沒提到早餐，平常的習慣是煮咖啡。

qs.q: What is Ben's mother doing?
qs.why: 原文：The mother is listening to music. 媽媽正在聽音樂。
wn: 文中沒有人玩遊戲，媽媽在 listening to music。
文中沒提到水，媽媽在聽音樂。
文中沒提到書，媽媽正在聽音樂。

qs.q: How is the weather?
qs.why: 原文：The sun is shining. 太陽在照，天氣是 sunny。
wn: 文中沒說颳風，說的是出太陽。
原文說 The sun is shining，不是下雨。

qs.why: 原文：He usually drinks water on Saturdays. 他平常星期六喝水，今天沒喝。
wn: 煮晚餐的是 sister，而且是現在，不是 Ben 的習慣。
文中沒有蛋糕，他平常是 drinks water。
文中沒提到信，平常的習慣是喝水。

qs.q: What is Ben's sister doing?
qs.why: 原文：The sister is cooking dinner. 他的姊妹正在煮晚餐。
wn: 文中沒提到電影，sister 在 cooking dinner。
喝水是 Ben 平常的習慣，不是 sister 現在做的事。
文中沒提到茶，sister 正在煮晚餐。

qs.q: How is the weather?
qs.why: 原文：The sun is shining. 太陽在照，天氣是 sunny。
wn: 文中沒有 snowing，是出太陽。
文中沒說颳風，說的是出太陽。
原文說 The sun is shining，不是下雨。

writing.prompt: 寫一段 6 句以上的短文：週末下午的現在情境，包含肯定、否定、問句和一句習慣（簡單式）。
writing.sample: It's Sunday afternoon. I'm sitting in a café. I'm not working today. My friend is drinking tea. Is it raining? No, the sun is shining. I usually come here on Sundays.

writing.prompt: 寫 3 句：現在窗外的情形（天氣、路上的人）。
writing.sample: It's raining now. A man is walking with an umbrella. Two children are running to school.

writing.prompt: 寫 3 句：你的朋友現在可能正在做什麼。
writing.sample: Amy is probably working now. Ken is studying. Lisa is cooking lunch.

writing.prompt: 寫一則傳給朋友的簡訊，說你現在在做什麼、不能接電話的原因。
writing.sample: Sorry, I can't talk now. I'm driving to work. I'm calling you back later.

items.q: Where ___ you from?
items.why: Where … from? 問來自哪裡；主詞 you 配 are。
wn: you 只配 are，不配 is。
am 只配 I，回答時才說 I am from…。

items.q: ___ two banks near the station.
items.why: 說某處有什麼用 There is／are；two banks 是兩間（複數），用 There are。
wn: two banks 是複數，要用 There are。
They are 指已經講過的人或東西，說某處有什麼要用 There are。

items.q: My grandmother ___ in a small village when she was young.
items.why: when she was young（她年輕時）是過去的事，live 加 d 變過去式 lived。
wn: lives 是現在，when she was young 是過去。
這是以前的事，要改成過去式 lived。

items.q: That is my sister. ___ name is Mei-ling.
items.why: my sister 是女生，name 是名詞，前面用女生的所有格 Her。
wn: His 是男生的，sister 是女生。
She 是主詞，名詞 name 前面要用所有格 Her。

items.q: There is ___ rice in the bowl.
items.why: rice 是不可數名詞，前面用 some 表示一些。
wn: rice 不可數，不能說 a rice。
many 配可數複數（many eggs），rice 不可數。

items.q: My father ___ coffee every morning.
items.why: every morning 是習慣，My father 是一個人，drink 加 s。
wn: My father 是一個人，drink 要加 s。
is 和 drink 不能一起用，句子只要一個動詞。

items.q: Ken ___ to the gym on Sundays.
items.why: on Sundays 是習慣，用現在簡單式；Ken 一個人，go 要加 es：goes。
wn: Ken 是一個人，現在簡單式的 go 要加 es。
-ing 前面要有 be 動詞，而且 on Sundays 是習慣。

items.q: ___ you like to come to dinner on Friday?
items.why: 邀請別人來吃晚餐，禮貌說法是 Would you like to…?
wn: Do you like to…? 是問平常喜不喜歡，不是邀請。
like 是動詞，前面不用 be 動詞。

items.q: She ___ eat meat.
items.why: eat 是一般動詞，否定用 doesn't／don't；She 一個人，用 doesn't＋原形 eat。
wn: She 是一個人，要用 doesn't。
eat 是一般動詞，否定要用 doesn't，不用 isn't。

items.q: ___ you watch the game last night?
items.why: last night 是過去，watch 是一般動詞，過去式問句用 Did＋原形 watch。
wn: last night 是過去，要用 Did。
watch 是一般動詞，過去問句用 Did，不用 Were。

items.q: I don't have ___ money with me.
items.why: don't have 是否定句，否定句說「一些都沒有」用 any；money 不可數。
wn: some 多用在肯定句，否定句要用 any。
money 不可數，不能說 a money。

items.q: We ___ visit our uncle next month.
items.why: next month 是已計畫的未來，用 be going to＋原形 visit；We 配 are。
wn: are going 後面還少了 to，才能接原形 visit。
going to 前面要有 be 動詞，We 用 are。

items.q: My brother and I ___ tired today.
items.why: My brother and I 是兩個人，等於 we，be 動詞用 are。
wn: am 只配 I 一個人，這裡是兩個人。
is 配一個人，這裡是兩個人。

items.q: ___ you like a glass of water?
items.why: 在問對方要不要一杯水，禮貌的說法是 Would you like…?（比 Do you want 客氣）。
wn: Do you like…? 是問平常喜不喜歡，不是請對方喝。
like 是動詞，前面不用 be 動詞。

items.q: We love ___ new apartment.
items.why: apartment 是名詞，名詞前面要用所有格 our（我們的）。
wn: we 是主詞，名詞前要用 our。
us 是受詞，名詞前要用 our。

items.q: He ___ come to the party yesterday.
items.why: yesterday 是過去，come 是一般動詞，否定用 didn't＋原形 come。
wn: wasn't 後面不接原形動詞，一般動詞的過去否定用 didn't。

items.q: Our neighbour ___ two big dogs.
items.why: Our neighbour 是一個人（像 he／she），表示擁有要用 has。
wn: have 配 I／you／複數，neighbour 是一個人。
is 是「是」，表示「有」要用 has。

items.q: Birds ___ fly, but chickens can't fly far.
items.why: but 表示對比：後面說雞飛不遠 can't，前面就是鳥會飛 can；can 後面接原形 fly。
wn: 鳥不會飛不合事實，和 but 後面的對比也不通。
fly 是原形動詞，前面要用 can，不能用 are。

items.q: There ___ any milk in the fridge.
items.why: milk 不可數，當單數用 is；有 any，是否定句：There isn't any milk。
wn: not 前面要有 is：There is not＝There isn't。
milk 不可數，要用 is，不用 are。

items.q: I ___ late for work.
items.why: 頻率副詞 never 放在 be 動詞後面：I am never late。never 本身就是否定。
wn: never 要放在 am 後面；放動詞前面是一般動詞才這樣。
never 已經是否定，再加 not 就重複否定了。

items.q: Look at the sky. It ___ rain.
items.why: 看天空（有跡象）預測快要下雨，用 be going to＋原形；主詞 It 用 is。
wn: going to 前面少了 be 動詞 is。
goes to 是「去某地」，預測要用 is going to。

items.q: How much ___ this bag?
items.why: 問價錢用 How much is／are…？this bag 是一個，用 is。
wn: are 配複數（these bags），this bag 只有一個。
does 後面要接原形動詞，這裡沒有動詞，用 is。

items.q: ___ shoes on the floor are very old.
items.why: shoes 是複數，後面動詞也是 are，所以用複數的 These。
wn: This 配一個東西，shoes 是複數，後面也是 are。
That 也只配一個東西，複數要用 These 或 Those。

items.q: The cat is ___ the sofa. You can't see it.
items.why: 後一句說 You can't see it. 看不到貓，所以牠在沙發下面：under。
wn: 在沙發上面一定看得到，和後一句矛盾。
在旁邊也看得到；看不到應該是在下面。

items.q: ___ your teacher from Canada?
items.why: 主詞是 your teacher（你的老師，一個人），不是 you，be 動詞用 Is。
wn: Are 配 you，但主詞是 your teacher 一個人。

items.q: The pharmacy is ___ the bank and the post office.
items.why: 後面是 the bank and the post office 兩個地方，在兩者中間用 between。
wn: behind 是在某個東西後面，不會接 A and B 兩個地方。
in 是在裡面，藥局不會在銀行和郵局裡面。

items.q: ___ your friends like Japanese food?
items.why: like 是一般動詞，問句用 Do／Does；your friends 是複數，用 Do。
wn: Does 配一個人（he／she），your friends 是複數。
like 是一般動詞，問句要用 Do，不用 be 動詞。

items.q: My sister ___ swim very well, so she wants lessons.
items.why: so she wants lessons（所以想上課），可見她游得不好，用 can't＋原形 swim。
wn: 如果很會游就不需要上課，so 前後不合理。
don't 不配 my sister；而且這裡講能力，用 can't。

items.q: Is there ___ bus stop on this street?
items.why: bus stop 是可數名詞，這裡是一個（單數），問有沒有一個用 a：Is there a bus stop…?
wn: some 配複數或不可數，bus stop 是單數。
any 多配複數或不可數（any buses），單數可數用 a。

items.q: She ___ a new phone last week.
items.why: last week 是過去，buy 是不規則動詞，過去式是 bought。
wn: buy 不規則，過去式是 bought，不能加 ed。
last week 是過去，要用過去式 bought。

items.q: It ___ cold in the office this morning.
items.why: 主詞是 It（說天氣、溫度常用 It），be 動詞用 is。
wn: are 配複數或 you，主詞是 It。

items.q: They ___ at home now. They are at work.
items.why: 後面是 at home，沒有一般動詞，要用 be 動詞；They 是複數，否定是 aren't。
wn: isn't 配一個人，They 是複數。
not 前面要有 be 動詞：They are not at home。

items.q: We ___ at the beach last Sunday.
items.why: last Sunday 是過去；主詞 We 是複數，過去的 be 動詞用 were。
wn: was 配 I／he／she／it，We 要用 were。
last Sunday 是過去，要用過去式 were。

items.q: Look at ___ bird in the tree over there.
items.why: bird 只有一隻，又在 over there 遠處，用單數、指遠的 that。
wn: these 配複數，而且是近的；bird 只有一隻。
those 是複數，bird 只有一隻。

items.q: How ___ eggs do we need for the cake?
items.why: eggs 可以一顆一顆數，是可數名詞複數，問多少個用 How many。
wn: much 配不可數（water、money），eggs 可以數。
沒有 How some 的說法，問數量用 How many。

items.q: 「hello」是什麼意思？
items.why: hello＝你好。例句：Hello! Nice to meet you.

items.q: 「take care」是什麼意思？
items.why: take care＝保重。例句：Take care! It is cold today.

items.q: 「teacher」是什麼意思？
items.why: teacher＝老師。例句：She is a teacher.

items.q: 「two」是什麼意思？
items.why: two＝二。例句：I have two pens.

items.q: 「old」是什麼意思？
items.why: old＝年老的。例句：My grandfather is old.

items.q: 「hobby」是什麼意思？
items.why: hobby＝嗜好。例句：What is your hobby?

items.q: 「brother」是什麼意思？
items.why: brother＝兄弟（哥哥或弟弟）。例句：I have one brother.

items.q: 「uncle」是什麼意思？
items.why: uncle＝叔叔／舅舅。例句：He is my uncle.

items.q: 「laptop」是什麼意思？
items.why: laptop＝筆記型電腦。例句：She has a laptop.

items.q: 「big eyes」是什麼意思？
items.why: big eyes＝大眼睛。例句：The baby has big eyes.

items.q: Where does Amy live now?
items.passage: Hi, my name is Amy. I am from Taichung, but now I live in Taipei. I work in a small bookshop near my apartment. I usually start work at ten o'clock. My boss, Mr. Lin, is very kind. He has two children, and they often come to the shop after school. There is a café next to the bookshop, and I have lunch there every day. Last Saturday, I didn't work. I went to the beach with my friends. Next weekend, we are going to visit my parents in Taichung. I can't wait!
items.why: 原文：but now I live in Taipei. now 是現在，她現在住台北。
wn: 台中是她的家鄉（from），現在不住那裡。
海邊是她上週六去玩的地方，不是住的地方。

items.q: What time does Amy usually start work?
items.passage: Hi, my name is Amy. I am from Taichung, but now I live in Taipei. I work in a small bookshop near my apartment. I usually start work at ten o'clock. My boss, Mr. Lin, is very kind. He has two children, and they often come to the shop after school. There is a café next to the bookshop, and I have lunch there every day. Last Saturday, I didn't work. I went to the beach with my friends. Next weekend, we are going to visit my parents in Taichung. I can't wait!
items.why: 原文：I usually start work at ten o'clock. 她通常十點開始上班。
wn: 原文是 ten o'clock 十點，不是九點。
原文是 ten o'clock 十點，不是兩點。

items.q: Who has two children?
items.passage: Hi, my name is Amy. I am from Taichung, but now I live in Taipei. I work in a small bookshop near my apartment. I usually start work at ten o'clock. My boss, Mr. Lin, is very kind. He has two children, and they often come to the shop after school. There is a café next to the bookshop, and I have lunch there every day. Last Saturday, I didn't work. I went to the beach with my friends. Next weekend, we are going to visit my parents in Taichung. I can't wait!
items.why: 原文：My boss, Mr. Lin... He has two children. He 指的是老闆 Mr. Lin。
wn: He 指的是 Mr. Lin，不是 Amy。
朋友只出現在去海邊那段，沒說有小孩。

items.q: Where does Amy have lunch every day?
items.passage: Hi, my name is Amy. I am from Taichung, but now I live in Taipei. I work in a small bookshop near my apartment. I usually start work at ten o'clock. My boss, Mr. Lin, is very kind. He has two children, and they often come to the shop after school. There is a café next to the bookshop, and I have lunch there every day. Last Saturday, I didn't work. I went to the beach with my friends. Next weekend, we are going to visit my parents in Taichung. I can't wait!
items.why: 原文：There is a café next to the bookshop, and I have lunch there.
wn: 咖啡店在書店旁邊，她不是在書店裡吃。
文中說她每天在咖啡店吃午餐，不是在家。

items.q: What did Amy do last Saturday?
items.passage: Hi, my name is Amy. I am from Taichung, but now I live in Taipei. I work in a small bookshop near my apartment. I usually start work at ten o'clock. My boss, Mr. Lin, is very kind. He has two children, and they often come to the shop after school. There is a café next to the bookshop, and I have lunch there every day. Last Saturday, I didn't work. I went to the beach with my friends. Next weekend, we are going to visit my parents in Taichung. I can't wait!
items.why: 原文：Last Saturday... I went to the beach. 上週六她去了海邊。
wn: 原文說 Last Saturday, I didn't work，那天沒上班。
看父母是 Next weekend 下週末的計畫，還沒發生。

items.q: Good morning! ___ you Mr. Chen?
items.why: 問對方是不是陳先生，主詞是 you，用 Are 放句首。
wn: Am 只配 I，這裡問的是對方 you。
Mr. Chen 是單數，但主詞是 you，you 永遠用 are。

items.q: We ___ from Kaohsiung.
items.why: We 是複數主詞，用 are；be from 表示來自哪裡。
wn: Kaohsiung 是一個地方，但主詞是 We，用 are。

items.q: My brother ___ a nurse.
items.why: My brother 是一個人（he），用 is。
wn: are 用在複數或 you，兄弟只有一位。
am 只配 I，主詞是 My brother。

items.q: ___ your parents teachers?
items.why: your parents 是兩個人，複數，問句用 Are 開頭。
wn: Is 配單數，parents 有 s，是兩個人。

items.q: I ___ not tired today.
items.why: 主詞 I 固定配 am；否定是 I am not tired.
wn: is 配 he／she／it，不能配 I。
are 配 you／we／they，不能配 I。

items.q: It ___ very hot in July.
items.why: 說天氣用 It 當主詞，單數配 is：It is very hot.（天氣很熱）
wn: July 不是主詞；主詞 It 是單數，用 is。

items.q: They ___ Japanese. They are Korean.
items.why: 後句說 They are Korean，所以前句要否定；They 配 are，否定是 aren't。
wn: isn't 配單數 he／she／it，They 是複數。
am not 只配 I，主詞是 They。

items.q: How old ___ your sister?
items.why: 問年紀用 How old + be + 人；your sister 是一個人，用 is。
wn: How old are you 的 are 配 you；這裡是 your sister。
am 只配 I，這裡問的是姊妹。

items.q: 'Are you a doctor?' 'No, I ___.'
items.why: 回答時主詞是 I，配 am，否定是 I'm not（= I am not）。
wn: isn't 配 he／she／it，回答的主詞是 I。
問句用 Are you，但回答換成 I，要用 am not。

items.q: Lisa and I ___ good friends.
items.why: Lisa and I 是兩個人，等於 we，用 are。
wn: am 只在 I 單獨當主詞時用，這裡是兩個人。
is 配一個人，Lisa and I 是兩個人。

items.q: Where ___ you from?
items.why: Where … from? 問來自哪裡；主詞 you 配 are。
wn: you 只配 are，不配 is。
am 只配 I，回答時才說 I am from…。

items.q: The bus ___ late again.
items.why: The bus 是一台公車，單數用 is：The bus is late.
wn: are 配複數，這裡只說一台公車。
am 只配 I，主詞是 The bus。

items.q: Choose the correct sentence.
items.why: He 是一個人（第三人稱單數），be 動詞用 is：He is a cook.
wn: am 只配 I，He 要用 is。
are 配 you／we／they，He 要用 is。

items.q: Choose the correct question.
items.why: 問句把 be 動詞移到主詞前；they 是複數配 are，所以是 Are they hungry?
wn: they 是複數，要配 Are，不能配 Is。
這是直述句的順序；標準問句要把 Are 移到 they 前面。

items.q: 'Is Mr. Lin at home?' '___'
items.why: 用 Is 問就用 is 答：Yes, he is. 肯定簡答句尾的 he is 不能縮寫。
wn: 肯定簡答結尾不能用縮寫，要說 Yes, he is.
is he 是問句順序；回答要用 he is。

items.q: Anna ___ from Germany. She is German.
items.why: Anna 是一個人（she），用 is；後句 She is German 也是線索。
wn: am 只配 I，主詞是 Anna。
are 配複數或 you，Anna 是單數。

items.q: You ___ right. The answer is five.
items.why: 第一句主詞 You 配 are；第二句的 is 是配 The answer。
wn: 後句的 is 屬於 The answer；這句主詞是 You，要用 are。
am 只配 I，主詞是 You。

items.q: My shoes ___ new.
items.why: shoes 是一雙鞋（兩隻），英文當複數，用 are。
wn: shoes 有 s，是複數，不用 is。
am 只配 I，主詞是 My shoes。

items.q: I ___ Taiwanese, and my wife ___ Thai.
items.why: 前半主詞 I 配 am；後半主詞 my wife 是一個人（she），配 is。
wn: 順序顛倒了：I 要用 am，my wife 要用 is。
前半 am 對，但 my wife 是單數，要用 is 不是 are。

items.q: 'What ___ your job?' 'I'm an engineer.'
items.why: 問句主詞是 your job（一份工作），單數用 is：What is your job?
wn: are 雖然配 you，但主詞是 your job，不是 you。
回答裡有 I'm，但問句主詞是 your job，要用 is。

items.q: Tom and Amy ___ at work today. They're at home.
items.why: Tom and Amy 是兩個人（they）；後句說他們在家，所以用否定 aren't（are not）。
wn: isn't 配一個人，Tom and Amy 是兩個人。
am not 只配 I，主詞是 Tom and Amy。

items.q: Choose the correct negative.
items.why: be 動詞的否定是在 is 後面加 not：She is not happy，縮寫成 She isn't happy.
wn: not 要放在 is 的後面，不能放前面。
有 be 動詞的句子不用 don't 否定；而且 she 也不配 don't。

items.q: ___ it cold outside?
items.why: 主詞 it 在這裡指天氣，單數；問句把 is 放句首：Is it cold?
wn: Are 配 you 或複數，it 是單數。
Am 只配 I，主詞是 it。

items.q: Our teacher ___ very kind.
items.why: 主詞是 Our teacher（一位老師），不是 we，單數用 is。
wn: Our 是「我們的」，但主詞是 teacher 一個人，用 is。

items.q: 'How are you?' '___'
items.why: 回答要有主詞和動詞：I 配 am，所以是 I am fine, thanks.
wn: is 不能配 I，I 只配 am。
少了主詞 I，英文句子要有主詞：I am fine.

items.q: 「hello」是什麼意思？
items.why: hello＝你好。例句：Hello! Nice to meet you.

items.q: 「thank you」是什麼意思？
items.why: thank you＝謝謝。例句：Thank you for your help.

items.q: 「country」是什麼意思？
items.why: country＝國家。例句：Taiwan is my country.

items.q: 「years old」是什麼意思？
items.why: years old＝…歲。例句：I am twenty years old.

items.q: 「driver」是什麼意思？
items.why: driver＝司機。例句：He is a bus driver.

items.q: 「boss」是什麼意思？
items.why: boss＝老闆。例句：She is my boss.

items.q: 「twenty」是什麼意思？
items.why: twenty＝二十。例句：I am twenty years old.

items.q: 「old」是什麼意思？
items.why: old＝年老的。例句：My grandfather is old.

items.q: 「handsome」是什麼意思？
items.why: handsome＝英俊的。例句：He is handsome.

items.q: 「classmate」是什麼意思？
items.why: classmate＝同班同學。例句：She is my classmate.

items.q: Where is Mei from?
items.passage: Hello! My name is Mei. I am from Tainan, but now I am in Taipei. I am thirty-two years old, and I am a nurse. My hospital is big and very busy. My friend Ken is a nurse too. He is from Japan. He is not tall, but he is strong and funny. Our boss is Mrs. Wang. She is fifty years old. She is not a nurse; she is a doctor. She is very kind. Today is Sunday. We are not at work. We are at a small café. The coffee is hot and the cake is good. We are happy.
items.why: 原文：I am from Tainan. from 是從哪裡來，Mei 來自台南。
wn: 台北是她現在在的地方，不是她來自哪裡。
來自日本的是 Ken，不是 Mei。

items.q: Ken is a ___.
items.passage: Hello! My name is Mei. I am from Tainan, but now I am in Taipei. I am thirty-two years old, and I am a nurse. My hospital is big and very busy. My friend Ken is a nurse too. He is from Japan. He is not tall, but he is strong and funny. Our boss is Mrs. Wang. She is fifty years old. She is not a nurse; she is a doctor. She is very kind. Today is Sunday. We are not at work. We are at a small café. The coffee is hot and the cake is good. We are happy.
items.why: 原文：My friend Ken is a nurse too. too 是也，Ken 也是護理師。
wn: 醫生是老闆 Mrs. Wang，不是 Ken。
文中沒有人是老師，Ken 是護理師。

items.q: Is Ken tall?
items.passage: Hello! My name is Mei. I am from Tainan, but now I am in Taipei. I am thirty-two years old, and I am a nurse. My hospital is big and very busy. My friend Ken is a nurse too. He is from Japan. He is not tall, but he is strong and funny. Our boss is Mrs. Wang. She is fifty years old. She is not a nurse; she is a doctor. She is very kind. Today is Sunday. We are not at work. We are at a small café. The coffee is hot and the cake is good. We are happy.
items.why: 原文：He is not tall. Ken 不高，所以回答 No, he isn't.
wn: 原文說 He is not tall，他不高。
Yes 後面不能接否定，回答要前後一致：No, he isn't.

items.q: Mrs. Wang is ___.
items.passage: Hello! My name is Mei. I am from Tainan, but now I am in Taipei. I am thirty-two years old, and I am a nurse. My hospital is big and very busy. My friend Ken is a nurse too. He is from Japan. He is not tall, but he is strong and funny. Our boss is Mrs. Wang. She is fifty years old. She is not a nurse; she is a doctor. She is very kind. Today is Sunday. We are not at work. We are at a small café. The coffee is hot and the cake is good. We are happy.
items.why: 原文：She is not a nurse; she is a doctor. Mrs. Wang 是醫生。
wn: 原文說 She is not a nurse，她不是護理師。
32 歲的是 Mei；Mrs. Wang 是 fifty 五十歲。

items.q: Where are they today?
items.passage: Hello! My name is Mei. I am from Tainan, but now I am in Taipei. I am thirty-two years old, and I am a nurse. My hospital is big and very busy. My friend Ken is a nurse too. He is from Japan. He is not tall, but he is strong and funny. Our boss is Mrs. Wang. She is fifty years old. She is not a nurse; she is a doctor. She is very kind. Today is Sunday. We are not at work. We are at a small café. The coffee is hot and the cake is good. We are happy.
items.why: 原文：We are not at work. We are at a small café. 今天他們在咖啡店。
wn: 原文說 We are not at work，今天沒上班。
醫院是上班的地方；今天星期天，他們在咖啡店。

2.title: Week 2 檢測：所有格與 have/has

items.q: That is Mr. Wu. ___ car is red.
items.why: 空格後有名詞 car，要用所有格 His（他的）。
wn: He 是主詞（他），不能放在名詞前面。
Him 是受詞，放在動詞後面，不能當他的。

items.q: We love ___ new apartment.
items.why: apartment 是名詞，名詞前面要用所有格 our（我們的）。
wn: us 是受詞，名詞前要用 our。
we 是主詞，名詞前要用 our。

items.q: ___ your grandmother have a garden?
items.why: your grandmother 是一個人（她），後面有動詞 have，問句用 Does。
wn: Do 配 I／you／we／they，grandmother 要用 Does。
Is 是 be 動詞，後面有動詞 have 要用 Does 問。

items.q: My cousins ___ two dogs and a cat.
items.why: My cousins 有 s 是複數，表示擁有用 have。
wn: has 只配一個人，cousins 是複數。
英文沒有 haves 這個形式；複數主詞用 have。

items.q: Sarah ___ long black hair.
items.why: Sarah 是一個人（她），說有長頭髮用 has long hair。
wn: 說頭髮的樣子用 has long hair，不說 is long hair。

items.q: I ___ any brothers, but I have one sister.
items.why: 主詞 I 的否定是 don't have；any brothers 常用在否定句。
wn: doesn't 配 he／she／it，主詞 I 要用 don't。
英文不能直接說 I not have，要加 don't。

items.q: Look at ___ shoes over there. They are old.
items.why: shoes 是複數，over there 是遠的，後句 They 也是複數，用 those。
wn: this 是近的單數，shoes 有 s 又在遠處。
these 是近的，over there 要用 those。

items.q: ___ is my uncle. He is a farmer.
items.why: 介紹一個人（my uncle）用 This is…，後句 He 也說明是一個人。
wn: These 配複數 are，這裡是 is 和一位叔叔。
Those 是「那些」，複數，不配 is。

items.q: Kevin ___ a car or a bike.
items.why: Kevin 是一個人，否定用 doesn't，doesn't 後面的動詞要回到原形 have。
wn: Kevin 是一個人，要用 doesn't，不是 don't。
doesn't 後面動詞用原形，has 要改回 have。

items.q: Is ___ your umbrella?
items.why: your umbrella 是一把傘，配 Is，用 this（這個）。
wn: these 是複數，不配 Is 和一把傘。
those 是遠的複數，不配 Is 和一把傘。

items.q: The children are tired. ___ school bags are very heavy.
items.why: 空格後有名詞 school bags，要用所有格 Their（他們的）。
wn: They 是主詞（他們），不能放在名詞前面。
Them 是受詞，放在動詞後，不能當所有格。

items.q: '___ you have a big family?' 'Yes, I do.'
items.why: 回答是 Yes, I do.，問句主詞是 you，用 Do 開頭：Do you have…?
wn: Does 配 he／she／it，主詞是 you。
有一般動詞 have 的問句用 Do，回答也是 I do，不是 I am。

items.q: Emma is my wife, and ___ mother is a teacher.
items.why: 後面接名詞 mother，Emma 是女生，用所有格 her：her mother。
wn: she 是主詞，不能放在名詞 mother 前面。
hers 是「她的東西」，單獨用，後面不能再接名詞。

items.q: 'Does Peter have a beard?' '___'
items.why: 問句用 Does 開頭，簡答也要用 does：Yes, he does.
wn: 問句是 Does 開頭，簡答要用 does，不用 has。
he 是單數，要用 does，不是 do。

items.q: You and Ben are lucky. ___ boss is very friendly.
items.why: You and Ben 是對方那一群，空格後有名詞 boss，用所有格 Your。
wn: You 是主詞或受詞，不能放在名詞前。

items.q: My grandfather ___ short grey hair and blue eyes.
items.why: My grandfather 是一個人（他），表示擁有用 has。
wn: 英文沒有 haves，一個人用 has。

items.q: Which sentence is correct?
items.why: 主詞 She 否定用 doesn't，而 doesn't 後面動詞要用原形 have。
wn: She 是一個人，否定要用 doesn't，不是 don't。
doesn't 已經表示第三人稱，後面動詞回原形 have。

items.q: Which question is correct?
opts: Does your father have a car?
Do your father have a car?
items.why: have 的問句要借 Does／Do；your father 是一個人用 Does，have 用原形。
wn: 現代英文問「有沒有」不把 has 放句首，要用 Does…have。
your father 是一個人，要用 Does，不是 Do。

items.q: ___ is my desk, and that desk is for new workers.
items.why: 後半句用 that desk 指別張桌子，前面講自己的桌子就用 This（這個），一近一遠對比。
wn: 後面已經用 that desk 指另一張，前面要用 This 做對比。
These 是複數，後面 is my desk 只有一張桌子。

items.q: My parents are very busy, so ___ house is not clean.
items.why: 空格後有名詞 house，是 My parents 的房子，用所有格 their。
wn: they 是主詞，不能放在名詞前面。
there 是那裡，發音和 their 一樣，但不是他們的。

items.q: Ann and Mike ___ a daughter. She is five.
items.why: Ann and Mike 是兩個人（they），說「有」一個女兒用 have。
wn: has 配一個人（he／she／it），這裡是兩個人。
are 是「是」，不是「有」；說有小孩要用 have。

items.q: ___ people in the photo are my friends from work.
items.why: people 是複數（很多人），照片在眼前，用 These，動詞也是 are。
wn: This 配單數，people 是複數。
That 只配單數，people 是好幾個人。

items.q: I love ___ mom. She is very funny.
items.why: 空格後有名詞 mom，要用所有格 my。
wn: I 是主詞，不能放在名詞前面。
me 是受詞，不能放在名詞 mom 前面。

items.q: Our neighbors ___ a big dog. It is quiet.
items.why: Our neighbors 有 s 是複數（他們），表示擁有用 have。
wn: has 只配一個人，neighbors 是複數。
are 不表示擁有，neighbors are a big dog 意思不通。

items.q: Tim is tall and thin, and ___ hair is brown.
items.why: 後面接名詞 hair，要用所有格 his（他的）：his hair。
wn: he 是主詞「他」，不能放在名詞 hair 前面。
him 是受詞「他」，放在動詞後，不能修飾 hair。

items.q: 「mother」是什麼意思？
items.why: mother＝媽媽。例句：This is my mother.

items.q: 「son」是什麼意思？
items.why: son＝兒子。例句：He is their son.

items.q: 「grandma」是什麼意思？
items.why: grandma＝奶奶（口語）。例句：My grandma is very kind.

items.q: 「grandchildren」是什麼意思？
items.why: grandchildren＝孫子女們。例句：They have five grandchildren.

items.q: 「dog」是什麼意思？
items.why: dog＝狗。例句：I have a dog.

items.q: 「watch」是什麼意思？
items.why: watch＝手錶。例句：My father has a watch.

items.q: 「black hair」是什麼意思？
items.why: black hair＝黑髮。例句：She has black hair.

items.q: 「mustache」是什麼意思？
items.why: mustache＝八字鬍。例句：He has a mustache.

items.q: 「friendly」是什麼意思？
items.why: friendly＝友善的。例句：My neighbor is friendly.

items.q: 「favorite color」是什麼意思？
items.why: favorite color＝最喜歡的顏色。例句：Blue is her favorite color.

items.q: What does the father have?
items.passage: This is a photo of my family. The tall man is my father, Mr. Huang. He is fifty-five, and he has a small restaurant. The woman in the blue dress is my mother. She has short hair and a big smile. She is very friendly. These two girls are my sisters, Amy and Joy. Amy has long hair and glasses. Joy doesn't have glasses. That little boy is our cousin, Leo. He is seven. He has a red bike, and it is new. We don't have a dog, but we have two cats. Their names are Mimi and Coco. I love my family very much.
items.why: 原文：my father... he has a small restaurant. 爸爸有一家小餐廳。
wn: 有腳踏車的是表弟 Leo，不是爸爸。
原文說 We don't have a dog，家裡沒有狗。

items.q: Who has glasses?
items.passage: This is a photo of my family. The tall man is my father, Mr. Huang. He is fifty-five, and he has a small restaurant. The woman in the blue dress is my mother. She has short hair and a big smile. She is very friendly. These two girls are my sisters, Amy and Joy. Amy has long hair and glasses. Joy doesn't have glasses. That little boy is our cousin, Leo. He is seven. He has a red bike, and it is new. We don't have a dog, but we have two cats. Their names are Mimi and Coco. I love my family very much.
items.why: 原文：Amy has long hair and glasses. 戴眼鏡的是 Amy。
wn: 原文說 Joy doesn't have glasses，她沒戴眼鏡。
文中只說 Leo 有紅色腳踏車，沒提到眼鏡。

items.q: Leo is ___.
items.passage: This is a photo of my family. The tall man is my father, Mr. Huang. He is fifty-five, and he has a small restaurant. The woman in the blue dress is my mother. She has short hair and a big smile. She is very friendly. These two girls are my sisters, Amy and Joy. Amy has long hair and glasses. Joy doesn't have glasses. That little boy is our cousin, Leo. He is seven. He has a red bike, and it is new. We don't have a dog, but we have two cats. Their names are Mimi and Coco. I love my family very much.
items.why: 原文：That little boy is our cousin, Leo. Leo 是表弟（cousin）。
wn: 原文說 Leo 是 cousin 表親，不是 brother 兄弟。
sister 是姊妹，指 Amy 和 Joy；Leo 是男生。

items.q: Does the family have a dog?
items.passage: This is a photo of my family. The tall man is my father, Mr. Huang. He is fifty-five, and he has a small restaurant. The woman in the blue dress is my mother. She has short hair and a big smile. She is very friendly. These two girls are my sisters, Amy and Joy. Amy has long hair and glasses. Joy doesn't have glasses. That little boy is our cousin, Leo. He is seven. He has a red bike, and it is new. We don't have a dog, but we have two cats. Their names are Mimi and Coco. I love my family very much.
items.why: 原文：We don't have a dog. 沒有狗，所以回答 No, they don't.
wn: 原文說 We don't have a dog，他們沒有狗。
主詞 they 是複數，要用 don't，不能用 doesn't。

items.q: Mimi and Coco are ___.
items.passage: This is a photo of my family. The tall man is my father, Mr. Huang. He is fifty-five, and he has a small restaurant. The woman in the blue dress is my mother. She has short hair and a big smile. She is very friendly. These two girls are my sisters, Amy and Joy. Amy has long hair and glasses. Joy doesn't have glasses. That little boy is our cousin, Leo. He is seven. He has a red bike, and it is new. We don't have a dog, but we have two cats. Their names are Mimi and Coco. I love my family very much.
items.why: 原文：we have two cats. Their names are Mimi and Coco. 牠們是貓。
wn: 原文說 We don't have a dog，他們養的是貓。
cousin 是 Leo；Mimi 和 Coco 是貓的名字。

items.q: My father ___ coffee every morning.
items.why: every morning 是習慣，My father 是一個人，drink 加 s。
wn: My father 是一個人，drink 要加 s。
前面沒有 is，不能只用 -ing。

items.q: We ___ to the gym on Saturdays.
items.why: 主詞 We 是複數，動詞用原形 go。
wn: goes 配 he／she／it，We 用 go。
沒有 gos 這個字，go 要加 es 變 goes。

items.q: Jenny ___ English at a high school.
items.why: Jenny 是一個人；teach 結尾是 ch，要加 es 變 teaches。
wn: Jenny 是一個人，teach 要加 es。
ch 結尾要加 es，不是只加 s。

items.q: The baby ___ a lot at night.
items.why: The baby 是一個，cry 是子音加 y 結尾，去 y 加 ies：cries。
wn: baby 是第三人稱單數，cry 要變 cries。
子音加 y 結尾要把 y 改 i 再加 es，不是直接加 s。

items.q: I ___ meat. I only eat vegetables.
items.why: 後句說只吃蔬菜，所以是否定；主詞 I 用 don't，後面接原形 eat。
wn: doesn't 只配 he／she／it，I 要用 don't。
一般動詞的否定要用 don't，不能只放 not。

items.q: ___ your husband cook dinner?
items.why: your husband 是一個人（等於 he），cook 是原形一般動詞，問句用 Does。
wn: Do 配 I／you／we／they；your husband 是一個人。
cook 是一般動詞，要用 Does 問，不用 Is。

items.q: Choose the sentence with the adverb in the correct place.
opts: She always is late for work.
She is always late for work.
Always she is late for work.
items.why: 句子有 be 動詞 is，頻率副詞要放在 is 後面：She is always late。
wn: 遇到 be 動詞，always 要放在 is 後面，不是前面。
always 一般不放句首，要放在 is 後面。

items.q: My sister ___ TV. She has no time.
items.why: She has no time 表示她從不看；never 放動詞前，sister 是一個人，watch 加 es。
wn: My sister 是一個人，watch 要加 es 變 watches。
頻率副詞 never 要放在動詞前面，不是後面。

items.q: 'Do you like spicy food?' '___'
items.why: 用 Do 問，就用 do 回答：Yes, I do.
wn: like 後面要接東西，簡答要用 do 代替。
問句用 Do，不用 am 回答。

items.q: Our office ___ at nine o'clock.
items.why: 主詞 Our office 是一件事（單數），說固定時間用現在簡單式，open 加 s。
wn: office 是一個（單數），動詞要加 s。
open 直接加 s 就好，不用加 es。

items.q: Ken ___ to work by MRT. He doesn't drive.
items.why: 在說 Ken 平常怎麼上班；Ken 是一個人，go 變 goes。
wn: Ken 是一個人，要用 goes。
前面沒有 is，不能只用 -ing。

items.q: ___ they live near the station?
items.why: they 是複數，一般動詞 live 的問句用 Do，後面接原形。
wn: Does 配 he／she／it，they 用 Do。
live 是一般動詞，問句用 Do，不用 Are。

items.q: Tina ___ her homework on Fridays.
items.why: Tina 是一個人，否定用 doesn't，後面接原形 do：doesn't do。
wn: Tina 是一個人，要用 doesn't。
doesn't 後面用原形 do，不用 does。

items.q: He ___ the dishes after dinner.
items.why: He 是一個人，wash 結尾是 sh，要加 es 變 washes。
wn: He 是一個人，wash 要加 es。
sh 結尾要加 es，不是只加 s。

items.q: I ___ take a taxi. It's too expensive.
items.why: 後句說太貴了，所以是 never（從不）搭計程車。
wn: 嫌太貴卻總是搭，前後矛盾。
嫌太貴卻通常搭，前後矛盾。

items.q: My grandmother ___ a walk before breakfast.
items.why: My grandmother 是一個人，take a walk（散步）的 take 要加 s。
wn: grandmother 是一個人，take 要加 s。
前面沒有 is，不能只用 -ing。

items.q: Find the correct sentence.
opts: We go often to the beach in summer.
Often we go the beach in summer.
We often go to the beach in summer.
items.why: often 放在一般動詞 go 前面；去海邊要說 go to the beach。
wn: often 要放在 go 前面，不是後面。
go 後面少了 to，要說 go to the beach。

items.q: Find the correct question.
opts: What time do the shops close?
What time does the shops close?
items.why: 一般動詞的問句要有 do／does；the shops 是複數，用 do。
wn: shops 是複數，要用 do，不用 does。
少了 do，一般動詞問句一定要有助動詞。

items.q: 'Does Mia study on Sundays?' '___'
items.why: 用 Does 問，就用 does 回答；Mia 是她，所以回答 No, she doesn't.
wn: she 是一個人，要用 doesn't。
問句用 Does，回答也要用 does，不用 is。

items.q: The kids ___ to school on Saturday.
items.why: The kids 是複數（孩子們），否定用 don't，後面接原形 go。
wn: doesn't 配一個人，kids 是複數。
一般動詞否定要有 don't，不能只放 not。

items.q: Paul ___ a bus to the airport.
items.why: Paul 是一個人，動詞要變化；catch 結尾是 ch，要加 es 變 catches。
wn: 字尾是 ch 的動詞要加 es，不是只加 s。
主詞 Paul 是一個人，catch 要加 es。

items.q: We ___ dinner at seven, but sometimes we eat late.
items.why: 後面說 but sometimes 有時會晚吃，所以是 usually（通常）七點吃。
wn: always 是每次都這樣，和有時晚吃矛盾。
never 是從不，和後句的晚吃不合。

items.q: My mother ___ the house every weekend.
items.why: every weekend 是習慣，My mother 是一個人，clean 加 s。
wn: My mother 是一個人，clean 要加 s。
clean 直接加 s，不用 es。

items.q: Amy ___ fish, so she doesn't buy it.
items.why: 後半說不買，所以是不喜歡；Amy 是一個人用 doesn't，後面接原形 like。
wn: Amy 是一個人，要用 doesn't。
doesn't 後面用原形，like 不加 s。

items.q: ___ Mr. Lee work in Taichung?
items.why: 句中有原形動詞 work，問句用 Do／Does；Mr. Lee 是一個人，用 Does。
wn: Do 配 I／you／we／they，一個人要用 Does。
後面是一般動詞 work，不用 Is 問。

items.q: 「wake up」是什麼意思？
items.why: wake up＝起床（醒來）。例句：I wake up at 7 o'clock.

items.q: 「put on clothes」是什麼意思？
items.why: put on clothes＝穿上衣服。例句：He puts on his clothes fast.

items.q: 「start work」是什麼意思？
items.why: start work＝開始上班。例句：I start work at 9.

items.q: 「do homework」是什麼意思？
items.why: do homework＝做作業。例句：He does his homework after class.

items.q: 「watch TV」是什麼意思？
items.why: watch TV＝看電視。例句：We watch TV after dinner.

items.q: 「dishes」是什麼意思？
items.why: dishes＝碗盤。例句：My brother washes the dishes after dinner.

items.q: 「every night」是什麼意思？
items.why: every night＝每天晚上。例句：I read every night.

items.q: 「Tuesday」是什麼意思？
items.why: Tuesday＝星期二。例句：She has a meeting on Tuesday.

items.q: 「in the evening」是什麼意思？
items.why: in the evening＝在晚上。例句：We eat dinner in the evening.

items.q: 「spend time with family」是什麼意思？
items.why: spend time with family＝和家人相處。例句：I spend time with my family every evening.

items.q: What time does David get up on weekdays?
items.passage: My name is David, and I work at a bank in Hsinchu. I get up at six o'clock from Monday to Friday. I never eat breakfast at home. I usually buy a sandwich and a coffee near my office. Work starts at eight thirty. At noon, I eat lunch with my friend Jack. He often talks about football. I finish work at six, and then I go to the gym. My wife, Linda, doesn't work at a bank. She teaches music at a school. She sometimes comes home late. On weekends, we don't get up early. We watch movies and cook together. I like my life.
items.why: 原文：I get up at six o'clock from Monday to Friday. 平日六點起床。
wn: 八點半是開始上班的時間，不是起床。
noon 中午是他吃午餐的時間。

items.q: Where does David eat breakfast?
items.passage: My name is David, and I work at a bank in Hsinchu. I get up at six o'clock from Monday to Friday. I never eat breakfast at home. I usually buy a sandwich and a coffee near my office. Work starts at eight thirty. At noon, I eat lunch with my friend Jack. He often talks about football. I finish work at six, and then I go to the gym. My wife, Linda, doesn't work at a bank. She teaches music at a school. She sometimes comes home late. On weekends, we don't get up early. We watch movies and cook together. I like my life.
items.why: 原文：I usually buy a sandwich and a coffee near my office. 早餐在公司附近。
wn: 原文說 I never eat breakfast at home，從不在家吃。
健身房是下班後去的地方，不是吃早餐。

items.q: Who often talks about football?
items.passage: My name is David, and I work at a bank in Hsinchu. I get up at six o'clock from Monday to Friday. I never eat breakfast at home. I usually buy a sandwich and a coffee near my office. Work starts at eight thirty. At noon, I eat lunch with my friend Jack. He often talks about football. I finish work at six, and then I go to the gym. My wife, Linda, doesn't work at a bank. She teaches music at a school. She sometimes comes home late. On weekends, we don't get up early. We watch movies and cook together. I like my life.
items.why: 原文：my friend Jack. He often talks about football. He 指的是 Jack。
wn: David 是說故事的人，常聊足球的是朋友 Jack。
Linda 是 David 的太太，文中沒說她聊足球。

items.q: What does Linda do?
items.passage: My name is David, and I work at a bank in Hsinchu. I get up at six o'clock from Monday to Friday. I never eat breakfast at home. I usually buy a sandwich and a coffee near my office. Work starts at eight thirty. At noon, I eat lunch with my friend Jack. He often talks about football. I finish work at six, and then I go to the gym. My wife, Linda, doesn't work at a bank. She teaches music at a school. She sometimes comes home late. On weekends, we don't get up early. We watch movies and cook together. I like my life.
items.why: 原文：She teaches music at a school. Linda 在學校教音樂。
wn: 原文說 Linda doesn't work at a bank。
去健身房的是 David，不是 Linda。

items.q: On weekends, David and Linda ___.
items.passage: My name is David, and I work at a bank in Hsinchu. I get up at six o'clock from Monday to Friday. I never eat breakfast at home. I usually buy a sandwich and a coffee near my office. Work starts at eight thirty. At noon, I eat lunch with my friend Jack. He often talks about football. I finish work at six, and then I go to the gym. My wife, Linda, doesn't work at a bank. She teaches music at a school. She sometimes comes home late. On weekends, we don't get up early. We watch movies and cook together. I like my life.
items.why: 原文：On weekends... We watch movies and cook together. 週末他們一起看電影。
wn: 原文說 On weekends, we don't get up early。
在學校工作的只有 Linda，而且是平日，不是週末。

4.title: Week 4 檢測：There is/are 與方位

items.q: ___ a big park near my house.
items.why: a big park 是一個公園（單數），用 There is。
wn: There are 配複數，a big park 只有一個。
說某處有某物用 There is，不說 There have。

items.q: There ___ two banks on this street.
items.why: two banks 是兩間銀行，複數，用 There are。
wn: is 配單數，這裡有 two 兩間。
說某處有東西用 There are，不說 There have。

items.q: ___ there a bathroom on the first floor?
items.why: a bathroom 是一間浴室，單數，問句用 Is there…?
wn: Are 配複數，a bathroom 只有一間。
問某處有沒有東西用 Is there，不用 Have。

items.q: The cat is ___ the bed. I can't see it.
items.why: 後句 I can't see it 看不到貓，表示牠躲在床底下 under the bed。
wn: 貓在床上應該看得到，和 I can't see it 不合。
在床旁邊通常也看得到，和 I can't see it 不合。

items.q: There ___ any chairs in the room. It's empty.
items.why: 線索是 It's empty 房間是空的；chairs 是複數，用 There aren't any…。
wn: isn't 配單數，chairs 是好幾張。
There 句型否定用 aren't，不用 don't。

items.q: The post office is ___ the bank and the school.
items.why: 線索是 the bank and the school 兩個地方，夾在中間用 between。
wn: in 是在裡面，不能表示在兩個地方中間。
under 是在下面，郵局不在銀行底下。
