items.q: 'Are there any shops near here?' '___'
items.why: 問句 Are there any shops 是複數，回答用 Yes, there are.
wn: is 配單數，shops 是複數。
問有沒有要用 there 回答，不用 they。

items.q: Your phone is ___ your bag. Look inside!
items.why: 後句 Look inside! 叫人往裡面看，所以手機在包包裡 in your bag。
wn: on 是在包包上面，和 Look inside 往裡面看不合。
under 是在包包底下，和 Look inside 不合。

items.q: There ___ a hospital in our town. We go to the city.
items.why: 後面說 We go to the city，表示鎮上沒有醫院；a hospital 是一間，用 isn't。
wn: aren't 配複數，a hospital 只有一間。
not 要放在 is 後面，寫成 is not 或 isn't。

items.q: Select the correct sentence.
opts: There are a lamp on the desk.
There is a lamp on the desk.
There have a lamp on the desk.
items.why: a lamp 是一盞燈，單數，所以是 There is a lamp on the desk。
wn: are 配複數，a lamp 只有一盞，要用 is。
說某處有東西用 There is，不說 There have。

items.q: The bus stop is ___ the supermarket, so it's very close.
items.why: 線索是 so it's very close 很近，所以用 near the supermarket。
wn: far 是遠，和 very close 相反；而且要說 far from。
under 是在下面，公車站不在超市底下。

items.q: Select the correct question.
opts: Is there any eggs in the fridge?
There are any eggs in the fridge?
Are there any eggs in the fridge?
items.why: eggs 是複數，問句用 Are there，而且 be 動詞要放在 there 前面。
wn: eggs 是複數，要用 Are，不用 Is。
問句要把 Are 移到 there 前面，不能直述句加問號。

items.q: My car is ___ the house. You can see it from the street.
items.why: 後句 You can see it from the street 從街上看得到，所以車在房子前面。
wn: 車在房子後面，從街上通常看不到。
under 是在下面，車子不會在房子底下。

items.q: The pictures are ___ the wall.
items.why: 照片掛在牆面上，貼著表面用 on the wall。
wn: in 是在裡面，照片不在牆壁裡面。
at 指一個地點，掛在牆上要用 on。

items.q: ___ there a lot of people at the party?
items.why: people 是複數，a lot of people 是很多人，問句用 Are there…?
wn: people 是複數（很多人），不能用 Is。
There 問句用 be 動詞開頭，不用 Do。

items.q: There ___ some milk in the fridge.
items.why: milk 是不可數名詞（不能一個一個數），不可數的東西用 There is。
wn: milk 不能數，不算複數，不用 are。
說某處有某物用 There is，不說 There have。

items.q: Go straight, and the library is ___ your left.
items.why: 說在左邊、右邊的固定說法是 on your left／on your right。
wn: 沒有 in your left 的說法，要用 on your left。
at your left 不自然，指路固定說 on your left。

items.q: 'Is there a bus station in this town?' '___'
items.why: 問句 Is there a bus station 是單數，否定回答用 No, there isn't.
wn: aren't 配複數，a bus station 是單數。
問有沒有要用 there 回答，不用 it。

items.q: The dog is ___ the door. It wants to go out.
items.why: 線索是 It wants to go out，狗想出去，所以在門的前面：in front of。
wn: in 是在裡面，狗不會在門裡面。
on 是在表面上，狗不會在門上。

items.q: There ___ three bedrooms in the new apartment.
items.why: three bedrooms 是三間臥室，複數，用 There are。
wn: is 配單數，這裡有 three 三間。
說某處有東西用 There are，不用 has。

items.q: Anna sits ___ me in class. We are good friends.
items.why: next to 是在旁邊：Anna 上課坐我旁邊，我們是好朋友。
wn: under 是在下面，人不會坐在我底下。
in 是在裡面，不能說坐在我裡面。

items.q: There ___ a cinema in my town, but there is a theater.
items.why: 後面 but there is a theater 表示沒有電影院；a cinema 單數，用 isn't。
wn: aren't 配複數，a cinema 只有一間。
not 不能單獨當動詞，要寫 is not 或 isn't。

items.q: The bank is ___ the hospital. Go around the hospital and you can see it.
items.why: 線索是 Go around the hospital，要繞過醫院才看得到，所以在後面：behind。
wn: between 要接兩樣東西（A and B），這裡只有醫院。
on 是在表面上，銀行不會在醫院上面。

items.q: ___ any restaurants in this hotel?
items.why: 句尾是問號，any restaurants 是複數，問句用 Are there…?
wn: Is there 配單數，restaurants 是複數。
這是問句，be 動詞要移到 there 前面。

items.q: Put the plates ___ the table, please.
items.why: 盤子擺在桌面上，用 on the table。
wn: in 是在裡面，盤子是放桌上，不是放進桌子裡。
under 是在桌子底下，擺盤子要放桌上。

items.q: 「bedroom」是什麼意思？
items.why: bedroom＝臥室。例句：There is a bed in the bedroom.

items.q: 「study」是什麼意思？
items.why: study＝書房。例句：There is a desk in the study.

items.q: 「bed」是什麼意思？
items.why: bed＝床。例句：There is a bed next to the window.

items.q: 「oven」是什麼意思？
items.why: oven＝烤箱。例句：There is an oven next to the sink.

items.q: 「school」是什麼意思？
items.why: school＝學校。例句：She works at a school.

items.q: 「hotel」是什麼意思？
items.why: hotel＝飯店。例句：There is a hotel between the park and the museum.

items.q: 「corner」是什麼意思？
items.why: corner＝街角。例句：There is a bank on the corner.

items.q: 「ahead」是什麼意思？
items.why: ahead＝前方。例句：The park is straight ahead.

items.q: 「in front of」是什麼意思？
items.why: in front of＝在...前面。例句：There is a car in front of the garage.

items.q: 「at」是什麼意思？
items.why: at＝在(某點)。例句：There is a man at the door.

items.q: How many bedrooms are there?
items.passage: I live in a small apartment in Taichung. There are two bedrooms, a kitchen, and a bathroom. There isn't a living room, but there is a big balcony. On the balcony, there are many plants. My bedroom is next to the kitchen. There is a desk in it. My computer is on the desk, and my books are under the bed. There is a night market behind my building. There is a bank on the corner, and a bus stop in front of it. There isn't a park near here, but there are two coffee shops between my building and the MRT station.
items.why: 原文：There are two bedrooms, a kitchen, and a bathroom. 有兩間臥室。
wn: 原文是 two bedrooms 兩間，不是一間。
原文是 two bedrooms 兩間，不是三間。

items.q: Is there a living room?
items.passage: I live in a small apartment in Taichung. There are two bedrooms, a kitchen, and a bathroom. There isn't a living room, but there is a big balcony. On the balcony, there are many plants. My bedroom is next to the kitchen. There is a desk in it. My computer is on the desk, and my books are under the bed. There is a night market behind my building. There is a bank on the corner, and a bus stop in front of it. There isn't a park near here, but there are two coffee shops between my building and the MRT station.
items.why: 原文：There isn't a living room. 沒有客廳，所以回答 No, there isn't.
wn: 原文說 There isn't a living room，沒有客廳。
問句是單數 Is there a…，要答 isn't。

items.q: Where is the computer?
items.passage: I live in a small apartment in Taichung. There are two bedrooms, a kitchen, and a bathroom. There isn't a living room, but there is a big balcony. On the balcony, there are many plants. My bedroom is next to the kitchen. There is a desk in it. My computer is on the desk, and my books are under the bed. There is a night market behind my building. There is a bank on the corner, and a bus stop in front of it. There isn't a park near here, but there are two coffee shops between my building and the MRT station.
items.why: 原文：My computer is on the desk. 電腦在書桌上。
wn: 在床底下的是 books 書，不是電腦。
陽台上的是 plants 植物，不是電腦。

items.q: What is behind the building?
items.passage: I live in a small apartment in Taichung. There are two bedrooms, a kitchen, and a bathroom. There isn't a living room, but there is a big balcony. On the balcony, there are many plants. My bedroom is next to the kitchen. There is a desk in it. My computer is on the desk, and my books are under the bed. There is a night market behind my building. There is a bank on the corner, and a bus stop in front of it. There isn't a park near here, but there are two coffee shops between my building and the MRT station.
items.why: 原文：There is a night market behind my building. 大樓後面是夜市。
wn: 銀行在 on the corner 轉角，不是大樓後面。
原文說 There isn't a park near here，附近沒有公園。

items.q: The bus stop is ___ the bank.
items.passage: I live in a small apartment in Taichung. There are two bedrooms, a kitchen, and a bathroom. There isn't a living room, but there is a big balcony. On the balcony, there are many plants. My bedroom is next to the kitchen. There is a desk in it. My computer is on the desk, and my books are under the bed. There is a night market behind my building. There is a bank on the corner, and a bus stop in front of it. There isn't a park near here, but there are two coffee shops between my building and the MRT station.
items.why: 原文：a bus stop in front of it. it 指前面說的 bank 銀行。
wn: between 是在兩者之間，文中用來說咖啡店的位置。
under 是在下面；公車站在銀行前面。

5.title: Week 5 檢測：可數不可數與 some/any

items.q: We need ___ eggs for the cake.
items.why: 肯定句，eggs 是複數，說一些用 some。
wn: an 只接單數；eggs 是複數。
any 用在否定或問句，這句是肯定的。

items.q: Is there ___ milk in the fridge?
items.why: Is there…? 是問句，milk 不可數，問句用 any。
wn: 一般問句多用 any，不用 some。
milk 不可數，不能說 a milk。

items.q: I don't have ___ money with me today.
items.why: 句子有 don't，是否定句。否定句用 any；money 不可數，不能加 a。
wn: some 用在肯定句；否定句 don't have 要配 any。
money 是不可數名詞，前面不能放 a。

items.q: She eats ___ apple every morning.
items.why: apple 可數單數，開頭 a 是母音的音，用 an：an apple。
wn: some 接複數或不可數；一顆 apple 用 an。
apple 是母音開頭，要用 an，不用 a。

items.q: ___ oranges do you want?
items.why: oranges 是複數、可以數，問幾顆用 How many。
wn: How much 接不可數，oranges 可以數。
單用 How 問方式，問數量要加 many。

items.q: ___ is this bag of rice?
items.why: 問價錢固定說 How much is…?：How much is this bag of rice?
wn: How many 問數量，不能問價錢。
單用 How is… 是問狀況好不好，問價錢要加 much。

items.q: I'd like ___ glass of water, please.
items.why: glass 可數單數，開頭 g 是子音，用 a：a glass of water。
wn: an 用在母音開頭的字，glass 是 g 開頭。

items.q: We would like ___ the menu, please.
items.why: would like 後面接 to 加動詞原形：would like to see。
wn: would like 後面要加 to，不能直接接 see。
would like 不接 -ing，要用 to see。

items.q: Would you like ___ tea?
items.why: Would you like…? 是請別人吃喝東西（提議），這時用 some；tea 不可數。
wn: a few 配可數複數，tea 不可數。
tea 不可數，前面不放 an；an 也只用在母音開頭的字前。

items.q: There isn't ___ bread on the table.
items.why: isn't 是否定句，bread 不可數，用 any：There isn't any bread.
wn: some 用在肯定句；這句是 isn't 否定。
bread 不可數，不能說 a bread。

items.q: My brother has two ___.
items.why: two 表示兩隻，可數名詞超過一個要加 s：dogs。
wn: two 是兩隻，dog 要加 s。
前面已經有 two，不能再加 a。

items.q: Rice ___ very cheap in Taiwan.
items.why: rice 不可數，不可數名詞當主詞時看成單數，用 is。
wn: are 配複數主詞；rice 不可數，當單數用。

items.q: Do you want ___ cheese on your pizza?
items.why: Do you want…? 是問句，cheese 不可數，問句用 any。
wn: cheese 不可數，不說 a cheese。
cheese 不可數不加冠詞；an 也只用在母音開頭的字。

items.q: They would like ___ at a Japanese restaurant tonight.
items.why: would like 後面接 to 加動詞原形：would like to eat。
wn: would like 後面要先加 to，不能直接接 eat。
would like 不接 -ing，要用 to eat。

items.q: How many ___ are there in the box?
items.why: How many 後面接可數複數，cookie 要加 s 變 cookies。
wn: How many 後面要用複數，cookie 要加 s。
sugar 不可數，要用 How much。

items.q: The ___ are on the shelf near the door.
items.why: 動詞是 are，主詞要複數：tomatoes（o 結尾加 es）。
wn: 後面是 are，主詞要用複數 tomatoes。
water 不可數，要配 is，不配 are。

items.q: I need ___ salt for the soup.
items.why: salt 不可數，肯定句說需要一些用 some salt。
wn: salt 不可數，前面不加 a。
any 多用在否定和問句；這是肯定句。

items.q: Two ___ of coffee, please.
items.why: Two 表示兩杯，cup 要變複數 cups：two cups of coffee。
wn: 前面有 Two，要用複數 cups。
Two 和 a 不能一起用，兩杯是 two cups。

items.q: How much ___ the strawberries?
items.why: the strawberries 有 s，是複數，問價錢用 How much are…?
wn: is 配單數，strawberries 是複數。
問價錢是 How much 加 be 動詞，不用 do。

items.q: ___ like some noodles with your soup?
items.why: 問句要把 would 放在主詞前面：Would you like…?
wn: You would 是敘述句的順序，問句要把 would 放前面。
would 本身就能放句首問，不再加 do。

items.q: We don't need ___ onions.
items.why: don't 是否定句，用 any；onions 複數可以配 any。
wn: onions 是複數，不能加 a。
some 用在肯定句；否定句 don't 配 any。

items.q: Mia has ___ orange juice in her bag.
items.why: orange juice 是果汁，不可數，肯定句用 some。
wn: 這裡是 juice 果汁，不可數，不是一顆 orange。
juice 不可數，不能說 a juice；也看 orange 是母音開頭。

items.q: ___ water do you drink every day?
items.why: water 不可數，問量用 How much water。
wn: How many 接可數複數，water 不可數。
How much of 後面要接 the／my 等，不能直接接 water。

items.q: Is there ___ ATM near the market?
items.why: ATM 唸成 A-T-M，開頭是母音的音（ei），用 an：an ATM。
wn: 看的是開頭的音；ATM 唸起來是母音開頭，用 an。
some 不接單數 ATM；Is there 配單數。

items.q: The chicken ___ 150 dollars.
items.why: 說價錢可用 be 動詞：The chicken is 150 dollars. chicken 當食物是單數，用 is。
wn: are 配複數；The chicken 是單數。
am 只配 I，The chicken 要用 is。

items.q: 「bread」是什麼意思？
items.why: bread＝麵包。例句：I would like some bread.

items.q: 「salt」是什麼意思？
items.why: salt＝鹽。例句：There isn't any salt in the soup.

items.q: 「strawberry」是什麼意思？
items.why: strawberry＝草莓。例句：Do you have any strawberries?

items.q: 「mushroom」是什麼意思？
items.why: mushroom＝蘑菇。例句：Are there any mushrooms in the soup?

items.q: 「fork」是什麼意思？
items.why: fork＝叉子。例句：There isn't any fork on the table.

items.q: 「expensive」是什麼意思？
items.why: expensive＝貴的。例句：That watch is too expensive.

items.q: 「money」是什麼意思？
items.why: money＝錢。例句：How much money do you have?

items.q: 「much」是什麼意思？
items.why: much＝多少（不可數疑問）。例句：How much water do you want?

items.q: 「bottle」是什麼意思？
items.why: bottle＝瓶。例句：I would like a bottle of juice.

items.q: 「is it fresh」是什麼意思？
items.why: is it fresh＝這新鮮嗎。例句：Is this fish fresh?

items.q: How many tomatoes does Amy buy?
items.passage: Every Saturday, Amy goes to the market near her home. Today she needs some vegetables and some fruit. She buys three tomatoes, two onions and a big cabbage. The tomatoes are 20 dollars each. She also wants some bananas, but there aren't any bananas today. Amy asks, "How much is the rice?" The man says, "It's 90 dollars for a bag." She buys one bag. Then she goes to a small coffee shop. She would like a cup of tea and a sandwich. The tea is 40 dollars and the sandwich is 60 dollars. Amy is happy. She has some good food for the weekend.
items.why: 原文：She buys three tomatoes. 她買了三顆番茄。
wn: 兩個是 onions 洋蔥，番茄是三顆。
一個是 cabbage 高麗菜，番茄是三顆。

items.q: Why doesn't Amy buy any bananas?
items.passage: Every Saturday, Amy goes to the market near her home. Today she needs some vegetables and some fruit. She buys three tomatoes, two onions and a big cabbage. The tomatoes are 20 dollars each. She also wants some bananas, but there aren't any bananas today. Amy asks, "How much is the rice?" The man says, "It's 90 dollars for a bag." She buys one bag. Then she goes to a small coffee shop. She would like a cup of tea and a sandwich. The tea is 40 dollars and the sandwich is 60 dollars. Amy is happy. She has some good food for the weekend.
items.why: 原文：but there aren't any bananas today. 今天沒有香蕉可買。
wn: 文中沒說香蕉太貴，是今天沒有香蕉。
原文說她想要 bananas，不是不喜歡。

items.q: How much is a bag of rice?
items.passage: Every Saturday, Amy goes to the market near her home. Today she needs some vegetables and some fruit. She buys three tomatoes, two onions and a big cabbage. The tomatoes are 20 dollars each. She also wants some bananas, but there aren't any bananas today. Amy asks, "How much is the rice?" The man says, "It's 90 dollars for a bag." She buys one bag. Then she goes to a small coffee shop. She would like a cup of tea and a sandwich. The tea is 40 dollars and the sandwich is 60 dollars. Amy is happy. She has some good food for the weekend.
items.why: 原文：It's 90 dollars for a bag. 一袋米 90 元。

items.q: What would Amy like at the coffee shop?
opts: A cup of coffee and a cake
A cup of tea and a sandwich
items.passage: Every Saturday, Amy goes to the market near her home. Today she needs some vegetables and some fruit. She buys three tomatoes, two onions and a big cabbage. The tomatoes are 20 dollars each. She also wants some bananas, but there aren't any bananas today. Amy asks, "How much is the rice?" The man says, "It's 90 dollars for a bag." She buys one bag. Then she goes to a small coffee shop. She would like a cup of tea and a sandwich. The tea is 40 dollars and the sandwich is 60 dollars. Amy is happy. She has some good food for the weekend.
items.why: 原文：She would like a cup of tea and a sandwich. would like 是想要。
wn: 她在咖啡店，但點的是茶和三明治，不是咖啡和蛋糕。

items.q: How much does Amy pay at the coffee shop?
items.passage: Every Saturday, Amy goes to the market near her home. Today she needs some vegetables and some fruit. She buys three tomatoes, two onions and a big cabbage. The tomatoes are 20 dollars each. She also wants some bananas, but there aren't any bananas today. Amy asks, "How much is the rice?" The man says, "It's 90 dollars for a bag." She buys one bag. Then she goes to a small coffee shop. She would like a cup of tea and a sandwich. The tea is 40 dollars and the sandwich is 60 dollars. Amy is happy. She has some good food for the weekend.
items.why: 原文：The tea is 40 dollars and the sandwich is 60. 40＋60＝100。
wn: 90 元是一袋米的價錢，不是在咖啡店付的。
40 元只是茶，還要加三明治 60 元。

items.q: Ken ___ at home last night because he was sick.
items.why: last night 是過去；主詞 Ken 是一個人，用 was。
wn: were 配 you／we／they；Ken 一個人用 was。
is 是現在式；last night 要用過去式。

items.q: We ___ very tired after the long trip last week.
items.why: last week 是上週，說旅行後當時很累，用過去式；We 是複數，用 were。
wn: was 配單數，We 是複數。
are 是現在式；本題說旅行後當時的感覺。

items.q: ___ you at the office yesterday afternoon?
items.why: yesterday afternoon 是過去；主詞 you 用 Were。
wn: you 不管一個人或多人，都用 were。
後面是地點 at the office，沒有一般動詞，要用 be 動詞。

items.q: The movie ___ good, so we left early.
items.why: 後半句 we left 是過去；movie 單數，後面是形容詞，用 wasn't。
wn: the movie 是單數，用 wasn't。
後面是形容詞 good，沒有一般動詞，要用 be 動詞。

items.q: My parents ___ home last weekend. They were in Tainan.
items.why: 後句 They were 是過去；parents 複數，後面是地點，用 weren't。
wn: 後面是地點 home，沒有一般動詞，要用 be 動詞。

items.q: She ___ the piano for two hours yesterday.
items.why: yesterday 是過去；play 是母音＋y，直接加 ed：played。
wn: play 直接加 ed，不能只加 d。
a＋y 是母音＋y，不用改 i，直接加 ed：played。

items.q: I ___ for the test all last week.
items.why: all last week 是過去；study 去 y 加 ied：studied。
wn: 子音＋y 結尾要把 y 改 i 再加 ed：studied。
y 不能拿掉，要把 y 改 i 再加 ed：studied。

items.q: The bus ___ in front of the bank.
items.why: stop 是短母音＋一個子音結尾，加 ed 前要重複 p：stopped。
wn: stop 要重複字尾 p 再加 ed，少了一個 p。
英文沒有 stopt 這種拼法，要寫 stopped。

items.q: They ___ to Japan two years ago.
items.why: two years ago 是兩年前，用過去式；go 不規則，過去式是 went。
wn: go 不規則，沒有 goed，要用 went。
go 是現在式，跟 two years ago 對不上。

items.q: We ___ dumplings for dinner last night.
items.why: last night 是過去，eat 的過去式是不規則的 ate。
wn: eat 是不規則動詞，過去式是 ate，沒有 eated。
有 last night，要用過去式 ate。

items.q: Lisa ___ a bad cold last week.
items.why: last week 是過去；have a cold 的過去式是 had。
wn: has 是現在式；last week 要用過去式 had。
have 是不規則動詞，過去式是 had，沒有 haved。

items.q: I ___ your sister at the station this morning.
items.why: this morning 的事已經發生了，see 的過去式是 saw。
wn: see 不規則，不能加 ed；seed 是種子。
see 是現在式；早上看到是過去的事，用 saw。

items.q: He ___ his homework before dinner.
items.why: 做功課是過去的事，do 的過去式是不規則的 did。
wn: done 是過去分詞，不能單獨當過去式用。
do 是不規則動詞，過去式是 did，沒有 doed。

items.q: My mother ___ a big cake for my birthday.
items.why: 講過去生日做蛋糕，make 的過去式是不規則的 made。
wn: make 是不規則動詞，過去式是 made，沒有 maked。
主詞 My mother 現在式也要 makes；這裡用過去式 made。

items.q: We ___ up late last Sunday.
items.why: last Sunday 是上週日，用過去式；get up 的過去式是 got up。
wn: get 是不規則動詞，過去式是 got，沒有 getted。
這裡講過去的事，用過去式 got。

items.q: Tom ___ to Taiwan in 2020.
items.why: in 2020 是過去的年份；come 不規則，過去式是 came。
wn: come 不規則，沒有 comed，要用 came。
Tom 是一個人，而且 2020 年要用過去式。

items.q: She ___ a taxi to the airport.
items.why: 搭計程車去機場是發生過的事；take 不規則，過去式是 took。
wn: take 不規則，沒有 taked，要用 took。
She 是一個人，原形 take 不行。

items.q: I ___ a new phone last month.
items.why: last month 是過去；buy 的過去式是不規則的 bought。
wn: buy 是不規則動詞，過去式是 bought，沒有 buyed。
有 last month，要用過去式 bought。

items.q: He ___ to work yesterday. He stayed in bed.
items.why: yesterday 是過去，否定用 didn't＋原形：didn't go。
wn: didn't 後面接原形 go，不再用 went。
don't 是現在式；yesterday 要用 didn't。

items.q: I ___ breakfast this morning, so I'm hungry now.
items.why: 今天早上沒吃（過去），否定是 didn't + 原形：didn't eat。
wn: didn't 已經表示過去，後面不能再用 ate。
not 不能直接放動詞前，要用 didn't。

items.q: ___ you ___ the email yesterday?
items.why: yesterday 是過去；問句用 Did，Did 後面動詞用原形 send。
wn: Do 是現在式；yesterday 要用 Did。
Did 已經表示過去，後面不再用 sent，用原形 send。

items.q: ___ she call you last night?
items.why: last night 是過去，後面是一般動詞 call，問句用 Did。
wn: Does 是現在式；last night 要用 Did。
後面是一般動詞 call，不用 be 動詞，用 Did。

items.q: Where ___ they ___ last summer?
items.why: last summer 是過去；問句用 did，did 後面動詞用原形 go。
wn: do 是現在式；last summer 要用 did。
did 已經表示過去，後面不再用 went，用原形 go。

items.q: I visited my grandmother two weeks ___.
items.why: 一段時間＋ago 表示多久以前：two weeks ago（兩週前）。
wn: before 要接事情或時間點，不單獨放在 two weeks 後面表示以前。
last 放在時間詞前面（last week），不放在後面。

items.q: We watched a great show ___ night.
items.why: 昨天晚上的固定說法是 last night。
wn: 英文不說 yesterday night，要說 last night。
ago 要放在一段時間後面，例如 two days ago。

items.q: 「yesterday」是什麼意思？
items.why: yesterday＝昨天。例句：I was at home yesterday.

items.q: 「hungry」是什麼意思？
items.why: hungry＝餓的。例句：I am hungry now.

items.q: 「played」是什麼意思？
items.why: played＝玩了。例句：He played soccer last week.

items.q: 「listened」是什麼意思？
items.why: listened＝聽了。例句：She listened to the radio.

items.q: 「do」是什麼意思？
items.why: do＝做。例句：I do my homework every night.

items.q: 「didn't」是什麼意思？
items.why: didn't＝沒有（did not 縮寫）。例句：I didn't go to school yesterday.

items.q: 「rain」是什麼意思？
items.why: rain＝下雨。例句：Did it rain yesterday?

items.q: 「shopping」是什麼意思？
items.why: shopping＝購物。例句：She went shopping last weekend.

items.q: 「swam」是什麼意思？
items.why: swam＝游泳了。例句：We swam at the beach last weekend.

items.q: 「after that」是什麼意思？
items.why: after that＝之後。例句：After that, we had lunch.

items.q: What did the writer buy in the morning?
items.passage: Last Sunday was my friend Jenny's birthday. In the morning, I went to a bakery and bought a small chocolate cake. Then I took the MRT to her house. Jenny's mother made a lot of food. We ate noodles, chicken and fruit. After lunch, we played games and watched a funny movie. Jenny's brother didn't come because he was in Taichung for work. He called her at night. At six o'clock, Jenny saw the cake. She was very happy. I got home at nine and went to bed early. It was a great day.
items.why: 原文：I went to a bakery and bought a small chocolate cake.
wn: 水果是在 Jenny 家吃的，不是作者買的。

items.q: How did the writer go to Jenny's house?
items.passage: Last Sunday was my friend Jenny's birthday. In the morning, I went to a bakery and bought a small chocolate cake. Then I took the MRT to her house. Jenny's mother made a lot of food. We ate noodles, chicken and fruit. After lunch, we played games and watched a funny movie. Jenny's brother didn't come because he was in Taichung for work. He called her at night. At six o'clock, Jenny saw the cake. She was very happy. I got home at nine and went to bed early. It was a great day.
items.why: 原文：Then I took the MRT to her house. 作者搭捷運去。
wn: 原文說 took the MRT 搭捷運，不是公車。
原文說 took the MRT 搭捷運，不是計程車。

items.q: Who made the food?
items.passage: Last Sunday was my friend Jenny's birthday. In the morning, I went to a bakery and bought a small chocolate cake. Then I took the MRT to her house. Jenny's mother made a lot of food. We ate noodles, chicken and fruit. After lunch, we played games and watched a funny movie. Jenny's brother didn't come because he was in Taichung for work. He called her at night. At six o'clock, Jenny saw the cake. She was very happy. I got home at nine and went to bed early. It was a great day.
items.why: 原文：Jenny's mother made a lot of food. 做菜的是 Jenny 的媽媽。
wn: Jenny 的兄弟那天沒來，他在台中。
作者只買了蛋糕，菜是 Jenny 媽媽做的。

items.q: Why didn't Jenny's brother come?
opts: He was in Taichung for work.
items.passage: Last Sunday was my friend Jenny's birthday. In the morning, I went to a bakery and bought a small chocolate cake. Then I took the MRT to her house. Jenny's mother made a lot of food. We ate noodles, chicken and fruit. After lunch, we played games and watched a funny movie. Jenny's brother didn't come because he was in Taichung for work. He called her at night. At six o'clock, Jenny saw the cake. She was very happy. I got home at nine and went to bed early. It was a great day.
items.why: 原文：because he was in Taichung for work. because 後面就是原因。
wn: 文中沒說他生病，是因為在台中工作。
文中沒說他不喜歡派對，是因為在台中工作。

items.q: What time did the writer get home?
items.passage: Last Sunday was my friend Jenny's birthday. In the morning, I went to a bakery and bought a small chocolate cake. Then I took the MRT to her house. Jenny's mother made a lot of food. We ate noodles, chicken and fruit. After lunch, we played games and watched a funny movie. Jenny's brother didn't come because he was in Taichung for work. He called her at night. At six o'clock, Jenny saw the cake. She was very happy. I got home at nine and went to bed early. It was a great day.
items.why: 原文：I got home at nine and went to bed early. 作者九點到家。
wn: 六點是 Jenny 看到蛋糕的時間。
原文是 at nine 九點，文中沒有十點。

7.title: Week 7 檢測：be going to 與 can

items.q: I ___ visit my aunt this weekend.
items.why: 未來計畫用 be going to＋原形；主詞 I 配 am：I am going to visit。
wn: 少了 be 動詞，I 後面要有 am：I am going to。
這裡要用 going，固定說法是 am going to。

items.q: She ___ to cook dinner tonight.
items.why: tonight 是今晚的計畫，She 配 is：She is going to cook。
wn: 少了 be 動詞，She 後面要有 is。
goes to cook 不是計畫的說法，要用 is going to。

items.q: They ___ going to watch the game tomorrow.
items.why: 主詞 They 是複數，be 動詞用 are。
wn: is 配一個人或一件事，They 用 are。
am 只配 I，They 用 are。

items.q: We ___ going to work next Monday. It's a holiday.
items.why: 主詞 We 是複數，be going to 的否定是 aren't going to。
wn: isn't 配單數，We 是複數。
going to 前面要用 be 動詞，不用 don't。

items.q: He isn't going ___ the bus. He's going to walk.
items.why: be going to 後面接原形動詞，否定是 isn't going to take。
wn: 少了 to，going 後面要先接 to 再接原形：going to take。
going 後面要接 to 加原形 take，不接 taking。

items.q: ___ you going to buy a new bike?
items.why: be going to 的問句把 be 動詞放最前面；主詞 you 用 Are。
wn: going to 前面要用 be 動詞，不用 Do。
Is 配單數，主詞 you 要用 Are。

items.q: ___ is she going to do after class?
items.why: 線索是句尾的 do：問她要做什麼事，用 What。
wn: Where 問地點；句尾有 do，是問做什麼。
Who 問人；她要做的是一件事，用 What。

items.q: Look at the clouds! It ___ rain soon.
items.why: 看到烏雲，預測快下雨；It 配 is：It is going to rain.
wn: 少了 be 動詞，It 後面要有 is。
will 和 going to 不能一起用，選一個就好。

items.q: My sister is going to ___ a cake for the party.
items.why: going to 後面接原形動詞；做蛋糕說 make a cake。
wn: going to 後面不接 V-ing，要原形 make。
going to 後面要原形，不加 s。

items.q: I'm going to ___ home this weekend. I need a rest.
items.why: going to 後面接原形；待在家說 stay home。
wn: going to 後面不接 V-ing，要原形 stay。
going to 後面要原形，不加 s。

items.q: Ben ___ Japanese very well. He lived in Tokyo for ten years.
items.why: 線索是在東京住了十年，所以會說日文；can 後接原形 speak。
wn: 住東京十年又 very well，應該是會說，不是不會。
can 後面要原形，speak 不加 s。

items.q: I ___ drive, so I always take the bus.
items.why: 所以總是搭公車，表示不會開車；不會用 can't。
wn: 會開車就不需要總是搭公車，前後意思不合。
can 後面直接接動詞，不加 to；意思也不合。

items.q: My grandmother ___ read without her glasses, so she always wears them.
items.why: 線索是 so she always wears them：沒戴眼鏡就看不到，所以是不能 can't。
wn: can 是能夠；能看就不必一直戴眼鏡，和後半句矛盾。
can 不管主詞是誰都不加 s，沒有 cans 這種寫法。

items.q: A: ___ your brother ride a horse? B: Yes, he can.
items.why: 線索是回答 Yes, he can：用什麼問就用什麼答，問句用 Can。
wn: 用 Does 問，回答會是 Yes, he does，不是 he can。
Is 後面不能接原形 ride，回答也不會是 he can。

items.q: Lily can ___ two languages.
items.why: can 後面接原形動詞：can speak。
wn: can 後面不加 s，Lily 是一個人也一樣。
can 後面直接接原形，不加 to。

items.q: I can't ___ the small words on the menu.
items.why: can't 後面接原形動詞 read：看不清菜單上的小字。
wn: can't 後面不接 ing，要用原形。
can't 後面直接接原形，不加 to。

items.q: The baby is only six months old. She ___ walk yet.
items.why: 六個月大的嬰兒還不會走路，能力上辦不到，用 can't 加原形 walk。
wn: 前面說才六個月大，yet 也表示還沒，要用否定 can't。
isn't 後面不能接原形動詞 walk，不會做某事用 can't。

items.q: ___ like to come to my birthday party on Saturday?
items.why: 邀請別人用 Would you like to…?（想不想…），是禮貌的固定說法。
wn: Do you like to 是問平常喜不喜歡，邀請要用 Would you。
Are you 後面不能直接接動詞 like，句子不成立。

items.q: It's hot today. ___ go to the beach!
items.why: 天氣熱，提議一起去海邊，用 Let's＋原形：Let's go。
wn: We go to the beach 只是陳述，沒有一起去吧的提議語氣。
Let 後面要接人（Let me），提議一起做要用 Let's。

items.q: Would you like ___ a movie with us tonight?
items.why: Would you like 後面接 to＋原形動詞：like to see。
wn: like 後面少了 to，要說 like to see。
Would you like 後面用 to see，不接 V-ing。

items.q: A: Let's ___ tennis this afternoon. B: Good idea!
items.why: Let's 後面接原形動詞：Let's play tennis。
wn: Let's 後面不接 V-ing，要原形 play。
Let's 後面直接接原形，不加 to。

items.q: We are going to have a picnic ___.
items.why: are going to 說未來的計畫，時間詞要配未來：tomorrow。
wn: yesterday 是過去，不能配 going to。
last week 是過去，不能配 going to。

items.q: Are you going to visit Kaohsiung ___?
items.why: 線索是 going to，講未來的計畫，所以配 next week 下週。
wn: last night 是昨晚，已經過去，和 going to 不合。
ago 是多久以前，前面要有時間（two days ago），也是過去。

items.q: I'm going to see the doctor ___ Friday.
items.why: 線索是 going to，表示未來，所以用 next Friday 下週五。
wn: 星期幾前面不用 in；要說 on Friday 或 next Friday。
last Friday 是上週五，已經過去，和 going to 不合。

items.q: The weather is going to be ___ tomorrow, so bring an umbrella.
items.why: 線索是 so bring an umbrella：要帶傘，表示明天會下雨 rainy。
wn: sunny 是晴天，和帶雨傘的提醒對不上。
cold 冷要多穿衣服，不是帶雨傘的理由。

items.q: 「tomorrow」是什麼意思？
items.why: tomorrow＝明天。例句：I am going to study English tomorrow.

items.q: 「move」是什麼意思？
items.why: move＝搬家。例句：They are going to move to a new house.

items.q: 「speak」是什麼意思？
items.why: speak＝說(語言)。例句：I can speak English a little.

items.q: 「skate」是什麼意思？
items.why: skate＝溜冰。例句：He can skate on the ice.

items.q: 「photography」是什麼意思？
items.why: photography＝攝影。例句：I am interested in photography.

items.q: 「hobby」是什麼意思？
items.why: hobby＝嗜好。例句：What is your hobby?

items.q: 「forecast」是什麼意思？
items.why: forecast＝天氣預報。例句：The weather forecast says it will rain.

items.q: 「movie」是什麼意思？
items.why: movie＝電影。例句：We like this movie.

items.q: 「museum」是什麼意思？
items.why: museum＝博物館。例句：There is a museum in the city.

items.q: 「suitcase」是什麼意思？
items.why: suitcase＝行李箱。例句：I am going to pack my suitcase tonight.

items.q: How is the family going to go to Hualien?
items.passage: Next weekend is a long weekend, and my family is going to go to Hualien. We are going to take the train on Friday morning. My father can drive, but he doesn't want to drive for three hours. On Saturday, we are going to ride bikes by the sea. My little brother can't ride a bike yet, so he is going to sit behind my mother. The weather is going to be sunny and warm. On Saturday night, we are going to eat at a night market. On Sunday, we aren't going to do much. We are going to come home in the afternoon. I can't wait!
items.why: 原文：We are going to take the train on Friday morning. 他們要搭火車去。
wn: 爸爸會開車，但不想開，所以不開車去。
文中沒提到公車，他們搭火車。

items.q: Why isn't the father going to drive?
opts: He doesn't want to drive for three hours.
items.passage: Next weekend is a long weekend, and my family is going to go to Hualien. We are going to take the train on Friday morning. My father can drive, but he doesn't want to drive for three hours. On Saturday, we are going to ride bikes by the sea. My little brother can't ride a bike yet, so he is going to sit behind my mother. The weather is going to be sunny and warm. On Saturday night, we are going to eat at a night market. On Sunday, we aren't going to do much. We are going to come home in the afternoon. I can't wait!
items.why: 原文：he doesn't want to drive for three hours. 他會開，只是不想開。
wn: 原文說 My father can drive，他會開車。
文中沒說他沒有車，是不想開三小時。

items.q: What are they going to do on Saturday?
items.passage: Next weekend is a long weekend, and my family is going to go to Hualien. We are going to take the train on Friday morning. My father can drive, but he doesn't want to drive for three hours. On Saturday, we are going to ride bikes by the sea. My little brother can't ride a bike yet, so he is going to sit behind my mother. The weather is going to be sunny and warm. On Saturday night, we are going to eat at a night market. On Sunday, we aren't going to do much. We are going to come home in the afternoon. I can't wait!
items.why: 原文：On Saturday, we are going to ride bikes by the sea.

items.q: Who can't ride a bike?
items.passage: Next weekend is a long weekend, and my family is going to go to Hualien. We are going to take the train on Friday morning. My father can drive, but he doesn't want to drive for three hours. On Saturday, we are going to ride bikes by the sea. My little brother can't ride a bike yet, so he is going to sit behind my mother. The weather is going to be sunny and warm. On Saturday night, we are going to eat at a night market. On Sunday, we aren't going to do much. We are going to come home in the afternoon. I can't wait!
items.why: 原文：My little brother can't ride a bike yet. 弟弟還不會騎腳踏車。
wn: 媽媽會騎，弟弟要坐在她後面。
文中說爸爸會開車，沒說他不會騎腳踏車。

items.q: When are they going to come home?
items.passage: Next weekend is a long weekend, and my family is going to go to Hualien. We are going to take the train on Friday morning. My father can drive, but he doesn't want to drive for three hours. On Saturday, we are going to ride bikes by the sea. My little brother can't ride a bike yet, so he is going to sit behind my mother. The weather is going to be sunny and warm. On Saturday night, we are going to eat at a night market. On Sunday, we aren't going to do much. We are going to come home in the afternoon. I can't wait!
items.why: 原文：We are going to come home in the afternoon. 指星期天下午。
wn: 星期六晚上是去夜市吃東西。
原文說 in the afternoon 下午，不是早上。

9.title: 補充週檢測（現在進行式）

items.q: We ___ a game every morning.
items.why: every morning 是習慣，用現在簡單式；We 是複數，用原形 play。
wn: 沒有 are，-ing 不能單獨當動詞。
every morning 是習慣；is 也不配 We。
加 s 只給一個人，We 是複數。

items.q: My father ___ talking to the teacher at the moment.
items.why: My father 一個人，be 動詞用 is；at the moment 加 talking 是進行式。
wn: are 配複數或 you，My father 是一個人。
be 是原形，要改成 is。

items.q: They ___ watching the game now.
items.why: watching 是 -ing，否定用 be 動詞；They 配 are，所以用 aren't。
wn: doesn't 配單數且接原形，They 是複數。
don't 後面接原形 watch，不接 watching。
少了 be 動詞，要說 They aren't。

items.q: I ___ talking on the phone today.
items.why: 主詞 I 的 be 動詞固定用 am：I am talking。
wn: is 配他／她／它，不配 I。
be 是原形，要改成 am。
are 配 you 或複數，I 用 am。

items.q: My brother is ___ basketball now.
items.why: is 後面接 -ing；play 的 y 前是母音，y 不變直接加 ing：playing。
wn: 前面有 is，要用 -ing 形。

items.q: They ___ taking a shower today.
items.why: They 是複數，be 動詞用 are，加 taking 表示進行中。
wn: is 配一個人，They 是複數。
be 是原形，要改成 are。

items.q: My friends are ___ the computer now.
items.why: are 後面接 -ing；use 結尾的 e 去掉再加 ing：using。
wn: 多寫了 e；use 是去 e 加 ing。
前面有 are，要用 -ing 形。
use 的 e 要先拿掉：using。

items.q: What ___ she doing? She is cleaning my room.
items.why: 主詞 she 一個人，回答也用 She is，所以問 What is she doing?
wn: be 是原形，要改成 is。
are 配複數或 you，she 是一個人。

items.q: The children ___ cleaning my room right now.
items.why: children 是複數，配 are；後面 cleaning 是進行式，否定用 aren't。
wn: doesn't 配單數且接原形，不接 cleaning。
少了 be 動詞，要說 aren't。
isn't 配一個人，children 是好幾個孩子。

items.q: He ___ drinking coffee today.
items.why: He 是一個人，be 動詞用 is：He is drinking。
wn: are 配複數或 you，He 是一個人。
be 是原形，要改成 is。

items.q: Amy ___ waiting for the bus at the moment.
items.why: waiting 是 -ing，否定用 be 動詞加 not；Amy 一個人用 isn't。
wn: don't 後面接原形，也不配 Amy。
aren't 配複數或 you，Amy 是一個人。
少了 be 動詞，要說 Amy isn't。

items.q: My friends ___ using my phone today.
items.why: My friends 有 s 是複數，be 動詞用 are：are using。
wn: be 是原形，要改成 are。
is 配一個人，friends 是複數。

items.q: She ___ running to the station right now.
items.why: running 是 -ing，否定用 be 動詞加 not；She 一個人用 isn't。
wn: don't 後面接原形，也不配 She。
doesn't 後面要接原形 run，不接 running。
少了 be 動詞，要說 She isn't。

items.q: Ken and Lisa ___ waiting for the bus today.
items.why: Ken and Lisa 兩個人配 are；後面 waiting 是進行式，否定用 aren't。
wn: isn't 配一個人，這裡是兩個人。
doesn't 配一個人且接原形，不接 waiting。
少了 be 動詞，要說 aren't。

items.q: What ___ my brother doing? He is drinking water.
items.why: my brother 一個人，回答用 He is，所以問 What is my brother doing?
wn: be 是原形，要改成 is。
are 配複數，my brother 是一個人。

items.q: My father ___ talking on the phone now.
items.why: talking 是 -ing，否定用 be 動詞加 not；My father 一個人用 isn't。
wn: 少了 be 動詞，要說 My father isn't。
aren't 配複數或 you，My father 是一個人。
doesn't 後面接原形 talk，不接 talking。

items.q: We ___ sleeping in the bedroom right now.
items.why: We 配 are；sleeping 是進行式，否定用 aren't。
wn: don't 後面接原形 sleep，不接 sleeping。
doesn't 配單數且接原形，這裡不行。
isn't 配一個人，We 是複數。

items.q: I ___ wearing jeans now.
items.why: 主詞 I 配 am，加 wearing 表示現在穿著：I am wearing。
wn: are 配 you 或複數，I 用 am。
is 配他／她／它，不配 I。
be 是原形，要改成 am。

items.q: She is ___ an email now.
items.why: is 後面接 -ing；write 去掉 e 再加 ing：writing。
wn: 前面有 is，要用 -ing 形。
多了 e；write 要去 e 再加 ing。

items.q: We ___ running to the station at the moment.
items.why: We 是複數，be 動詞用 are；at the moment 加 running 是進行式。
wn: be 是原形，要改成 are。
is 配一個人，We 是複數。

items.q: Is my mother cleaning my room at the moment? No, she ___.
items.why: 用 Is 問就用 is 答；No 是否定：No, she isn't。
wn: 問句用 Is，回答也用 be 動詞；No 也要否定。
am 只配 I；she 用 is。
aren't 配複數，she 是一個人。

items.q: We ___ learning to drive today.
items.why: We 配 are；learning 是 -ing，否定用 aren't。
wn: 少了 be 動詞，要說 We aren't。
isn't 配一個人，We 是複數。
don't 後面接原形 learn，不接 learning。

items.q: My brother ___ eating an apple today.
items.why: My brother 一個人，be 動詞用 is：is eating。
wn: are 配複數或 you，My brother 是一個人。
be 是原形，要改成 is。

items.q: Is my father cooking soup now? Yes, he ___.
items.why: 用 Is 問就用 is 答；Yes 是肯定：Yes, he is。
wn: 問句用 Is，回答也用 be 動詞 is。
aren't 配複數，而且 Yes 不接否定。
Yes 後面要肯定，不能接 isn't。

items.q: She ___ washing the dishes at the moment.
items.why: washing 是 -ing，否定用 be 動詞；She 一個人用 isn't。
wn: aren't 配複數或 you，She 是一個人。
doesn't 後面接原形 wash，不接 washing。
don't 是現在簡單式，也不配 She。

items.q: 「wait」是什麼意思？
items.why: wait＝等。例句：We are waiting for the bus.

items.q: 「message」是什麼意思？
items.why: message＝訊息。例句：He is writing a message.

items.q: 「walk」是什麼意思？
items.why: walk＝走路。例句：We walked to school.

items.q: 「cry」是什麼意思？
items.why: cry＝哭。例句：The baby is crying.

items.q: 「laugh」是什麼意思？
items.why: laugh＝笑。例句：They are laughing.

items.q: 「now」是什麼意思？
items.why: now＝現在。例句：Are you busy now?

items.q: 「online」是什麼意思？
items.why: online＝在網路上。例句：I am shopping online.

items.q: 「wear」是什麼意思？
items.why: wear＝穿著。例句：He is wearing a hat.

items.q: 「right now」是什麼意思？
items.why: right now＝此刻。例句：She is busy right now.

items.q: 「phone」是什麼意思？
items.why: phone＝電話。例句：He has a new phone.

items.q: Is this ___ umbrella, or is it ___ umbrella?
items.why: umbrella 是名詞，前面要用所有格：your umbrella、his umbrella。
wn: you、he 不能放名詞前面，要用 your、his。
him 是受詞，名詞前面要用 his。

items.q: ___ apples here are cheaper than ___ oranges over there.
items.why: apples here 是近的複數，用 These；oranges over there 是遠的複數，用 those。
wn: apples、oranges 都是複數，要用 these、those。
oranges 是複數，遠的要用 those。

items.q: Where ___ you when I called? You ___ at home.
items.why: 問過去在哪裡，用 be 動詞過去式；主詞 you 配 were，否定是 weren't。
wn: was 配 I／he／she，you 要用 were。
句中沒有一般動詞，問在哪裡要用 be 動詞 were。

items.q: The Wangs live next door. ___ garden is beautiful, and ___ have three cats.
items.why: garden 是名詞，前面用所有格 Their；後半句缺主詞，用 they：they have three cats。
wn: 順序反了：名詞前用 Their，當主詞用 they。
Theirs 後面不接名詞，garden 前面要用 Their。

items.q: Lily ___ usually ___ breakfast because she gets up late.
items.why: Lily 一個人，否定用 doesn't；doesn't 後面的動詞要用原形 eat，不加 s。
wn: Lily 一個人要用 doesn't；後面動詞也不加 s。
doesn't 後面的動詞用原形 eat，不加 s。

items.q: It ___ a lot in Taipei in spring, so I ___ an umbrella every day.
items.why: It 是第三人稱單數，rain 要加 s：It rains；主詞 I 用原形 carry。
wn: It 是單數，現在簡單式的 rain 要加 s。
主詞 I 不加 s，用原形 carry。

items.q: There is a bus stop ___ the hospital, so you can wait there.
items.why: 公車站在醫院外面可以等車，只有一個地點 the hospital，用 in front of（在…前面）。
wn: between 要接兩樣東西（A and B），這裡只有醫院。
in 是在裡面，公車站不會在醫院裡。

items.q: The shops ___ closed today because it ___ a holiday.
items.why: The shops 是複數，用 are；it 是單數，用 is。
wn: The shops 有 s 是複數，要用 are。

items.q: How ___ water do you drink every day? — About two litres.
items.why: water 是不可數名詞，問多少量用 How much。
wn: many 配可數複數，water 不可數。
沒有 How some 的說法，問量用 How much。

items.q: Your keys are ___ the table, ___ the lamp.
items.why: 鑰匙放在桌面上用 on；只有一樣東西 the lamp，在旁邊用 next to。
wn: 鑰匙放在桌面上，用 on；in 是在裡面。
between 要接兩樣東西，這裡只有 the lamp。

items.q: They ___ to the concert because the tickets ___ too expensive.
items.why: 過去否定用 didn't＋原形 go；tickets 是複數，過去的 be 動詞用 were。
wn: didn't 後面要接原形 go，不接 went。

items.q: There ___ a lot of people at the party, but there ___ any music.
items.why: a lot of people 是複數，用 were；music 不可數，當單數，用 wasn't。
wn: 相反了：people 複數用 were，music 不可數用 wasn't。

items.q: ___ you ___ the film last night? — No, I ___.
items.why: last night 是過去，問句用 Did，Did 後面動詞用原形 see；回答也用 didn't。
wn: Did 已經表示過去，後面動詞要用原形 see。
last night 是過去，要用 Did 和 didn't。

items.q: Does your sister ___ a boyfriend?
items.why: 問句已經用了 Does，後面的動詞要用原形 have。
wn: Does 已經配了單數，後面要用原形 have。
Does 後面接原形動詞，不接 -ing。

items.q: It's very late. I ___ go to bed now.
items.why: 決定馬上要做的事用 be going to＋原形動詞；主詞 I，所以是 am going to go。
wn: going to 前面少了 be 動詞 am。
要用 going，不是 go：am going to。

items.q: The last train ___ at eleven, so we always ___ the shop early.
items.why: The last train 是一班車（單數），動詞加 s：leaves；we 是複數，close 不加 s。
wn: 剛好相反：train 單數要加 s，we 複數不加 s。
主詞 we 是複數，close 不加 s。

items.q: ___ these your keys, or ___ this one yours?
items.why: these 是複數，配 Are；this one 是一個，配 is。
wn: 剛好相反：these 複數用 are，this one 單數用 is。
後半句 this one 只有一個，要用 is。

items.q: We didn't buy ___ vegetables because there weren't ___ at the market.
items.why: didn't buy 和 weren't 都是否定句，否定句的「一些」都用 any。
wn: 兩句都是否定，要用 any。
weren't 也是否定，後面也要用 any。

items.q: He ___ at work yesterday, and he ___ at work now.
items.why: yesterday 是過去，用 wasn't；now 是現在，用 isn't。at work 前面要用 be 動詞。
wn: 時間反了：yesterday 用 wasn't，now 用 isn't。
at work 前面要用 be 動詞，過去否定是 wasn't。

items.q: The weather ___ terrible yesterday, so we ___ at home all day.
items.why: yesterday 是過去；The weather 是單數，用 was；stay 加 ed 變 stayed。
wn: The weather 是單數，過去式用 was。
yesterday 是過去，stay 要加 ed。

items.q: How ___ students ___ in your class?
items.why: students 可數，用 How many；問有幾個是 there are 的問句，are 移到前面：are there。
wn: students 可以數，不用 much；複數也不配 is。
這是問句，要把 are 放到 there 前面：are there。

items.q: ___ you like to join us for dinner tomorrow? — Yes, I'd love to.
items.why: 回答 Yes, I'd love to.，是在接受邀請。邀請別人用 Would you like to…?
wn: Do you like to…? 是問平常喜不喜歡，不是邀請。
like 是動詞，前面不用 be 動詞。

items.q: Is there ___ post office in this town? — No, there ___.
items.why: post office 是單數可數，問有沒有一間用 a；Is there 的否定回答是 there isn't。
wn: post office 是一間（單數），要用 a。
問 Is there，回答要一致用 isn't。

items.q: My grandfather ___ a car, but he ___ a bicycle.
items.why: My grandfather 一個人：否定說 doesn't have（have 用原形），肯定說 has。
wn: 沒有東西要說 doesn't have；後面 he 也要用 has。
My grandfather 一個人，否定要用 doesn't。

items.q: I ___ very early this morning, and I ___ my breakfast quickly.
items.why: this morning 已經過去了，兩個動詞都用過去式：get up → got up，eat → ate。
wn: get up 也要改成過去式 got up。
eat 是不規則動詞，過去式是 ate。

items.q: I can't find ___ glasses. Are they on ___ desk?
items.why: glasses、desk 是名詞，名詞前面要用所有格：my glasses、your desk。
wn: me、you 是受詞，名詞前面要用 my、your。
mine、yours 後面不接名詞，要單獨用（It's mine.）。

items.q: Why ___ the children so happy this morning?
items.why: 主詞是 the children（一群小孩，複數），be 動詞用 are。
wn: is 配一個人，children 是 child 的複數。

items.q: ___ a small park behind our office building.
items.why: 說某個地方有什麼東西用 There is／are；a small park 只有一個，用 There is。
wn: It is 指已經講過的東西，說某處有什麼要用 There is。
a small park 只有一個，要用 There is。

items.q: I ___ come to the meeting on Monday because I have a doctor's appointment.
items.why: because 後面說要看醫生，所以是沒辦法來，用 can't＋原形 come。
wn: 有看醫生的約，邏輯上是不能來。
don't come 是說平常不來；這裡是沒辦法來，用 can't。

items.q: I ___ hungry now because I had a big lunch.
items.why: hungry 是形容詞（餓的），前面要用 be 動詞；主詞 I，否定是 am not。
wn: not 前面要有 be 動詞：I am not hungry。
hungry 不是動詞，否定要用 am not。

items.q: We ___ a car last year, but this year we ___ buy one.
items.why: last year 是過去，用 didn't have；this year 打算買，用 are going to＋原形 buy。
wn: last year 是過去，要用 didn't have。
going to 前面要有 be 動詞，We 用 are。

items.q: ___ your boss ___ on Saturdays?
items.why: your boss 一個人，一般動詞問句用 Does；Does 後面動詞用原形 work。
wn: your boss 是一個人，要用 Does。
Does 後面的動詞用原形，不加 s。

items.q: Last year my family ___ to Japan, and we ___ a great time.
items.why: Last year 是過去，兩個動詞都用過去式：go → went，have → had（都是不規則）。
wn: go 是不規則動詞，過去式是 went，不能加 ed。
Last year 是過去，have 要改成 had。

items.q: How often ___ your parents ___ you?
items.why: your parents 是複數，一般動詞問句用 do；do 後面動詞用原形 visit。
wn: your parents 是複數，要用 do。
do 後面接原形，visit 不加 s。

items.q: ___ any good restaurants near here? — Yes, ___ one on the corner.
items.why: restaurants 是複數，問句用 Are there；回答 one（一間），用 there's。
wn: restaurants 是複數，問句要用 Are there。
回答是 one 一間，要用 there's。

items.q: My cousin ___ English at a school, and his students ___ him.
items.why: My cousin 一個人，teach 加 es：teaches；his students 是複數，love 不加 s。
wn: 相反了：cousin 一個人用 teaches，students 用 love。
his students 是複數，love 不加 s。

items.q: My son is only two, so he ___ read yet, but he ___ count to ten.
items.why: 兩歲還小，所以還不會讀書 can't read yet；but 表示轉折，後面會數到十 can count。
wn: 順序反了，兩歲還不會讀書，yet 也常配否定。
but 表示前後相反，前面不會，後面應該是會。

items.q: She ___ me an email two days ago, but I ___ it.
items.why: two days ago 是過去：send 不規則，過去式是 sent；否定用 didn't＋原形 read。
wn: send 是不規則動詞，過去式是 sent。
didn't 後面接原形 read，而且沒有 readed 這個字。

items.q: I'd like ___ bread and ___ eggs, please.
items.why: bread 不可數，不能用 a；eggs 是複數，也不能用 a。兩個都用 some 表示一些。
wn: bread 不可數，不能說 a bread。
eggs 有 s 是複數，a 只配一個（an egg）。

items.q: We ___ go to bed late, so we ___ tired in the morning.
items.why: never 本身是否定，直接放動詞 go 前面；從不晚睡，所以早上不累，tired 是形容詞用 aren't。
wn: never 已經是否定，不能再加 don't；不晚睡應該不累。
tired 是形容詞，否定用 aren't，不用 don't。

items.q: ___ you like some more rice? — No, thanks. I'm full.
items.why: 回答 No, thanks. I'm full.，可見是問要不要再吃。請人吃東西用 Would you like…?
wn: Do you like rice? 是問平常喜不喜歡，不是問現在要不要。
like 是動詞，前面不用 be 動詞，沒有 Are you like 的說法。

items.q: Excuse me, ___ this seat free?
items.why: 主詞是 this seat，只有一個座位，be 動詞用 is。
wn: are 配複數，this seat 只有一個。

items.q: What ___ they ___ do after the class?
items.why: 問打算做什麼用 What＋be 動詞＋主詞＋going to＋原形；they 用 are。
wn: be going to 要配 be 動詞：are they going to。
要用 going to，不是 go to。

items.q: My parents ___ doctors, but my brother ___ a nurse.
items.why: My parents 是兩個人，用 are；my brother 是一個人，用 is。
wn: 相反了：parents 複數用 are，brother 單數用 is。
my brother 只有一個人，要用 is。

items.q: There ___ too much sugar in this coffee. I don't want ___ more.
items.why: sugar 不可數，當單數用 is；I don't want 是否定句，「一點都不要」用 any。
wn: sugar 不可數要用 is；否定句也要用 any。
don't want 是否定句，要用 any。

items.q: 「hello」是什麼意思？
items.why: hello＝你好。例句：Hello! Nice to meet you.

items.q: 「email」是什麼意思？
items.why: email＝電子郵件。例句：What is your email?

items.q: 「wife」是什麼意思？
items.why: wife＝妻子。例句：She is his wife.

items.q: 「check the phone」是什麼意思？
items.why: check the phone＝看手機。例句：He checks his phone in bed.

items.q: 「Friday」是什麼意思？
items.why: Friday＝星期五。例句：They go shopping on Friday.

items.q: 「bookshelf」是什麼意思？
items.why: bookshelf＝書架。例句：There are many books on the bookshelf.

items.q: 「chicken」是什麼意思？
items.why: chicken＝雞肉。例句：Would you like some chicken?

items.q: 「any apples」是什麼意思？
items.why: any apples＝一些蘋果（疑問/否定）。例句：Do you have any apples?

items.q: 「no, I didn't」是什麼意思？
items.why: no, I didn't＝不，我沒有。例句：Did you go home? No, I didn't.

items.q: 「painting」是什麼意思？
items.why: painting＝繪畫。例句：My sister enjoys painting pictures.

items.q: What time does Peter usually start work?
items.passage: Peter is a chef at a small restaurant in Tainan. He usually works from four o'clock until midnight, so he doesn't see his family very often. Last month, the restaurant was closed for two weeks, and Peter went to Hualien with his wife and daughter. They stayed in a small hotel near the sea. There was a beach in front of the hotel, and every morning they swam before breakfast. Peter's daughter can't swim well, so she played in the sand. On the last day, they bought some tea and cookies for Peter's parents. Next year, Peter is going to open his own restaurant. His wife is going to help him, and his daughter would like to make the desserts.
items.why: 原文：He usually works from four o'clock until midnight. 四點開始上班。
wn: midnight 午夜是 until 後面，是下班時間。
早餐前是他們在花蓮游泳的時間，不是上班。

items.q: Why did Peter go to Hualien last month?
opts: He wanted to open a restaurant there.
The restaurant was closed for two weeks.

His wife is going to help him, and his daughter would like to make the desserts.
items.why: 原文：the restaurant was closed for two weeks, and Peter went to Hualien.
wn: 開餐廳是明年的計畫，文中沒說要開在花蓮。
文中沒說父母住花蓮；茶和餅乾是買給父母的。

items.q: Where was the beach?
items.passage: Peter is a chef at a small restaurant in Tainan. He usually works from four o'clock until midnight, so he doesn't see his family very often. Last month, the restaurant was closed for two weeks, and Peter went to Hualien with his wife and daughter. They stayed in a small hotel near the sea. There was a beach in front of the hotel, and every morning they swam before breakfast. Peter's daughter can't swim well, so she played in the sand. On the last day, they bought some tea and cookies for Peter's parents. Next year, Peter is going to open his own restaurant. His wife is going to help him, and his daughter would like to make the desserts.
items.why: 原文：There was a beach in front of the hotel. 海灘在飯店前面。
wn: behind 是後面；原文是 in front of 前面。
文中沒說海灘在餐廳旁邊，是在飯店前面。

items.q: Why did Peter's daughter play in the sand?
items.passage: Peter is a chef at a small restaurant in Tainan. He usually works from four o'clock until midnight, so he doesn't see his family very often. Last month, the restaurant was closed for two weeks, and Peter went to Hualien with his wife and daughter. They stayed in a small hotel near the sea. On the last day, they bought some tea and cookies for Peter's parents. Next year, Peter is going to open his own restaurant. His wife is going to help him, and his daughter would like to make the desserts.
items.why: 原文：She can't swim well, so she played in the sand. so 前面就是原因。
wn: 文中沒說她不喜歡海，是因為她游不好。
文中沒說她很累，是因為她游不好。

items.q: What is Peter going to do next year?
items.passage: Peter is a chef at a small restaurant in Tainan. He usually works from four o'clock until midnight, so he doesn't see his family very often. Last month, the restaurant was closed for two weeks, and Peter went to Hualien with his wife and daughter. They stayed in a small hotel near the sea. There was a beach in front of the hotel, and every morning they swam before breakfast. Peter's daughter can't swim well, so she played in the sand. On the last day, they bought some tea and cookies for Peter's parents. Next year, Peter is going to open his own restaurant. His wife is going to help him, and his daughter would like to make the desserts.
items.why: 原文：Next year, Peter is going to open his own restaurant.
wn: 花蓮是上個月去玩的地方，不是明年的計畫。
買茶和餅乾是在花蓮最後一天，已經做過了。
